flags: no pay stated in the ad or the feed, verify vs floor
Early-stage YC startup; Skilled Worker sponsorship capacity and a GBP 70k+ base are both uncertain at this size.
CRM is Attio, not Salesforce or HubSpot; his admin evidence transfers but there is no production CRM ownership history.
Culture signals long in-office hours and high intensity ('not for everyone', late-night dinners), which is worth probing early.
Sells into NHS GP practices, a public-sector buyer, so the sales motion differs from the enterprise SaaS renewals he knows.
verdict: Strong pivot-building RevOps IC role suiting his build fluency; sponsorship and London comp at a small startup are the real risks.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
About Pleo 
Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.
The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.
Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.
 About the role 
We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help our high-touch, Mid Market customers achieve success and maximise the value of Pleo’s solutions and be part of a dynamic and collaborative team as we scale our innovative expense management platform across the UK & Ireland
If you're excited about solving customer challenges, and driving growth through exceptional service and are passionate about Customer Success in the SaaS industry, then this is the opportunity for you!
 Who you’ll be working with and reporting to 
You’ll report to our Director of CX and work closely with teams in CX, Onboarding, AM, Sales and Product. Our team of 30 is highly collaborative and dedicated to Customer Experience.
 What you’ll be doing 
As a Senior Customer Success Manager, your main markets will be UKI customers. You will:
Nurture, support and process expansion for any opportunity from the customer base
As a customer's trusted product advisor and business consultant advise them on how to create their ideal processes with the tool to optimise their value-add
Own the adoption journey of your customer portfolio (after the onboarding phase)
Collaborate across teams with different internal stakeholders such as product management, services & solutions, marketing, customer support, etc. to improve the entire customer experience
Receive, qualify and triage all inbound communication from all communication channels; email, Intercom (web chat), and/or other performance marketing channels
Cultivate key customers to become advocates of Pleo and the Fintech community
Manage day-to-day operations and long-term business relationships with our customers
Do everything in your power to prevent customers from leaving Pleo through measuring health scores, and product/feature adoption and acting proactively on those
Optimise the product-market-fit by building the bridge between the customer's feedback and our product team
 What you bring 
You’ll thrive in this role if:
You have 7+ years of prior experience in account management or sales or customer success roles
You have an open mindset that always looks for the positive. Your customers and colleagues find your energy contagious
You truly enjoy helping others move and improve. You love helping your customers scale and grow
You love goals and objectives. You don't always need to be given tasks – you create your own tasks while chasing your targets, and it motivates you to reach them
You love a fast-paced and dynamic environment, where you have different kinds of tasks - from customer calls to meetings with our product team
This is a high volume, high velocity role. Being able to think and do things at scale is a huge plus
You are a trustworthy person who always ensures that deadlines are reached, promises are kept, and you do what is expected of you
You are empathetic. You have a strong ability to feel how others are doing. You are also able to communicate in a very empathetic way and touch people's emotions
You are fluent in English
 Why is this role a good fit for you 
This role is a good fit for you if:
You enjoy building long-term relationships with high-touch, Mid Market customers and taking ownership of their success from adoption through expansion.
You thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment and feel energised by balancing customer conversations, internal collaboration, and proactive problem-solving.
You’re motivated by impact and outcomes — helping customers grow, spotting expansion opportunities, and turning feedback into meaningful product improvements excites you.
This role is not a good fit for you if:
You’re not motivated by customer-facing work or influencing customer outcomes through proactive engagement and collaboration.
You’re uncomfortable with project management or coordinating multiple initiatives at the same time.
You’re not motivated by upselling, cross-selling, or optimising the long-term value of your customers’ accounts.
 How you’ll develop in this role 
In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:
Lead customer adoption projects to drive impact in helping high-touch, Mid Market clients maximise the value of Pleo’s solutions.
Collaborate with Customer Success and Product teams to improve customer experience processes and feedback loops.
Grow your skills in relationship management and upselling strategies, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale.
We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in customer success.
 The location 
London, UK
 Show me the benefits 
Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays
For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice
We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work
The interview process 
We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:
Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.
A 30-45 minute call with the Hiring Manager
Our Pleo Challenge - an opportunity for you to showcase your ability in the form of a presentation and how you would approach the task at hand
Final Interview - Our Bar Raiser meeting - how would you raise the bar for us?
Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!
Last time we hired a CSM, we received many applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:
CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!
Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.
 About your application 
 English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
 A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
 Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
 Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
 Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here .
 Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
 Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.
flags: CSM in UK-London at a non-standout company
no pay stated in the ad or the feed, verify vs floor
High-volume, high-velocity mid-market book with inbound triage via Intercom reads closer to scaled CS than strategic enterprise CSM.
London Skilled Worker floor of ~GBP 70,000 is a stretch for a mid-market Senior CSM; sponsorship unconfirmed.
verdict: Solid experience fit at a known fintech, but a lateral, high-volume UK CSM role that does little for the RevOps pivot.

title: Principal Analyst II, Revenue Operations
description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. 
When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
 Principal Analyst II, Revenue Operations 
 Why We Have This Role 
The Revenue Strategy & Operations team ensures that our global sales/revenue organization is positioned to achieve their highest potential by optimizing revenue opportunities across the globe. We do this by leveraging data from many sources, including internal customer purchasing and usage information as well as firmographic, technographic, and intent data from 3rd party sources. We set high targets for our revenue teams and work to exceed them every quarter. Part of our success comes from having world-class business processes, systems, and tools. We love data and we love to show results in the form of more Sales success. We have impressive members on this team, and will continue to add more top talent!
Qualtrics is seeking a Field Operations Partner to support our EMEA Sales Teams, responsible for setting new business and renewal targets, optimizing territories to ensure the greatest opportunity for each individual rep's success, and leading other key strategic revenue-enhancing initiatives.
 How You’ll Find Success 
Love working with data and learning new things
Love helping others find solutions to problems
Excellent problem solving, decision-making and analytical skills
Ability to collaborate with teams across the organization while also being able to work independently and as a self-starter
Proven ability to meet aggressive deadlines
 How You’ll Grow 
Leadership Exposure: significant exposure to key leaders in the EMEA sales organization, providing the opportunity to work closely with them as a trusted advisor. Helping you develop strong leadership and communication skills, as well as a deep understanding of the company's strategic vision.
Strategic Thinking: The role involves collaborating with leadership to develop and implement go-to-market strategies. This strategic involvement will allow you to expand your strategic thinking and planning capabilities, which are highly valuable skills for career growth.
GTM (Go-To-Market) Expertise: As the role involves working closely with sales & success leaders and monitoring performance metrics, it provides an ideal environment for someone looking to deepen their understanding of the GTM processes and methodologies.
 Things You’ll Do 
Serve as trusted advisor to EMEA leadership, shaping go-to-market strategy across a diverse set of countries and market maturities.
Drive forecasting rigor across a multi-country book of business - accounting for currency, seasonality, and market-specific buying cycles.
Monitor pipeline development, conversion rates, and rep productivity by country/sub-region; partner with leaders to close performance gaps.
Own annual and quarterly GTM planning - business modeling, quota setting, headcount/capacity modeling, and territory design across direct and partner-led markets.
Partner with Ecosystem teams to mature channel programs in markets where a direct sales model isn't viable, and govern partner performance and reporting.
Drive adoption of tools, processes, and operating rhythms - accounting for language, timezone, and cultural differences - from front line to senior leadership.
Build cross-functional relationships with Finance, Marketing, Enablement, and Ecosystem teams to align regional strategy with execution.
Key Metrics You’ll Own. Own performance reporting and executive insights across for all revenue. Key metrics include:
New ACV and Renewals
Forecast accuracy across a multi-currency, multi-country pipeline
Pipeline creation, coverage, and conversion
Average deal size and sales cycle length
Sales productivity & win rates
 What We’re Looking For On Your Resume 
7+ years of relevant experience in Sales, Sales Operations, Finance, or Management Consulting with a focus on the following: Forecasting, go-to-market (GTM) execution, sales compensation and incentive plan creation, and partnering with senior sales leaders
At least 5 years of experience in the software industry and cloud platform businesses
Salesforce.com (SFDC) reporting and analytics experience required
Experience with Power BI or Tableau, or other data visualization tools
Experience operating in a multi-country, multi-currency environment, ideally spanning both direct and partner-led markets
Familiarity with GDPR and local compliance considerations as they affect compensation design and data reporting
 What You Should Know About This Team 
Supportive environment with opportunities to work both autonomously and collaboratively
Fun, inviting, and inclusive team made up of passionate, kind, and smart people who exemplify what it means to be Customer Obsessed
Continuous Improvement guides our path forward
 Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits 
Wellness Reimbursement each quarter to reimburse wellness activities including gym memberships, massages, workout equipment, meditation apps, and more
Amazing QGroup Communities; MOSAIQ, Green Team, Qualtrics Pride, Q&Able, Qualtrics Salute, and Women’s Leadership Development, which exist as places for support, allyship, and advocacy.
Competitive benefits packages
 The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model : Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid
 Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic. 
 ​​​​​​​Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws: Family & Medical Leave Act , Equal Opportunity Employment , Employee Polygraph Protection Act 
 Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know. 
 Not finding a role that’s the right fit for now? Qualtrics Insiders is the one-stop shop for all things Qualtrics Life. Sign up for exclusive access to content created with you in mind and get the scoop on what we have going on at Qualtrics - upcoming events, behind the scenes stories from the team, interview tips, hot jobs, and more. No spam - we promise! You'll hear from us two times a month max with fresh, totally tailored info - so be sure to stay connected as you explore your best role and company fit.
flags: title band: analyst -- check the JD for actual scope and comp
no pay stated in the ad or the feed, verify vs floor
Role owns quota setting, territory design and capacity modeling; his only evidence is one MBA case study.
The requirements section is truncated, so stated years of experience and tool must-haves were not checked.
Multi-country EMEA forecasting and channel/partner governance are outside his post-sale account-level experience.
verdict: Bullseye function at a tier-1 brand, but planning-heavy scope exceeds his evidence; apply and lead with the Factorial model and post-sale depth.

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE
We're hiring a Revenue Operations Specialist/Manager to run and own the business layer of RevOps alongside Sales, CS, and Marketing. As a partner to the GTM leaders and teams, you'll own their operating rhythm day to day and translate their requirements into precise, build-ready requests.
ABOUT DATASNIPPER 🚀
Audit and finance are still massively manual and we are changing that. DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms.
Now, we are taking things further with our Excel Agent, bringing AI directly into where the work actually happens. Unlike generic AI tools, we do not sit on the sidelines. Our AI operates inside Excel, with access to real documents and audit evidence, meaning it does not just generate answers, it does the work, with full traceability.
We are not just applying AI, we are redefining how audit gets done. If you want to build something category-defining at scale, this is the place.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Define and run the operating rhythm
 - Run point in pipeline reviews, weekly syncs, and QBR prep across Sales, CS, and Marketing.
 - Own the full QBR end to end - narrative, data pull, slides, pre-read, agenda, and follow-up actions.
 - Pull and interpret the numbers before every pipeline review or weekly sync - not just the data, but the story behind it.
Translate field needs into build-ready briefs
 - Convert business and system needs from any of the three functions into precise, build-ready briefs that GTM Engineering can execute against immediately, helping achieve your goals alongside the GTM leaders.
Own process and drive improvement
 - Own the operating model for the functions you support - how deals move through stages, handoff criteria, what "at-risk" means, what a qualified opportunity looks like.
 - Spot what's breaking - a misfiring routing rule, a renewal that fell through a process gap - and drive the fix, whether that's a system request, a process change, or a direct conversation.
Shape planning and quota-setting
 - Bring Sales, CS, and Marketing context into annual planning and quota-setting, stress-testing whether targets are realistic against what you see on the ground.
WHAT YOU BRING
 - 2-3+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Success Operations, or Marketing Operations, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment, with a hunger to innovate, learn, and self-start in a fast-paced environment.
 - Technical comfort. You're comfortable working in HubSpot or an equivalent CRM day to day, and understand the basics of Customer Revenue Systems.
 - Sharp communication. You can translate ambiguous asks into precise, actionable briefs in a room full of stakeholders.
 - An ownership habit. Detail-oriented and organised, you own a QBR end to end rather than handing off pieces of it.
 - Cross-functional range. You're comfortable supporting Sales, CS, and Marketing at once, switching between their different rhythms and priorities day to day, and are eager to bridge context between these teams.
 - AI-forward. You use AI tools to speed up data pulls, QBR prep, and briefs, and you're always looking for the next manual step to automate.
What you'll work with:
 - CRM and prospecting: HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Dealhub
 - Contracts and commissions: Juro, DocuSign, Qobra
 - Data and AI: Snowflake, Claude
Haven't used all of these? That's fine. Strong CRM basics matter most, and we'll help you learn the rest.
Nice to have:
A HubSpot certification (or similar), or experience building AI assisted RevOps workflows.
WHAT WE OFFER
 - Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact.
 - Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth.
 - Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary.
 - 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance.
 - Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office.
 - Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energised.
 - NS business card for easy commuting to the office.
 - A structured onboarding programme designed to set you up for success, including dedicated time to learn our product and customers before you hit the ground running.

title: Revenue Operations Expert | Legal Tech Scale-up
description:
Saga is a legal innovation company on a mission to remove the friction between legal expertise and real-world impact, so lawyers can focus on what matters the most: people, ethics, and impact. Founded in Norway and built for the legal profession from day one, we integrate with local legal sources across multiple jurisdictions and are currently available in 12 languages.  Your role as Revenue Operations Expert 
This is Saga's first dedicated Revenue Operations role, which means you'd be building the foundation rather than inheriting one. Right now, RevOps work sits spread across different people and functions, and your job is to bring it together into something clear, reliable and scalable. You'll own HubSpot end to end, along with the reporting, data and automation around it, working closely with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Finance team. title: Revenue Operations Manager – London
description:
Location: London (Oval), United Kingdom
 Type: Full-time. Office-based
👋 I’m Oren, Co-founder of Zen Educate
We’re looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to turbo-charge our next chapter of growth in the UK.
If you love designing elegant solutions to complex problems, turning data into meaningful stories and rolling up your sleeves to drive user adoption of processes you create, then keep reading.
 🌍 Why we exist
 Education is the cornerstone of a thriving society. Schools do their utmost to provide children with positive experiences, but having the right staff is essential to fulfilling that promise - that’s where we come in. Whether it’s a Year 1 teacher to greet her “good morning” or a Teaching Assistant to support him in the break times, Zen helps schools find the right educators faster without breaking the bank.
Schools in the UK spend over £2bn a year on agency staff. Zen is an all-in-one digital platform that gives schools full control over how they find, vet, and manage temporary educators. School leaders can search, book, and manage staff in real time, while gaining full visibility and control over their spend and compliance.
To go with our technology, we practice a culture of “we care more”, so that ultimately, by improving staffing in schools, we’re delivering thousands of smiles to children’s faces every single day. What we need now is sharper, faster insight to power the next stage of growth. That’s where you come in.
 🌱 What We Are Looking For
 We’ve built strong foundations already:
We are one of the leading suppliers in our industry and one of the fastest growing companies in the UK. 
A high-performing and highly motivated team in place. 
A differentiated product that makes a genuine impact on the lives of educators and pupils. 
 We’re now looking to level up even further. You’ll be excited about this role if you:
Love mapping out processes and deeply understanding problems with stakeholders, before designing solutions. 
Communicate and collaborate equally effectively with ICs adopting your suggested solutions as you do with leaders struggling with repetitive admin. 
Can deliver at pace while maintaining accuracy. You’re equally passionate about pushing teams forward as you are about maintaining everyone’s trust in the data they see. 
Are as comfortable rolling out new processes to 100 people as you are in creating dashboards or data visualisations. 
 Some traits that usually correlate with success in this role:
You’re passionate about making real world impact on the education system. 
You think BIG, not only incrementally. In three years the revenue operations function will be unrecognisable from where it is now. 
You’re process-led and hyper-structured. You plan meticulously to deliver commercial results by building playbooks that don’t rely on you on an ongoing basis. 
 What your first 6-12 months might look like:
Turbo-charge the sales team by taking over the management of our recent hubspot implementation. 
Motivate a high performing account management team even further by improving the commissions process. 
Deliver world class service to our largest customers by designing processes that connect commercial contracts to the finance process seamlessly. 
Increase profitability by implementing automation to replace repetitive admin carried out by commercial ICs. 
 Who You’ll Work With
 We’re a 500+ (and growing!) team operating across the UK, US, and Canada. We’re well funded, growing fast, and have tremendous unit economics. Simply put, we’re doing really well by doing good. As such, we’re a passionate group of missionaries rather than mercenaries. We’re looking to find someone who shares our passion for the mission of making education better.
 What You Might Like Or Dislike
 Every place makes trade-offs based on what they value and where they are in their journey.
Here’s a list of things you might find useful in figuring out if this is the right role for you. If we end up chatting, feel free to dig deeper into any of them:
Slope and passion over Y-intercept. High-trajectory individuals with a passion for what they do very quickly lap those with a higher initial starting point in their domain but slower trajectory. That means that how you go about tackling hard unstructured problems matters to us more than your experience with a specific tool or industry. 
First principles reasoning rather than replicating other companies best practices: we believe every situation has nuance. Experience is an input in decision making, but not the only one. The leaders that do best are endlessly curious and deconstruct problems to first principles. They’re not just making decisions because they’ve seen them work at previous companies, they experiment a lot and double down only on the successful ones. 
Building the system rather than individual heroics: having great players on the pitch is critical. However, a great system trumps the best performer without one. We’ve got a product with genuine product market-fit that makes our customers’ lives better. We’re looking for someone who can level up systems and then extract themselves from them to tackle the next big problem. 
🎁 Perks & benefits
Competitive salary + ownership in the company. 
25 days holiday + all the usual UK public holidays. 
A central London (dog friendly!) office with perks like fresh fruit, bike parking, showers, an on-site gym, and a café. 
Meaningful work - this isn’t just another SaaS tool; you’re literally helping schools save money and pay teachers more. 
1-1 coaching to keep you growing personally and professionally.

Join a certified B Corp: where your work creates a real, positive impact.

 At Zen, we strive to build a culture of equity and inclusion, where everyone is respected, valued and appreciated for their unique traits, experiences and perspectives. We are committed to creating a safe, inclusive and equitable environment where our team can thrive, regardless of age, ethnicity, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, disability, religion or beliefs. We value our differences and believe that practices of Diversity, Equity and Inclusion help us create a fairer, more compassionate environment for all.
We welcome applicants with diverse backgrounds and different experiences and perspectives - just like the staff who teach through Zen and the children at the schools we work with. We believe in hiring the best people from the widest pool and creating an inclusive culture where people’s voices are heard and all our team can look forward to coming to work.
We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and promoting an equitable and inclusive environment for all. We seek out diverse opinions, beliefs, and experiences because they collectively make us stronger; we’ve had former teachers, pilots, fundraisers, engineers, lawyers, marketers, social media experts and more join our team.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Customer Success Manager 
 Remote 
 Employment Type: Full-Time 
 About Nsight Health 
 Nsight Health is transforming how care is delivered through Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), Chronic Care Management (CCM), and Behavioral Health Integration (BHI). We empower healthcare providers to manage chronic conditions using real-time data, AI-enabled technology, and 24/7 clinical support. Our HIPAA-compliant platform connects patients and care teams nationwide—improving outcomes, adherence, and peace of mind. Join a fast-growing, mission-driven team that blends healthcare and technology to make a measurable difference in people’s lives. 
 Nsight Health — Where Technology Meets Compassion. 
 Position Summary 
 We are seeking a Customer Success Manager to own the health and retention of a portfolio of provider accounts. Reporting to the Director of Customer Success, you are the senior point of contact above the front line — the person providers trust with their hardest questions and the one who keeps their program delivering value month over month. 
 You own account health, drive retention, move accounts onto durable long-term agreements, and project manage complex issues to clean resolution. You partner with the Customer Growth team in a shared pod model to keep your accounts both healthy and expanding, and you bring clinical value to the foreground — surfacing outcomes, care gaps, and trends that show providers exactly what the program is doing for their patients. 
 Our clients are sophisticated physicians, and you meet them with equal credibility. You engage escalations directly, de-escalate with composure, and turn pressure into a stronger relationship. This is a role for someone who takes real ownership of their book, fights for every account, and is energized by keeping it healthy as the company grows. 
 AI Fluency Requirement - Non-Negotiable 
 Nsight Health is an AI-first organization. Every member of our leadership and operations team is expected to actively use AI tools in their day-to-day work - not as a novelty, but as a core productivity multiplier. This role requires genuine curiosity about AI, comfort experimenting with tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and workflow automation platforms, and the judgment to know when AI helps and when it doesn't. If AI makes you uncomfortable, this is not the right role. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Account Health and Retention : Own the health and status of your assigned accounts against a clear green, yellow, and red standard, keeping a direct line to each decision maker so every account can be championed when it counts. Own retention on your accounts, surfacing risk early and pulling in your Director, Support, Implementation, and Customer Growth partners to keep at-risk accounts whole. Move your accounts onto durable long-term agreements that protect and compound the book. Own the warm handoff from Sales and Growth into Customer Success at go-live, confirming that what was sold is what gets delivered. 
 Issue Resolution and Service : Serve as the senior point of contact above the front line, engaging providers directly to resolve and de-escalate the hardest issues with composure. Project manage issues to resolution, coordinating Support and Implementation to close them cleanly and keep the provider informed throughout. Action non-adherent patients and bring proactive clinical value to your providers, using care gaps, outcome trending, and program reporting to raise the value they see in the program. Run quarterly business reviews and provider reporting, keeping clinical results and program value in front of every account you own. 
 Cadence and Collaboration : Participate in the Customer Success deep dive and escalation sync, the dedicated team session for working escalations and account detail. Partner in the pod model with Customer Growth, using the healthy tension between retention and growth to keep your accounts both well and expanding. Stay tightly aligned with the Implementation and Support teams so that handoffs are clean and issues resolve quickly. 
 Data and Continuous Improvement : Maintain accurate account health, status, and activity in HubSpot so that your book reads clearly to your Director and leadership. Bring an honest read on client health, risk, and retention to your Director on a regular cadence, flagging accounts that need help early. 
 The Impact You’ll Make 
 Revenue Protection That Compounds : Every account you keep green, every at-risk relationship you turn around, and every long-term agreement you close directly protects and grows the revenue base that powers Nsight Health's mission. Your book is not just a portfolio. It is the foundation the business builds on. 
 Clinical Outcomes That Matter : By surfacing care gaps, outcome trends, and program results in front of sophisticated physicians, you are not just managing a relationship — you are demonstrating that the program is genuinely improving patient lives. That is what keeps providers enrolled and engaged for the long term. 
 The Standard for Provider Trust : In a market where providers have been let down by vendors before, the way you show up — with credibility, composure, and a willingness to own the hard conversations — sets the standard for what a true healthcare partnership looks like. 
 Qualifications 
 Required : 
 Three or more years in Customer Success, client services, or account management in a multi-client environment. 
 Proven track record of owning account relationships and reducing churn or improving retention. 
 Strong project management and de-escalation skills, with the willingness to own the hardest accounts personally. 
 Clinically literate, or able to become fluent quickly, and comfortable speaking to clinical outcomes with providers. 
 High AI fluency, meaning active, working use of AI tools in your daily professional workflow. 
 Strong analytical ability, able to read a health scoring view, diagnose why an account is at risk, and execute a plan to fix it. 
 Preferred: 
 Experience in remote care, RPM, CCM, or chronic care management and provider-facing relationships. 
 Experience working within health scoring, quarterly business review frameworks, onboarding programs, and escalation protocols. 
 Hands-on experience inside HubSpot or Salesforce, including health score tracking and reporting. 
 Background in a PE-backed or venture-backed high-growth environment where speed and accountability were expectations rather than aspirations. 
 Experience operating in a pod model alongside a growth or sales team. 
 Compensation & Benefits 
 Competitive base pay: $110,000 – $135,000 annually. 
 Additional Compensation: 
 Performance-Based Bonus: Eligible for an annual bonus based on company and individual performance. 
 Benefits Include: 
 PTO Accrual 
 Medical, Dental, Vision, and supplemental insurance options 
 401(k) Plan with 3.5% Company Match 
 Company-provided equipment 
 Join Our Mission-Driven Team 
 At Nsight Health, you will be part of a fast-growing organization at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and compassion. We are looking for a Customer Success Manager who takes real ownership of their book, shows up with clinical credibility and commercial instinct, and is energized by the challenge of keeping sophisticated provider relationships healthy, growing, and built to last. 
 Recruitment Fraud Alert 
 Nsight Health takes candidate safety seriously. Please be aware that fraudulent individuals may impersonate our recruiters or employees and offer fake employment opportunities. 
 All legitimate interviews with Nsight Health are conducted through our formal hiring process, and employment offers are only extended after candidates have successfully completed required interviews and evaluations. Official employment offers are communicated by a member of our team via a scheduled phone call. title: Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager (CSM)
description:
About Fable 
Global enterprises work with Fable to make products more accessible for over one billion people who live with disabilities. Our customers include global leaders like Walmart, Slack, and Shopify. Fable was featured on the Forbes Accessibility 100 list in 2025, awarded Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies in Design, and has received accolades from global entities like the World Summit Awards and the UN-endorsed Zero Project. 
 About the role 
Fable is seeking a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager to own customer retention and drive sustained product usage across a portfolio of enterprise accounts. Working with leading global brands, you will help customers achieve meaningful business outcomes and make Fable an integral part of how they design, build, and improve their products. 
A critical part of this role is building trusted relationships with senior leaders across accessibility, design, product, UX, engineering, and research . You will proactively engage these leaders, understand their priorities, and connect Fable’s value to their strategic goals. By cultivating executive sponsorship and relationships beyond a single champion, you will strengthen customer commitment, broaden adoption across teams, and secure support for continued investment in inclusive research. 
You will own the customer journey from onboarding and adoption through renewal, with direct accountability for retention and long-term customer value. This means actively growing platform usage, helping customers establish consistent accessibility research practices, and ensuring they can demonstrate the impact of their investment. You will use product usage data and customer insights to identify churn risks early, address barriers to adoption, and lead action plans that improve engagement and protect renewals. 
Success in this role is measured by customer retention, renewal performance, and the depth and consistency of product usage across your portfolio. You will also identify expansion opportunities grounded in demonstrated value, strong stakeholder relationships, and customer needs. 
This role directly advances Fable’s mission to empower people with disabilities to participate, contribute, and shape society by helping customers embed inclusive practices throughout product development. 
We welcome applicants based in the Greater Toronto areas who can work within North American time zones. 
Responsibilities 
Product adoption & usage 
Own adoption and sustained product usage across your portfolio, helping customers embed Fable into their product development and research workflows. 
Build and execute shared success plans with measurable usage goals, business outcomes, milestones, and clear ownership. Provide strategic guidance and enablement that turn these plans into consistent accessibility research practices. 
Proactively analyze usage and engagement to identify adoption barriers and churn risks. Lead targeted action plans to reengage customers, deepen feature adoption, and broaden usage across teams. 
Retention & commercial management 
Own customer retention and the renewal process from planning through signature, with accountability for gross revenue retention (GRR) and net revenue retention (NRR) targets. 
Build compelling renewal business cases that connect product usage and research outcomes to customer priorities. Identify expansion opportunities grounded in demonstrated value and customer needs, partnering with Sales to advance them. 
Prepare and manage renewal proposals and order forms, coordinating with Legal, Security, Finance, and Sales to navigate contract and procurement requirements. 
Maintain accurate renewal forecasts, proactively manage timelines and risks, and lead commercial conversations that protect customer relationships and deliver sustainable outcomes for Fable. 
Senior leadership relationships & advocacy 
Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across accessibility, design, product, UX, engineering, and research, understanding their priorities and connecting Fable’s value to their strategic goals. 
Cultivate executive sponsorship and relationships beyond a single champion to strengthen account resilience, expand adoption, and secure support for continued investment. 
Lead business reviews that demonstrate customer impact, align stakeholders on progress, and secure clear commitments to address adoption barriers and support renewal. 
Develop customer advocates and identify opportunities for references, case studies, and sharing meaningful accessibility outcomes. 
Cross functional alignment & support 
Partner with Platform Support and Innovation teams to resolve issues, remove adoption barriers, and deliver a consistent customer experience. 
Coordinate with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Finance on account plans and actions that improve usage, retention, and growth. 
Translate customer feedback, usage patterns, and renewal insights into actionable input for product and roadmap discussions. 
Improve Customer Success processes, playbooks, and engagement strategies using lessons from your portfolio to strengthen adoption and retention at scale. 
Requirements
 Key qualifications and assets 
4+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role. 
3+ years of managing enterprise customer relationships. 
Experience supporting renewals, commercial discussions, and cross-functional deal coordination. 
Experience using or experimenting with AI for research, preparation, follow-ups, analysis, or workflow automation. 
Demonstrated ability to adapt and evolve ways of working with AI tools to drive new approaches, improve processes, and increase day-to-day efficiency. 
Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment. 
Proficiency with CRM and CS platforms such as HubSpot 
Willing to learn about accessibility and follow inclusive design practices   
 Our values 
 To lead, listen first 
You amplify voices that are less often heard and create space for those voices to grow. The quality of an idea doesn't correlate with the loudness of someone's voice. 
 The brain is a muscle 
If you're going to do something, you will do it well. Practice often and rest when needed. Give your mind what it needs to thrive. 
 Unlearn to learn 
What did we learn growing up, and what do we need to unlearn? It's essential to understanding our personal bias and position so that we can grow. 
Benefits
 What’s in it for you? 
At Fable, you’ll join a collaborative and mission-driven environment where you’ll work with people who care deeply about building a more inclusive digital world. We offer benefits such as stock options, career growth opportunities, professional development support, health and dental coverage, and more. 
 Accessibility accommodations 
Fable is an inclusive workplace. If you are facing any accessibility requirements or concerns regarding the hiring process or employment with us, please fill out this form or email us at jobs@makeitfable.com and include the subject line “Accessibility accommodation for Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager (CSM).” 
 Pay range 
$115,000 – $150,000 On-target earnings, the salary band is designed to reflect the range of skills and experience needed for the position and is subject to change. The final salary is based on relevant skills, experience, and internal equity. This posting reflects an existing vacancy. Artificial intelligence (AI) tools may be used to support part of the recruitment and selection process. However, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring managers.

title: Sales Operations Business Partner

You will bring the evidence to back it up.
This is a business partner role, not an analyst role. Reporting to the Revenue Operations Leader, Americas New Business, you will work side by side with Mid-Market Sales Leadership as a trusted advisor.  Forecast Integrity

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Build the dashboards and reporting infrastructure that give leadership visibility into performance, productivity, and pipeline generation.
Establish the metrics that distinguish top performers, diagnose the root causes of underperformance, and scale what works across the team.

Project-manage cross-functional initiatives spanning Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Engineering & Product, Finance, Recruiting, and Operations.

AI fluency: You have a practical instinct for using AI to increase your leverage. You also know its limits and hold its output to the same standard as your own work.
Advanced Excel or Sheets is a must. Experience with Salesforce, SQL, and BI tools is a plus.
Experience in Sales, Sales Strategy, Business Operations, or Revenue Operations is a plus.

title: Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager

About Us 
AfterShip, a Great Place to Work Certified company, is transforming the global eCommerce landscape. Founded in 2012, AfterShip is a post-purchase SaaS company on a mission to build the world’s leading automation platform for ecommerce merchants.
AfterShip unifies shipping & labels, order tracking, AI predictive delivery, and returns management into one system—giving merchants a single place to manage and automate everything that happens after checkout. By centralizing these workflows, AfterShip enables merchants to reduce customer support inquiries, deliver a more reliable and engaging customer experiences, and unlock incremental revenue at every post-purchase touchpoint.
AfterShip integrates seamlessly with eCommerce platforms including Shopify and TikTok Shop, and connects with more than 1,400+ carriers worldwide. Today, over 20,000 businesses—including Samsung, Gymshark, Mejuri, Dr. Squatch, and Alo Yoga—rely on AfterShip to turn every post-purchase moment into an opportunity to build trust, reduce costs, and drive repeat purchases.
Built for a global market from day one, AfterShip operates with an engineering-driven, internationally distributed team. The company employs more than 450 people across 8 offices, spanning North America, Europe, and Asia, and representing over 20 cities worldwide.
 Your Mission: 
We succeed when our customers succeed. Customer Success is not only a critical function at AfterShip, but a core value of the organization. As a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you'll own a portfolio of some of AfterShip's most strategic and commercially important accounts, including some of the industry's top DTC brands. These are our highest-value relationships, and you'll be trusted to protect and grow them.
This role goes beyond adoption and support. You'll lead complex commercial conversations, drive renewal and expansion outcomes, and build durable relationships across every level of the customer organization, from day-to-day operators to the executive suite. Your ability to influence senior stakeholders, deliver compelling business reviews, and negotiate win-win commercial outcomes will directly shape AfterShip's retention and growth trajectory.
This is a high-impact position within the growing global Customer Success team. As part of a global team, there may be a need to work outside of regular office hours for meetings with Europe or APAC. Meetings outside of regular business hours are planned with advance adequate notice.
 What You’ll Do: 
Own the end-to-end success of a portfolio of AfterShip's most strategic accounts, carrying direct responsibility for Net Dollar Retention, minimize churn and expansion targets.
Lead commercial negotiations for renewals, upgrades, and multi-year agreements, partnering with Sales and leadership to structure deals that protect revenue and deepen the partnership.
Build and execute proactive renewal strategies well ahead of contract dates, identifying risk early and mobilizing internal resources to defend and grow accounts, including in competitive situations.
Develop multi-threaded stakeholder maps across your accounts, cultivating champions and building trusted relationships with economic buyers and executive sponsors.
Prepare and present executive-level business reviews (QBRs/EBRs) that connect AfterShip's impact to the customer's business outcomes, using account performance metrics, industry insights, and ROI narratives to influence decision-makers and surface incremental opportunities.
Act as the strategic voice of your customers internally, working cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering across time zones to remove blockers and shape the product roadmap.
Lead onboarding for new strategic clients in close collaboration with implementation counterparts, ensuring time-to-value is fast and measurable.
Mentor and raise the bar for the broader CSM team, sharing best practices on commercial conversations, executive engagement, and business review craft.
Be willing to travel for onsite client meetings, executive sessions, and trade events (up to 20%).
 Who We're Looking For: 
5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related customer-facing role in SaaS, preferably in eCommerce, with a track record of managing strategic or enterprise-tier accounts.
Proven expertise in commercial negotiations and renewals, including navigating procurement, structuring pricing conversations, and defending revenue in competitive situations.
Demonstrated ability to own a revenue number, with a history of strong retention and expansion performance against quota.
Exceptional executive presence and stakeholder management skills, with experience building relationships and influencing at the VP and C-suite level.
A strong storyteller who can build and deliver business reviews that land with executives, translating data into a clear narrative about value, ROI, and opportunity.
Ability to understand and explain technical solutions in business terms to both clients and internal stakeholders.
Comfortable managing complex, multi-stakeholder accounts with competing priorities, and skilled at prioritization in a growth-paced environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
 At AfterShip, we know great talent doesn’t always fit every requirement. If you’re passionate about our mission and believe you can make an impact, we encourage you to apply.

We take immense pride in fostering a culture that’s inclusive, which has allowed us to surround ourselves with the industry's most talented professionals.

title: Revenue Operations Associate - B2B SaaS Fintech
description:
Landytech is on a mission to transform the way financial institutions, investment managers, asset owners and their advisers access, manage and use investment data. 
Powered by our investment technology platform, we help organisations bring together complex investment information, improve data accuracy and control, reduce manual processes and make better-informed decisions. 
We work with clients across multiple markets and jurisdictions and are continuing to expand our presence with sophisticated financial institutions globally. 
 Team & Role 
As Revenue Operations Associate, you will connect marketing, partnerships and sales around one set of data, processes and goals, and be the operational engine behind how Landytech goes to market. 
You will partner daily with leaders across marketing, sales, partnerships and customer-facing teams, and report to the Chief Revenue Officer. 
As we roll out AI strategies across the organisation, you will turn those ideas into working go-to-market (GTM) systems: cleaner data, faster workflows and sharper forecasting. We are looking for someone with genuine AI expertise and an AI-forward mindset, who can bring colleagues along. 
 What You Will Be Doing 
Design and maintain lead-to-revenue processes, including lead routing, scoring, handoffs, pipeline stages and deal desk rules. 
Align marketing, partnerships and sales on shared definitions, funnel metrics and SLAs. 
Report on territory, quota and compensation plan administration in partnership with Finance. 
Administer and optimise the GTM technology stack, including CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, enrichment and BI tools. 
Keep CRM data clean, governed and trusted, and own data hygiene standards across teams. 
Evaluate, procure and integrate new tools, and retire those that do not earn their place. 
Build dashboards and reporting for pipeline, conversion, retention and revenue performance. 
Lead the forecasting cadence and pipeline reviews with the CRO and GTM leaders. 
Turn analysis into clear recommendations on where to invest, fix or stop. 
Identify and prioritise AI use cases across the revenue lifecycle, and run pilots from idea to adoption. 
Build and document AI-assisted workflows, such as lead research, call summaries, forecasting support and automated data enrichment. 
Train and coach GTM teams to use AI tools effectively, and measure the impact on productivity and revenue. 
Partner with IT, Security and Legal to apply sound data privacy and governance standards to AI use. 
 Your Skills & Expertise 
We are looking for an experienced revenue operations professional who combines strong GTM operational discipline with genuine AI expertise. 
Ideally, you will have: 
3+ years' experience in revenue operations, sales operations or marketing operations at a B2B SaaS, technology or financial technology company. 
Hands-on CRM administration (HubSpot), plus experience with marketing automation and sales engagement tools. 
Strong analytical skills, including funnel metrics, forecasting models, BI tools and SQL or spreadsheet modelling. 
A proven ability to work across marketing, sales and partnerships and to align teams around shared processes and numbers. 
Process design skills: you can map a messy workflow, simplify it and get people to adopt the new version. 
Clear communication with senior leaders, able to explain the numbers and the recommendation in plain language. 
A self-starting, organised and detail-oriented approach, and ease working in a growing, changing environment. 
In particular, we are looking for an AI-forward operator who uses these tools daily and can bring others along: 
Practical fluency with generative AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot), with the skill to write effective prompts and build repeatable workflows. 
Experience applying AI within GTM work, such as AI features in the CRM and sales stack, automated enrichment, lead and account research, call analysis or forecasting support. 
Working knowledge of automation and integration tools to connect systems and agents into end-to-end workflows. 
A test-and-measure mindset: you can scope a pilot, define success metrics and decide whether to scale, adjust or stop. 
Awareness of AI risks, including data privacy, accuracy and bias, and sound judgement about when to keep a human in the loop. 
Enthusiasm for change management: you can teach, document and drive adoption, not only build. 
The following would be advantageous: 
Experience in fintech, wealth management or other data-heavy B2B software. 
Partner or channel operations experience, including referral and alliance tracking. 
Familiarity with revenue intelligence, conversation intelligence or CPQ tools. 
Basic scripting (Python or similar) for data work and automation. 
Prior experience launching an AI or automation programme within a GTM team. 
 What Success Looks Like 
You will be successful in this role if you can combine strong operational execution with a practical, measurable approach to AI across the go-to-market teams. 
 First 90 days: Audit the GTM stack, data quality and funnel definitions; agree a shared metrics set with marketing, partnerships and sales; and deliver a prioritised roadmap of operational and AI opportunities. 
 By month 6: Ship a trusted pipeline and forecast dashboard, standardise lead-to-close handoffs, and launch at least two AI pilots with defined success metrics. 
 By month 12: Run a predictable forecasting rhythm, scale proven AI workflows across GTM teams, and show measurable gains in productivity, conversion or cycle time.

Hybrid working

description:
Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online. 
Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.
But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year , reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.
Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.
 What We Offer 
 Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.
 Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.
 Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.
 Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.
 Position Summary: 
Reporting to the Director, Customer Success, the Strategic Customer Success Manager plays a pivotal role in maintaining and growing customer health and revenue by aligning customer needs, product capabilities, and evolving use cases. This position combines entrepreneurial drive, deep technical aptitude, and collaborative leadership with the ability to influence senior leaders and work across high-profile customers in Payments, Marketplaces, Online Trading, Crypto, Banking, and Wealth Management. As a strategic member of the team, you partner with peers and senior executives across Trulioo and customer organizations to drive customer outcomes, expand adoption, increase revenue, and shape the company's direction. You also support complex cross-functional projects that have significant impact on Trulioo's growth and long-term success.
This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.
This is a full-time, permanent position, working remotely from anywhere in the United States, with a preference for candidates based in San Diego, San Francisco, or New York. 
 What You'll Be Doing: 
Act as the primary contact for Trulioo's largest customers, owning day-to-day engagement and the creation and execution of each customer's success plan.
Lead high-stakes customer engagements, independently resolving complex challenges and escalations while ensuring stakeholders are aligned and well briefed.
Drive use of Trulioo's full product suite while consistently achieving high NPS and customer satisfaction.
Be the voice of the customer across your book of business to influence roadmap and strategy.
Provide strategic analysis and critical thinking to plan long-term expansion, and own upsell initiatives across each customer's deployment.
Mentor and advise the CSM team, enabling skill development and mastery of the CSM playbook.
Embody Trulioo's core values as a respected and trusted internal and external brand ambassador.
Leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement while ensuring the responsible, secure, and compliant use of AI tools.
Use AI to analyze usage trends and customer health data and to prepare account plans and QBR materials, verifying every output against source data before it reaches a customer, and share the workflows that work with the CSM team.
 What You'll Bring: 
Post-secondary degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
7+ years of customer success, account management, or related B2B SaaS experience, ideally in compliance, fintech, financial services, or e-commerce.
Proven ability to develop strategic relationships by becoming a trusted advisor to each customer, focused on customer outcomes and business value from Trulioo.
Strong stakeholder management skills across both customer and internal executive teams.
Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and communication skills across executive and technical audiences, including the ability to deliver impactful external presentations and webinars.
High achievement orientation with a strong work ethic, responsiveness, and a customer-first mindset.
Proven track record managing multi-million-dollar enterprise customers, driving adoption, retention, and revenue growth, with demonstrated success in complex SaaS expansion and executive-level relationships.
Experience leading cross-functional strategic initiatives with measurable impact on company direction and revenue.
Strong identity and compliance expertise, with the ability to discuss onboarding, KYC, fraud prevention, and user experience, and industry experience in compliance, identity, fintech, AML/KYC, or other financial and regulatory environments.
Proficiency analyzing data and translating insights into business outcomes.
Experience with the following tools/technology: Excel or BI tools.
Working fluency using AI in your own account management workflow, with a repeatable process and a habit of verifying output before relying on it, plus experience introducing a shared workflow or template that other team members use, and sound judgment on where AI should not touch confidential customer data.
 Interview Process: 
At Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. Our process is designed to help us learn more about your skills and experience while giving you insight into our team, culture, and the impact of the work we do.
Here's what you can expect throughout the interview process:
Recruiter Interview: 30 minutes
Hiring Manager Interview: 45–60 minutes
Panel/Presentation/Assignment: 60 minutes
Final Leadership Interview: 30–45 minutes
 Thriving at Trulioo 
At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we can shape the digital future.
We’re on the lookout for exceptional people to empower with trust, autonomy and the freedom to cultivate their potential. Your curiosity, meticulous attention to detail and passion to contribute are highly valued. If that resonates with you, apply today to become a part of our team. Join us in shaping a future where your career isn’t just a journey but also a boundless exploration into the possibilities of technology and digital identity verification. 
Get an inside look at life at Trulioo by following us on LinkedIn , or learn more about us at www.trulioo.com 
 If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that minorities and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We are committed to creating a more equitable, inclusive and diverse company and we strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply. 
 Trulioo welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Support is available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Finally, we know from time-to-time emergencies happen and you may need to reschedule an interview - we understand and encourage you to be in communication without worrying about losing the opportunity or your credibility. 
 Privacy Notice 
As part of our job application process, Trulioo collects, processes, and discloses personal data for the purpose of identifying suitable candidates for our job openings. For more detail, please visit Trulioo’s Website Privacy Policy in the section “When you apply for a job”.

pay not confirmed in the ad; 130000-180000 USD came from the feed

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
Job Description
 About us
 Joining Busuu means being part of one of the top EdTech companies in the world, a multiple award-winner recognised for its innovation and impact in language learning.
Busuu’s vision is to empower people through languages. We are the world’s largest online community for language learning, with 120+ million registered users. We make learning a language easy by combining AI-powered courses with feedback from our global community of native speakers and lesson content designed for real life.
Busuu is part of the global Chegg family. Chegg is the leading student-first connected learning platform and a NYSE listed company.
 What does a Revenue Operations Manager do at Busuu?
 You'll bring Marketing, Sales and Customer Success together, making sure the processes and systems that support our customer lifecycle work effectively as one.
Reporting to the Head of Revenue Operations, you'll take ownership of how these teams work together, from lead generation and pipeline creation through to onboarding, renewal and expansion. Acting as a trusted deputy, you'll turn business needs into clear processes, improve how our teams operate and help build the foundations for sustainable growth.
This is a hands-on role for someone who combines systems knowledge with commercial thinking and takes improvements through to implementation and adoption.
 Your responsibilities:
 Improve the customer lifecycle: Own processes and handoffs across Marketing, Sales and Customer Success, including lead progression, nurture, onboarding and renewal. Establish clear ownership and coordinate the operating process behind our target account list.
 Lead marketing systems governance: Manage the handover of HubSpot from our external agency, document its setup and enable the Marketing team to take over day-to-day operations. Own standards for campaign tracking, taxonomy, integrations and data quality, and partner with Marketing on the HubSpot roadmap.
 Coordinate reporting and revenue processes: Define reporting requirements for Marketing and Customer Success, working with Decision Intelligence on analytics and source-of-truth data. Partner with Finance to align operational workflows and revenue tracking with business needs.
 Build consistent ways of working: Own Revenue Operations documentation, SOPs and playbooks. Train teams on processes and systems, and use AI tools where useful to improve workflows and efficiency.
 What we’re looking for:
 Essential
3–5 years' experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Operations or a closely related Marketing Operations role within a SaaS, EdTech, subscription or technology business. 
A strong understanding of how Marketing, Sales and Customer Success work together across acquisition, conversion, retention and expansion. 
Practical experience with HubSpot and/or Salesforce, including workflows, configurations and data flows. 
Experience improving cross-functional processes and turning business needs into clear operational requirements. 
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the confidence to challenge assumptions and influence without formal authority. 
Confidence working with dashboards and reporting, validating data and identifying the information teams need to make decisions. 
The ability to create clear, practical documentation and drive adoption of new processes and systems. 
 Desirable
Experience with HubSpot Marketing Hub, marketing automation or lead lifecycle management. 
Knowledge of campaign taxonomy, UTM tracking, attribution, integrations or data enrichment. 
Experience managing a technical handover from an external agency or vendor. 
Familiarity with SQL, data warehouses or business intelligence tools. 
Experience using AI to improve documentation, training or workflow automation. 
Experience in commercial or financial analysis, particularly in a subscription-based business. 
 At Busuu we want to ensure that you have access to some great benefits
Our centrally located offices are well-equipped with free breakfast, plenty of snacks and fresh fruit. 
2 free lunches per week at our office that you can choose out of a wide selection of restaurants in the area. 
Great Private Health Insurance scheme
We love to support our teams with their work-life balance so we offer flexible working hours, a hybrid and remote model of working. 
Staying connected as a team is very important to us, so we have lots of social activities for you to join such as team lunches, Thursday socials, quarterly team, and company events. 
 What Happens Next
 We aim to have a simple and speedy hiring process and we want to make sure that we are right for you as much as the other way around.
 CV application review : We will review it as quickly as possible
 Let's chat : Quick chat with our recruiter about your experience and the role
 Interview : With the Hiring Manager
 Case Study : At-home case study to show off your skills
 Final Interview : Interview to review the task and speak with other colleagues in the team.
 Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. We pride ourselves on embracing our differences, whether they're cultural, racial, religious, or otherwise. This means each one of us comes to work knowing that we have a voice – and a safe, judgement-free zone to speak freely.
 If you like the sound of that, join us. We'd love to hear what you have to sa y!

 Show less

 Mid-Senior level
 Employment type
 Full-time
 Industries
 E-Learning Providers

A 3–5 year RevOps Manager band in London may price below the ~£70k Skilled Worker floor.
