title: Sales Operations Manager
description:
About Kinaxis
 Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
Location
This is a remote/hybrid position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Canada. Please note if you are located in Ottawa, ON we work a hybrid schedule where you will work from our headquarters 3 days per week.
 About The Team
 The Regional Sales Operations Manager partners with Sales Leadership to drive pipeline execution, forecast discipline, and operational excellence across assigned North America territories. This role provides business insights, supports sales execution, and helps optimize pipeline performance to drive predictable revenue growth.
Reporting to the Director of Global Sales Operations, this position supports a subset of North America territories and works closely with Sales, Marketing, Analytics, and Operations teams.
What you will do
 Sales Partnership, Forecasting & Pipeline Management
 Serve as the primary Sales Operations partner for assigned sales teams. 
 Support forecast reviews, pipeline inspections, and business planning activities. 
 Monitor pipeline health, opportunity progression, coverage, and forecast performance. 
 Identify risks, gaps, and opportunities and provide recommendations to sales leadership. 
 Support deal inspection and qualification review processes. 
 Sales Performance & Business Insights
 Develop reporting and analysis to support pipeline reviews, forecast discussions, QBRs, and performance management. 
 Provide insights into territory performance, productivity metrics, conversion rates, and pipeline trends. 
 Translate data into actionable recommendations that help improve sales results. 
 Pipeline Generation & Funnel Performance
 Partner with Marketing, Business Development, and Sales teams to support pipeline generation initiatives. 
 Monitor campaign follow-up, lead conversion, and opportunity creation. 
 Analyze funnel performance from MQL through opportunity creation and progression. 
 Provide feedback on lead quality, targeting effectiveness, and conversion challenges. 
 Sales Process, CRM & Operational Excellence
 Promote adoption of sales processes, methodologies, and best practices. 
 Support compliance with forecasting standards, opportunity management requirements, and stage exit criteria. 
 Monitor CRM data quality and opportunity hygiene to ensure reliable reporting and decision-making. 
 Support territory planning, account alignment, and operational improvement initiatives. 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration
 Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Sales Analytics, and Sales Operations teams. 
 Support process improvement initiatives, system enhancements, and productivity programs. 
 Contribute to the successful execution of operational priorities across the region. 
What we are looking for
 Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Economics, or a related field. 
 3-5+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, Marketing Operations, Analytics, or a related role. 
 Experience supporting forecasting, pipeline management, business reviews, and performance reporting. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 Experience working with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms. 
 Advanced Excel skills and experience analyzing business data. 
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
#Senior
 Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
 Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.
 Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:
Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
Flexible work options
Physical and mental well-being programs
Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
Mentorship programs, training, and career development
Recognition programs and referral rewards
Hackathons
For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.
Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

title: Sales Enablement Operations Manager
location: Barcelona or Lisbon or London or Madrid or Porto or Portugal or Spain or United Kingdom
description:
About Revolut
 People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day. 
 As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. 
About the role
Our Sales team powers customer growth around the world. From prospecting to acquisition and activation, they own their market segments, solve complex problems, and help more customers discover the value of Revolut with a sharp, solution-oriented approach.
We're looking for a Sales Enablement Operations Manager to sit at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution. You'll be building systems and optimising processes that allow our sales force to reach peak performance.
You'll use data to analyse trends and identify performance gaps to design technical, scalable solutions.
Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.
What you'll be doing
Structuring and running rigorous pilots to test new operational models, sales methodologies, or tools within specific segments to determine what works before scaling globally
Designing and optimising scalable sales workflows to ensure our Sales team moves with maximum speed and minimal friction
Analysing sales performance data to identify bottlenecks in the funnel, and implementing operational fixes through process, tooling, or training
Scoping, prioritising, and owning sales enablement and operations projects, from identifying opportunities to coordinating stakeholders and measuring impact
Transforming the onboarding programme from a simple training track into a high-impact, metric-driven system that reduces time to productivity for new hires
Developing KPIs and dashboards to measure the direct ROI of enablement initiatives on sales velocity and conversion
What you'll need
5+ years of relevant experience, including 3+ years in operations, strategy consulting, or finance
Experience with B2B sales, sales enablement, and the development and implementation of enablement programmes
Impressive analytical skills and the ability to use data to identify opportunities and solve complex problems
Expertise in building, implementing, and improving processes as a business scales
A bias for action, with the ability to break complex problems into smaller ones and drive solutions forward
Fluency in English with excellent communication skills
Nice to have
Experience scoping and delivering cross-functional projects, from defining success metrics to measuring impact
Coding experience, particularly in SQL or Python
Experience developing KPIs and dashboards to measure business performance and the impact of enablement initiatives
Experience designing and running pilots to test new operational models, sales methodologies, or tools before scaling them
Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.
 Important notice for candidates: 
Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.
• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.
 We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.
By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice
hard_gaps: 3+ years in operations, strategy consulting, or finance
flags: no pay stated in the ad or the feed, verify vs floor
Revolut's interview process is notoriously long and test-heavy, and its culture is famously high-pressure.
Role is pre-sale enablement and onboarding focused, so his post-sale differentiator carries less weight here.
Posting names no office or city, so confirm the role's base location and office pattern before applying.
verdict: Credible enablement-ops pivot at a strong brand, but the operations-tenure requirement and pre-sale focus make screening uncertain.

title: Senior Lead Customer Success Manager
description:
As a Senior Lead Customer Success Manager, you'll own some of Workiva's most strategic enterprise relationships and be the advisor your customers rely on to connect our platform to outcomes that matter. Beyond your accounts, you'll help shape how great CS is done at Workiva by mentoring the CSMs around you and contributing to the practices that make the whole team better. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Customer Journey & Success Planning 
 Build and maintain a clear picture of each account's organization, goals, and strategic priorities, and develop multi-year account plans that connect those priorities to Workiva capabilities 
 Cultivate C-suite and VP relationships as an ongoing partnership, not just at renewal time, and run Business Reviews that tell a story about impact rather than a recap of features 
 Map our full portfolio against each customer's agenda to identify where Workiva can do more, and keep account plans current with whitespace opportunities and clear next steps 
 Platform Adoption 
 Use adoption data and health signals to diagnose what's working and what isn't, then design targeted interventions that address root causes 
 Ask consultative questions to uncover workflow gaps and build enablement that drives lasting behavior change, not just short-term usage 
 Sales Collaboration 
 Identify expansion opportunities through structured whitespace analysis and bring them to your AE with a clear business case, not just a product suggestion 
 Maintain a reliable renewal forecast well ahead of deadlines, flag risk early with a mitigation plan attached, and navigate commercial conversations with confidence 
 Executive Presence 
 Stay consistently engaged with VP- and C-level stakeholders and communicate in terms of business risk, efficiency, and strategic impact 
 Prepare internal executive sponsors with the context they need before every high-stakes customer conversation 
 Risk & Issue Resolution 
 Catch problems before your customers do by reading health trends, engagement signals, and relationship dynamics proactively 
 Own escalations from identification through resolution: document the root cause, coordinate across functions, and keep the customer informed throughout 
 Organizational Excellence & Mentorship 
 Mentor fellow CSMs on territory management, stakeholder strategy, and commercial thinking, and share your approaches so others can learn from your experience 
 Contribute to team-wide playbooks and tools that make strong execution repeatable across the organization 
 Synthesize patterns across your accounts into specific, evidence-backed input that helps Product and GTM teams make better decisions 
 What You'll Need 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 8+ years in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, or Consulting 
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 A track record of retaining and growing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise accounts across multiple renewal cycles 
 Sharp commercial instincts and experience identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities alongside a sales partner 
 Executive presence that earns trust at the C-suite level and holds up in high-stakes conversations 
 The ability to read data, find the signal, and turn it into a clear story that drives action 
 CRM discipline that makes your forecasts reliable, your work visible, and your accounts transferable 
 Experience leading or coordinating cross-functional work without direct authority, bringing together the right people across Sales, Support, Product, and other teams to drive outcomes for your accounts 
 A genuine interest in mentoring others and making the team around you better 
 Travel Requirements & Working Conditions 
 Willingness to travel up to 20% for team and corporate meetings, fostering relationships and representing company interests. 
 Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely, as we embrace flexible work arrangements. 
 How You’ll Be Rewarded 
✅ Salary range in the US: $137,000.00 - $235,000.00
✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually
✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire
✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package
The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.
 Why Join Workiva 
 Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world. 
 At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you. 
Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.
Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email talentacquisition@workiva.com .
Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.
 Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment. 
#LI-JW1
flags: Travel up to 20% for team and corporate meetings is expected.
Workiva has European offices such as Amsterdam, Dublin and London, so an internal transfer could be a later route abroad.
The role is lateral senior CS with no RevOps scope, so it is runway rather than pivot.
verdict: Excellent fit on experience and GRC domain with strong pay, but a US lateral CS move that only works as runway.

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.
We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com .
EvenUp is looking for an Enterprise Customer Success Manager to oversee a portfolio of 25-30 large law firm accounts, focusing on deep, strategic partnerships and user-level engagement to deliver measurable customer outcomes. This role requires a strategic mindset, exceptional relationship management skills, technological fluency and a proven track record in influencing senior-level stakeholders as well as driving individual/user-level behavior. You will act as a trusted advisor, advocate for customers within EvenUp, and help each customer maximize the value they see from our platform.
 What you’ll do: 
 Proactive Account Management: 
Regularly conduct executive-level business reviews and deliver adoption analyses to ensure customers are leveraging the full capabilities of EvenUp’s platform.
Collaborate with internal teams to deliver tailored value, and resolve complex challenges promptly.
 In-Depth User Activation: 
Partner with customers to define success metrics and align with their long-term business objectives.
Develop and execute tailored account plans for user groups and customers, driving measurable outcomes and engaging with the EU platform directly.

title: Sales Operations Business Partner (CX)
description:
About Pleo 
Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.
The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.
Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.
 About the role 
We’re looking for a Sales Operations Business Partner to sit between our sales leadership and the systems, data, and processes that run the revenue engine. You’ll help the sales team understand where deals stand, where revenue is coming from, and where it’s at risk. You’ll own how we track pipeline, report on performance, and build the dashboards leaders rely on to make decisions. This is a role for someone who thinks in business outcomes first and uses data and tools as the means to get there.
 What you’ll do 
Own pipeline management processes, including stage definitions, forecasting cadence, and hygiene standards, and work with sales managers to keep the pipeline accurate.
Build and maintain regular sales reporting covering bookings, pipeline coverage, conversion rates, win/loss, and rep and team performance.
Design, build, and maintain dashboards that give leadership and frontline managers a clear view of performance against targets.
Act as a business partner to sales leaders: understand their priorities, translate them into operational requirements, and bring data-backed recommendations to planning and business reviews.
Support forecasting and quarterly business reviews by preparing the data, challenging assumptions, and flagging risks early.
Own day-to-day administration and configuration of the CRM (e.g. Salesforce or HubSpot), including fields, workflows, user access, and reporting structure, in partnership with the RevOps or systems team.
Drive adoption of CRM and sales processes by working with managers and reps, and by making the right behaviour the easy one.
Support territory, quota, and compensation-related analysis as needed, in partnership with Finance.
Identify process gaps and inefficiencies across the sales funnel and lead improvements, documenting changes and training the team on them.
Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Product Ops to keep data consistent across systems.
 What you’ll bring 
7+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, GTM operations, or a related commercial role, ideally in a [B2B SaaS / relevant industry] environment.
Strong experience with CRM systems, ideally Salesforce or HubSpot, including reporting and basic administration.
Solid understanding of sales metrics and funnel dynamics, including pipeline coverage, conversion, forecasting accuracy, and sales cycle length.
Proven ability to build clear reports and dashboards in tools such as Excel/Google Sheets, Looker, Tableau, or Power BI. You don’t need to write code, but you should be comfortable working with data and spotting what matters.
Experience running pipeline reviews or forecast calls, or supporting leaders who do.
A consultative approach: you can listen to a sales leader, ask the right questions, and turn their needs into a practical solution.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to senior stakeholders and explain trade-offs simply.
Good judgement and attention to detail, with the ability to balance speed and accuracy.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities.
 Nice to have 
Experience supporting a sales team through a scaling or transformation phase.
Familiarity with sales compensation or territory planning tools.
Exposure to revenue analytics or forecasting methodologies.
Experience with a BI tool or basic SQL, though this is not required.
 What success looks like 
Leadership trusts the pipeline and forecast numbers and uses them to make decisions.
Sales managers run their reviews from the dashboards you’ve built, without needing manual reports.
CRM data quality improves measurably over time.
Sales leaders see you as a partner who brings ideas, not just reports.
 About your application 
 English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
 A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
 Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
 Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
 Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here .
 Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
 Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to influence cross-functional partners without direct authority.
 Additional Information

Familiarity with Deal-to-Cash and Order-to-Cash processes, including billing and collections.
Experience with subscription and usage-based models, renewals, co-terming and uplifts.
Experience in Financial Automation – Accounts Receivable/Payable.
 How Success Is Measured
Case SLA attainment for credits, churn and FTL requests.
Reduction in order conflicts, rework and downstream cleanup.
Salesforce data accuracy and renewal forecast reliability.
Adoption of documented processes and playbooks across CS and PSO teams
 Rewards & Benefits
Flexible Work: Embrace a hybrid work model blending office and remote setup for a balanced lifestyle. 
Endless Learning: Access global opportunities for growth through our 24/7 online learning platform. 
Inclusive Community: Join our Empowered Communities and engage in our Philanthropy program. 
Comprehensive Rewards: Enjoy competitive Total Rewards covering wellness, work/life balance, and more, including a generous referral scheme. 
Caring for Wellbeing: Access our complimentary employee assistance program for mental health support. 
 Smart Work at Quadient 
 At Quadient, our Smart Work approach fosters connection, collaboration, and innovation while offering flexibility based on role requirements. Whether on-site, hybrid, or remote, our work environments are designed to support productivity and engagement. Hybrid employees balance remote and in-office work, on-site roles contribute daily to our vibrant workplace culture, and remote employees stay connected through virtual collaboration and in-person events. No matter where you work, you’ll be part of a dynamic, people-first community that drives success together.
 Be yourself at Quadient 
 Our values define how we work as a team: Empowerment, Passion, Inspiration and Community. They inspire us to be EPIC. Together. What makes Quadient different is how different we are. We’re a team of individuals with one goal but many perspectives. When you connect with Quadient, you become part of a community that cares - in a culture that embraces differences and values every voice.
We will consider any reasonable modifications to the interview process. If you require any assistance with the application process, please email us at career@quadient.com

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
The role
We are looking for an experienced Senior Customer Success Manager to join the Customer team at Legatics. You will be the adoption expert for a portfolio of strategic law firm accounts: getting customers live, training their lawyers, building internal champions and making sure the platform is well used across every practice group that bought it. You will work in close partnership with our team of Account Managers, who own the account, the commercial relationship and the account plan, while you lead onboarding, enablement, support and usage insight. You will also play a meaningful role in shaping how the team operates, bringing experience and leadership that helps elevate those around you.
This forms part of the Customer team's mission to help law firms roll out Legatics to their lawyers, remove barriers to use and ensure our customers get lasting value from our platform.
The role sits within a newly defined operating model for account management and customer success. On some accounts you may lead intermediate check-ins for a period, until these move across to account management as the model beds in.
You will look after several of our largest and most valuable accounts, predominantly across the UK and US. Regular travel is part of the role, including US travel for conferences, key customer visits and events. We work hybrid, with at least two days a week in our London office.
What you would be doing
Working as part of the Customer team at Legatics and reporting into the VP, Customer:
Onboarding and proof of value
Lead onboarding and implementation for new customers and practice groups: workspace and admin setup, templates, integrations and getting the first live matter up and running.
Run accelerated onboarding for customers on a proof of value, so they see clear results before the break clause and the Account Manager can make the case for a full contract.
Training and enablement
Design and deliver end-user and practice-area training, workshops and webinars, in person and online.
Run deeper product demos that unlock new use cases and greater product depth within each firm.
Communicate new releases to users so they know what has changed and how to get value from it.
Build and equip internal champions within each customer and identify the next advocate beyond the original one.
Scale enablement with tools such as Claude, from training materials and knowledge base content to usage reporting.
Adoption planning and insight
Co-develop each account and adoption plan with the Account Manager, leading on usage analysis, the adoption story and recommendations, with the Account Manager signing it off.
Deliver the enablement that puts the plan into action, moving usage across offices and practice groups.
Map user groups, champions and active users per office and practice group in Salesforce, alongside the buyer-group map owned by account management.
Produce monthly and intermediate usage reports, and provide the data and adoption inputs for quarterly business reviews (QBRs) and check-ins.
Propose next steps ahead of check-ins and QBRs and join them when the Account Manager brings you in.
Customer health and renewal readiness
Track account health and usage, flagging churn risk and expansion signals early to the Account Manager with the context they need to act.
Make sure the evidence is in place before renewal conversations start: the practice groups each customer bought for are trained and running live matters, and any product or support issues that could affect the renewal are logged and being fixed.
Debrief the Account Manager after every customer interaction: who was engaged, who was not and what came up.
Spot happy champions and strong results, and flag them to the Account Manager as potential success stories.
Support and product feedback
Work with the team on support and escalations, covering first-line triage when needed.
Collect feedback and feature requests from users, log them and represent the customer view to the Product team.
Customer visits and events
Run in-region end-user training visits to your accounts.
Support Account Managers on senior stakeholder visits and customer events where product depth is needed.
Mentorship and development
Act as a senior voice within the Customer team, sharing knowledge and best practices that help raise the standard of customer success across the team.
Support the onboarding and development of more junior team members, offering coaching and guidance on onboarding, training and adoption.
Collaborate closely with the VP, Customer on strategic initiatives, contributing to how the team evolves its approach to onboarding, adoption and customer health.
How we'll measure success
Adoption growth in the practice groups each customer bought for.
Time to first live matter.
Health and usage coverage across the book.
Renewal readiness evidence in place before each renewal.
Requirements
What we need from you
Essential
Substantial experience in B2B SaaS customer success, with a strong track record of driving adoption across a portfolio of accounts with large user bases.
Hands-on experience leading onboarding and implementation, including platform setup, configuration and integrations.
Confidence designing and delivering training, workshops and demos to users at every level, in person and online.
A data-informed approach: you turn usage and health data into clear reports, insight and practical recommendations.
Proven ability to build champions and strong relationships with end users across different teams and offices.
Strong product aptitude, with the ability to learn complex software quickly and explain it simply.
An organised, calm approach to support and triage, with experience escalating effectively to product and engineering teams.
A strong partner to commercial colleagues: you share insight early, keep account owners informed and know when to bring them in.
Fluent in using AI tools in your day-to-day work. We use Claude across the business, and you will be able to show how you have used it, or similar tools, to scale enablement and insight, for example training materials, knowledge base content, usage analysis and reporting, and how you check the output is accurate.
Can show measurable adoption growth from the enablement you have led.
A growth mindset and a proactive approach: you seek out feedback, act on it and can show how you have changed your approach as a result, and you move things forward without being chased.
Builds constructive working relationships across teams, including giving direct feedback to colleagues respectfully and in the right forum.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to large groups and senior contacts.
Experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM.
Willingness to travel regularly, including to the US.
Bonus points for the following (but these are not essential)
Experience mentoring or coaching junior team members in a customer success setting.
Experience working in LegalTech.
Familiarity with legal workflows and transaction management processes.
Familiarity with APIs and AI integrations.
We use AI tools across the business to enhance productivity, decision-making and creativity, and we look for people who use them confidently and responsibly. You will join a team that keeps learning how to get the most from AI to drive meaningful results.
We welcome applications from everyone and are happy to make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process. Let us know what would help.
Benefits
 What we offer you 
Competitive salary (depending on experience)
25 days holiday per year (plus public holidays).
Early Finish Fridays - on the last Friday of every month, we finish around lunchtime!
Private Medical Insurance with Bupa, giving you fast access to diagnosis and treatment when you need it.
Healthshield Health Cash Plan, helping you claim money back on everyday healthcare like dental, optical and physio.
Pension with NEST.
Personal Learning & Development budget.
Enhanced parental leave policies so you can spend more time with your family.
Lots of opportunities for accelerated professional development and career progression.
Work alongside a supportive and talented team with the opportunity to grow one of the world’s leading LegalTech scale-ups.
A warm, genuinely collaborative culture and an awesome team; and
Regular socials.
 Power in diversity 
We put users at the heart of our design to provide legal transaction experiences that everyone loves. In order to make that a reality, we seek to foster a diverse and inclusive working environment that can empower our people to be creative, effective and innovative, to build a brand we are proud of.
We don’t discriminate against gender, race, religion or belief, disability, age, marital status or sexual orientation. Whatever your background may be, we welcome anyone with talent, drive and emotional intelligence. We're committed to building a diverse team, and are constantly looking for ways to improve our processes to help us do that.
flags: CSM in UK-London at a non-standout company
no pay stated in the ad or the feed, verify vs floor
Small LegalTech scale-up: sponsor licence unconfirmed, and Senior CSM pay may struggle to clear the GBP 70k Skilled Worker floor.
Account Managers own commercials, renewals and account plans, so the role is adoption and training only, with no revenue ownership.
Regular US travel is expected for conferences and customer visits.
verdict: Credible legal-tech CSM fit, but an adoption-only scale-up role in London that does little for the RevOps pivot; sponsorship and comp are doubtful.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Corporate - Life Sciences
description:
About AlphaSense: 
 The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content. 
 The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us! 
 Location: London (In office presence required) 
 About the Team: 
The Customer Success organisation is composed of four teams: pre-sales, customer success managers, account management and support. The CS org is dedicated to ensuring every client realises the full value of their investment in our platform, working as an integrated partner to help clients achieve meaningful outcomes and embed AlphaSense into their everyday decision-making.
By blending industry knowledge, product expertise, and a deep understanding of client priorities, the team helps organisations uncover new use cases, accelerate adoption, and sustain long-term growth. Their close engagement with clients also creates a powerful feedback loop—informing product innovation, shaping content strategy, and ensuring that the evolving needs of the corporate community are consistently reflected in how AlphaSense delivers value.
 About the Role: 
As a Senior Customer Success Manager (Sr. CSM) at AlphaSense, you will be the strategic lead for our most complex and high-value accounts within the Corporate sector. You are responsible for navigating multi-million dollar global organizations and driving long-term ROI through technical group/individual training while ensuring company-wide adoption across multiple business units. You will manage a concentrated portfolio of strategic accounts, remaining at the forefront of product and Corporate vertical expertise, while scaling your impact across the organization through account strategy, leadership and innovation.
 What You’ll Do: 
 Strategic Account Influence: Navigate and influence multiple business units and key power users across the world largest and most complex global organizations. Create a groundswell of positive user sentiment to drive renewals and expansion with Senior Leadership.
 Architect Deep Adoption & Value Realization: Synthesize complex usage into actionable insights. Design multi-quarter adoption roadmaps in tandem with your Account Management peers that align AlphaSense capabilities with business objectives.
 Onboarding & Ongoing Training: As an expert on the product, you will guide new clients through onboarding, training, and best-practice adoption to ensure a strong foundation, both virtually and in person.
 Technical & Domain Mastery: Independently lead sophisticated technical conversations regarding Managed Content Providers (MCP), APIs, and Large Language Models (LLMs) with technical stakeholders and platform owners.
 Executive Presence & Communication: Command virtual and in-person rooms with executive presence, and leverage powerful, strategic follow-ups as a tool to drive adoption and link AlphaSense to specific Senior Leader business objectives.
 Solo On-Site Leadership: Fully own high-stakes, multi-day on-site engagements and lead customer "Lunch & Learns,’’ tailoring presentations to diverse user groups and core personas using our WWH (Why, What, How) framework.
 Company Innovation: engage in cross-functional initiatives outside the standard CSM scope, such as product feedback loops, hiring committees, mentorship programs and process innovation to improve team efficiency.
 Who You Are: 
4 -6+ years of professional experience in Customer Success or Account Management, with a proven track record of managing a strategic portfolio. 
Ability to travel 20% of time. 
Experience working with clients in the Life Sciences industry, including Pharma, Biotech, Medical devices and diagnostics - additional bonus for familiarity with competitive intelligence, business development and clinical and commercial strategy workflows. 
Possess the technical acumen to navigate complex conversations around data integrations, APIs, and AI-driven market intelligence solutions.
Ability to identify the 5% of users who drive the majority of sentiment and influence within an account, focusing on high-level business outcomes over basic feature adoption.
Excellent communication skills with a demonstrable track record for collaborating internally in a cross-functional environment and onsite with customers. 
A natural leader who thrives in fast-paced environments and is committed to contributing to the "AlphaSense Playbook" through mentorship and internal innovation.
 AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination. 
 In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works. 
 Recruiting Scams and Fraud 
 We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note: 
 AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training. 
 All official communications will come from an @ alpha-sense.com email address. 
 If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page . 
 If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

title: Sales Operations Manager
description:
Are you the person who asks "what's the real problem?" before building the report?
 Do you get more satisfaction from a process that runs cleanly every week than from a deck presented to leadership? 
 Then Jobber might be the place for you! We’re looking for a Sales Operations Manager to be part of our Sales Enablement department.
Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!
Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers.
 The team:
 Jobber’s mission is to make sure every blue collar business has the technology and knowledge to win, and the Sales team you support is how those businesses first find us.
As a Sales Operations Manager at Jobber, you'll go deep in the sales channel, developing the context, credibility, and relationships with Sales leaders that only come from sustained ownership. You'll sit at the table where operational decisions are made, bring a clear point of view, and influence how the channel runs. You’ll provide data-driven recommendations, you'll lead the rollout, drive adoption, and be measured on the real improvement you deliver to how our Sales team performs.
 The role: 
 Jobber’s Sales Operations team partners with our Sales organization to improve how our sales channels operate. As a Sales Operations Manager, you’ll act as the Sales Operations partner for an assigned channel or priority area of focus, helping identify operational friction and turn business problems into practical solutions. This is an individual contributor role.
You’ll independently lead channel-level projects from discovery through rollout and measurement. This includes defining requirements, building project plans and workback schedules, coordinating cross-functional execution, keeping stakeholders aligned, and measuring impact.
You will own delivery and communication within your scope, make project-level decisions, and bring well-supported data-driven recommendations and trade-offs to Sales leaders. You will escalate cross-channel impacts and decisions that require broader leadership alignment.
The Sales Operations Manager will:
 Sales Partnership & Thought Leadership
Act as the primary Sales Operations partner for an assigned sales channel or priority area. 
Serve as a trusted thought partner to channel leaders, building a deep understanding of the channel's goals and performance drivers, and proactively raising operational opportunities they haven't yet considered. 
Proactively partner with Sales leaders and frontline teams to analyse issues, and identify opportunities for improvement. 
Make strategic recommendations where the channel can optimize and contribute to discussions on how priorities are sequenced over the coming quarters. 
Provide ongoing support while looking for longer-term solutions that reduce friction and improve consistency. 
 Problem Diagnosis & Recommendation
Investigate operational problems by gathering stakeholder input, reviewing current workflows, and analyzing available data. 
Separate immediate requests from the underlying problem that needs to be solved, and structure ambiguous problems into testable hypotheses. 
Build the fact base: pull and analyze operational and performance data, size the impact, and translate findings into clear recommendations with the trade-offs made explicit. 
Document current-state processes, requirements, owners, handoffs, dependencies, and common failure points. 
Design practical improvements that make processes clearer, more efficient, and more scalable. 
 Project & Workstream Delivery
Lead assigned channel projects from discovery and scoping through execution, rollout, and post-launch measurement. 
Translate business problems into clear requirements, project plans, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, and success measures. 
Maintain structured delivery plans that give stakeholders clarity on timing, responsibilities, and decisions. 
Keep projects moving by following up on actions, resolving blockers, and escalating risks when needed. 
Develop rollout plans that include communication, documentation, training, readiness, and post-launch support, anticipating where resistance may arise and what support will be needed to make the change stick. 
 What you'll do: 
 Sales Partnership & Thought Leadership
Act as the primary Sales Operations partner for an assigned sales channel or priority area. 
Serve as a trusted thought partner to channel leaders, building a deep understanding of the channel's goals and performance drivers, and proactively raising operational opportunities they haven't yet considered. 
Proactively partner with Sales leaders and frontline teams to analyse issues, and identify opportunities for improvement. 
Make strategic recommendations where the channel can optimize and contribute to discussions on how priorities are sequenced over the coming quarters. 
Provide ongoing support while looking for longer-term solutions that reduce friction and improve consistency.

Translate business problems into clear requirements, project plans, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, and success measures. 
Maintain structured delivery plans that give stakeholders clarity on timing, responsibilities, and decisions. 
Keep projects moving by following up on actions, resolving blockers, and escalating risks when needed. 
Develop rollout plans that include communication, documentation, training, readiness, and post-launch support, anticipating where resistance may arise and what support will be needed to make the change stick. 
 Stakeholder Partnership
Deliver executive-ready updates on project status, milestones, risks, decisions, and required actions, focused on what needs to be decided and the recommended path. 
Ensure stakeholders understand what is changing, why it matters, when it is happening, and what is expected from them. 
Facilitate discovery sessions, working meetings, project updates, and launch readiness discussions. 
Escalate issues with clear context, business impact, and recommended next steps. 
Partner with RevTech, Enablement, Sales Planning, Finance, Analytics, and Sales stakeholders on assigned work. 
Bring partner teams together around a shared channel need, providing the context and requirements they need to deliver a coordinated solution. 
Respect functional ownership while maintaining clarity across decisions, responsibilities, and handoffs. 
Identify broader impacts or trade-offs that require cross-channel or leadership alignment. 
Partner with Enablement and Sales leaders to prepare impacted teams for new processes, tools, or expectations. 
Define success measures and monitor adoption, process health, stakeholder feedback, and business impact. 
Connect project results to channel outcomes such as productivity, conversion, pipeline quality, sales cycle, or forecast accuracy, and use results and feedback to refine improvements after launch. 
 To be successful, you should have:
3–5 years experience, ideally in management consulting or tech, strategy, or a business/revenue operations role, with experience leading client- or stakeholder-facing workstreams from problem definition through recommendation. 
Structured problem-solving: the ability to break an ambiguous business problem into hypotheses, test them with data and stakeholder interviews, and land on a clear recommendation. 
Executive-ready communication: crisp written recommendations, decision memos, and the ability to facilitate leadership discussions. 
Strong project ownership and follow-through, with the ability to lead work from discovery through delivery and measurement. 
Comfort acting as a trusted advisor to leaders, bringing a clear point of view and being sought out for perspective on operational decisions. 
Strong operational judgment, including knowing when to make decisions independently and when to escalate. 
Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy, organization, and clear follow-through. 
Ability to identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to channel workflows and build repeatable, lightweight solutions that reduce recurring operational effort. 
 Nice to Have: 
Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or a go-to-market or strategic operations role. 
Experience supporting various sales channels such as Inbound, Outbound, Account Management, or Channel Partnerships. 
Familiarity with Salesforce and other sales technology platforms. 
Experience supporting system implementations, process redesigns, user acceptance testing, or operational rollouts. 
Exposure to sales planning, forecasting, routing, pipeline management, compensation, or performance reporting. 
 Location:
 We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo.
 Compensation: 
 At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $98,300, midpoint of $115,700 and a maximum of $133,100 designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.
We design our compensation to reflect each new hire’s skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual’s current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.

title: Revenue Operations Manager, Customer Success
description:
This posting reflects a current, actively recruited opening at Float. All applications are being reviewed on a rolling basis.
 About Float
 Float is on a mission to simplify finance for Canadian businesses, empowering them to eliminate complexity and unlock new opportunities. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth.
As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies and top-rated startups in 2025, 2024 and 2023, Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple.
At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success.
 Our Product
 Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 10,000 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C, and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank.
Our team is a collection of ambitious, collaborative and mission-driven people from all walks of life but with one goal: helping Canadian companies not just survive but thrive. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada.
 AI Use in Our Hiring Process
 We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.
 About The Role
 Float is investing in the next chapter of its Customer Success Operations function. As our Revenue Operations Manager, Customer Success , you'll play a foundational role in shaping how Customer Success scales by building the systems, programs, and operating rhythms that help our customers grow and our team operate more effectively. While we already leverage Salesforce across the business, this role will lead the evolution of our dedicated Customer Success tooling and operating model as we continue to scale.
We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager, Customer Success to build the systems, processes, and insights that enable our Customer Success team to scale efficiently while driving customer retention, expansion, and operational excellence. You'll partner closely with Customer Success leadership, RevOps, Finance, Product, and Sales to transform strategic ideas into repeatable operating programs that improve customer outcomes and business performance.
 What You'll Do
Design and optimize the end-to-end post-sales (Customer Success) customer journey across onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion.
Build and own the Customer Success operating system, creating scalable processes that improve retention, expansion, forecasting, and operational efficiency.
Evaluate, implement, and optimize the Customer Success technology stack, driving adoption and enablement across the team.
Develop and continuously improve customer health scoring frameworks, risk indicators, and expansion signals.
Build and own recurring forecasting programs and target setting for customer retention and expansion, ensuring leadership has accurate visibility into business performance.
Create scalable account planning and risk management programs for Float's largest customers.
Partner with Customer Success leadership to define CSM workflows, operating rhythms, success metrics, and performance measurement.
Translate complex and fragmented customer data into clear recommendations and actionable insights for Customer Success and GTM leadership.
Partner cross-functionally with RevOps, Product, Finance, Sales, and Data teams to improve systems, reporting, customer handoffs, and operational efficiency.
Identify opportunities to automate manual work and streamline workflows so Customer Success Managers can spend more time driving customer value.
Establish reporting, dashboards, and operating cadences that help leadership make faster, data-informed decisions.
 About You
You Put Customers First. You're constantly thinking about how operational improvements ultimately create a better customer experience.
You Act Like an Owner. You proactively identify opportunities, solve problems, and take accountability for outcomes.
You Think Big and Move Fast. You're energized by building from zero to one and thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
You Constantly Learn and Grow. You actively seek feedback, adapt quickly, and continuously improve your craft.
You Raise the Bar. You balance speed with quality and are always looking for ways to improve how teams operate.
You Win as a Team. You build strong relationships across functions and know that great operations require great collaboration.
 What You'll Bring
5+ years of experience in Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, or a similar strategic operations role with end-to-end ownership.
Experience working in a consumption or usage-based SaaS business where forecasting, customer growth, and compensation models are more complex is highly preferred.
Proven experience building scalable Customer Success programs, processes, and operating rhythms from the ground up.
Hands-on experience selecting, implementing, and optimizing Customer Success technology and operational tooling.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn complex, fragmented data into clear business recommendations.
Experience building customer health models, forecasting frameworks, and executive reporting.
Exceptional cross-functional communication skills with experience partnering closely with Customer Success, Sales, Finance, Product, and RevOps leaders.
A bias toward action—you identify problems, propose solutions, and drive execution without waiting for direction.
Bonus: Familiarity with Salesforce, Metabase, or similar CS and BI platforms is a plus — but curiosity and the ability to pick up new tools fast matter more. Our stack is still taking shape, and we want someone excited to help decide its future, not someone anchored to what they already know.
 This May Not Be the Role for You If...
You prefer inheriting mature processes rather than building them from scratch.
Your experience is primarily as a Customer Success Manager or Account Manager rather than leading operational strategy and systems.
You've primarily worked as an analyst supporting operations rather than owning an operations function.
You prefer reporting on metrics over building the systems that generate them.
You thrive in highly structured environments with clearly defined processes rather than creating them yourself.
 Our Hiring Philosophy
 We hire for character, curiosity, and learning velocity before credentials. Titles matter less than impact, and every hire is expected to raise the bar for Float as a whole.
 Why You Should Join
Work at one of Canada's fastest-growing fintech companies
Make a real impact in a high-autonomy, high-growth role
Collaborate with an ambitious and supportive team
Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits
Hybrid work model – we are based in Toronto with in-office days for connection and collaboration
Enjoy catered team lunches every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday
Bring your pup to our dog-friendly office
Thrive in a high-trust, high-performance culture where your work truly matters
 In Short
 At Float, you’ll thrive if you’re bold, curious, and eager to make a real impact. We're building something special—and having a lot of fun along the way. If you’re excited to build, grow, and win together, we’d love to meet you.
 We’re committed to building a workplace that’s welcoming and accessible for everyone. If you need any accommodations during the hiring process or once you join Float, just let us know! You can reach out to Vic ( victoria@floatfinancial.com ), and we’ll work with you to make sure you have what you need to succeed.

title: Senior Principal Customer Success Manager
description:
PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.
 About the role 
As a Senior Principal Customer Success Manager you will be an executive-facing partner to some of PagerDuty’s most important enterprise customers across the UK, Ireland and wider EMEA. You will build value relationships with the leaders who own incident response and reliability, and shape how their organisations use PagerDuty to meet their goals. You will work closely with Sales, Product and Marketing, and you will share what you build so the whole team gets better.
 What you’ll do 
Own the customer journey end to end, from strategic kick-off and the Sales handover through to QBRs, renewal and expansion, and hold the standard consistent across your accounts.
Build value relationships with the executives accountable for incident management, alerting and service reliability, not only the teams who use the product day to day.
Co-create a strategic roadmap with each customer, aligned to their critical OKRs for incident response and alerting, and agree objectives and measures with them.
Lead the change that comes with it: process, ownership and behaviour, so customers adopt what they have bought and keep using it.
Run executive business reviews that set direction for the next period, not only report on the last one.
Identify risks to customer goals early, agree mitigation with the customer and Sales, and own the outcome.
Work across Sales, Product and Marketing to grow accounts, feed customer evidence into the roadmap, and sharpen how we position value.
Advise customers on best practice across incident and alerting workflows, and build playbooks, AI agents and shared assets that help both customers and the CS team.
 Basic Qualifications: 
Six to ten years in enterprise Customer Success, account management or a similar role, with sustained engagement at VP and C-level.
A track record of taking customers from little use to full use, and of renewal and expansion outcomes you can show.
Experience building value cases and running reviews that change decisions.
A working understanding of incident management, alerting and DevOps, enough to advise practitioners on integrations and workflows.
Daily, hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude or OpenAI Codex, and a record of building something others now use, whether for customers or your team.
 Preferred Qualifications: 
Fluency in German or French.
Experience moving customers to consumption, credit or AI-based pricing.
Examples of AI skills or workflows you built for your team, and how they changed the way it works.
There will be some customer travel within Europe required for this role and be working out of our brand new designed London office 2 days a week.

Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for job alerts !
 Where we work 
PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with offices in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we cannot employ candidates residing in:
 Location restrictions: 
 Australia: Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia
 Canada: Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon
 United States: Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming
 Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role. 
 How we work 
 Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.
People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.
 What we offer 
As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country-specific offerings, on our benefits site .
 Your package may include: 
Competitive salary
Comprehensive benefits package 
Flexible work arrangements
Company equity*
ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Program)*
Retirement or pension plan*
Generous paid vacation time
Paid holidays and sick leave
Dutonian Wellness Days & HibernationDuty - companywide paid days off in addition to PTO
Paid parental leave: 22 weeks for pregnant parent, 12 weeks for non-pregnant parent (some countries have longer leave standards and we comply with local laws)*
Paid volunteer time off: 20 hours per year
Company-wide hack weeks
Mental wellness programs
*Eligibility may vary by role, region, and tenure
 About PagerDuty 
PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. The PagerDuty Operations Cloud is an AI-powered platform that empowers business resilience and drives operational efficiency for enterprises. With a generative AI assistant at its core, PagerDuty empowers teams to detect and resolve issues in real time, orchestrate complex workflows, and drive continuous improvement across their digital operations. Trusted by nearly half of both the Fortune 500 and the Forbes AI 50, as well as approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100, PagerDuty is essential for delivering always-on digital experiences to modern businesses
PagerDuty is Great Place to Work-certified™, a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, a Fortune Best Medium Workplace, a Fortune Best Workplace in Technology, and a top rated product on TrustRadius and G2. 
Go behind-the-scenes on our careers site and @pagerduty on Instagram.
 Additional Information 
PagerDuty is an equal opportunity employer. PagerDuty does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or disability status. Your privacy is important to us. By submitting an application, you confirm that you have read and understand PagerDuty's Privacy Policy .
PagerDuty is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application process. Should you require accommodation, please email accommodation@pagerduty.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

 Description

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to bring rigour and insight to how we grow.

Identify the gaps in our growth. Spot where &Dine isn't growing yet, and build the case for how we should be growing, by product, customer or supply.
Explain the story behind the numbers. Dig into why we're growing strongly in some areas and products, and not in others, so the business is acting on real causes rather than assumptions.
Track trends across our top-tier customers, flagging which relationships are thriving, which are stagnant, and which are at risk, before it's too late to act.
Understand our most impactful makers, sharing why some makers generate more growth than others and what we can do to elevate performance across our wider maker community.
Find the opportunity in our long tail accounts with real potential, and help the commercial team build a plan to unlock it.
 Skills, Knowledge and Experience 
3+ years' experience in a revenue operations, commercial finance, or analytics role
Strong analytical skills, confident with Excel and BI / Ai tools, and able to turn messy data into a clear, commercial story
A natural communicator, credible enough to influence account managers, salespeople and senior stakeholders with insight, not just numbers
Commercial instinct, where you understand what drives customer growth, retention and churn, not just how to report on it
Experience working with CRM and pipeline tools (e.g. HubSpot) and building reporting or dashboards
Structured and process-driven, comfortable operating close to the CFO and senior commercial leadership

 The type of person we are looking for 
Analytical and genuinely curious about what the data is telling you
