description:
At Klue , We’re Building the Future of Competitive Intelligence 
 The Customer Success team is hiring 👋 
You're the person who walks into an account and immediately sees what matters: the risk no one's named yet, the expansion hiding in plain sight, the champion waiting to be developed. You earn trust fast, ask the right questions, and turn a customer's goals into a plan that actually sticks.
If that sounds like you, keep reading. We'd love to meet you.
As a Senior Customer Success Manager at Klue, you own the full customer relationship, from onboarding through renewal and expansion. You're the connective tissue: keeping every account team aligned, every customer growing, and every risk on the radar before it becomes a problem. Klue's product moves fast. New AI agents, integrations, and capabilities ship continuously. The CSMs who thrive here stay ahead of it, act on signals early, and show up as both a trusted advisor and a confident commercial partner.
 Your Mission? To make sure every customer in your book gets real, measurable value from Klue, and grows because of it. You build the relationships, drive the adoption, and close the commercial outcomes. When your customers win, you win.
 What's In It for You? 
This role puts you at the center of how B2B companies use competitive intelligence to win deals, grow revenue, and own their markets. You'll work across industries and stakeholder levels, build deep customer intuition, and gain hard-won experience running complex change management inside leading organizations. In an AI-first company shipping continuously, your expertise compounds fast. No two years here look the same.
 What You'll Do 
 Own Renewals and Expansions. Your book, your number. You forecast it, manage it, and hit it. That means spotting churn signals before anyone else names them, building the business case for expansion, and running cross-sell motions with Sales, including Klue's win-loss interview program. The commercial outcomes are yours.
 Drive Adoption and Platform Completeness. Klue ships fast. Your job is to make sure every customer keeps up: AI agents running, integrations live, Curators and Consumers actually using the platform. You stay current on what's new and make it land, translating product velocity into conversations your customers care about.
 Map Outcomes and Demonstrate ROI. You connect Klue to what your customers actually care about: win rate, rep confidence, PMM efficiency. You quantify it, document it, and make it impossible to argue with at renewal time. ROI isn't a slide you build at the end, it's a story you're telling all year.
 Multi-Thread and Lead Change. Single-threaded accounts are at-risk accounts. You build across levels by default: economic buyers, Champions, Consumers, exec sponsors. You help customers navigate their own organizations and drive adoption through real friction, not around it.
 Lead the Account Team. You own the account, which means owning the strategy and everyone working inside it. Win-Loss Researchers, PMAs, Sales, AI Solutions. You set the direction. They execute alongside you.
 What Success Looks Like 
We want you to love the role you're in and believe these are the things that matter most. You'll know you're nailing it when:
GRR and expansion targets are met or exceeded for your book every quarter.
All eligible customers have their AI agents running: right competitors tracked, right integrations live, platform usage above benchmarks.
Upsell and cross-sell opportunities are identified, qualified, and closed at or above target. Win-loss cross-sell pipeline exists and is actively moving for eligible accounts.
Every account has at least one documented ROI moment per quarter, tied to a specific Klue outcome.
Every account has at least two active contacts at different levels. No single-threaded accounts in your book.
Customers are activated on new product capabilities within one quarter of release.
Risk is flagged and acted on early, not discovered at renewal.
 What You Bring 
 Must Haves: 
 The experience. track record in a CSM or commercial role with direct revenue accountability. You've owned renewals and expansion targets and hit them.
 Ownership. ability to lead and coordinate a cross-functional account team without direct authority.
 Customer facing. Proven success building trust and credibility across a customer organization, from day-to-day champions to executive buyers.
 Commercial fluency. comfortable with upsell conversations, business-case development, and navigating contract dynamics with confidence.
 Strong discovery skills. can diagnose a customer's business goals, connect them to Klue's platform outcomes, and make the link explicit and repeatable.
 Change management instinct. knows how to build internal Champions, navigate complex stakeholder dynamics, and drive adoption against organizational friction.
 Multi-threading instinct. you build relationships across levels by default, not as a recovery strategy.
 Signal awareness and speed. proactively identifies risk and opportunity in customer behavior, usage data, and relationship health, and acts fast.
 Technical curiosity. comfortable learning integrations and AI capabilities, and explaining them clearly to non-technical audiences.
 AI-fluency. actively uses AI tools in day-to-day work and can model that behavior with customers.
 Nice-to-Haves: 
Experience in competitive intelligence, product marketing, sales enablement, or B2B SaaS.
Familiarity with technical integrations (MCP, CRM, Slack, or similar) and comfort guiding customers through deployment.
Knowledge of competitive enablement best practices and how revenue teams operationalize competitive programs.
Hands-on experience with AI tools beyond basic usage: prompt design, workflow automation, or AI-assisted customer work.

 Why Klue Might Be the Perfect Fit For You 
At Klue, you’ll push the boundaries of what’s possible. For yourself, your team, and our customers. The environment here feels more startup than corporate. You’ll roll up your sleeves, build, iterate, and level up. This is a place where your ideas matter, you can shape what comes next, and leave your mark.
If you’re looking to join a category-defining company… where you own big outcomes, influence real customers, and work with smart, gritty people… you’ll thrive here. 
 Unlock Your Potential. Take Risks. Take Action. Innovate 
 How We Work at Klue 
We love the balance of connection and flexibility. We work Office-First , with a hybrid touch, and work together in our vibrant offices on Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays to collaborate, brainstorm, and build together.
Our main hiring hubs are in:
 🇨🇦 Vancouver (HQ) 
 🇨🇦 Toronto 
 🇬🇧 London 
 Our Commitment to You 
 High Performance Culture. We reward high performance and growth through career development, coaching, and annual performance reviews.
 Comprehensive benefits: Extended health & dental coverage that starts on Day 1. Fun perks like discounts at Goodlife and Perkopolis are gravy.
 Ownership: All full-time employees have the opportunity to participate in our Employee Stock Option Plan.
 Our Vacation Policy is Take The Time You Need. We just ask that you give notice and don’t leave your team hanging. 
 Top-tier tools. All employees will receive a Mac (or PC, if that’s your jam) and access to A+ tooling. 
 AI First. All employees are encouraged to lean into AI to work smarter and faster. Built something cool lately? Show us at our Friday Show, Don’t Tell Meetings.
 Growth / Leadership. Direct access to our leadership team, including our CEO, and opportunities to connect with incredible people across the company.
 Social connection. There’s no shortage of ways to stay connected and have fun. We get together once a year in Vancouver for a company- wide kickoff. Throughout the year our Hubs hold regular social events.
 Dog-friendly spaces. Bring your four-legged friend along in Vancouver or Toronto, as our offices are pup-approved.
 About Klue 
We’re on a mission to help organizations stop losing winnable deals. Klue’s AI agents generate market, competitor, and buyer insights in a unified platform. We ensure it’s trustworthy, automated, and activated across every department, so they have the answers they need to own their market.
✨ Here’s what makes us tick:
 Klue is AI-first at its core. It’s wired deep into our internal processes and tooling, powering our small but mighty team. It drives Klue’s autonomous agents that handle the heavy lifting for customers: collecting intel, generating insights, and ensuring content is updated and available across departments. Our agents help them scale their impact, stay ahead of the market, and reclaim the time that used to be consumed by manual, repetitive busywork.
 Competitor Insights. Klue helps revenue teams win more competitive deals by turning market, competitor, and buyer signals into insights teams can actually use. Our AI analyzes calls, CRM data, and real buyer feedback to give product marketers and sellers a clear picture of what’s happening in their market and why deals are won or lost. We’re a curious, collaborative team building a platform that helps companies compete with confidence, and we’re looking for people who want to do meaningful work alongside others who care about craft and impact.
 A culture of curiosity, ownership and winning together . We’re a fast-growing, globally-distributed team based in Vancouver (with hubs like Toronto), scaling quicker than ever. We value people who own their domain, act boldly, stay curious and thrive in a collaborative, high-performance environment.

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will manage a larger and more complex book of business, leading high-impact customer engagements, expansions, and rollouts. Provide strategic guidance across onboarding, integrations, platform configuration, and ongoing engagement
Act as a trusted advisor, providing data-driven insights and strategic guidance to customers to help them achieve their business objectives.

Proactively improve customer health by continuously showing value and outcomes achieved, identifying and mitigating risks, managing escalations with confidence and implementing retention strategies.
Drive cross-functional collaboration, aligning customer needs with product, sales, and support teams to improve customer outcomes.
 KPIs: Internal Feedback Utilization, Product Adoption Growth
Identify and execute upsell and expansion opportunities to maximize customer value and contribute to revenue growth.
 KPIs: Expansion Revenue
Advocate for customer needs while fostering executive relationships and collaborating effectively across internal teams, balancing business objectives to deliver measurable customer success and business growth.
Serve as a subject matter expert on best practices for procurement, AP automation, and spend management.
 Who we’re looking for: 
5+ years of Customer Success experience in SaaS, with a track record of managing and growing a high-value book of business.
Proven ability to build executive-level relationships and influence across both customer organizations and internal teams.
Strong experience leading multi-stakeholder implementations, rollouts, and change management initiatives.
Thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity while adapting to a changing culture.
Able to work effectively cross-functionally, aligning with Product, Sales, and Support teams to deliver strong customer outcomes.
Comfortable managing escalations and turning challenges into opportunities for growth.
A data-driven, strategic thinker who proactively identifies risks and opportunities to drive retention and expansion.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and drive action.
Passion for customer success, with a customer-centric mindset and a problem-solving attitude.
Experience in procurement, AP automation, or fintech industries is a plus.
For customer-facing roles, maintains an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensures it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect their role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.

title: Commercial Operations Manager
description:
About us 
Every large company is trying to make better decisions with the data it already owns. Most hit the same wall. Strategy lives in one system, sales in another, the market model in a consultant's spreadsheet, and the plan in a deck nobody has opened since the offsite. By the time a regional head knows a segment has moved, the quarter is gone. The data exists. It just never arrives anywhere a decision is being made.
STRATOS was built to solve this problem. We work with global B2B companies to synchronize strategy and execution and ensure commercial success is driven by potential, not gut feel or old data.
STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup funded extensively by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by nearly a dozen global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI.
Tasks
 The role. You are the operational backbone of our commercial team. You own how we deliver: the playbooks our Commercial Product Managers run customer rollouts from, the knowledge base that holds what we have learned, and the processes and templates that keep quality consistent as the team grows. You work across commercial, product and engineering, and directly with our co-founders.
This is not a traditional project management role. You are not tracking other people's tasks — you are deciding how the work should be done and building the systems that make it happen. The gaps you find are yours to close.
 The roles you'll play 
 Owner of the playbooks — design and maintain how we run a customer rollout, from onboarding through to ongoing value delivery, and improve it after every engagement.
 Keeper of what we know — build and curate the internal knowledge base, capturing the insights and the mistakes from customer work so the next team doesn't repeat them.
 Architect of how we work — establish the repeatable processes, templates and workflows that let a growing team deliver consistently excellent work.
 Conductor across teams — coordinate workstreams across commercial, product and engineering so nothing falls between them, and distil the patterns into recommendations that improve the next rollout.
Requirements
 Who this is for. We hire for judgement and follow-through. Most people who do well here have three to five years in operations, business operations, programme management, consulting or a chief-of-staff role — but we are open about where yours comes from.
You see the gap before anyone else does, and you close it without being asked.
You write clearly. You can turn something messy into a document other people can follow, and you keep it current rather than letting it rot.
You hold the detail and the direction at once — you notice the missing field in the template, and you know why the template exists.
You are comfortable telling a founder that something isn't working, and comfortable being told the same.
You would rather build the system once than solve the same problem five times.
 This probably isn't for you if you want a defined remit handed to you, or if you would rather run a process someone else designed. 
Benefits
 What We Offer 
Equity through our stock option programme, so you share in the long-term success and growth of the company
A highly competitive salary
High visibility and direct work with the co-founders from day one
Close mentorship from experienced operators — our team is small enough that this happens in person, not through a training curriculum
Private healthcare with BUPA
Pension scheme
25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays
Work from abroad — up to four weeks a year, and up to two weeks at a time
Hybrid office policy in our Farringdon office, with visa sponsorship available
A company committed to social and environmental responsibility — we pledge to be a net-zero CO₂ company and donate 1% of our revenue to social causes
 Practicalities 
London-based, 3 days a week in our Farringdon office
German is a plus, and not a requirement
 The process 
First round with our Talent Lead — 30 minutes
Technical case interview — 45 minutes
Hiring manager interview — 30 minutes
Senior exec interview – 30 minutes
Final stage with our CEO — 45 minutes

Description
Job Description
We are looking for an Enterprise Customer Success Manager (CSM) who is passionate about helping IMPLAN's largest customers get lasting value from IMPLAN software and economic analysis. Enterprise CSMs each own a book of about 25 strategic accounts: Fortune 500 teams, federal program offices and labs, and large campus-wide institution licenses. This is a hands-on role. The CSM learns how each customer works and helps them make IMPLAN a regular part of the studies, briefings, and reports they produce. The CSM owns each relationship from the sales handoff through renewal, and is expected to deliver results that lead to on-time renewals, broader adoption, and value the customer's leadership can see.
Primary Responsibilities
The Enterprise CSM will develop a deep understanding of IMPLAN data and products, and of the analytical work each customer does. In practice, the role works much like a forward deployed engineer. The CSM works inside the customer's process, not just next to it: setting up first projects alongside the customer's analysts, building templates and repeatable study structures, and connecting IMPLAN results to the tools the customer already uses. For campus-wide licenses, the CSM builds adoption at scale with AI agents and automated outreach. This person excels in a fast-paced team environment, can manage many concurrent accounts with minimal supervision, and communicates clearly with everyone from analysts to executives.
Onboarding & Implementation
? Review each Sales-to-CS handoff for completeness, and accept it or send it back with the gaps named
? Lead the kickoff with the customer's team and build a success plan with business goals and a first value milestone.
? Lead data collection and first-project setup alongside the customer's teams, partnering closely with Education Services internally.

Adoption & Engagement
? Run the engagement cadence: a quarterly business review (QBR) for all clients including an annual Executive business review. 
? Build relationships with each customer at every level, from users to executives, and make sure every account has several relationships so no account depends on one champion
? Join customer working sessions, review drafts of their studies, and travel on site for workshops, and executive reviews

? Route how-to and technical tickets to Support, and work with Education Services on analysis support. 
Retention & Renewals

? Deliver an ROI analysis and renewal strategy so impact is visible

Expansion & Growth

 Evaluate and manage the go-to-market (GTM) technology stack to support efficient and scalable sales operations.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
Who We Are 
Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:
 Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
 Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
 Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.
Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.
Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.
Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.
 Senior Customer Success Manager 
 Who we are 
Are you passionate about innovating at the intersection of technology and personal security? At Pindrop, we recognize that the human voice is a unique personal identifier, increasingly susceptible to sophisticated fraud, including the threat of deepfakes. We're leading the way in developing cutting-edge authentication, fraud prevention, and deepfake detection. Our mission is to provide seamless and secure digital experiences, safeguarding the most personal aspect of our identity: our voice. Here, you'll be part of a team driven by values of Innovation, Customer Advocacy, Excellence, and Impact. We're not just creating a safer digital landscape by fortifying trust and integrity with those we serve, we're also building a dynamic, supportive workplace where your contributions make a real difference.
Headquartered in Atlanta, GA, Pindrop is backed by world-class investors such as Andreessen-Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.
 The opportunity 
As a Senior CSM, you are a strategic advisor to enterprise and strategic customers. You own complex relationships, full renewal outcomes, executive escalations, and multi-quarter account strategy, while using customer insight to shape how Product, GTM, and the broader CS organization serves customers. This is a remote-based role located within the United States.
 What you'll do 
Own a portfolio of enterprise and strategic customers, serving as the primary customer success leader and trusted advisor across multiple stakeholder levels, including executives. Serve as the primary point of contact for your customers for the life of the relationship.
Build and execute account strategies tied to customer business priorities, retention, and expansion. Define and execute account planning with Account Executives to achieve strategic goals. Identify growth opportunities and build business cases for expansion; present portfolio strategy to Sales and leadership as needed.
Own with sales the full renewal lifecycle for complex accounts, including risk identification, forecast accuracy, and clear mitigation plans for accounts at risk. Track renewal events, raise renewal risks, and drive customer retention.
Lead executive business reviews and value conversations that connect Pindrop capabilities to measurable business outcomes. Quantify value realized vs. expected, and align on results with customers.
Use product usage, customer health, and business data to identify adoption gaps and expansion opportunities. Anticipate customer needs and serve as a strong internal voice of the customer across Product, Sales, GTM, and leadership.
Independently lead complex escalations, including executive dissatisfaction, through resolution. Coordinate recovery plans across Sales, Product, Support, and other partners. Run postmortems and recommend process changes that prevent recurrence.
Assist customers with operationalizing new product features and quantify customer benefits. Educate customers on fraud and authentication best practices. Serve as conduit between customer and product team: communicate new features, support the enhancement request process, facilitate beta engagements, coordinate case studies and customer references, and compile product feedback.
Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve customer outcomes, retention, and adoption beyond individual accounts. Develop playbooks and processes that improve how the broader CS team manages adoption, retention, risk, and executive engagement.
Mentor other CSMs through account strategy, executive communication, renewal risk management, and customer advocacy.
Determine the optimal cadence of customer engagement to resolve open items, discuss performance, and drive product and feature adoption. Execute annual satisfaction surveys and report results internally and to customers.
Manage contractual commitments and track subscription license usage on a monthly basis. Facilitate responses for compliance and model risk assessments.
Leverage Gainsight, analytics, and reporting tools to manage customer health and engagement. Apply good judgment to system-generated signals rather than accepting them at face value.
 What success looks like 
Customers view you as a strategic advisor, not just a point of contact.
Renewal risks are identified early, the commercial path is clear, and forecast accuracy is reliable across your portfolio.
Executive business reviews consistently connect product usage to customer business outcomes.
Your portfolio shows measurable progress in retention, health, adoption, and expansion over time.
Cross-functional teams act on your customer insight to improve product, process, and GTM decisions.
Other CSMs are using your processes and your influence extends beyond your own book of business.
 What makes this a senior CSM role 
You operate with a high degree of autonomy across complex enterprise accounts, not just a larger task list.
You shape customer strategy and internal decisions through executive relationships, data, and good judgment.
Your impact extends beyond your own portfolio through cross-functional leadership, customer advocacy, and mentoring.
 Who you are 
You are an excellent communicator and presenter for all levels of management
You understand the value of strong relationships and cultivate them both internally and externally
You are resilient in the face of challenges, change, and ambiguity
You are optimistic and believe that you can make a problem into a solution
You have a passion for improving the customer experience in the voice channel
You have the ability to analyze data to find and understand trends and ultimately offer suggestions for improved performance
You are resourceful, excited to uncover innovative solutions and teach yourself something new when needed
You take accountability, do the things you say you'll do, under-promise and over-deliver
You are nimble and adaptable when priorities change and continue to see the "forest through the trees"
 Your skill-set 
7-10+ years of relevant experience, with meaningful tenure in a Customer Success or strategic account management role in a SaaS or enterprise software environment
Proven ability to manage C-level relationships with Fortune 100 customers across a portfolio of enterprise and strategic accounts
Track record of owning renewals, managing customer health, and demonstrating value realization in terms customers connect to their business outcomes
Strong executive presence with the ability to lead strategic discussions, executive business reviews, escalations, and commercial conversations
Ability to build multi-quarter account plans, prioritize across a portfolio, and identify expansion opportunities based on customer needs and usage
Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Support, and Professional Services to drive customer outcomes
Experience with Gainsight, Salesforce, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Office
Understanding of call center, CCaaS, or contact center infrastructure is preferred
Experience in fraud, authentication, security, or adjacent technology environments is preferred; experience with anti-fraud or authentication solutions is a plus
Willing to travel up to 25% is required
 What's in it for you : 
As a Pindropper, you join a rapidly growing company making technology more human with the power of voice. You will work alongside some of the best and brightest. We're a passionate group committed to excellence but that doesn't stop us from enjoying the journey as a team with chess and poker tournaments, catered lunches and happy hours, wellness programming, and more. Because we take our jobs seriously, we add in time for rest with Unlimited PTO.

Within 90 days you'll:

At Pindrop, our Core Values are fundamental beliefs at the center of all we do. They are our guiding principles that dictate our actions and behaviors. Our Values are deeply embedded into our culture in big and small ways and even help us decide right from wrong when the path forward is unclear. At Pindrop, we believe in taking accountability to make decisions and act in a way that reflects who we are. We truly believe making decisions and acting with our Core Values in mind will help us to achieve our goals and keep Pindrop a great place to work:
Audaciously Innovate - We continue to change the world, and the way people safely engage and interact with technology. As first principle thinkers, we challenge standards, take risks and learn from our mistakes in order to make positive change and continuous improvement. We believe nothing is impossible.

title: GTM Engineering - ShareGate

Your role
ShareGate’s customers generate rich signals (product usage, support interactions, renewal dates), but those signals aren’t yet connected into an engine that protects and grows the revenue we already have. As our GTM Architect, Expansion & Retention, you’ll design, build and ship AI agents and agentic workflows that turn those signals into saved renewals and cross-sell pipeline. This is an embedded engineering role within GTM, not back-office ops: you’ll apply the signal-based, agent-first approach we already use for new customer acquisition to the customers we already have.
 Your impact: 
Protect renewals by building AI agents that continuously monitor renewal health and flag at-risk accounts to Account Managers early, with context, recommended next steps and enough lead time to act.
Grow revenue from our existing customers by designing and running an agentic cross-sell motion: score fit for our second product line, research each account, personalize outreach, qualify interest and route genuine intent to the right salesperson with the full context needed to close.
Define the signals your agents need and partner with Revenue Systems, which builds and owns the data flow between product usage and the CRM. Validate the data with SQL before you act on it.
Replace manual workflows with AI agents and reusable pipeline modules (not one-off automations) that Account Management and Sales can run and own on their own.

Drive adoption by turning everything you build into SOPs, demos and playbooks, so the team uses what you ship, not just appreciates it.
Your team
You’ll join a GTM engineering effort that already runs a signal-based, agent-first approach to new customer acquisition, and now points it at the customers we already have. The ability to work directly with Sales and Account Management, translate complex builds into plain language, and earn adoption through demos and handoff docs, without a PM to bridge the gap;
Bonus: experience building AI-driven qualification or scoring systems; a B2B SaaS background with multiple product lines, ideally product-led or demo-led; published technical content that makes complex systems accessible.
Note: The internal title for this role is GTM Architect.
What the job comes with

OTE : $120,000 - $155,000
LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.
RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.

Claude access, for everyone.
 What drives us

We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.
If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.
 How we hire 
Transparency is how we hire — for you as much as for us.
Here's how it works: a first call with a recruiter, then a virtual interview with the hiring manager. We can't wait to meet you.

title: Revenue Operations

Building out prospecting programs, marketing campaigns and events cadences, helping the sales team to drive net new demand.

Turn insight into action: Analyze complex datasets and translate findings into clear, executive-ready recommendations that drive high-leverage decisions.

 What you’ll bring

 Even better… 
SQL experience.
Familiarity with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and marketing automation tools.
Previous 0-1 startup or operational experience.
 Our values

 Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.
 Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. You’ll work across Vitesse to bring the right expertise to customer priorities, manage risks and keep agreed outcomes on track.
Success will be reflected in customer health and growth in balances, payment accounts, participant connections and Vitesse’s share of customer payment activity.
 Core Responsibilities 
Own strategic Enterprise customer relationships and build trusted connections with operational, technical and executive stakeholders.
Develop and maintain Customer Success Plans tied to customer priorities, with clear measures of value, regular reviews and agreed next steps.
Help customers realise value from Vitesse and use effective discovery to identify opportunities to grow its role across their treasury and payment activity.
Map stakeholder groups, understand customer decision-making and maintain alignment across complex organisations.
Identify risks and barriers early, and coordinate with customer and Vitesse teams to resolve issues and keep agreed outcomes on track.

 Why Join Us?

 Skills and Experience 
Significant experience in Customer Success, Account Management or a related role in insurance or a complex B2B technology environment.
A strong record of managing strategic customers and delivering measurable value, adoption and growth.
Confidence building trusted relationships with C-suite and senior executives and acting as a strategic adviser within complex organisations.
Experience developing Success Plans, leading business reviews and connecting customer goals to measurable outcomes.
Strong commercial judgement and the ability to identify customer needs and credible expansion opportunities.
Excellent discovery, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
The ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and keep complex customer priorities moving without relying on direct authority.
An understanding of carriers, TPAs, MGAs or the wider insurance ecosystem. or the ability to build that expertise quickly.
We understand that everyone has their own work rhythm and believe in a flexible working schedule - at Vitesse you’re expected to work 35 hours a week. 
 Our Values – or what we call “Vitesse at Our Best” 
The Vitesse values are a true reflection of what it takes to thrive in our business, so it’s important to us that any employee who joins our business is aligned with these 3 attributes
 Confident Humility 
We believe the best ideas come from listening and learning. We leave ego at the door, ask for help when we need it, and celebrate collective success. When one of us wins, we all do.
 Driven to Succeed

 Tenacious Responsibility

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Sales Operations Lead
description:
**Description**
---------------
**About Bright Software Group** 
At Bright, we are powering the digital practice of tomorrow – today. 
We deliver products that help accountants, payroll bureaus, and businesses across the UK and Ireland work smarter and win more. Our portfolio spans payroll, accounting, tax, and practice management, built around the people who use them every day. 
We believe understanding is the difference between working and winning. 
**The Role**
The Sales Operations Lead owns the day-to-day running of Sales Operations, working closely with the Director of Revenue Operations to keep the function well governed and consistently delivered. The post-holder is the operational backbone for the sales team's use of HubSpot, driving process, reporting and platform discipline, and building capability across the wider team so expertise isn't concentrated in one person.
**What You'll Do**
------------------
* Own pipeline reporting and forecasting, building, maintaining and challenging sales forecasts, pipeline reviews and revenue projections, with accuracy against target on a weekly and monthly cadence.
* Manage deal validation and booking rules — new business, upsell, cross-sell and renewals — including reviewing pricing, discounts and non-standard terms so every deal is classified and counted correctly.
* Own full-funnel reporting, from lead through to closed-won, covering conversion rates, sales velocity and win/loss analysis.
* Track core metrics and own the dashboards that give the business a single, trusted view of sales performance.
* Work with the CRO's sales leadership team on go-to-market process design, territory and account assignment, and quota management.
* Manage sales-facing HubSpot processes: pipeline stage definitions, deal data quality standards, and day-to-day sales workflow administration.
* Identify and fix bottlenecks in the sales funnel, working with Marketing on lead response times and qualification criteria.
* Support commission and compensation reporting, ensuring bookings data feeds cleanly into commission calculations.
* Partner with the Director of Revenue Operations and the CRM/HubSpot Systems Architect on sales operations strategy and platform changes.
**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------
**Essential**
* Proven HubSpot operations experience, ideally at enterprise scale.
* Strong hands-on reporting and data skills, comfortable with SQL, Power BI or similar data manipulation tools, with a track record of building sales ops reporting for every level of the business.
* Strong understanding of how a sales operations function should run, pipeline management, forecasting support, deal validation, reporting cadence.
* Strong data-driven decision-making skills and commercial awareness, with comfort working across Sales, Finance, Marketing and Customer Success.
* Comfortable training and upskilling colleagues on CRM use, not just doing the work themselves.
* Experience operating in a fast-moving, multi-system commercial environment (CRM, CPQ, billing, systems), bringing siloed data together to drive real data insights.
* Uses AI tools confidently in day-to-day work, and actively seeks new ways to apply them to do the job better.
**Nice to Have**
* Experience managing or mentoring junior sales operations colleagues.
* Exposure to CPQ or billing platforms (for example DealHub or Maxio) alongside HubSpot.
* Experience in a PE-backed or fast-scaling SaaS business.
**Working At Bright**
---------------------
We build software that makes working lives easier — and we believe in it. You will never need to apologise for what you sell. 
The culture here is collaborative and human. We are not a small company anymore, but it still feels like one — in the best way. People are genuinely looked after, and that is not just something we say. 
You get real autonomy here. We are growing fast, investing heavily in AI, and that creates genuine opportunity – for the business and for the people in it. 
It's a place where curious people thrive.
**About Bright Software Group**
-------------------------------
Bright is built around brilliant people doing brilliant work, and we invest in making sure the environment matches that ambition.
You’ll have genuine flexibility in how you work, backed by modern practices that adapt to how work actually gets done today. We recognise and celebrate strong performance, support your wellbeing, and give you real opportunities to grow, not just in role, but in career.
We’re proud of the culture we’ve built. It’s high-trust, high-expectation, and focused on doing great work.
***That’s Bright***

title: GTM Enablement Manager
description:
**GTM Enablement Manager**
==========================
Procurify is the leading agentic procurement platform for the mid-market, helping organizations take control of their spend and make smarter financial decisions.
We’re building an ambitious, high-performance company where talented people are trusted with meaningful ownership and given the opportunity to make a real impact. Our remote-first culture values accountability, resilience, collaboration, and continuous growth. You’ll work alongside driven teammates on complex, important problems, grow your career through meaningful challenges, and help shape an AI-native company at a defining moment in the evolution of agentic procurement. We’re looking for a talented and team-driven GTM Enablement Manager to join us on our journey.
**About the Role**
------------------
As a GTM Enablement Manager, you will architect the systems, workflows, and intelligence that drive the performance and effectiveness of all GTM teams — including Sales, Customer Experience (CX), and Partnerships. Rather than treating enablement as a series of one-off trainings, you'll approach it as an interconnected system: designing onboarding programs, coaching frameworks, and playbooks that reinforce one another and compound in value over time.
We're looking for someone who thinks from first principles — questioning why processes exist, breaking problems down to their fundamentals, and rebuilding them in ways that are simpler, faster, and more scalable. A core focus of this role is reimagining how GTM teams manage, qualify, and convert inbound opportunities into real pipeline, while elevating outbound execution, customer engagement, and partner-facing motions through automation and AI.
This role sits at the intersection of enablement and our evolution as an AI-enhanced platform. You'll champion how AI and automation can eliminate manual work, surface better insights, and help both our teams and our customers operate more effectively using data. If you see systems where others see silos, and you believe the best process is often the one you can automate away, you'll thrive here.
**What you'll be working on:**
------------------------------
GTM Enablement, Systems & Coaching
* Design onboarding and ramp programs as repeatable, scalable systems for new GTM hires across Sales, CX, and Partnerships.
* Develop and deliver ongoing training, coaching, and skills development — increasingly augmented by AI-driven feedback, call intelligence, and automated coaching workflows.
* Build and maintain playbooks, talk tracks, objection-handling guides, persona briefs, and situational frameworks as living, interconnected assets aligned to our multi-team GTM strategy.
* Conduct call reviews, coaching sessions, and performance retros — leveraging AI conversation-intelligence tools to scale insights across GTM roles, from inbound qualification to customer success conversations and partner engagements.
Pipeline Support & Opportunity Management (Systems & Automation)
* Partner with Growth, Marketing, Customer Success, and RevOps to build automated, intelligent systems for lead routing, opportunity management, and renewal orchestration that serve all relevant GTM teams across the full customer lifecycle.
* Apply first-principles thinking to identify and remove friction in how GTM teams manage pipeline and drive renewals — from initial qualification through expansion and retention — automating the repeatable and reserving human effort for high-value deals and at-risk accounts.
* Monitor pipeline health and renewal performance as a connected system (e.g., speed-to-lead, pipeline velocity, win rates, renewal rates, net revenue retention, churn risk indicators), using data and automation to drive proactive intervention and training priorities across the GTM org.
Collaboration & Cross-System Alignment
* Partner with Marketing, RevOps, Product Marketing, Sales Leadership, CX Leadership, and Partnerships Leadership to align messaging, campaigns, processes, and readiness across the entire GTM system.
* Ensure consistent, automated communication of product updates, market changes, and new GTM initiatives to all customer-facing teams.
* Act as the voice of GTM teams in internal planning, advocating for scalable systems that serve all teams HR, Sales, CX, and Partnerships.
**KPIs for Success**
--------------------
* Reduced ramp time and improved performance across all GTM roles through scalable, systemized enablement.
* Increased inbound conversion, qualified pipeline creation, and overall GTM execution quality — accelerated by AI and automation.
* Consistent adoption of enablement systems, playbooks, and tools across GTM functions.
* High cross-functional alignment and strong operational partnership with Marketing, RevOps, and Product Marketing.
* Improved pipeline contribution, follow-up discipline, and customer engagement across GTM.
**Who we're looking for:**
--------------------------
* 3+ years in GTM enablement, Sales/CX/Partnerships leadership, or a coaching-focused go-to-market role.
* A systems thinker who sees how people, processes, tools, and data connect — and who designs for scale rather than one-off fixes.
* A first-principles problem solver who questions assumptions, deconstructs complex processes, and rebuilds them more efficiently.
* Genuine enthusiasm for AI and automation — with a track record (or strong interest) in using them to eliminate manual work and amplify team performance.
* Deep understanding of full-funnel GTM motions across Sales, CX, and Partnerships teams.
* Proven ability to design and deliver effective onboarding, enablement, and coaching programs for diverse GTM stakeholders.
* Strong grasp of lead management, customer engagement processes, CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), and GTM performance analytics.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and cross-functional influence skills.
* Data-driven mindset with the ability to diagnose performance gaps and prioritize enablement impact.
* Passion for developing talent, improving systems, and building high-performing GTM teams.
* Bonus: Experience in high-growth SaaS; familiarity with Gong, Outreach, Salesloft, enablement platforms, AI/automation tools, or partner engagement tools.
For customer-facing roles, maintains an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensures it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect their role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.
**WHY PROCURIFY?**
------------------
Help us modernize spend management
Procurify is redefining how organizations manage spend — transforming a historically manual, reactive process into a strategic advantage. Today, hundreds of companies trust us to manage billions in spend, and we're just getting started.
Powered by our $50M Series C funding, we are actively expanding our core offering, launching new payment capabilities, and building an AI-enhanced procure-to-pay experience for our customers. Read the press release here. With fresh investment, a strong product foundation, and big ambitions in AI and payments, we're entering our next phase of growth. That means a real opportunity to shape what we build, how we scale, and the impact we have on our customers.
The best part? The team. We're a group of builders who move fast, think big, and show up for each other. No egos, no passengers, just people who want to do great work and win together.
If you're looking for a place where you can make a real impact alongside a team that raises the bar, you'll fit right in.
**Be empowered to do your best work**
We've created an environment where personal and professional growth is a real priority. Some of the great perks we offer include:
* Flexible working: We're a remote-first organization with flexible working hours. Work anywhere from within Canada! And US if applicable.
* Responsible time off: We offer a flexible approach to time off; we trust our team to take the time they need to rest and recharge while staying accountable to their commitments.
* Extended health benefits: We prioritize our team's health and well-being. We offer a competitive health, vision, and dental package along with an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and a health and wellness spending account.
* Continuous Learning: We host regular educational lunch and learns to help our team grow, share knowledge, and stay curious.
* Stock options: Everyone has a chance to own a part of Procurify with our competitive stock program.
* Base Salary Range: $64,000 - $80,000 (This range is dependent on experience and not inclusive of any bonus, commission, benefits or equity that might exist in your total compensation package.)
**Work with an amazing team**
We've welcomed team members who were boat captains, funeral directors, swing dancers, competitive gamers, plumbers, and novelists. Everyone has a story and we're here to embrace them!
**LEARN MORE**
--------------
Procurify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against any team members or applicants for employment because of race, color, disability, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity and/or expression.
If you feel like you don't meet all of the requirements for this role, we encourage you to apply anyway. We know that feelings of imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting incredible candidates, and we certainly don't want those feelings to get in the way of meeting you! We really want to get to know you and why you're great for the role. Please avoid including your picture and age on your resume.
Apply online today and let's start a conversation.
To learn more about Procurify, check out these resources:
* Check out what our customers are saying about us
* Learn more about our procure-to-pay platform

Working closely with a dedicated Technical Account Manager (TAM), Sales, Service Delivery, Support, and Engineering, the Strategic CSM provides leadership, coordination, and proactive account oversight throughout the customer lifecycle. This is a highly visible role requiring demonstrated success managing significant enterprise relationships, identifying and mitigating business risks, and building trusted customer partnerships.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Account Ownership: Serve as the primary post-sales business and relationship owner for a select portfolio of high-value Strategic accounts, maintaining accountability for customer engagement, account governance, business objectives, and overall relationship health.
 Customer Outcomes: Develop and execute customer success plans that align Vultr's services and contractual commitments with the customer's business objectives, deployment milestones, operational expectations, and measurable success outcomes.
 Executive Relationship Management: Build and maintain executive-level relationships (CTO, CIO, VP Engineering, Procurement, etc.), becoming a trusted advisor in infrastructure strategy.
 Service Delivery Coordination: Partner with Technical Account Managers (TAMs), Service Delivery, Support, and Engineering to maintain visibility into deployment milestones, service performance, contractual commitments, and operational risks, ensuring customer expectations and communications are effectively managed throughout the engagement.

title: Revenue Enablement Specialist

title: Customer Success Team Lead
description:
At Orbisk, we're on a mission to create a world where zero food waste isn't just a dream, it's a reality. We combine cutting-edge tech with a sustainability-first mindset to help the hospitality industry make smarter, greener choices. As a proud B Corp, we're leading the way in the fight against food waste, and our results speak volumes: 8+ million kg of food waste eliminated in 50+ countries (and counting!).
We don't just offer technology; we're a trusted partner to our customers, working alongside them to create lasting change. Our AI monitor sits above the bin, recognises every discard, prices it at what the kitchen actually pays for its food, and turns it all into weekly actions a chef can use. From five-star hotels to global contract caterers, our customers use Orbisk to turn food waste from a number they measure into a cost they manage.
With our team growing, we're looking for a Customer Success Team Lead to build and run the team that keeps and grows our customer base, and helps every kitchen waste less. Let's create impact together!
 What's on the menu?
 You lead a team of Customer Success Managers across all our markets, and you own the revenue of our installed base: what we keep, what we renew and what we grow.
This is a player-coach role. You coach the team and hold it to a clear commercial standard. You keep a small portfolio of strategic accounts yourself, so you stay close to customers and lead by example in renewals and negotiations.
You also shape where Customer Success goes next. With leadership, you decide where your team adds the most value, and you build the playbook, rituals and data that let each CSM handle a bigger portfolio without losing quality.
A typical week: a pipeline and renewal review with your team on Monday, a joint call with a CSM to unblock a tricky renewal with a hotel group, a session with Product on what customers are asking for, and a business review with one of your own accounts.
You work closely with Sales, Account Management, RevOps, Product and Operations.
 What You Will Own
 Your team
Lead, coach and develop the team. Run weekly 1:1s, give direct feedback and grow people into commercial owners.
Set clear targets per CSM for retention, expansion and adoption, and hold the team to them.
Hire well: shape the profile, interview and onboard new CSMs as the team grows.
Decide how accounts are allocated by market, segment and size.
 The revenue of the installed base
Own net revenue retention and renewals across the Customer Success portfolio.
Run the renewal engine: every renewal visible months ahead, risks escalated early, contracts signed well before the end date.
Turn the team into an expansion engine: opportunities spotted, qualified and closed, with Sales on the biggest ones.
Own the Customer Success forecast and present it to leadership every week.
Lead the renewals and expansion of your own strategic accounts.
 The playbook
Build and keep up the playbook: onboarding, adoption, business reviews, renewal and expansion.
Define the health signals that predict churn and expansion, and make sure the team acts on them.
Make HubSpot the single source of truth for the team, with clean data and clear stages.
 Across Orbisk
Bring the voice of the customer to Product and Operations, with structured feedback and priorities.
Agree hand-overs with Sales and Account Management, so no customer falls between two teams.
Work with RevOps on reporting and targets.
 What Success Looks Like
 You are measured on the revenue your team keeps and grows, and on a team that can do it without you in every call.
Net revenue retention of the Customer Success portfolio.
Renewal rate: the share of ARR up for renewal that renews.
Early renewals: the share of renewals signed well ahead of the end date.
Expansion: new ARR from the installed base.
Forecast accuracy: renewals and expansion land where you said they would.
Team: every CSM hitting their targets, and regretted attrition kept low.
By day 60 you know the portfolio and the people, have a renewal and risk view of every account, and have agreed team targets with leadership. By day 90 the playbook is in place, the forecast is trusted and expansion is a weekly habit in the team.
 What You Bring To The Table
You have led a team with a revenue target for two years or more, in customer success, account management or sales.
You have turned a service-minded team into one that sells. You set expansion targets, changed how people were paid or measured, and the numbers moved. You can show how.
You have owned retention and expansion numbers for a portfolio, and you can show how you moved them.
You are a strong negotiator. You have closed renewals and expansions with multi-stakeholder customers, from operational teams to procurement and executives.
You coach people to perform. You give direct feedback, set a clear standard and help people grow into it.
You build structure. You have set up playbooks, health scores, forecasts or CRM processes, ideally in a start-up or scale-up.
You work with data. ARR, retention, pipeline and forecast are your daily language.
You understand how hotels, restaurant groups and catering operations run, and how they make purchasing decisions.
You are fluent in English. Any additional language is a strong plus.
 Things that would make us extra excited
You have scaled a Customer Success team through fast customer growth.
You have worked in hardware plus software, or in a subscription business with multi-year contracts.
You have a background in hospitality or F&B, or a network in hotel groups or contract catering.
 Why join Orbisk?
 There are plenty of good reasons. Some are big, like making a real impact by reducing food waste and cutting CO₂ and water footprints worldwide. Others are more personal: joining a fast-growing scale-up is exciting, full of opportunities, and a great chance to shape a team from the ground up. Plus, you'll be part of a team that's driven, innovative, and just a little adventurous. And of course, we've got some great perks to offer too:
30 days annual leave.
7% pension contribution.
A monthly wellness budget, home office budget and travel allowance.
Free lunch at the office.
€500 a year for your own learning and development
Regular company activities to connect, celebrate and have fun together.
 A team for a better world
 Ending food waste takes the brightest, most passionate minds, and we know the best ideas come from bringing different perspectives together.
We strongly believe we all do our best work when we're free to be ourselves. That's why we're committed to building diverse and inclusive teams where everyone belongs.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and all hiring decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. If you need any reasonable adjustments at any point in the application or interview process, please don't hesitate to reach out.

title: Sales Operations Manager
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen
 Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.
 THE TEAM
 ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
 Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
 An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation
 About The Role
 Relay sells through two core motions. The first is our new-business engine: a B2B enterprise sales motion winning large retailers and brands with significant parcel volumes — and, in time, extending down-market into Small medium enterprises (SME) as that segment opens up. The second is our field engine, which grows Relay's network of "Pitstops" — local shops and businesses that act as pick-up and drop-off points where consumers can collect parcels and return items.
Both motions depend on the systems and processes this role will build and own: the account universe and TAM, lead scoring and prioritisation, outreach, CRM architecture, governance, and sales tooling.
You'll be both architect and operator, and AI-native in how you work. You'll define what great looks like across the systems and processes underpinning both sales motions, then take ownership of making it happen. You’ll also be highly fluent in metrics — using dashboards and funnel data to identify where performance is breaking down, where opportunities are being lost, and where we can drive greater efficiency.
 What You'll Do
Build the new-business engine: own TAM, account scoring and weekly prioritisation, plus a top-of-funnel (enrichment, multi-threaded contacts, sequencing, signal-based triggers) that lets sales spend their time pitching, not hunting. 
Own the CRM and deal desk: architect Pipedrive around the selling rhythm, govern deal terms, stages and approval gates from pitch to activation, and raise the quality and speed of pitches and proposals. 
Scale the Pitstop engine: run the field team's scoring, territories, targets and dashboards, manage pricing levers and CPA, and keep lead-to-live data clean, pushing toward a self-running engine with algorithmic assignment, referrals and AI-handled inbound. 
Automate relentlessly: own the tooling stack and build-vs-buy calls (defaulting to building), strip manual work out of the sales day, and design systems that extend to SME and self-serve through configuration, not a rebuild. 
Diagnose and fix the funnel: use funnel data to find where deals stall and pipeline leaks, then ship the fixes. 
 Who Will Thrive in This Role
Systems thinker. You build systems rather than one-off fixes, and you take ideas all the way to a shipped, working solution yourself. 
Proven RevOps experience. You've run sales or revenue operations in a fast-moving environment and know what best-in-class looks like across top-of-funnel, CRM, deal desk and process. 
CRM owner, not just admin. You've implemented and evolved Pipedrive (or similar) so it fits the selling motion, rather than bending the motion to fit the tool. 
Native AI builder. You're fluent with Claude and have shipped real tooling and automations in a live business. 
Fast, practical delivery. You implement quickly and are comfortable scoping work for engineering when you need their help. 
High bar for quality. You insist on clean data and tight processes
Equally strong in detail and with people. You're comfortable refining a workflow in depth and equally at ease talking pipeline quality with sales. 
 Compensation, Benefits & Workplace
Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay's success
Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you'd need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it
25 days of holidays
Enhanced parental leave
Hardware of your choice
Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more)
Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote. 
 Who Thrives at Relay?
Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously. 
Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction. 
1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience. 
All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts. 
People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success. 
Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we. 
If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

title: Revenue Enablement Lead
description:

The Semios Group includes trusted brands such as Semios, Agworld, Altrac, and Greenbook. We continue to drive the next generation of digital agriculture, supporting growers, agronomists and ag retailers in improving sustainability and profitability.
Our innovative work has been recognized with several industry awards, including:
AgTech Breakthrough – Smart Irrigation Company & Pest Management Solution of the Year
Thrive Top 50

Collaborate to design and implement sales incentive and compensation programs that drive growth in alignment with company objectives.
Partner with sales leadership to track, improve forecasting discipline and strengthen pipeline management practices across the organization.

Operational Frameworks:

Map, refine, and optimize internal workflows to enable commercial operational excellence and revenue growth.

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description:
Enterprise Customer Success Manager 
 Location: Hybrid (Montréal, QC | Toronto, ON | Halifax, NS)
 Reports to: Head of Customer Support & Success
 About Us 
Trolley is the payouts platform for the internet economy. Our mission is to unlock the global economic opportunity of the internet by building a truly borderless payouts ecosystem.
Through our platform and API, Trolley enables businesses to pay people anywhere in the world, supporting creators, on-demand workers, and suppliers at scale. Companies rely on Trolley as mission-critical infrastructure to automate payouts, collect tax and banking information, and reduce fraud and risk, all in one place.
Today, Trolley is the trusted payouts solution for hundreds of businesses, including Canva, SoundCloud, and Envato. We've processed millions of payments globally, helping creators, artists, and suppliers get paid quickly, securely, and with confidence.
As we continue to grow, we're looking for a customer-focused technical expert who is passionate about building strong client relationships, solving complex challenges, and helping customers realize the full value of the Trolley platform. This role can be based in Montréal, Toronto, or Halifax , working in a hybrid environment alongside our collaborative and globally distributed team.
 What You'll Do 
Own and manage a portfolio of high-value and complex customers and act as their strategic business partner.
Deliver a world-class customer experience to your customers and evangelize the benefits and value of our solutions.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers, becoming a trusted advisor and advocate for their success.
Become a solution expert to instate a high level of customer confidence in you and our Trolley solutions.
Gain a deep understanding of our customers’ operational workflows and use cases to provide more tailored and impactful client guidance.
Gain deep industry knowledge in end-to-end payment automation, tax regulations, and the unique challenges facing our key market segments to earn the right to become a trusted advisor.
Grow your customers' depth of understanding by providing enablement sessions on new and existing features and capabilities, and translate complex concepts into easy to understand solutions that align with your customers’ business workflows and goals.
Provide a strong functional consultative approach to customer management with a passion for identifying solutions to meet customers' business goals (understanding how complex solutions work in practice).
Drive engagement across multiple customer stakeholders by understanding their unique goals/business outcomes, supporting their internal change management process during implementation/onboarding, and continually monitoring KPIs and changing business needs through quarterly business reviews.
Build and maintain influential relationships with customers with highly complex use cases, from end users to executive sponsors, to ensure they achieve their business goals and have a best-in-class experience.
Actively monitor adoption, analyze data/metrics/industry trends, and implement strategies that showcase how customers can enhance their workflows and use our product to derive value.
Collaborate with support, product and other internal stakeholders to help resolve customer issues and ensure timely resolution.
Advocate for customers' needs (product features, bug fixes and potential improvements), working cross-functionally with internal teams to champion projects and product enhancements.
Effectively engage multiple customer stakeholders in discussing organizational goals, uncovering additional business problems/opportunities, and exploring potential up/cross-sell solutions. 
Driving strategic growth for both Trolley and the customers.
Proactively identify and close up/cross-sell opportunities by thoroughly understanding client needs and aligning additional products with those needs; contributing to revenue growth while ensuring clients achieve their desired outcomes.
 What We're Looking For 
10+ years of progressive and consultative experience in customer-facing account management roles.
5+ years of experience in Customer Success in B2B SaaS/Software managing large mid-market accounts.
The highest degree of initiative, courtesy, and professionalism to build valuable customer relationships that you will leverage to generate a positive feel in the market and contribute significantly to revenue and company growth.
Bonus points for having experience in financial services, SaaS payment automation, and the internet economy/music royalties.
The ability to learn and pivot quickly in a fast-paced, often ambiguous environment.
Experience managing multiple stakeholders, departments, and implementation cycles.
A high degree of resourcefulness, flexibility, and adaptability.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and trust with customers.
Experience conducting product demonstrations and training sessions.
Proficient in leading meetings, ensuring follow-up on action items, and demonstrating strong interpersonal communication skills.
Analytical mindset with experience using data to drive decisions and improve customer success.
Excellent problem-solving, negotiation, and commercial skills.
Proven track record of driving customer success and retention.
Proactively working with at-risk customers to mitigate churn.
Outstanding command of the English Language - written and spoken.
Experience in working with SaaS business/enterprise applications.
Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and the ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.
Confident and proactive team player. You will also be self-motivated and able to think on your feet when dealing with customers.
Exposure to CRM best practices (Salesforce preferred)
Comfortable with Google Apps (Gmail, docs, calendars).
 What We Offer 
Join an amazing team of diverse people working together on a common mission.
Competitive base salary and bonus.
ESOP Program: Meaningful equity and ownership that aligns your success with ours.
Extended healthcare benefits from Day 1.
4 weeks paid vacation per year + public holidays (+ 1 extra vacation day per year of service).
30 days remote work from anywhere.
Gym membership allowance.
1/2 day Fridays off during summer.
Company-provided use of Apple MacBook Pro and Mac gear.
#LI-HYBRID

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋
 Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!
The Revenue Operations team is central to the success of our go-to-market functions. As the Manager of Revenue Operations for the B2B business unit, you will build and lead a high-performing RevOps team in your region, establishing a best-in-class revenue operations function. Your expertise will guide GTM teams in strategic planning, insightful reporting, and performance optimization, helping drive alignment and efficiency across departments.
In this role, you will own the development, monitoring, and refinement of key performance indicators (KPIs) across the entire customer journey to ensure measurable success at every stage. Partnering closely with Finance and GTM leadership, you’ll play a critical role in developing investment cases to enhance team productivity and efficiency. This is a strategic, high-impact position where you will contribute directly to business growth by optimizing processes, establishing robust reporting frameworks, and ensuring data-driven decisions across the organization.
 What You’ll Be Doing
 As the Manager of Revenue Operations, you will lead the RevOps function to drive operational excellence and support profitable revenue growth strategies. Working closely with senior leadership, you’ll develop and execute strategic initiatives aligned with our company OKRs to help achieve revenue and profitability targets.
Weekly Performance Review and Pipeline Updates Lead weekly performance reviews, providing a comprehensive analysis of the pipeline and insights to leadership. This includes detailed forecasting updates for end-of-month (EOM), end-of-quarter (EOQ), and end-of-year (EOY) projections to support proactive decision-making across the organization. You’ll Identify and establish new KPIs to track the health and effectiveness of the GTM teams, adapting to emerging business priorities.
Bi-Weekly Deep-Dive Reviews Conduct in-depth bi-weekly sessions focusing on New Business (AE) and Account Management (AM) performance. This includes delivering rep-level insights, analyzing trends, identifying pipeline risks and opportunities, and contributing to the Weekly Business Review (WBR) to ensure the sales teams are equipped to drive growth.
Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews (MBR/QBR) Facilitate the Monthly Business Review (MBR) and Quarterly Business Review (QBR) sessions, partnering with GTM leaders to provide a strategic overview of performance. These reviews will analyze key metrics, assess progress against targets, and align on actionable insights to drive overall success.
Monthly Quota Analysis and Coverage Recommendations Oversee the monthly analysis of quota attainment and coverage across the sales and customer teams. This responsibility includes providing unbiased data driven insights and recommendations on IC Quotas and Coverage to ensure optimal alignment with market opportunities, our company planning, and resource efficiency.
Quarterly Reforecasting Lead the quarterly reforecasting process, working closely with Finance and GTM leadership. This involves adjusting revenue and performance targets to align with current business realities, identifying areas for investment or cost optimization, and ensuring targets are realistic and achievable.
 In Addition To These Core Responsibilities, You Will
Build and develop the Revenue Operations team as a strategic partner for the Head of RevOps, fostering a culture of high performance that aligns with Lightspeed’s values.
Collaborate with cross-functional leaders in Enablement, Product, and Sales to ensure the strategy is aligned with global priorities and product roadmaps.
 What You Need To Bring
A bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as business, finance, technology, or operations; a master’s degree in business or a related discipline is a plus but not required.
Proven experience leading and developing high-performing teams (2+ years) in a hybrid or remote environment, fostering a collaborative and results-oriented culture.
