 An Overview Of This Role
 As a Staff Renewals Operations Manager at GitLab, you'll help own the operational engine that makes renewals predictable, measurable, and efficient at scale. Reporting to the Director of CX Operations, you'll be the Renewals team's go-to business partner for processes, tooling, forecasting and insights, consumption and subscription data, and the steps required to quote and close a renewal. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll lead through ownership and influence, connecting teams and workflows, turning ambiguous problems into clear next steps, and driving improvements that others across the revenue organization depend on.
 What You'll Do
Own and continuously improve the end-to-end renewal operating model; from renewal identification, assignment through risk management, quoting, through to close and post-renewal data hygiene processes.
Develop and improve the operating cadences that guide the renewal business, with a focus on efficiency and process improvement.
Define, maintain, and evolve retention reporting with cross-functional partners, including gross and net retention, churn and downgrade analysis, and the drivers behind each.
Partner with Revenue Technology, Revenue Analytics, Finance, and other stakeholders to improve Salesforce and the systems and data flows supporting customer relationship management (CRM), subscription and entitlement records, quoting, orders, billing, and reporting. Translate business needs into requirements, validate solutions, and strengthen data quality and operational controls.
Simplify and scale the renewal motion through automation, standardized workflows, alerts, playbooks, and self-service insights that reduce manual effort and improve execution consistency.
Support renewals planning and capacity management, including segmentation implementation, coverage models, productivity assumptions, capacity modeling, supporting target setting, and scenario planning.
Own and mature the Renewal Operations case-management program, including intake, triage, routing, service-level visibility, resolution, and root-cause analysis. Requests may include user migrations, de-duplication, Renewal Manager ownership changes, compensation exceptions, and Salesforce or data issues.
Raise the operating standard in your domain by documenting processes, mentoring others on how the renewal motion works, and contributing to broader Revenue Operations initiatives that need the renewals perspective.
 What You'll Bring
Experience in Renewals Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, management consulting, strategy, or a similar analytical and problem-solving role, with ownership of operational improvements and cross-functional initiatives.
Hands-on experience with both consumption and subscription renewal motions, including renewal forecasting, retention reporting, and the contractual and process mechanics that govern how renewals close.
Strong critical thinking and structured problem-solving skills. You can break down ambiguous problems into clear workstreams and move them forward.
Strong quantitative and analytical skills. You're highly proficient in Excel or Google Sheets, can build and validate models from scratch, and can translate analysis into clear recommendations and action. Experience with Structured Query Language (SQL) or equivalent data-querying tools is preferred, not required.
Systems thinking and experience using Salesforce for pipeline and renewals reporting. You understand how changes in one part of the go-to-market motion affect others, including how CRM, subscription or entitlement records, quoting, and billing relate to one another, and you design solutions accordingly.
Sound commercial judgment and an understanding of renewal complexity, including co-terming, amendments, expansions, downgrades, price changes, multiyear agreements, auto-renewals, procurement requirements, and approval policies.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills. You build trust with stakeholders at all levels, including field teams and senior leadership, and influence without direct authority.
Curiosity, sound judgment, and a bias toward action. You learn new domains and tools quickly, move from insight to implementation, and follow through until improvements are adopted and sustained.
 About The Team
 You'll work within CX Operations, partnering closely with Renewals and Customer Success leadership, Sales, Finance, Revenue Technology, and Revenue Analytics. These partnerships connect renewal execution with the processes, systems, and data that support it. In GitLab's all-remote, values-driven environment, documentation, iteration, and cross-functional partnership are core to how you'll work.

description:

 Location: Amsterdam
 Description
 As a Sales Enablement Manager , you will strengthen our go-to-market execution by creating high-impact sales enablement across our multi-product SaaS portfolio (20+ solutions), turning solution expertise into field-ready messaging, assets, and e-learnings that increase win rates - and you will build an AI-first enablement engine that scales certification without adding manual review overhead.
You will work closely with Solution Engineers, subject matter experts, and designers to ensure our enablement content is consistent, compelling, and used in real customer interactions. In addition, you will establish a pragmatic win/loss feedback loop - translating deal learnings into continuous improvements to enablement and internal certifications.
 What You’ll Own
 Build an AI-first enablement & certification model: use AI to enable, assess, and certify Account Executives and Business Development reps at scale, reducing the need for manual certification review by Presales/SEs.
 Design and manage internal certifications (levels, assessments, recertification cadence) to improve Account Executives execution - especially in deals without Solution Engineers’ involvement.

 Run a win/loss insights loop and convert learnings into updates for our messaging, enablement, and certifications.
 Build scalable Sales Enablement content (onboarding + continuous learning) that is practical, adopted, and measurable.
 Continuously innovate: keep evolving our enablement and certification processes with new formats and tools, and design them to be genuinely engaging - driving high voluntary participation from Sales.

 Proven experience in Sales/Revenue Enablement in a B2B environment (ideally multi-product SaaS).

 AI-first mindset: experience using AI tools to scale enablement and certification (e.g., AI-supported assessments, content generation, coaching), reducing reliance on manual review.

Curious and innovative mindset, always looking to modernize and improve enablement and certification processes.

 Strong facilitation and collaboration skills with Presales/SMEs; ability to simplify complex topics into buyer-relevant narratives.

title: RevOps / GTM Engineer
description:
Job description
 🌊 Who are we? 
We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging.
Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive.
As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in.
Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow.
About the role
Aquablu's revenue engine needs one owner.
That's you. As our AI-native RevOps Manager and GTM Engineer, you own our Revenue Architecture end to end. The Bowtie is how we operate from Lead to Expansion, and you run it. You set the canonical definitions and the KPI tree the whole commercial team works from. You build the forecast engines across Direct, Indirect, and Enterprise, and you run commission and compensation operations. Then you build the AI operating layer on top, so the commercial org's routine work runs without anyone chasing it.
You're a mid-level individual contributor reporting to the VP GTM.
 What you'll do 
Own the Bowtie as operating model, the canonical definitions in one auditable home, the KPI tree, unit economics and CAC per motion; translate the plan into targets and systems and close the impact loop with prospect and customer evidence
Own the forecast engines across Direct, Indirect and Enterprise; run centralised, signal-led prospecting so sellers sell; run the reporting rhythm and pipeline attribution with defined metric owners
Co-deliver the deal-to-cash overhaul from contract to ledger, exceptions visible and owned
Make demand generation proactive: own signal-based flows that detect buying triggers (intent, hiring, office moves, visitor identification, telemetry), route them into BDR feeds, campaigns and ABM clusters in HubSpot and Lemlist, and prove per source which signals produce SQLs and drive conversion
Own the AE ARR plan, BDR point scheme and Channel Manager plan end-to-end — documentation, per-seller calculators, HubSpot sync, payout workbook; run the quarterly payout with Finance reconciled to HubSpot; model and cost plan changes before they are announced
Own the GTM skill library and Claude-powered HubSpot automations as monitored scheduled routines; build where a repeated question exists, retire what nobody uses; operationalise playbooks in HubSpot and Notion and own the technical certification gate in commercial onboarding
About you
 Three to seven years in RevOps, GTM Engineering, or Sales Operations at a recurring-revenue business. SaaS, hardware-enabled SaaS, or usage-based, you know how the money moves.
 You've owned a CRM as the system of record. In HubSpot, that means custom objects, lifecycle and pipeline design, property and segmentation architecture, and every system connected to it.
 You think in revenue architecture, not funnels. The Bowtie data model is how you see the business and conversion rates are how you read it. When a number misses, you trace it back to the one step that broke.
 You build with AI. A GTM tool or automation goes from idea to working prototype in hours. You've got the technical depth (APIs, scripting, low-code through to code) to take it all the way to implementation.
 You speak model and money. KPI trees, unit economics, forecast cadence, and commission cycles are shared language between you and Finance.
 You start with definitions and write everything down. When the number's bad, you publish it anyway. The fix ships the same day.
You are fluent in English and based in or close to Amsterdam.
Nice to have
None of these are required. Each one gives you a head start.
 Winning by Design Revenue Architecture , whether you hold the certification or just work fluently in the framework.
 You've run commission operations end to end. That covers the calculators, the payout reconciliation, and the plan changes mid-year.
 You've implemented deal-to-cash or subscription billing , so you know what happens to a deal after it closes.
 You've built scheduled AI agents or LLM-based automations on top of a CRM that run on their own and keep running.
 You speak German or another European language alongside English.
Why Aquablu?
You will be part of a young, fun and ambitious team which aims to change the way people consume water!
💰 A yearly salary between €53k – €80k base salary (incl. 8% holiday allowance)
🌴 26 paid holiday days
📈 Equity through our Aquablu for All plan — everyone shares in what we’re building
🌱 Healthy (heavily discounted) lunches
💪 Urban Sports Club membership
🚀 Access to the Corporate Benefits platform for endless savings
🚆 Travel compensation >10km
👴 A pension plan by Zwitserleven.
💧 Endless amount of our very own flavoured water !
💙Check out out our Youtube to get a feeling for the culture at Aquablu!
hard_gaps: 3-7 years in dedicated RevOps, GTM Engineering or Sales Ops
Owned production HubSpot CRM as system of record

Stated band includes 8% holiday allowance; base top is about EUR 74k, so only the top end clears the HSM floor.

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description:
Description
For many of us there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.
Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.
 About the Customer Success Team 
Our Customer Success team is dedicated to helping our customers maximize the value of our platform. We build strong relationships, provide strategic guidance, and ensure a seamless experience from onboarding to renewal. Acting as trusted advisors, we proactively address challenges, drive adoption, and identify opportunities for growth. If you're passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences and thrive in a dynamic, relationship-focused role, this is the team for you.

 Location: This role is open to candidates based in Toronto or the Greater Toronto Area (GTA) . The role will require one office day every month at our Downtown Toronto office.
Requirements
 What you bring to the table: 
At least 5+ years of experience in customer success in a SaaS environment managing enterprise logos.
Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment
Occasional client visits
Passion to apply your tech-savviness to learn Riverside’s product functionality
An ability to excel in achieving KPIs and targets
Strong verbal and written communication skills in English
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to prioritize, organize, and execute multiple tasks with deadlines
 Bottom line? If you want to take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place.  Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to make an impact at an extraordinary scale.

title: Sales Operations Manager
description:
Job DescriptionJob Description
Who We’re Looking For
At ScalePad, we hire thoughtful builders who want their work to matter. Our roles are designed for people who thrive on driving impact, see ambiguity as an opportunity, and believe that raising the bar is a team sport.
We don’t bring people in to run playbooks. We hire people who want to rewrite them . And in this role, you’ll get to do that, while shaping the future of managed services for our global partners. (That’s what we call our customers.)
What is ScalePad
At ScalePad, we’re building more than software; we’re building confidence and clarity for the people who manage the technology businesses rely on every day.
Our mission: help MSPs evolve into MVPs (their clients’ most valuable partner). Our tools turn them from reactive service providers into strategic advisors through a consistent, scalable Customer Success motion.
Our product suite unifies risk insights, client planning, and service delivery so MSPs can have smarter conversations, show clients their value, and grow their revenue. 
But our purpose goes beyond our software. We’re creating a workplace where curious, growth-minded people can do their best work, where ideas are valued, progress is shared, and everyone belongs. Together, we’re creating a future where MSPs don’t just keep businesses running, they help them thrive. We believe that when our partners succeed, we all do.
With offices in Vancouver, Toronto, Montreal, and Phoenix and a global-first mindset. ScalePad has grown into a category leader trusted by 12,000+ partners across 60+ countries. We’ve been recognized for our products and corporate culture by MSP Today, G2, and Great Place to Work™, to name a few. 
About The Role 
The Sales Operations Manager is a critical hire within the Revenue Operations org, sitting at the intersection of sales strategy and operational execution. This is a strategic role that requires an operator's mindset — someone who can hold a long-term view while executing in the short term, navigate ambiguity without losing momentum, and adapt quickly as the business evolves. You will partner directly with Sales leadership and the broader RevOps team to drive measurable revenue outcomes, not just operational efficiency.
What You’ll Own
Get ready to go beyond order-taking. Your strategic responsibilities include:
Sales Technology & AI
Own the full sales tech stack end-to-end — administration, adoption, and roadmap.
Define utilization and impact metrics for every tool; make rationalization calls and lead implementations in partnership with Revenue Systems.
Drive adoption across the sales team through enablement and change reinforcement; adoption is an outcome, not an assumption.
Identify and deploy AI-powered workflows that improve rep productivity, pipeline quality, and sales cycle efficiency — covering conversation intelligence, predictive scoring, CRM enrichment, and automated outreach.
Build ROI expectations before deploying AI tools and measure impact after; AI is a means to a revenue outcome, not a checkbox.
Directly manage the HubSpot Admin, setting priorities, ensuring platform governance, and driving the right protocols and processes across the sales tech stack
Maintain data integrity across platforms with HubSpot as the commercial system of record.
Sales Strategy & Revenue Influence
Partner with Sales leadership to translate strategy into operational plans — territory design, quota setting, capacity modeling, and coverage analysis.
Build and maintain reporting and dashboards that leadership actually relies on, with clear visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and rep performance.
Surface leading indicators of revenue performance and flag risks or opportunities before they show up in the numbers.
Bring a point of view into strategic conversations — not just analysis.
Partner with CS Ops on expansion motion visibility so the Grow pipeline is as well-supported as new logo.
Contribute to pricing, packaging, and segmentation decisions with operational data and field feedback.
Own the operating cadences that keep pipeline healthy and forecasts honest
Change Management & Execution
Lead the operational response when processes, tools, or motions change — rollout plans, stakeholder alignment, field enablement.
Anticipate resistance and build buy-in proactively; partner with Sales leadership to land changes with the field.
Document processes and maintain a living knowledge base so changes stick and institutional knowledge doesn't walk out the door.
Coordinate cross-functionally with CS Ops, Marketing Ops, and RevOps leadership to ensure changes are sequenced and aligned.
Manage day-to-day sales ops requests with clear prioritization and SLA discipline.
Operate effectively in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift and the ability to adapt quickly is as important as functional expertise.
What we’re looking for
We care about what you can do more than where you’ve done it. However, experience in the following areas will help you hit the ground running in this role:
4–6 years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or a closely related function at a SaaS company.
Deep HubSpot & Gong expertise; familiarity with adjacent tools (Sales Nav, ZoomInfo, Clay, or similar) a strong plus.
Hands-on experience evaluating or deploying AI tools in a sales context — you know the difference between a demo and a deployed workflow.
Strong analytical skills — comfortable building models, telling a story with data, and connecting operational metrics to revenue outcomes.
Experience owning a tech stack, not just administering tickets within one.
Proven ability to influence Sales leaders without relying on authority.
A track record of driving adoption and landing change with field teams.
Clear, direct communicator who can move between tactical execution and executive conversation without losing altitude.
Perks
ScalePad offers our employees a blend of purpose, growth, and genuinely great perks.
Everyone’s an owner. Share in our success through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) and RRSP matching.
Support for growing families. Parental leave programs are in place to support you and your family when it matters most.
Structured mentorship with builders. Join opt-in mentorship programs and learn directly from founders and senior leaders who’ve scaled multiple SaaS ventures and spent decades in the MSP industry.
Invest in your growth every year. Access an annual professional development budget to level up your skills, your career, and your impact.
Set yourself up with great tools. Work with brand new, top-of-the-line hardware and equipment so you can do your best work, whether you’re at home or in one of our hubs.
Modern ways of working. Roles at ScalePad are structured as remote or hybrid, with hub locations in Vancouver, Toronto, Montreal, and Phoenix. Specific work models are outlined in each posting.
Support for hybrid life. Receive a monthly stipend to help you create an effective hybrid or remote work environment.
Well-being and time to recharge. Take care of yourself with 100% employer-paid benefits.
Before You Apply
This is a full-time role for those who are eligible to work in Canada or the United States. We thank all applicants for taking the time to apply, but only candidates who make it to the next stage will be contacted.
Note on AI Use: ScalePad uses AI technology to support certain administrative aspects of our hiring process, such as transcription, note-taking, and interview documentation. These tools are strictly used to assist our team and have no influence on candidate evaluation or hiring decisions.
 No recruiters, please.

title: Global GTM Enablement Lead
description:
At ITRS, we make society's critical technology work. Our mission is to deliver automated and holistic IT observability solutions that safeguard critical applications and enable innovation. We are the only monitoring and observability platform designed for the most demanding and regulated industries — trusted by 90% of Tier 1 capital markets firms.
We believe when our team thrives, so do our customers. With us, you'll find:
 A culture that backs you - We're proud to be a Great Place to Work for multiple years in a row due to our inclusive, supportive environment.
 Work that matters - Make a real difference with 1,000s of global customers in industries that keep the world running, including 9 out of 10 top investment banks.
 Room to grow - Whether you're starting your career or bringing years of experience, we're committed to your development. Just ask our team members who've been excelling here for 10+ years.
With headquarters in London and teams across the US, Europe, and Asia, ITRS combines the agility of a high-impact tech business with the stability of a private equity-backed global partner.
Join our rapidly growing team as a Global GTM Enablement Lead, reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO). In this dynamic role, you will develop and implement strategies to enhance our GTM team's effectiveness and efficiency. 
You will be the connective tissue across our go-to-market organization, bringing BDR, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success together to execute growth campaigns and product launches as one coordinated unit. You will also create and manage GTM enablement programs, tools and content to support our GTM processes, driving revenue growth and improving win rates. You will partner with and enable our global Sales, Customer Success, BDR, Presales, renewals, HR and L&D teams.
As a Global GTM Enablement Lead, you will:
Develop and implement a metrics-driven comprehensive GTM enablement strategy aligned with our global business objectives and GTM goals.
Better synchronize all GTM functions on growth campaigns and product launches: own coordinated execution and rally BDRs, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success to deliver as one unit.
Establish and run a regular enablement cadence, including fortnightly enablement calls, so every GTM team has a consistent, predictable rhythm of updates and training.
Bridge Product and the field, ensuring every new technology release is translated into clear, field-ready messaging, talk tracks and training in time for launch.
Present with authority at the monthly go-to-market meeting, to field teams and to leadership, shaping how the GTM organisation executes.
Create and maintain GTM enablement content Own GTM training and content programs, including playbooks, content repositories, product training, campaign and launch materials, and onboarding materials, with subject matter experts from Product, Product Marketing and Solutions contributing their expertise into them.
Design and deliver effective GTM training programmes to enhance product knowledge, GTM skills, and performance across the GTM organisation.
Collaborate with Product Management, Marketing, work hand in hand with Product Marketing and collaborate closely with Product Management, GTM (including Presales), and Customer Success teams to ensure consistent messaging and positioning of our software solutions.
Implement and manage GTM enablement tools and technologies to streamline processes and improve GTM productivity.
Analyse GTM performance and market trends to identify areas for improvement and develop targeted enablement initiatives.
Design and implement career progression plans for all the key roles within the GTM team to promote growth and development internally
Partner with global GTM leadership to define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for measuring the impact of GTM enablement efforts on pipeline, win rates and campaign performance, not just activity or course completion.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and best practices in GTM enablement to continuously refine our approach.
 Requirements
7+ years of experience in GTM enablement, GTM operations, or a related function in B2B software or technology. A degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
A track record of orchestrating cross-functional campaigns or product launches across BDR, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success teams.

title: Senior Manager - Revenue Operations
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Manager to build out and own the business layer of a next generation RevOps that the entire DataSnipper GTM organisation runs on. In this critical role, you'll be the single accountable owner of what our numbers mean (ICP, rules of engagement, what counts as a qualified opportunity), how territory and quota get assigned, and how Marketing, Sales, CS and BD all read from one shared forecast - you will be the mirror to the organisation's truth.
This is a builder's seat at the centre of DataSnipper's GTM teams and motion. You'll lead an embedded team of RevOps Specialists working daily alongside Sales, CS and Marketing, and set the definitions that GTM Engineering builds and automates against. The sharper and more strategic your thinking, the faster the whole GTM engine scales.
ABOUT DATASNIPPER 🚀
Audit and finance are still massively manual and we are changing that. DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms.
Now, we are taking things further with our Excel Agent, bringing AI directly into where the work actually happens. Unlike generic AI tools, we do not sit on the sidelines. Our AI operates inside Excel, with access to real documents and audit evidence, meaning it does not just generate answers, it does the work, with full traceability.
We are not just applying AI, we are redefining how audit gets done. If you want to build something category-defining at scale, this is the place.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Own the business definitions
 - Define and own the ICP, lead routing policy, handoff criteria, and what counts as a qualified opportunity - the rules GTM Engineering implements in the CRM.
 - Be the final word when Marketing, Sales, CS, or BD read the funnel differently.
Own territories & quota
 - Own territory and account ownership assignment.
 - Run bottom-up quota setting and capacity planning, translating Finance's top-down targets into rep-level coverage.
Run analytics, reporting & forecasting
 - Own all GTM reporting and analytics in HubSpot - the single source of truth for pipeline, forecasting, attribution, and KPIs (ARR, NRR, CAC, LTV) - and push it toward AI-assisted, increasingly self-serve dashboards.
 - Run new business, expansion, and renewal forecasting, including deal-weighting and roll-up methodology, using AI-driven forecasting models where they sharpen accuracy.
 - Run the RBR (Revenue Business Review) and weekly GTM reporting rhythm.
Lead the RevOps team
 - Manage a team of RevOps Specialists who work alongside Sales, CS, and Marketing.
 - Own QBRs, weekly packs, planning inputs, and process documentation delivered through the team.
Partner across the business
 - Translate business rules and field needs into precise briefs for GTM Engineering through a request → brief → build → feedback model, shaping how AI agents and automation get deployed across the funnel.
 - Partner with Finance on annual planning, revenue recognition, and commissions.
WHAT YOU BRING
 - 7+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a similar role in a B2B SaaS environment, including experience managing or mentoring a team.
 - An ownership instinct. When a metric means two different things to two different teams, you're the one who resolves it - and makes sure it stays resolved.
 - Forecasting rigor. You can build and own a forecasting methodology end to end, and defend it confidently in front of leadership.
 - People leadership. You've managed a small, cross-functionally embedded team and held it to a consistent operating rhythm.
 - Cross-functional fluency. You move comfortably between Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance, and a technical build function like GTM Engineering.
 - AI-forward. You use AI tools to speed up reporting, forecasting, and QBR prep, and you're always looking for the next manual step to automate.
 - Technical comfort. You're proficient administering and reporting in HubSpot or an equivalent CRM.
What you'll work with:
 - CRM and prospecting: HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Dealhub
 - Contracts and commissions: Juro, DocuSign, Qobra
 - Data and AI: Snowflake, Claude
Nice to have:
HubSpot Admin certification, experience scaling an embedded ops team from a handful of people into a full function, or experience building AI-assisted RevOps workflows.
WHAT WE OFFER
 - Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact.
 - Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth.
 - Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary.
 - 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance.
 - Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office.
 - Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energised.
 - NS business card for easy commuting to the office.
 - A structured onboarding programme designed to set you up for success, including dedicated time to learn our product and customers before you hit the ground running.
 - Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills.
 - Engage with a vibrant international team spread across seven global offices.
 - Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together.
 - Access to OpenUp, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing.
RECRUITMENT PROCESS
 1. Recruiter Screen (30 minutes, online)
 2. Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online)
 3. Assessment Interview (1 hour, on-site)
 4. Final Interview (30 minutes, online)
At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience.
Our hiring decisions are merit based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role.
We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.
What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper.

title: Nonprofit GTM Strategy Manager
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
 The Opportunity 
Okta is looking for an entrepreneurial, data-driven Nonprofit GTM Strategy Manager to join our team. At Okta, we are building a world where anyone can safely use any technology. Mission-driven organizations, from global NGOs to local community services, are among the most targeted sectors for cyberattacks today, yet they often operate with severe resource constraints.
In this cross-functional role, you will be both a strategist and executor for our global nonprofit segment. You will drive revenue, impact, and customer growth targets for the segment and share responsibility for its performance and long-term health. You will analyze segment metrics to diagnose what's working, partner with customers to pressure-test our go-to-market (GTM) positioning, and lead the work to fix what isn't. Your analytical skills and proven wins with nonprofit customers will shape how we grow.
You will enable GTM leadership and maintain ongoing feedback loops with field sales teams. You will align and mobilize senior stakeholders, both internal and customer-facing, around shared business objectives. By connecting historical success data with active market opportunities, you will make sure our field resources are used well and that Okta's nonprofit initiatives translate into scalable market expansion. Your work will grow Okta's addressable market while helping secure the organizations that provide critical services around the world.
In this role, you'll get to:
 Accelerate Nonprofit Segment Growth: Grow Okta's existing nonprofit go-to-market (GTM) motion. Design, launch, and manage targeted sales plays, specialized programs, field events, and market initiatives that turn our overall strategy into active market expansion.
 Drive Segment Performance and Long-Term Health: Drive the performance of the global nonprofit segment across the full lifecycle, including pipeline creation, deal velocity, customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Work across the GTM organization to diagnose trends, remove friction, and rally stakeholders around growth initiatives.
 Embed with GTM Leadership: Work closely with GTM teams to make the nonprofit business a core part of the planning, cadence, and execution of the broader GTM organization. Use segment performance data and peer benchmarks to continuously improve and champion Okta's nonprofit vertical strategy.
 Support Field Enablement: Build consistent feedback loops with Field and Sales Enablement teams to remove obstacles, refine messaging, and help them win and grow nonprofit deals. Work directly with Account Executives (AEs) and sales development representatives (xDRs) to capture insights from the field and turn winning approaches into scalable GTM motions and playbooks.
 Sharpen Market Focus and Positioning: Analyze historical wins and market dynamics to find where Okta competes most effectively. Identify high-growth nonprofit sub-segments, map the buying journeys, purchase triggers, and compliance requirements of target verticals, and direct GTM investment toward the opportunities where we are best positioned to win.
 Measure Social Impact Alongside Growth: Keep Okta's social impact commitment measurable, not just stated. Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to track the impact and value of donated and discounted licenses alongside revenue and pipeline. Use these results to make pragmatic decisions about where donated licenses create the most impact.
What you’ll bring to the role:
8+ years of experience in B2B SaaS GTM strategy, sales enablement, growth operations, customer success, or a vertical-specific sales overlay role, preferably within identity, cybersecurity, or cloud.
A proven track record of program ownership. You build a program strategy, gather feedback, refine the approach, and execute with minimal oversight.
Advanced problem-solving skills. You apply deep professional knowledge and company objectives to design and resolve complex operational models.
Exceptional persuasion and communication skills. You align and mobilize senior cross-functional and external stakeholders around shared business targets.
Strong data and analytical skills. You have hands-on experience tracking pipeline health, sales velocity, and conversion metrics in Salesforce or Tableau.
Resource and project management experience. You are comfortable defining program requirements, managing budgets, and directing external partners.
Proven wins with nonprofit customers. Experience in the nonprofit tech ecosystem, cybersecurity, or SLED/Public Sector GTM is a strong plus.

 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
 Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

 For everyone, everywhere.
 Job Description
 More about our mission and what we offer .
 THE ROLE
 We’re looking for a Manager to lead the Growth Pillar within our Business Operations team. This is a critical strategic role dedicated to Wise Business, our international account that helps small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) scale without borders.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
About GitHub 
GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.
 Locations 
In this role you can work from Remote, United States
 Overview 
 GitHub is seeking a Senior Customer Success Manager to drive business value and long-term success with GitHub’s largest enterprise customers within the Digital Natives portfolio (Tech, Media, Telecom, etc.). You’ll build a deep understanding of customer priorities and transformation goals, and use customer insights and adoption data to shape success plans, guide change, track progress, and help customers realize value from the GitHub platform. 
 As a trusted advisor to senior business and technical decision-makers, you’ll work closely with account teams, product and engineering partners, and Microsoft partners to advance customer outcomes and resolve adoption barriers. You’ll monitor customer health and engagement, advocate for customer needs, and share insights and successful practices across internal and external communities. The ideal candidate will also play a role in evolving GitHub’s customer success practices, mentoring your peers, and using AI-assisted tooling for analysis and scale. 
 Responsibilities 
 Understanding the Customer 
 Proactively align with internal teams on customers’ business priorities. 
 Develop a deep understanding of customer business processes, outcomes, competition, key personas, and industry trends. 
 Engage customer stakeholders to map and maintain key business and technical relationships. 
 Ensure customer insights, needs, and risks are captured and communicated across the relevant account teams, Product, Engineering, etc. 
 Driving Business Value Realization 
 Establish shared success measures with customers and use adoption data to assess progress against agreed business outcomes and customer expectations. 
 Develop and execute customer success plans that align with customers’ business priorities and transformation objectives. 
 Collaborate with Sales, EPD, Partners, and our Customer Success Architects to build customer-specific presentations and roadmaps that advance business outcomes. 
 Driving Change Management 
 Guide customers through organizational change helping leaders implement, scale, and sustain new ways of working. 
 Help customers align their culture, stakeholders, and transformation goals to support adoption and consumption. 
 Take accountability for resolving adoption and consumption blockers by coordinating people, resources, and solutions. 
 Guiding Customer Success Strategy 
 Engage executives by providing insights and feedback that shape their digital and business transformation strategy. 
 Leverage GitHub’s success frameworks to create customer journeys and dynamic success plans. 
 Provide actionable feedback to GitHub on customer needs to influence product and program roadmaps. 
 Partner and Cross-Team Collaboration 
 Lead cross-functional engagement to align account strategy, develop business outcomes, and enable execution. 
 Integrate stakeholders across solution areas to increase relevance and impact. 
 Build relationships with key partners (including Microsoft) to develop joint success plans that support customer outcomes. 
 Operational & Execution Excellence 
 Manage customer health, engagements, and blockers using Gainsight 
 Lead solution-specific rhythms of business (ROB), governance processes, and reporting across your portfolio. 
 Provide regular updates on customer transformation progress to account and regional stakeholders. 
 Use AI-enabled tools and agents to analyze customer data and drive operational consistency across your portfolio. 
 Customer Trust & Advocacy 
 Act as the voice of the customer by surfacing feedback, blockers, and escalations across GitHub. 
 Build customer advocates and capture success stories to inspire adoption across the community. 
 Establish trusted advisor status and secure executive sponsorship to sustain long-term success. 
 Team Growth, Scale & Community 
 Strengthen the Customer Success team by sharing customer insights, proven practices, and lessons learned across internal and external communities. 
 Identify recurring customer needs and opportunities to scale the team’s impact through reusable programs, playbooks, and engagement practices. 
 Mentor peers and support onboarding, helping teammates build the skills and confidence to deliver consistent, high-quality customer outcomes. 
 Technical and Strategic Expertise 
 Maintain the competitive, industry, and GitHub product knowledge needed to advise customers and recognize strategic opportunities. 
 Partner with Customer Success Architects, Engineering, and other technical teams to deepen expertise and bring the right technical guidance to customer engagements. 
 Apply technical and strategic expertise to customer planning, adoption, and business-value conversations. 
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications: 
 7+ years experience in enterprise customer success management, software adoption management, account management, professional services consulting, customer-facing program management, including executive stakeholder management 
 OR Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering, Technology, or related field AND 5+ years experience 
 OR Master’s Degree in Business, Engineering, Technology, or related field AND 4+ years experience 
 OR equivalent experience 
 Experience managing high-value-high-visibility ($1M-$10M+, Fortune 100), enterprise customers in the Digital Natives space (Tech, Media, Telecom, etc.) 
 Experience using AI-native productivity , analysis, or workflow tools and applying them appropriately in customer-facing work. 
 Ability to travel up to 25% 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 7+ years experience in enterprise SaaS, DevOps/DevSecOps, Developer AI, Forward Deployed Engineering, or SDLC domains 
 Experience with GitHub or related developer tooling/experiences 
 Experience with supporting consumption-driven products and a strong understanding of adoption methods 
 Track record of mentoring peers and shaping customer success best practices 
 Compensation Range 
The base salary range for this job is USD $86,560.00 - USD $229,600.00 /Yr.
In addition, this role also has the opportunity to earn sales incentives. On target earnings (OTE) is based on a 80/20 base salary/sales incentive.
These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.
This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Customer-obsessed
Ship to learn
Growth mindset
Own the outcome
Better together
Diverse and inclusive

Care

Deliver success
 Who We Are 
GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). 
At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager - North America
description:
Traild: Who are we?  
Traild is a high-growth SaaS company redefining how finance teams operate, combining AI, automation, and payments infrastructure to power the future of B2B finance. 
Every year, businesses lose billions to fraud, errors, and mistakes. Traild exists to solve this at scale, helping finance teams move faster, stay in control, and operate with confidence. 
With rapid customer growth, global expansion across APAC, North America and EMEA, and continued investment in product innovation, we are at a defining stage of our journey. 
This is an opportunity to help shape the next category leader in finance automation, control and security, building technology that transforms how businesses manage, move, and protect money. At the core of this is a powerful AI-driven platform, enabling finance teams to deploy intelligent agents that do the work, surface risk in real time, and continuously improve how financial operations run. 
Traild is building the infrastructure behind modern finance, protecting and powering meaningful volumes of the world’s B2B transactions. 
If you’re excited by high growth, real ownership, and building something that matters, Traild is the place to do the most impactful work of your career. 
Hear how Traild customers speak about us here. 
The Role
As Traild scales, our clients are getting bigger and more strategic. We already have an Enterprise Implementation role, and now we need an Enterprise Customer Success Manager to care for these accounts after go-live. This is the first role of its kind here, so you will help shape how it works as we learn what our largest customers need.
You will own a portfolio of high-value accounts, acting as trusted advisor and advocate for client leadership and day-to-day teams. You will build long-term success strategies, protect and grow revenue, and turn happy clients into public references. Expect ambiguity, change, and plenty of room to make your mark.
This is a full-time, remote and open to candidates across North America. Some early morning or evening calls will be needed to work with our development teams in APAC and EMEA.
Key Responsibilities
Manage a portfolio of strategic and enterprise-level accounts as their primary point of contact and advocate.
Develop long-term success strategies with each customer, aligned to their goals and desired outcomes.
Drive revenue retention and expansion, partnering with Sales on upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
Manage churn - Spot at-risk accounts early using health, usage, and sentiment signals. Lead save plans with cross-functional support, and track churn reasons to feed back to Product, Support, and Sales.
Plan and deliver Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), building the value narrative for client leadership.
Manage escalations end to end: pull in Engineering and Product, turn client concerns into action, and keep stakeholders updated.
Follow up on roadmap commitments and interim fixes with Product and Engineering.
Monitor usage, health, and support activity daily to spot early escalation risks.
Spot trends across the customer base and share them with Product, Support, and Sales.
Turn successful clients into references
Contribute to documentation and mentor junior team members
Who You Are
You are a proactive and customer-obsessed professional who thrives on building relationships, solving problems, and driving customer value. You understand the customer journey end-to-end and excel at helping clients succeed post-onboarding. You are confident engaging with stakeholders at all levels and enjoy working in a fast-moving, scaling environment. You are at ease with executives, you think commercially, and you thrive in a start-up where the role is still taking shape and the path is not always clear.
 Must have 
2+ years of experience in a start-up or scale-up, ideally in fintech or payments.
Experience managing high-value accounts ($100K+ ARR) in a customer success, account management, or similar client-facing role.
Strong relationship and stakeholder management skills, including executive presence and C-suite fluency.
Commercial acumen, with a track record of driving retention and expansion.
Data-driven storytelling: you can turn usage and health data into a clear value narrative for EBRs.
Project management and cross-functional orchestration across Support, Product, Engineering, and Sales.
Comfort working independently, managing your own time, and adapting as the role evolves.
The ability to de-escalate clients and own mistakes rather than assign blame.
Flexibility to take occasional early morning or evening calls with global teams.
 Nice to have 
Experience in the ERP, accounts payable, or payments space.
Familiarity with Zendesk, HubSpot, Jira, Slack, Confluence, Omni, and Claude.
We know great customer success people come from all sorts of backgrounds. If you have transferable skills from other project management, onboarding, consulting or delivery roles, we'd still like to hear from you, please apply and use the relevant/transferable skills question in the application to tell us how your experience maps to this role.
Salary Range
The base salary range for this position is:
U.S. Candidates: $100,000 - $140,000 USD per year
Canadian Candidates: $100,000 - $140,000 CAD per year
Compensation is determined based on experience, education, and geographic location. The final offer may vary within the stated range to reflect the candidate’s qualifications and market conditions in their area.
The Perks of Working at Traild   
Flexibility: we offer a range of remote, hybrid and flexible working options. 
Global team: we are growing across APAC, NA and EMEA and have team all across the world.  
We are growing at an exponential rate, this is an opportunity to get involved with a true rocketship with all the excitement and opportunities that comes with it  
Our team genuinely loves working at Traild: our eNPS score is 68, where anything above 50 is considered world-class. 
Please note that the final applicants for this job will be asked to consent in writing to a police check / criminal background check to the extent permitted by law in your jurisdiction of employment. Please note that Traild is an E-Verify employer. 
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Revenue Operations Manager - UK
description:
EMEA Revenue Operations Manager 
 London, UK 
Sigma is expanding its footprint across EMEA, and we need a Revenue Operations Manager to turn that plan into a working operation. You will sit at the centre of the expansion, working with sales leaders across the region to build the systems, cadences and plans that let new markets scale quickly.
This role is less ops coordinator and more trusted advisor, with a bias for action and a sharp analytical mind. You have done market expansion work before, you would rather design the system than run the report, and you get uncomfortable when you are the last to see a problem coming.
What you will own
The operational plan for our EMEA expansion: market entry sequencing, territory and coverage design, headcount and capacity planning, and the milestones that tell us whether each new market is on track.
The operating rhythm of a high-growth, multi-country sales organisation, including QBRs, planning cycles, leadership offsites and the cadences that keep teams in different markets and time zones aligned.
Annual and half-year planning for EMEA, built from the ground up with regional sales leadership. You will own the process, the timeline and the room.
The health of the whole GTM engine in EMEA, from lead to upsell: lead flow, pipeline generation and coverage, conversion, forecast accuracy, renewals and expansion.
Strategic diagnostics: the leading indicators, structural risks and pipeline dynamics that show where each market is headed before the quarter does.
Regional execution detail, including multi-currency forecasting and pricing, partner and cloud marketplace deal flow, and country-specific requirements for data, contracts and hiring, in step with Finance, Legal and People.
AI-native workflows that remove manual work and let sales leaders spend their time on decisions, not dashboards.
A direct line to senior leadership, with the credibility to challenge as well as advise. You will be expected to have a view, and to defend it.
What we are looking for
8 - 10 years of experience in Sales Strategy, Revenue Operations or a Chief of Staff function inside a high-growth B2B SaaS business.
Direct experience of launching or scaling a sales organisation in new international markets, ideally across several EMEA countries, and a clear view of what worked and what did not.
Deep knowledge of how a high-performance GTM engine runs end to end, from lead to upsell: lead flow and conversion, pipeline creation and hygiene, forecasting, territory management, coverage models, renewals and expansion, operating rhythms and annual planning.
Strong written and verbal communication. You can take a complex situation, translate it for the right audience and land a clear point of view in two minutes or two slides.
Comfort with ambiguity and speed, and the flexibility to handle shifting priorities across time zones and cultures.
Curiosity about AI and automation, and the ability to build them into our current systems to raise speed and efficiency while keeping operational rigour. We are rebuilding how this function works at scale, and this role will be a key part of that work.
Who you are
Present. You will work with experienced sales leaders and cross-functional partners who have seen every ops hire before. You build trust quickly and know how to earn a seat at the table.
Proactive. You look around corners, flag risks early and arrive with a point of view rather than waiting to be asked.
Precise. You give a sharp read and a recommended next step. No unnecessary slides and no endless dashboards.
A builder. You treat process as infrastructure and enjoy making things work better at scale.
Nice to have
Fluency in one or more European languages, and experience with partner or channel operations.
Why this role
This role sits where that growth needs sharper operational thinking. You will not maintain a legacy system. You will help build the operation that takes Sigma into new European markets, working with sales leaders who want a real partner and a VP of Ops who cares about how this function runs. If that sounds like the work you do best, we would like to hear from you.
 About us: 
Sigma is the AI Apps and agentic analytics platform built on the cloud data warehouse. Business and technical teams use Sigma to explore live data, build intelligent applications, and automate critical workflows all without moving data or breaking governance. Sigma supports a spreadsheet interface, SQL, Python, and native AI in a single governed workspace, giving every team the speed to act and IT the control to scale. Sigma is trusted by more than 2,000 customers, including AMD, Duolingo, Colgate-Palmolive, and JPMorgan Chase. 
Sigma announced its $80M in Series E financing in May 2026. The round was led by Princeville Capital, with new strategic investors Databricks Ventures, ServiceNow Ventures, and Workday Ventures participating alongside returning investors Altimeter Capital, Avenir Growth Capital, D1 Capital Partners, K5 Global, NewView Capital, Spark Capital, Sutter Hill Ventures, and XN. This milestone follows Sigma reaching $200M in annual recurring revenue in April 2026, with more than 100% year-over-year growth and 1.1 million new active users added in the latest fiscal year.
Come join us!

Equity

Commuter and FSA benefits

Dog friendly office

title: GTM Operations Lead
description:
Please note the internal job title is: Principal Payments GTM Operations and Strategy
 Want to build the go-to-market engine for a fast growing payments business? 
 Then Jobber might be the place for you! We’re looking for a Payments GTM Operations and Strategy Lead to be part of our Fintech department.
Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!
Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers.
 The team:
 We’re building the financial backbone for field service businesses. Our Fintech team is one of the most strategically important and fastest growing parts of Jobber. We help businesses get paid, access capital, understand their financial health, and ultimately stay in business longer.
The future of financial services is embedded, and we’re still early. Small businesses increasingly rely on vertical SaaS platforms like Jobber not just to run their operations, but to manage their money. Payments is the foundation of everything we do in Fintech, and how we go to market with our Get Paid products (invoicing, payments, instant payouts, etc) is the single biggest lever we have to grow the business.
This role will own how Jobber’s payments business grows. Think of this as running the commercial side of a payments business inside a SaaS company.
 The role: 
 Reporting into the VP & GM, Payments and Fintech you will establish Payments GTM Operations as a new function at Jobber. You will bring together every team that touches payments go-to-market (Marketing, Sales, Account Management, Customer Support, Risk, Operations, Analytics, Product Development) and build the programs, processes, and measurement that turn these teams into a coordinated growth engine.
The job has two objectives: help more customers discover and get value from Jobber’s payments products, and accelerate revenue growth for the business.
Day to day, the Payments GTM Operations and Strategy Lead will identify opportunities, design programs, and run experiments to drive adoption and usage of Jobber’s payments products. This will include:
Mapping and rebuilding the end-to-end customer journey for payments, from first touch through activation and ongoing usage, working closely with cross-functional partners. This includes identifying where customer-facing teams (sales, post-sales, support) can change their motions to drive better outcomes. 
Experimenting with a range of actions (e.g. incentives) to drive payments adoption and usage, rapidly iterating based on results. 
Defining the metrics that matter for payments GTM and holding yourself (and cross-functional partners) accountable to them. 
Building deep working relationships across GTM teams, Product, RevOps, Analytics, etc. You are the connective tissue between these teams on payments GTM. 
Using data and qualitative insights to find opportunities, size them, run experiments, and measure results. 
Staying close to what other vertical SaaS and embedded payments players are doing. Knowing where Jobber can differentiate. 
 To be successful, you should have:
Operating and strategy experience, ideally a mix of both:
Operating experience: you have experience identifying opportunities, mobilizing teams, and driving measurable results. Could be Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Strategy & Operations, Product Commercialization, or a GM/Founder role, ideally at a scaling SaaS or Fintech company. 
Strategy experience (valued): you have been a strategic partner to senior leaders, making data-driven recommendations. Examples could be Management Consulting, VC, or Strategy & Operations. 
Deep understanding of payments and financial services business models, metrics, and growth strategies is desirable, particularly financial services for small businesses. 
Strong data instincts. You use analytics to measure impact, make decisions, and optimize performance. You are not just comfortable with data, you reach for it first. 
Experience using languages such as SQL to manipulate large data sets is a plus, but not required. 
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across GTM teams, Product, Executive Leadership, etc. You translate data into stories and strategies into action plans. 
Demonstrated ability to design and implement scalable operational processes that enhance efficiency and ultimately drive growth. 
Passion for helping small businesses succeed through innovative financial solutions. 
A curious mind and a growth mindset. You are a scrappy learner who can quickly become an expert and build new capabilities. 
A proactive drive to solve problems. You are capable of bringing structure to ambiguous problems, corralling resources, and delivering results. 
A preference for working in an ambiguous and fast-paced environment. We’re growing fast and things are changing every day. 
 Location:
 We believe great collaboration is intentional, and that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect from time to time. This role is open to candidates anywhere in Canada. Employees who live in one of our hub cities - Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo will participate in their department's in-office schedule, while employees outside our hub cities will work remotely.
 Compensation: 
 At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $151,200 a midpoint of $177,900 and a maximum salary of $204,500 designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.
We design our compensation to reflect each new hire’s skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual’s current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.
Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You’ll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.
We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we’re happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!
 What you can expect from Jobber:
A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options. 
A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential. 
A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet. 
To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers. 
 We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.
 A bit more about us:
 Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

The role in one line
As our first EMEA Strategic Customer Success Manager, you’ll help define what strategic success looks like at incident.io , and become the trusted partner who makes us core to how the biggest enterprises run reliability.
What that looks like day to day
You’ll work with a small number of our largest, most complex and highest-value customers. These are established, often global and regulated enterprises, where buying decisions take time, many business units are involved, and incident management is part of a wider move away from legacy tools and processes. You’ll be their strategic partner across the full lifecycle, from early involvement in the deal with Sales through to adoption and expansion, and from the on-call engineer to the CIO and CTO.
You’ll help land strategic logos with focused first contracts, then build the business case and success plan that turns them into larger deals. From there you’ll expand across the enterprise, mapping the organisation, finding champions and repeating proven wins across business units and regions. You’ll run Executive Business Reviews and connect our leadership with theirs, tying what we do to what matters to their business: operational resilience, regulatory risk, the cost of downtime, tool consolidation, MTTR reduction and incident process maturity.
You’ll lead onboarding and migrations in organisations that move carefully, moving them off legacy tools and ITSM-led processes and making the change stick, including deeper adoption across Response, On-call, Status Pages and our AI capabilities. You’ll spot and reduce business, operational and reputational risk before it becomes visible, and bring Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing and Support together around shared goals for each account, including expansion and renewals.
You’ll also work directly with Product and Engineering on the roadmap and design partnerships. As the first EMEA Strategic CSM and third on the team overall, you’ll help define our strategic CS playbook, support high-stakes deals and help develop your peers as the segment grows.
Who you are
You have significant experience in Customer Success, Account Management or Technical Account Management, managing strategic or Fortune 500-scale accounts in enterprise SaaS. Traditional enterprises like financial services, insurance, pharma, retail or private equity are ideal. Developer tooling, observability or incident management is a plus.
You’ve driven adoption, retention and expansion in large, complex accounts with many stakeholders, and you have results you can point to.
You know how to land small and grow large, turning a pilot or single business unit into a multi-BU footprint over a long sales cycle.
Building a business case doesn’t faze you, nor does navigating procurement, security, legal and change management in slow-moving organisations.
You’re confident with senior technical executives, running EBRs and strategic planning sessions, and just as comfortable going deep with SREs and platform engineers.
You’re technically fluent in modern engineering organisations, on-call, incident response, SRE practices and the observability and DevOps ecosystem, and you can translate it for business stakeholders.
You have strong commercial judgement, partner well with Sales on renewals and expansion, and get ahead of customer challenges rather than reacting to them.
You’re autonomous and comfortable with ambiguity. You’re excited to define the role, not just step into it.
Supporting you
We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.
 Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.
 Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.
 First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.
 Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.
 Meaningful equity. We’re rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.
 Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We’re all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.
 Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we’re doing here, and we want you to be present for them.
 Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

title: Staff Renewals Operations Manager
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
