GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
 An Overview Of This Role
 As a Staff Renewals Operations Manager at GitLab, you'll help own the operational engine that makes renewals predictable, measurable, and efficient at scale. Reporting to the Director of CX Operations, you'll be the Renewals team's go-to business partner for processes, tooling, forecasting and insights, consumption and subscription data, and the steps required to quote and close a renewal. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll lead through ownership and influence, connecting teams and workflows, turning ambiguous problems into clear next steps, and driving improvements that others across the revenue organization depend on.
 What You'll Do
Own and continuously improve the end-to-end renewal operating model; from renewal identification, assignment through risk management, quoting, through to close and post-renewal data hygiene processes.
Develop and improve the operating cadences that guide the renewal business, with a focus on efficiency and process improvement.
Define, maintain, and evolve retention reporting with cross-functional partners, including gross and net retention, churn and downgrade analysis, and the drivers behind each.
Partner with Revenue Technology, Revenue Analytics, Finance, and other stakeholders to improve Salesforce and the systems and data flows supporting customer relationship management (CRM), subscription and entitlement records, quoting, orders, billing, and reporting. Translate business needs into requirements, validate solutions, and strengthen data quality and operational controls.
Simplify and scale the renewal motion through automation, standardized workflows, alerts, playbooks, and self-service insights that reduce manual effort and improve execution consistency.
Support renewals planning and capacity management, including segmentation implementation, coverage models, productivity assumptions, capacity modeling, supporting target setting, and scenario planning.
Own and mature the Renewal Operations case-management program, including intake, triage, routing, service-level visibility, resolution, and root-cause analysis. Requests may include user migrations, de-duplication, Renewal Manager ownership changes, compensation exceptions, and Salesforce or data issues.
Raise the operating standard in your domain by documenting processes, mentoring others on how the renewal motion works, and contributing to broader Revenue Operations initiatives that need the renewals perspective.
 What You'll Bring
Experience in Renewals Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, management consulting, strategy, or a similar analytical and problem-solving role, with ownership of operational improvements and cross-functional initiatives.
Hands-on experience with both consumption and subscription renewal motions, including renewal forecasting, retention reporting, and the contractual and process mechanics that govern how renewals close.
Strong critical thinking and structured problem-solving skills. You can break down ambiguous problems into clear workstreams and move them forward.
Strong quantitative and analytical skills. You're highly proficient in Excel or Google Sheets, can build and validate models from scratch, and can translate analysis into clear recommendations and action. Experience with Structured Query Language (SQL) or equivalent data-querying tools is preferred, not required.
Systems thinking and experience using Salesforce for pipeline and renewals reporting. You understand how changes in one part of the go-to-market motion affect others, including how CRM, subscription or entitlement records, quoting, and billing relate to one another, and you design solutions accordingly.
Sound commercial judgment and an understanding of renewal complexity, including co-terming, amendments, expansions, downgrades, price changes, multiyear agreements, auto-renewals, procurement requirements, and approval policies.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills. You build trust with stakeholders at all levels, including field teams and senior leadership, and influence without direct authority.
Curiosity, sound judgment, and a bias toward action. You learn new domains and tools quickly, move from insight to implementation, and follow through until improvements are adopted and sustained.
 About The Team
 You'll work within CX Operations, partnering closely with Renewals and Customer Success leadership, Sales, Finance, Revenue Technology, and Revenue Analytics. These partnerships connect renewal execution with the processes, systems, and data that support it. In GitLab's all-remote, values-driven environment, documentation, iteration, and cross-functional partnership are core to how you'll work.

title: Sales Operations Manager
description:
Job Description
 Pure Data Centres is seeking an experienced and highly organised Sales Operations Manager to support and optimise the effectiveness of our growing global sales function.
This is a pivotal role, responsible for developing and managing the systems, processes and reporting that underpin our commercial operations. Working closely with the senior sales leadership team and multiple departments across the business, the successful candidate will bring structure, visibility and consistency to our sales pipeline, account planning, stakeholder mapping and CRM management.
The role will take ownership of the CRM platform, including its implementation, ongoing development and adoption across the sales team, ensuring accurate, accessible and actionable commercial data. The Sales Operations Manager will also oversee the maintenance of the land book, support strategic account planning and provide high-quality presentations, reporting and financial analysis to support key business decisions.
This position requires an individual who is commercially astute, exceptionally organised and confident communicating with stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.
 Responsibilities
 Core Responsibilities:
CRM Management & Implementation: Take ownership of the CRM platform, overseeing its implementation, configuration, ongoing management and continuous improvement to ensure it supports the business's commercial objectives and sales processes.
Pipeline Management: Develop and maintain robust pipeline management processes, ensuring accurate forecasting, visibility of opportunities, tracking of sales activity and clear reporting on commercial progress.
Account Plan Management: Own and coordinate strategic account planning, ensuring key customer relationships, commercial opportunities, growth strategies and engagement plans are documented, regularly reviewed and aligned with business objectives.
Stakeholder Mapping: Take ownership of key business stakeholder mapping, maintaining a clear overview of customer organisations, decision makers, influencers and relationship networks to support strategic engagement and business development.
Land Book Management: Maintain and regularly update the company's land book, ensuring accurate and up-to-date information on land opportunities, site status, commercial progress and associated business development activity.
Sales Reporting & Presentations: Produce high-quality management reports, presentations and commercial documentation, with excellent PowerPoint and PDF capabilities, to support senior leadership meetings, client presentations and strategic decision-making.
Financial Analysis: Support the sales function with financial reporting, commercial analysis, pipeline valuation and forecasting, ensuring that sales opportunities are assessed with a strong understanding of their financial implications.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with teams across the business, including Investment, Land, Development, Finance, Legal and Marketing, to ensure alignment of commercial priorities, accurate information sharing and effective coordination.
Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve sales operations, reporting structures, CRM utilisation and internal processes, driving greater efficiency, consistency and accountability across the commercial function.
Data Integrity & Governance: Establish and maintain consistent standards for CRM data, reporting and documentation, ensuring information is accurate, structured and readily accessible to relevant stakeholders.
Business Coordination: Support the sales leadership team with the organisation and coordination of key commercial activities, ensuring priorities, actions, meetings and deliverables are effectively managed and followed through.
 Qualifications
 Knowledge and Skills:
Proven experience in a Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Sales Enablement or similar role, ideally within data centres, technology, real estate, infrastructure or another complex B2B environment.
Strong experience in CRM implementation, management and optimisation, with the ability to develop systems and processes that support a growing sales organisation.
Demonstrable experience in pipeline management, sales forecasting, account planning and commercial reporting.
Advanced Microsoft PowerPoint skills, with the ability to produce high-quality, professional presentations and PDF documentation for senior leadership and external stakeholders.
Strong financial acumen, with the ability to understand commercial models, analyse pipeline performance and interpret financial information.
Experience in stakeholder mapping and managing complex customer account structures.
Excellent organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage and collaborate across multiple departments and seniority levels.
Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to translate complex information into clear, actionable insights.
Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and reporting tools.
 Personal Attributes
Highly Organised: Exceptional planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, maintain accurate information and ensure deadlines are consistently achieved.
Commercially Minded: A strong understanding of commercial operations, financial performance and the importance of supporting revenue generation and strategic growth.
Proactive & Solutions Focused: An individual who takes ownership, anticipates business requirements and actively looks for ways to improve processes and performance.
Excellent Communicator: Confident and articulate, with the ability to build relationships, influence stakeholders and communicate effectively across multiple functions.
Analytical & Detail Oriented: Able to interpret data, identify trends and provide meaningful insights to support commercial decision-making.
Collaborative: A natural team player who can work effectively across departments, building strong relationships and encouraging consistency in how the business operates.
Adaptable: Comfortable working in a fast-growing, evolving international business where priorities can change and new processes and systems are continually developed.
 The Opportunity
This is an opportunity to play a central role in the continued growth of Pure Data Centres, helping to shape and develop the operational framework behind our global sales function.
The Sales Operations Manager will have significant exposure to senior leadership and cross-functional teams, with the opportunity to influence how Pure manages its commercial pipeline, customer relationships, sales intelligence and strategic growth opportunities.

title: Sales Enablement Manager
description:
WHAT IS BOX?
 Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.
By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.
 WHY BOX NEEDS YOU 
 As part of the broader Go To Market (GTM) Enablement organisation, the EMEA Sales Enablement Manager owns the regional enablement strategy end to end. You will design, build, and execute a bespoke EMEA enablement roadmap that directly accelerates revenue performance across the region while acting as the primary bridge between global enablement strategy, EMEA GTM strategy, and the activation of both in market.
This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role focused on 'last mile enablement'- ensuring that global enablement is successfully translated into how reps act in the field. You will operate as a trusted business partner to EMEA Sales and broader GTM leadership, quickly absorbing business context, understanding regional priorities, and translating them into practical enablement actions that improve seller execution and business performance. You must be able to connect market conditions, regional business priorities, seller needs, and customer outcomes - and champion those priorities when partnering directly with EMEA GTM teams.
Business acumen is critical in this role; you must bring a customer-first mindset and a deep understanding of the value of Box for our customer's business, maximising the value of global programmes while building locally-driven initiatives that reflect the unique dynamics of EMEA markets and sales motions. EMEA Enablement is uniquely positioned to act as a testing ground for new processes, selling motions, and cross-functional GTM teaming initiatives. You will lead the enablement charge that translates those from strategies to high-impact field performance.
Reporting Structure: Reports directly to the Global Head of Enablement with a dotted line to EMEA
 What You'll Do
Regional Strategy & Roadmap: Design, own, and execute a bespoke, agile EMEA enablement roadmap aligned with regional revenue priorities, GTM strategy, and QBR planning. Integrate closely with Chief of Staff and GTM Ops as a core commercial lever.
Global-to-Local Integration: Bridge global enablement and EMEA field teams by adapting global tools, training, and content for regional market nuances, while championing EMEA-specific priorities and resource needs at the global level.
Bi-directional Feedback & Insight: Maintain a continuous feedback loop between EMEA sellers, frontline managers, and global stakeholders, surfacing field realities, seller experience insights, and performance trends in real time.
End-to-End Programme Delivery: Design, facilitate, and reinforce high-impact enablement programmes (virtual and in-person) across onboarding, product launches, sales processes, MEDDPICC adoption, and manager enablement to drive sustained behavior change.
Executive Advisory & Stakeholder Leadership: Serve as a trusted advisor to the EMEA SVP, sales leadership, and cross-functional GTM teams, building consensus in a matrixed environment and proactively identifying performance gaps.
Measurement & Commercial Impact: Partner with RevOps to build and maintain performance dashboards tracking key seller metrics (ramp time, win rates, deal velocity) and directly communicate enablement’s ROI on revenue, pipeline, and retention.
 Who You Are
Experience: 3-5+ years of experience in sales enablement, sales training, sales management, or closely related commercial roles, including significant experience supporting enterprise sellers and sales leaders in EMEA markets.
Business Partnership: Proven ability to operate as a trusted business partner to Sales and GTM leaders, using sound judgment and commercial understanding to shape priorities, influence decisions, and drive execution.
Enterprise Sales Experience: Strong background working directly with enterprise Sales teams, including experience coaching sellers and managers across multiple EMEA markets on value-based selling, sales process excellence, and in-field execution. Deep empathy for seller experience and a practical understanding of what helps frontline teams adopt, execute, and win.
Customer-First Mindset: A strong customer-first mindset with a deep understanding of how to articulate and position the value of Box for our customer's business.
Tools: Proficient with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), enablement and LMS platforms, and data/analytics tools, a plus if you’ve been leveraging AI tooling to drive efficiency, scale and impact.
Communication: Exceptional presentation and facilitation skills for executive audiences, virtual and in-person; able to influence and inspire across cultures and seniority levels.
Analytical Skills: Ability to leverage performance dashboards; skilled at using data to identify gaps, measure ROI, and tell a compelling impact story.
Autonomy & Drive: Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast
We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.
Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.
At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. If you are head-over-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!
 Benefits
Box Benefits package includes pension, medical and dental coverage. We have a robust wellness program including 25 days of vacation (plus your birthday off!) and subsidized gym membership. There is such a thing as a free lunch, you can order from a daily menu along with lots of snacks and drinks. EMEA HQ office is located in the impressive White Collar Factory on Old Street; www.whitecollarfactory.com and other European offices in Paris, Munich, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.
 EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation.

In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in.
Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we re proud of. We re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow.
About the role
Aquablu's revenue engine needs one owner.
That's you. As our AI-native RevOps Manager and GTM Engineer, you own our Revenue Architecture end to end. The Bowtie is how we operate from Lead to Expansion, and you run it. You set the canonical definitions and the KPI tree the whole commercial team works from. You build the forecast engines across Direct, Indirect, and Enterprise, and you run commission and compensation operations. Then you build the AI operating layer on top, so the commercial org's routine work runs without anyone chasing it.
You're a mid-level individual contributor reporting to the VP GTM.
 What you'll do

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋
 Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!
We’re looking for a {job title} to join our {team name} team in {location}. You will {one sentence that explains the purpose of the role}.
The Revenue Operations team is central to the success of our go-to-market functions. As the Manager of Revenue Operations for the B2B business unit, you will build and lead a high-performing RevOps team in your region, establishing a best-in-class revenue operations function. Your expertise will guide GTM teams in strategic planning, insightful reporting, and performance optimization, helping drive alignment and efficiency across departments.
In this role, you will own the development, monitoring, and refinement of key performance indicators (KPIs) across the entire customer journey to ensure measurable success at every stage. Partnering closely with Finance and GTM leadership, you’ll play a critical role in developing investment cases to enhance team productivity and efficiency. This is a strategic, high-impact position where you will contribute directly to business growth by optimizing processes, establishing robust reporting frameworks, and ensuring data-driven decisions across the organization.
 What You’ll Be Doing
 As the Manager of Revenue Operations, you will lead the RevOps function to drive operational excellence and support profitable revenue growth strategies. Working closely with senior leadership, you’ll develop and execute strategic initiatives aligned with our company OKRs to help achieve revenue and profitability targets.
Weekly Performance Review and Pipeline Updates Lead weekly performance reviews, providing a comprehensive analysis of the pipeline and insights to leadership. This includes detailed forecasting updates for end-of-month (EOM), end-of-quarter (EOQ), and end-of-year (EOY) projections to support proactive decision-making across the organization. You’ll Identify and establish new KPIs to track the health and effectiveness of the GTM teams, adapting to emerging business priorities.
Bi-Weekly Deep-Dive Reviews Conduct in-depth bi-weekly sessions focusing on New Business (AE) and Account Management (AM) performance. This includes delivering rep-level insights, analyzing trends, identifying pipeline risks and opportunities, and contributing to the Weekly Business Review (WBR) to ensure the sales teams are equipped to drive growth.
Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews (MBR/QBR) Facilitate the Monthly Business Review (MBR) and Quarterly Business Review (QBR) sessions, partnering with GTM leaders to provide a strategic overview of performance. These reviews will analyze key metrics, assess progress against targets, and align on actionable insights to drive overall success.
Monthly Quota Analysis and Coverage Recommendations Oversee the monthly analysis of quota attainment and coverage across the sales and customer teams. This responsibility includes providing unbiased data driven insights and recommendations on IC Quotas and Coverage to ensure optimal alignment with market opportunities, our company planning, and resource efficiency.
Quarterly Reforecasting Lead the quarterly reforecasting process, working closely with Finance and GTM leadership. This involves adjusting revenue and performance targets to align with current business realities, identifying areas for investment or cost optimization, and ensuring targets are realistic and achievable.
 In Addition To These Core Responsibilities, You Will
Build and develop the Revenue Operations team as a strategic partner for the Head of RevOps, fostering a culture of high performance that aligns with Lightspeed’s values.
Collaborate with cross-functional leaders in Enablement, Product, and Sales to ensure the strategy is aligned with global priorities and product roadmaps.
 What You Need To Bring
A bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as business, finance, technology, or operations; a master’s degree in business or a related discipline is a plus but not required.
Proven experience leading and developing high-performing teams (2+ years) in a hybrid or remote environment, fostering a collaborative and results-oriented culture.
Significant experience (6+ years) within a go-to-market (GTM) environment, with a track record of delivering on strategic GTM initiatives that drive revenue growth and operational efficiency.
Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional outcomes, successfully collaborating with stakeholders in Information Systems, Data, Finance, GTM, and Marketing.
Strong experience leading budget and forecasting processes to align with company goals and expectations, ensuring financial accuracy and effective resource allocation.
Solid analytical and data-driven decision-making skills, with experience establishing and managing KPIs to measure and optimize performance across the customer journey.
As a global company with employees and clients outside of Quebec, fluency in English as a working language is required for this position
 What Will Help You Succeed In This Role
Exceptional Analytical Skills: A keen ability to analyze complex data sets and derive actionable insights that will guide GTM strategies and optimize performance metrics across all customer journey stages.
Strong Communication and Relationship-Building Abilities: Excellent communication skills to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels, especially in a cross-functional, hybrid, and rapidly evolving environment.
Strategic Thinking and Problem-Solving: The capacity to think big-picture while managing details, with an eye for process improvement and alignment to organizational goals.
Self-Starter with a Results-Driven Mindset: A proactive and resourceful attitude, with a drive for achieving tangible results and measurable impact on revenue performance.
 Be a changemaker
 You’ll Enjoy
A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work
A culture that celebrates performance
The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard
Career-defining opportunities
Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.
Flexible paid time off and remote work policies
Equity options, because this is your company too
Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters
Training opportunities to grow your skills and career
Health and wellness credit so you feel your best
Time off to volunteer and give back to your community
Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams
Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook
Enhanced parental leave to support growing families
Fuel your growth. Find your people.
At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities
 Final thought... Studies show that gender-coded words significantly reduce the number of women applying. Use this link to find out if your job description is gender-neutral: http://gender-decoder.katmatfield.com/
 || ONLY IF CRIMINAL CHECK APPLIES || Please note that we ask applicants to disclose any criminal convictions, and we conduct criminal record checks as part of our hiring process for this role.
 To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
 Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.
 Where to from here?
 Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.
Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.
 Who We Are
 Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.
Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

title: Manager, Growth Operations
description:
Our Company 
BrandActive specializes in the financial analysis, strategy, and logistics of rebrand implementation. Since 1998, we’ve helped many of the world’s most valuable brands plan, budget, and implement brand change—optimizing spend, improving efficiency, and reducing complexity along the way.
Our work combines industry-leading analytics with a proven methodology to help clients make smarter decisions, save time and money, and get more value from their brand investments—whether they’re navigating a major rebrand or managing their brand day to day. You can explore examples of our work in our case studies.
At BrandActive, we’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive workplace where people can do their best work and grow together. We strive to set the global standard for excellence in our industry while fostering a culture rooted in trust, agility, and growth —guided by our North Star: great people, doing great work, and having a great time doing it.
 The Opportunity 
We’re looking for a highly organized, process-minded Growth Operations leader who can turn strategic priorities into coordinated action across an integrated sales and marketing team. You’ll bring structure, visibility, and follow-through to how the team operates, leading cross-functional initiatives, creating and strengthening processes and systems, and ensuring teams have the clarity, information, and tools they need to execute effectively.
 Responsibilities 
 Growth operational planning and performance 
Acts as the operational driver behind strategic goals set by SVP, Growth, translating priorities into coordinated actions across campaigns, partnerships, sales initiatives, and internal workflows to ensure consistent execution and follow-through.
Translates growth strategy into clear, actionable plans—breaking down priorities into trackable steps, aligning stakeholders, documenting processes, and ensuring visibility into progress and next actions across teams.
Owns preparation and ongoing improvement of the integrated GTM dashboard, increasing visibility into activities, improving usability, and identifying opportunities to enhance it with AI and automation.
Owns development of recurring metrics and reporting, with support from the Growth Coordinator, ensuring data is consolidated, accurate, and aligned with growth priorities.
Evaluates new tools and, if adopted, manages implementation and ensures teams use systems effectively.
 Sales and partnership enablement 
Oversees pipeline hygiene and visibility, ensuring next steps are consistently updated, supporting weekly pipeline reviews, and contributing to pipeline restructuring and qualification efforts.
Supports sales process execution by ensuring the sales team has clear priorities, building and maintaining account planning templates and proposal submission checklists, and ensuring sales activities such as prep calls, debriefs, and follow-ups are completed with clear ownership and within defined timelines.
Supports new offering readiness by working with leadership to translate go-to-market plans into actionable components, including sales processes, materials, and workflows, with a focus on making them repeatable and easy for teams to execute.
Owns day-to-day coordination of partnership activities, including tracking next steps, maintaining partner documentation and mapping, supporting partner meetings and follow-ups, and helping identify opportunities to deepen strategic partner engagement.
 Strategic initiatives and cross-functional enablement 
Leads and project manages strategic Growth Operations initiatives, including HubSpot improvements and transformation, operationalization of the community advocacy program, and industry research and advancement initiatives, coordinating stakeholders and maintaining visibility from planning through delivery.
Strengthens cross-functional coordination by improving communication flows, ensuring stakeholders are informed and aligned, and helping centralize information across tools such as pipeline, partner data, and project tracking.
Identifies bottlenecks and creates systems to eliminate them, building repeatable processes that reduce manual effort and solve cross-functional friction.
Supports role clarity and capability-building across growth roles, creating playbooks, SOPs, and templates to harmonize workflows so teams can collaborate more effectively.
Facilitates growth team huddles, cross-team forums, and retrospectives.
Manages vendor relationships where applicable.
 Professional Development 
Own your growth by setting and updating development goals, actively seeking feedback, and aligning your aspirations with business goals.
Contribute to internal initiatives that impact the client and/or team member experience such as our Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Advisory Committee, Community Impact Committee, or our Social Committee.
Bring forward smarter, faster, better solutions to processes and identify opportunities to be more agile in day-to-day activities.
Demonstrate inclusive and supportive behavior, contributing to BrandActive’s core values of trust, agility, and growth, commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion, (EDI), humanity, and wellbeing.
 Qualifications and Experience 
This role is for someone who thinks about Growth Operations holistically—how an integrated sales and marketing team works together, how priorities move across functions, and how the right processes, systems, information, and operating rhythms enable the team to perform. It is not a traditional Marketing Operations or technology-focused role; while tools such as HubSpot and project management platforms are important enablers, the focus is on improving how the broader Growth team operates.
You might not tick every box, but if you meet most of the qualifications and are excited about the role, we’d love to hear from you. We value potential, curiosity, and a growth mindset.
Strong project and program management skills, with experience translating strategic priorities into structured plans and coordinating multiple workstreams through execution.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, align stakeholders, and drive clear ownership, decisions, and follow-through.
Strong ability to manage up by anticipating needs, proactively surfacing risks and decisions, and providing leadership with clear visibility into progress and priorities.
Experience shaping and improving project management systems, processes, and ways of working to increase team effectiveness and reduce friction.
Strong facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to lead productive meetings and working sessions across teams and levels of seniority.
Highly organized and process-minded, with strong judgment, initiative, and the ability to identify roadblocks and bring forward practical solutions.
Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to consolidate information, identify meaningful insights, and support data-informed decision-making.
Comfortable working across CRM, reporting, project management, and collaboration platforms; experience with HubSpot and using automation or AI to improve workflows is critical.
 Compensation and Benefits 
 BrandActive offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including: 
 Competitive compensation: $110,000-$130,000 CAD. Total compensation depends on experience, skills, and location and includes non-cash rewards.
 Values led culture focused on humanity, trust, agility, and growth. Check out our Culture Statement. 
 Comprehensive health and dental coverage with no waiting period – your benefits start on day one.
 Mental health resources such as an Employee Assistant Program (EAP) and access to the Headspace app.
 Generous paid time off: 4 weeks of vacation, additional office closures, Flex Fridays, and extended long weekends throughout the summer.
 Holistic wellbeing benefits, including a wellbeing allowance, flexible additional time off to care for a loved one, support mental health, or observe meaningful religious or cultural holidays.
 Parental leave benefits to support you and your family.
 $2,000 annual professional and personal development support , including funding and time off for learning to support your growth.
 Home office and communications reimbursement to help you work comfortably.
 Charitable donation matching to support the causes that matter to you.
 Flexible work options – Remote (open to BC, Alberta, Ontario provinces) with adaptable schedules.
 Two annual town halls in Toronto, featuring engaging sessions and fun team activities.
 Supportive leadership and career development , with ongoing coaching and feedback to help you grow and succeed, quarterly formal feedback, annual performance reviews and separate annual development meetings.
 Work-from-anywhere flexibility, with the option to work abroad for up to four weeks (in eligible countries and after a minimum tenure depending on the role and circumstance).
And more!
 Start Date 
Immediately
 Location 
Remote (Canada); BrandActive also has an office available for those in Toronto, ON.
 Job vacancy 
This role reflects growth in our team and expanded operational scope.
 Commitment to Equal Opportunity 
BrandActive is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values inclusion in its workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability status.
 Accessibility Statement 
BrandActive is dedicated to ensuring an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations during the application process, please let the Talent Manager know. We are committed to partnering with you to provide support and make reasonable adjustments throughout the process. All information received in relation to accommodation will be kept confidential and will be handled in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act.
 The Interview Process 
At BrandActive, we use AI within our recruitment process in the following ways: screening applicants and recording calls and interviews. All candidates will be notified of the use of AI at the start of a call or interview and can request to opt out. As part of our broader dedication to EDI, we continuously review and refine our use of AI to support equitable experiences for all applicants.
 Initial Call (Pre-Screen): If your application is selected, you will have a prescreen call with the Talent Manager where we will use AI to transcribe for accurate note taking.
 Virtual Interview: Followed by an interview with the hiring manager.
 Case Presentation Interview: The last step is a case study and presentation to our team.
We thank all applicants for their interest in BrandActive, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Sr. Sales Operations Analyst
description:
About Gusto
 At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.
All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.
AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.
 About The Role
 This is your chance to own one of the most technical, horizontal levers in GTM planning: building the scalable models and infrastructure that enable every route to market to grow efficiently. As Senior Sales Operations Analyst, you’ll partner with GTM leaders, Finance, Revenue Operations, and GTM Ops to develop and execute segmentation, book-of-business design, quota setting, and capacity planning. You’ll turn GTM strategy into concrete, automated models that determine how customers are segmented, how reps are staffed, and what they are held accountable for.
This role takes an end-to-end, platform-minded view across GTM motions, not just a single sales team. You’ll identify where manual work, fragmented logic, or inconsistent processes limit scale and build durable planning infrastructure that drives revenue outcomes as the business evolves. You’ll own the outcome: balanced books, defensible quotas tied to capacity, and scalable models that hold up under scrutiny.
 About The Team
 You'll sit within GTM Operations, working as the dedicated segmentation, book-of-business, and capacity planning owner for our Direct, Expansion, and Benefits sales teams. We think of ourselves as builders and problem solvers: we turn ambiguous planning questions into scalable, defensible models, and we hold the line on rigor even when the business is moving fast and priorities compete.
You'll work in close partnership with each organization's GTM leaders and their dedicated GTM Ops partners, leaning on their operational and business context, while you own building, defending, and maintaining the segmentation, book, quota, and headcount models that everyone plans against.
 Here's What You'll Do Day-to-day
 Segmentation & Book of Business
Own the design and ongoing maintenance of customer/account segmentation for Direct, Expansion, and Benefits sales, translating org-level segmentation strategy into concrete, rules-based models these teams can operate against.
Build and maintain balanced books of business across reps and teams, accounting for account potential, workload, geography, and product mix; own rebalancing when the business shifts (new hires, departures, territory changes, book splits).
Set and maintain clear, documented rules for account assignment, routing, and reclassification, and serve as the ruling authority when edge cases or disputes come up.
Partner with Sales, GTM Ops, and Systems & Tooling to ensure segmentation and book structures are reflected accurately in Salesforce and downstream systems.
 Quota Setting
Own the end-to-end quota-setting process for Direct, Expansion, and Benefits: translating top-down revenue targets into bottoms-up, capacity-based quotas by rep, team, and segment.
Build and maintain the quota models and methodology, ensuring quotas are defensible, equitable across territories/books, and tightly tied to book-of-business design and headcount capacity.
Partner with RTM leaders, Finance, and Sales Compensation to align quotas with comp plans, revenue targets, and business priorities each planning cycle.
Own quota administration through the cycle: true-ups for territory or book changes, new-hire ramp adjustments, and mid-cycle corrections.
 Headcount & Capacity Planning
Partner with GTM Ops & Finance on capacity planning for Direct, Expansion, and Benefits: modeling the headcount needed to cover segmented books and hit revenue targets, and identifying where the org is over- or under-staffed relative to opportunity.
Build the headcount models that inform hiring plans, partnering with RTM leaders and Finance on timing, sequencing, and prioritization of new roles.
Continuously monitor capacity against actual book size, productivity, and attrition, flagging gaps or imbalances before they become a problem.
Own scenario planning for headcount and territory changes (reorgs, new segments, M&A, product launches), modeling the impact before decisions are made.
 Cross-functional Partnership & Communication
Partner closely with RTM leaders and their GTM Ops partners across Direct, Expansion, and Benefits to ensure segmentation, book, quota, and capacity decisions reflect real operational context, while retaining ownership of the outcome and the execution.
Work with GTM Ops, Finance, and Sales Compensation to stay aligned with org-wide segmentation frameworks, revenue targets, and comp design.
Communicate clearly and proactively with sales leadership on plan status, tradeoffs, and risk: you're the trusted authority on "how the books, quotas, and headcount are built and why."
Document methodology and decisions so segmentation, quota, and capacity models are transparent, auditable, and repeatable across planning cycles.
 Here's What We're Looking For
5+ years in Sales Ops, RevOps, or a similar analytical GTM role, with direct, hands-on experience owning segmentation, territory/book design, quota setting, or headcount/capacity planning; ideally in a fast-paced SaaS or fintech environment.
Proven ability to own outcomes and execution, not just analysis or recommendations: you're comfortable being the accountable owner when a quota, book, or headcount plan is challenged.
Strong sales process & tooling proficiency: you can build and audit account assignment/routing logic, manage territory and book structures, and build reporting that leaders trust.
Analytical depth; comfortable building and defending quantitative models (quota, capacity, segmentation) under time pressure.
Experience running planning processes on a recurring cadence (annual/quarterly quota setting, ongoing book rebalancing, headcount reviews) across multiple stakeholder groups.
Excellent written and verbal communication; you can defend a model's methodology to GTM leaders and senior sales leadership, and hold your ground when a decision is unpopular but correct.
A first-principles problem solver who can build a defensible model from ambiguous inputs and translate org-level strategy into concrete, rules-based execution.
A strong cross-functional partner, able to work closely with GTM leaders and GTM Ops peers without ceding ownership of the outcome.
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience owning segmentation, book-of-business, or quota/capacity planning across multiple sales organizations or motions simultaneously (e.g., new business, expansion, and a distinct product line).
Experience in payroll, HR tech, benefits, or SMB SaaS go-to-market motions.
Experience partnering with Sales Compensation and Finance on quota-to-comp alignment.
Experience designing or improving account assignment/routing automation (e.g., lead-routing tools, rules engines).
 Compensation
 Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $100,000 - $120,000/yr in Scottsdale, $105,000 - $130,000/yr in Denver and Atlanta, $130,000 - $155,000/yr in San Francisco and New York, and $120,000 - $145,000 CAD/yr for Toronto. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.
Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.
Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.
When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.
Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.
Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you.

title: Principal Analyst, Sales Strategy & Operations - EMEA Sales
description:
Overview
 At Atlassian, we are on a mission to reinvent B2B selling. We have built a fast-growing, multi-billion business by focusing relentlessly on building products that delight our customers and removing friction to drive sales and adoption.
Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, look to solve challenging problems and are motivated to implement innovative ways to do things better? You'll thrive if you are highly organized, driven, a self-starter, analytical and have a strong attention to detail. If so, continue reading.
This highly visible role will be a strategic partner to our Senior Sales Leadership, helping us deliver in period performance and scale for tomorrow. This role will support EMEA Account Executive (AE) teams, partnering closely with the applicable leaders to drive operational excellence and accelerate revenue growth. The ideal candidate will thrive in a high-growth, collaborative environment, blend operational rigor with a deep understanding of enterprise SaaS go-to-market motions, and bridge from business intelligence analyst up to the C-suite.
This role will serve as a key operational partner to our Senior Sales leadership, helping deliver in-period performance and build the operational foundation for scalable growth. You will partner closely with sales leadership and across Revenue Operations teams to drive operational rigor, forecasting discipline, and data-driven decision-making. The ideal candidate will thrive in a high-growth, collaborative environment, blend operational rigor with a deep understanding of enterprise SaaS go-to-market motions, and bridge from business intelligence analyst up to the senior leadership.
 Responsibilities
Field partnership & insights Serve as trusted operational partner for Sales leaders in our high touch businesses in EMEA, helping drive revenue performance, operational rigor, and strategic insights to power accelerated performance. 
Forecasting & pipeline management Assist Sales to continuously improve their sales forecasting and pipeline generation and management practices under our Sales Franchise operating model, partnering with regional team leaders to improve accountability, predictability and forecast accuracy.
Coverage, target and capacity planning Support annual planning cycles for our high touch EMEA sales teams, including territory design, target splits, headcount planning, and capacity modeling. Ensure equitable coverage, alignment to strategic priorities, and support for the org's growth trajectory. Support field leaders with headcount management in line with published policies and governance. 
Sales process design & optimization Drive the adoption of franchised sales practices to improve consistency and effectiveness across teams and geographies. Identify areas of friction in process workflows and lead initiatives to improve field productivity, engagement tracking, and funnel metrics. Look for opportunities to implement AI and automation to drive efficiencies.
Sales excellence evangelism Partner with Central Operations, Analytics, Systems and Sales Enablement teams to assess, standardize, implement, and optimize Sales processes, people and technology to deliver revenue growth. Support QBR preparation, compensation tracking, performance reporting, rhythm-of-business cadences for the sales organization and change management with new processes and tools.
 Compensation
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
 Qualifications
 Qualifications
7+ years of experience in Sales Operations or Revenue Operations
Proven success supporting velocity B2B Sales Operations 
Expertise in sales planning, forecasting, analytics, and process design
Strong business acumen and executive presence, with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and executive leadership

English language proficiency (written and verbal)
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience operating in a public company or pre-IPO scale-up environment
MBA or relevant advanced degree or relevant experience

 Benefits & Perks
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits .

 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager, Enablement
description:
About Juniper Square 
Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.
Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!
 Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. 
About your role
We're looking for a builder, someone who's excited to shape how our go-to-market teams learn, ramp, and get better at their jobs. Someone who understands sellers and what they need in enablement.
This role sits inside Revenue Operations and owns GTM Enablement. You'll be the connective tissue between everything changing across the company (new product capabilities, pricing and packaging updates, fresh sales motions, market shifts) and the programs that help sellers, Customer Success, and partner-facing teams work effectively with prospects and clients. Onboarding, ramp, training, content, and continuous learning are yours to define and run.
What you'll do
 Own GTM enablement (the core of the role) 
Drive the enablement framework as AI-native (AI-based pitch review with certification, etc)
Own and lead our GTM Enablement function, setting and actioning a vision for onboarding, training, and continuous learning.
Own the training and certification program for GTM teams: Audit rep readiness against role and level requirements, and drive completion in partnership with GTM and RevOps leadership.
Design onboarding and ramp programs for new sellers that target the same time-to-productivity benchmarks tenured reps hit, working alongside the Customer Education team on content production and enforcement.
Partner with Product Marketing and Product on new launches and campaigns, translating positioning, pricing, and feature updates into training, certification, and content.
Collaborate with managers and subject-matter experts to curate and refine training content, turning complex inputs into clear and engaging learning experiences.
Identify and close knowledge gaps by monitoring GTM performance, gathering feedback, and launching targeted learning programs.
Support frontline coaching by surfacing insights from call libraries and equipping managers to drive rep development.
Manage and maintain our learning systems, including the GTM content hub and LMS, keeping resources organized, current, and accessible.
Report enablement impact to GTM and RevOps leadership in outcome terms: ramp time, certification completion, content adoption, and the performance measures that show the work is landing.
 Flex into revenue operations 
Own the seam between process and adoption: RevOps builds the process and you translate it into role-based training and enablement so GTM teams actually use it.
Build and maintain reporting and dashboards that connect enablement activity to GTM performance, and contribute to broader RevOps reporting as needed.
Help design, document, and improve revenue processes, including opportunity management, handoffs between teams, and the playbooks that sit on top of them.
Take on discrete RevOps projects where the team needs capacity, scoped with your manager so enablement stays the priority.
 Use AI as a force multiplier 
Use AI tools to synthesize source material such as recordings, transcripts, and slides, accelerate content creation, extract insights, and personalize learning.
Orchestrate multi-step workflows across tools to reduce manual work on recurring tasks.
Own and further define Sales Enablement Harness and associated substrates
Qualifications
7+ years of experience in Revenue Operations and 3+ years in Sales Enablement
Experience in fintech, SaaS, or a complex B2B enterprise sales motion
Exceptional ability to translate large volumes of complex information into clear, engaging, and actionable content
Experience designing and running enablement, onboarding, or certification programs for a GTM team.
Proven project management and organizational skills; comfortable balancing multiple projects, stakeholders, and deadlines.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for clarity and concision.
Proficiency in Salesforce: you can build reports and dashboards, pull and interpret data, and understand how CRM structure shapes reporting.
Strong analytical skills, with proficiency in data and reporting tools (e.g., Salesforce reporting, Tableau, Looker, or advanced Google Sheets/Excel).
Demonstrated success collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing teams.
A learning-oriented mindset; you're curious, proactive, and eager to understand new subjects and processes deeply.
Experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude) to orchestrate multi-step workflows across two or more tools without writing code, producing reusable, structured outputs.
Preferred: Experience with GTM tooling such as Gong, Outreach, Apollo, Clay, or an LMS platform.
Preferred: Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, communications, or a related field.
At Juniper Square, we believe building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture makes us a better company. If you think this job sounds like a fit, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the qualifications.
 Compensation 
Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $116,000 - $145,000 USD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.
Benefits include:
Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family
Life insurance
Mental wellness coverage
Fertility and growing family support
Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays
Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies
Retirement saving plans
Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home
Annual professional development stipend
Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

title: GTM Strategy and Operations Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical, technically proficient GTM Strategy and Operations Manager to own the data, AI workflows, systems and operating processes that govern pipeline from opportunity creation through close, customer handoff and renewal. This is a hands-on builder role at the intersection of GTM Operations, analytics and GTM Engineering. The successful candidate will establish trusted pipeline and forecast reporting, turn commercial data into decisions, and build governed AI-enabled workflows that improve forecast accuracy, deal execution, retention visibility and leadership insight.
 We are proud to offer competitive salary ranges aligned to industry standards. Please note that our ranges are representative and individual compensation specifics may vary based upon experience level, professional competencies and geographic differentials. 
 What You Will Do (Essential Responsibilities): 
 Analytics, Data and Decision Infrastructure: 
 Own the analytical foundation for pipeline through renewal, including the commercial data model, metric definitions, source-of-truth logic, transformations and dashboard architecture. 
 Build reliable reporting for pipeline coverage, stage conversion, win rate, deal size, sales cycle, slippage, forecast accuracy, retention, renewal risk and partner contribution. 
 Create analytical views across region, segment, product, source, owner, partner, opportunity type and cohort, using trend and root-cause analysis to explain performance drivers. 
 Establish data-quality monitoring, reconciliation and reporting QA across Salesforce, Clari and related sources so leaders can trust outputs and understand metric lineage. 
 Deliver decision-ready pipeline, forecast and renewal narratives that distinguish signal from noise and recommend specific management actions. 
 AI, Automation and GTM Engineering: 
 Design, build and operate production-ready AI workflows for opportunity hygiene, deal-risk detection, forecast commentary, meeting intelligence, next-step quality, renewal preparation, churn and expansion signals, and management reporting. 
 Connect AI capabilities to Salesforce, Clari, Clari Copilot and structured commercial data using low-code tools, integrations, APIs and agent-based platforms. 
 Define prompts, structured outputs, evaluation criteria, exception handling, human-in-the-loop controls and monitoring for accuracy, adoption and business impact. 
 Apply appropriate governance for data security, permissions, transparency and responsible use while continuously testing and improving workflow performance. 
 Identify high-value automation opportunities, quantify expected benefit and measure realised gains in forecast accuracy, seller capacity, cycle time and retention visibility. 
 Opportunity, Pipeline and Forecasting Ownership: 
 Own the Salesforce opportunity lifecycle from creation through qualification, progression and close, including stages, entry and exit criteria, required fields, validation and hygiene standards. 
 Own the forecasting operating model, including cadence, hierarchy, categories, inspection views, submissions, governance and forecast-accuracy measurement. 
 Administer and optimise Clari and its Salesforce integration, ensuring access, roll-ups, workflows and data are accurate, usable and trusted. 
 Use Clari and Clari Copilot insights to surface movement, slippage, risk, upside, stakeholder coverage and coaching opportunities for leaders and sellers. 
 Partner with Sales leadership to improve pipeline discipline and execution through clear process, enablement, inspection and data-led intervention. 
 Close, Renewal and Partner Operations: 
 Own closed-won handoff into implementation and Customer Success, including required context, ownership, service levels, milestone capture and exception management. 
 Design and maintain renewal processes covering record creation, ownership, timelines, stages, risk, forecast categories, escalation, retention outcomes and expansion signals. 
 Own scalable processes for partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities, including registration, approval, attribution, handoffs and performance reporting. 
 Ensure closed-lost, churn and contraction reasons are consistently captured and converted into actionable insight. 
 Cross-Functional Leadership and Governance: 
 Serve as the operational and analytical partner to Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, Finance, GTM Systems and executive leadership for pipeline-to-renewal performance. 
 Lead requirements gathering, process design, solution configuration, testing, release management, documentation, enablement and adoption measurement. 
 Drive alignment on commercial definitions, forecast policy, data standards and prioritisation, balancing near-term needs with scalable architecture. 
 What You'll Need (Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities): 
 4+ years of experience in GTM Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Operations, GTM Engineering, Revenue Systems or an equivalent technical GTM role in a B2B technology or SaaS environment. 
 Advanced analytical ability, including experience designing data models, metric definitions, dashboard architecture and scalable reporting infrastructure for operational and executive decision-making. 
 Strong Salesforce proficiency across opportunity data modelling, process design, automation, reports, dashboards, permissions and data-quality governance. 
 Hands-on experience with forecasting processes and platforms, preferably Clari, including configuration, inspection, reporting and forecast-accuracy analysis. 
 Demonstrated success building and operationalising AI-enabled workflows using low-code tools, integrations, APIs or agent-based platforms. 
 Working knowledge of AI workflow design, including prompt design, structured outputs, testing and evaluation, monitoring, exception handling and human oversight. 
 Experience designing opportunity, close, customer handoff, renewal and recurring-revenue reporting processes. 
 Ability to combine quantitative analysis with commercial judgement, communicate clear recommendations and influence senior cross-functional leaders. 
 Strong requirements-gathering, process-mapping, solution design, testing, documentation and change-management skills. 
 What Would Be Nice (Preferred Experience): 
 Experience with Clari Copilot, conversation intelligence or AI-assisted deal inspection. 
 Experience with SQL, BI tools, data transformation, reverse ETL or warehouse-based reporting. 
 Experience building GTM applications, internal tools or agents in a GTM Engineer capacity. 
 Exposure to Salesloft, Lusha, Clay, Nooks, Qualified or LinkedIn Sales Navigator, plus experience supporting enterprise or multi-product recurring-revenue motions.

Strong Salesforce automation, permissions and data-governance proficiency

title: GTM Program Manager
description:
Dropbox is a Virtual First company. For this role, we are currently only authorized to hire candidates from the following provinces: Alberta, British Columbia, Ontario, and Saskatchewan.
Role Description
As a GTM Program Manager focused on the GTM organization, you will turn revenue-driving strategies into operational execution. You will play a crucial role in translating business priorities into the systems, processes, and business rules needed to bring new commercial initiatives to life and scale existing motions.
You will lead cross-functional planning, define business requirements, align stakeholders, and drive delivery with business and technical partners. Your work will connect teams across the customer lifecycle, ensure operational readiness, and measure whether implemented solutions achieve their intended business outcomes.
You will play a crucial part in helping the organization deliver on its growth strategy. You’ll build partnerships across GTM functions and see the direct impact of your work on revenue execution and the customer and seller experience.
 Responsibilities
Translate strategy into execution: Turn revenue-driving strategies into actionable plans across GTM systems, processes, and business rules.
Define business requirements: Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, document requirements, and establish clear success criteria.
Lead cross-functional delivery: Manage programs from discovery through implementation, coordinating scope, timelines, dependencies, and accountable owners.
Drive solution development: Partner with business and technical teams to evaluate options, resolve gaps, and implement scalable solutions.
Align stakeholders and decisions: Facilitate discussions, clarify tradeoffs, and drive agreement on priorities, ownership, and outstanding decisions.
Ensure operational readiness: Coordinate testing, documentation, and change management to support successful launches and adoption.
Measure outcomes and improve: Track results against business objectives, identify operational gaps, and drive improvements to execution and the customer and seller experience.
 Requirements
At least 3 years of overall professional experience.
3+ years of experience in Product Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Business Systems, or another role supporting complex cross-functional GTM initiatives.
Experience working in a B2B SaaS or subscription-based business with multiple products, customer segments, or routes to market.
Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear requirements, process workflows, and measurable success criteria.
Experience partnering with technical and business teams to evaluate solutions, assess tradeoffs, and validate that changes meet business needs.
Ability to identify root causes, use data to assess outcomes, and implement practical improvements that scale.
Strong systems thinking, with the ability to understand how a change in one part of the commercial lifecycle can affect downstream processes, systems, data, and customer experiences.
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Salesforce, CPQ, billing, commerce, provisioning, entitlement, or other systems supporting the quote-to-cash/customer lifecycle.
Understanding of the customer lifecycle and how systems, processes, data, and business rules support commercial execution.
Familiarity with automation and AI capabilities that can simplify requirements gathering, dependency management, testing, and operational readiness.
Durable Skills
 Skills
 AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:
Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.
To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.
 Compensation
 Canada Pay Range
$103,700—$140,300 CAD
The range listed above is the expected annual salary/OTE (On-Target Earnings) for this role, subject to change.
Salary/OTE is just one component of Dropbox’s total rewards package. All regular employees are also eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).
 Company Description
 Read more about our benefits here.
Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. We’re a global community of bold visionaries and resourceful doers shaping the future of Dropbox and, in turn, the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you’re ready to push boundaries and challenge yourself, Dropbox is ready for you.
 Team Description
 The Dropbox Business Strategy & Operations team unlocks the company's full potential by driving strategic initiatives and promoting operational excellence. We combine analytical rigor with creative problem-solving to tackle Dropbox’s biggest opportunities and challenges across all business functions. Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Finance, we translate our strategic vision into actionable plans that foster growth, optimize performance, and facilitate informed decision-making. Our work shapes the future of Dropbox by leading cross-functional business planning, developing insights that guide corporate and business unit strategies, creating systems and processes that power scalable success. If you're passionate about strategic thinking, solving complex problems, and making an impact through collaboration, join our Business Strategy & Operations team.
 Virtual First
 Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. Virtual First is built to provide the same access to opportunity, growth, and impact for everyone, regardless of location.
This role requires travel to offsites and various other team gatherings (approximately 5-10% of the year or 2-3 days per quarter). We provide advance notice when possible and encourage candidates to discuss any accommodation needs during the interview process.
 AI Fluency
 AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others.
 We Look For Four Key Behaviors In Candidates
Ownership: You use AI responsibly by protecting data, applying sound judgment, and taking accountability for the quality and accuracy of your work.
Experimentation: You explore new AI capabilities and apply them to improve workflows within approved tools and practices.
Leverage: You use AI to enhance thinking, improve efficiency, and increase your impact and your team’s.
Learning: You stay current on emerging AI tools and trends, continuously build your skills, and share what you learn with others.
Together, these behaviors help build a workforce where technology amplifies human judgment, creativity, and impact.
Dropbox supports responsible use of AI for preparation, but misrepresentation of skills or experience is not permitted. To learn more, see our approach to AI in hiring.
Dropbox is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.
