title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health. 
Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.
Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.
As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.
The Strategic Customer Success Account Manager at Spring Health builds and manages relationships with the company’s largest customers to ensure satisfaction, retention, and growth. This role oversees the full customer lifecycle, aligning Spring’s solutions with customer goals to drive engagement and revenue. Success is measured by accurate forecasting, achieving revenue targets, and fostering strong relationships across all levels of the customer organization. This is a remote, full time position on our team reporting to the Director of Strategic Customer Success. Occasional travel (10%) may be required for in-person events or meetings. 
 What you’ll do: 
 Serve as a product expert and advocate for mental health, supporting a portfolio of Spring Health’s largest and most impactful partners.
 Own forecasting projections for revenue, renewals, and upsell opportunities across your portfolio, ensuring the delivery of accurate forecasts.
 Identify and position upsell opportunities proactively, driving revenue growth by aligning solutions with customer goals.
 Develop and manage positive relationships with multiple customers, consultants, and key stakeholders to build trust and ensure satisfaction.
 Manage the entire customer lifecycle , including implementations, engagement strategies, renewals, and upsells by:
Developing timely, actionable account plans
Managing census files efficiently
Designing and executing member engagement communications
Preparing and presenting business reviews to senior HR executives
Delivering insightful, data-driven recommendations aligned with customer success metrics
Developing renewals strategy and delivering proposals/contracts
Managing the end-to-end deal cycle (procurement process)
 Collaborate cross-functionally to collect customer feedback and recommend process improvements across internal teams.
 Support sales efforts by partnering on retention, upsell initiatives, and expansion opportunities as well as supporting net new business acquisition through efforts like attending finalist meetings.
 Leverage data to drive results , using member engagement metrics and portfolio insights to adjust strategies.
 What success looks like: 
Customer Renewal and Expansion
Relationship with Executive Buyers
Gross Retention Rate (GRR)
Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
Net CACV Retention (NCR)
Product utilization and engagement
Net Promoter Score (NPS)
Customer Health Score
 What you’ll bring: 
Bachelor’s degree or higher preferred.
10+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or healthcare management, ideally in B2B2C environments and at early-stage companies.
 Previous experience driving forecasting, renewals, and upsell revenue. 
 Previous experience managing Fortune 100 clients and overseeing a portfolio valued at $25M or more. 
Strong understanding of sales motions similar to farmer sales roles , emphasizing relationship building and portfolio expansion.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and build trusted relationships.
 Experience creating growth through portfolio management, upsells, and cross-sell opportunities. 
Organized, with high attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.
Resourceful, proactive, and able to thrive in fast-paced environments.
Ability to probe, challenge, and consult customers to align solutions with their ultimate needs.
High integrity and professionalism, with a passion for transforming mental healthcare.
 Benefits provided by Spring Health: 
 Note : We have even more benefits than listed here and below, your recruiter will provide more in-depth information as you continue in the interview process. Benefits are subject to individual plan requirements and eligibility criteria. 
Health, Dental, Vision benefits start on your first day at Spring. You and your dependents also receive access to One Medical accounts HSA and FSA plans are also available, with Spring contributing up to $1K for HSAs, depending on your plan type.
Employer sponsored 401(k) match of up to 2% for retirement planning
A yearly allotment of no cost visits to the Spring Health network of therapists, coaches, and medication management providers for you and your dependents.
We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave and company holidays.
At 6 months tenure with Spring, we offer parental leave of 18 weeks for birthing parents and 16 weeks for non-birthing parents.
Access to Noom , a weight management program—based in psychology, that’s tailored to your unique needs and goals. 
Access to fertility care support through Carrot , in addition to $4,000 reimbursement for related fertility expenses.
Access to Wellhub , which connects employees to the best options for fitness, mindfulness, nutrition, and sleep in one subscription

title: Go-To-Market Operations Manager
description:
Who Are CSL? 
We are a leading international critical IoT connectivity expert provider specialising in sectors including Building & Security, Healthcare & Telecare, Infrastructure, Retail & Hospitality, and Transport & Logistics.
We are a rapidly growing, private equity-backed company with an international presence, operating across the UK, Ireland, the Nordics, Benelux, Spain, and North America.
We have completed 7 acquisitions, with each acquired business adding further expertise and scale to our market-leading propositions.
We have over 30 years of experience and now operate over 3 million active IoT connections around the world.
We now have over 270 employees within the Group – and this is growing all the time.
We are ranked 10th in the 2025 UK’s Best Workplaces™ by Great Place To Work®
Our high performing team is renowned for delivering leading solutions and services, backed up by world-class customer support across markets that demand nothing less than absolute certainty.
Our products and solutions have won over 20 awards across a range of industries.
 Who Are CSL Looking For? 
We’re looking for a GTM Operations Manager to own the systems, data, and reporting that marketing and sales both depend on – and to be the person who can say, with numbers people trust, where revenue is coming from and what is holding it back.
This role starts as maternity cover for our Marketing Operations Specialist, so the marketing systems, data, and reporting engine has to keep running from day one. But it is deliberately broader than a like-for-like backfill. CSL has grown fast across multiple countries and integrated seven acquisitions – and the gap we need closing is the different definitions, different systems, and to build a full GTM operations function that supports go-to-market excellence, with an agentic first approach. You will be the first dedicated revenue operations hire, laying the foundations for a function that covers the full funnel.
Over time, the weight of the role shifts. As the marketing operations maternity cover ends, the focus moves towards sales operations – pipeline discipline, forecasting, territory and quota support, and commercial reporting – as part of an evolving revenue operations function. We are being open about that from the start: this is a role that changes shape, and we want someone who finds that interesting rather than unsettling.
You’ll be technical enough to build and troubleshoot, be commercial enough to know which numbers matter, and be curious to quickly adapt to new and evolving technologies. You will also be central to how CSL uses AI across the revenue engine – automating the repetitive, and building the infrastructure that lets the wider team get business intelligence to know which levers to pull to grow revenue.
 Duties & Responsibilities: 
This role will encompass a range of responsibilities including but not limited to:
 Revenue Reporting, Forecasting & Insight 
Own end-to-end funnel reporting – from enquiry through to closed won – so marketing, sales, and leadership work from one set of numbers.
Build and maintain the forecasting process with Sales: pipeline coverage, conversion rates by stage, deal velocity, and forecast accuracy.
Own attribution and source reporting, and make sure regional and Group reporting reconcile.
Turn data into insight and recommendations for the CMO and commercial leadership – what to do differently, not just what happened.
Report on the commercial return of marketing and sales investment, including cost per opportunity and pipeline contribution by channel and region.
 Sales Operations & Pipeline 
Own pipeline hygiene and CRM discipline: stage definitions, exit criteria, close dates, and data completeness.
Own lead lifecycle and routing end to end – definitions, scoring, assignment rules, SLAs, and the handover from marketing into sales – and hold both sides to it.
Support sales process improvement, including building a revtech roadmap quoting, and improving the operational detail that slows deals down.
Provide the operational inputs behind territory design, target setting, and quota and commission calculation.
Partner with Sales leadership on shared process, definitions, and reporting across the funnel.
 Marketing Operations (Maternity Cover Period) 
Own the marketing technology stack – administration, integration, adoption, vendor relationships, licences, and cost.
Own marketing automation build and governance: templates, programmes, scoring, nurture logic, and preference management.
Support the marketing team with campaign setup, tracking, and quality assurance so activity is measurable from the start.
Manage deliverability, consent, and compliance across markets, including GDPR obligations.
Provide the regional marketers and the Senior Marketing Manager with the reporting they need against their pipeline and coverage targets.
 Systems, Data & Governance 
Own data quality across CRM and marketing platforms – deduplication, enrichment, segmentation structure, and account and contact hygiene across regions.
Define and document the data model, naming conventions, and taxonomy that marketing and sales both work to.
Manage integrations between systems so data flows without manual intervention.
Bring data from acquisitions and third-party sources into the core platforms cleanly.
Set and maintain governance so the numbers mean the same thing in every report, in every country.
 AI, Automation & the Revenue Brain 
Identify and automate the repetitive operational work across marketing and sales, using AI and workflow tooling where it genuinely saves time.
Build and maintain the technical infrastructure behind CSL’s central ‘brain’ – the shared, structured store of positioning, messaging, proof points, customer language, and performance data – extending it to cover sales conversations and commercial outcomes.
Build agents and workflows that let marketing and sales query performance data and reusable content without waiting on a report.
Use AI-assisted analysis for reporting, anomaly spotting, and post-campaign and post-quarter review, with proper validation before anything is acted on.
Set practical standards for safe, compliant AI and data use across the commercial team.
 Key Skills & Qualifications Sought: 
Solid revenue operations, sales operations, or marketing operations experience in a B2B environment – with genuine exposure to both sides of the funnel.
Hands-on experience administering CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce, Pardot, HubSpot).
Strong command of pipeline and funnel metrics, and how commercial performance is actually built from the underlying data.
Experience supporting a sales forecasting process, and the judgement to know when a forecast is being optimistic.
Strong data skills – comfortable with data structures, segmentation, deduplication, and reconciliation across systems.
Experience building dashboards and reporting in BI or AI tools, and explaining the results to non-technical stakeholders.
Working knowledge of GDPR and data compliance across multiple countries.
Confident building AI-assisted and automated workflows, with sound judgement on data quality, security, and validation.
Comfortable working with integrations, APIs, or scripting is a strong advantage.
Credible with sales people – able to hold the line on process and data discipline without losing the room.
Methodical, precise, and able to bring order to systems and data inherited from multiple sources.
Comfortable with a role that changes shape, and interested in building a function rather than inheriting one.
 How the Role will Evolve: 
 Months 1–12 – Cover and Foundations 
Full ownership of marketing operations during the maternity cover period: martech stack, marketing automation, campaign operations, data quality, and marketing reporting.
Establish shared funnel definitions, a single agreed set of revenue metrics, and reporting that marketing and sales both recognise.
Diagnose and fix the highest-value gaps in sales process and pipeline data – lead handover, opportunity hygiene, and forecast inputs.
Produce the first integrated revenue reporting pack for the CMO and commercial leadership.
 Month 12 Onwards – Integrated GTM/Agentic Operations 
Transition marketing operations back cleanly, with documented process, governance, and reporting.
Shift the centre of gravity to sales operations: forecasting, pipeline management, territory and quota support, commission inputs, and sales performance reporting.
Scale the function.
The above should not be viewed as an exhaustive list of skills and/or qualifications but rather CSLs view on the ideal candidate. If you feel you can meet three quarters of the requirements and learn the rest with support from CSL please apply now with an indication of your salary expectations for the role.

title: BizOps Lead
description:
About Sprout 
At Sprout, our mission is to make fertility and family-building accessible to all Canadians, regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, or family structure. The journey to parenthood can be emotionally, physically, and financially challenging, and too many people go through it without the support they need.
Nearly half the Canadian workforce is in peak family-building years, yet most benefits plans weren't built for this journey. The toll shows up at work - in attrition, lost productivity, and added HR burden. Sprout is one platform that supports people through the full continuum, from the moment they start thinking about family-building to their first day back at work.
We’ve just closed our seed round and are expanding the platform, growing the team, and deepening our partnerships across the benefits industry. The people we hire now will play a pivotal role in shaping Sprout’s future.
 The role 
This is a new role, and a new function, at Sprout. Many of the most important problems in our business sit across ops, GTM, and product, and don't fit neatly into any one person's mandate. We're looking for a BizOps Lead to take them on.
The common thread in this role is that you'll own the problem, not just the analysis. You'll take something from "we think this might be an opportunity" through research and a recommendation, and then help make it happen. On any given week, that might mean sizing a new product opportunity, joining a customer call to understand why something isn’t working, building a new pricing model or automating invoicing. You’ll research, design, and build processes, transition them to the right owners, then move on to the next challenge.
We’re looking for someone who does their best work early, when things are still taking shape, and there isn’t a playbook or framework. If you excel here, you’ll have a path to leading a function as Sprout grows. 
 What you’ll do 
Own high-priority, cross-functional problems: work with product, GTM, and member experience on challenges that don't have an obvious owner. You'll find what's slowing us down and bring structure where it's needed.
Build how we measure the business: define the metrics that matter and build our reporting from the ground up. That includes business performance, product metrics, and the utilization reporting we share with customers and partners.
Test new ideas before we build them: develop the business case for new products, segments, and partnerships, and run small pilots to learn what works before we commit significant time and resources.
Design our operating stack: use the best tools and systems to get the job done, from spreadsheets and CRM data to AI, no-code tools, and conversations with customers.
 Who you are 
We're looking for someone who is high-agency, intellectually curious and comfortable getting their hands dirty. 
Have 4-6 years of experience, ideally in an early-stage startup, BizOps, Chief of Staff or founding-team role. The background matters less than the evidence that you can figure stuff out and get it done.
You've built something from zero before, whether a process, program, product, or function.
You're strong with numbers, including financial modelling and messy data. SQL is a bonus, not a requirement.
You demonstrate strong judgment when evaluating if something needs a deep dive or "good enough, let's test it" is the right answer to learn quickly
You use AI every day to research, analyze, and work more efficiently, and you're always looking for ways to use it better
You’re low-ego about the work and are equally happy developing strategy or running reports for partners if that's what the business needs
You're curious and passionate about family-building, healthcare, and the future of work. No industry experience is needed. We'll teach you the insurance and benefits landscape
 How we work 
Remote-first in Canada - work from anywhere in Canada, with access to our Toronto office
Async-friendly and outcome-focused - we care about what you accomplish, not whether you're online at a particular time
Small team with high ownership - you'll work closely with the founders and have visibility into almost every part of the company
Low ego, high standards - we care deeply about the quality of the work, but nobody is above doing the unglamorous parts
We use Slack, Google Workspace, Figma, HubSpot, GitHub and Linear to collaborate
 What we offer 
Competitive compensation + stock options: you'll have comprehensive health and wellness benefits, plus meaningful ownership in the company you're helping build
Unlimited vacation: we trust you to manage your time and take the time you need
Remote flexible: work from home or use our downtown Toronto office
Impactful work: your work will directly influence what Sprout builds, how we operate and where we go next
We aren’t just building a company; we’re creating a world where family-building is accessible to everyone. If you want to lead at the intersection of technology, health, and deeply human experiences, we’d love to meet you.

title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 
 An overview of this role 
As a Senior Revenue Operations Manager at GitLab, you'll own work the whole go-to-market organization relies on: the policies and processes that govern how we sell and book deals, our global forecasting process, and the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) operating cadence. You'll report to the Senior Manager, Sales Operations, and work closely with sales leadership, other Revenue Strategy & Operations teams, Finance, Deal Desk, Product, and Data.
This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll bring experience running a forecast process day to day and a practical understanding of how a sales organization works. You'll work independently to take a problem from "something looks off in the numbers" to a fix that sticks.
GitLab is all-remote, and most of our work happens in writing. Clear, concise documentation is a big part of this job.
 What you’ll do 
Own the policies that define how deals are booked, credited, and forecasted, including bookings rules, opportunity netting, and sales stages and exit criteria. Write them, get them approved, and make sure the field understands what changed and why.
Identify process problems before they affect the numbers. Validate and size the problem with data, find the root cause, and drive the fix with the right team, whether that's Revenue Systems, Deal Desk, Enablement, or compensation.
Partner with Revenue Systems to build policy into system rules, validations, and alerts, reducing manual reviews and after-the-fact corrections.
Improve forecast methodology by tracking actual results against the forecast, explaining variances, and changing processes that aren't working. Partner with Finance and Revenue Analytics to reconcile the field forecast with the finance outlook.
Own the weekly forecast readout for the CRO and sales leadership, keeping it short and focused on decisions. Bring the forecasting and policy perspective into annual planning.
Coordinate the CRO organization's weekly, monthly, and quarterly reviews, metrics, and follow-ups. Measure their impact on pipeline hygiene, data quality, forecast accuracy, and bookings, and change the cadence where it isn't working.
Work with other Revenue Strategy & Operations teams, Finance, Product, Data, and Enablement to deliver changes from the first draft through field adoption. Keep cadence documentation current so the organization knows what happens when, who owns it, and what's expected.
Mentor others on the team and improve how we document and run our processes.
 What you’ll bring 
Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, management consulting, or a similar role, including running a forecast process day to day in a business-to-business (B2B) subscription business.
A practical understanding of how a sales organization runs, including pipeline stages, deal bookings and crediting, bookings and annual recurring revenue (ARR) definitions, and how compensation influences sales representative behavior.
Strong data and analysis skills. You're highly proficient in Excel or Google Sheets, can build a model from scratch, and check your own numbers before sharing them.
The ability to work independently, identify what needs to be done, and work with stakeholders to get it done. You involve your manager when you need a decision or hit a blocker.
Clear, concise writing. You can turn a complex issue into a short document or Slack message that a senior leader will read and act on.
Comfort working with senior leaders, including taking feedback from a CRO and turning it into a better process or a more useful readout.
Systems thinking and the ability to learn new tools and domains quickly. You understand how customer relationship management (CRM), quoting, billing, and compensation systems connect, and how a change in one affects the others. How you think matters more to us than which forecasting tool you've used.
Helpful, but not required: experience rolling out bookings, crediting, or deal policies; forecasting consumption or usage-based revenue; using tools such as Clari and Salesforce reporting; or a consulting, strategy, or structured problem-solving background.
 About the team 
The Sales Strategy & Operations team sits within Revenue Strategy & Operations at GitLab. We're a small team working closely with Finance, Deal Desk, Revenue Systems, Revenue Analytics, and sales leadership. We work asynchronously first, keep our documents short, and focus on practical solutions that make the field's job easier.

Join CE&S and help us build a future where customers achieve their business outcomes faster with technology that does more.
Are you the tech-savvy, cloud loving person that has Cloud and IT Service Management blood running in their veins? Do you want to be that key person that helps our strategic enterprise customers to achieve the most with Microsoft products and services? Do you get your energy from helping your customers succeed in making their transformational cloud projects real?
As Customer Success Account Manager (CSAM), you are the primary delivery lead and a partner for our more strategic public sector customers , empowering them to achieve more by accelerating their value realization across our Digital Cloud platforms. By leveraging your technical expertise, business acumen and industry perspectives you will be responsible for the end-to-end post sales delivery and support orchestration across the Microsoft and Partner ecosystem to align the right resources at the right time to achieve customer business outcomes.
The CSAM role in the Customer Success Unit at Microsoft will allow you to accelerate your career growth, leverage your delivery management capabilities and deepen your cloud and industry expertise.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
 Please note the location for the position is Paddington, London. 
 Responsibilities 
Our CSAM’s are positioned and aligned with our customers as Chief Operating Officers or Customer Success Consultants ensuring that we have the appropriate level of engagement to support and drive value and change. As such you will work with some of the world’s largest public sector organisations pursuing strategic activities, utilising Microsoft technologies to modernise their business and to deliver better services to citizens.
We create an environment where you can do your best work and build a career both in the CSAM role as well as the wider Microsoft. As your interests and goals evolve we will enable you to connect you with a diverse, thriving community that can help you grow.
As a CSAM your key areas of responsibility will be:
Customer Relationship Management
You will nurture, establish, and expand relationships with key C-level customer stakeholders to enable clear understanding of customer priorities and goals to align quality solution planning, delivery execution and governance.
Customer Success Leadership – Consumption Leadership
De-risk and accelerate the delivery of Microsoft solutions and take ownership of team orchestration and coordination that accelerates production level consumption and customer adoption across all three clouds. Ensure there is alignment to top customer priorities to help our customers get value from their Microsoft investments and leverage support agreement to achieve their goals.
Customer Success Leadership – Customer Strategy and Growth
Engages with customers and demonstrates alignment between customer objectives and the current Microsoft portfolio of work in the customer account.
Aligns with the account team to link Customer Success Plans (CSPs) with account plan priorities and develop bookable programs of work.
Customer Success leadership - Delivery and program Management 
Leads the strategic execution of program planning and customer-facing program reviews, prioritization of engagements, and management of key stakeholder and executive expectations to address agreed-upon customer outcomes and account priorities to deliver ongoing customer success.
Customer Success Leadership - Customer Health
You will identify and assess customers’ critical services across our cloud platforms and work with customers to ensure that these services are healthy and resilient.
Technical Relevance
Develop technical competency across a breadth of Solution areas which supports customer advice, connecting their business goals to Microsoft solutions.
 Qualifications 
You will bring to us:
A passion for technology, driving customer value, strategic outcomes, while working with the best people in the industry.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
About Us 
 We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.  
 Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today! 
 Description 
Bueno (BUilt ENvironment Optimization) is a division of Copeland and a leader in Smart Building Analytics. The Bueno Platform and services connect to building equipment to identify issues, reduce energy consumption and optimize operations, helping businesses decarbonize their buildings.
At Bueno, listening and caring about our clients and partners is at the heart of what we do. We work in a complex ecosystem of stakeholders, incentives and constraints, and we give our teams the knowledge, tools and supportive environment to bring their true selves to work every day.
The Bueno and Verdant Partnership
Verdant by Copeland is a plug-and-play energy management offering that combines occupancy and thermal sensing, network connectivity and real-time analytics to cut heating and cooling waste in vacant rooms and shared spaces while preserving guest comfort. It serves hotels, senior living, student housing and multifamily properties, with more than 7,000 installed properties in North America ( Copeland ). Bueno and Verdant are building a joint offering for the hotel and hospitality market. This hire is the dedicated Customer Success lead for that partnership: the person who makes sure it works for hospitality customers, for Verdant's teams and for Bueno.
This role owns the success of Bueno's partnership with Verdant, another Copeland entity, and the hotel and hospitality customers that partnership serves. You will turn the Bueno Platform into a measurable part of how hotel owners, operators and management companies cut energy use, avoid equipment failures and hit sustainability targets, and you will be the day-to-day bridge between Bueno and Verdant teams.
As the Senior Customer Success Manager, you will: 
 Own the Verdant Partnership: Act as the primary Bueno counterpart for Verdant. Build a joint success plan, run regular working sessions with Verdant leadership, sales and delivery teams, and keep both organizations aligned on priorities, pipeline, deployments and outcomes.
 Build Strong Hospitality Relationships: Develop trusted relationships with hotel owners, asset managers, management companies and brand-level stakeholders, as well as general managers, chief engineers and facilities teams on property. Understand each group's goals, from guest comfort and operating cost to brand sustainability standards, and position Bueno as part of the solution.
 Create Seamless Onboarding Experiences: Lead onboarding of new hospitality portfolios and properties, working with sales, product, services and Verdant to move from signed agreement to live, valuable analytics quickly and with minimal disruption to hotel operations.
 Deliver Tailored Services and Support: Understand each property's equipment, operations and occupancy patterns, and deliver engineering analysis and reporting that solves real problems, such as HVAC and refrigeration faults, guest-room and central-plant energy waste, kitchen and cold-storage performance, and comfort complaints.
 Plan for Customer and Partner Success: Develop and execute success plans aligned with client and partner objectives. Identify adoption, expansion and cross-sell opportunities across portfolios, hand them to the account management team, and consistently demonstrate the value delivered.

title: Sales Operations Specialist
description:
**JOIN A COMPANY THAT’S GOING PLACES** 
We are seeking a Sales Operations Specialist to take ownership of the systems, processes, and insights that support our sales team.
Your mandate is to help our sales representatives stay organized, focus on the right opportunities, and convert more leads into business. You will manage our existing sales operations while identifying and implementing improvements that strengthen accountability, productivity, and sales performance.
HubSpot will be central to your work. We recently introduced a lead pipeline generator and activated HubSpot’s prospecting agent. You will help turn that prospecting activity into a consistent, measurable sales process, ensuring leads are qualified, assigned, followed up on, and moved through the pipeline.
This role requires someone who can manage the details, understand the data, and turn findings into practical improvements.
**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**
* Company Vehicle
* Sales Commission Plan
* Extended Health & Dental Benefits
* Flexible Health Spending Account
* Employee Family Assistance Program
* Wealth Benefits – Group Matching RRSP.
* Generous Paid Time Off Program
* Company closure between Christmas and New Year.
* Competitive Wages
* Exciting Career Progression Paths
* Making a difference in our communities
**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
**HubSpot and Pipeline Ownership**
* Own day-to-day HubSpot administration, including contact and company records, deal pipelines, workflows, reporting, and automation.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and organized CRM data, including managing duplicates, enrichment, ownership, and record consistency.
* Establish and maintain clear standards for lead qualification, deal stages, required information, and next steps.
* Ensure new leads reach the appropriate sales representative and receive timely follow-up.
* Monitor our lead generation tools and HubSpot prospecting agent, assessing the quality and progression of generated leads.
* Work with our AI and technical team to troubleshoot workflows, improve lead enrichment and routing, and verify that automations produce accurate records and appropriate follow-up tasks.
**Sales Team Organization and Accountability**
* Establish a consistent rhythm for pipeline reviews, opportunity updates, and follow-up.
* Help sales representatives prioritize prospecting, active opportunities, and overdue actions.
* Identify stalled deals, missing information, and missed follow-ups, and work with representatives and sales leadership to address them.
* Ensure active opportunities have a clear owner, current status, and documented next step.
* Train and support the team on HubSpot, sales processes, and CRM expectations.
* Reinforce consistent adoption of agreed processes and provide leadership with visibility into gaps requiring attention.
**Analytics and Conversion Improvement**
* Build and maintain dashboards that show lead volume, response times, sales activity, pipeline progression, and conversion rates.
* Track conversion at each stage, from initial lead through qualification, quoting, and closed business.
* Analyze performance by lead source, representative, and business line.
* Assess lead quality and identify where opportunities stall or fall out of the pipeline.
* Investigate lost opportunities and identify patterns that can inform better qualification, outreach, and follow-up.
* Recommend practical improvements, implement agreed changes, and measure their impact.
* Present findings and recommended actions clearly to sales leadership.
**Process Improvement and Sales Productivity**
* Manage, document, and improve existing sales processes.
* Reduce manual administrative work through practical workflows and automation.
* Identify successful sales practices and turn them into repeatable processes the team can adopt.
* Clearly document automation requirements and collaborate with technical teams to implement and validate solutions.
* Improve information flow and handoffs between sales and other teams.
* Evaluate whether new tools and process changes improve follow-through, productivity, and conversion.

Monitor portfolio health signals and direct team effort toward the accounts where intervention changes the outcome.

title: Senior Manager, Strategic Operations
description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.
 About 1Password
 At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.
 If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.
 As part of 1Password’s Strategic Operations team, you’ll lead cross-functional initiatives that turn complex business priorities into clear plans, coordinated execution, and measurable results. You’ll work with senior leaders and teams across the company to advance priorities such as international expansion, high-priority customer programs, corporate crisis management, and planning. By helping the organization execute with greater clarity and consistency, you’ll contribute to 1Password’s mission of making security simpler and more accessible. Reporting into the Director, Strategic Operations, this role is remote in the United States or Canada.
 How We’re Using AI Today
 On the Strategic Operations team, we’re using AI to cut through complexity, stay aligned, and move quickly. AI supports how we manage and execute programs by bringing together signals from across the business and turning them into decision-ready summaries, project plans, and executive briefs. We expect every team member to build at least one AI-powered workflow, and we’re committed to growing together through shared best practices, regular learning sessions, and team resources as we scale and collaborate across 1Password.
This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.
 What We're Looking For
 7–9+ years of experience in strategic operations, business operations, program management, or a related field, with a track record of delivering complex initiatives.
 Experience leading cross-functional programs and influencing senior or executive stakeholders without direct authority.
 Strong ability to translate broad objectives into practical plans, roadmaps, decisions, and measurable outcomes.
 Sound judgment and confidence working through ambiguity, resolving dependencies, and constructively challenging assumptions when needed.
 Strong analytical, communication, and presentation skills, including the ability to turn data into clear recommendations and concise status updates.

 Experience in Software as a Service (SaaS), cybersecurity, technology, product operations, or a similarly fast-moving environment, along with experience using Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools or workflow automation to improve operational efficiency.
 What You Can Expect

 Bring teams together to resolve blockers, align priorities, manage change, and deliver shared outcomes.
 Use modern tools, including AI-assisted analysis and workflow automation, to generate insights, identify risks and dependencies, and scale program execution.
USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $171,000 USD and $248,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.
Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $147,000 CAD and $213,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.
At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.
 This posting is for an existing vacancy.
 Our culture 
 At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.
You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.
 How We Work With AI
 We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.
This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.
 Our approach to remote work 
 We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.
 What We Offer
 We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:
 Health and wellbeing
 👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

🌎 Remote-first work environment
Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.
 You belong here.
 1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status.  Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

 We're looking for a curious, commercially sharp CRM & Revenue Operations Analyst to join our growing RevOps function. This is a dual-natured role: on one side, hands-on CRM administration and data stewardship within a collaborative team; on the other, a broader remit that spans the full commercial journey — from Marketing through Sales to Customer Success — ensuring the processes, tools, and data that connect them are coherent, reliable, and built to support business growth.
You'll work closely with our Revenue Operations Manager, based in Copenhagen, and collaborate with market teams, sales and marketing stakeholders, and internal IT across all 14 markets. – Experience supporting tool integrations or working alongside IT on system connectivity
– Exposure to multi-market or international business environments
– A track record of creating structured training content or process documentation
– Background in B2B services, IT staffing, or professional consultancy

– Direct mentorship from an experienced Revenue Operations Manager with deep HubSpot and systems expertise
– Broad exposure to a modern RevOps toolstack and clear room to grow — technically and strategically
– A hybrid working setup with real autonomy and flexibility, based in one of our office locations across our 14 markets

title: Senior Customer Success Manager (Americas)
description:
RemotePass exists because talent is distributed equally, but opportunity is not. Backed by EBRD and trusted by 800+ companies across 150+ countries, RemotePass is the platform that gives businesses the infrastructure to hire anyone, anywhere - and gives workers in emerging markets the financial tools and global access they deserve.
RemotePass is the only platform that combines Employer of Record, contractor management, direct employment, and corporate spend cards in a single product - rated 4.8/5 on G2, trusted by Spotify, Logitech, and Deloitte, and operating across 150+ countries.
We are backed by leading global investors, including Oraseya Capital, Endeavor Catalyst, Khwarizmi Ventures, Flyer One Ventures, Access Bridge Ventures, A15, Swiss Founders Fund, and Plug & Play.
 Overview 
As we expand into the US and Americas market, we are looking for a passionate Senior Customer Success Manager to join our growing team and help us build lasting relationships with our US and Americas customers. This role is open to candidates anywhere in the world, provided you're able to work US Eastern Time (EST) hours.
As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will play a critical role in ensuring our customers achieve their goals using RemotePass's platform. You will act as a strategic advisor and advocate for our customers, helping them maximize the value of our services. With your expertise, you will foster strong partnerships and drive customer satisfaction, retention, and growth.
Responsibilities
 Seamless Onboarding: Guide new customers through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth transition and quick adoption of RemotePass.
S trategic Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong connections with key stakeholders, acting as a trusted partner to help them achieve their goals.
 Customer Advocacy: Serve as the primary contact for customers, addressing inquiries and ensuring swift resolution of issues.
 Proactive Account Management: Monitor account health and engage customers to identify and implement opportunities for enhancement and growth.
 Insight-Driven Feedback: Collect and analyze customer feedback to provide actionable insights that shape product development.
 Retention and Growth Leadership : Drive customer loyalty and uncover opportunities for upselling or cross-selling RemotePass services.
 Cross-department Collaboration: Collaborate with Sales, Operations, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience while supporting growth and retention objectives.
 Value Optimization: Foster business growth and profitability by ensuring customers realize the full value of RemotePass's services.
Requirements
5+ years of experience in a Customer Success, Account Management, or related role — ideally within EOR, HR-Tech, Payroll, or Global Employment platforms.
Proven experience owning the full client lifecycle (onboarding through renewal and expansion), not just a single stage of the customer journey.
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.
Proven ability to build strong customer relationships and drive customer satisfaction.
Analytical mindset with the ability to gather insights from data to make informed decisions.
Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Comfortable working US Eastern Time (EST) hours, regardless of your physical location.
Experience in SaaS or HR/Payroll/Global Employment solutions is strongly preferred.
Benefits
Be part of a fast-growing global company revolutionizing remote work management.
Work in a collaborative and inclusive environment that values innovation and creativity.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
Competitive, uncapped variable compensation tied directly to the accounts you grow.

title: Global Business Operations Manager
description:
Job Requirements
 Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.
 Global Business Operations Manager
 The Global Business Operations Manager is aligned to an assigned zone comprising multiple countries and serves as the primary business liaison between global Commercial Excellence and zone and country organizations. The role ensures coordinated adoption, governance, and execution of CRM-related processes, sales operating standards, data governance requirements, and commercial initiatives across the zone.
The GBOM partners with zone leaders and country-level roles to translate global standards into coordinated zone priorities and practical country execution, while ensuring common needs, local requirements, risks, and adoption barriers are represented in governance forums and transformation programs.
The role steers execution across the assigned zone by aligning country plans, consolidating priorities and performance insights, reinforcing clear ownership and consistent operating routines, and coordinating cross-country action and escalation to achieve zone and country business goals.
 Key Responsibilities
 Zone Operating Model & Country Execution
Translate global CRM business standards into a coordinated zone operating model and clear country-level execution expectations, including required fields, process steps, ownership rules, and reporting routines.
Establish and maintain a zone governance cadence with zone and country stakeholders to review adoption, data quality, pipeline hygiene, forecasting discipline, priorities, dependencies, and open risks across assigned countries.
Align country execution plans to zone priorities and global standards while documenting approved local deviations, rationale, owners, effective dates, and required approvals.
Coordinate with zone leadership, country CRM support, Sales Operations, and Commercial Excellence teams to clarify handoffs, decision rights, accountability, and shared actions required to achieve zone and country goals.
 Zone Governance & Country Representation
Serve as the primary Commercial Excellence representative for an assigned zone and its constituent countries.
Act as the key point of contact connecting global CRM and governance organizations with zone leaders and designated country-level roles.
Coordinate communication and deployment of global commercial policies, governance standards, and process changes across the zone, supporting consistent execution in each country.
Consolidate country feedback, adoption barriers, business risks, and local requirements into a zone perspective for representation in global governance forums.
Maintain visibility to zone objectives and country priorities, readiness, performance, decision needs, and implementation dependencies; coordinate action plans and escalations with the appropriate zone and country owners.
 CRM & Process Adoption
Drive adoption of standardized sales processes and CRM practices.
Monitor adherence to opportunity management, customer engagement, forecasting, and funnel management standards.
Partner with zone commercial leadership and country sales leaders to address adoption gaps, process compliance issues, and shared performance goals.
 CRM Data Quality & Pipeline Discipline
Monitor completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and consistency of key CRM data fields across the assigned zone and its countries.
Partner with zone and country teams to resolve duplicate records, inactive or expired funnel, missing ownership, territory mismatches, and other CRM data quality issues.
Reinforce standards for account ownership, territory alignment, opportunity stage progression, close-date maintenance, forecasting inputs, and customer engagement documentation.
Coordinate zone and country action plans to improve pipeline hygiene and enable reliable business reviews, forecasting, and commercial performance reporting.
 Business Requirements Management
Collect, consolidate, and document zone-wide and country-specific business requirements.
Assess alignment among country needs, zone priorities, and global standards, identifying opportunities for common solutions across countries.
Coordinate zone-level prioritization and escalation of enhancement requests with country stakeholders.
Coordinate review and approval of zone- and country-driven process changes.
 Exception & Change Control Management
Manage intake, triage, and documentation of country exception requests related to CRM processes, business rules, data standards, and operating procedures.
Assess business impact, cross-country scalability, compliance considerations, and downstream reporting implications before escalating exceptions for approval.
Maintain traceability of approved deviations and ensure they are reviewed periodically for continued relevance or harmonization back to the global standard.
 Zone & Country Readiness and Change Management
Coordinate rollout of CRM capabilities, governance initiatives, and business process changes across the assigned zone.
Work with zone and country stakeholders to coordinate training, communication, and awareness activities.
Monitor readiness across the zone and identify country-level gaps, dependencies, and support needs for new capabilities and transformations.
Confirm country readiness against defined launch criteria and consolidate the results into a zone readiness view, including data readiness, business owner assignment, process documentation, training completion, and support model alignment.
Coordinate post-launch stabilization with zone and country roles by tracking issue volume, adoption gaps, training needs, and open decisions until countries reach steady-state operations.
 Performance Monitoring
Track adoption and governance metrics at both zone and country levels.
Analyze CRM utilization and performance trends across countries to identify shared improvement opportunities and country-specific needs.
Coordinate remediation plans with zone and country owners for markets with low adoption or compliance metrics.
Prepare consolidated zone scorecards and country-level management summaries covering CRM adoption, data quality, pipeline hygiene, forecasting discipline, and remediation progress.
Identify recurring issues across countries and propose zone or global process, training, reporting, or system improvements to prevent repeat gaps.
 Stakeholder Engagement
Build strong relationships across zone leadership, country commercial and CRM teams, CRM Excellence, Data & Analytics, and IT and Digital teams.
Facilitate structured feedback loops among global, zone, and country teams, ensuring decisions, actions, and accountability are cascaded across levels.
Bring zone and country stakeholders together around shared priorities, cross-country dependencies, and coordinated plans to achieve business goals.

Vector transforms logistics networks into a competitive advantage for shippers and 3PL’s by digitizing driver engagement, optimizing yard orchestration, and digitizing documents such as BOL’s and Seals. Revenue Operations at Vector owns how we understand and grow revenue. title: GTM Strategy & Operations

Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

Customer lifecycle improvements
Quote-to-Cash transformation
Revenue technology implementations

 Experience That Could Make You Successful

Product or Engineering partnership

 What Success Looks Like

Turn ambiguous business priorities into clear, executable plans.

Drive timely decisions and maintain momentum across cross-functional teams.
Build trust with both business and technical stakeholders.

 Who You Are 
You are highly organized without being overly process-driven. You are comfortable walking into an initiative where not everything has been figured out yet and helping the team establish a path forward.
You ask good questions, learn unfamiliar areas quickly, and understand when to facilitate, when to challenge, and when to escalate. You are equally comfortable working with detailed project teams and communicating with senior leadership.

 Compensation and Values

title: Senior Business Operations Manager
description:
What We’re All About.
 Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients across all industries with an initial focus on insurance to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.
 We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.
 The Senior Business Operations Manager is responsible for improving the operational structure, reporting and day-to-day governance that help the business run efficiently and consistently. This is a Senior Manager role: it requires strong, varied operational experience, the ability to lead medium-to-large or more complex cross-functional initiatives with some oversight, and the judgement to make well-reasoned recommendations that balance impact, risk and practicality. The role combines revenue operations, business analysis, process improvement, and quality management as part of a broader business operations remit. It works closely with the Head of Operations, the wider Operations function, the Go-To-Market team, and company-wide stakeholders to turn business priorities into clear processes, reliable reporting and practical operational improvements.
 Key Responsibilities
 Revenue operations and Salesforce
Maintain and improve the revenue operations framework across GTM, including pipeline governance, forecasting cadence, sales process discipline and commercial reporting.
Your team acts as the business owner for Salesforce and connected revenue systems, ensuring they support current, often high stakes, operating needs, data quality and consistent adoption.
Support on integration and usage of other relevant systems and how they form the process, such as Planhat and Clari.
Define, monitor and interpret key commercial metrics such as bookings, recurring revenue, conversion rates, deal cycle, retention, productivity and forecast accuracy. Drive data consistency in both usage and interpretation across teams as it relates to measuring commercial health.
Document core processes, workflows and data definitions so commercial reporting remains reliable and easy to maintain in Confluence.
Train and support users to drive consistent usage, reduce process friction and improve reporting confidence.
 PowerBI, reporting and analysis
Develop and maintain PowerBI dashboards and operational reporting packs for leadership and functional teams.
Respond to analysis requests from across the business, clarifying the business question, sourcing the right data and presenting clear, actionable findings.
Build reporting that helps the business understand performance, diagnose issues and make decisions with confidence.
Improve data consistency, definitions and reporting processes across teams.
Use analysis to support business cases, process changes, investment decisions and operational priorities.
 Operational excellence and process improvement
Design, document and improve business processes so they are scalable, efficient and easy to follow. This could be across a wide range of areas, from Alliances, Marketing, Procurement, and more.
Define and lead medium-to-large cross-functional operational projects from diagnosis through to implementation and adoption, with appropriate oversight from senior leaders.
Proactively identify bottlenecks, duplication, control gaps and opportunities for improvement within Operations and across related functions, then recommend practical solutions that reduce cost, risk or manual effort. Provide support to implement these recommendations.
Establish operating rhythms, review cadences and governance forums that create accountability and visibility across the business.
Support change management by communicating the context, purpose and value of work clearly, engaging stakeholders and embedding new ways of working.
 ISO9001 and quality management
Own the ongoing maintenance of ISO9001 accreditation and ensure the quality management system remains effective, current and audit-ready.
Coordinate internal audits, external assessments, corrective actions and continuous improvement activity.
Maintain quality documentation, process controls, evidence records and governance materials.
Work with process owners to ensure quality standards are embedded into day-to-day business operations.
Track non-conformities, risks and improvement actions through to completion.
 People leadership and team development
Define and align team goals with the Operations direction, setting clear expectations and holding the team accountable for delivery.
Manage workload, priorities, performance and an allocated team budget where applicable, balancing multiple high-priority deadlines and responding calmly to unexpected risks or issues.
Build capability within the team through regular feedback, mentorship, development planning and knowledge sharing, with limited people growth decisions made with supervisory approval.
Create a motivating, cohesive and engaging team environment by providing context, making clear decisions and ensuring feedback and priorities are transparent.
Promote cross-functional collaboration by documenting knowledge, sharing learnings and building trusted relationships with peers and stakeholders.
 Skills And Experience
Strong, varied experience in business operations, revenue operations, sales operations, commercial operations or a similar role, typically including 3-5 years of management experience.
Strong Salesforce ownership or administration experience, with the ability to translate business needs into practical system and process requirements.
Confident with PowerBI reporting and data visualisation capability, with strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
Commercial awareness and confidence working with revenue, pipeline, forecasting and performance data.
Experience defining and leading medium-to-large cross-functional projects or initiatives, managing senior stakeholders independently and navigating ambiguity with sound judgement.
Understanding of ISO9001, quality management systems, audit preparation and continuous improvement principles.
People management experience, including coaching, prioritisation, performance management and team development.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data or process issues clearly to different audiences.
Organised, pragmatic and resilient, with the ability to balance strategic priorities with hands-on delivery, say no constructively where needed and keep a solutions-focused approach.
 Our mission.
 We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.
 It’s All About You.
 We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q . We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.
We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.
 No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.
