title: Senior Go-to-Market Insights Analyst
description:
Location: Atlanta, GA - Hybrid; Denver, CO - Hybrid; New York, NY - Hybrid; San Francisco, CA - Hybrid; Scottsdale, AZ - Hybrid; Toronto, Ontario - Remote
 Department: Revenue Operations
About Gusto
At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.
All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.
AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.
About the Role
The Senior GTM Insights Analyst is the strategic and analytical backbone of Gusto's GTM organization. You will partner directly with GTM leadership to shape business strategy, own the analytics infrastructure and serve as the connective tissue between Finance, GTM Operations, GTM leadership, and Product/Growth. You'll build and defend the end-to-end view of how our GTM organization is designed, how our sales processes perform, and how changes to the business (new products, pricing, org design, market shifts) ripple through the organization and revenue outcomes.
Where other RevOps leaders own the operational engine & execution you own the strategic and analytical through-line that cuts across all of them, translating what's happening across every motion into a single, coherent narrative leadership can act on, and translating, positioning, and reporting business decisions directly to the Head of GTM for the entirety of the org.
This is a high-visibility leadership role embedded in Revenue Operations, partnering directly with the Head of GTM, Finance, Product, Growth, and every GTM route-to-market leader.
About the Team
You'll join the Revenue Operations organization at Gusto. RevOps at Gusto owns the machine: the infrastructure, systems, and operational execution that make our GTM motions possible.
You'll be a peer to the RevOps leaders aligned to each route to market along with Sales Compensation, Sales Enablement, and GTM Systems & Tooling, but your remit cuts horizontally across all of them rather than sitting inside one. The best version of this role is fluent in the mechanics of every motion without being married to any one of them, and leans into those partnerships to build one shared picture of the business rather than several competing ones.
Here's what you'll do day-to-day
 Strategy & Business Partnership 
Partner directly with the Head of GTM, Head of Revenue Ops, GTM leadership & I&O to shape business strategy, translating ambiguous strategic questions into structured analysis leadership can act on.
Serve as the primary conduit between Finance, GTM Operations, and GTM leadership, translating financial targets into operational plans, and operational reality back into financial forecasts.
Build the end-to-end view of the sales process across every route to market so leadership always has one coherent picture of how the business functions & performs
Represent GTM in cross-functional conversations with Product and Growth, ensuring changes to product, pricing, or packaging are understood in terms of their downstream impact on pipeline, quota, and rep behavior before they ship. Partnering directly with your RevOps peers to execute new sales motions or change existing sales processes & behaviors.
 Analytics & Reporting Infrastructure 
Partner with Revenue Analytics to build the core analytics and reporting infrastructure the GTM org relies on, defining the metrics, definitions, and data sources that leadership trusts as the single source of truth.
Design and maintain the recurring reporting cadence (weekly/monthly/quarterly business reviews) that keeps the Head of GTM and their leadership team decision-ready.
Partner with Revenue Analytics, GTM Systems & Tooling, and Finance to ensure the analytics layer scales as new routes to market, products, and motions are added.
Build forward-looking models (scenario planning, what-if analysis) that quantify how a proposed business decision would change outcomes and expectations before it's made.
 Translation & Executive Communication 
Translate business decisions (org changes, comp plan updates, territory redesigns, product launches) into clear positioning and narrative for the Head of GTM and the broader GTM org.
Own executive-level reporting directly to the Head of GTM, distilling complex, cross-functional inputs into a small number of decisions and recommendations.
Partner with Finance to act as the trusted second read on any major GTM decision, pressure-testing assumptions and identifying where a proposed change will create winners, losers, or unintended consequences across routes to market.
 Cross-Functional Alignment 
Build and maintain trusted relationships with Finance, Product, Growth, and every GTM lead, so GTM strategy reflects input from, and stays aligned with, the rest of the business.
Identify where routes to market should operate consistently and where they genuinely need to diverge, and make that judgment visible to leadership rather than letting it get decided ad hoc, motion by motion.
Here's what we're looking for
8+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Sales Operations, Strategy, or a strategy/analytics function within a SaaS or subscription business, with direct exposure to senior sales or GTM leadership.
Proven experience acting as a strategic partner to senior GTM leadership, not just an analyst producing reports on request, but someone who shapes the questions being asked.
Deep fluency in building and owning analytics and reporting infrastructure end-to-end, including defining metrics and data sources that become the org's source of truth.
Track record of translating complex, cross-functional inputs (Finance, Product, Ops) into clear executive narrative and recommendations.
Experience partnering across Finance, Product, and GTM Ops, with the credibility to influence decisions in each.
Strong analytical foundation: comfortable building financial/operational models, auditing assumptions, and explaining them in plain English to senior leaders.
AI fluency is required: you actively use AI tools to automate workflows, accelerate analysis, and prototype operational solutions.
Clear, credible communication style: you can influence without authority, hold the line in escalations, and present confidently to senior GTM leaders.
Familiarity with multi-segment or multi-motion GTM orgs (Direct, Indirect, or similar) strongly preferred.
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Compensation
Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $130,000 - $160,000/yr in Denver, Atlanta, and Scottsdale, $155,000 - $185,000/yr in San Francisco and New York, and $150,000 - $180,000 CAD/yr for Toronto. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.
Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.
Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.
When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.
Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.
Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
About Definitive Healthcare : 
 At Definitive Healthcare (NASDAQ: DH), we’re passionate about turning data, analytics, and expertise into meaningful intelligence that helps our customers achieve success and shape the future of healthcare. We empower them to uncover the right markets, opportunities, and people—paving the way for smarter decisions and greater impact. 
 Headquartered just outside of Boston, Massachusetts, Definitive Healthcare operates across North America, Europe, and India, supporting a growing global client base of more than 2,400 customers since our founding in 2011. 
 We’re also a great place to work. In 2024 and 2025, we earned multiple workplace honors, including Built In’s 100 Best Places to Work in Boston (both years), a Stevie Bronze Award for Great Employers, and recognition as a Great Place to Work in India.
 We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture where diverse perspectives drive innovation. Through programs like DefinitiveCares and our employee-led affinity groups we strive to promote connection, education, and inclusion. 
 About the position: 
The Senior Customer Success Manager owns the end-to-end customer experience and net dollar retention (NDR) for a portfolio of enterprise life sciences customers at Definitive Healthcare. Serving as the primary post-sale point of contact, this role drives product adoption, documents measurable ROI, and directly influences renewal and expansion outcomes. The Senior CSM combines a structured, value-selling methodology with deep life sciences industry knowledge to connect data adoption to business outcomes customers can see and quantify, coordinating across Commercial, Medical, Market Access, Marketing, R&D, and HEOR teams within assigned accounts. Operating as a credible, strategic counterpart to customer C-suite stakeholders, the role carries direct accountability for a $5M+ enterprise book of business and a 95%+ NDR target. Success in this role is measured by renewal rates, expansion revenue, and the strength of documented ROI across the portfolio. 
 What you'll do:

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Revenue Operations Manager based in Canada.
 We are looking for a hands-on Revenue Operations Manager to build and scale the revenue infrastructure for a new Home & Auto insurance business unit from the ground up. In this role, you will own the design and implementation of CRM systems, sales processes, reporting frameworks, and operational workflows that support customer acquisition and retention. You will serve as the primary owner of HubSpot, developing scalable system architecture, automations, integrations, and data governance practices. Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations, you will transform evolving business needs into practical processes and actionable insights. You will also establish reliable performance metrics, improve visibility across the customer lifecycle, and ensure that system changes are adopted effectively. This is an exciting opportunity for a proactive builder who thrives in a fast-paced, remote-first environment and enjoys creating structure, driving operational excellence, and influencing business growth.
Accountabilities
Revenue systems ownership: Administer, maintain, and continuously improve HubSpot CRM, including objects, properties, pipelines, workflows, automations, permissions, validation rules, and reporting. 
CRM architecture and data governance: Establish scalable CRM standards covering naming conventions, property design, object associations, required fields, lifecycle stages, data quality, and duplicate record management. 
System administration and support: Manage user access, permissions, provisioning, and system governance. Monitor system health, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate resolutions with vendors and technical partners. 
Customer lifecycle optimization: Design and improve lead routing, pipeline stages, lifecycle definitions, customer handoffs, and data governance processes to create a consistent and efficient customer journey. 
Workflow automation and integrations: Build automations that reduce manual work and improve operational consistency. Manage integrations and data flows between HubSpot, Five9, Front, and other business systems. 
Reporting and business intelligence: Develop and maintain dashboards that provide visibility into pipeline performance, conversion rates, retention, productivity, and customer activity. 
Forecasting and operational planning: Support forecasting, business planning, territory analysis, customer segmentation, capacity planning, and compensation analysis through reliable data and reporting. 
Data-driven decision-making: Partner with functional leaders to define key performance indicators, improve data confidence, identify emerging trends and risks, and translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations. 
Cross-functional requirements gathering: Work with stakeholders to understand business needs, evaluate potential solutions, and recommend approaches that balance business impact, technical feasibility, and operational effort. 
Change management and implementation: Plan, test, document, and launch system updates with clear communication and appropriate change-management support. Monitor adoption and outcomes, then refine solutions based on user feedback and business performance. 
Documentation and training: Create and maintain process documentation, system guides, and training materials that help teams adopt consistent workflows and use systems effectively. 
Continuous improvement: Identify friction across revenue operations, build trusted relationships with stakeholders, and deliver scalable improvements that support the new business unit and the wider revenue organization. 
 Requirements
Professional experience: At least 5 years of experience in Revenue Operations, CRM administration, Business Systems, Sales Operations, or a related field. 
HubSpot expertise: Strong hands-on experience administering HubSpot CRM in a growing or complex organization. 
CRM systems and automation: Demonstrated experience designing and managing CRM workflows, automations, integrations, user permissions, reporting, and data governance practices. 
Analytical and troubleshooting skills: Strong ability to investigate system issues, analyze data, identify process inefficiencies, and develop practical solutions. 
Project and change management: Experience gathering business requirements, testing system changes, managing releases, documenting technical processes, and supporting implementation and adoption. 
Reporting and spreadsheet proficiency: Strong spreadsheet and reporting skills, including the ability to transform incomplete or inconsistent data into clear, actionable insights. 
Technical communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and system changes to non-technical stakeholders. 
Collaboration and influence: Ability to build productive relationships across teams, influence stakeholders without relying on formal authority, and work effectively in a collaborative environment. 
Attention to detail: High standards for data quality, accuracy, documentation, and system reliability. 
Practical mindset: A proactive, solutions-oriented approach, with a willingness to take ownership, move quickly, and build processes where established structures may not yet exist. 
 Nice-to-have Qualifications
Knowledge of or experience in the insurance industry. 
Experience supporting Five9, Front, Confluence, and Jira. 
HubSpot Administrator certification or equivalent practical experience. 
Familiarity with SQL, data modeling, APIs, webhooks, JSON, or workflow automation. 
Experience with business intelligence platforms such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI. 
Experience in CRM release management, integration monitoring, or business systems support. 
 Benefits
Competitive compensation: Total target cash compensation of CAD $110,000–$150,000, depending on experience.

Comprehensive benefits: A comprehensive benefits plan with premiums fully paid by the employer.

Collaborative culture: Join a high-performing, low-ego team focused on innovation, teamwork, and improving the customer experience.

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
Pomelo Care is the leading virtual medical practice for women and children, providing care across pregnancy, postpartum, pediatrics, menopause, and perimenopause. We combine proactive, 24/7 clinical care with technology that helps us reach patients earlier, identify risks sooner, and deliver personalized care throughout their journey. Our team includes clinicians, technologists, operators, and problem-solvers working together to make high-quality care more accessible for families nationwide.
About the role
We are hiring for a Revenue Operations Manager to own the data, systems, and analysis behind how we plan and grow revenue. You will work directly with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance leaders, and you will be trusted to find the important questions yourself, not only answer the ones you are handed.
AI is changing how operations work gets done. We want someone who is already building with it and is eager to bring that into how our revenue team runs.
This role reports to the Head of Strategic Finance and can be based anywhere in the continental U.S. 
 What you'll do 
Own revenue reporting and dashboards. Build and maintain the dashboards leaders use to run the business: pipeline, forecast, conversion, retention, and rep performance.
Run analysis end to end. Scope the question, pull the data via SFDC or SQL, do the analysis, and present a clear conclusion and recommendation.
Manage our tech stack. Maintain and improve how our teams use tools (Outreach, Clay, Gong, etc.), driving adoption, efficiency, and insight gathering.
Build with AI. Find manual, repetitive, or slow parts of the revenue process and build AI-powered workflows, agents, or tools that fix them. Help the wider go-to-market team adopt what works.
Improve the funnel. Spot where deals stall or leak between stages and teams, and work with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to fix it.
Keep the data trustworthy. Own CRM data quality, metric definitions, and the processes that keep our numbers consistent across teams.
Be a partner to leadership. Bring insights to revenue leaders before they ask, and tell them plainly what the data does and does not support.
Ad hoc analyses and projects as needed
 Who you are 
You have 4+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, or a similar analytical role, and you understand how a B2B funnel works ideally in telehealth
Excited about AI and eager to build. You have built with AI in a professional or personal setting, such as an automation, an agent, an internal tool, or a side project, and you can walk us through what you made and what you learned.
Fluent in CRM data. You have worked hands-on with Salesforce, HubSpot, or a similar CRM and know where its data goes wrong.
A strong analyst. You can run an analysis on your own from raw data to recommendation, and you are careful about whether the numbers are right.
Comfortable in SQL and familiar with BI tools (Metabase, Hex, SFDC).
A clear communicator. You explain findings simply to non-technical stakeholders and are willing to push back when the data disagrees with the room.
 Why you should join our team 
By joining Pomelo, you will get in on the ground floor of a fast-moving, well-funded, and mission-driven startup that always puts the patient first. You will learn, grow and be challenged, and have fun with your team while doing it.
We strive to create an environment where employees from all backgrounds are respected. We value working across disciplines, moving fast, data-driven decision making, learning, and always putting the patient first.
Benefits and perks
Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision coverage for employees and their families
High deductible Health Plans with Health Savings Account (HSA) options
Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
Equity grant participation
401(k) program
Competitive vacation policy
16 weeks paid parental leave
Fully remote work flexibility (within the US)
 Compensation 
The expected base salary range offered for this role is $145,000 - $165,000. This role is also eligible for equity, giving you an ownership stake in Pomelo’s mission. Actual compensation may vary based on relevant experience, skills, competencies, and certifications.
We are committed to hiring the best team to improve outcomes for all mothers and babies. To solve the complex challenges facing the diverse population we serve, we need diverse perspectives, actively welcoming people of all races, ages, sexual orientations, gender identities and expressions, national origins, religions, disabilities, and veteran statuses. We strive to cultivate an inclusive and respectful environment where team members thrive by working across disciplines, moving fast, making data driven decisions, learning continuously, and always putting the patient first.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
At Chift , we're building the financial integration layer for software companies and AI agents.
Founded in 2022, Chift is a Series A scaleup backed by strong investors, already working with hundreds of B2B SaaS, including public companies and many unicorns 🦄
Our platform helps B2B software companies and AI agents to connect with financial tools easily. Thanks to a unified API, our clients are able to connect with dozens of financial software at once, instead of spending years building integrations themselves.
Our clients are some of the biggest fintechs in Europe such as Qonto, Pennylane, Wise, Revolut, Square, and many others.
Our ambition: become the European leader of financial integration 🚀
 Tasks 
We're hiring our first GTM Engineer to industrialize Chift's revenue engine. Our marketing team creates demand through events, content, SEO and webinars. The sales team turns demand into revenue. Your job is everything in between: capturing every signal we generate, qualifying it with AI, routing it to the right person at the right time, and giving the whole revenue org a data-driven backbone.
And you don't just wire the pipeline, you help fill it. You're always launching: shipping new lead magnets, dedicated campaigns for every event, and on-the-ground plays (booth activations, expert dinners, meetups) that create demand, before feeding them straight back into the machine.
You'll work closely with the CEO, Head of Operations, the sales team, and our marketing function, and you'll have direct ownership over the systems that fill our pipeline.
Here are some non-exhaustive tasks: 
 Build the outbound machine. Design and run multi-channel outbound sequences that book qualified meetings with European fintech and SaaS leaders. You'll own the tooling stack (Clay, LaGrowthMachine, HubSpot), the data, the messaging, and the handoff to our AEs.
 Always Be Launching. You imagine new ways of engaging our prospects and you’re always on the hunt for new ideas. Organizing expert dinners, creating new landing pages for a certain type of customers, imagine new ideas to book meeting at a business fair, …
 Be the bridge between marketing and sales. AEs get warm, contextual leads with all the info they need to close. Everything sales learns flows back into how we target the next batch. You're the person making that loop tight and fast.
 Own the revenue data backbone. Pipeline dashboards, multi-touch attribution, conversion rates by stage, cost per qualified meeting, channel ROI. You bring data discipline to weekly revenue reviews and you're the person leadership turns to when they want to know what's actually working.
 Make every AE 5x more effective with AI . Build agents everywhere. Our sales team should only focus on selling, while you’re automating their pipeline and admin.
 Requirements 
 Experience: +2 years in growth, RevOps, marketing operations, or as a GTM Engineer in B2B SaaS.
 GTM stack fluency: Comfortable with the modern growth stack (HubSpot, Clay, Make/n8n, etc). You don't need to know all of them, but you should pick up new tools fast.
 AI-native: You already use Claude (or other), AI agents, and similar tools in your daily work. You're excited about how AI reshapes outbound, enrichment, and lead qualification, and you've probably already shipped something with it.
 Builder mentality: You'd rather spend a week building the system than two more weeks running it by hand. You ship rough versions fast and refine them once you see how they perform. That’s the most important skill we’re looking for.
 Drive: Ambitious, goal-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
 Languages: Fluent English. French and/or Dutch is a strong plus.
 Benefits

 About

title: Strategy & Operations Manager, Specialty Travel & Events
description:
About the Role 
Navan is looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help drive execution across Specialty Travel & Events. The Specialty Travel & Events team owns verticals including Professional Services, Healthcare Professionals, Production and Media, and others. This role will lead cross-functional initiatives to further mature these service offerings, advancing Navan’s mission to make travel easy for every frequent traveler.
In this role, you will work closely with the Strategy & Operations Director to translate strategic priorities into clear plans, coordinate stakeholders across the organisation, build quantitative analyses and dashboards, and help ensure leadership has a reliable view of performance, progress, risks, and decisions.
 What You'll Do 
 Cross-functional programme leadership 
You will lead complex, cross-functional initiatives to improve and scale Specialty Travel & Events service offerings, consistent with the organisation’s biggest priorities.
Build strong relationships across the organisation and create alignment among stakeholders with different priorities. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Finance, and other teams across the organisation.
Identify risks, resolve blockers, and escalate decisions with sound judgement and appropriate urgency.
 Drive strategic initiatives for senior leadership 
Partner closely with the Strategy & Operations Director and senior leaders to turn emerging priorities into focused initiatives and measurable outcomes.
Support the development and ongoing management of leadership operating cadences, including priority-setting, business reviews, and follow-up mechanisms.
Take ownership of high-priority, ambiguous projects that arise from changing business needs.
 Leverage business insights to solve problems 
Partner with Finance and Revenue Operations to build analyses, dashboards, and reporting to understand business performance.
Develop reporting that gives leaders and cross-functional teams a clear view of performance and progress.
Leverage these insights to inform executive decisions.
 Who You Are 
4–6 years of professional experience in strategy and operations, business operations, programme management, consulting, or a related field. Experience in a high-growth tech company is strongly preferred.
Strong project management skills and a track record of delivering through others without relying on formal authority.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
Comfort operating in a fast-changing environment with competing priorities.
High emotional intelligence, discretion, resilience, and a collaborative working style.
Demonstrated quantitative and analytical skills a plus, including experience building analyses and business intelligence reporting.
People who thrive at Navan tend to move quickly, are self-sufficient, demonstrate good judgement, and have strong emotional intelligence.

title: Head of Business Operations
description:
Take over founder-led operations and build the systems that help us grow.
 You might be a consultant who moved into a startup, a founder’s associate already running important parts of a business, or an operator who has started building software and automations yourself.
You enjoy understanding how a business works, finding what slows it down, and making it work better. You can turn an unclear problem into a practical plan, bring people with you, and build the first solution.
We are looking for someone ready to take that ability further: own our operations function, lead a small team, and join the company’s leadership team.
 About Us
 Platform Engineering Masters is the company behind platformengineering.org and PlatformCon. We bring together engineers, technology leaders and vendors through our community, conferences, education and Weave Intelligence.
As the business grows, the systems behind it need to grow too: how we deliver for customers, run events, produce content, understand performance and share information across teams.
Our co-founder, Christoph currently leads operations. You will work closely with him during the handover, then take responsibility for running and developing the function independently. You will report to Luca, our Managing Director.
 The challenge
 We have a working business, an existing operations team and plenty already being built. We also have manual handovers, disconnected information and processes that depend too much on particular people.
Your job is to decide what needs attention, understand the business problem behind each request, and lead the work through to a solution people actually use.
Some of the questions you will tackle:
How do we turn a customer commitment into a reliable delivery process across sales, content and events?
How do we give teams trustworthy information about what is working and where to focus?
How do we make recurring work, such as publishing a webinar or delivering a sponsored asset, easy to run consistently?
Which problems need custom software, which need better use of existing tools, and which simply need a clearer process?
How do we keep improving our systems without making the business dependent on their original builders?
 What you will own
 The operations roadmap. Work directly with Sales, Growth, Content and Events to understand their needs. Prioritize by business impact, challenge requests where necessary, and make trade-offs explicit, including when requests come from founders.
 A small, growing team. You will manage our existing revenue operations and systems engineering specialists from the start, and help recruit and develop additional content/design and growth operations capacity.
 Hands-on delivery. Prototype, write code, connect systems and build automations yourself when that is the fastest way to make progress. Give your team clear direction and space to own delivery.
 Systems that last. Make sure critical workflows have clear ownership, useful documentation and sensible standards for reliability, access and maintenance.
 Adoption and results. Work with business teams until the solution is part of their everyday work. Judge success by better delivery, useful information and time saved.
Your remit is the operational systems supporting the business. Functional leaders own their commercial, editorial and event outcomes; you work with them to make those outcomes easier to achieve.
 What You Will Bring
Structured problem-solving and strong communication. You can understand an internal customer’s needs, question assumptions and explain a recommendation clearly. Consulting or similar client-facing experience would be useful. 
Evidence that you build. You have used code, APIs, automation or AI tools to solve real problems. You can walk us through what you built, why you chose that approach and what happened when people used it. 
Commercial judgment. You connect operational improvements to revenue, delivery quality, cost or capacity. 
Ownership in an ambiguous environment. You can make progress without a complete brief and follow through when implementation gets difficult. 
Readiness to lead. You can set priorities, give useful feedback and hold a small team accountable while staying close to the work. 
Curiosity about technology and the business. You learn unfamiliar tools and domains quickly and care about the quality of the result. 
Experience managing processes in a startup would be valuable. You do not need to have held a Head of Operations title or worked in every area this role touches. We care more about your judgment, learning speed and track record than a particular CRM certification or tool stack.
 What Success Looks Like
 In your first months, you will establish clear priorities with the team, take ownership of the most important systems and deliver improvements that business teams can see and use.
Over time, routine work will run with fewer manual interventions, teams will have better information, and the founders will be able to step out of day-to-day operations with confidence.
 Why join
 You will inherit a real team, work directly with leadership and have the mandate to shape an important part of a growing business. This is an opportunity to move from solving individual problems to owning the function that solves them.
 Interested?
 Send us your CV or profile and a short example of something you improved or built. Tell us what the problem was, what you personally did and what changed. If you have any questions, please contact james@platformengineering.org

title: Manager, Customer Success
location: King of Prussia or United States
description:
What makes us Qlik? 
 A Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader for 16 years in a row , Qlik helps teams get more out of AI with trusted data products, a powerful analytics engine, and AI agents. This helps teams reduce risk and operating costs, while scaling AI responsibly. 
 Used by 75% of the Fortune 500, Qlik works with the systems organizations already use, maintaining flexibility without lock-in. 
 The Manager, Customer Success Role 
 Qlik is looking for a Manager, Customer Success to lead and develop a team of Enterprise Customer Success Managers (CSMs) supporting our most strategic Americas accounts. This role sits at the center of Qlik's enterprise customer strategy: you'll coach a team of seasoned CSMs who act as trusted advisors to VP, SVP, and C-suite stakeholders at Fortune 500 and Global 500 organizations, while building the consistency, methodology, and cross-functional alignment needed to scale a world-class Customer Success practice across a growing enterprise portfolio. 
 What makes this role interesting? 
 • You'll lead a team of 5-8 high-performing Enterprise CSMs who manage some of Qlik's most complex, highest-value accounts, giving you direct visibility into the strategies that shape customer retention and growth at the top end of our business. 
 • As Qlik's enterprise book continues to expand, you'll be building the leadership bench for Customer Success and helping define what great team leadership looks like as the function scales. 
 • This role carries real influence: you'll partner directly with Sales, Product, Professional Services, and Support leadership to shape coordinated account strategy, and you'll have a voice in how Qlik's Customer Success methodology evolves. 
 • The challenge is real too. You're balancing hands-on coaching and career development for your team with the judgment to know when to step into high-stakes executive relationships yourself, all while building repeatable playbooks across a geographically distributed, Americas-wide portfolio. 
 • This is a genuine leadership track: a clear path from Manager to Senior Manager and Director of Customer Success for someone who proves they can scale a team and a portfolio at the same time. 
 Here’s how you’ll be making an impact: 
 • Lead, coach, and develop a team of 5-8 Enterprise CSMs, setting clear expectations, running regular 1:1s and pipeline/portfolio reviews, and building the skills that help each CSM grow into a stronger strategic advisor for their accounts. 
 • Own the health of your team's Americas portfolio, tracking retention, adoption, and expansion metrics across accounts, using telemetry and usage data to spot risk early, and holding your team accountable to outcome-driven Customer Success Plans. 
 • Raise the bar on execution by establishing consistent standards for Customer Success Plans, Quarterly and Executive Business Reviews, and account strategy, so every customer gets the same caliber of experience regardless of which CSM they work with. 
 • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Professional Services, Product, and Support leadership to build coordinated, high-impact account strategies and to represent the voice of the customer in internal planning. 
 • Step in on the highest-stakes accounts, coaching your team through escalations and executive engagements, and occasionally engaging directly with senior customer stakeholders when a deal, renewal, or relationship needs it. 
 • Recruit, hire, and onboard new CSMs as the team grows, and mentor the broader Customer Success organization on what great enterprise account leadership looks like. 
 • Report on team and portfolio performance to senior leadership, using data to tell the story of where the business is winning and where it needs attention. 
 We’re looking for a teammate with: 
 • A university degree or equivalent, plus a minimum of 8 years of relevant professional experience in customer success, account management, or a related customer-facing role within enterprise software or SaaS. 
 • Direct experience managing or leading a team of Customer Success Managers or similar customer-facing professionals, with a track record of coaching people to measurably better performance. 
 • A proven ability to operate with executive presence, comfortable guiding your team through, and personally engaging in, conversations with VP, SVP, and C-suite stakeholders at large enterprise accounts. 
 • Strong commercial and data-driven judgment, with the ability to read portfolio health across retention, adoption, and expansion metrics and translate that into action for your team. 
 The location for this role is: 
USA - Remote or King of Prussia, PA - USA
#LI-Remote
 Apply now and help change how the world transforms complex data landscapes into actionable insights and turns complex data challenges into new opportunities! 
 More about Qlik and who we are: 
 Find out more about ‘Life at Qlik’ on social: Instagram , LinkedIn , YouTube , and X/Twitter , and to see all other opportunities to join us and our values, check out our Careers Page .
 What else do we offer? 
· Named in Newsweek’s ‘Americas Greatest Workplaces 2025’: https://rankings.newsweek.com/americas-greatest-workplaces-2025 .
 · Genuine career progression pathways and mentoring programs. 
 · Culture of innovation, technology, collaboration, and openness. 
 · Flexible, diverse, and international work environment. 
 Giving back is a huge part of our culture. Alongside an extra “change the world” day plus another for personal development, we also highly encourage participation in our Corporate Responsibility Employee Programs .
 Salary and Benefits: The anticipated base salary range for this role is $116,900 USD MIN - $140,000 USD MAX per year. This position is eligible for a commission within a range of $50,100 USD - $60,000 USD subject to meeting targets set forth in a sales commission plan. Final compensation offered by Qlik will be based on factors such as the candidate’s location, job-related skills, education, experience, and other business and organizational needs. 
 This position is eligible for comprehensive benefits, including - but not limited to - medical, dental, and vision coverage life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, paid parental / maternity leave, participation in a 401(k) program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits. 
 Application Window: The application window is 60 days, but applicants are encouraged to apply as soon as possible. The posting will be removed before the application window closes if the position is filled. 
 For positions in Massachusetts: It is unlawful to require or administer a lie detector test for employment. Violators are subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. 
 Qlik is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to fostering a workplace that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. 
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy and related medical conditions, genetic information, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. For United States applicants and employees, go to the US Department of Labor’s website to review the Equal Employment Opportunity Posters, including the “Know Your Rights” and “Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination” posters. 
 If you need assistance applying for a role due to a disability, please submit your request via email to accessibilityta@qlik.com . Any information you provide will be treated according to Qlik’s Recruitment Privacy Notice . Qlik may only respond to emails related to accommodation requests. 
 Qlik uses artificial intelligence (e.g. Talent Intelligence developed by Eightfold) to screen and summarize resumes, assess and evaluate candidates, and score candidates for all positions at Qlik. Any hiring decision will involve a human review, and you will not be subject to decisions based solely on automated means. For questions about this tool, contact accessibilityta@qlik.com . 
 Qlik is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. Please, no phone calls or emails. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Qlik via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of Qlik. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Qlik as a result of the referral or through other means.

title: Sales Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
Job DescriptionJob Description
-English version to follow-
 À propos de Stay22 
Basée à Montréal, Stay22 aide les créateurs ambitieux et les plateformes numériques à forte intention à transformer leur trafic existant en revenus additionnels, grâce à une technologie qui fonctionne discrètement en arrière-plan.
Aujourd'hui, plus de 6 500 créateurs et plateformes font confiance à Stay22, avec plus d'un milliard de dollars en transactions annuelles transitant par la plateforme. Initialement conçue pour le secteur du voyage, l'entreprise accompagne désormais des partenaires dans les domaines du commerce de détail, du lifestyle, de l'édition, des événements et du transport, alors qu'elle poursuit l'expansion de son infrastructure de monétisation pour l'économie moderne des créateurs.
 Aperçu du poste 
Nous bâtissons le pilier Ventes de RevOps, après le marketing et le succès client, alors que nous ajoutons des SDR et préparons notre expansion en Asie. C'est le tout premier rôle entièrement dédié aux opérations de ventes : un poste fondateur au sein du pod GTM.
Tu ne produiras pas que des rapports. La barre est simple : si une transaction, un chiffre ou un processus est remis en question, tu connais déjà la réponse, parce que tu y étais. Tu seras propriétaire de la gouvernance du pipeline, de la précision des prévisions et du deal desk, dans HubSpot, aux côtés du leadership des ventes, d'un analyste RevOps et d'un coéquipier des opérations systèmes. Tu seras la personne que le leadership appelle en premier quand quelque chose ne concorde pas. C'est un rôle individuel senior, à forte propriété, pour une personne qui l'a déjà fait : capable de le prendre en main de façon autonome dès le premier jour et d'absorber ce qui s'en vient à mesure que l'équipe grandit, avec un chemin crédible vers la gestion avec le temps.
 Principales responsabilités 
Être propriétaire du pipeline, de l'hygiène du CRM et de la précision des prévisions pour les ventes, de bout en bout, sur tous les pods et les SDR.
Diriger et améliorer la cadence du pipeline et la revue des transactions, et parler de la santé de toute transaction sur demande.
Concevoir et opérer les étapes de l'entonnoir, les critères de sortie et les cadres de qualification dans HubSpot.
Être le premier point de contact pour le deal desk : questions, exceptions, approbations et structuration.
Bâtir et maintenir le suivi de la productivité, de l'atteinte des quotas et de la performance par territoire et par pod.
Faire ressortir de façon proactive les risques, les écarts de prévision et les bris de processus avant l'escalade.
Assurer des transferts propres entre les ventes et le succès partenaire, avec les opérations de succès client.
Transformer les demandes ambiguës du leadership en cadres évolutifs : une recommandation structurée, pas l'exécution de la première idée.
Avec le temps, contribuer à la conception des processus de ventes et aux mécaniques de rémunération, aux côtés du leadership RevOps.
 Collaboration transversale 
Tu opéreras au cœur du moteur de revenus, dédié aux ventes mais jamais en silo. Tu travailleras en partenariat étroit avec :
Le leadership des ventes, comme partenaire de performance de premier plan.
Le leadership RevOps senior, pour la direction et les priorités.
Un analyste RevOps, pour la modélisation approfondie et l'analyse de performance.
Un coéquipier des opérations systèmes, qui gère les outils, l'automatisation et l'infrastructure.
Les opérations marketing et succès client, pour garder tout le cycle de revenus aligné de bout en bout.
 Expérience recherchée 
4 ans et plus en RevOps ou opérations de ventes, avec une réelle propriété du pipeline, des prévisions et du deal desk, pas seulement du support.
Une forte expertise HubSpot : à l'aise avec les décisions d'architecture CRM, pas seulement l'hygiène.
Un historique de conception ou de refonte de méthodologies de prévision, d'étapes de pipeline ou de cadences de revue.
De l'expérience concrète en prévision de pipeline et en conception de territoires.
Un instinct analytique aiguisé : savoir si un chiffre est réel avant même qu'on te le demande.
À l'aise de tenir ton bout avec le leadership, avec des recommandations structurées, pas de simples extractions.
Une grande propriété : tu signales le problème avant qu'on te demande de le régler.
À l'aise dans un environnement rapide où le modèle de revenus n'est pas de type SaaS.
Une bonne maîtrise de l'anglais, curiosité marquée et fort alignement aux valeurs de Stay22.
 À quoi t'attendre pendant notre processus de recrutement 
Nous savons que ton temps est précieux, voici un aperçu rapide des prochaines étapes :
Appel avec notre conseiller en acquisition de talents (30 min).
Entrevue avec le ou la gestionnaire d'embauche (45 min).
Entrevue technique et étude de cas en direct avec des membres de l'équipe RevOps (en personne, 60 min).
Entrevue en panel avec d'autres membres de l'équipe (60 min).
Entrevue finale avec notre PDG (30 min).
Offre et intégration ????
Note : ce processus peut évoluer selon les besoins de l'équipe.
Pourquoi rejoindre Stay22 ? 
 Emplacement de choix à Montréal : Travaillez depuis notre dynamique siège social situé dans la Petite-Italie, avec une allocation pour la cafétéria, un accès complet au gym, ainsi qu'une terrasse sur le toit comprenant un terrain saisonnier de basketball/pickleball et une patinoire de hockey.
 Une gamme complète d'avantages sociaux : Couverture santé et dentaire, contribution de l'employeur au REER, titre de transport STM entièrement payé, ainsi que des activités d'équipe, événements et retraites réguliers.
 Une flexibilité adaptée à votre réalité : Horaires flexibles, possibilités de travailler de n'importe où, fermeture des bureaux en fin d'année et journées flexibles.
 (Stay22 est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances. Toutes les candidatures qualifiées seront examinées. Si vous avez un handicap ou des besoins particuliers nécessitant des aménagements, contactez-nous à careers@stay22.com .) 
 Ton CV sera lu par Nayo , notre recruteur interne, même si tu ne coches pas toutes les cases, on aimerait quand même te rencontrer. 
 _____________________________________ 
About Stay22 
Based in Montreal, Stay22 helps ambitious creators and intent-rich digital platforms turn their existing traffic into incremental revenue, with technology that works quietly in the background.
Today, more than 6,500 creators and platforms rely on Stay22, with over $1 billion in annual transactions flowing through the platform. Originally built for travel, the company now supports partners across retail, lifestyle, publishing, events, and transport as it expands its monetization infrastructure for the modern creator economy.
Position overview 
We are building the Sales pillar of RevOps, after marketing and customer success, as we add SDRs and prepare to expand into Asia. This is the very first role fully dedicated to sales operations: a founding seat on the GTM pod.
You won't just produce reports. The bar is simple: if a deal, a number, or a process gets questioned, you already know the answer, because you've been in it. You'll own pipeline governance, forecast accuracy, and the deal desk, in HubSpot, alongside sales leadership, a RevOps analyst, and a Systems Ops teammate. You'll be the person leadership calls first when something doesn't add up. This is a senior individual contributor role with high ownership, for someone who has done this before: able to take it end to end independently from day one and absorb what's coming as the team grows, with a credible path toward management over time.
 Key responsibilities 
Own the pipeline, CRM hygiene, and forecast accuracy for sales, end to end, across all rep pods and SDRs.
Run and improve the pipeline commit cadence and deal reviews, and speak to the health of any deal on demand.
Design and operate the sales funnel stages, exit criteria, and qualification frameworks in HubSpot.
Be the first point of contact for the deal desk: questions, exceptions, approvals, and deal structuring.
Build and maintain tracking for rep productivity, quota attainment, and territory and pod performance.
Proactively surface pipeline risk, forecast variance, and process breakdowns before they escalate.
Ensure clean, reliable handoffs between sales and partner success, with customer success ops.
Turn ambiguous leadership asks into scalable frameworks: a structured recommendation, not just the first idea executed.
Over time, help shape sales process design and comp and incentive mechanics alongside RevOps leadership.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration 
You'll operate at the center of the revenue engine, dedicated to sales but never in a silo. You'll partner closely with:
Sales leadership, as a frontline performance partner.
Senior RevOps leadership, for direction and priorities.
A RevOps analyst, for deeper modeling and performance analysis.
A Systems Ops teammate, who owns tooling, automation, and infrastructure.
Marketing Ops and CS Ops, to keep the full revenue lifecycle aligned end to end.
 Requirements 
4+ years in RevOps or sales operations, with real ownership of pipeline, forecasting, and deal desk, not just support of them.
Strong HubSpot expertise: comfortable owning CRM architecture decisions, not just hygiene.
A track record of building or overhauling forecasting methodology, pipeline stages, or deal review cadences.
Hands-on experience with pipeline forecasting and territory design.
Sharp analytical instincts: able to know whether a number is real before anyone asks.
Comfortable holding your own with sales leadership, with structured recommendations, not just data pulls.
High ownership: you flag the problem before you're asked to fix it.
At ease in a fast-paced environment where the revenue model is not SaaS.
English proficiency, strong curiosity, and a real alignment with Stay22's values.
 What to expect during our hiring process 
We know your time is valuable, here is a quick look at the next steps:
Call with our Talent Acquisition Advisor (30 min).
Interview with the hiring manager (45 min).
Technical interview and live case with members of the RevOps team (in person, 60 min).
Panel interview with other members of the team (60 min).
Final interview with our CEO (30 min).

Note: this process may evolve based on the team's needs.
Why join Stay22? 
 Prime Montreal Location : Work from our vibrant Little Italy HQ with a cafeteria allowance, full gym access, and a rooftop terrace complete with a seasonal basketball/pickleball court & hockey rink.

title: Sales Enablement Lead (Remote)
description:
Who We Are:
 Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.
Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.
Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.
 Who You Are:
 We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking an Enablement Lead who will be responsible for defining and driving sales and partner readiness strategy across a specific product, platform, or segment domain — equipping the field with the positioning, sales plays, and execution frameworks needed to sell and scale solutions globally. If you love translating complex capabilities into compelling field strategies and thrive at the intersection of product, go-to-market, and revenue execution, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!
 What You’ll Do:
 As an Enablement Lead, your key area of responsibility will be owning and defining the end-to-end enablement strategy for a specific product, platform, or segment domain, ensuring all solutions are grounded in deep domain expertise and directly tied to field execution. You will be responsible for translating product and solution capabilities into domain-specific value propositions, sales plays, deal strategies, and scalable execution frameworks that span the full revenue lifecycle — from prospecting and discovery through proposal and expansion. You will also need to define and own a suite of enablement assets including sales playbooks, messaging frameworks, competitive positioning guides, objection handling frameworks, demo strategies, and discovery guides, all built to reflect real-world customer scenarios and sales motions within your domain.
You will need to work closely with Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales Leadership, Revenue Delivery, and Revenue Operations to ensure enablement is tightly aligned to roadmap, GTM priorities, and field performance outcomes, while also collaborating with central teams including Learning Design, Content, and Demo Excellence to operationalize and deliver programs at scale. To be successful in this role you will be a strategic thinker who balances big-picture vision with execution-focused outcomes and thrives in cross-functional environments. In addition, the successful candidate will have deep understanding of solution selling, strong stakeholder management skills, and the ability to communicate complex domain concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
 How You’ll Make An Impact:
 Own and define the enablement strategy for a specific product, platform, or segment domain, ensuring all enablement solutions are grounded in deep expertise within that specific area
 Act as the primary enablement partner to Sales leadership, aligning on priorities, pipeline needs, and performance outcomes
 Ensure readiness across the full revenue lifecycle, including prospecting, qualification, discovery, demo, proposal, and expansion
 Identify domain-specific readiness gaps and define targeted enablement strategies to improve execution and results
 Translate capabilities within their specific product, platform, or segment domain, into clear, domain-specific value propositions, use cases, and customer outcomes
 Define how solutions should be positioned across segments, personas, and sales motions
 Ensure messaging reflects the unique needs, challenges, and buying behaviors associated with their specific product, platform, or segment domain
 Establish competitive positioning and differentiation specific to the domain
 Develop domain-specific sales plays, discovery approaches, and deal strategies aligned to their specific product, platform, or segment domain
 Translate product or segment solutions into role-specific execution across SDR, BDR, Account Executives, Partners, and Solution Engineering
 Ensure all sales motions and execution frameworks are tailored to the realities of their specific product, platform, or segment domain, including customer use cases and deal dynamics
 Enable repeatable, scalable execution models that support pipeline generation, deal progression, and expansion within the domain
 Define and own all enablement solutions for their specific product, platform, or segment domain, ensuring they are directly aligned to domain expertise and field execution needs
 Establish requirements and direction for enablement assets specific to their product, platform, or segment domain, including: Sales playbooks, Messaging frameworks, Demo strategies and flows, Competitive positioning guides, Objection handling frameworks, Discovery guides, Deal support materials
 Ensure all assets are built to reflect real-world execution within their specific product, platform, or segment domain, including customer scenarios, industry nuances, and sales motions
 Partner with Content, Learning Design, and Demo Excellence teams to operationalize and deliver these solutions
 Partner with Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales, Revenue Delivery and Revenue Operations to ensure enablement is aligned to roadmap, messaging, and GTM priorities
 Collaborate with other Enablement Leads to ensure consistency and alignment across product and segment domains
 Ensure horizontal and vertical alignment so that solutions are both globally consistent and locally relevant
 Gather domain-specific field insights, feedback, and performance data related to their specific product, platform, or segment domain
 Identify gaps in positioning, messaging, and execution specific to the domain and drive improvements
 Continuously refine enablement solutions to reflect evolving customer needs, market dynamics, and sales performance
 Ensure enablement remains practical, relevant, and directly tied to field success
 What You’ll Bring To This Role:
 Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent combination of education and work experience
 5-8 years of experience in sales enablement, product enablement, sales strategy, or a related field
 Experience in B2B technology, SaaS, IoT, or similar industries strongly preferred
 Experience working in cross-functional go-to-market environments required
 Deep expertise in a specific product, platform, solution area, or customer segment, with the ability to translate that knowledge into actionable sales enablement strategies
 Strong understanding of sales enablement principles, value-based and solution selling, and the full revenue lifecycle from prospecting through expansion
 Proven ability to develop domain-specific enablement solutions including sales plays, messaging frameworks, competitive positioning, and execution tools
 Sales methodology certifications (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger, CHAMP) considered an asset
 Enablement or product-related certifications considered an asset
If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

 At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. title: GTM Strategy & Ops Manager
description:
Who We Are Is What We Do.
 Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.
Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.
 Why should you be part of our success story?
 As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.
Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.
Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.
 Summary
 As the GTM Strategy & Ops Manager, you will oversee the operational processes and logistics required to launch and scale Deel’s services in new countries and regions. You will help Deel scale its services, optimize workflows, and deliver exceptional experiences for clients managing international talent. Your job will be to ensure the smooth execution of operations, driving efficiency and scalability as Deel expands its global reach.
 Responsibilities
Executing on Deel's global expansion strategy across operations, products, and new markets
End-to-end project management on top business priorities including identifying opportunities, scoping projects, and driving cross-functional implementation
Creating data driven recommendations by accessing, analyzing, and synthesizing large data sets
Problem solving and solution implementation
Process design and improvement, particularly for operations at scale
Working with the product and development teams to drive high impact improvements
Supporting strategic goal setting and performance management
Creating and maintaining existing processes, workflows, and organizational tools
 Qualifications
4+ years of relevant work experience in a fast-paced environment
Previous experience in at least one of the following: fast growth startup, BizOps role in tech, top-tier management consulting, investment banking, or private equity
Solid track record of achievement - e.g. had success in a top tier company, delivered quantifiable business impact, quickly assumed responsibilities or won competitive awards
Can break complex problems into smaller, actionable solution steps
Strong analytical foundation with ability to manipulate and synthesize data
Are curious by nature and interested in making an impact
Excellent written and verbal communication in English
Advanced working knowledge of SQL is a plus
 Application Deadline for U.S. Applicants: Recruiting timelines vary by position, however, all Deel positions accept applications for a minimum of 5 days from the posting date listed herein. This position is open and still accepting applications
 Benefits : Full-time employees in the United States receive a variety of benefits while employed at Deel.
Health Insurance Effective from Day 1 (Medical, Dental, & Vision)
401k Retirement Plan
Disability Insurance
Life Insurance
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Flexible Savings Account (FSA)
Flexible time off (PTO)
12 paid holidays per year
Parental leave: 16 weeks for the birthing parent and 8 weeks for the non-birthing parent
 Ce que nous faisons définit qui nous sommes.
 Deel est la plateforme tout-en-un de paie et de RH dédiée aux équipes internationales. Notre vision est de donner à chaque individu, équipe et entreprise accès aux opportunités mondiales. Conçue pour répondre aux modes de travail actuels, Deel regroupe le SIRH, la paie, la conformité légale, les avantages sociaux, la performance et la gestion des équipements au sein d'une interface unique et fluide. Grâce à des outils propulsés par l'IA et une infrastructure de paie interne, Deel accompagne tous les types de travailleurs dans plus de 150 pays, aidant ainsi les entreprises à se développer de manière plus intelligente, plus rapide et plus conforme.
Comptant parmi les plus grandes entreprises au monde, notre équipe de 7 000 collaborateurs s'étend sur plus de 100 pays, parle 74 langues et porte une culture connectée et dynamique qui favorise l'apprentissage continu et l'innovation pour nos clients.
 Pourquoi devriez-vous prendre part à notre succès ?
 En tant qu'entreprise de Logiciel en tant que Service (SaaS) à la croissance la plus rapide de l'histoire, Deel transforme la manière dont les talents mondiaux se connectent aux entreprises de premier plan ; brisant les frontières qui limitent traditionnellement l'embauche et les opportunités de carrière. Nous ne nous contentons pas de créer un logiciel ; nous bâtissons l'infrastructure du futur du travail, favorisant une économie mondiale plus diverse et inclusive. En 2024 seulement, nous avons versé 11,2 milliards de dollars à des travailleurs dans près de 100 devises et fournit une couverture santé et des avantages sociaux dans 109 pays, garantissant que chacun soit rémunéré et protégé, peu importe où il se trouve.
Notre élan se reflète dans nos réussites et la satisfaction de nos clients : CNBC Disruptor 50 , Forbes Cloud 100 , Deloitte Fast 500 , ainsi qu'une reconnaissance répétée dans la liste des meilleures entreprises de Y Combinator , tout en maintenant une note moyenne de 4,83 basée sur 15 000 avis via G2, Trustpilot, Capterra, Apple et Google.
Votre expérience chez Deel sera un véritable accélérateur de carrière. À l'avant-garde de la révolution mondiale du travail, vous relèverez des défis complexes qui impactent la vie professionnelle de millions de personnes. Porté par notre dynamique, soutenue par une valorisation de 17,3 milliards de dollars et un revenu annuel récurrent (ARR) d'un milliard de dollars en un peu plus de cinq ans, vous générerez un impact significatif tout en développant une expertise qui fera de vous un leader convoité de la transformation du travail à l'échelle mondiale.
 Résumé
 En tant que Gestionnaire de la Stratégie GTM et des Opérations, vous superviserez les processus opérationnels et la logistique nécessaires pour lancer et développer à l'échelle les services de Deel dans de nouveaux pays et régions. Vous aiderez Deel à développer ses services, à optimiser les flux de travail et à offrir des expériences exceptionnelles aux clients qui gèrent les talents internationaux. Votre rôle sera de garantir une exécution fluide des opérations, en promouvant l'efficacité et la scalabilité à mesure que Deel étend sa portée mondiale.
 Responsabilités
Exécuter la stratégie d'expansion mondiale de Deel dans les opérations, les produits et les nouveaux marchés
Gestion de projets de bout en bout sur les principales priorités commerciales, y compris l'identification des opportunités, la définition de la portée des projets et la mise en œuvre interfonctionnelle
Formuler des recommandations fondées sur les données en accédant, analysant et synthétisant de grands ensembles de données
Résolution de problèmes et mise en œuvre de solutions
Conception et amélioration des processus, en particulier pour les opérations à grande échelle
Collaboration avec les équipes produit et développement pour générer des améliorations à fort impact
Soutien à la définition des objectifs stratégiques et à la gestion du rendement
Création et maintien des processus existants, des flux de travail et des outils organisationnels
 Qualifications
4 ans ou plus d'expérience professionnelle pertinente dans un environnement dynamique
Expérience antérieure dans au moins l'un des domaines suivants : jeune entreprise en croissance rapide, rôle de BizOps dans le secteur technologique, conseil en gestion de haut niveau, banque d'investissement ou capital-investisseurs
Solides antécédents de réussite - p. ex., succès dans une entreprise de premier plan, livraison d'un impact commercial mesurable, assomption rapide de responsabilités ou obtention de prix compétitifs
Capacité à décomposer les problèmes complexes en étapes de solution plus petites et réalisables
Fondement analytique solide avec la capacité de manipuler et de synthétiser des données
Curiosité naturelle et intérêt à créer un impact
Excellente communication écrite et verbale en anglais
Connaissance approfondie en pratique de SQL constitue un atout
 Rémunération Globale
 Nos collaborateurs méritent une rémunération juste et compétitive qui s'adapte à leur réalité. Avec des avantages sociaux et des gratifications évolutives, notre programme de rémunération globale reflète notre engagement en faveur de l'inclusion et de l'accessibilité pour tous.
 Ce Dont Vous Bénéficierez :
Des opportunités d'attribution d'actions (stock options) selon votre rôle, votre statut d'emploi et votre localisation.
Des avantages et privilèges supplémentaires basés sur votre statut d'emploi et votre pays.
La flexibilité du travail à distance, incluant un accès optionnel aux espaces IWG.
 Égalité des chances et Diversité
 Chez Deel, nous sommes un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances. Nous valorisons la diversité et encourageons vivement les candidatures de personnes qualifiées, sans distinction de race, de religion, de sexe, d'origine nationale, d'identité de genre, d'orientation sexuelle, d'âge, d'état civil, de statut de vétéran, de handicap, de grossesse ou de maternité, ou de toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi.
Sauf accord contraire, nous communiquons avec les candidats via des adresses e-mail spécifiques à Deel (se terminant par @deel.com ou celles de sociétés acquises comme @payspace.com et @paygroup.com). Vous pouvez consulter nos offres d'emploi à jour sur notre page carrières.
 Accessibilité et Processus de Recrutement
 Deel s'engage à offrir des aménagements sur demande tout au long du processus de recrutement, de sélection et d'évaluation pour les candidats en situation de handicap. Si vous avez besoin d'un aménagement, veuillez en informer notre équipe d'acquisition de talents via [ce lien] ; un membre de l'équipe vous contactera pour garantir votre participation équitable. En cas de difficulté d'accès au formulaire, contactez-nous à recruiting@deel.com.
Notre processus repose principalement sur des entretiens et des évaluations liées au poste. Dans certains cas restreints, nous pouvons examiner des informations contextuelles informelles pertinentes pour le rôle, conformément à nos obligations de confidentialité et d'équité.
 Utilisation de l'IA et de la Technologie
 Ce processus de candidature utilise des outils d'aide à la décision automatisée ( AEDT ) et des systèmes d'IA pour évaluer les candidats en fonction de leur niveau d'expérience, de leurs compétences techniques et de leurs qualifications. En tant qu'entreprise 100 % en télétravail, nous utilisons également des technologies de détection de fraude et de deepfake propulsées par l'IA pour vérifier l'authenticité de l'identité des candidats lors des évaluations. Ce traitement est effectué dans le respect des lois sur la protection des données, la gouvernance de l'IA et le droit du travail. Nous garantissons qu'une supervision humaine est maintenue pour toutes les décisions finales d'embauche. Vos données personnelles ne sont pas utilisées pour entraîner des modèles d'IA. Pour plus d'informations, consultez notre Politique de Confidentialité.

 Total Rewards
 Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.
