title: Manager, Ad Partnership Management (Manager, Sales Operations)
description:
Position Summary...
Walmart Connect is seeking a Manager, Sales Operations to play a critical role in enabling and scaling our sales organization by owning our core sales systems, data, and operational processes. This role involves data analytics, sales forecasting, and collaboration and day-to-day support with cross-functional teams to deliver effective advertising solutions and maintain strong client relationships. 
This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who is equally comfortable rolling up their sleeves to create reports and dashboards, solve day-to-day operational challenges, and drive strategic decisions that improve how the sales organization operates. This role will help shape core sales operations across pipeline management, forecasting, platform health, commissions, and reporting—ensuring the business has the insights, processes, and tools needed to scale effectively.
What you'll do...
Oversee processes, tools, and strategies to support maximizing ad sales, including pipeline management, sales forecasting, and data analysis. 
Develop and implement strategies to optimize sales operations, improve productivity, and enhance revenue generation. This includes managing resource requests, address process pain points and inefficiencies, and the integration of new tools and technologies to enable the sales team to work efficiently. 
Collaboration with product management, development teams, and other cross-functional teams is essential to deploy advertising solutions and ensure effective campaign execution. 
Create and manage business intelligence dashboards to provide insights and guide decision-making. 
Build and evolve scalable sales operations workflows across lead management, opportunity progression, account planning, and internal request intake to improve consistency, speed, and visibility for the sales organization. 
Design, maintain, and automate recurring sales reports and dashboards that provide visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, seller performance, revenue trends, and operational KPIs. 
Partner with Sales leadership to translate business questions into reporting requirements, performance insights, and workflow improvements that support faster, data-driven decision-making. 
Establish reporting standards and CRM workflow discipline to improve data accuracy, streamline reporting, and ensure the day-to-day health of sales systems and processes. 
Support key sales operating cadences, including pipeline reviews, forecast calls, commissions tracking, and business performance reviews, by delivering accurate reporting and actionable insights. 
Monitor campaign performance, create reports, and provide actionable recommendations to improve revenue performance. 
 Minimum Qualifications: 
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Analytics, Marketing, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
5+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, business operations, or sales analytics, preferably supporting a high-growth sales organization. 
Proven experience building and maintaining sales reports, dashboards, and operating cadences that support pipeline management, forecasting, business performance reviews, and decision-making. 
Experience designing and improving workflows across core sales processes, including lead management, opportunity progression, internal intake, or account planning. 
Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and business intelligence tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker. 
Experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, including supporting system hygiene, workflow discipline, and data quality. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and business recommendations. 
Demonstrated ability to partner cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Product, and Operations teams, with strong communication skills and executive presence. 
Salesforce Admin or BA certificate is an asset. 
Leadership Expectations:
Respect the Individual:
Demonstrates and encourages respect for all; builds a high-performing team; seeks, and embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas and experiences; creates a workplace and experiences where all associates feel seen, supported and connected through culture of belonging so associates thrive and perform; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all; identifies, attracts, and retains the best team members.
Creates a discipline and focus around developing talent, through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; promotes an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work; empowers associates and partners to act in the best interest of the customer and company; and regularly recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments.
Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively and cross-functionally to achieve objectives; and communicates and listens attentively, with energy and positivity to motivate, influence, and inspire commitment and action.
Acts with Integrity:
Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by making a positive impact for associates, customers, and the world around us (e.g., creating a sense of belonging, eliminating waste, participating in local giving).

title: Revenue Operations Lead
description:
Koyfin is a fast growing fintech company building a powerful, intuitive analytics platform used by financial advisors and individual investors to research ideas, manage portfolios, and grow their businesses. We believe every investor deserves world-class research tools without the complexity or price tag of legacy platforms.
Our impact so far:
🚀 One of the fastest-growing platforms for financial advisors, driven by product-led growth
🥇 Recognized by users as a top-rated investment solution on G2
🏆 Rated as the top research platform for user satisfaction in the Kitces survey, the largest survey in the advisor industry
Reporting to the Head of Sales, this is a from-scratch build. Koyfin has over 60,000 financial advisors using the platform, and over 800,000 registered users. Koyfin is standing up a Revenue Operations function for the first time to help the sales team improve the sales assist motion to the existing registered users. You’ll be working directly with the Head of Sales to build the systems, data, and messaging infrastructure the rest of the org runs on. We are looking for someone to support existing AEs, newly hired SDRs and the Head of Sales to run tests, build reporting and create efficiently run motions to reach out aggressive goals.
This is a builder role, not a maintainer role. You'll be defining: a funnel, a lead-scoring model, a reporting layer, an outbound message library that does not yet exist, in a company that runs lean and expects you to own outcomes.
 What you'll own 
 CRM, systems & data (foundational) 
Full ownership of HubSpot: administration, integrations, and data quality
Own and expand enrichment for new registrants and existing users
Define and document the funnel from lead to deal created, including the lead-scoring model
 Reporting & analytics 
Build the dashboards, reporting, and forecasting infrastructure the org uses to judge whether a motion is working
Own test-validation tooling for time-boxed motion tests
 Outbound messaging 
Create and iterate all prospect-facing messaging across email and LinkedIn, working in tandem with the SDRs on targeting and sequencing
Own message performance (reply rates, positive-reply definition) as an input to the funnel data above
 Partnership & process 
Work alongside AEs and SDRs day to day to identify what’s working, iterate and improve
 What we're looking for 
5–8+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM analytics
Deep, hands-on HubSpot experience (admin-level) or equivalent depth in a comparable CRM; comfortable owning integrations and data architecture, not just reporting on top of them (there is a full engineering team available on an as-needed basis)
Strong analytical skills with ability to build funnel definitions, lead-scoring models, and forecasting from scratch, without a data team behind you
Experience writing and iterating outbound sales copy (email and LinkedIn), or directly overseeing it, since this role owns messaging end to end here, not just the systems around it
Comfortable in ambiguity: this is a two-person function (you and the Head of Sales) inside a five-person sales org, and you'll be setting definitions and processes that don't currently exist
Fintech, financial data, or advisor-facing SaaS experience a plus, not required
 Why Join Koyfin 
Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary, equity options, and a comprehensive benefits package.
Innovative Environment: Be part of a fast-growing company at the forefront of financial technology, moving quickly to release new products.
Dynamic Culture: Customer First, Humility & Respect, Teamwork, Continuous Improvement, and Getting Things Done.
Impactful Work: Work with a small, talented team where your contributions directly impact the product and the community it serves.
Industry-Leading Product: Join a company with an industry-leading product that is disrupting the financial analytics space through a product-led growth sales motion.
Efficiency and Growth: Join a company that values efficiency, sustainable growth, and operational excellence. Koyfin is cash flow positive and emphasizes doing more with less.

title: Lead, Senior Sales Enablement
description:
Job DescriptionJob Description
Best Workplaces™ in Canada 2022 - 2026 | Best Workplaces™ with Most Trusted Executive Teams 2024 - 2026 | Best Workplaces™ in Financial Services & Insurance 2022 - 2026 | Best Workplaces™ for Mental Wellness 2023 - 2026 | Best Workplaces™ for Giving Back 2022 & 2024 | Best Workplaces™ for Inclusion 2021, 2024, 2026 | Best Workplaces™ for Women 2021 | Best Workplaces™ in Ontario™ 2024 - 2025 | Best Workplaces™ for Professional Development 2025, 2026 | Best Workplaces™ for Young Talent 2026 
 One of Canada’s Most Trusted Investment Brands. 
At Picton Mahoney Asset Management (PICTON Investments), being alternative isn’t just what we do, it’s who we are.
Founded by industry pioneer David Picton, we’ve spent 20 years challenging conventional wisdom and redefining the investing landscape. As one of Canada’s most trusted investment brands, we are proudly independent, privately run, 100% employee-owned, and deeply committed to delivering results for our clients.
 Thinking Alternatively is in Our DNA. 
With a team of 250 bold thinkers - one-third dedicated solely to investment management - we are specialists, not generalists. Managing over $20.8 billion (October 31, 2026) for institutional and retail clients, we navigate markets with conviction, resilience, and a forward-thinking approach.
We’re more than investors; we’re innovators. We challenge traditional investment mindsets, constantly pushing the boundaries to achieve our mission: to bring greater certainty to investors.
 Our success is built on four guiding principles: 
Treat investors’ money like our own.
Redefine the way investors invest.
Be human, always approachable.
Succeed together, one investment at a time.
These aren’t just words. They define how we think, how we invest, and how we work. 
Now, we’re entering our next chapter. We’re transforming our brand and reshaping the way the world invests. If you think alternatively, embrace an entrepreneurial spirit, and thrive in a dynamic, bureaucracy-free environment, join us and be part of what’s next.
 Thriving in Our Entrepreneurial Culture 
At PICTON Investments , you’ll thrive in our creative and dynamic workplace, where collaboration and support are at the core of everything we do. At our firm, you’ll have the opportunity to take on significant responsibilities, work in a flexible environment, and tackle challenging projects from the outset. Our culture is designed for ambitious professionals who want to make an immediate impact while continuing to push boundaries and achieve our greater mission. You’ll be empowered with a high level of responsibility, trust, and flexibility, providing an exciting and creative space for you to help reshape how the world views alternative investments. With competitive total rewards, performance-based bonuses, and a clear path for career growth, you’ll have everything you need to develop both now and over the longer term.
 The Opportunity 
Be the link between strategy and the field. PICTON Investments is currently looking for a Lead, Senior Sales Enablement to improve the effectiveness, productivity and execution of our Retail Sales organization. Reporting under the Revenue Operations team and working closely with Sales Leadership, you will translate commercial priorities into practical programs, tools, processes and sales disciplines that help External and Internal Sales teams execute against the firm’s growth objectives.
Working across Sales, Marketing, Product, Operations, Compliance and Technology, you will combine sales effectiveness, process improvement, training, strategic initiative execution and cross-functional coordination. The position has a sales-first mandate, with Retail Sales as your primary internal customer.
The expected annual base salary for this role is $100,000 to $120,000 with the final number depending on your experience, skills, and education. On top of that, you’ll be eligible for our discretionary bonus program.
At PICTON Investments , being employee-owned means we really take care of our team. Eligible employees get access to a full benefits package - including profit sharing, health and wellness coverage, life and disability insurance, paid time off and holidays, learning and development programs, and more - many elements of which are fully covered or subsidized by us.
 You’ll have the opportunity to learn and lead: 
 Sales Strategy & Execution 
Partner with Sales Leadership to turn business objectives into clear sales initiatives and execution plans.
Maintain an enablement and initiative plan with Sales Leadership, reviewed on a weekly basis, that sets the priorities and sequencing of campaigns and initiatives.
Lead the rollout of sales initiatives, products and campaigns across Retail Sales, ensuring teams know the audience, positioning, actions and measures of success.
Identify barriers to execution and resolve them with internal partners.
 Performance, Process & Technology 
Drive adoption of KPIs, scorecards and performance insights, working with Sales Leadership and Revenue Operations to turn them into coaching priorities and action.
Streamline sales processes and workflows, identifying inefficiencies, and scaling what works across territories.
Reinforce Salesforce and sales technology use in day-to-day sales routines, in coordination with the CRM Operations team bring field feedback back to CRM Operations & Engineers.
Identify gaps in process and performance, and build training, onboarding, playbooks and tools that improve execution and outcomes
 Cross-Functional Partnership 
Be the connection point between Retail Sales and Marketing, Product, Compliance, Operations, and Technology, ensuring cross-functional coordination during campaigns and initiatives.
Serve as a direct point of contact for sales to raise enablement needs.
Bring field insights back to Sales Leadership and Revenue Operations to inform strategy, programs, tools and communications.
 What we’re looking for: 
10+ years in sales enablement, sales effectiveness, sales operations, commercial excellence or a related discipline, with a record of leading enterprise-level initiatives.
Experience supporting a distributed Sales organization and partnering credibly with senior Sales leaders and frontline teams.
Track record of translating business priorities and performance data into practical tools, programs and measurable improvements in adoption or productivity.
Strong CRM experience, preferably Salesforce, including driving adoption.
Strong project and change-management skills, with experience running multiple initiatives and stakeholders at once.
Experience developing or mentoring others, and the ability to influence without direct authority.
Strong communication and facilitation skills, sound judgment and a sales-first mindset.
Experience in asset management, financial services or another regulated industry is required.
 Our Commitment to Employees 
At PICTON Investments , we take pride in enhancing our employees' experiences through a comprehensive suite of exceptional perks and programs. Our benefits include corporate fitness reimbursement and discounts, VersaFi memberships (formerly Women in Capital Markets), PICTON Investment Counseling and portfolio management services, volunteer and charitable donation matching, maternity and parental leave top-up, recognition awards, semi-annual performance bonuses, a generous annual vacation entitlement (minimum of 15 days per year), training and development reimbursement, extensive health and dental benefits, a healthcare spending account, and more.
These offerings are designed to support your career growth, well-being, and overall success. Join us and thrive in an environment that values and invests in you!
 PICTON Investments is committed to providing an equitable, fair, and accessible work environment for everyone. All hiring and other employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, creed, religion, sex, disability, gender identity, gender expression, family status, age, language, or national origin. We welcome applications from candidates with diverse experiences from around the world, and Canadian work experience is not required. We are committed to providing an accessible recruitment process, with accommodations available upon request at any stage of the application and selection process. If you require an accommodation to support your participation, please contact Human Resources at (416) 955-4108 or accessibility@pictoninvestments.com.
 PICTON Investments does not accept unsolicited resumes, emails, calls, or any other form of communication from third-party recruitment agencies. Any unsolicited outreach, including commercial electronic messages, will neither be acknowledged nor considered.
 Please note: We use AI-assisted tools to support parts of our recruitment process, including summarizing interview notes and aligning candidate profiles with job requirements. All decisions are made by our hiring team.

title: Senior Digital Customer Success Campaign Manager
description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.
About 1Password
At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.
If you’re excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.
The Customer Experience team at 1Password designs digital-first experiences that help customers deploy, activate, and grow with confidence. Our goal is to create scalable programs that guide customers to the right next step at the right moment, improving product adoption, reducing friction, and supporting long-term customer outcomes.
As a Senior Digital Customer Success Campaign Manager, you will own and evolve our digital customer success programs across the customer lifecycle. You will design, build, and optimize targeted digital journeys that help customers move from onboarding through activation and beyond. This role blends program strategy, campaign execution, analytics, experimentation, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver measurable customer impact at scale.
This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys building programs from the ground up, working through ambiguity, and improving digital-first customer experiences in a fast-changing environment. Reporting into the Senior Manager, Digital Customer Success, this is a remote role within North America.
How We’re Using AI Today
Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.
Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.
What We're Looking For:
6+ years of experience in Digital Customer Success, Customer Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Growth Operations, Customer Success Operations, Product-Led Growth, or a related Software as a Service environment.
Demonstrated success building and owning lifecycle or digital success programs with measurable business impact.
Experience creating scalable campaigns, workflows, or journeys rather than managing a book of business.
Strong understanding of the customer lifecycle, including onboarding, activation, adoption, retention, expansion, renewal, and risk management motions.
Ability to interpret customer and product signals, identify patterns, and translate them into clear campaign strategies and measurable interventions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create concise, effective messaging for different customer audiences and personas.
Hands‑on experience with tools such as Gainsight, Salesforce, Marketo, Outreach, or similar customer success and marketing automation platforms.
Experience collaborating across Customer Success, Product, Support, Operations, Marketing, Content, and Data teams to ensure alignment across the customer journey.
Comfort working in changing environments where teams are building new programs, processes, and operating models from the ground up.
Preferred: experience using Artificial Intelligence tools to support program design, experimentation, and campaign optimization; experience with 1Password and/or cybersecurity is also valued.
What You Can Expect:
Design, launch, and improve digital customer success campaigns and programs across onboarding, activation, adoption, and growth stages.
Build scalable customer journeys that help customers reach key milestones using content‑led interventions and targeted human engagement when needed.
Identify customer signals, behaviors, milestones, and friction points that indicate progress, risk, or opportunity across the lifecycle.
Translate customer and product insights into triggered programs and campaigns that guide customers to the right next step using existing resources and tools.
Draft, edit, and optimize customer‑facing communications, including email campaigns, journey messaging, and supporting content.
Monitor program performance using metrics such as activation, deployment, engagement, retention, expansion, churn, and content interaction to evaluate effectiveness.
Use testing methods such as A/B testing, cohort analysis, and message iteration to improve campaign tone, timing, targeting and outcomes.
Partner with Data, Product, Customer Success Operations, Customer Experience Content, and Voice of Customer teams to align digital programs with customer insights and business priorities.
Build dashboards and reporting to track program health, surface insights, and recommend improvements to digital‑first customer experiences.
Use Artificial Intelligence tools and emerging technologies to accelerate campaign creation, analysis, experimentation, and optimization.
USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $121,000 USD and $146,500 USD. This role is also immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.
Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $104,000 CAD and $139,000 CAD. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.
At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.
This posting is for an existing vacancy.
Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.
How We Work With AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting‑edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it’s an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.
This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.
Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote‑first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in‑office roles, with an expectation of being on‑site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in‑person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.
For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department‑wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.
What We Offer
Maternity and parental leave top‑up programs
Competitive health benefits
Generous PTO policy
RSU program for most employees
Retirement matching program
Free 1Password account
Paid volunteer days
Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in‑person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.
You belong here.
1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.
Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.
Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.
Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

title: Customer Success Lead - Enterprise
description:
We are Vitesse – the treasury and payment partner of choice for insurance. 
 Your next adventure awaits! 
Join the team who are redefining the payments space.
 About Us 
At Vitesse, we're more than just a payments platform – we're the trusted financial infrastructure connecting the global insurance ecosystem. Tailor-made for insurers, brokers, MGAs, and TPAs, our unified platform optimises claims funds, enables real-time global payments, and delivers full financial control. Our impact is real: over $20 billion in payments across 200+ countries, hundreds of millions returned to insurers’ balance sheets, and counting. We’re licensed in the UK (FCA), Europe (DNB), and New York (NYDFS), with over 260 amazing colleagues worldwide. With $93 million recently raised in Series C funding from KKR, our journey is just beginning, and our ambitions are sky-high.
Headquartered in the heart of London and expanding across Europe and the US, Vitesse is where your ideas power tomorrow’s insurance solutions. Are you ready to make a difference? You're in the right place.
Customer Success at Vitesse is still taking shape, which means if you join us you’ll have a genuine opportunity to shape how the function works – from engagement models and playbooks, to the way we measure customer value and growth. You’ll be responsible for our enterprise customer sucesss team that owns a portfolio of our Vitesse’s largest and most complex customers across the carrier, TPA and MGA market. These matrixed organisations often have multiple stakeholder groups, complex operating models and legacy systems. You’ll help the team navigate that complexity, build trusted executive relationships and grow the value customers realise from Vitesse. Your ideas will matter, and your impact will be visible.
 The Role 
Reporting into the VP of Customer Success, you’ll lead a team of CSMs and personally own one or two strategic accounts. Together, you’ll drive material growth across our Enterprise customer base by helping customers realise measurable value and increase their use of Vitesse
You’ll guide the team to build strong relationships, from operational users to senior executives, and mobilise the right people across Vitesse to deliver on customer priorities. Strong adoption and customer health will underpin that growth. You’ll work closely with Sales, Pre-Sales, Product, Onboarding, Operations, Support and Data to make it happen.
 Core Responsibilities 
Coach and develop Enterprise CSMs to act as trusted advisers and build effective relationships with senior customer stakeholders.
Guide the team in creating and delivering Customer Success Plans that connect customer goals to Vitesse’s value, with clear success measures, regular check-ins and strategic reviews.
Hold the team accountable for customer outcomes, portfolio health and growth in balances, payment accounts, participant connections and Vitesse’s share of payment activity.
Help CSMs map stakeholder groups, identify risks early and coordinate action across customer and internal teams.
Guide the team through complex customer initiatives by clarifying ownership, aligning stakeholders and keeping activity focused on agreed outcomes.
Support customers in enabling third parties in their payment networks, coordinating across CSMs and other internal teams where needed.
Partner with Sales to identify and qualify expansion opportunities.
Bring customer feedback to Product and operational teams, and shape the Enterprise Customer Success model and practices.
 Why Join Us? 
Vitesse is a high-growth business with a strong, open and positive culture. We combine the innovative energy of a scale-up with proven product-market fit and a significant market opportunity.
As Customer Success Lead, Enterprise, you’ll shape how we work with some of our largest customers, lead a talented team and help build an approach suited to complex organisations and meaningful growth.
 Skills and Experience 
Experience leading and developing a Customer Success or Account Management team in insurance or a complex B2B technology environment.
Experience managing strategic accounts with matrixed organisations and multiple operational, technical and executive stakeholders.
A record of helping customers realise measurable value and growing adoption or usage within existing relationships.
Confidence coaching teams to engage senior executives and communicate business value.
Strong commercial judgement and the ability to turn customer insight into credible account and growth plans.
The ability to guide teams through complex customer initiatives, keeping outcomes, ownership and risks clear.
Strong cross-functional leadership and knowledge of carriers, TPAs, MGAs or the wider insurance ecosystem, or the ability to build that expertise quickly.
An adaptable leadership style and interest in shaping an evolving Enterprise Customer Success model.
We understand that everyone has their own work rhythm and believe in a flexible working schedule - at Vitesse you’re expected to work 35 hours a week. 
 Our Values – or what we call “Vitesse at Our Best” 
The Vitesse values are a true reflection of what it takes to thrive in our business, so it’s important to us that any employee who joins our business is aligned with these 3 attributes
 Confident Humility 
We believe the best ideas come from listening and learning. We leave ego at the door, ask for help when we need it, and celebrate collective success. When one of us wins, we all do.
 Driven to Succeed 
We’re ambitious about the opportunity ahead and committed to achieving it together. We hold ourselves to high standards, take pride in what we deliver, and push for meaningful outcomes for our customers, our partners, and each other.
 Tenacious Responsibility 
We take ownership of our work, our decisions, and our results. We face challenges with resilience, learn from setbacks, and see things through to completion. Because doing the right thing matters.
 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer 
We commit to creating an inclusive environment that enables everyone to perform at their best, where we recognise the rights of all individuals to mutual respect and where there is an unbiased acceptance of others. Our policies and practices aim to promote an environment that is free from all forms of unlawful or unfair discrimination and values the diversity of all people. At the heart of our policy, we seek to treat people fairly and with dignity and respect . If you require any interview adjustments please contact Clara Moretti-Parker on clara.moretti-parker@vitesse.io.

title: Go to Market Intelligence Analyst
description:
The Opportunity
Euna Solutions is hiring a Go-to-Market Intelligence Analyst to own the account and contact intelligence layer that tells our sellers which public sector agencies to pursue and when. title: Revenue Operations Systems Manager (Remote East Coast US)
description:
Revenue Systems Manager at Ardoq 
 Keep our GTM systems running smoothly, so the people closest to our customers can always rely on the tools. 
 The Ardoq Story 
 Ardoq is one of Norway's most exciting scale-ups, a truly global company built out of Oslo. We are a SaaS platform that helps organizations understand, manage, and evolve their complex digital landscape. By providing a dynamic, collaborative "digital twin" of their business, we connect systems, people, and processes to drive better decision-making and accelerate digital transformation. 
 Today, we help some of the world's most complex organizations, like ExxonMobil and BT, gain clarity in a changing world. We are backed by leading global tech investors, including EQT and One Peak, giving us the stability of a mature company with the speed and soul of a startup. 
 About the Role 
 Every GTM team at Ardoq depends on Salesforce and its integrated applications working the way they should: a lead reaching the right rep in seconds, a quote going out the door in minutes. As our Revenue Systems Manager, you'll be responsible for the health of Salesforce and its integrations, moving seamlessly between quick tickets and carefully scoped system improvements. 
 In this role, you’ll be working closely with our Customer leadership to support our processes and insights that drive renewals, expansion and retention. 
 At Ardoq, we value autonomy and psychological safety. In this role, you won't just follow a script; you will have the influence to shape your domain and the ownership to see your ideas through to execution. 
 What you'll do 
 Own Salesforce, end to end: You'll be one of two dedicated Salesforce admins owning user set-up and permissions, as well as the configuration and ongoing optimization of Salesforce as part of our wider tech ecosystem. 
 Partner across GTM: work closely with Customer Success, Renewals, Professional Services and Sales to turn real business problems into system solutions people actually trust and use. 
 Lead system projects: you’ll drive system projects that might range from deploying a CPQ tool to establishing a robust Customer SQL framework. 
 Cultural contribution: help shape the habits of a small, high-trust team where picking up a ticket and shipping a project matter equally. 
 On a typical day, you will 
 Start by clearing a handful of tickets, the small stuff that keeps Sales and CS moving. Then shift into project mode: reviewing a Flow that's throwing errors, scoping the next phase of an important integration, or sitting down with our VP of Customer Success or Professional Services to optimize a post-sales process. You'll lean on AI tools daily, to check a formula, sanity-check an automation, or move faster through a repetitive task, because that's simply how good admin work gets done now. Some days are almost entirely tickets. Some are almost entirely project work. Most days are a mix of both. 
 Who you are 
 The Experience: you hold a current Salesforce Administrator certification and have supported Salesforce inside a high-growth tech company. You’ve had roles with a dedicated focus on customer operations and understand how to support a Customer team and their focus on renewals and retention. 
 The Mindset: you're happy being one of a small team, not one of many. You move comfortably between answering a ticket and running a project, often on the same day, and the unglamorous work isn't beneath you. 
 The Tools: You're a certified Salesforce Admin. You use AI tools like Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT as part of your daily workflow, not as an occasional experiment, to move faster and catch things you'd otherwise miss. 
 The Communicator: you can explain a system change to a non-technical stakeholder in terms of what it means for their day, not just what changed under the hood. 
 The "Ardoq Way" 
 We live by three values, Bold, Caring, and Driven, that define how we work, how we treat each other, and how we win. 
 BOLD: you continuously raise the bar for yourself and others, starting from a place of "what if I could?" You act decisively, even when the information isn't complete, choosing forward motion and learning over waiting for the perfect answer. 
 CARING: you care enough to be candid, delivering direct, kind, and timely feedback that helps your teammates grow. You operate as one team, sharing knowledge openly, celebrating others' wins, and putting collective success ahead of your own. 
 DRIVEN: at Ardoq, everyone has a stake in the outcome, including stock options. You act like an owner: measuring success by impact rather than effort, saying "no" to distractions, and staying focused on the highest-value work at pace. 
 Why Ardoq? 
 We believe that high performance is powered by wellbeing. You'll have access to a competitive package that supports performance, wellbeing, and long-term success. 
 Employee Stock Options, share in Ardoq's success as we grow together 
 25 days annual leave, offered globally 
 Enhanced parental leave, available globally, to support you and your family 
 401(k) retirement plan, and health, disability, and life insurance 
 Annual learning budget to support your growth and development 
 Fully remote within Eastern US time zone hours 
 Compensation: $102,000 - $125,000 
 How to Apply 
 Send us your resume, we'd love to hear from you. Our hiring process typically includes: TA screen → hiring manager interview → case interview → values interview. We provide thoughtful feedback at every step. 
 Final Note 
 At Ardoq, every teammate has a voice. Whether you love tackling enterprise-scale challenges or improving how companies run, you'll not only belong, you'll impact, grow, and make work meaningful. 
 #LI-Remote

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
We're hiring a Customer Success Manager! Signing a brand is where it starts. Making them win is the job. Bring your marketing brain, your loyalty know-how and a love for proving results with numbers.
Job description
 Customer Success Manager | NeoDay | Tilburg 
🔹 Location: Tilburg (On-site 80% / Remote 20%)
🔹 Type: Full-time
🔹 Experience: Mid to senior level (4–7 years in Customer Success, Account Management or CRM / Loyalty Marketing)
About NeoDay
For decades, loyalty programs meant endless IT projects and ROI "somewhere in year three." We think that's broken, so we're proving the opposite. At NeoDay, we help retailers and consumer brands, from supermarkets and fashion chains to fast food and fuel stations, turn loyalty into a real growth engine. Our platform combines AI-driven personalization, gamification and ready-to-launch apps, so brands like Tesco, Action and La Place can go live in weeks instead of years.
NeoDay is the award-winning loyalty platform. We won Best Retail Loyalty Program Worldwide at the International Loyalty Awards and were named by Forrester among the world's leading loyalty platforms. Everything we build is made in-house in The Netherlands and the Philippines, and we're scaling fast across Europe and beyond.
Your role
A loyalty program isn't won on launch day. It's won in the months after: every new member, every campaign that lands, every euro of uplift on the client's books. When our clients succeed, NeoDay grows with them. You're the one who makes that happen. 
As Customer Success Manager, you own a portfolio of our international brands from go-live onwards. You become an extension of their marketing team: the loyalty expert at the table who knows what to launch next, why it will work, and how to prove it did. Strategy, results, and a story your client can take straight to their board. You report to our Head of Customer Success and work hand-in-hand with our Solution Architects, Sales, Product, Data and Support teams.
What you'll do
 Own your book: Be the go-to partner for a portfolio of international brands, from the loyalty manager running campaigns to the C-suite signing off on budget.
 Define what winning looks like: Set clear goals and a proper baseline with every client, and turn them into a Success Plan you both steer on.
 Make value impossible to ignore: Deliver campaign results, impact snapshots and benchmarks that your champions share with their leadership. The kind of numbers that get forwarded to the CEO with "have you seen this?"
 Lead the strategic conversation: Run QBRs, shape the marketing and campaign calendar, and bring loyalty ideas that grow members, visit frequency and basket size.
 Grow the program, grow the account: Drive adoption and the growth built into every contract. Spot expansion opportunities early and team up with Sales to land them.
 Never rely on one champion: Map stakeholders, build relationships across marketing, IT and leadership, and make NeoDay part of how the whole organization works.
 Be the Voice of the Customer: Bundle client feedback into sharp input for Product and bring the roadmap back to your clients. You know when to say "yes," when to say "not now," and how to say "no" so it still lands well.
 Raise the bar for Customer Success: Help set the standard for how NeoDay partners with its clients. You bring best practices, sharpen how we work and make excellence the norm in every account.
What you bring
 Experience: 4–7 years in Customer Success, Account Management or client-side CRM / loyalty marketing, ideally at a SaaS or martech company working with retail or consumer brands.
 A marketer at heart: You speak the language of CMOs and loyalty managers. Campaigns, segments, member lifecycles and promo calendars are your home turf.
 Data into stories: Baselines, uplift, retention. You're at home in a dashboard and you know which number matters to the board.
 Trusted advisor: Confident in front of C-level, honest when expectations need resetting, calm when things get hectic.
 Commercial instinct: You spot growth opportunities before the client does, and you build the business case that turns them into a yes, together with Sales.
 Client champion: You genuinely care about your clients' success. You listen closely, act before they have to ask and build relationships that feel like partnerships.
 Languages: Fluent in written and spoken English. Dutch is a bonus.
What you'll get
A competitive base salary plus an OTE component: you grow the accounts, you share in the upside.
25 vacation days (based on a full-time contract).
A laptop and phone subscription compensation.
An international role with a portfolio of leading brands and real commercial impact.
Travel allowance / NS card.
Great colleagues, team events, and an informal Brabant-style culture: we perform together and enjoy together!
Why NeoDay?
NeoDay combines the energy of a scale-up with decades of combined loyalty experience. We're scaling from a handful of flagship partnerships to a customer base across Europe and beyond, and Customer Success is where that growth is won. You'll get clear goals, real ownership and the freedom to build it your way. If you want to be the reason great brands keep growing, we want to talk to you.

 - Continuously improve how we work: Identify opportunities to optimize workflows, enhance digital engagement, and improve the effectiveness and scalability of our Customer Success programs.
WHAT YOU BRING:
 - Fluent in English; French, German, or Dutch is a plus but not required.
 - 1–3 years of experience in a customer-facing role, ideally in Customer Support, Customer Success, Business Development, Sales, or Account Management.

title: Sales Enablement Manager
description:
About Us 
At Benepass we're making benefits easy. We believe people are the most important asset to any company. Traditional one-size-fits-all benefits packages no longer cut it in today's hybrid and remote-first environment. With Benepass, companies can tailor their benefits to the unique needs of their workforce.
Through our easy-to-use and highly customizable fintech platform, People teams can implement, administer, and track the benefits that meet employees where they are. Employers design their benefits and perks plan by setting a contribution amount and eligible spend categories.  Our Mission 
Helping companies reimagine how companies take care of their people.

We are backed by leading investors, including Centana Growth Partners, Portage Ventures, Threshold Ventures, Gradient Ventures, Workday Ventures, and Clocktower Technology Ventures. To date, the company has raised approximately $75 million in equity capital.
 Articles 
 Founder Story - Jaclyn Chen 
 Benepass Raises $40M Series B 
 Candidate Resources 
 Benepass | Candidate Resource Page 
 Benepass Listed on Inc. Magazine's Best Workplaces of 2023 
 TEAM & ROLE 
We’re looking for a Sales Enablement Manager to help our commercial team sell with greater confidence, consistency, and impact. You’ll turn our product knowledge, market insights, and sales strategy into practical resources and learning experiences that help the team move opportunities forward.
Our sales involve complex benefits decisions and multiple stakeholders, including employers, brokers, and consultants. You’ll help our team explain our value clearly to each audience, handle common objections, and connect our solutions to the outcomes buyers care about.
You’ll report to the Head of Sales and partner closely with the Director of Sales Operations. You’ll own sales readiness, content, and training; Sales Operations will remain a key partner on sales process, systems, reporting, and workflow.
 WHAT YOU'LL DO 
Build and improve onboarding and ramp programs for new sales hires, including product, market, process, and selling skills.
Create and maintain practical sales resources, such as discovery guides, talk tracks, pitch decks, one-pagers, FAQs, objection handling, case studies, and competitive guidance.
Develop role- and audience-specific materials for conversations with employers, brokers, consultants, and other partners.
Lead ongoing training and reinforcement on sales skills, product updates, messaging, competitive positioning, and sales process changes.
Partner with the Head of Sales and frontline managers to identify skill gaps and focus enablement on current business priorities.
Work with Marketing and Product to turn product capabilities, launches, and market changes into clear, accurate guidance for the field.
Gather feedback from sellers and managers, and review customer conversations, win/loss themes, and deal outcomes to identify what the team needs.
Coordinate with Sales Operations on CRM workflows, sales tools, process adoption, and reporting so that training and systems support one another.

Measure whether enablement is helping, using indicators such as ramp time, training completion, content use, rep confidence, process adoption, and relevant sales performance trends.
 ABOUT YOU 
3+ years of experience in sales enablement, sales training, sales, sales operations, product marketing, or a related commercial role.
Experience supporting a B2B sales team with a consultative or multi-stakeholder sales process.
Strong writing and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex products and ideas clear for different audiences.
Experience creating sales materials and delivering training or coaching that sellers can use in real customer conversations.
Strong project management skills and the ability to coordinate work across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations.
A practical, feedback-driven approach to improving programs, content, and workflows.
Familiarity with CRM and sales tools such as Salesforce, Gong, Seismic, or similar platforms.
Experience in employee benefits, healthcare, HR technology, fintech, or another complex B2B solution is a plus.
 HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED 
New sales hires ramp effectively and understand our product, buyers, and sales process.
Reps can explain our value clearly and adapt their approach to employers, brokers, and consultants.
Sales resources are current, easy to find, and used in the field.
Training and enablement programs improve targeted skills and support adoption of agreed sales practices.
Field feedback and sales performance data lead to useful, visible improvements in enablement.
 COMPENSATION 
Base Salary $120,000 to 140,000 + equity
 Range(s) is subject to change. Benepass takes a number of factors into account when determining individual starting pay, including market comparables, interview performance, peer compensation, and years of experience. 
 What We Offer 
95% coverage of medical, dental, and vision

$500/year Learning & Development Benefit
$150/month cell phone + internet
$100/month Wellness
$100/month Co-working and Commuter Benefit
We offer several team onsites a year
Flexible PTO
At Benepass, we are working towards reimagining how companies take care of their people. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all our employees and are seeking to build a team that reflects the diversity of the people we hope to serve with our revolutionary products. Benepass is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Manager - Revenue Operations & Analytics
description:
Manager Revenue Operations & Analytics
 Are you a results-driven leader who combines analytical expertise with a passion for improving business performance? Do you enjoy turning data into meaningful insights, leading high-performing teams, and helping organizations uncover revenue opportunities while mitigating risk? Join us and play a critical role in enabling sales success, optimizing operations, and driving revenue growth across the business.
 Key Information
 Employment Status: Full Time
Job Type: Hybrid – In office with flexibility to manage your work schedule with up to 8 days per month to work from home.
Location: London, Ontario
Vacancy Type: This position is for an existing vacancy.
Please note that we have two operating entities in Canada, CARFAX Inc., and CARFAX Canada. This position is with CARFAX Canada.
 Position Summary
 The Manager, Revenue Operations is responsible for supporting the sales and client-facing teams through reporting, analytics, process improvement, and operational leadership. This role ensures leaders have the insights and information needed to drive performance, improve productivity, and support revenue growth.
This individual will personally lead and oversee a team in the development and maintenance of reporting, dashboards, and business insights across Sales, Client Engagement, Commercial Sales, and Sales Operations. Working closely with stakeholders throughout the organization, they will translate business needs into meaningful metrics and actionable recommendations that help leaders make informed decisions and coach their teams effectively around key revenue opportunities.
This role will also lead initiatives to improve operational processes, identify revenue opportunities and risks, and support the ongoing evolution of revenue systems and workflows. Acting as a trusted advisor to the business, the Manager, Revenue Operations will partner with cross-functional teams to implement best practices, drive adoption of new processes, and ensure operational consistency across the revenue organization.
The role will provide analytical support and recommendations related to pricing, performance, productivity, and revenue optimization, helping leadership improve business results, reduce revenue leakage, prevent fraudulent behavior, and identify account misuse. The position will also perform both advisory and investigative activities and serve as a key point of contact for business and operational teams regarding revenue-risk, compliance, and operational process inquiries and initiatives.
 Position Responsibilities
 Revenue Analytics & Reporting
Lead the development and ongoing enhancement of reporting, dashboards, and business insights that support Sales, Client Engagement, Commercial Sales, and Sales Operations teams.
Translate business requirements into meaningful metrics and actionable insights that support decision-making, revenue growth, and performance management.
Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of revenue-related reporting and performance measures across the organization.
Partner with business stakeholders to identify reporting needs and support the successful implementation of process, reporting, and system enhancements.
 Revenue Risk & Compliance
Develop and maintain processes, policies, and controls designed to reduce revenue leakage, prevent fraudulent behavior, and identify account misuse.
Monitor and analyze revenue risk indicators, providing insights and recommendations to business leaders and governance committees.
Perform advisory and investigative activities related to operational, compliance, and revenue-risk matters.
Serve as a key point of contact for business and operational teams regarding revenue-risk, compliance, and process-related initiatives.
Lead initiatives that strengthen operational controls while balancing customer experience and business objectives.
 Revenue Operations & Process Improvement
Identify opportunities to improve revenue-generating processes, operational efficiency, and business performance.
Support the ongoing evolution and optimization of CRM, reporting, and revenue technology platforms.
Drive adoption of new processes, tools, and operational best practices across the revenue organization.
Develop scalable processes and measurement frameworks that support organizational growth and strategic priorities.
 Leadership & Collaboration
Lead, coach, and develop a team responsible for revenue reporting, analytics, and operational support.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Client Engagement, Product, IT, Finance, Legal, and other business partners to drive alignment and achieve organizational objectives.
Act as a trusted advisor to leadership by providing data-driven recommendations related to pricing, productivity, performance, and revenue optimization.
 Position Requirements
8+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, Analytics, or a related field, with increasing levels of responsibility.
Demonstrated experience leading/managing teams and cross-functional projects and driving operational improvements.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, risks, and opportunities through data.
Experience developing reporting, dashboards, and business insights to support decision-making and performance management.
Advanced knowledge of CRM, reporting, and business intelligence platforms.
Ability to think strategically while remaining hands-on in execution and day-to-day problem solving.
Proven ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively across multiple departments and levels of the organization.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience supporting initiatives related to process improvement, revenue optimization, compliance, risk management, or operational controls.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
 Compensation
 At CARFAX Canada, we believe in fair, transparent, and equitable compensation. This role has an annual salary range of $100,000 - $130,000 CAD. This role is also eligible for an annual performance-based bonus.
We recognize that every team member brings unique skills and experience. Compensation for this role will reflect your skills, experience, and career progression - whether you are developing and growing in your role or bringing extensive expertise to the team.
 Perks & Benefits
 At CARFAX Canada, we believe in total rewards and creating an exceptional employee experience. In addition to competitive compensation, our team members enjoy:
Weekly, free catered lunches at the office
Flexible work that allows us to prioritize work-life balance
4-day summer work weeks
A state-of-the-art collaborative environment at our head office at 100 Kellogg Lane, London Ontario
Exceptional benefits that take effect day one of employment
Flexible employee wellness funding,
Company matched pension program
Parental leave top-up benefits
Paid volunteer days
The list goes on!
Questions about compensation and the many perks and benefits of working at CARFAX? Ask us during the process - we can’t wait to hear from you!
Please note, some benefits may be subject to eligibility for employees.
 Equal Opportunity Employer
 CARFAX Canada is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, military veteran status, unemployment status, or any other status protected by law.
We’re committed to providing accommodations by request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. For a confidential inquiry or to request an accommodation, please contact your recruiter or email hr@carfax.ca.
If you are interested in applying for this position, please visit our website https://www.carfax.ca/careers. Applications will be accepted until 10/30/2026.
We thank all applicants for their interest; however only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
 About Us
 CARFAX Canada, a part of Mobility Global (NYSE: MBGL), is Canada’s definitive source of automotive information, delivering vehicle history, valuation and service solutions. Drawing on billions of data records from thousands of sources, its products enable used vehicle buyers, sellers and vehicle service providers to make informed decisions. CARFAX Canada is dedicated to transparency and is trusted to provide vehicle history, valuation and service information to dealerships, vehicle manufacturers, consumers, service shops, major auctions, governments, insurance providers and police agencies.
CARFAX‘s Canadian headquarters in London, Ontario is consistently recognized as a top employer and business.
Find out more at www.carfax.ca and connect with us on Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn

title: Go-to-Market (GTM) Manager
description:
Papaya Global is a rapidly growing, award-winning B2B tech unicorn with an ambitious mission to revolutionize the payroll & payments industry. With over $400M raised from multiple tier-one investors, our innovative technology provides a comprehensive solution for managing global workforces, encompassing everything from hiring and onboarding to managing and paying employees in over 160 countries.
We’re looking for an action-oriented GTM Manager to join our Go-to-Market organization and help turn Papaya’s products, innovation, and expertise into scalable commercial growth. 
This is not a traditional Product Marketing role. 
The GTM team sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, Marketing, and Client Success , owning how Papaya takes its products and services to market - from defining the story and positioning, to launching new capabilities, enabling our revenue teams, and ultimately helping drive adoption and revenue. 
We’re looking for someone who can think strategically but loves to execute. Someone who can understand a complex product, identify why it matters to a customer, turn it into a compelling commercial story, and give our sellers the tools and confidence to take that story to market. 
 What You’ll Do 
Own GTM strategy and execution for assigned Papaya products and Workforce OS service lines. 
Lead product and service launches end-to-end , from positioning and launch strategy through sales readiness, rollout, and adoption. 
Translate complex product capabilities into clear, compelling commercial stories and value propositions . 
Develop persona-based messaging and positioning that clearly articulates why Papaya, why now, and why we win . 
Partner closely with Product to understand the roadmap and turn innovation into market-ready propositions. 
Work directly with Sales and Account Management to understand what is happening in real deals, identify gaps, and continuously strengthen our positioning. 
Build and deliver sales plays that help Revenue teams identify opportunities, run stronger discovery, overcome objections, and close business. 
Own sales enablement for your service line, including training, storytelling sessions, product demos, competitive positioning, and launch readiness. 
Create the commercial assets sellers need to win, including pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, demo stories, landing pages, client-facing materials, and AI-powered sales tools. 
Develop competitive intelligence and ensure sellers understand how Papaya differentiates in the market. 
Partner with Marketing on campaigns, events, website messaging, thought leadership, and demand-generation initiatives. 
Use customer, prospect, seller, and market feedback to continuously improve our GTM strategy and messaging. 
Leverage AI to accelerate research, content creation, enablement, personalization, and GTM execution. 
Measure the impact of GTM initiatives through adoption, pipeline creation, conversion, product uptake, and revenue impact. 
 What Success Looks Like 
You will help ensure that when Papaya launches something new, the market understands why it matters , our sellers know how to sell it , our clients understand the value , and the business can measure the impact through adoption, pipeline, and revenue . 
3+ years of experience in Go-to-Market, Product Marketing, Product Strategy, or a similar commercial role within a B2B technology company. 
Strong commercial mindset with an understanding of how positioning, enablement, and product strategy translate into pipeline and revenue. 
Exceptional storytelling and communication skills with the ability to simplify complex products into compelling customer narratives. 
Experience developing GTM strategies, product launches, sales plays, and enablement programs. 
Strong understanding of persona-based messaging, competitive positioning, and value propositions. 
Comfortable working directly with Sales teams and using real opportunities and customer conversations to shape GTM strategy. 
Proven ability to leverage AI tools across research, content, enablement, personalization, and workflow automation. 
Experience in Payroll, Payments, HCM, HR Tech, FinTech, Workforce Management, or related B2B SaaS is a strong advantage. 
Highly collaborative and comfortable working across Product, Sales, Marketing, Client Success, and senior leadership. 
Hands-on, fast-moving, and comfortable operating in an environment where strategy and execution happen simultaneously. 
Strong ownership mentality—you don’t wait for someone else to move an initiative forward. 
Excellent attention to detail without losing sight of the broader commercial objective. 
Confident presenting, training, and influencing stakeholders at all levels. 
Native-level English.

title: RevOps Manager
description:
Appear is building the infrastructure that helps brands get cited by AI: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini. We're early, we're growing fast, and we need someone who can sell a category that didn't exist two years ago.
 Context 
Search is shifting. When someone asks ChatGPT which law firm, clinic, or software to use, the brands that get cited win the business, and most companies have no idea whether they're showing up. Appear fixes that. We measure AI visibility, identify the gaps, and build the content infrastructure to close them.
Tasks
Own HubSpot end-to-end: configuration, workflows, custom objects, pipelines, permissions, and data hygiene across Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, and Service Hub.
Design and maintain account and lead segmentation models that reflect our multiple GTM motions, ensuring each segment is routed and worked correctly.
Build and own lead routing logic, territory, round-robin, and rules-based that runs cleanly across concurrent motions and avoids conflicts or leakage.
Design, implement, and continuously tune lead scoring models (fit + engagement) that reflect the different buying signals across each motion.
Design and maintain lifecycle stages and scoring models that align Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success and Product-Led Growth.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports that give leadership real-time visibility into pipeline, funnel conversion, and revenue performance across all active motions.
Partner with Sales and Marketing leadership to identify process gaps and implement scalable solutions inside HubSpot.
Own integrations between HubSpot and the rest of the GTM stack (e.g. Slack, Lemlist, Instantly, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, billing/finance systems), evaluating and onboarding new tools as our needs evolve.
Use AI-powered enrichment and automation tools to keep contact, account, and pipeline data continuously updated, deduplicated, and accurate reducing manual data entry across the GTM team.
Establish and enforce data governance standards deduplication, field standardization, and enrichment processes.
Support quota and territory planning, forecasting, and compensation reporting with clean, reliable data.
Train and support end users across the GTM org on HubSpot best practices.
Requirements
3-5+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Marketing Operations, with deep hands-on HubSpot experience (admin-level required; HubSpot certifications a plus).
Proven experience building and maintaining HubSpot workflows, custom properties, reporting, and pipeline automation.
Hands-on experience designing segmentation, lead routing, and lead scoring models, ideally across more than one GTM motion running at once.

title: RevOps Lead
description:
About Kernel
 Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?
Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.
Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.
Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.
We have raised $14M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.
The Role
We’re looking for a RevOps Lead to own the systems, data and operating rhythms behind Kernel’s revenue engine. You’ll work across Sales, Marketing, and Finance to build and own GTM systems that take us to $100m+ ARR.
This is a builder role and our first dedicated RevOps hire. You’ll improve the foundations already in place while designing what Kernel’s RevOps model should become as we scale. You’ll also be Kernel’s own internal customer , deploying Kernel on our CRM to improve our data, pressure-test the product in real workflows and turn what we learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering.
You’ll report to Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations , and partner closely with our Finance & Operations team and GTM leadership.
What You’ll Be Doing
Run the revenue operating rhythm: own pipeline management, forecasting, funnel reporting, quota planning, GTM incentive compensation and the systems behind renewals and expansion - giving leadership a clear view of performance, risk and what needs attention
Make the GTM team more productive: simplify processes, automate repetitive work and improve handoffs so Sales, Marketing and Account Management can spend more time with customers and less time on admin
Make our outbound motion better: improve targeting, account prioritisation, routing, sequencing and performance measurement so the team consistently focuses on the right companies at the right time
Own the GTM tooling and tech stack: make Salesforce the source of truth, own the systems around it and ensure our sales engagement, enrichment, and automation tools work together reliably
Build trustworthy data and automation: improve data quality, reporting and AI-powered workflows across the sales process, with sensible controls, monitoring and human judgement where needed
Be Kernel’s own internal customer: deploy Kernel on Kernel’s CRM, use it to improve our GTM data and turn what we learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering
What You Bring
3+ years of experience in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations at a high-growth Series A-C SaaS company. You have owned meaningful parts of the revenue engine end to end, ideally as the first or one of the first RevOps operators
Deep Salesforce fluency: you understand objects, record types, fields, formulas, flows, validation rules, permissions, reports and data migration. You can reason about architecture and debug production behaviour
Commercial judgement: you understand how meetings become pipeline, how pipeline is qualified and forecast, and how won revenue flows into implementation, expansion, renewal and retention
Technical building ability: you have built and deployed AI or agent-assisted workflows into real operating processes, are comfortable with connecting different systems together, and can debug how systems behave
Strong analytical skills: you can build funnel, capacity and revenue models, work confidently in spreadsheets, and reconcile numbers across systems
Clear, low-ego communication: you can turn a messy request into a crisp decision, explain trade-offs to non-technical teams, push back constructively and drive adoption through influence rather than authority
 It Is a Plus If You Also Have
Experience supporting an enterprise sales motion with multi-stakeholder deals and MEDDPICC.
Experience with renewals, expansion, compensation, quota setting or planning
Familiarity with Gong, Slack workflows, sales engagement platforms and modern data or enrichment tooling
Experience building operational controls around LLM- or agent-powered workflows
⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:
Prefer strategy and recommendations over configuring systems, cleaning data, investigating edge cases and debugging workflows yourself
Need outlined requirements or stable priorities before you can make progress
See RevOps primarily as CRM administration or ticket fulfilment rather than a revenue-generating operating function
❌ This role is definitely not for you if you:
Are not comfortable taking broad ownership of a function
Prefer a predictable, low-intensity environment
Want to protect a 9-to-6 or a mostly remote setup - we are in the office together 4–5 days a week and the pace is high
What We Offer
We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.
💰 Salary: £70,000–£90,000 + equity
🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays
🥕 £450 monthly office dinner allowance
✈️ 2 weeks work-from-anywhere
🍼 Generous parental leave policy
💼 Pension plan
💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office
🎉 Team events and dinners
🚀 Work directly with the founders to deploy AI across a fast-growing company
🏆 High-autonomy, high-trust environment with a small team shipping at pace

 Stage 2 – Case study interview (in person) with the team.
 Stage 3 – Coffee chat with Sales & Marketing team
 Stage 4 – Values interview with the Founders.
