title: Sales Enablement & Revenue Operations Lead
description:
About Strategus 
 Strategus is an advertising technology company that helps brands and agencies drive measurable business outcomes through data-driven strategy, cross-channel media, and transparent reporting across every screen. From CTV and online video to display, streaming audio, and digital out-of-home, Strategus aligns every channel around the business results that matter most.
 Our culture is grounded in three values: Respect, Full Engagement, and Growth. They shape how we work, make decisions, and show up for clients and one another. Our north star is simple: make Strategus the best job you’ve ever had. That means building a high-performing team where people are trusted to contribute, supported in their development, and empowered to shape what comes next. Together, we’re helping define the future of CTV and programmatic advertising while delivering smarter outcomes for the clients who count on us. 
 About the role 
 Strategus is building a modern, insight-led sales organization for 2027, and we're looking for a Sales Enablement & Revenue Operations Lead to help get us there. Reporting to the EVP of Sales, you'll own new-seller onboarding, ongoing sales training, the sales playbook, and adoption of the tools our sellers use every day, including Salesforce, Gong, sales-intent and prospecting tools, and approved AI tools. 
 This is a hands-on role focused on how sellers work, not on forecasting, spreadsheet-heavy reporting, or sales-planning models. You'll measure whether training and tools are changing seller behavior, and partner with managers to close the gaps. 
 What you'll be doing as a Sales Enablement & Revenue Operations Lead: 
 Own the sales enablement strategy, program calendar, and day-to-day execution, aligned with Sales leadership's priorities 
 Build role-based learning paths covering Strategus positioning, products, sales methodology, core selling skills, sales processes, and tools 
 Run new-seller onboarding from day one through full productivity, with clear ramp milestones, practice assignments, and certifications 
 Partner with frontline managers to assess readiness through role-plays, account work, live opportunities, and Gong call reviews, and build targeted 30-day plans when a seller misses a milestone 
 Deliver ongoing training for new and experienced sellers on prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposals, objection handling, negotiation, closing, and client handoffs 
 Reinforce Challenger, MEDDIC, and other methods adopted by Sales leadership through real examples and live opportunities 
 Partner with Marketing, Product, and Planning to turn product launches, market insights, and approved messaging into seller-ready training 
 Equip frontline managers with coaching guides, practice exercises, and reinforcement plans so learning continues in team meetings, one-on-ones, and deal coaching 
 Drive adoption of Salesforce, sales-intent and prospecting tools, Gong, and approved AI tools, and teach sellers the practical workflow for each 
 Turn approved AI capabilities into everyday seller workflows for research, meeting prep, and drafting, with clear guidance on responsible use and protecting client information 
 Own the sales playbook and keep onboarding materials, job aids, recordings, and call examples current and easy to find 
 Track onboarding progress, certifications, proficiency, and tool adoption, and re-measure after each program to confirm seller behavior improved 
 Partner with platform owners on requirements, testing, and rollout of system improvements 
 Share regular, action-oriented updates with Sales leadership on progress, gaps, and recommended next steps 
 Qualifications: 
 5+ years of experience in sales enablement, sales training, revenue or sales operations, or a related commercial role 
 Proven track record of building and running onboarding and ongoing training programs that improve ramp and seller performance 
 Hands-on experience driving CRM adoption, preferably Salesforce, through practical training, workflow design, and manager reinforcement 
 Experience with Gong or a similar conversation-intelligence platform for coaching and skill development 
 Familiarity with sales-intent and prospecting tools and how sellers use them to prioritize accounts and personalize outreach 
 Experience teaching sales methodologies such as Challenger or MEDDIC 
 Ability to create clear learning paths, role-plays, job aids, certifications, and playbooks 
 Comfortable using adoption data, performance signals, and field feedback to find gaps and show what's working 
 Practical experience with AI-enabled sales workflows and sound judgment about protecting client and company information 
 Excellent facilitation, coaching, writing, and project-management skills, with credibility among sellers, managers, and sales leaders 
 A hands-on, change-oriented approach focused on helping people apply new skills, not just delivering training 
 Experience in digital advertising, ad tech, or media sales preferred 
 Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field preferred 
 We offer a base salary of $100,000-$120,000, but that's just the starting point. This role includes a profit share bonus of up to 15%, plus a full benefits package, because we believe in rewarding the people who help us grow.
 Strategus is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion, as well as non-discrimination in employment. All qualified applicants receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, veteran status, disability unrelated to performing the essential task of the job or other legally protected categories. If you're smart, scrappy and good at what you do, come as you are. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment.

Experience teaching sales methodologies such as Challenger or MEDDIC
Proven track record building seller onboarding and training programs

Ad tech media sales is outside his SaaS post-sale domain, and ad tech experience is preferred.

title: GTM Systems Manager
description:
About The Role NOTE:
Priority will be given to candidates available to work on-site in New York City or Montreal, QC, Canada.
As GTM Systems Manager, you will own the architecture, integration, and optimization of our Sales and Marketing technology stack. This is a role at the intersection of systems design, marketing and revenue operations, and process implementation. You will be the primary owner of our core GTM tools, including HubSpot as our system of record, along with Gong, Clay, and adjacent tools.
You will own the systems roadmap and serve as a thought partner to Sales and Marketing leadership on how the platform foundation can drive efficiency and revenue outcomes. You will design the workflows and automation that scale with us, and ruthlessly prioritize the work that moves the business forward.
Responsibilities GTM Tech Stack Ownership
Own the architecture and day-to-day operation of the Sales and Marketing tech stack, with HubSpot as the system of record
Evaluate, implement, and integrate adjacent tools (Gong, Clay, and others) to create a cohesive, high-leverage revenue infrastructure
Lead system integrations and ensure clean, reliable data flows across the stack via native connectors, middleware, and API-based integrations
Make build, buy, or kill decisions on tools. Consolidate where possible, eliminate redundancy
Maintain a documented system architecture so the stack remains legible and scalable as the team grows
Proactively find opportunities for process automation across the GTM org by leveraging AI and workflow tooling.
HubSpot Administration
Serve as the primary HubSpot admin: users, teams, permissions, properties, pipelines, and lifecycle stages
Build and maintain workflows, automations, and reporting that power day-to-day Sales and Marketing operations
Establish and enforce data governance: property naming conventions, picklist hygiene, deduplication, and record lifecycle policies
Business Process Design
Partner with Sales and Marketing leaders to document and continuously improve the core GTM business processes, including lead-to-opportunity, opportunity-to-close, customer onboarding, renewal, and expansion
Identify friction points in the revenue motion before they become bottlenecks. Propose and ship solutions
Build the operational foundation for new GTM motions (outbound plays, ABM programs, PLG signals, etc.) as the company evolves
AI & Automation
Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to repetitive GTM workflows like enrichment, routing, follow-up, and reporting
Stay current with developments across the modern revenue stack and bring a point of view on where we should be investing
Enablement & Adoption
Partner with Enablement to ensure reps actually use the systems you build
Document workflows, build training materials, and run change management for new processes and tools
Measure adoption and iterate. A system no one uses is a system that doesn't exist
Act as the internal subject matter expert and escalation point for systems and process questions
Support with other responsibilities and projects as required
Qualifications
5+ years of experience in revenue operations, GTM systems, or sales operations in a B2B SaaS environment
Hands-on CRM expertise. You've architected a CRM from the ground up, not just used it. HubSpot experience and certifications are a plus.
Strong understanding of how CRM integrates across the modern revenue stack, from prospecting and enrichment through conversation intelligence and CS tooling
Proven ability to translate business requirements into scalable systems and process solutions
Comfortable in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment. We're growing quickly, and things change every day
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, establishing new processes while streamlining existing ones
Strategic thinker who is also execution-oriented. Comfortable operating at altitude and in the weeds in the same week
Bias for action and strong opinions held loosely. You bring a point of view to every conversation
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Comfortable working cross-functionally with Sales, CS, Marketing, and Finance
Strong documentation habits and attention to detail
Curiosity about AI tools and how they can streamline revenue workflows
Why Ethyca?

 Growth: Collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry and continue to grow your skills in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Benefits
Competitive cash and equity compensation
100% medical and dental insurance coverage for you and your dependent(s)
Remote-friendly office hours and vacation policy
Sponsored company lunches and events
Generous Parental leave

That's why we celebrate individuals' strengths, skills, and interests — from your first interview to your long-term growth — rather than rely on traditional career ladders. title: Manager, Customer Success
description:
About Schema App 
Schema App is a fast-growing, profitable SaaS company headquartered in Guelph, Ontario, with a team across Canada. We’re a smart, collaborative group driven by a shared mission: to become a global leader in enterprise marketing technology and help organizations future-proof for the age of AI.
We work with some of the world’s most recognized enterprises, including SAP, Wells Fargo, and Henry Ford Health, to give them control over how their brand is understood and represented by AI across search and digital experiences.
At our core, we believe that in the age of AI, a brand is only as strong as the data behind it and the connections within it. As search evolves into AI-driven and agent-led experiences, that foundation becomes critical. That’s why we’re building the infrastructure enterprises need to control how they show up in AI today and compete in the agentic web tomorrow: driving growth, protecting their brand, and leading in the next generation of digital experiences.
Visit Schema App at www.schemaapp.com or on LinkedIn.
We are hiring a Manager, Customer Success to lead and develop a high-performing Customer Success team that helps Enterprise customers realize measurable value, build strategic partnerships, renew with confidence, and expand their adoption of Schema App.
 About the Role 
The Manager, Customer Success leads, coaches, and develops a team of Customer Success Managers to deliver exceptional customer outcomes, build strategic relationships, and drive retention and growth.
You will establish clear processes, performance expectations, and accountability to ensure consistent execution across the customer base. You will oversee customer health, adoption, renewal readiness, expansion opportunities, and revenue forecasting, proactively addressing risks and coaching the team to success.
You will own the team's execution of renewals and expansion opportunities, ensuring Customer Success operates as a revenue-responsible function while maintaining strong customer partnerships. You will collaborate closely with Customer Delivery, Sales, Product, and Engineering to deliver a seamless customer experience and support Schema App's growth.
Reporting to the Director, Customer Success & Delivery , you are an experienced SaaS people leader who combines strong coaching skills, commercial acumen, and operational discipline to drive team performance and customer success.
 Functional Accountabilities 
 Lead, Coach, and Develop a High-Performing Customer Success Team 
Hire, onboard, coach, and develop CSMs who take ownership of customer and commercial outcomes.
Set clear goals and scorecards, provide regular feedback, address performance gaps, and conduct quarterly talent and coaching reviews.
Partner with the Director to translate company priorities into team plans, deliver quarterly initiatives, and build future leadership capability while modelling Schema App’s values.
 Drive Customer Retention and Expansion 
Own team performance against retention, renewal, and expansion goals.
Coach CSMs on early renewal planning, value-based business cases, qualified growth opportunities, and commercial conversations.
Maintain accurate forecasts, clear close plans, and early visibility into risk.
Review pricing and negotiation strategies with the Director and RevOps, ensuring commercial decisions protect customer trust and company goals.
 Deliver Measurable Value and Strategic Enterprise Relationships 
Ensure customers have clear success plans, adoption goals, and credible evidence of progress.
Improve Business Reviews and proactive recommendations so customers understand results and next steps.
Coach CSMs to build relationships across technical, program, economic-buyer, and executive stakeholders.
Personally support priority accounts, executive alignment, transitions, and escalations where leadership involvement improves outcomes.
 Build Scalable Operations and Cross-Functional Partnerships 
Establish consistent account standards, current customer records, and operating rhythms that surface risk and guide decisions.
Balance portfolios and capacity, anticipate staffing needs, and resolve competing priorities.
Partner with Customer Delivery on clear handoffs: CSMs own customer strategy, communication, value, and commercial outcomes; Delivery owns technical execution.
Bring customer insights to Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering, and close the feedback loop.
 AI First 
Actively uses and continuously improves AI to become more effective and efficient in daily work.
Builds strong prompting skills, uses available AI tools well, and creates agents leveraging available data/integrations to automate manual tasks.
Demonstrates curiosity and resourcefulness by exploring opportunities to improve how work gets done, taking accountability for quality of output, sharing what they learn, and helping the team adopt better AI-enabled ways of working.
Ensure AI is consistently used where it adds value, streamline key workflows, and turn what works into documented playbooks.
Continuously improve the “Schema App way” by incorporating team learnings, driving adoption of standard approaches, and preparing the team to scale.
 Key Competencies 
 People Leadership and Coaching: Sets clear expectations, develops capability, gives constructive feedback, addresses performance gaps, and builds accountability and engagement.
 Enterprise Relationships and Executive Communication: Builds trust across stakeholders and communicates customer value, recommendations, risks, and decisions clearly to executives and teams.
 Commercial Acumen: Connects customer outcomes to retention and expansion, coaches negotiations, and applies sound judgment to revenue opportunities and trade-offs.
 Strategic Thinking and Execution: Translates company goals into focused plans and measurable action while balancing customer needs, team capacity, and business priorities.
 Operational and Analytical Judgment: Uses data and repeatable processes to identify patterns, anticipate risk, allocate capacity, and improve performance.
 Cross-Functional Influence and Change Leadership: Builds productive partnerships, resolves ownership gaps, and helps teams adopt new processes and ways of working.
 Market Proficiency and Learning Agility: Develops and applies knowledge of Enterprise SaaS, structured data, knowledge graphs, SEO, and AI search through curiosity, feedback, and learning.
 Success Metrics 
Achievement of the annual Customer Success targets for NRR and GRR
100% of renewals completed by their contractual deadline, with no avoidable overdue renewals
85% average customer health score
At least 90% Business Review satisfaction, with consistent adoption of the defined Business Review standard across eligible customers
 AI-based tools may be used to support screening; all resumes are reviewed by a member of our team. 
 Life @ Schema App 
Culture focused on your growth: Weekly 1:1 with conversations around Professional Development
Great benefits for health & wellness, and your coverage starts as soon as you do
RRSP matching!
Flex days to re-energize on top of vacation days and you don’t work on your birthday
The Culture Club keeps our virtual team connected through fun and innovative events
Diverse smart team! The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be
Schema App’s purpose is to build meaningful connections, with each other, our customers, and the data so that we are all understood. We are a team of smart people helping each other solve hard problems.
If you require accommodation during the application process, please let us know. We are committed to an inclusive work environment and welcome applicants of all backgrounds and perspectives.

title: Head of Customer Success Enablement
description:
The Work We Do 
Teciem designs, builds, and delivers treasury and capital markets software solutions for financial institutions worldwide. We serve banks of every size and geography, offering the right setup for the right need.
Our solutions are designed to replace multiple disconnected systems with one complete, front-to-back platform, helping customers to capture trading and business opportunities quickly, clearly and with control. We cover the entire trading lifecycle, ensuring that everything - from execution to position keeping, to risk management – runs smoothly.
With decades of experience and one of the largest, most diverse client bases in the industry, we turn deep industry knowledge into software that covers most asset classes, meets complex real-world treasury and capital market's needs, and adapts as markets evolve. 


 Head of Customer Success Enablement 
 London | Reports to: Chief Customer Officer 
 The organisation 
 Teciem is a financial software solutions provider. Treasury and capital markets run through our name, our heritage and our DNA. Through strategic acquisitions and continuous innovation, our people and products have pioneered financial software solutions as part of Misys and Thomson Reuters and most recently leveraged scale as the Treasury and Capital Markets business within Finastra. Now with our new name, increased ambition and a new strategy we are in a phase of accelerated growth, innovation and transformation with a culture infused by transparency, accountability, performance orientation, our customer mindset and our people. 
 The opportunity 
 Teciem is building a new Customer organisation under the Chief Customer Officer, with clear accountability for customer health, retention and lifecycle outcomes. This role defines how Customer Success is done at Teciem: the roadmap, the best practice, the playbooks and the skills that let every CSM deliver consistent, measurable value to treasury and capital markets customers. 
 Role purpose 
 Build a consistent, high-performing Customer Success capability, so that every CSM runs proven plays, evidences the value customers receive, and drives renewal and expansion readiness. 
 Core accountabilities 
 Own the Customer Success roadmap: how the CS function and its capabilities evolve over time 
 Design Customer Success best practice across the lifecycle and for each customer segment 
 Own the CS playbooks for Expand, Renew and Risk, and ensure they are adopted 
 Own value validation: the frameworks and methods CSMs use to evidence customer value 
 Own CSM enablement: onboarding, training, certification and ongoing capability building 
 Key distinction: 
 Customer Success Enablement owns how CSMs work: roadmap, best practice, playbooks, value and skills 
 CCO Operations & Programs owns the data, signals, tooling, escalation management and programme mechanics those depend on 
 Head of Customer Experience owns VoC, NPS, CAB, advocacy and community 
 CRO owns renewals, expansion deals and bookings 
 Scope of Responsibility (Direct ownership) 
 Enablement (primary focus) 
 CS Roadmap Management (CS capability roadmap, priorities, maturity model) 
 Best Practice Design (engagement models, success plan standards, lifecycle motions) 
 CS Playbooks (Expand, Renew, Risk) 
 Value Validation (value frameworks, value reviews, customer value evidence) 
 CSM Enablement (onboarding, training curriculum, certification, coaching) 
 Capability & standards 
 CSM competency framework and career pathways 
 Quality standards for success plans and Quarterly Business Reviews 
 Knowledge base and best practice sharing across regions 
 Matrix / shared alignment (no direct ownership) 
 Sales / CRO 
 Renewals and expansion deals (fully owned by Sales) 
 Alignment of Expand and Renew plays with sales motions and Sales Enablement 
 COO 
 Onboarding and delivery handovers (Professional Services) 
 Support processes referenced in playbooks 
 CPO / CTO 
 Product knowledge and release readiness for CSMs 
 Product value drivers that inform value frameworks 
 HR / People 
 Learning platforms, career frameworks and performance cycles 
 CCO peers 
 CCO Operations & Programs: signals, health scores, CS platform, at-risk and escalation governance that playbooks run on 
 Customer Experience: VoC insight that informs best practice 
 Important clarifications 
 The role does not line-manage CSMs. It builds their capability; CSM line managers own day-to-day performance 
 The role does not own renewals or expansion deals. It equips CSMs to drive renewal and expansion readiness 
 The role does not own CS data, tooling or risk governance mechanics. It defines the plays that use them 
 Key Responsibilities 
 CS roadmap management 
 Define and maintain the Customer Success roadmap in line with the CCO strategy 
 Assess CS maturity and prioritise the capabilities, processes and programmes needed next 
 Work with CCO Operations & Programs to plan and track delivery of roadmap initiatives 
 Best practice design 
 Design the lifecycle motions CSMs run, from onboarding readiness through adoption, renewal and expansion 
 Define engagement models by segment, aligned with the CCO coverage framework 
 Set standards for success plans and QBRs, and review quality across the team 
 CS playbooks (Expand, Renew, Risk) 
 Build and maintain Expand, Renew and Risk playbooks: triggers, actions, owners and exit criteria 
 Align Expand and Renew plays with Sales motions, and Risk plays with the At-risk process 
 Measure playbook adoption and effectiveness, and refine plays based on outcomes 
 Value validation 
 Develop value frameworks by product and use case that reflect how treasury and capital markets customers measure success 
 Equip CSMs to agree measurable outcomes in success plans and evidence them in value reviews 
 Build a library of validated value stories to support renewals, expansion and advocacy 
 CSM enablement 
 Run CSM onboarding to reduce time to productivity 
 Own the training curriculum and certification: CS methodology, product, domain and commercial skills 
 Provide coaching and skills development, informed by the competency framework 
 Drive adoption of CS tools and processes in partnership with CCO Operations & Programs 
 Success metrics: 
 Primary 
 Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) 
 Playbook adoption and effectiveness 
 % of accounts with success plans containing validated, measurable outcomes 
 CSM ramp time to full productivity 
 CSM certification and competency coverage 
 Secondary 
 Retention and expansion outcomes where plays are run (influence) 
 Success plan and QBR quality scores 
 CS roadmap delivery against plan 
 Validated value stories captured 
 Operating model principles 
 Clear RACI (critical) 
 CS Enablement → CS roadmap, best practice, playbooks, value validation, CSM capability 
 CCO Operations & Programs → operating model, customer insight, tooling, renewal and risk process, escalation management, Always-N programme 
 Head of Customer Experience → VoC, NPS, CAB, advocacy, community 
 CSM line managers → day-to-day CSM performance and account execution 
 CRO → sales, account planning, renewals, bookings 
 COO → delivery, upgrade execution, support, escalation resolution 
 Product → roadmap 
 Objective: one consistent, repeatable way of doing Customer Success across every region and segment. 
 Organisation design 
 Reports to 
 Chief Customer Officer 
 What this role is not 
 Not a CSM line management role 
 Not a Sales Enablement or renewals ownership role 
 Not a training-only function 
 It is the owner of how Customer Success is done at Teciem, accountable for a consistent, high-performing CSM capability. 


 Diverse Minds, Shared Ambition 
At Teciem, we believe that our strength comes from the diversity of our people. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fuel our innovation and help us build solutions that truly make a difference in the world of financial technology.
We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, heard, and empowered to grow. Here, you can bring your whole self to work, contribute your unique ideas, and be part of a team driven by shared ambition.
We welcome talent from all walks of life and encourage applications from individuals of all genders, races, ages, abilities, identities, and beliefs. Together, we’re shaping a culture where diversity isn’t just celebrated — it’s essential to our success.

title: Marketing & GTM Operations Lead (Hybrid)

Marketing & GTM Operations Lead 
With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 
Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.
 About the Job 
As the Marketing & GTM Operations Lead, you will architect and modernize the operational foundation connecting marketing, enablement, and customer-facing teams. You will drive cross-functional efficiency by eliminating manual bottlenecks and designing scalable, automated, and AI-assisted workflows across the lead-to-revenue lifecycle. In this high-leverage role, you will balance strategic systems architecture with hands-on execution, prototyping intelligent automations and translating operational insights into executive business cases. Ultimately, your work will empower go-to-market teams to accelerate pipeline velocity, optimize conversion, and focus on high-impact customer engagements.
 Responsibilities 
Audit and re-engineer end-to-end go-to-market processes—including lead capture, enrichment, routing, and handoffs—to eliminate operational friction and accelerate pipeline velocity.
Architect, deploy, and maintain scalable automation frameworks across marketing, enablement, and product releases using a structured impact-versus-effort prioritization model.
Identify, pilot, and implement practical AI applications and intelligent agents that streamline research, campaign production, and reporting while maintaining strict quality and data privacy standards.
Serve as the technical and operational owner of the marketing technology and CRM ecosystem, ensuring seamless data hygiene, governance, lifecycle management, and reliable attribution modeling.
Design robust operational dashboards and reporting suites to track core performance metrics, evaluate campaign return on investment, and deliver data-backed strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to translate complex business requirements into unified definitions, technical architectures, and seamless operational handoffs.
 Minimum Qualifications 
3+ years of experience in marketing operations, revenue operations, or go-to-market operations, supporting complex B2B sales cycles.
Demonstrated hands-on experience administering marketing automation platforms and CRM systems, including architecting cross-platform integrations.
Proven track record of designing, shipping, and maintaining workflow automations that measurably improve operational velocity, team efficiency, or revenue outcomes.
Direct experience evaluating, testing, and implementing applied AI tools or automated workflows within day-to-day business processes.
Demonstrated analytical skills in full-funnel data analysis, pipeline attribution modeling, and translating operational data into cross-functional business recommendations.
 Preferred Qualifications 
Experience with enterprise integration and orchestration platforms (such as Zapier, Make, Workato, or n8n) and B2B data enrichment platforms.
Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, relational database querying (SQL), or scripting.
Experience building, deploying, or testing large language model (LLM)-based workflows or autonomous agents.
Background working within account-based marketing (ABM) or product-led growth (PLG) operating models.
Experience evaluating technology vendors, managing vendor relationships, and leading build-versus-buy analyses.
This posting is for an existing vacancy.
 Benefits and Perks 
Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
Focus on mental health and well-being:
Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
Company-paid subscription to Headspace
Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
Paid parental leave
Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
Paid volunteer time
Focus on your career growth:
Development Dollars
Leadership development
Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
Travel Discounts
Employee Resource Groups
20 days of paid time off
Private health and dental insurance
Life and Disability insurance
The best connections happen face-to-face, whether you’re sitting down to dinner or having coffee with a coworker. That’s why OpenTable has adopted a hybrid workplace model. This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office two days a week—giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility.

ABOUT CIVILGRID 
CivilGrid is the trusted civil design platform powering affordable infrastructure renewal and growth. We give utilities, civil engineers, and municipalities a single, collaborative source of truth for what's underground so teams can plan, design, and build faster, smarter, and safer.
Our platform consolidates utility records, geotechnical and environmental data, paving moratoriums, and jurisdictional requirements directly from 3,000+ utilities, agencies, and municipalities with full chain-of-custody documentation. Teams at PG&E, Mark Thomas, and dozens of leading engineering firms use CivilGrid to cut research time by up to 88%, reduce project costs, prevent dig-ins, and accelerate delivery on the projects that keep communities running.
We're a venture-backed Series A startup tackling a $4.7T US infrastructure market that has been underserved by software for decades. Founded by industry insiders, each with 10+ years in utilities and civil engineering, we move fast, ship work that matters, and stay close to the customers and field teams we build for.
 WHY THIS ROLE 
As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you'll own CivilGrid's largest and most complex customer relationships. These include enterprise utilities, state DOTs, and national engineering firms, where CivilGrid is rolling out across many teams, regions and projects. You'll be the executive-level partner for these accounts. You'll turn early wins into organization-wide adoption, multi-year renewals and expansion.
This role reports to the Manager of Customer Success. This is a remote position, but our primary location preference is Texas. We are also considering candidates in Colorado, Georgia, Kansas City (MO), and Chicago. We are not considering candidates located outside of these markets at this time.
 WHAT YOU'LL DO 
Own a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts end to end: pilot, adoption, health, renewal and expansion
Build and maintain strategic account plans that map org structure, stakeholders, business priorities and whitespace across departments and regions
Build and keep relationships with executive sponsors (VPs and Directors of engineering, gas and electric operations, GIS and asset management) as well as day-to-day champions
Lead executive business reviews that tie CivilGrid usage to customer outcomes
Partner with Solutions Engineers on pilot and deployment strategy, set success criteria, and turn successful pilots into enterprise rollouts
Drive expansion with Account Executives: find new teams, use cases and products, and co-own the commercial motion
Spot and reduce risk early, and run escalations across Product, Engineering and Operations when needed
Bring structured voice-of-customer input to Product, shaping the roadmap around enterprise requirements
Develop case studies and references with flagship customers
Help build CivilGrid’s enterprise CS playbook, including account planning, EBR frameworks and health scoring, and serve as a model for the wider CS team
 WHAT YOU'LL BRING 
6+ years in customer success, account management or consulting roles, including managing enterprise accounts with complex, multi-stakeholder buying groups
A track record of driving renewals and expansion in large accounts, ideally utilities, DOTs, public agencies or AEC firms
Comfort working with executives: you can run a QBR/EBR with a VP and hold a technical conversation with a GIS lead in the same week
Strong commercial instincts and the ability to build a business case and quantify ROI
Strong technical aptitude, with familiarity in civil design, utility operations or infrastructure data
A strong bias toward action, comfort having a point of view, and the judgment to work independently with limited guidance
Willingness to travel 30–50% for on-site executive meetings, account planning sessions and fieldwork
 BONUS POINTS 
Background in civil engineering, utilities or a related field
Experience at an early-stage or high-growth SaaS company
CAD and/or GIS experience
 HOW WE WORK 
We're a small, but rapidly growing team that ships. Expect direct feedback, real ownership from day one, and proximity to customers — huge utilities, public agencies, and engineering firms whose work depends on what we build. We default to in-person collaboration where it matters and remote-friendly flexibility otherwise. We hire people who care deeply about their craft and the communities our customers serve.
 COMPENSATION & BENEFITS 
 The OTE for this role is $130,000 - $190,000 with a 70/30 base to commission split. 
Cash is only one part of your total compensation package at CivilGrid, which also includes meaningful early-stage equity, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to shape a category-defining company. The base salary range listed above may encompass various levels and/or geographic locations; final offers are determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, level, and work location.
Additionally, we offer:
Company-funded medical, dental, and vision insurance — including medical plans at no cost to the employee
FSA (health and dependent care)
Unlimited PTO and a culture that expects you to actually use it
401(k) plan
Flexible, remote-friendly work environment
A high-trust team, real ownership, and the chance to do the most meaningful work of your career
 EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY 
CivilGrid is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Employment decisions at CivilGrid are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact us — we're happy to help.
hard_gaps: Familiarity with civil design, utility operations or infrastructure data
flags: band 91000-133000 USD starts below your 130000 USD CS floor -- only the top half clears it
CSM in US-Remote at a non-standout company
Remote hiring is limited to TX, CO, GA, Kansas City and Chicago; candidates elsewhere are not considered.
30–50% travel for on-site executive meetings and fieldwork is a heavy load.
Base derived from a 70/30 OTE split; only the top of the band clears the $130K CS floor.
Series A startup with no NL, IE, UK or CA presence, so no internal transfer route abroad.
verdict: Solid enterprise CSM fit, but this is a lateral US runway role with location limits, heavy travel and borderline base pay.

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager - EMEA
description:
About Sigma Computing
Sigma Computing is at the forefront of cloud-based analytics and business intelligence, transforming the way businesses leverage their data to make informed decisions. Our platform bridges the gap between complex data queries and business insights, providing an intuitive interface for users of all technical backgrounds.
We're looking for a Customer Success Manager with a deep understanding of analytics and business intelligence to join our team. This role is critical for ensuring our customers maximize the value they derive from our platform, with a direct focus on improving Net Dollar Retention (NDR) through strategic account management and growth initiatives.
 Key Responsibilities: 
Strategic Account Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with decision-makers and influencers within our customer base, with a focus on high-value accounts.
Analytics Expertise: Leverage your deep understanding of analytics and business intelligence to guide customers in optimizing their use of Sigma Computing's platform. Help them understand their data and gain actionable insights.
NDR Growth: Develop and implement strategies aimed at maximizing NDR. This includes identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling, as well as reducing churn through proactive engagement and solution-oriented support.
Customer Advocacy: Serve as the bridge between our customers and our product team. Advocate for features, enhancements, and integrations that will drive customer satisfaction and retention.
Success Plans: Collaborate with customers to develop and execute success plans that align Sigma Computing's capabilities with the customer's business goals and objectives.
Educational Initiatives: Design and deliver training sessions, webinars, and workshops to increase product knowledge, adoption, and engagement among our user base.
 Required Skills / Experience: 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
7+ years of experience in a customer success, account management, or consultative role within the SaaS, analytics, or business intelligence industry.
Experience navigating complex enterprise sales environments with multiple priorities and stakeholders
Strong analytical skills with a proven ability to solve complex problems using data.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a knack for building trust and driving engagement.
Demonstrated ability to manage and grow customer accounts, specifically focusing on net dollar retention.
Experience with SQL, data visualization tools, and cloud-based analytics platforms highly preferred (Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery)
ETL experience
Experience implementing production business intelligence solutions
Startup experience
 Additional Job details 
Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work at Sigma Computing. This role is eligible for a variable pay (based on goal achievement), stock options, as well as a comprehensive benefits package.
 If you do not feel that you satisfy all the listed requirements, we encourage you to still apply. 
 About us: 
Sigma is the AI Apps and agentic analytics platform built on the cloud data warehouse. Business and technical teams use Sigma to explore live data, build intelligent applications, and automate critical workflows all without moving data or breaking governance. Sigma supports a spreadsheet interface, SQL, Python, and native AI in a single governed workspace, giving every team the speed to act and IT the control to scale. Sigma is trusted by more than 2,000 customers, including AMD, Duolingo, Colgate-Palmolive, and JPMorgan Chase. 
Sigma announced its $80M in Series E financing in May 2026. The round was led by Princeville Capital, with new strategic investors Databricks Ventures, ServiceNow Ventures, and Workday Ventures participating alongside returning investors Altimeter Capital, Avenir Growth Capital, D1 Capital Partners, K5 Global, NewView Capital, Spark Capital, Sutter Hill Ventures, and XN. This milestone follows Sigma reaching $200M in annual recurring revenue in April 2026, with more than 100% year-over-year growth and 1.1 million new active users added in the latest fiscal year.
Come join us!
Benefits For Our Full-Time Employees:
Equity 
Generous health benefits
Flexible time off policy. Take the time off you need!
Paid bonding time for all new parents
Traditional and Roth 401k
Commuter and FSA benefits
Lunch Program
Dog friendly office
Sigma is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a smart and strong team regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, veteran, or any other protected status. We look forward to learning how your experience can enable all of us to grow.
 Note: We have an in-office work environment in all our offices in SF, NYC, London and Sydney. All roles have a 25% travel expectation unless explicitly stated otherwise. 
 Our Privacy Practices 
When you submit a job application on this site, Sigma processes your personal data for the purposes of evaluating your candidacy for employment at Sigma and as otherwise needed throughout the recruitment and hiring process. Please review Sigma’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more details. Please note that your personal data may be transferred to a country other than the one in which it was provided (including to the USA, the UK, and Canada, Australia). 
 Sigma’s use of AI 
This hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.
hard_gaps: Deep understanding of analytics and business intelligence
ETL experience
Experience implementing production business intelligence solutions

Role is technical BI-flavoured CS; Snowflake/Databricks and SQL depth expected, and Tom has only basic SQL.
Unspecified seniority; the 7+ years bar suggests mid-level CSM rather than Senior/Principal scope.
25% travel expectation stated by default for all roles.
verdict: Strong brand, and the NDR focus fits, but this is a lateral CSM role needing BI/ETL depth Tom lacks; marginal.

description:

 One of Canada’s Most Trusted Investment Brands. 
At Picton Mahoney Asset Management (PICTON Investments), being alternative isn’t just what we do, it’s who we are.
Founded by industry pioneer David Picton, we’ve spent 20 years challenging conventional wisdom and redefining the investing landscape. As one of Canada’s most trusted investment brands, we are proudly independent, privately run, 100% employee-owned, and deeply committed to delivering results for our clients.
 Thinking Alternatively is in Our DNA. 
With a team of 250 bold thinkers - one-third dedicated solely to investment management - we are specialists, not generalists. Managing over $19.9 billion (September 30, 2026) for institutional and retail clients, we navigate markets with conviction, resilience, and a forward-thinking approach.
We’re more than investors; we’re innovators. We challenge traditional investment mindsets, constantly pushing the boundaries to achieve our mission: to bring greater certainty to investors.
 Our success is built on four guiding principles: 
Treat investors’ money like our own.
Redefine the way investors invest.
Be human, always approachable.
Succeed together, one investment at a time.
These aren’t just words. They define how we think, how we invest, and how we work.
Now, we’re entering our next chapter. We’re transforming our brand and reshaping the way the world invests. If you think alternatively, embrace an entrepreneurial spirit, and thrive in a dynamic, bureaucracy-free environment, join us and be part of what’s next.
 Thriving in Our Entrepreneurial Culture 
At PICTON Investments , you’ll thrive in our creative and dynamic workplace, where collaboration and support are at the core of everything we do. At our firm, you’ll have the opportunity to take on significant responsibilities, work in a flexible environment, and tackle challenging projects from the outset. Our culture is designed for ambitious professionals who want to make an immediate impact while continuing to push boundaries and achieve our greater mission. You’ll be empowered with a high level of responsibility, trust, and flexibility, providing an exciting and creative space for you to help reshape how the world views alternative investments. With competitive total rewards, performance-based bonuses, and a clear path for career growth, you’ll have everything you need to develop both now and over the longer term.
 The Opportunity 
Be the link between strategy and the field. PICTON Investments is currently looking for a Lead, Senior Sales Enablement to improve the effectiveness, productivity and execution of our Retail Sales organization. Reporting under the Revenue Operations team and working closely with Sales Leadership, you will translate commercial priorities into practical programs, tools, processes and sales disciplines that help External and Internal Sales teams execute against the firm’s growth objectives.
Working across Sales, Marketing, Product, Operations, Compliance and Technology, you will combine sales effectiveness, process improvement, training, strategic initiative execution and cross-functional coordination. The position has a sales-first mandate, with Retail Sales as your primary internal customer.
The expected annual base salary for this role is $100,000 to $120,000 with the final number depending on your experience, skills, and education. On top of that, you’ll be eligible for our discretionary bonus program.
At PICTON Investments , being employee-owned means we really take care of our team. Eligible employees get access to a full benefits package - including profit sharing, health and wellness coverage, life and disability insurance, paid time off and holidays, learning and development programs, and more - many elements of which are fully covered or subsidized by us.
 You’ll have the opportunity to learn and lead: 
 Sales Strategy & Execution 
Partner with Sales Leadership to turn business objectives into clear sales initiatives and execution plans.
Maintain an enablement and initiative plan with Sales Leadership, reviewed on a weekly basis, that sets the priorities and sequencing of campaigns and initiatives.
Lead the rollout of sales initiatives, products and campaigns across Retail Sales, ensuring teams know the audience, positioning, actions and measures of success.
Identify barriers to execution and resolve them with internal partners.
 Performance, Process & Technology 
Drive adoption of KPIs, scorecards and performance insights, working with Sales Leadership and Revenue Operations to turn them into coaching priorities and action.
Streamline sales processes and workflows, identifying inefficiencies, and scaling what works across territories.
Reinforce Salesforce and sales technology use in day-to-day sales routines, in coordination with the CRM Operations team bring field feedback back to CRM Operations & Engineers.
Identify gaps in process and performance, and build training, onboarding, playbooks and tools that improve execution and outcomes
 Cross-Functional Partnership 
Be the connection point between Retail Sales and Marketing, Product, Compliance, Operations, and Technology, ensuring cross-functional coordination during campaigns and initiatives.
Serve as a direct point of contact for sales to raise enablement needs.
Bring field insights back to Sales Leadership and Revenue Operations to inform strategy, programs, tools and communications.
 What we’re looking for: 
10+ years in sales enablement, sales effectiveness, sales operations, commercial excellence or a related discipline, with a record of leading enterprise-level initiatives.
Experience supporting a distributed Sales organization and partnering credibly with senior Sales leaders and frontline teams.
Track record of translating business priorities and performance data into practical tools, programs and measurable improvements in adoption or productivity.
Strong CRM experience, preferably Salesforce, including driving adoption.
Strong project and change-management skills, with experience running multiple initiatives and stakeholders at once.
Experience developing or mentoring others, and the ability to influence without direct authority.
Strong communication and facilitation skills, sound judgment and a sales-first mindset.
Experience in asset management, financial services or another regulated industry is required.
 Our Commitment to Employees 
At PICTON Investments , we take pride in enhancing our employees' experiences through a comprehensive suite of exceptional perks and programs. Our benefits include corporate fitness reimbursement and discounts, VersaFi memberships (formerly Women in Capital Markets), PICTON Investment Counseling and portfolio management services, volunteer and charitable donation matching, maternity and parental leave top-up, recognition awards, semi-annual performance bonuses, a generous annual vacation entitlement (minimum of 15 days per year), training and development reimbursement, extensive health and dental benefits, a healthcare spending account, and more.
These offerings are designed to support your career growth, well-being, and overall success. Join us and thrive in an environment that values and invests in you!
 PICTON Investments is committed to providing an equitable and fair work environment for everyone and all hiring and other personnel actions will be taken without regard to race, colour, creed, religion, sex, disability, gender identity, gender expression, family status, age, language or national origin. We welcome applications from candidates with diverse experiences globally. Canadian experience is not required. If you require an accommodation at any point in time throughout the application and hiring process, please contact Human Resources at (416) 955-4108 or at accessibility@pictoninvestments.com.
 PICTON Investments does not accept unsolicited resumes, emails, calls, or any other form of communication from third-party recruitment agencies. Any unsolicited outreach, including commercial electronic messages, will neither be acknowledged nor considered.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Canada Strategic Account Services
description:
Description
This role is based in our Toronto office.
The Canadian Strategic Account Services (SAS) Core organization is seeking a Sr. Customer Success Manager to help shape the future of the program. The Sr. Customer Success Manager drives business growth for some of the largest Sellers on the Amazon Canada Store, ensuring Seller satisfaction by delivering an optimal level of service through strategic insights and relentlessly high operational standards. In this role, you will own building and executing strategic joint business plans with your Sellers; collaborating with them to explore innovative ways to identify and execute new selection, merchandising, traffic and conversion drivers, and operational improvement opportunities. 
The ideal candidate for this role should possess strong client management skills with the keen ability to work backwards with Sellers to identify and prioritize the right inputs and outputs to deliver value and growth. They will be able to manage multiple workflows in a fast-paced work environment and surface program suggestions and areas of improvement to leadership. Above all, they should demonstrate a high level of ownership and the ability to embrace and navigate ambiguity and complexity. They are agile, inventive, and an advocate for their Sellers experience on the Amazon Canada Store. If you are interested in growing Amazon’s leading brands, then we’re interested in you
Key job responsibilities
Sr. Customer Success Managers are responsible for driving Seller business growth by providing customized insights and recommendations, educating selling partners regarding relevant tools, products, and services, and delivering a positive experience with our program. The key responsibilities of a Sr. Customer Success Manager include but are not limited to: 
Business Growth 
• Identify, action and/or provide advice on how to improve business input metrics that drive growth and improve end customer experience. Identify what is hindering growth, assist with developing solutions, and testing. 
• Analyze data and trends to identify, action and/or influence long term to maximize potential for your assigned portfolio of Sellers. 
• Act as a strategic and influential partner for your Sellers. Seek out new opportunities for customers and Sellers that drive towards their goals. Create tailored solutions and recommendations where out of the box thinking is required. Present compelling value propositions using a strategic and consultative approach. 
• Lead business strategy development and design long term account plans.
• Implement and track metrics to record the success and quality of your portfolio of Sellers. Use these metrics to guide your work and uncover hidden areas of opportunity. 
Seller Relationship Management 
• Build effective working relationships with your Sellers; be a trusted advisor and a business advocate. 
• Deliver timely, accurate and professional operational support to all Sellers in your portfolio within a specified SLA. 
• Drive optimal program and Customer Success Manager satisfaction. 
• Work with other partner teams to assist cross-functionally to resolve Seller issues and questions quickly with high quality. 
• Play a “consultant” role with oversight of key strategic activities that are underway for the Seller. Work with manager to follow up, escalate, and clear blockers as appropriate. Advocate as the voice of the customer internally, using data and anecdotes to drive prioritization.
• Educate Sellers on how to drive incremental growth on Amazon through frequent education on tools, policies, products and programs. Maintain in-depth knowledge in these areas to keep Sellers informed of new opportunities and tie recommendations to their specific goals and value proposition. 
Program Process Excellence 
• Improve team efficiency and optimize previously defined processes. 
• Assist with the design of tools, standard operating procedures and processes of Seller Services. 
• Work with manager to Identify, quantify, and define feature enhancements and new products to improve Amazon Canada product based on customer feedback, data analysis, and feature gaps with competitive products. 
• Aggregate themes and data to advocate to function as Voice of the Seller with owning teams to address opportunities at root cause level.
• Own project status communication. Consistently impart clear and concise summaries for the projects you own to your leadership/management team and are effective at answering questions in detail.
About the team
Basic Qualifications
- Experience with strong project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
- Experience in e-commerce, retail or advertising, or experience in sales/business development
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- 5+ years professional experience in Buying, Merchandising, Planning and/or relevant experience within Customer Success, Account Management, Management Consulting and/or relevant experience in negotiating, nurturing, and growing customer relationships.
Preferred Qualifications
- MBA or equivalent graduate degree preferred
- Experience in refining GenAI outputs, and applying AI practices to augment productivity.
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
The base salary range for this position is listed below. As a total compensation company, Amazon's package may include other elements such as sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, basic life & AD&D insurance), Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP), Deferred Profit Sharing Plan (DPSP), paid time off, and other resources to improve health and well-being. We thank all applicants for their interest, however only those interviewed will be advised as to hiring status.
CAN, ON, Toronto - 79,800.00 - 133,200.00 CAD annually

title: Program Execution Manager -Sales Enablement
description:
Overview 
Microsoft is on a mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their top efforts each day.
The Account Team Unit (ATU) Sales Enablement team accelerates revenue growth and field execution by equipping enterprise sellers with the processes, tools, experiences, and readiness needed to execute Microsoft’s strategic priorities.
Our goal is to make execution simpler, more efficient, and more impactful by translating business priorities into structured, field-ready programs that help sellers and managers take action.
 Role 
The ATU Program Execution Go-To-Market Manager (GTMM) provides independent execution capacity across the ATU Sales Enablement portfolio, partnering with Program Leads to turn program strategy and requirements into field-ready execution.
In this role, you will independently own and drive defined workstreams across multiple programs, spanning areas such as process, tooling, communications, readiness, launch, field activation, and ongoing operations.
You will take direction on overall program strategy and outcomes, then determine how to structure and deliver the work needed to achieve them. Success requires a hands-on executor who can bring structure to ambiguity, mobilize stakeholders, manage dependencies, solve problems, and drive work through completion with limited day-to-day oversight.
 Responsibilities 
 Workstream Planning & Execution 
Independently own and execute defined program workstreams, translating program direction into clear plans, milestones, deliverables, owners, and actions.
Establish and manage execution rhythms that ensure actions, decisions, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder commitments are tracked through completion.
Partner with Program Leads to define success criteria and execution measures for assigned workstreams and use those measures to monitor progress and identify areas requiring intervention.
Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders and contributors to move deliverables from planning through completion.
Proactively identify execution barriers, risks, and dependencies and resolve issues or escalate decisions when needed.
Build repeatable processes and execution mechanisms that improve consistency and scale.
 Field Readiness, Launch & Adoption 
Develop and coordinate field-facing communications, readiness, training, tools, and activation activities in support of program objectives.
Translate complex business and program requirements into simple, actionable guidance for sellers and managers.
Manage execution of program launches, coordinating content, communications, readiness, tooling, stakeholders, and support mechanisms.
Help ensure field audiences understand what is changing, why it matters, what action is required, and where to go for support.
Drive reinforcement and follow-through activities that help move programs from launch to sustained execution and adoption.
 Insights & Continuous Improvement 
Use available data, stakeholder input, and field feedback to assess execution effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
Evaluate assigned workstreams to identify execution gaps, field needs, and potential solutions, bringing recommendations to Program Leads and acting independently within agreed direction.
Partner with Program Leads to implement improvements to processes, tools, readiness, communications, and field experiences.
Identify opportunities to simplify execution, reuse successful approaches, and reduce duplication across programs.
 Collaboration & Alignment 
Partner closely with Program Leads, who maintain overall program strategy and accountability, to translate priorities into coordinated execution.
Work independently across sales, marketing, customer success, operations, partner, and other cross-functional teams to deliver assigned workstreams.
Build strong working relationships that enable decisions to be made, issues to be resolved, and work to move forward.
Maintain clear visibility into execution status, risks, dependencies, decisions, measures, and next actions.
Connect execution across programs to help create a simpler and more coordinated experience for the field.
 Qualifications 
 Required/minimum qualifications 
3+ years field product marketing, product management, marketing strategy, sales enablement, business development, technical pre-sales,or related work experience.
 Additional or preferred qualifications 
5+ years field product marketing, product management, marketing strategy, business planning, sales enablement, business development, technical pre-sales, or related work experience AND Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, or related field
OR equivalent experience.
Field Product Marketing IC3 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $86,100 - $169,800 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $113,300 - $187,400 per year. 
Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:
 https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay 
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.

title: Head of Revenue Operations
description:
Description 
 Role: Head of RevOps
 Reports to: Chief Revenue Officer 
 Office: London
 The Organisation 
Efekta provides the world's leading AI-powered learning technology. Our mission is to help everyone learn faster and go further by making personal tutoring affordable and accessible. AI Personalized Learning that works alongside human teachers in schools, universities, and global companies. With an AI-driven curriculum, personal AI tutor, and AI teaching assistant, we deliver proven results at scale.
Recently added to the TIME 100 Most Innovative Companies list, we have extremely ambitious growth plans and are looking for highly talented, motivated people to help fuel them. A career with us offers the scale of a global organization with the pace, purpose, and energy of a fastgrowing business. We look for thinkers and doers who are excited to help us shape the future of education.
 The Opportunity 
As Head of RevOps you'll own the commercial operating system for Efekta; how we forecast, how we measure pipeline health, how we run the deal desk, and how we make sure the data we rely on is trustworthy. You'll report to the CRO, have one direct report (Bid Manager), and work closely with regional sales leads across multiple markets.
This is a builder role. There is no mature playbook to inherit. If you've spent your career
optimising systems that already exist, this probably isn't the right fit. If you're energised by designing from scratch in a fast-moving environment, it might be exactly right.
 What you’ll own 
Forecasting; own the methodology, the cadences, and the accuracy. Make the pipeline honest.
Pipeline health; track stage-to-stage conversion, identify where deals stall, and turn that into insight the CRO and regional leads can act on.

title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
description:
BlueOptima is the global reference for Software Engineering Intelligence. Our objective metrics help businesses transform engineering from a cost center to a value creator.
We are a team of around 110 people across the UK, US, India, Mexico, Japan and Canada and we work closely across teams and time zones. People here are given real ownership early and the autonomy to run with it. If you like seeing your work change how a company operates, you will feel at home.
 Job Description
 BlueOptima is investing in Revenue Operations, and we want an experienced RevOps leader to build the function and own it. The vision is simple: one CRM the whole business trusts, a forecast that calls the quarter early, and a revenue engine designed on purpose. You are a builder who has run forecasting and CRM design before and wants ownership and autonomy. The role is based in London on a hybrid pattern.
As Senior Revenue Operations Manager you will work on and develop the systems, data and processes behind BlueOptima’s revenue: the CRM, the forecast, enablement, the deal desk and the planning behind targets and pay. You will report to our Head of Finance & Operations, giving you an independent view of the numbers, and work day to day with our CRO. Our customers rely on BlueOptima for objective measurement of their engineering, and this role brings the same objectivity to how we measure and grow our own business.
 Our Product Portfolio: (Platform Insights, Code Insights, Predictive Assessment, Active Multisite)
 BlueOptima is a multi-product business. Platform Insights gives engineering leaders objective measures of productivity, quality and cost across their teams, vendors and AI tools. Code Insights finds vulnerabilities, exposed secrets and AI-authored code before release. Predictive Assessment helps companies hire developers on measured coding performance. Our Active MultiSite suite (SVN Multisite, Git Multisite, Gerrit Multisite and Access Control Plus) ensures high availability, performance and security for distributed development teams, and is trusted by leading global organizations to manage their critical source code and infrastructure.
 Key Responsibilities
Roadmap: Develop the RevOps roadmap, priorities and team, and run a fixed rhythm with the CRO: weekly forecast, monthly revenue review and quarterly business review. 
CRM: Make our CRM the single system of record for customers, pipeline and contracts, and own its data model, integrations, automation and change control. 
Govern revenue data: Agree metric definitions with Finance and the CRO, keep data quality high, and reconcile bookings and ARR between the CRM and Finance every month. 
Run the forecast: Build a forecast process the CEO, CRO and board rely on, give an independent view alongside the sales call, and improve its accuracy every quarter. 
Define the revenue process: Set stage definitions, MEDDPICC qualification, handoffs and a renewals pipeline that opens well before each contract ends, across all product lines. 
Build the deal desk: Put pricing and discount rules, quoting and approvals on a written footing with Legal and Finance, so standard deals move fast and exceptions get a quick decision. 
Support planning and pay: Build the capacity model behind the bookings plan, support territory and quota setting, and keep commissions accurate and paid on time.

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
About Dwelly
Dwelly is building the AI operating system for residential lettings. Its growing network of agencies provides its AI with real-world data, continuous feedback, and control over complete workflows, making exceptional service the standard for landlords and tenants. Today, Dwelly operates more than 15,000 properties and $470 million in GMV, making it one of the UK’s ten largest lettings operators. The company has raised $263 million.
We’re a fast-growing, product-focused company, backed by top-tier investors and led by a team with deep experience in real estate, technology, and operations.
 
Position Summary
The Revenue Operations Manager builds the commercial operating system behind Dwelly’s growth. This is the first RevOps hire in the UK and a senior role: you will own the numbers, the systems, the pricing, and the incentives that the entire commercial organisation runs on — and you will build a small team to do it.
The UK GM / Commercial Director owns the relationships and the outcome. You own the machine that makes the outcome predictable: one source of truth on portfolio, revenue and margin by agency and branch; a pricing and fee realisation engine that closes the gap between what we should charge and what we actually collect; a landlord CRM that is clean enough to run a business on; and a target and incentive structure that points every Area Director, Branch Leader / MD, and Valuer at the same number.
Your targets are the company’s: +10% portfolio growth and +20% revenue growth year-on-year. You will be measured on results within the first 3–6 months, so this role suits someone who balances rigorous, data-driven thinking with a “get things done” attitude.
We are scaling from ~20,000 properties today to 50,000–70,000 within 12 months and ~200,000 in the following 12–24 months, largely through acquisition. Every agency we buy arrives with its own fee structures, its own data, its own spreadsheets and its own definition of a “landlord”. Turning that into one commercial system — repeatably, on a two-month integration clock — is the core of this job.
 
Key Responsibilities
 1. Commercial Reporting, Forecasting & Operating Cadence 
Own the single source of truth on portfolio, revenue, and profit contribution — by agency, branch, MD, and landlord segment — and make it the number the business argues from.
Define the commercial metric tree from top-line targets down to what a Valuer does on a Tuesday, so that every layer of the org is measured on something it can actually move.
Run the weekly and monthly commercial cadence for the GM: forecast vs. plan, variance analysis, early warning on agencies drifting off trajectory, and the decisions each review needs to produce.
Build the reporting that surfaces the drivers behind the number — churn by cause, fee leakage, attach rates, rent review execution — not just the number itself.
 2. Pricing, Fee Realisation & Ancillary Revenue 
Own fee realisation across acquired portfolios: quantify the gap between standard and actual fees, harmonise inconsistent and legacy-discounted structures, and drive the migration agency by agency without triggering churn.
Make recurring revenue levers fire reliably across the whole portfolio — annual rent reviews above all — with tracked coverage, timing, and uplift rather than best efforts.
Grow the underdeveloped ancillary line (rent guarantees, zero deposit, unified deposit schemes, contractor commissions, mortgage and other financial products) by owning attach rate targets, pricing, partner commercial terms, and the operational path to sell them.
Build the pricing governance: who can discount, by how much, with what approval, and what it costs us — and hold the line.
 3. Commercial Systems & CRM Operations 
Own the usage of the landlord CRM: pipeline stages, data model, hygiene standards, workflow automation, and adoption across a distributed MD and Valuer org.
Own commercial data quality end-to-end — landlord, property, fee, and tenancy data — and the reconciliation between CRM, the platform, and finance. If the numbers disagree, it is your job to make them agree.
Partner closely with the Growth Product Manager: they own what we build for landlords, you own how the commercial org runs on it. Translate field reality into product requirements, and product releases into adoption on the ground.
Select, implement, and administer the supporting commercial stack (BI, CRM, enablement, comp tooling) with a strong bias toward fewer tools used properly.
 4. Targets, Incentives & Performance Management 
Design the target-setting model: how portfolio and revenue targets are set per agency and branch, normalised for portfolio quality, local market, and acquisition timing.
Design and administer commission and bonus plans for the MD, Branch Leader and Valuer org — aligned to growth, retention, and profit contribution, and deliberately free of conflicting incentives.
Own territory and portfolio allocation, capacity modelling, and the analysis of what good actually looks like at each level.
Build the performance management layer: league tables, coaching inputs, and the evidence base for where to invest, intervene, or exit.
 5. Commercial Integration of Acquired Agencies 
Build the repeatable commercial integration playbook: what we measure from day one, how fee and landlord data is migrated and cleansed, when the agency joins the standard cadence, and what "integrated" means as a checklist.
Support diligence and the first 100 days with the revenue analytics that tell us what we bought — fee quality, concentration, churn exposure, and the realistic uplift case.
Work with the GM to sequence pricing and process change across newly acquired portfolios so that value capture does not cost us the portfolio.
 
Qualifications & Preferred Background
 Experience: 5–7 years in revenue operations, commercial operations, sales operations, or strategy & operations, including time in a fast-scaling, target-carrying commercial environment. Experience building a function from scratch rather than inheriting one
 Skills: Genuinely strong analytics — SQL and BI tooling as a working habit, financial modelling, comfort owning a forecast in front of a board. Deep, hands-on CRM ownership. Commission and incentive plan design
Exceptional people skills: this role only works if a distributed org of MDs, Branch Leaders and Valuers actually adopts what you build. You will spend real time in branches, not only in dashboards
Highly commercial acumen — comfortable owning revenue and margin outcomes, not just reporting on them
In step with recent technology advancements: can build meaningful analysis, automation and internal tooling independently with the help of AI
Strong numerical and analytical skills, with a “get things done” attitude and excellent attention to detail
 Preferred background 
Experience in multi-site, branch-network, or franchise businesses — where the commercial org is distributed and local relationships carry the revenue
Experience in a PE-backed roll-up or high-velocity M&A environment, including commercial integration of acquired businesses
Exposure to financial services / fintech attach products (insurance, guarantees, lending, payments) is a strong plus
 
Compensation & Benefits
Competitive salary with the potential for equity options based on stellar performance.
 
 What is it like being a Dwell-er 
Feel free to check out Dwelly Core Principles . That’s about what we believe in, how we operate and make decisions.
