title: Institutional Sales Enablement Specialist Sr
description:
Job Description
 Institutional Sales Enablement Specialist Sr
 Please note
Current work authorization for Canada is required for all openings
This is a regular, full-time role
You will be working on a flexible hybrid schedule as part of Fidelity’s dynamic working arrangement
The work location for this role is 483 Bay Street in Toronto until approximately late 2026 when the work location will change to the new Mississauga office at 3 Robert Speck Parkway.
 Who We Are
 At Fidelity, we’ve been helping Canadian investors build better financial futures for over 35 years. We offer individuals and institutions a range of trusted investment portfolios and services - and we’re constantly seeking to find new and better ways to help our clients. As a privately owned company, we boldly embrace innovation in all areas as we continue to grow our business into the future.
Working with us means you’ll be part of a diverse and dedicated group of people who make a real difference for our clients and communities every day. You’ll have a wide range of opportunities to grow and develop your career in an inclusive environment where you’ll feel valued and supported to be your best - both personally and professionally.
 What We Do
 As an Institutional Sales Enablement Specialist Sr., you will play a critical role in driving the adoption and effective use of sales processes and tools within the Institutional division. Working closely with L&D, business partners, and cross-functional teams, you’ll ensure Institutional Distribution front-line Teams have the training, resources, and support needed to maximize efficiency and adhere to business standards. As a member of the Institutional Sales Enablement team, you would also provide support on projects and systems enhancements as needed to ensure the successful achievement of business initiatives. You will foster a collaborative and mutually beneficial working relationship with partners across the organization to ensure the optimal implementation and support of projects and initiatives.
This individual is also responsible for overseeing and driving improvements in data quality in Salesforce.com. As the departmental data expert, they would also represent Institutional on the Data Governance Council and collaborate with partners across the organization to communicate and manage the downstream implications of data initiatives within Institutional. You will maintain a central knowledge database that empowers the Institutional front-line team and foster collaboration across teams to deliver impactful solutions.
 How You’ll Make An Impact
Act as a trusted resource for championing new and existing tools, including innovative AI Solutions 
Identify and evaluate emerging AI- driven solutions that can streamline Sales workflows and boost productivity
Champion AI innovation by promoting best practices, monitoring usage, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement
Accountable for owning knowledge management of all Institutional Distribution processes and tools, ensuring information is clear, accessible and impactful
Collaborate with subject matter experts to create and maintain engaging job aids and reference materials that empower the Institutional Distribution Team
Develop an onboarding programme to deliver smooth, effective training on processes and tools

Strong client service orientation with the ability to build relationships and navigate across the organization, working collaboratively within the team and across multiple business units.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written).
Strong detail orientation, planning, organization, analytical/problem solving skills
Successfully manage multiple competing priorities and have a demonstrated ability to effectively assemble resources within the firm to achieve a common vision
Strong technical skills and knowledge of data, tools and technology
 What We’re Looking For
3+ years of related experience required, sales operations and/or financial services experience is preferred
Strong working knowledge of MS Office Suite, including Excel, required
University degree required, or equivalent work experience

Bilingualism in French/English, written and verbal, is an asset.

 We believe exceptional work deserves exceptional recognition. That’s why we offer a competitive compensation package designed to support your success today—and your financial well-being tomorrow.

Base Salary and Discretionary Performance Bonus Total annual cash compensation (base salary plus target bonus) ranges from $79,000 to $90,000 based on your experience and qualifications.

We’re proud to offer a compensation package that aligns with provincial pay transparency requirements.
 This posting represents an existing vacancy within our organization—an opportunity to step into a role where your talents will make a meaningful difference.

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description:
**Come join Too Good To Go Canada’s team.**
Mission: At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious mission: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. More than 1/3 of all food produced in the world is wasted, which has a huge impact on our planet - 10% of greenhouse gas emissions to be exact.
Product: Too Good To Go operates the world's largest marketplace for surplus food, where we connect food businesses with consumers who can buy and enjoy it at 50%+ off retail value. Alongside our app, we operate an end-to-end surplus food management solution, and influence legislation to reduce food waste.
Scale: We’re growing fast: Our community of 108 million registered users and 245.000 active partners across 19 countries, have together already saved 395+ million meals from going to waste - avoiding over 1 Million tonnes of CO2e! We partner with some of the industry’s biggest names like Starbucks, Whole Foods Market, Metro, and Tim Hortons to drive social and climate impact.
️ Impact: Too Good To Go was named in FastCompany list of the World's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas. We are also honoured to be included in TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies. Most recently, we won Apple’s coveted Cultural Impact Winner.
We’re looking for an exceptional **Enterprise Customer Success Manager** to join the team at Too Good To Go to lead the Canadian partnerships.
**Your role**
As a **Enterprise Customer Success Manager**, you will play a pivotal role in driving the success of our most strategic partnerships. You will be responsible for managing a portfolio of key account partners, building and sustaining strong relationships with senior stakeholders. With a proactive, consultative, and data-driven approach, you will identify opportunities to increase meals saved, grow account value, and expand product adoption. By deeply understanding each partner’s business challenges, you will deliver tailored solutions aligned with our value drivers, ensuring long-term mutual success.
In this role, you will oversee the full account lifecycle from onboarding through to ongoing optimization. You will lead the development and execution of strategic account plans, conduct regular performance reviews such as Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and focus on driving retention at both HQ and store levels. Your ability to effectively pitch our full product portfolio will be key to introducing new categories and enhancing partner engagement. Collaborating closely with Sales, Store Operations, and Marketing teams, you will ensure strong store coverage, optimize supply quality, and deliver a seamless partner experience, all in support of our mission to reduce food waste.
**Key Responsibilities:**
* **Drive Account Growth**: Own the health and success of your customers from launch through expansion, with a focus on optimizing meals saved.
* **Analyze and Manage Risks**: Analyze store data to forecast meal savings accurately. Identify, communicate, and manage store risks proactively throughout the year, and lead in developing resolution strategies.
* **Provide Consultative Support:** Offer expert recommendations on food-saving practices
* **Lead Client Meetings:** Regularly lead and present at client meetings, both in-person and via video conference, to ensure alignment and progress.
* **Onboard and Train:** Oversee the execution of client programs, ensuring they are implemented effectively and deliver the expected value. Train new stores, collaborating with both store-level contacts and senior stakeholders to ensure a smooth process.
* **Manage Portfolio Autonomously**: Take ownership of your portfolio, maintaining strong relationships and meeting business KPIs independently.
* **Enhance Team Scalability:** Contribute to the scalability of the key account team through effective documentation and process optimization.
* **Advocacy and Impact:** Act as the voice of the client within Too Good To Go, advocating for their needs and contributing to our mission of reducing food waste through successful partnerships.
As a proactive, organized and experienced “quarterback”, you will excel in the following areas:
* **Communication:** Polished and effective communication with stakeholders and team members to ensure that we deliver a high quality client engagement with our key account.
* **Value & Solution Selling**: Experienced in solving complex business pains through solution selling, using data to influence decisions and successfully expanding partnerships through targeted upselling and cross-selling.
* **Account Strategy**: Effectively manages pipelines and portfolios, driving partner engagement and loyalty while setting benchmarks through strategic, collaborative account leadership.
* **Technical Skills:** Experience with sales CRM, project management and analysis tools like.. Salesforce, Ninja, Looker, Asana, as is a high competency with google drive (sheets, docs, decks).
* **Problem-Solving Skills**: Critical thinking and adaptability are essential for identifying and addressing issues as they arise during the project.
* **Project Management:** Meeting monthly meals saved milestones is critical, so time management skills and the ability to work in multiple stages of launch for different regions is imperative.
* **Organizational Skills:** Effective documentation and resource management to ensure will be critical to the successful launch and continued rollout of our key partner.
* **Cool Cucumber:** The ideal candidate is an individual who not only loves a challenge but also thrives in the face of occasional ambiguity.
**Requirements**
* Previous experience in sales, customer success, business development, or account management - specifically selling into VP+. Industry experience that translates well include: food, hospitality, media and technology.
* Strong accountability and demonstrated ability to effectively manage and meet key performance indicators (KPIs)
* Master communicator, you know when to speak, you know how to listen, and you know how to engage a whole room and keep their attention.
* Strong commercial acumen and appropriate assertiveness to drive deals forward.
* Proactive, solution-focused mindset with a strong emphasis on growth and curiosity.
* Polished, detail-oriented professional with a humble and collaborative attitude.
* Data analysis skills with raw data to create performance reports and projections to identify and understand trends, opportunities and issues.
* Enthusiasm for sustainability, food waste reduction, and environmental issues.
* Experience with value-based selling and/or MEDDICC methodology (preferred).
* Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred).
**Our values:**
* We Win Together
* We Raise the Bar
* We Keep It Simple
* We Build A Legacy
* We Care
**What we offer:**
* Flexible Work & Time Off
 + Work in a hybrid model, splitting your time between our office (3x a week) and home
 + Take 20 paid vacation days each year
 + Give back with paid volunteer time through our Shareback program
 + Take paid parental leave with top-up support
 Wellbeing & Support
 + Health insurance and RRSP matching in Canada!
 + Stay active with monthly ClassPass credits
 + Extra parental leave and days off beyond local legislation and the option to take an extra week of unpaid leave
 Connection & Community
 + Join regular social events and team celebrations
 + Enjoy coffee and snacks in our welcoming office space
 + Get involved and connect with our teammates around the world in our P.R.I.D.E., Women in the Workplace, Global Majority Voices, and Functionally Diverse Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)
**How to apply**
Please submit your CV and cover letter in English. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch within a few weeks. We look forward to reading your application!
*A reasonable estimate for the base salary range of this role is a base salary between* ***$70,000 - $80,000 + 15% commission per annum and this job posting is for an existing vacancy.*** *Actual salaries may vary and this range is not inclusive of additional compensations such as bonus or commission structures.*
*We welcome all applicants and are happy to provide reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process. Please email accessibility@toogoodtogo.ca with any accommodation needs.*
flags: CSM in CA at a non-standout company
CAD 70-80K base plus 15% commission is well below what 11 years and an MBA should command.
The partners are food retail and grocery chains, and the work involves store-level operations rather than B2B SaaS post-sale.
The posting says it fills an existing vacancy, a backfill signal that may clash with the uncertain Canadian citizenship timeline.
verdict: A competent CSM fit, but low pay, a retail-marketplace domain, lateral CS work and Canada make it skippable.

title: Manager, Sales Operations, NAM
description:
About Us
 At Seequent, we help organisations to understand the underground, giving the confidence to make better decisions faster.
We build world-leading technology that is at the forefront of Earth sciences, transforming the way our customers work. Every day we help them develop critical mineral resources more sustainably, design and build better infrastructure, source renewable energy, and reduce their impact on the environment.
We operate in 145+ countries while proudly maintaining headquarters in New Zealand.
 The Role 
 Reporting to the Director, Regional Operations, NAM, the Manager, Sales Operations enables sales teams through data-driven insights, reporting, and analysis that support informed strategic and operational decisions. This role partners with regional and global stakeholders to strengthen forecasting, sales execution, systems, and processes across the region.
 In this role, you will have the opportunity to: 
Develop and deliver regular and ad hoc sales reporting for leadership forums, translating insights into actionable recommendations. 
Analyse sales performance, productivity, cost of sale, market drivers, and trends to identify anomalies and opportunities. 
Build dashboards and visualisations that communicate complex sales, revenue, entitlement, and product-usage data clearly. 
Establish and manage the sales rhythm of business, including accurate revenue forecasting and performance monitoring. 
Support deal governance, deal desk activities, and major opportunity planning while ensuring adherence to sales policies and processes. 
Partner with sales leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to address performance gaps and improve sales effectiveness. 
Leverage CRM, ERP, Power BI, and reporting tools to improve data quality, reporting capability, automation, and scalability. 
Lead training, onboarding, change initiatives, and continuous improvement for sales processes, systems, and ways of working. 
 To be successful in this role, you should have: 
7+ years of experience in sales operations, sales strategy, or a related field. 
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
Strong knowledge of sales operations frameworks, forecasting, pipeline management, performance metrics, and KPIs. 
Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and P&L analysis. 
Advanced proficiency with sales and financial systems such as Salesforce Lightning, SAP, Excel, Power BI, and PowerPoint. 
Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesise complex information into clear, concise, and actionable recommendations. 
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional decision-making. 
A highly organised, detail-oriented, proactive approach, with strong ownership and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
 Additional Information
 Work from the local office 2 days a week and home-based the remainder of the week – Seequent calls this Work Mode= Hybrid
 Our Commitment to Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion 
 At Seequent, we champion the uniqueness of each individual. Our commitment to inclusiveness, equity, and accessibility is fundamental to who we are. Please don't count yourself out if you don’t tick every box. We are committed to hiring a diverse team and encourage individuals of all background and abilities to apply. Thank you for considering us as your potential employer; we're excited to see what you can bring to our team!
 Benefits of being a Seequenteer and why you’ll love being on our team. 
 We aspire to be pioneers of positive change in the way organisations work with the underground. We work collaboratively, stay curious, make change happen and have a global impact. We bring our authentic selves to work and are enthusiastic about what we do. Plus, you can expect great benefits; these benefits are unique to each location Seequent resides in. Please ask your Talent Acquisition Specialist.
If this posting gets you excited about joining Seequent please apply now!
For more information about everything Seequent, please visit Seequent.com.
 Equal Opportunity Employer
 Seequent (Bentley) is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, pregnancy, protected veteran status, religion, national origin, age, genetic information or any other protected characteristic. title: Principal Customer Success Portfolio Manager
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
 Role 
We are looking for a Principal Customer Success Portfolio Manager to join our team. This is a Remote role reporting to the Sr Director, Customer Success Strategy & Operations in the Customer Success department. In this role, you will lead the development, maintenance, and optimization of the Customer Success Portfolio across the Professional Services, Technical Success, and Support departments to deliver high-impact experiences and foster continuous growth.
 What you’ll do (Role Expectations) 
Develop well-structured and measurable service offerings aligned with the customer lifecycle and company vision
Audit and evaluate existing portfolio items for relevance, accuracy, and customer satisfaction impact
Collaborate with cross-department stakeholders to align portfolio goals and streamline processes
Create metrics, KPIs, and governance processes to assess portfolio effectiveness and improve adoption rates
Stay updated on industry trends and recommend improvements that enhance the portfolio's strategic value
 Who You Are (Success Profile) 
You seek out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
You build deep empathy for the customer and anchor your decisions in solving their real-world problems.
You operate with integrity and a strong bias for action, navigating seamlessly between strategy and hands-on execution.
You use data and analytics to measure what matters and guide informed decisions.
You connect your work to the larger company mission and build scalable solutions designed for a global organization.
 What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications) 
Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, or a related field
8+ years of experience in portfolio management, program management, or customer success roles
Expertise in auditing and optimizing service documentation to meet business standards
Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills
Proven ability to analyze data and create actionable performance metrics
 What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications) 
MBA or advanced degree in a related field
Experience with SaaS, B2B technology solutions, or similar industries
Demonstrated success in leading cross-departmental initiatives to scale service portfolios

25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
Enhanced salary sacrifice pension

Monthly fitness and wellbeing reimbursement
Flexibility in hours – around life and family commitments

title: Senior Manager, Renewals
description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.
 About 1Password
 At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.
 If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.
 The Renewals team protects and grows 1Password's recurring revenue by helping customers realize ongoing value and make confident decisions about their subscriptions. As Senior Manager, Renewals, you'll lead the global renewals function, owning the operating model, team performance, and renewal outcomes that support retention and expansion.
You'll lead renewal managers across regions, establish the standards and systems that make the renewal motion predictable, and partner with senior leaders across Go To Market (GTM) to resolve risk and capture growth opportunities.
This role reports to the Senior Director, Customer Success.
 How We’re Using AI Today
 Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.
This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.
Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.
 What We're Looking For
Lead renewals, customer success, account management, or a related post-sale function in Business-to-Business (B2B) SaaS, with a demonstrated record of owning retention outcomes.
Manage global or senior renewals teams, including hiring, developing, and supporting managers or team leads.
Lead complex renewal negotiations with enterprise customers while building repeatable renewal motions for smaller customer segments.
Apply strong knowledge of renewal frameworks, commercial terms, pricing, procurement, legal processes, forecasting, and retention metrics such as gross retention rate, net retention rate, churn, renewal rate, and expansion.
Use Salesforce, Gainsight, or comparable customer success platforms to manage customer health, risk, forecasts, and team performance.
Build trusted partnerships across Customer Success, Sales, Revenue Operations (RevOps), Finance, Legal, Support, Solutions Engineering, and Product.
Bring experience in cybersecurity, identity security, or identity and access management; experience as a 1Password user or practitioner is a plus.
 What You Can Expect
Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing renewals team across regions and experience levels.
 Own the global renewals forecast and retention outcomes, partnering with Customer Success and Sales on expansion opportunities.
Establish clear standards for coverage, handoffs, risk management, negotiation, forecasting, and performance management.
Coach managers and team members through deal reviews, call debriefs, calibration, and development plans.
Partner with senior leaders to resolve complex renewal situations and embed learnings into the broader operating model.
Design and improve renewal playbooks, commercial workflows, AI-assisted systems, and enablement programs that increase team capacity and create repeatable outcomes.
Provide clear, commercially disciplined insight into renewal performance, risk, expansion opportunities, and strategic priorities.
USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $139,000 USD and $202,000 USD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.
Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $137,000 CAD and $199,000 CAD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.
At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.
 This posting is for an existing vacancy.
 Our culture 
 At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.
You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.
 How We Work With AI
 We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.
This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.
 Our approach to work
 We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.
For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.
Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.
 What We Offer
 We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:
 Health and wellbeing
 👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy
 Growth and future 
 📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account
 Community

🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.
 You belong here.
 1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.
 Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.
 Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.
 Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

GTM architecture & revenue systems

Develop and monitor a comprehensive suite of KPIs and proactively flag risks before they impact the bottom line.
 3. Accountability & Cross-Functional Orchestration 
Act as the accountability layer across GTM. Use conversion metrics to tell leaders precisely what activities — call/email volume, outreach cadence, conversion rates — are required to hit targets.
Stand your ground in executive forums. Defend data integrity and the system's outputs when stakeholders push back, and manage senior partners across CX, Sales, Marketing, and Product through influence rather than authority.
Take full ownership of quarterly review decks and the data surfaced within them, rather than relying on department heads to assemble them.
Standardize definitions, SLAs, and shared accountability frameworks across all GTM functions.
Oversee lead qualification processes, deal attribution, SKU management, and pipeline hygiene to ensure a smooth transition through the customer journey.
 4. CRM Architecture & AI-Enabled Automation 
Take ultimate responsibility for our HubSpot ecosystem, ensuring it is best-in-class and scalable for a growing B2B SaaS environment.
Set architectural direction and partner with the internal technical lead (and third-party consultants where appropriate) to evaluate whether current systems need targeted improvements or more substantial redesign.
Architect the transition toward an AI-enhanced revenue stack — prioritizing tools and workflows that automate CRM hygiene, lead routing, and routine administrative tasks so GTM teams can focus on high-value strategic execution.
Establish and maintain rigorous data-quality and hygiene standards — a true single source of truth for revenue reporting.
Design and document end-to-end processes that eliminate friction between Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.
 5. Team Leadership & Mentorship 
Provide direct management, mentorship, and technical guidance to our RevOps Analyst, who currently operates without senior support.
Build a high-performing RevOps function with clear ownership, healthy escalation paths, and the discipline to grow with the business.
 Qualifications 
 Experience: 7+ years in high-growth RevOps, GTM Strategy, or Sales Operations, with prior experience managing a team — this is not a step-up role for a first-time manager.
 Industry: B2B SaaS experience is essential; you bring pattern recognition for how great CRM architectures work across software companies.
 Metrics & influence: Expert-level fluency in B2B SaaS metrics (ARR, LTV/CAC, churn dynamics, pipeline velocity, incentive design) with a track record of influencing C-suite and board-level decisions through data-backed insight.
 AI & automation fluency: Proven ability to architect and pilot AI-driven workflows — agentic automation, predictive lead scoring, AI-assisted CRM hygiene — that measurably increase GTM velocity and team efficiency.
 Technical literacy: Deeply familiar with the CRM ecosystem (HubSpot strongly preferred) — able to make high-level architectural decisions and evaluate consultant recommendations critically, even without being the primary hands-on builder.
 Executive presence: Able to stand your ground in executive forums, defend data integrity when senior stakeholders push back on the numbers, and distill complex data into persuasive narratives for non-technical audiences.
 Mindset — strategic: Outcome-oriented and able to connect operational tasks to broad business outcomes, leading through influence rather than authority.
 Mindset — pragmatic: Tool-agnostic and comfortable in ambiguity, focused on business outcomes and data integrity — ensuring technology serves the strategy and not the other way around.
 Location

While some roles may require proximity to our Toronto, Calgary and Vancouver offices, roles based outside our office locations can be remote in Canada and the US. Please only apply if you are able to live and work full-time in the US and Canada. #LI-Remote
 Our Culture

In our culture, collaboration and initiative fuel our growth as we embrace new challenges, learn constantly, and move quickly to seize opportunities. If you're a go-getter who thrives on impact and thrives in a dynamic setting, you'll fit right in. Our values are:

title: Senior Manager, Sales Operations
description:
Dropbox is a Virtual First company. For this role, we are currently only authorized to hire candidates from the following provinces: Alberta, British Columbia, Ontario, and Saskatchewan.
Role Description
We are looking for a data-driven, systems-thinking Sales Operations Manager to lead our regional Sales Operations team while directly owning Sales Operations for NAMER. In this highly visible role, you will serve as the primary Sales Operations partner to NAMER Sales leadership and manage two Sales Operations Managers supporting EMEA and APJ.
You will act as the primary regional business partner for NAMER sales executives, supporting all routes to market within the region. You will own or coordinate sales planning, territory and quota execution, forecast interpretation, operational improvements, and translation of strategic priorities into clear execution plans. In parallel, you will provide functional leadership to the EMEA and APJ Sales Operations Managers, helping create consistency in how we operate across regions while preserving flexibility for local market needs.
You’ll drive process clarity, pipeline health, forecasting hygiene, and cross-functional governance, using AI and automation-enabled workflows to reduce manual reporting effort while maintaining strong human judgment over business recommendations. You will also help shape the broader Sales Operations model across NAMER, EMEA, and APJ by developing the regional team, establishing common operating standards, and connecting regional execution into a cohesive global approach.
 Responsibilities
 Regional Sales Operations Leadership
Lead the regional Sales Operations team, directly managing Sales Operations Managers supporting EMEA and APJ while personally owning the NAMER Sales Operations partnership and operating model and the Channel Sales Operations partnership across all regions. Develop the team, establish clear expectations, and create consistency across regions while preserving flexibility for regional business needs.
Establish consistent Sales Operations standards and ways of working across NAMER, EMEA, and APJ, while allowing for regional differences where appropriate. Ensure regional coverage, forecasting, pipeline management, business reviews, and planning connect into a cohesive global operating model.
Work in close partnership with the Chief Business Officer’s organization and the GTM Strategy & Programs team to connect regional Sales Operations to company-wide priorities, provide timely inputs for executive reporting, and ensure consistency across regional and corporate operating cadences.
Partner with Sales Strategy, Systems, Analytics, Compensation, Finance, and Enablement to automate recurring workflows and continuously improve how the team operates.
NAMER Sales Operations Ownership
Serve as the primary Sales Operations partner to NAMER Sales leadership across all routes to market, translating GTM strategy and business priorities into clear operating plans and execution.
Own the NAMER operating cadence, including territory management, account segmentation, forecasting governance, pipeline inspection, business reviews, and performance visibility, delivering executive-ready insights that drive forecast accuracy, balanced sales coverage, and operational excellence. Partner directly with NAMER Sales leaders across all routes to market to improve forecast accuracy, pipeline health, sales coverage, deal quality, and operational execution.
Lead end-to-end NAMER coverage design, including segmentation, book cutting, territory planning, account assignment, capacity planning, and quota allocation in partnership with Sales Leadership, Compensation, Finance, Systems, and Analytics.
Own CRM QA and hygiene for the supported region, including SFDC hierarchy management, pipeline quality, process compliance, forecast integrity, deal quality investigations, and exception resolution.
Partner with NAMER leadership on pipeline inspection, forecasting, and opportunity assessment, and build executive-ready reporting, dashboards, MBR/QBR readouts, and business insights that help leaders identify risks and make better decisions.
Support organization design, interim coverage plans, role changes, new-hire onboarding, SPIF development and administration, and Channel deal registration as part of the regional operating model.
 Requirements
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of experience in sales operations, business strategy, investment banking, venture capital, private equity, or corporate advisory, or 6 years of experience with an advanced degree.
People management experience, with demonstrated ability to lead and develop experienced Sales Operations or similar professionals while remaining hands-on in the work.
4+ years of experience working with executive stakeholders.
Experience leading territory planning, account segmentation, forecasting, pipeline inspection, and annual sales planning processes.
Deep understanding of quota planning, sales capacity modeling, and quota governance, with the ability to align quotas to business strategy and commercial objectives.
Experience using AI, automation, and analytics tools to improve forecasting, pipeline inspection, reporting, and workflow efficiency, with the ability to validate outputs and apply sound business judgment before making recommendations.
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting executive operating cadences (e.g., Weekly Business Reviews, Forecast Calls, Quarterly Business Reviews) for senior sales leadership.
Experience designing or optimizing territory, account segmentation, or book-of-business models for high-growth SaaS organizations.
Experience leading Sales Operations across multiple regions or managing regionally aligned Sales Operations teams.
Experience developing quota methodologies, allocating quotas, and partnering with Sales Leadership and Finance to align quotas with territory design, capacity planning, and business objectives.
Experience supporting multiple sales motions (Direct, Channel, Self-Serve, Enterprise) across global or multi-region organizations.
Strong proficiency with Salesforce, Tableau, SQL, or similar business intelligence and CRM platforms.
Experience operating in a high-growth or transformational environment where Sales Operations played a strategic role in scaling the business.
Durable Skills
 Skills
 AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:
Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.
To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.
 Compensation
 Canada Pay Range
$166,600—$225,400 CAD
The range listed above is the expected annual salary/OTE (On-Target Earnings) for this role, subject to change.
Salary/OTE is just one component of Dropbox’s total rewards package. All regular employees are also eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).
 Company Description
 Read more about our benefits here.
Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. We’re a global community of bold visionaries and resourceful doers shaping the future of Dropbox and, in turn, the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you’re ready to push boundaries and challenge yourself, Dropbox is ready for you.
 Team Description
 The Company Strategy & Operations team (CS&O) is part of the Office of the CEO (OCEO). We partner with Dropbox’s most senior leaders to drive the CEO’s vision forward by bringing focus and structure to the company’s most important work. Our team combines strategic thinking with strong operations — we ask the right questions, navigate ambiguity, and partner with teams to help maintain alignment. Whether we’re shaping strategy, managing operating rhythms, or driving cross-functional collaboration, we do it with clarity, humility, and impact. If you thrive in complexity and enjoy building alongside others — you’ll find your people here.
 Virtual First
 Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. Virtual First is built to provide the same access to opportunity, growth, and impact for everyone, regardless of location.
This role requires travel to offsites and various other team gatherings (approximately 5-10% of the year or 2-3 days per quarter). We provide advance notice when possible and encourage candidates to discuss any accommodation needs during the interview process.
 AI Fluency
 AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others.
 We Look For Four Key Behaviors In Candidates
Ownership: You use AI responsibly by protecting data, applying sound judgment, and taking accountability for the quality and accuracy of your work.
Experimentation: You explore new AI capabilities and apply them to improve workflows within approved tools and practices.
Leverage: You use AI to enhance thinking, improve efficiency, and increase your impact and your team’s.
Learning: You stay current on emerging AI tools and trends, continuously build your skills, and share what you learn with others.
Together, these behaviors help build a workforce where technology amplifies human judgment, creativity, and impact.
Dropbox supports responsible use of AI for preparation, but misrepresentation of skills or experience is not permitted. To learn more, see our approach to AI in hiring.
Dropbox is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

title: BlackBerry Radar- Senior Manager, Strategic Accounts & Customer Success
description:
Worker Sub-Type: 
Regular
 Job Description: 
 Built for Transportation Asset Intelligence 
 BlackBerry Radar is an Asset Intelligence Platform for Transportation that helps operators turn reliable equipment data into useful operational information. Its cloud-based software and portal help teams understand equipment location, activity, and condition and apply that information within day-to-day operating processes. Purpose-built, easy-to-install monitoring hardware provides the reliable field-data foundation across chassis, trailers, containers and railcars. Data is transmitted and stored securely through BlackBerry Radar's cloud platform using security and privacy safeguards designed for enterprise use. 
 Are you a commercially minded Customer Success leader who knows how to turn strategic customer relationships into long-term partnerships and sustainable growth? 
We’re looking for a leader to shape the success of BlackBerry Radar’s most strategic customers, bringing together customer advocacy, commercial focus and strong people leadership.
You’ll lead a team of Account Relationship Managers and take ownership of the strategies that strengthen customer relationships, accelerate adoption, protect renewals and uncover opportunities for growth. Working closely with Sales, Product and Engineering, you’ll ensure our customers realize measurable value from BlackBerry Radar while bringing their priorities and insights back into the business.
This is an opportunity to make a visible impact on both the customer experience and our commercial success, helping us deepen strategic partnerships and grow customer lifetime value.
 What you’ll do 
 Lead Strategic Accounts & Customer Success 
 Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team of Account Relationship Managers, creating a culture of accountability, customer advocacy and commercial awareness.
Build trusted, executive-level relationships across our most strategic customer accounts.
Set the strategy for customer engagement, account planning and Executive Business Reviews, ensuring we clearly demonstrate value, business outcomes and ROI.
Provide senior leadership and direction on complex customer opportunities, challenges and escalations.
Establish a consistent, proactive approach to managing strategic accounts and identifying opportunities and risks early.
 Drive Retention, Renewals & Growth 
Develop and execute strategies that strengthen retention, protect renewals and minimize churn risk .
Partner closely with Sales on renewal strategy, account planning and long-term growth opportunities.
Identify opportunities to expand existing relationships through additional deployments, assets and use cases .
Drive stronger adoption and utilization of BlackBerry Radar solutions across strategic accounts.
Translate customer value into sustainable commercial outcomes and increased customer lifetime value.
 Deliver Measurable Customer Value 
Set the standard for a seamless customer journey, from onboarding and implementation through adoption, renewal and expansion.
Use customer health, engagement, adoption and retention insights to identify risks, opportunities and areas for intervention .
Ensure customers achieve clear operational and business outcomes from their investment.
Lead impactful Executive Business Reviews that connect BlackBerry Radar’s solutions to measurable value, ROI and operational improvements .
Build a customer success approach that is proactive, insight-led and focused on value realization.
 Be the Voice of the Customer 
Partner across Sales, Product and Engineering to align customer priorities with business opportunities.
Champion customer feedback internally, ensuring insights from strategic accounts help inform decision-making.
Bring market and customer intelligence into the business to help identify emerging needs and opportunities.
Drive continuous improvement across the customer journey, identifying ways to make it easier for customers to realize value and grow their relationship with us.
 What success looks like: 
You’ll have a clear impact on both customer outcomes and commercial performance , including:
Strong customer retention and renewal performance.
Increased net revenue retention.
Growth and expansion across strategic accounts.
Increased customer adoption and utilization.
Growth in customer lifetime value.
Strong customer satisfaction, advocacy and executive engagement.
A high-performing Account Relationship Management team with clear accountability for customer outcomes.
What you’ll bring
 Proven customer success and strategic account leadership , with the ability to build trusted relationships with senior and executive-level stakeholders and navigate complex customer organizations.
 Strong people leadership skills , with experience coaching and developing customer-facing teams, setting clear expectations and creating a culture of accountability, collaboration and high performance.
 Commercial acumen , with a strong understanding of customer retention, renewals, expansion and revenue growth, and the ability to identify opportunities that create value for both the customer and the business.
 A strategic, data-driven approach to customer success , using customer health, adoption, engagement and commercial insights to anticipate risk, prioritize opportunities and inform account strategy.
 The ability to translate technology into business value , connecting solutions to customers’ operational priorities and clearly demonstrating outcomes, value realization and ROI.
 Excellent communication, influencing and executive presence , with the confidence to lead strategic conversations, Executive Business Reviews, negotiations and complex customer situations.
 Strong cross-functional leadership , with the ability to partner effectively across Sales, Product, Engineering and other teams, champion the voice of the customer and influence decisions without direct authority.
 Advanced expertise in Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or other customer-facing leadership functions.
 Demonstrated leadership experience building, coaching, and developing high-performing customer-facing teams.
Proven success driving customer retention, customer satisfaction, product adoption, and revenue growth within existing accounts.
Proven experience designing and implementing Customer Success programmes, including customer health scoring, engagement models, operational processes, KPIs, and success metrics.
Strong executive presence with the ability to build trusted relationships, influence senior stakeholders, and act as a strategic advisor to customers.
Exceptional communication, relationship management, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills.
Data-driven mindset with the ability to analyse customer insights, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable business strategies.
Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Operations, and Customer Support teams to drive customer outcomes.
Industry experience in transportation, logistics, fleet management, telematics, IoT, asset tracking, or enterprise SaaS is strongly preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience.
 Ready to make an impact? 
 If you’re energized by building strategic customer partnerships, developing high-performing teams and turning customer success into measurable business growth, we’d love to hear from you.

40

 Customer Experience & Operational Excellence

 About you:

title: Head of Revenue Operations
description:
TLDR; Conduct's first revenue operations hire. You will build RevOps from scratch: the systems, planning and data our whole go-to-market team runs on, and make it AI-native from day one.
Why Conduct
The world's largest companies compete by being different, and most of that difference lives in the software they've built for themselves, which decides everything from how parcels reach your door to how food gets onto supermarket shelves. That software is a real advantage, but it's also the hardest part of the business to change safely, so good ideas often wait months or even years for the systems to catch up.
Every large enterprise has a software company hiding inside it, and Conduct is building the operating system for it. We read a company's code and processes, work out what needs to change, and help the business and its systems move forward together, wherever custom software has become too complex to change safely.
Fortune Global 500 companies like DHL and Daimler Truck already trust us with their most critical systems, and we've just raised a $60M Series A from Index Ventures, ICONIQ and SAP.
We're a talent-dense team of about 70, growing fast across London and New York, with people from Palantir, G-Research, Legora and Sequoia. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here will shape the company and how the world's largest companies operate.
About the role
Our go-to-market team is growing fast in London and New York, and over the next year we'll scale it several times over, with new account executives and regional directors joining across both offices. They sell a technical product to CIOs and IT leaders at some of the world's largest companies, in long deals with many stakeholders, often alongside partners like SAP and the major consultancies. To grow at that pace, everyone needs one clear picture of the business and an operating rhythm they trust.
Today there's no RevOps function, so you'll be starting from a blank page. You'll decide how we plan, measure and run go-to-market, then build it yourself: the CRM and the systems around it, the planning cycle, the forecast and the analytics that tell leadership where to focus.
We're an AI company, so we expect RevOps to be AI-native too. Agents should do the work that headcount does elsewhere, so a small team can have an outsized impact. You'll work closely with our founders, sales leaders, partnerships, marketing and finance.
What you'll do
 Build the function from scratch. Hire and lead a small founding team, and set one set of definitions, KPIs and data standards across sales, marketing, partnerships and deployment strategy, so the whole company works from a single source of truth.
 Own the GTM tech stack. Implement and run the CRM and the tools around it, with clean data captured at the source rather than fixed after the fact.
 Put agents to work. Design and ship AI workflows for account research, enrichment, routing, pipeline hygiene and forecast inputs, and decide where a human stays in the loop and how the output is checked before anyone acts on it.
 Run the planning cycle. Own territory and coverage design, capacity and headcount planning, quota setting and comp plan design for enterprise land-and-expand deals.
 Run the revenue rhythm. Lead forecast calls, pipeline reviews and QBRs, build a forecast leadership can rely on, and deliver board-ready reporting with the story behind the numbers.
 Set commercial guardrails. Work with our deal desk on pricing discipline, approvals and contracting workflows for complex enterprise and partner deals.
 Decide where we play next. Turn win/loss, conversion and customer data into decisions, size the market by vertical and geography, and build the case and the infrastructure for new markets.
What we're looking for
A track record of building or scaling RevOps at a high-growth B2B software company, ideally one selling complex, technical products to enterprises. You've owned territory design, quota and comp plans, forecasting and pipeline management, and hired the team to run it.
Deep, hands-on CRM expertise (Salesforce or HubSpot at admin level) and experience designing an integrated GTM stack.
AI-native. You've put AI agents or LLM-powered workflows into production for a business team, and can show what broke, what you changed and the impact. Your default is to automate.
Strong analytical skills, including SQL and BI tools, with experience sizing markets and turning data into go-to-market decisions.
Equally strategic and hands-on. You design the system and also build the models, dashboards and workflows yourself.
A clear communicator who earns credibility with sales leaders, founders and the board.
Experience with long enterprise sales cycles, the SAP ecosystem or systems integrator co-sell motions is a strong plus.
An appetite for being in the office every day, close to the team and the work.
Your seniority does not matter. Ambition, craft and the ability to turn ideas into high-quality work quickly do. We sponsor visas from everywhere. We're convinced diverse teams build better products, and we especially encourage people from groups underrepresented in tech to reach out.

title: Revenue Operations Leader, Strategy & Planning
description:
What is Contentstack? 
Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.
While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.
Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.

 Who Are We? 
 At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching.  What Are We Looking For?

To support this vision, we recently established our GTM Strategy & Systems (GSS) team under the Office of the CEO. This team brings strategy, systems, and execution together under one leader, connecting Revenue Operations, Analytics, GTM Applications, and a newly formed GTM Engineering capability.
We’re looking for a Revenue Operations Leader, Strategy & Planning to build the planning and performance-management foundation that powers this organization. You’ll work closely with the CRO, Finance, and GTM leaders to turn business objectives into actionable plans, establish a clear view of performance, and help the business identify and address opportunities and risks early.
This is a hands-on builder role for someone who enjoys creating structure, challenging assumptions, and turning complex data into decisions that drive growth. If you're excited to help shape how a scaling enterprise SaaS company operates, we'd love to hear from you! Here’s what you’ll be doing:
 Lead GTM planning: Own annual planning across capacity, territories, quotas, and incentive-plan design. Build scenario models that clearly communicate tradeoffs, dependencies, and assumptions to GTM and Finance leadership.
 Drive performance management: Establish a rigorous forecasting approach and evaluate performance against the plan across pipeline, productivity, bookings, retention, and expansion. Identify gaps and partner with GTM leaders to determine what needs to change.
 Turn insights into action: Translate performance trends into clear recommendations, helping leadership understand risks, identify opportunities, and make informed decisions.
 Establish measurement and governance: Define and maintain cross-functional KPIs that ensure Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success are working from consistent metrics and business definitions.
 Improve cross-functional alignment: Identify gaps in reporting, measurement, and assumptions, and work with stakeholders to resolve issues and document agreed-upon standards.
 Leverage AI and automation: Build agent-enabled workflows that streamline recurring analysis, surface meaningful changes, and make business insights easier to access.
 What Really Gets Us Excited About You? 
8–15+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy, GTM Finance, or a similarly analytical role within a B2B SaaS organization.
Direct ownership of annual GTM planning across capacity, territories, quotas, and compensation design, with the ability to confidently defend planning assumptions with CRO and CFO-level stakeholders.
Strong command of forecasting, funnel economics, and SaaS growth metrics, with the hands-on ability to analyze complex pipeline, bookings, and customer data.

Hands-on experience building or significantly shaping segmentation, scoring, or attribution models, with the ability to assess the reliability of inputs and effectiveness of outputs.
Experience building and deploying AI or agentic workflows that expand analytical capacity, streamline recurring analysis, or improve business decision-making.
You’re a high-agency builder who enjoys creating new capabilities, raising standards, and rethinking processes as the business evolves.
You build trust across functions and are comfortable challenging assumptions with senior leaders when the data tells a different story.
You know when a directional answer is enough to move forward, when precision matters, and how to communicate uncertainty.
You stay close to the details while keeping broader business objectives in view, and know when to gather input versus when to take ownership and move forward.
You’ve built trusted partnerships with CROs and GTM leaders and know how to influence decisions while plans are still taking shape.
You value a collaborative, innovative, and fun culture!
 Salary for this role ranges between $155,000-195,000 based on skill set and experience

Through our proprietary methodology, our mission is to harness cutting edge science, data, and specialised services to create a community of origin verified buyers and suppliers, protecting our people and planet. We empower the world’s leading brands to make positive changes across their supply chain; ensuring product integrity, meeting regulatory demands, and reducing the risk of fraud and unethical sourcing, creating real change in our world.
 About the role:
 Demand for supply chain transparency is growing fast, driven by new regulation, better data and rising reputational risk. To meet it, we need a go-to-market engine as rigorous as our science. That’s where you come in.
You’ll join the Marketing team in London, reporting to the Head of Growth Marketing. You’ll advance the go-to-market engine that supports all areas of the business including the CRM, automation, enrichment, lead scoring, data and reporting that turn interest into qualified pipeline, built with HubSpot, Salesforce, Claude and the tools you choose to bring in.
You’ll work across marketing, sales and revenue operations, working day to day with our regional sales leaders and RevOps team. This role suits someone who’s as comfortable building an AI workflow that sharpens account targeting as getting sales to trust and use what it produces. If you’d rather ship a working system than write a spec for one, and you see unfinished processes as an opportunity rather than a frustration, there’s a lot here for you to shape.
 What you'll be doing
 You’ll support every part of the business, with the digital foundations that drive growth, from SEO and site performance to tracking and tag management. You’ll also build the calls to action, conversion paths and user journeys that turn website traffic into qualified enquiries.
At the heart of the role, you’ll strengthen our marketing backend in HubSpot and evolve it towards AI and agent-led workflows that replace manual effort across marketing and sales. You’ll build enrichment waterfalls and intent-signal workflows, using Clay or similar tools, to sharpen account targeting and prioritisation. You’ll structure the data pipelines that connect external data sources, AI models and our core CRM, and own our lead scoring model, tuning it as new fit and engagement signals come online.
You’ll design and maintain nurture journeys for our supplier and buyer audiences, and manage outbound infrastructure and email deliverability, including inbox warming DNS, SPF, DKIM and DMARC and ongoing sender reputation monitoring. You’ll also automate our weekly and monthly reporting, from performance dashboards through to executive and board-level reporting.
Throughout, you’ll partner with our sales leaders and revenue operations team on lead routing, account routing and territory coverage. And you’ll document what you build, so our systems and knowledge never depend on one person.
 What we're looking for
 You’ll bring 5+ years’ experience in demand generation, growth engineering, marketing operations or performance and digital marketing, ideally in B2B. You’ll have hands-on ownership of HubSpot and Salesforce, experience with newer GTM tools such as Clay, Instantly or Smartlead, and practical experience using AI tools such as Claude to build workflows and automation.
You’re comfortable with the technical detail, from CMS platforms, tracking implementation and technical SEO to email deliverability infrastructure. You’ve built or maintained lead scoring models, and analytics and attribution frameworks that go beyond running reports. You also understand B2B lifecycle stages and how marketing, sales and revenue operations data fit together.
You can manage several cross-functional workstreams at once, and explain technical decisions clearly to senior leaders and non-technical colleagues while helping them adopt new ways of working. Above all, you have a bias for action, fix root causes rather than symptoms, and are open to owning mistakes and learning from them.
Bonus points if you build GTM workflows or experiment with new tools in your own time. We’d love to hear about your side projects.
 What you'll get
 We’re a growing business, and we believe in growing our people with it. You’ll have real ownership from day one, room to stretch into new challenges, and a leadership team that’s visible, approachable and open to your ideas.

title: Head of Revenue Operations & Systems
description:
We power people’s progress.
 At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.
We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.
Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.
 Meet the team!
 This new team will design, scale, and future-proof the systems and automation that power Preply’s revenue engine. You’ll blend hands-on system expertise with strategic ownership - building scalable, integrated processes while leading a small, high-performing team to drive efficiency, data accuracy, and innovation across our GTM stack.
This is a hybrid role: part architect and builder, part strategic manager who aligns tools, data, and teams to accelerate growth, transforming RevOps from reactive operations to proactive scalability. The exciting part - lead a fast-moving, ambitious team that values precision, autonomy, and continuous improvement, plus the opportunity to build and shape the next-generation GTM infrastructure that powers global growth.
What You’ll Be Doing:
 Systems Ownership & Architecture
Own the design, optimization, and health of Preply’s GTM system landscape Salesforce, HubSpot, Clay, Vitally, Intercom, and connected tools.
Partner with cross-functional teams (Marketing Ops, Pre Sales, Sales, CS, Finance, Product) to ensure integrations are seamless and scalable.
Lead the evolution of system architecture — mapping processes, maintaining clean data structures, and reducing technical debt.
Drive adoption of new GTM tools through documentation, enablement, and user-friendly workflows.
 Automation & Process Optimization
Identify opportunities for automation across lead scoring, routing, deal management, and renewal workflows using Salesforce, Zapier, or Cargo.
Implement AI-assisted and no-code automation to streamline pipeline operations and reduce manual effort.
Build standardized playbooks and process documentation to ensure repeatable, reliable execution across teams.
Partner with Enablement to roll out new tools and processes with clear training and adoption metrics.
 Data Integrity & Insights Infrastructure
Own data accuracy and governance across CRM and connected systems.
Build and maintain self-serve dashboards (Salesforce, Looker) to visualize funnel metrics, forecasting, churn, and pipeline velocity.
Deliver strategic data insights to senior leadership to inform GTM decisions.
Partner with StratOps to ensure data models support forecasting, compensation, and territory planning.
 Tooling Strategy & Vendor Management
Manage the GTM tooling roadmap, budget, and vendor relationships.
Evaluate new technologies and AI integrations that enhance productivity, personalization, and insight generation.
Ensure ROI and strategic alignment of all tools — balancing innovation with practicality.
 Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Lead and mentor a small team of system specialists or analysts, fostering curiosity, precision, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and CS stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable system solutions.
Champion “system thinking” across GTM — ensuring clarity, consistency, and documentation in how we operate. 
What You Need to Succeed:
8+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, or Sales/Marketing Ops in a fast-scaling B2B SaaS environment.
Deep technical expertise in Salesforce (architecture, admin, and automation).
Strong understanding of GTM processes and data flows (lead-to-opportunity, opportunity-to-renewal).
Experience with BI and reporting tools (Looker, Tableau, Google Data Studio).
Proven ability to translate business,user and customer needs into technical solutions.
Familiarity with no-code automation tools (Zapier, Workato, n8n) and API integrations.
Experience leading teams and leading cross-functional initiatives.
Excellent communication and stakeholder alignment skills — comfortable bridging technical and commercial conversations.
Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail, balanced with pragmatism and speed.
 Why you’ll love it at Preply:
An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
Access to free mental health support platforms;
Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers to promote and support well-being and physical health; 
The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).

Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.

We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company.
