title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
description:
NEP EUROPE · COMMERCIAL OPERATIONS 
 Senior Manager, Revenue Operations (Europe) 
Permanent | Full-Time | Reports to Head of Commercial Operations, Europe.
Location: Hybrid, based from one of our European locations (London, Amsterdam, Oslo, Helsinki, Brussels, Stockholm or Munich), combined with remote working | European remit. 
 Why this role exists 
NEP is the business behind many of the world's biggest live Sports and Entertainment broadcasts. Across Europe we operate in more than a dozen countries, with production crews, mobile units, studios, remote and cloud capabilities, connectivity and software platforms serving broadcasters, streamers, rights holders and event owners.
Europe is building one commercial engine behind all of it. This role makes the numbers behind that engine work: targets, incentives, pricing and discount discipline, bid economics and forecasting. When it works well, sales teams trust their targets, get paid accurately and on time, get faster decisions on their bids, and can see clearly what is driving their performance.
It is a hands-on role with real ownership, sitting at the centre of how Europe sets targets, rewards performance and prices its work.
 What you will own 
 Targets and incentives 
The annual target process with Commercial Finance: the bottom-up view from business units and customers, the split across territories and sellers, and communicating targets clearly to the sales teams
Running the incentive scheme day to day: crediting who sold what, tracking attainment, and calculating bonuses, commission, SPIFs and multi-year signing bonuses
The payout list to Finance and payroll, and a monthly targets-to-actuals reconciliation that runs without being rebuilt by hand
In-year target changes and incentive queries, handled consistently, quickly and fairly
Checking with Finance that the scheme is driving the behaviour it was designed for, and recommending changes where it is not
 Pricing, discounting and approvals 
The rate card process across business units, kept current and version controlled
Discount tracking against the agreed guardrails, including the effective discount and concessions beyond equipment such as crew, third-party hire and fees
Approval compliance: deals routed to the right approver quickly, and exceptions visible and explained, using DealHub approval workflows as they go live
 Bids and deal economics 
Bid economics on larger deals, comparing bid, plan and actual at quote, close and renewal
IA, RFP and tender support: pricing inputs, IA submissions and reusable tender content
Post-bid win and loss reviews, so each bid learns from the last
 Forecasting and performance insight 
Forecast rigour: stage discipline, forecast categories and a review with sales leaders ahead of the weekly EU pipeline call
Commercial analysis and KPI reporting across win rate, conversion, pricing, margin, discount and attainment
Turning the numbers into clear recommendations that sales teams and leadership act on
 Who you will work with 
You will report to the Head of Commercial Operations, Europe, and work closely with the Sales Support Manager, who leads Salesforce, DealHub adoption, dashboards and the exec pack. Day to day you will work with Commercial Finance on targets, accruals and payouts, with HR on incentive eligibility, with Managing Directors and their sales teams across the UK&I, Netherlands, Nordics and Mid & South Europe, and with the Global Commercial Operations teams.
Local sales teams own their customer relationships and make pricing decisions within the agreed guardrails. Your job is to make sure they have the numbers, controls and support to make those decisions well.
 What good looks like after twelve months 
Targets are issued on time, built on a model sales leaders understand and accept
Incentives pay out accurately and on time, with few disputes and quick resolution of the ones that arise
Every material discount is visible, approved by the right person and reported
The forecast is more accurate, and the weekly pipeline call runs on numbers nobody needs to re-check
Win and loss reviews have enhanced pricing and bid approach
 What we are looking for 
Experience in revenue operations, sales operations, commercial finance or incentive administration, in a business with complex or high-value sales
Hands-on experience of target setting and incentive or commission calculations, ideally across more than one country
Strong Excel and modelling skills, comfort working in Salesforce, and experience with Power BI or similar
A good grasp of pricing, discount and margin, and the confidence to challenge a number
Accuracy and control, with the judgement to keep processes simple for sales teams
Clear communication: able to explain a payout to a salesperson and a trend to leadership
Helpful but not required: DealHub or other CPQ tools, live production or broadcast experience, incentive plan design, and other European languages
Applications close on 15 November 2026, although we reserve the right to close the advert early if we receive sufficient applications. Interviews are planned for 19 and 20 November 2026, with the successful candidate expected to start in January 2027, although we’re happy to be flexible for the right candidate.
hard_gaps: Hands-on target setting and commission calculation experience
Experience with Power BI or similar
Grasp of pricing, discount and margin in complex sales
flags: pay not confirmed in the ad; 60000-80000 EUR came from the feed
Role centres on incentive administration, rate cards and discount approvals, which leans toward deal desk and away from post-sale strengths.
Live broadcast production services, not SaaS; his post-sale retention and renewal differentiator barely applies here.
Senior Manager title with no RevOps tenure; the screen will want prior comp-plan and target-setting ownership.
verdict: RevOps title, but the job is sales comp and pricing control in broadcast services, his weakest areas; low odds.

 Summary
 The Sales Operations Manager (SOM) role ensures Celestica’s sales systems and processes operate correctly and efficiently, enabling the global sales organization’s opportunity pursuit. Department Mandate: Provide best-in-class sales tools and processes to enable the sales organization to efficiently manage and report their opportunities.

 CRM & User Administration

Assign industry-specific Khalix account codes for new account creations within CRM.
Review and validate CRM opportunities moving to Closed/Won against required award documentation.
 Incentive Plan Administration

Generate, audit, and maintain quarterly Compensation Tracker Reports extracted from CRM data.

Support HR in validating achievement data for Sales MBO’s
 Reporting & Executive Leadership Team Support
Execute month end reporting, including Forecast Wins, Live Funnel, Win/Loss, and Khalix system loads.
Consolidate and distribute monthly Global & Segment management reporting packages.
Produce monthly supporting backup reports
 Planning & Systems Management

Lead & support continuous improvement development in both Dynamics 365 and SalesForce CRMs
 Sales and GCBU Training
Administer ATS Sales and Account Team skills assessments, analyze results and recommend training plans

Support annual renewal of contracts with all vendors

 Qualifications & Knowledge

Physical Demands

Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

 Salary Range: $109-145K

Eight plus years of multi-disciplinary work experience in the fields of business management, sales, Finance, Marketing or process Engineering and project/program management (preferably in the high-tech industry).

Own internal communications: all-hands content, leadership announcements, company narrative, change comms

Support our internal objectives around AI-native workflows, potentially running a few AI enablement projects across the business, helping teams like People & Talent, Finance, Customer Support and Operations automate key tasks.

title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
description:
Location: Dublin ideally or London
 Working style: Hybrid 2 days on site
 Reports to: Chief Revenue Officer, with a close working line into Finance
 About Kota
 Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products - Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution - we're making benefits more accessible, valued, and global.
Today we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe, and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone, and Frontline, along with founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio, OpenAI, and more. We're now ~100 people and scaling fast.
 The Role
 We're hiring our first Senior Revenue Operations Manager to build the operating system behind Kota's revenue - the data model, the plan, the forecast and the rhythm that runs the business.
Kota sells two ways. Embed puts our insurance inside the world's largest EOR, payroll and HR platforms. Platform sells direct SaaS to People teams. Each has its own motion, partners, contracts and economics, across multiple products and countries. Our revenue is multi-product, ramps on go-live and renews on insurer cycles - a far richer model than a standard SaaS funnel.
The business has outgrown the systems that got us here. Today we need one view of the pipeline, contracted ARR and live revenue across both business lines, and a planning process that ties targets, headcount and investment back to it. This is a builder role: part strategy, part operator, part systems architect. You'll sit in the CRO's team, partner closely with Finance, and be the person the exec team and board rely on for the numbers.
This is not a CRM admin role. You'll decide what we build, own the answer and then make it run.
 What You'll Do
 First 90 days
Build one revenue truth. Design the data model for a multi-product brokerage: parent accounts with product-line opportunities, each carrying its own value, go-live date, renewal date and commission.
Stand up the forecast. One forecast across Embed and Platform, with three distinct views: pipeline, contracted ARR, and live, ramping revenue driven by go-live dates.
Pressure-test the 2027 plan. It’ll be signed off before you start. Rebuild the model underneath it, bottoms-up by business line, partner, product and market, so we know which assumptions it rests on and where it breaks. Own the re-forecast from there.
Fix the funnel definitions. Stages that match how we actually sell - technical evaluation, quoting, contracting, go-live - with clean source attribution from first touch to signed and live.
 Ongoing
Planning and targets. Own the annual and quarterly planning cycle from 2028: targets, quotas, territories, capacity and headcount models across Sales, Account Management and Partnerships. Land the plan before headcount planning, so the plan drives the hiring, not the reverse.
Compensation. Design and administer commission and incentive plans, including MBO structures for roles that build as well as close. Run payouts with Finance.
Operating rhythm. Run the weekly forecast call, monthly business reviews and the board and investor revenue pack.
Partner and renewal economics. Model partner rate cards, revenue share, attach and renewals. Track unit economics (CAC, payback, NRR) by channel.
Systems and tooling. Own the GTM stack (HubSpot today) and the BI layer above it. Decide what we build, buy or replace as we scale.
Strategy. Run deep-dives the exec team needs: market prioritisation, pricing, new segments and channels. Turn analysis into decisions.
Build the team. Hire and lead a small Rev Ops and analytics team as the business grows.
 What We're Looking For
8+ years across Rev Ops, sales strategy & operations, or GTM strategy, with at least 3 leading the function in a high-growth B2B or fintech business.
A strategist who builds. You've designed a revenue operating model from the ground up - data model, forecast, planning, comp - not inherited one.
Strong commercial finance. You can build a three-statement-aware revenue model, a partner rate card or a comp plan from a blank sheet. A background in corporate finance, consulting or investing is a plus.
Planning at scale. You've run annual planning end to end: targets, territories, quotas, capacity and headcount, signed off at exec and board level.
Systems fluency. Deep in HubSpot or Salesforce, comfortable with a BI layer (Looker or similar) and SQL, and clear on when to build, buy or replace.
Complexity is your comfort zone. Multi-product, multi-country, partner-led or usage-based revenue. Insurance, payments or embedded finance experience is a strong plus.
Credibility in the room. You turn data into a recommendation, and you're trusted by the CRO, CFO and board to hold the number.
Owner's mindset. You'll start as a team of one and do the work yourself before you build a team around it.
 Our Values
Have Integrity. We care deeply about our why and it won't jeopardise our how.
Care Deeply. Our products are our story; we look at the details and go the extra mile to delight customers.
Own Your Ship. Ask why, do the work, get the data, solve the problem, be an owner.
Raise the Bar. We continuously push past good enough. Expect more, move faster, and never stop raising your and the team's standards.
Play to Win. We exist because we decided to say no to the norm - now we do this every day.
 Kota Benefits
Health insurance via Kota
Workplace pension with matched contributions up to 5% via Kota
WFH stipend to support your home office
25 days of paid time off
Annual company-wide offsite plus a dedicated team offsite
Attractive stock options

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager, Exteriors
description:
Ready to be a Titan? 
 The Strategic Customer Success Manager owns the customer relationship and the technical solution in one seat. Our strategic customers need a CSM who can diagnose how their business runs inside ServiceTitan, design the fix, and drive it to adoption, not hand the technical work to another team. 
 You will own a portfolio of strategic accounts. For each, you hold the executive relationship, the adoption and outcomes plan, and the solution design: configuration, workflows, integrations, and data. You work closely with Implementation, Support, Product, and Engineering, and you are the person who finds the answer when an account is stuck. 
 What you'll do: 
 Strategic customer success 
 Own the executive relationship, business reviews, and success plan for a portfolio of strategic accounts, tied to measurable outcomes. 
 Lead escalations end to end: triage, root cause, cross-team coordination, and clear customer communication until resolved. 
 Monitor adoption and health, and turn gaps into prioritized, owned action plans. 
 Forecast and protect renewals; identify and develop expansion opportunities with Sales. 
 Represent the customer inside ServiceTitan, bringing product feedback with evidence and business impact. 
 Solution architecture 
 Run technical discovery: map the customer's workflows, data, third-party systems, and pain points to ServiceTitan capabilities. 
 Design and document solutions, including configuration, feature gates and settings, pricebook and estimate structures, workflows, reporting, and supplier or third-party integrations. 
 Troubleshoot complex issues hands-on: reproduce, inspect configuration and data, and distinguish a setup gap from a product defect. 
 Partner with Implementation, Support, and Engineering to scope, validate, and ship fixes, and write the case when a gap needs Product's attention. 
 Build reusable assets (SOPs, templates, best-practice configurations, enablement content) so solutions scale across accounts. 
 Use SQL, reporting, and AI tooling to find patterns across customers and speed up diagnosis. 
 What you'll bring: 
 5+ years in customer success, solutions architecture, implementation, professional services, or a similar customer-facing technical role, with strategic or enterprise accounts. 
 Demonstrated ability to solve customer problems technically: you can show a time you found the root cause in configuration, data, or an integration and designed the fix yourself. 
 Working knowledge of SaaS platforms: workflows, permissions and settings, data models, APIs and integrations, and reporting. 
 Comfort with data: able to query, filter, and interpret data (SQL or equivalent) to support a diagnosis or a business case. 
 Executive-level communication: you can explain a technical solution to a business owner and a business goal to an engineer. 
 Track record managing escalations and cross-functional work without direct authority. 
 Structured, documented working style: clear solution designs, action plans, and handoffs. 
 Preferred qualifications and success measures 
 Experience with field service, home services, construction, or roofing and exteriors workflows. 
 Hands-on ServiceTitan experience, such as configuration, pricebook, estimating, or integrations. 
 Experience with third-party or supplier integrations, scripting or automation, or building with AI tools. 
 Background in both a CSM and a technical or architect role. 
 How success is measured 
 Customer outcomes 
 Adoption of targeted features and progress against each account's success plan
 Retention and growth 
 Gross and net revenue retention for the portfolio; expansion pipeline sourced
 Technical resolution 
 Time to root cause on escalations; share of issues resolved without a handoff
 Scalability 
 Reusable solutions, SOPs, and templates adopted by the wider team
 Customer sentiment 
 Executive sponsor engagement and satisfaction trend 
 Be Human With Us: 
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us. 
 Use of AI Technology: 
We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.
 What We Offer: 
When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:
 Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work : Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more.
 Holistic health and wellness benefits: Company-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical.
 Support for Titans at all stages of life: Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more.
At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.
ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. For candidates in the United States, the good faith salary ranges estimate for this role is

Zone 1: $111,800 USD - $167,600 USD Applicable for: CA, CT, DC, MD, MA, NJ, NY, VA, and WA

Zone 2: $104,500 USD - $156,700 USD Applicable for: All other US locations.

International Compensation for candidates residing outside the United States will vary by location and will be discussed during the hiring process. Actual compensation within a range is determined by factors including relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and performance. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package includes an annual bonus, equity, and a holistic suite of benefits.

title: Associate Director, Business Development & Marketing Operations
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Director, Business Development & Marketing Operations based in Canada.
 We are looking for a strategic and results-driven leader to oversee business development and marketing operations, strengthening organizational efficiency and supporting sustainable growth. This role combines strategic planning, operational leadership, team development, technology management, and data-driven decision-making to improve commercial performance. You will partner with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to align sales and marketing priorities, optimize processes, and deliver high-impact initiatives. As the leader of a team spanning Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, and Project Management, you will foster accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. You will also oversee Salesforce and marketing technology capabilities, performance reporting, budgeting, and operational governance. This remote leadership opportunity is ideal for an experienced professional who enjoys solving complex business challenges while contributing to a purpose-driven organization with a global social impact.
Accountabilities
Lead strategic and operational planning: Develop the vision, goals, and roadmap for Revenue Operations in partnership with senior leadership, aligning sales and marketing strategies with broader organizational objectives. 
Drive operational excellence: Establish and implement processes, governance models, service-level agreements, and best practices that improve efficiency, transparency, scalability, and organizational effectiveness. 
Manage and develop the team: Lead, coach, and support three direct reports across Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, and Project Management, establishing clear expectations, performance goals, and professional development plans. 
Oversee Salesforce and business systems: Own Salesforce and related marketing technologies from a business perspective, prioritizing enhancements, defining requirements, improving adoption, and ensuring systems support pipeline management, forecasting, reporting, and decision-making.

title: Staff Revenue Operations Manager, Revenue Planning & Analytics
description:
Job DescriptionJob Description
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.
We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.
We are looking for a Staff Revenue Operations Manager to help shape how EvenUp plans for and achieves its growth targets. As we scale our go-to-market organization, this person will own the bottoms-up revenue model that connects company-level goals to the underlying assumptions across our Sales and broader GTM teams.
You'll partner closely with Revenue Operations and GTM leadership to build annual and quarterly plans, evaluate revenue performance, and conduct the strategic analyses that inform decisions around sales capacity, quotas, territories, and resource allocation. This is a highly analytical role that requires both strong modeling skills and the ability to translate complex business questions into clear recommendations.
 Title and compensation to be determined based on candidate experience. 
 What you'll do: 
 Own revenue planning and forecasting: Build and maintain EvenUp's bottoms-up GTM model, connecting revenue targets to the underlying drivers of performance, including pipeline, win rates, deal size, quota attainment, sales capacity, ramp time, churn, and expansion. Translate company-level growth targets into detailed operating assumptions and forecasts.
 Lead annual and quarterly planning: Partner with Revenue Operations and GTM leadership to develop annual and quarterly plans across relevant departments. Evaluate what needs to be true across headcount, productivity, conversion, and retention to achieve our goals, identifying key assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
 Drive strategic GTM analysis: Lead analyses that inform how we structure and allocate our GTM resources, including territory design, customer segmentation, quota setting, capacity planning, and sales productivity. Develop recommendations that help leadership make informed tradeoffs as the business scales.
 Evaluate business performance: Analyze actual performance against plan, identify the underlying drivers of variances, and assess their implications for future results. Build scenarios and sensitivities to help leadership understand potential outcomes and determine where adjustments are needed.
 Partner with GTM leadership: Serve as a strategic thought partner to Revenue Operations and functional leaders, translating complex analyses into clear insights and recommendations. Help leaders pressure-test assumptions, evaluate investment decisions, and prioritize opportunities to improve revenue performance.
 Strengthen planning methodologies: Improve the models, assumptions, and analytical approaches used to plan and forecast the business. Partner with Finance, Data, and other cross-functional teams as needed to ensure planning is grounded in reliable data and reflects how EvenUp's GTM organization operates.
 What we look for: 
 Relevant experience: 10+ years of experience in Revenue Planning & Analytics, GTM Strategy & Planning, Strategic Finance, Sales Finance, Revenue Operations, or a related function, ideally at a high-growth B2B SaaS company.
 Revenue modeling expertise: You have built and owned a bottoms-up revenue forecast, sales capacity model, or comparable operating model. You understand how assumptions around pipeline, win rates, deal size, quota attainment, ramp time, churn, and expansion translate into business outcomes.
 Strong analytical and quantitative skills: You can build models from scratch, evaluate scenarios, pressure-test assumptions, and break down complex business questions into structured analyses. You are comfortable working with large datasets and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
 GTM and SaaS business acumen: You understand the drivers of revenue growth in a recurring-revenue business and how decisions around sales capacity, territory design, segmentation, quotas, and productivity affect performance.
 Strategic problem-solving: You can identify the right questions to investigate, determine what the data needs to show, and develop recommendations that help leaders make decisions about planning, resource allocation, and GTM strategy.
 Cross-functional partnership: You communicate analytical findings clearly and can work directly with senior stakeholders to challenge assumptions, align on plans, and influence decisions without relying on formal authority.
 Ownership and execution: You are comfortable operating in a fast-growing environment, managing ambiguous problems independently, and building planning models and processes that can evolve as the business scales.
 Benefits & Perks: 
As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:
Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.
Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.
10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.
A home office stipend.
401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.
Paid parental leave.
A local in-person meet-up program.
Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.
 (Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees) 
 Notice to Candidates: 
 To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our careers page . 
 Please note that EvenUp may use AI notetakers and other recording devices in the recruiting process. If you interview with us, with your consent, we may record your conversations and summarize them into notes for internal use. Recording is optional, and declining will not affect your candidacy. 
 EvenUp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

description:
Description
 Position at Ezra 
 Job Role: Sales Enablement Lead

 Who we are 
We believe everyone can be better with a coach... and we won’t stop until we get there. 
Coaching changes people’s lives. It helps them be happier and more productive in their work. It turns entire companies into more inclusive, more productive places to be. That’s why we’ve made it easy for more people – not just those at the top – to benefit from the world’s best coaches. This is true of our EZRA team. We believe a happy team is a productive one. We help our people grow, to care deeply about and be proud of what we do.
 The Role

As part of this objective, the Sales Enablement Lead is an important role to driving our end-to-end process for equipping our Sales team with the knowledge and skills they need, from initial consultation and through delivery.  What You'll Do:

 About you

Comfortable collaborating across global time zones; occasional travel for in-person enablement and key meetings.

 Life at EZRA

title: Principal Customer Success Account Manager
description:
Overview 
 Overview: 
Join Microsoft’s U.S. Public Sector Industries Defense Industrial Base (DIB) team – where mission meets innovation.
The Defense Industrial Base (DIB) Operating Unit (OU) is a strategically critical organization with a bold mandate: to consolidate, simplify, and accelerate Microsoft’s presence across the DIB ecosystem. This ecosystem includes more than 100,000 organizations spanning aerospace, manufacturing, cybersecurity, mission systems, and advanced research – commercial enterprises that directly support U.S. Federal agencies, including the Department of Defense and other mission‑based intelligence and civilian organizations.
Our role is to help these customers modernize with confidence – securely adopting and scaling Microsoft technologies to meet mission outcomes, regulatory requirements, and long‑term operational resilience. We partner with customers from strategy through execution, enabling secure, scalable platforms that drive significant business value and trusted outcomes.
Within the DIB OU, the Customer Success Unit (CSU) is responsible for ensuring customers realize the full value of their Microsoft investments. The CSU works closely with sales, partners, and delivery teams to accelerate consumption, improve customer health, and deliver measurable outcomes across complex, regulated environments.
We are seeking a Customer Success Account Manager (CSAM) to lead customer success strategy and execution for some of Microsoft’s most complex and strategically important DIB customers. This is a senior individual contributor role with enterprise‑level scope, high autonomy, and significant impact.
By applying to this role, you may be considered for multiple positions at the same career stage within the DIB CSU.
 Role Overview: 
As a CSAM, you are the strategic owner of customer success for your assigned DIB accounts. You build deep, trusted relationships with customer executives, technical leaders, and internal stakeholders, aligning Microsoft solutions and services to customer business priorities and mission objectives.
You lead the planning, orchestration, and execution of customer success programs – driving adoption, accelerating consumption, improving operational health, and proactively mitigating risks and blockers. You operate as a trusted advisor, influencing customer strategy and internal execution without direct authority, while ensuring accountability to outcomes.
This is a non‑people‑manager (IC) role with enterprise‑level scope and responsibility, designed for senior professionals who thrive in high‑complexity, high‑trust environments.
 Responsibilities 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Customer Relationship Management 
Build and coach engagement strategies across customer, partner, and internal stakeholder ecosystems.
Develop and support executive level‑ relationships with customer technical, business, and mission leaders.
Expand relationships beyond existing support engagements by leading outcome based‑ conversations aligned to customer priorities.
Influence and challenge senior internal stakeholders to align resources and actions to customer needs.
Partner with Account Teams to co-own‑ customer success plans and contribute to integrated account strategies.
 Customer Success Leadership 
Lead the strategic execution of customer success planning, program governance, and customer facing‑ reviews.
Orchestrate Microsoft delivery resources to drive adoption, accelerate value realization, and improve customer operational health.
Proactively identify, monitor, and mitigate actual and potential blockers to consumption using data insights and customer feedback.
Lead escalation management and communications for complex delivery challenges, ensuring clarity, accountability, and resolution.
Hold accountability for consumption milestones, adoption outcomes, retention, and long term‑ customer health.
 Technical Relevance and Solution Alignment 
Understand and align Microsoft solutions and technical capabilities (e.g., Azure, Modern Work, Dynamics) to customer needs and mission priorities.
Identify complex customer scenarios (e.g., multi-cloud, ISV, partner‑ led‑, global subsidiaries) and collaborate with technical specialists to architect solutions.
Leverage knowledge of customer platforms and Microsoft’s roadmap to enable secure digital transformation.
Strengthen Microsoft’s competitive position by articulating platform value relative to point solutions.
 Operational Excellence and Collaboration 
Drive disciplined execution through structured planning, prioritization, and predictable delivery.
Partner across sales, engineering, support, and partners to ensure consistent customer experience and outcomes.
Use data, telemetry, and feedback loops to inform decision‑making and continuous improvement.
Model Microsoft’s culture and values while operating with integrity, accountability, and customer obsession.
 Capabilities and Skills 
 Required Upon Hire and Critical/Important 
Accelerating Consumption, Usage, and Value Realization
Driving Customer Health and Operational Excellence
Executive Relationship Building and Influence
Data Analysis and Insight Driven Decision Makin‑g
Business Acumen and Financial Literacy
Consultative Engagement and Stakeholder Orchestration
Negotiation, Storytelling, and Executive Communication
 Additional Strengths 
Change Leadership and Program Facilitation
Multi Initiative‑ Program and Portfolio Management
Cross functional‑ Team Leadership without Authority
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications: 
 Master's Degree in Business, Sociology, Psychology, Computer Science, or related field AND 4+ years customer success, solution delivery, practice management, customer-facing consulting, or portfolio management experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Sociology, Psychology, Computer Science or related field AND 6+ years customer success, solution delivery, practice management, customer-facing consulting, or portfolio management experience OR equivalent experience. 
 Other Requirements: 
 Citizenship & Citizenship Verification:  This position requires verification of U.S citizenship due to citizenship-based legal restrictions. Specifically, this position supports United States federal, state, and/or local United States government agency customers and is subject to certain citizenship-based restrictions where required or permitted by applicable law. To meet this legal requirement, citizenship will be verified via a valid passport. 
 Citizenship & Citizenship Verification:  This role will require access to information that is controlled for export under U.S. export control regulations, potentially under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations or the Export Administration Regulations.  As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide proof of citizenship, for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, citizenship will be verified via a valid passport. 
 Microsoft Cloud Background Check : This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Master's Degree in Business, Sociology, Psychology, Computer Science, or related field AND 10+ years customer success, solution delivery, practice management, customer-facing consulting, or portfolio management experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Sociology, Psychology, Computer Science or related field AND 12+ years customer success, solution delivery, practice management, customer-facing consulting, or portfolio management experience OR equivalent experience. 
 5+ years relevant work experience within customer industry. 
 Microsoft or competitor equivalent (e.g., AWS) certification in relevant technologies (e.g., Azure, 365). 
 Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation certification or equivalent service management certification. 
 Project Management Institute (PMI) or equivalent Project Management certification. 
 Prosci or equivalent certification. 
 Ability and Willingness to acquire and maintain a US Government Clearance 
Customer Success Account Mgmt IC5 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $130,900 - $251,900 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $165,600 - $272,300 per year. 
Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:
 https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay 
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.
hard_gaps: Technical relevance in Azure, Modern Work and Dynamics solutions
flags: Defense Industrial Base customers expect cloud-technical depth and defense-sector familiarity he lacks; GRC bank accounts are only partial cover.
The role requires willingness to obtain a US Government clearance, which likely ties it to the US long term.
Remote status is unconfirmed in the posting; DIB CSAM roles often expect proximity to customer sites or offices.
The posting is truncated, so years-of-experience and degree requirements could not be checked.
verdict: Strong brand and pay, but a technical cloud CSAM role in US defense is a lateral runway move with real technical-fit risk.

title: Sales Strategy & Enablement Lead
description:
Job DescriptionJob Description
 ✨ About the Company 
Makeship empowers influencers, creators, and brands of all sizes to develop and launch limited-edition products that matter to their fans. Leveraging our design, manufacturing, and marketing expertise, we work with our partners to bring their products to life through our community-powered crowdfunding platform. Each product is given a window of 21 days to be funded by the community before we produce and ship to fans worldwide. We put our brand behind every product and guarantee quality and ethical sourcing.
We're profitable; we have a three-year revenue growth of over 200%, ranking us 97th in 2024 and 86th on The Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies of 2025 list. In 2025 alone, our sales exceeded $65M CAD. We are proud to be Great Place to Work-Certified™ for 3 years in a row! Learn more about us at Makeship.com. 
 ️‍ About the Role 
We are looking for a Sales Strategy & Enablement Lead who can take what great selling looks like here, sharpen it, scale it, and keep evolving it as we grow. This is a role for someone who understands people deeply. You know how to build trust fast, uncover what actually matters, make a value proposition click, handle objections before they become roadblocks, and tell a story that people remember.
But you’re not just a great seller.
You know how to turn instinct into something teachable.
You can listen to a call and immediately hear what landed, what didn’t, and what should change. You can rewrite the deck, sharpen the talk track, rethink the follow-up, coach the AE, and then look at the data to see whether it worked.
You won’t carry an individual quota. Your impact will show up in the performance of the entire Partnerships team.
Reporting to the VP, Revenue, you’ll own how we approach, pitch, nurture, win, grow, and win back Creator relationships. Your closest business partner will be our Sales Manager, who owns day-to-day team leadership and performance. You’ll also work closely with RevOps, Marketing, Data, and teams across Makeship.
This is not a role where you sit on the sidelines and hand people frameworks.
You’ll be in sales calls. You’ll talk to Creators. You’ll coach AEs. You’ll challenge assumptions. You’ll test ideas. You’ll throw out what isn’t working. And when something starts working really well, you’ll figure out how to make the whole team better at it.
Makeship already has six years of learning, strong growth, and a lot that works. Your job is to understand why it works, make it better, and evolve it as we launch new products, enter new Creator verticals, and keep raising the bar.
 What We Are Looking For 
We’re looking for a salesperson first.
Someone with exceptional EQ, strong instincts, competitive energy, and a genuine understanding of how language, trust, relationships, and timing influence a sale.
You may be a top-performing AE, a sales strategy or enablement lead, or the person other sellers naturally come to when they need help closing something difficult. You may have built playbooks, mentored teammates, or moved into sales leadership.
Your title matters less to us than the pattern.
You’ve sold. You’ve learned what works. You’ve developed your own judgment. And at some point, you realized you were just as excited about making the team better as you were about winning the deal yourself.
Creator economy experience is a major advantage. Selling to Creators is not traditional B2B sales. Relationships are built through Instagram, Discord, YouTube, calls, DMs, and communities as often as they are through formal meetings.
You need to be comfortable in that world; or, come from another fast-moving, relationship-led environment where you’ve learned how to sell without hiding behind a rigid corporate playbook.
We move quickly. We’re competitive. We’re curious. We challenge each other, laugh a lot, and care deeply about doing great work. You should be confident enough to work independently, humble enough to change your mind, and comfortable jumping from a strategic conversation straight into the weeds.
 Your Key Responsibilities 
 Sales Storytelling & Methodology: 
Own and continuously evolve how Makeship sells.
Turn Makeship’s value proposition, results, capabilities, and differentiators into a clear, memorable sales story.
Personally develop and improve sales decks, talk tracks, discovery frameworks, pitch approaches, objection handling, nurture messaging, follow-up strategies, and playbooks.
Help AEs and AMs understand not just what to say, but why it works and how to adapt the story to the Creator in front of them.
Build a methodology flexible enough for emerging Creators, established Creators, and different Creator verticals.
Adapt our approach as Makeship launches new products, enters new Creator verticals, or tests new ways of working with Creators.
 Coaching & Enablement: 
Make the team better at selling.
Work directly with AEs through live coaching, call reviews, workshops, pitch development, and ongoing feedback.
Own our sales enablement program, including onboarding, recurring training, playbooks, workshops, and certification.
Partner closely with the Sales Manager so the methodology becomes part of ongoing team coaching.
Identify what our strongest sellers are doing differently and make those behaviours repeatable across the team.
 Creator Growth & Relationship Strategy: 
Help us sell beyond the first drop in the Creator's best interest.
Build frameworks that help AMs move from “we need another launch” to thoughtful Creator growth planning.
Help define how teams should think about timing, product progression, Creator milestones, fan moments, tentpoles, and larger programs.
Develop the questions, planning tools, and storytelling that help AMs build strategic roadmaps with Creators.
Create win-back approaches for Creators whose relationship with Makeship has lapsed.
Help the team understand how a great fan experience should influence what we recommend to Creators.
 Competitive Strategy: 
Make sure our team knows why Makeship wins.
Stay close to competitors, their positioning, their offers, and changes in the Creator merchandise space.
Turn competitive insight into better discovery, positioning, talk tracks, objection handling, and sales plays.
Teach AEs and AMs how to recognize competitive threats, uncover weaknesses, and position Makeship naturally and confidently.
Help build a team that knows how to assess the landscape in real time rather than relying on a static battlecard.
 Testing, Data & Continuous Improvement: 
Keep learning what works.
Stay close to frontline conversations and use them to form hypotheses about what could make us better.
Use funnel and performance data to understand what’s improving, where momentum is breaking down, and what to test next.
Track signals including win rate, conversion, sales-cycle length, speed to first launch, repeat launches, expansion, and other measures of sales effectiveness.
Work with RevOps and Data to define the reporting and insights you need.
Test changes in messaging, follow-up, sequencing, pitch structure, and methodology, then keep what works and change what doesn’t.
 Revenue Operations & Marketing Partnership: 
Know what great selling needs, then help the right teams build it.
Partner with RevOps on the sequences, workflows, CRM support, alerts, and tools that reinforce the sales methodology.
Be comfortable working in HubSpot and hands-on enough to build or test simpler solutions yourself when it makes sense.
Bring forward new sales technology when you believe it can make the team more effective.
Partner with Marketing so Creator-facing content reinforces the same story our team is telling in the field.
Identify the content and assets the sales team needs — from proof points and case studies to videos and Creator education — and work with Marketing to bring them to life.
Bring frontline Creator insights back into the business so our broader messaging keeps getting stronger.
 What You Bring 
7+ years of sales experience, including significant time in a quota-carrying role, with strong live selling instincts and a track record of building trust fast, uncovering motivation, and adapting quickly.
Evidence that you've made other sellers better through mentoring, coaching, sales leadership, or enablement.
The ability to turn a complex value proposition into a simple, memorable story, and to build the practical tools that help others tell it, such as talk tracks, pitch decks, discovery frameworks, objection handling, and follow-up strategies.
Experience in a startup, scale-up, or emerging category where the playbook was still being written, and a natural instinct to turn ambiguity into something clearer and more useful.
Strong competitive instincts and curiosity about why buyers choose one option over another.
Comfort interpreting sales funnel data and working in CRM and sales technology (ideally HubSpot) to improve performance.
A collaborative, low-ego approach and the confidence to challenge an idea when you see a better one.
 Bonus 
Experience selling to Creators, influencers, talent, communities, or other non-traditional business owners.
Experience in the Creator economy, gaming, merchandise, crowdfunding, fandom-led commerce, or another community-driven industry.
Experience adapting your sales approach across audience segments and verticals, from informal, relationship-led conversations to larger strategic accounts.
Previous experience as a sales leader, or building and evolving a sales enablement program in a high-growth startup.
Confidence speaking to groups, facilitating workshops, or representing a company externally.
 Benefits & Perks 
Work remotely anywhere in Canada and/or access any of our hubs
Health and dental benefits from day 1
4 weeks of paid vacation (including paid time off on your birthday)
An additional 1 week of paid time off during the winter holidays
Virtual & In-Person Social Events
Annual Paid Volunteer Day Off
1:1 RRSP Matching Program Up to 3%
$500 Pre-Tax Annual Health & Wellness Allowance
$400 Pre-Tax Home Office Setup Allowance
$65 Pre-Tax Monthly Phone Allowance
Maternity and Parental Leave Top-Up Program
Education Assistance Program
Employee Referral Program
Tenured Rewards Program
 Salary Band: $90-100K CAD base salary per annum, plus a variable of $30-40K CAD, for an OTE of $120-140K CAD. Individual compensation will depend on unique skills, experience, and qualifications. 
 Vacancy Status: Existing vacancy 
 AI Use Disclosure: 
 As part of our hiring process, we may use AI-powered tools to support tasks such as application screening and note-taking. These tools are used to assist our team, and all hiring decisions are made by humans . 
 We are committed to fair and unbiased hiring practices. If you require accommodations or have questions about how your application is assessed, please let us know. 
 At Makeship we are committed to fostering an environment that welcomes people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities. We are passionate about building an equitable and inclusive culture for our unique and diverse team of employees which makes us Makeship. As an equal-opportunity employer, we value and embrace everyone's opinions and differences, and actively seek new Makeshippers who will work respectfully with our team, propelling our company and the community forward. If there are any accommodations we can provide to make your interview experience more accessible and inclusive, please let us know in your application.
hard_gaps: Salesperson first: proven new-business AE selling track record
flags: The role centres on call coaching and pitch craft for AEs; Tom's selling was renewals and expansion, not new-logo closing.
This is creator-economy consumer merchandise sold via Instagram, Discord and DMs, far from his B2B SaaS post-sale strength.
The CAD 90-100K base is modest for 11 years of experience plus an MBA, though OTE reaches CAD 120-140K.
As an existing vacancy it likely wants a prompt start, a risk against the unproven citizenship-certificate timeline.
verdict: Enablement title fits the GTM narrative, but a sales-first, creator-economy brief and a Canada market make this a weak fit.

title: Senior Business Operations Lead
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
 The Community You Will Join
 The Chief Business Officer organization drives company-wide growth and global expansion.
This is the role that turns Airbnb's ambition for the UKI & Nordics into a plan and holds the organisation to delivering it: shaping strategy, aligning cross-functional teams, and driving sustainable commercial growth across one of our most important regions.
This includes recruiting and supporting high-quality Stays, Experiences, and Services, alongside executing Airbnb’s global market strategy. Shaping business approaches, quality supply sourcing, and international growth efforts are integral to the team’s success in connecting millions more hosts and guests to Airbnb's platform.
 The Difference You Will Make
 You will join the UKI, Nordics, Middle East and Africa team, covering one of Airbnb’s largest and most mature markets alongside five of Europe’s most digitally advanced, high-trust travel markets. The UK offers scale, brand strength, and a sophisticated regulatory environment; the Nordics offer strong domestic travel behaviour and significant headroom for growth. Together they make this one of the most commercially interesting regions in EMEA to build in.
 A Typical Day
 You will own the business operations agenda for the UKI and Nordics. Airbnb’s most established European market alongside five high-potential Nordic markets (Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland). Partnering closely with the Country Manager, you will set the regional growth strategy, translate it into a plan cross-functional teams can execute against, and run the operating rhythm that keeps it on track. This is a high-visibility role: your influence will come from the quality of your thinking and your ability to mobilise teams to grow further.
 Regional growth strategy
Own the UKI & Nordics growth strategy end to end: define where the region should compete, what it should stop doing, and the handful of bets that will move guest nights, supply growth, and revenue.
Build the annual and quarterly plan with the Country Manager, sizing opportunities and making explicit recommendations on where to deploy marketing spend, supply investment, and partnership effort.
Set and pressure-test the region’s targets, translating global goals into market-level commitments that supply, marketing, partnerships, policy, and product teams can own.
Run deep-dive analyses on demand and supply dynamics, competitive movements, pricing, and seasonality, turning each into a clear recommendation, not just a read-out.
Identify and stand up new growth initiatives, using the UK as a test market for offerings that can then scale across EMEA, and the Nordics as a proving ground for high-penetration, low-friction market plays.
Build the case for investment in the region: sizing, business case, and the socialisation needed to win resource in global planning cycles.
 Operating rhythm and execution
Own the region’s operating cadence: weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews, so leadership has a single, trusted view of performance and the story behind it.
Convert strategy into sequenced execution plans with named owners, milestones, and success measures across supply, marketing, partnerships, policy, and product.
Track delivery against the plan, surfacing risks and bottlenecks early and driving them to resolution rather than escalating them.
Design and continuously improve the operating processes the region runs on, raising the bar on efficiency, transparency, and decision speed.
Lead the region’s input into global planning and resource allocation cycles.
 Cross-functional leadership
Act as the connective tissue between the UKI & Nordics team and global functions such as Product, Marketing, Communications, Policy, Finance, Data Science, Legal, and Community Support.
Be the go-to decision partner alongside the Country Manager: the person other teams come to for the region’s position, context, and priorities.
Build alignment on high-priority projects, market launches, and product tests, brokering trade-offs between global consistency and local market reality.
Represent UKI & Nordics in NEMEA and global business operations forums, and bring the best of what other markets are doing back into the region.
Partner with Public Policy on the regulatory landscape, including short-term let rules in the UKI and Nordic city regulation so commercial plans account for policy risk and opportunity.
 Insights and storytelling
Turn complex data into clear narratives that help leadership decide with a recommendation attached.
Build the reporting layer the region relies on: dashboards, performance packs, and executive materials, working with a dedicated analyst.
Establish the metrics that matter for the region and hold the team to a shared definition of success.
Champion data-driven decision-making, and use AI tooling to compress the time from question to insight. Automating recurring analysis and reporting so the team spends its time on judgement, not assembly.
 Your Expertise
 To deliver in this role, Airbnb is seeking candidates with:
12+ years in business operations, strategy, consulting, or commercial leadership, with a track record of owning outcomes in a market or business unit
Demonstrated ability to set strategy and drive it through to execution 
Deep experience influencing without authority across a global matrixed organisation
Strong analytical toolkit; comfortable working with finance and data science partners and interrogating the numbers yourself
Exceptional written and verbal communication, with executive presence in front of senior leadership
Comfort with ambiguity, and a strong bias toward action and ownership
Practical fluency with AI tools and a view on where they change how a team operates
Familiarity with the UKI and/or Nordic markets, or comparable mature-market experience
 Additional
Experience in a two-sided marketplace, travel/hospitality, or consumer tech
Experience launching or scaling new products or lines of business in-market
This role will require to be in the London office 3 days per week. 
 Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging
 Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
 How We'll Take Care Of You
 Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.
United Kingdom Annual Pay Range
£126,000—£158,000 GBP
 Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
 A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Senior Revenue Enablement Specialist - Product
location: San Francisco or New York City or Portland or United States
description:
In the early days of Silicon Valley, the most powerful ideas spread not through ads or algorithms, but through conversation. It was founders sharing lessons over coffee, investors making connections at late-night dinners, communities forming around ambition and belief. These moments weren’t loud, but they were transformative.

title: Spécialiste des opérations des ventes / Sales Operations Specialist
description:
**À propos du poste**
Dans une entreprise de distribution interentreprises (B2B) générant plusieurs milliards de dollars de chiffre d'affaires, l'accélération des ventes est bien plus qu'un simple mot à la mode : c'est un véritable avantage concurrentiel. Le ou la **Spécialiste en opérations commerciales** occupe un rôle essentiel et stratégique, conçu pour les professionnels performants qui allient réflexion stratégique, rigueur opérationnelle et compréhension approfondie des enjeux commerciaux. Vous évoluerez au sein de l'ensemble de l'écosystème des ventes, en collaborant avec les équipes des ventes externes, les spécialistes techniques, le développement des affaires et les équipes de marques privées, afin de permettre à chaque représentant d'agir plus rapidement, de conclure davantage d'affaires et d'offrir une expérience client exceptionnelle.
Il ne s'agit pas d'un rôle de soutien administratif traditionnel. Vous serez un acteur proactif de la croissance, guidé par les données et les résultats, en créant des liens entre les équipes des ventes, du marketing, de la gestion des catégories, du service à la clientèle, des comptes clients et de l'analytique. Qu'il s'agisse d'optimiser des processus complexes, d'éliminer des obstacles ou de mettre en œuvre des initiatives stratégiques, vous serez un partenaire clé dans la progression des opportunités commerciales et l'efficacité de l'organisation.
Chez Bunzl, nous misons sur l'excellence opérationnelle, l'innovation numérique et une approche centrée sur le client. Si vous êtes passionné(e) par l'habilitation des équipes de vente, motivé(e) par la résolution de problèmes et enthousiaste à l'idée d'avoir un impact concret sur les revenus et la satisfaction des clients, ce poste est pour vous.
**Principales responsabilités**
À titre de partenaire en accélération des ventes, vous agirez comme pilier stratégique des opérations commerciales en veillant à ce que les opportunités progressent efficacement, que les données soient exploitables et que les équipes de vente demeurent concentrées sur leurs clients.
**Développement des ventes et accélération des opportunités**
*Vous contribuerez activement à faire progresser les opportunités tout au long du cycle de vente.*
* Collaborer avec les équipes de vente afin de faire progresser les opportunités du stade de qualification jusqu'à la conclusion.
* Analyser les données du pipeline dans le CRM afin de comprendre l'étape des opportunités, leur valeur et leur alignement stratégique.
* Participer aux séances de planification des ventes afin d'aligner les stratégies, comprendre les enjeux des clients et identifier les principaux moteurs de valeur.
* Fournir des analyses provenant de la recherche de marché, de la veille concurrentielle et des données clients.
* Coordonner les demandes d'information sur les produits, les exceptions tarifaires et le soutien des fournisseurs.
* Élaborer des modèles de coûts et préparer les propositions de prix destinées aux approbations internes.
* Cartographier les points de contact du parcours client afin d'identifier les irritants, améliorer l'engagement et accroître les taux de conversion.
* Concevoir du matériel de vente professionnel adapté aux besoins internes et externes.
**Analyse de données et renseignements clients**
*Vous transformerez les données en informations pertinentes pour soutenir des décisions commerciales éclairées.*
* Analyser les activités du pipeline et les données clients afin d'identifier les risques et les opportunités.
* Créer et maintenir des organigrammes clients pour soutenir la planification des comptes stratégiques.
* Développer des tableaux de bord, prévisions et rapports synthèses permettant aux intervenants d'obtenir des informations claires et exploitables.
* Utiliser les outils Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Power BI, Dynamics CRM et les plateformes d'automatisation pour soutenir la prise de décision basée sur les données.
* Relier les informations provenant de différentes plateformes afin de soutenir des approches de vente personnalisées.
* Soumettre les prévisions de consommation de nouveaux produits à l'équipe des achats.
**Soutien opérationnel et optimisation des processus**
*Vous serez responsable de l'amélioration continue des processus opérationnels afin d'assurer la fluidité des activités commerciales.*
* Collaborer avec les équipes de gestion des catégories et de la chaîne d'approvisionnement pour trouver des produits ou créer de nouvelles références.
* Coordonner les demandes d'échantillons et la facturation des fournisseurs afin de contrôler les coûts et respecter les délais.
* Préparer les dossiers de révision tarifaire et gérer les soumissions officielles de prix.
* Soutenir l'équipe des comptes clients lors de la création de nouveaux comptes en recueillant les informations manquantes et en facilitant la résolution rapide des dossiers.
* Assurer l'exactitude des fichiers de produits et de prix afin de garantir la fiabilité des soumissions et des commandes.
* Assurer le suivi des demandes jusqu'à leur résolution complète.
* Identifier les inefficacités et mettre en place des solutions pour améliorer l'exécution.
**Soutien administratif et commercial**
*Vous veillerez à ce que les équipes de vente demeurent organisées, conformes et efficaces.*
* Rédiger et réviser des ententes tarifaires, contrats et autres documents commerciaux.
* Effectuer le suivi des demandes en cours et des échéances afin d'assurer leur réalisation dans les délais.
* Maintenir une documentation centralisée et organisée des interactions clients et des dossiers de vente.
* Configurer les programmes de remises clients selon les ententes commerciales dans les systèmes de l'entreprise.
* Assurer le suivi du cycle de vie des contrats, de leur création à leur renouvellement.
* Veiller à la conformité de toute documentation avec les politiques internes, les exigences des clients et les normes d'audit.
* Préparer des présentations exécutives, dossiers d'approbation et documents de validation pour soutenir la conclusion des ventes.
**Collaboration interfonctionnelle et relation client**
*Vous agirez comme point de liaison et facilitateur entre les équipes internes et les clients.*
* Servir d'intermédiaire clé entre les équipes des ventes, du marketing, des produits, du service à la clientèle, des comptes clients, de la gestion des catégories et des données.
* Faciliter les transferts d'information et la livraison des engagements clients.
* Intervenir de façon proactive pour clarifier les besoins, résoudre les obstacles et maintenir la confiance des clients.
* Escalader les enjeux récurrents et participer aux initiatives d'amélioration des outils, processus et méthodes de travail.
**Qualifications**
* Diplôme d'études collégiales ou universitaires en administration des affaires, ventes, marketing ou domaine connexe.
* Minimum de trois ans d'expérience en opérations des ventes, habilitation des ventes ou analyse d'affaires, idéalement dans un environnement B2B. Une expérience en distribution constitue un atout.
* Excellente maîtrise des applications Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Power BI, Dynamics CRM et des plateformes d'automatisation.
* Capacité à établir des liens entre les activités tactiques et les objectifs stratégiques à long terme.
* Aisance à analyser les données et à en tirer des recommandations concrètes.
* Excellentes aptitudes en communication, avec la capacité d'adapter son message à différents publics, des représentants sur le terrain à la haute direction.
* Esprit analytique, curiosité et capacité à gérer la complexité avec calme et professionnalisme.
* Souci du détail et capacité à maintenir un haut niveau d'exactitude dans un environnement dynamique.
* Orientation client et engagement envers la création de valeur pour les partenaires internes et externes.
* Capacité à bâtir des relations de confiance et à favoriser la réussite collective.
**Indicateurs de performance**
Le succès dans ce rôle sera mesuré par votre capacité à accroître la rapidité, la clarté et l'efficacité du processus de vente.
* **Vitesse de progression des opportunités** : réduction du délai entre la création d'une opportunité et sa conclusion.
* **Efficacité du soutien aux ventes** : rapidité et précision des soumissions ainsi que satisfaction des parties prenantes internes.
* **Impact client** : rétroaction positive des clients et amélioration de l'engagement.
* **Excellence opérationnelle** : amélioration de la qualité des données du pipeline, de l'efficacité des processus et de leur adoption.
* **Retour sur investissement des outils d'aide à la vente** : augmentation de l'utilisation et de l'efficacité des outils, modèles et ressources commerciales.

**About the Role:**
In a multi-billion-dollar B2B distribution business, sales acceleration is more than a buzzword — it is a competitive advantage. The **Sales Operations Specialist** is a mission-critical role built for high-performing professionals who blend strategic thinking, operational precision, and commercial insight. You will operate across the entire sales ecosystem — from Outside Sales and Technical Specialists to Business Development and Own Brand teams — ensuring every seller is empowered to move faster, win more, and serve customers better.
This is not your typical behind-the-scenes support role. You will be an initiative-taking, data-informed force for growth — connecting the dots across Sales, Marketing, Category Management, Customer Service, Accounts Receivable, and Analytics. Whether it is untangling complex workflows, removing barriers, or bringing smart strategies to life, you will be the go-to execution partner for keeping the pipeline moving and the team on point.
At Bunzl, we thrive on digital execution, customer-first thinking, and operational excellence. If you are enthusiastic about sales enablement, obsessed with problem-solving, and excited to see the tangible impact of your work on revenue and customer success – this is your opportunity to lead from the center.
**Key Responsibilities**
As a Sales Acceleration Partner, you will function as the strategic operations backbone for the sales team — ensuring deals move faster, data is actionable, and sellers stay focused on customers. Your work spans five core areas:
**Sales Enablement & Deal Acceleration**
*You will fuel deal momentum through hands-on, tactical execution across the sales cycle*
* Partner with selling teams to advance opportunities through the qualify to close selling process
* Review CRM pipeline data to understand stage, deal size, and strategic fit
* Join sales planning sessions to align on strategy, customer pain points, and key value drivers
* Contribute insights from market research, competitive intel, and customer data
* Request and manage product information, pricing exceptions, and vendor support
* Build cost models and compile pricing packages for internal review and approval
* Map customer journey touchpoints to spot friction, improve engagement, and drive conversion
* Create polished, purpose-built sales materials for internal and external use
**Data Analysis & Customer Insights**
*You will turn raw data into actionable insights that support smarter selling:*
* Analyze pipeline activity, and customer data to highlight risks and opportunities
* Create and maintain customer organizational charts to support strategic account planning.
* Develop dashboards, forecasts, and data summaries to provide stakeholders with clear, actionable data
* Leverage reporting tools including Microsoft Office Applications: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Power BI, CRM - Dynamics, and automation platforms to support data-driven decision-making.
* Connect insights across platforms to support personalized selling approaches
* Submit new item usage and forecasts to the purchasing team
**Operational Support & Workflow Optimization**
*You will take charge of optimizing operational processes, ensuring deals stay on track and progress efficiently:*
* Partner with Category and Supply Chain teams to source SKUs or initiate new item creation
* Coordinate product sample requests and vendor bill-backs to manage costs and meet delivery timelines
* Prepare pricing review packages and manage formal pricing submissions
* Support Accounts Receivable by collecting missing customer information during New Customer setup and facilitating timely resolution of outstanding issues
* Ensure part and price file accuracy to support quoting and order integrity
* Track requests through completion and eliminate ambiguity in workflows
* Identify inefficiencies and implement solutions to streamline execution
**Administrative & Commercial Support**
*You will ensure sales teams stay organized, compliant, and focused:*
* Draft and review pricing agreements, contracts, and other commercial documents
* Monitor open requests and deadlines, following up to ensure completion and accountability
* Maintain organized, centralized records of customer interactions, agreements, and sales documentation
* Establish customer rebate based on trade agreements in the system
* Track and manage contract lifecycles — from initial request to execution and renewal
* Ensure all documentation complies with internal policies, customer requirements, and audit standards
* Prepare executive-ready summaries, approval decks, or sign-off packages to support deal closure
**Cross-Functional & Customer Collaboration**
*You will serve as a communication bridge and problem-solver across teams and with customers:*
* Function as a key liaison between Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Service, Accounts Receivable, Category Management, and Data teams.
* Facilitate smooth internal handoffs and customer deliverables
* Proactively step in to clarify requirements, resolve blockers, and preserve customer confidence
* Escalate friction points and co-lead efforts to improve tools, processes, and execution
**Qualifications:**
* Diploma or degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years in a sales operations, sales enablement, or business analysis role, preferably within a B2B environment. Experience in a distribution environment an asset.
* Experience with Microsoft Office Applications: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Power BI, CRM - Dynamics, and automation platforms are highly valued.
* You see how tactical work connects to long-term business goals.
* You are comfortable diving into data to uncover actionable insights.
* Adapt your message to your audience — from field reps to senior leadership.
* Approach complexity with curiosity and calm.
* Ensure accuracy and follow-through in fast-paced, high-stakes work.
* Prioritize value — for internal partners and external clients alike.
* Build trust and make your teammates better through partnership
**Performance Metrics**
*Success in this role is measured by your ability to drive speed, clarity, and confidence across the sales process*
**Deal Velocity** – Reducing time from opportunity creation to close
**Sales Support Effectiveness** – Fast, accurate quote turnaround and internal stakeholder satisfaction
**Customer Impact –** Positive feedback from customers and improved engagement outcomes
**Operational Excellence** - Improved pipeline data quality, workflow efficiency, and process adoption
**Enablement ROI** – Increased usage and effectiveness of tools, templates, and sales assets

title: Manager, Customer Success Management
