title: Director of Revenue Operations (Sales)
description:
About Onclusive 
Onclusive is a global leader in media intelligence technology and services. We empower PR, Communications and Marketing professionals with a unified platform for media management, monitoring and analysis.
Our solutions combine cutting-edge AI, data science and human expertise to help customers make better, faster, data-driven decisions and prove the value of their communications.
We are PE-backed, global and scaling. Our next phase requires a world-class Revenue Operations leader to build a predictable, insight-led, high-velocity commercial engine.
 About the Role 
This is a high-impact Sales Revenue Operations leadership role, owning everything from marketing-generated pipeline through to Sales closure.
Reporting directly to the CSO and working closely with the CCO and Finance, you will build and run a global RevOps and Enablement function that:
Establishes a single source of truth across Salesforce and our GTM systems.
Drives commercial insight, operational efficiency and frontline performance.
Elevates Onclusive's revenue engine to be disciplined, scalable and data-driven.
Leads a unified Sales and Customer Success Enablement capability, supporting consistent onboarding, methodology, coaching and performance improvement across both organisations.
Works in close partnership with Customer Success Operations to align processes, data, systems and reporting across the end-to-end customer lifecycle.
Plays a key role in shaping the future Revenue Operations operating model, identifying opportunities for greater alignment and operational efficiency across Sales and Customer Success.
You will be both strategic and deeply hands-on, the type of leader who can present at Board level but is equally comfortable personally building dashboards, analysing commercial performance, improving Salesforce processes, designing enablement programmes and implementing operational change.
This is not a role focused solely on strategy, oversight or delegation. We are looking for a leader who takes direct ownership of execution, is willing to get into the detail and can independently deliver operational improvements while building and developing the wider function.
 Your Responsibilities (Across the Five RevOps Pillars) 
 1. Strategy & Planning 
Lead annual and quarterly revenue planning.
Build top-down and bottom-up capacity and productivity plans.
Own global GTM planning across quota setting, headcount, segmentation, ICP definition, territories and coverage models.
Partner with CSO, CCO and Finance on growth strategy, market prioritisation and commercial design.
Work with Customer Success Operations to identify opportunities for greater alignment in revenue planning, operational processes and reporting across the customer lifecycle.
Support the assessment and development of Onclusive's longer-term Revenue Operations operating model, working with Sales, Customer Success and Finance leadership.
Identify the underlying operational drivers of revenue performance and translate insights into recommendations and actions that improve GTM outcomes.
 2. Process, Enablement & Commercial Excellence 
Deliver onboarding, methodology, deal coaching, playbooks and pipeline discipline programmes.
Diagnose performance gaps (win rate, velocity, conversion) and turn insights into targeted enablement initiatives.
Define and evolve the full-funnel GTM processes: lead → opportunity → close → onboarding.
Ensure consistent stage definitions, qualification criteria, forecasting rigour and deal inspection frameworks.
Lead a consolidated Sales and Customer Success Enablement function through a dedicated Sales & CS Enablement Lead.
Oversee enablement strategy and delivery across Sales and Customer Success, ensuring consistent approaches to onboarding, methodology, coaching and performance development.
Partner with CS Operations to align enablement priorities with customer onboarding, account management, renewal and expansion requirements.
Establish clear enablement success measures, including ramp time, productivity, methodology adoption and commercial performance.
Work with CS Operations to improve operational handovers and consistency across the customer lifecycle.
 3. Data, Metrics & Insight 
Create a trusted single source of truth for all Sales revenue metrics, including pipeline, forecast and bookings.
Produce Board-ready performance reporting with clear commercial narratives.
Build predictive analytics for forecasting and sales optimisation.
Deliver actionable insights that directly influence AE and BDR teams.
Partner with Customer Success Operations to establish consistent data definitions, reporting methodologies and performance visibility across Sales and CS.
Drive alignment on shared revenue metrics, including multi-year contracts, renewals and expansion, ensuring a consistent view across the business.
Work closely with Finance to ensure commercial reporting is reconciled with financial reporting and subject to independent validation and governance.
Move beyond performance reporting to identify root causes of revenue gaps and recommend targeted operational improvements.
 4. Systems, Tools & Automation 
Own and optimise Salesforce globally, supporting all new business workflows.
Lead our CRM consolidation project and future architecture.
Govern and optimise the GTM tech stack, including sales engagement, conversation intelligence, forecasting, BI and CPQ.
Drive automation and AI adoption to reduce admin time and increase seller productivity.
Implement scalable data governance and hygiene standards.
Partner with Customer Success Operations, IT and Finance to improve alignment and integration across Sales and CS systems.
Support consistent commercial data structures and definitions across the customer lifecycle, reducing duplication and improving reporting integrity.
Ensure Salesforce operates as the commercial source of truth, providing accurate and consistent data into downstream billing and financial systems.
Identify opportunities for shared technology, automation and process improvements across Sales and Customer Success.
 5. Governance, Alignment & Execution 
Global Sales commercial operating rhythm: forecast calls, pipeline reviews, QBRs and Board reporting.
Ensure alignment between Sales, BDR, CS, Marketing and Finance.
Partner with Finance on incentive planning, productivity models and compensation design.
Build, lead and develop a high-performing RevOps & Enablement team.
Lead the Sales & CS Enablement Lead, strengthening the capability and capacity of the Revenue Operations organisation.
Establish a close working partnership with the CS Operations, aligning shared priorities, processes, reporting and operational initiatives while maintaining clear functional accountability.
Work with the CSO and CCO to assess how Sales and CS Operations can operate more effectively together and help shape the future Revenue Operations structure.
Maintain clear accountability for GTM operational performance, while Finance independently governs financial integrity, reconciliation and validation of reporting.
Identify opportunities to simplify processes, remove duplication and improve efficiency across Sales and Customer Success.
Ensure RevOps remains embedded with GTM leadership and focused on identifying and addressing the operational causes of revenue performance gaps.
Maintain a strong hands-on approach to operational execution, personally driving critical initiatives, resolving process and system challenges, and delivering reporting, analysis and improvements where required rather than relying solely on team resources.
 What Success Looks Like 
A predictable, accurate forecasting model trusted by the CEO and Board.
A unified global GTM operating rhythm with consistent process adoption.
Improved win rates, larger deal sizes and shorter sales cycles.
Clean, reliable data across Salesforce and the revenue tech stack.
A commercial organisation that is more productive, better enabled and consistently outperforming targets.
A unified Sales and CS Enablement capability delivering measurable improvements in onboarding, productivity, methodology adoption and commercial performance.
A stronger Sales RevOps organisation with dedicated enablement leadership capacity.
Greater consistency in data, processes, systems and reporting across Sales and Customer Success.
Clear, effective collaboration between Sales Operations and CS Operations, with well-defined responsibilities and shared priorities.
Consistent commercial reporting supported by independent Finance validation and governance.
Meaningful contribution to the development of Onclusive's longer-term Revenue Operations operating model.
 Who You Are 
A proven RevOps leader with 10+ years in Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations or Sales Ops within B2B SaaS.
Have owned the full Sales RevOps function before, including Sales Ops, Analytics and Enablement.
Deep full-funnel expertise in pipeline management, forecasting and sales methodology.
Exceptional analytical and commercial acumen, understanding the levers behind bookings and revenue performance.
Hands-on Salesforce leader, able to design processes and reporting as well as guide CRM administrators.
Skilled in the modern GTM tech stack, including Salesforce, forecasting tools, sales engagement tools, conversation intelligence and BI/analytics.
Comfortable operating in PE-backed or rapidly scaling SaaS environments.
A strong communicator who can simplify complexity and influence senior stakeholders.
A builder who can roll up their sleeves, execute, iterate and scale.
Experienced in leading and developing multi-disciplinary Revenue Operations teams, including enablement.
Demonstrable experience partnering across Sales and Customer Success to improve operational alignment and revenue performance.
Able to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive shared outcomes without requiring direct organisational ownership.
Comfortable operating in evolving organisational structures and contributing to the design of future operating models.
Commercially focused, with the ability to translate performance data into clear recommendations and measurable improvements in GTM execution.
A genuinely hands-on operator and builder who combines strategic thinking with practical execution. You are comfortable working directly in Salesforce, building reports and dashboards, interrogating data, solving operational problems and implementing improvements yourself, rather than relying on others to deliver.
 What We Offer 
Competitive salary and benefits.
Hybrid working environment with global exposure.
High-visibility role with CEO, CSO, ELT and Board.
Opportunity to build a world-class RevOps & Enablement function.
A culture that values performance, wellbeing and inclusion.

Expanded leadership responsibility through dedicated enablement resources.
Opportunity to influence the future direction and operating model of Revenue Operations across Onclusive.

title: Founding Customer Success Lead (Healthtech Startup)
description:
We're hiring our first Customer Success expert at Asterix Health 
Millions of patients in the UK wait weeks for a GP appointment. Millions more are stuck on hospital waitlists. Preventable conditions go unnoticed. At the heart of it is one problem: a shortage of highly qualified doctors.
Asterix is building a new model of care to solve it. Our DoctorOS platform combines rigorous clinical leadership, real-world healthcare workflows and AI tooling, so highly qualified doctors can make safer, more consistent decisions and be up to 10x more productive.
We were founded by Julian and Max, who met at Entrepreneurs First, and we're backed by Triple Point Ventures, D2 Fund, DLB Ventures and a group of angels from healthcare, technology and policy. We're already deployed at some of the UK's largest healthcare providers, generating revenue and scaling fast.
 Why this role, why now 
Our service works, and practices nationwide love having Asterix GPs on their team. The challenge now is scale. We're moving from 4 to 10+ new customer launches every month, and we need someone to turn what works today into a system that works at ten times the size.
This is the person who will own the customer function as we grow from 450,000 to 10 million+ patients.
 What you'll own: 
 The operating model: define the rhythm for performance and health management across the whole customer journey, from pilot to ongoing delivery and retention
 Playbooks and SOPs: write and roll out internal and external playbooks, covering monthly reporting, headcount planning and feedback loops that track account health
 Team leadership: line manage, coach and develop our Medical Operations team, who own day-to-day practice relationships, so they can deliver an industry-leading customer experience
 Continuous improvement: use customer feedback to raise the quality of delivery across every account
 Who you'll work with: 
You'll report to Max (Co-founder & COO) and partner closely with Julian (Co-founder & CEO) on Sales and Customer Experience, Dr Harriet Bradley (Medical Director) on Clinical and Governance, and Jamil (Delivery Operations Manager) on GP supply-side operations.
Our customers include GP practices, PCNs, GP Federations and private healthcare providers across the UK.
 Who you are 
You're an experienced healthcare operator who has scaled services before. You've built an operational Customer Success function from the ground up in an early-stage, high-growth health or healthtech business, owned it end-to-end and grown it alongside the company.
You love the detail (onboarding playbooks, SOPs, KPIs, renewal health) but never lose sight of the bigger picture: retention, expansion and customers who become advocates.
 You're likely to have: 
7+ years in Customer Success / Operations
Startup experience, ideally in a healthtech scaleup or NHS primary care setting
Led a CQC inspection
Challenged senior colleagues when a trade-off was wrong
Strong commercial understanding of service economics, and the ability to explain it clearly
Fluency in CS metrics such as adoption, churn, retention and NRR
Experience "productising" operations: building the structures, blueprints and SOPs a growing team needs
Sound judgement on imperfect information, and hands-on use of AI, automation and analytics tools
We care more about what you've built and achieved than about your credentials. If you've bent reality to get something done, or have a side project you're proud of, we want to hear about it.
 How we work: 
 Humble: we assume we're wrong until the data or a clinician proves otherwise
 Founder mentality: we don't wait for permission and we push problems to resolution
 Joyful energy: we take the work seriously, not ourselves, and we celebrate progress together
 In-person by design: we work shoulder-to-shoulder in London because it makes us faster and tighter as a team
To be upfront: this is an early-stage company with ambitious delivery targets, and the pace is intense. It isn't a 9-to-5. If that excites you, you'll thrive here.
 What's on offer: 
£90k base + equity
Bupa private health and dental
28 days holiday + bank holidays
Central London office in Shoreditch, in-person 4 days a week
 The process: 
30 min intro with Al (Head of Talent)
30 min hiring manager interview with Max (COO)
30 min peer interview with Dr Harriet Bradley (Medical Director)
Take-home case study
1 hr in-person case study review with Julian and Max
Offer. We've done the whole thing in under a week.

Develop trusted relationships with decision makers

Achieve operational excellence

title: GTM Founder's Associate
description:
In just over two years, we’ve gone from 0 to over 900 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We’re now on the hunt for a brilliant all-rounder who wants to make an enormous impact on Spruce’s growth trajectory as we add thousands of installers over the next 18 months. You’ll work on marketing, commercial strategy, RevOps, reporting & analytics, and generally anything that helps accelerate our growth.
This is not an easy job – but we can promise it’ll be incredibly stimulating & fulfilling, and you’ll struggle to find a lovelier, more engaged group of customers to work with (..and the team’s not bad either!).
 🌲 About Spruce
Almost 20% of the UK’s carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there’s simply no way to make reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But there’s a problem: the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it really hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can’t currently offer a heat pump when someone’s boiler breaks and they urgently need heating. 
We’re fixing this. We’ve built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we’re having a massive impact on hundreds of installation businesses, merchants, utilities and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job, doubling their sales conversion rates, and boosting their bottom line. 
We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and have been scaling the team to massively grow our impact. We’re in the process of expanding outside heat pumps and by the end of the year will be an operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and autoCAD, you might get a sense of where we’re headed…
 🥖 The Role
 As we drive the business towards the next fundraise, you’ll be working closely with Hector and our founder Jo getting stuck into pretty much everything that goes on across the growth side of business. No two days will be the same, but at minimum your work will include:
Running growth experiments – setting up and running our full set of growth/marketing tests, quickly binning things that don’t work, and iterating quickly on everything to find our growth levers. 
Creating & managing ads, creative, and content – top and middle-funnel marketing content, videos, customer testimonials, short form copy for our website, socials, ads, and nurturing emails, and onboarding guides for new customers. 
Supporting sales & customer success – building the systems that allow our commercial teams to scale hyper-efficiently and deliver exponentially more value per hour of work they do. 
Data analysis & reporting – digging into how our customers are using the platform, breaking down conversion rates through our marketing and sales pipelines, spotting areas we can improve, and coming up with suggestions for when and how we should change tack. 
 🫵 About You
 You’ll have somewhere between 1 and 6 years work experience (doesn’t matter if it’s not directly related to this role) and you’ll ideally be:
Relentlessly proactive — you naturally take responsibility, are always pushing to make things better, and just want to crack on and get sh*t done;
A brilliant communicator — you write compelling, concise copy and can explain complex concepts simply;
Highly analytical — you have a real affinity for numbers, love diving into data, and are comfortable working in Excel;
A natural “people person” — you love working with people, find it easy to warm to them and quickly put them at ease;
An AI whizz – you’re way ahead of the average person with your LLM usage, have built interesting/cool things in your spare time, and are deeply conscious of all the things that are possible that you haven’t had a chance to try yet;
… and you’ll hopefully also love heat pumps! 🤓
 🌟 Our offer
💰 Base salary £50-70k, with quarterly bonus aligned to company targets
🍰 Slice of equity (options) in the company
🏖️ 33 days holiday and opportunity to work from abroad for another 30 days each year
👧 Workplace Nursery Benefit scheme (YellowNest)
🏥 Private Medical Cover
🧑‍🍼 Enhanced Parental Leave
🚲 Cycle to Work scheme
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Brilliant team to learn from and massive opportunity to grow
🌍 Meaningful, impactful work that genuinely improves the world. 
 🧑‍💻 Working at Spruce
We’re currently a close-knit team of 32, split between London and Bristol. We spend 2-3 days each week working together in-person in both locations, and get everyone altogether every fortnight. 
You'll have genuine influence from day one. The best idea wins regardless of seniority. We expect you to challenge everything, ask "why?" multiple levels deep, and push back when something doesn't make sense. 
We want everyone to spend time with installers on-site, feel their pain points, then be able to rapidly suggest and implement solutions based on real feedback rather than assumptions. 
We move fast and ship imperfect things, learning from users rather than trying to perfect in isolation. When things break, we focus on how we fix it, what can we learn and never blame. You'll own your outcomes whilst knowing the team has your back. 
Feedback is constant, direct, and kind – we'll tell you when something isn't working and expect the same honesty (and empathy) back.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
About Kernel
Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?
Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.
Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.
Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.
We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 10x YoY.
The Role
We're looking for a GTM Engineer to build the systems that take Kernel to $100m+ ARR. You'll own the infrastructure behind how we find, sell to and grow customers, from Salesforce and outbound to forecasting, renewals and expansion.
This is a hands-on builder role, not a traditional RevOps support function. You'll work like a product engineer for GTM: find the biggest constraint on growth, turn a messy commercial problem into a working system, ship it quickly and improve it using real results. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to be able to build with Salesforce, Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools rather than waiting for someone else to do it.
You'll also be Kernel's own internal customer , using Kernel to build an AI-native revenue engine, pressure-test the product in real workflows and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering.
You'll report to Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations , and work closely with Sales leadership and the wider GTM team.
What You'll Be Doing
 Build a better outbound engine: improve account targeting, signals, enrichment, prioritization, personalization, sequencing and measurement so the team consistently reaches the right companies at the right time
 Make the GTM team more productive: automate repetitive work across account research, meeting preparation, follow-ups, CRM hygiene and handoffs so BDRs, AEs and Account Managers spend more time with customers
 Run the revenue operating infrastructure: own the systems behind pipeline management, forecasting, funnel reporting, quota planning, GTM incentive compensation, renewals and expansion
 Set the rules of engagement: own account assignment and routing, settle ownership disputes, and make sure every meeting booked and held is captured and credited to the right person
 Improve how revenue work moves through Kernel: build reliable routing, attribution, account assignment and cross-functional handoffs, resolve edge cases and make performance visible
 Be Kernel's own internal customer: deploy Kernel on our CRM, use it to improve our GTM data and workflows, and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering
What You Bring
 3-5 years of relevant experience: you have worked in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM Engineering at a high-growth Series B-E SaaS company and owned meaningful parts of the revenue engine end to end
 Deep Salesforce fluency: you understand objects, record types, fields, formulas, flows, validation rules, permissions, reports and data migration. You can reason about architecture and debug production behavior
 Strong GTM building ability: you have built useful systems with Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools, and you know how to move from a rough idea to a reliable workflow that people adopt
 Commercial judgment: you understand how accounts become meetings, meetings become pipeline, pipeline is qualified and forecast, and won revenue flows into implementation, expansion, renewal and retention
 Strong data instincts: you can turn fragmented information into trustworthy workflows, measure what is working and create feedback loops that improve performance over time
 Clear, low-ego communication: you can turn a messy request into a crisp decision, explain trade-offs to non-technical teams, push back constructively and drive adoption through influence rather than authority
It is a plus if you also have:
Experience supporting an enterprise sales motion with multi-stakeholder deals and MEDDPICC
Experience with renewals, expansion, compensation, quota setting or planning
Familiarity with Gong, sales engagement platforms and modern enrichment or intent tooling
Experience building operational controls around LLM- or agent-powered workflows
⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:
Prefer strategy and recommendations over configuring systems, cleaning data, investigating edge cases and debugging workflows yourself
Need outlined requirements or stable priorities before you can make progress
See GTM Engineering primarily as CRM administration or ticket fulfillment rather than a revenue-generating function
❌ This role is definitely not for you if you:
Are not comfortable taking broad ownership of a function
Prefer a predictable, low-intensity environment
Want to protect a 9-to-6 or a mostly remote setup. We are in the office together 4-5 days a week and the pace is high
What We Offer
We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.
💰 Salary: £70,000-£90,000 + equity
🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays
🥕 £450 monthly office dinner allowance
✈️ 2 weeks work-from-anywhere
🍼 Generous parental leave policy
💼 Pension plan
💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office

title: Sr. Revenue Enablement Manager, Groups
location: United States or Denver or Tempe or Chicago
description:
About Engine 
Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.
That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).
We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.
Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.
 Your Mission: 
As a Sr. Revenue Enablement Manager, Groups, you'll be the dedicated enablement partner for Engine's Groups business. That team helps everyone from corporate offsites and field crews to weddings, sports teams, and disaster-relief deployments book hotel room blocks. New-hire onboarding is largely owned by a partner team. You own everything after it: ongoing enablement and everboarding that keep the Groups team sharp, consistent, and growing revenue. You'll report to the Manager, Revenue Enablement once that role is filled, and to the Director of Revenue Enablement until then. Here's what you'll take charge of:
 Own Groups Enablement: 
Everboarding Programs: Plan, build, and deliver the Groups training program after onboarding, including skill-building paths, refreshers, and certifications on Engine's group products, sales process, and call expectations.
Playbooks: Develop, deliver, and train Groups playbooks with Groups leadership, front-line managers, Revenue Operations, and Product Marketing, covering areas such as qualifying requests, building and presenting room-block proposals, handling objections, and expanding repeat group business.
Onboarding Alignment: Partner with the onboarding team so what's learned in onboarding carries through once reps are ramped.
AI-First Enablement: Build AI first. Use AI to create Groups training, playbooks, role-plays, and coaching at scale, so every rep gets more practice, faster answers, and content that keeps up with the business.
 Partner with the Groups Business: 
Know the Groups Business: Build a deep understanding of how Groups sells and serves customers, who it serves, what it's measured on, and what's changing in the group travel market.
Embedded Partnership: Spend regular time with Groups leaders, front-line managers, and reps. Join team meetings and pipeline reviews to understand needs and turn them into enablement that improves performance.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Product, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, and the broader Revenue Enablement team so launches, messaging, and process changes reach Groups ready to use.
 Programs & Measurement: 
Measure What Matters: Track and report enablement impact for Groups, such as certification and program adoption, request-to-booking conversion, revenue per rep, and repeat or expansion business.
Performance Inspection: Drive results through inspection, evaluation, and accountability on the skills and playbooks you design, using call reviews and performance data.
Enablement Tech Stack: Make sure the Groups team gets full value from our tools. Work with our tools and systems team so new tools actually get adopted.
Launch Readiness: Get the Groups team ready for new products, features, pricing, and process changes.
 Why This Role: AI-First at Engine: 
At Engine, AI isn't a side project. It's how we work. Our access to create with AI is incredibly unique, and this role is a rare chance to get exposure to a ton of AI tools and learn from the best. The expectation is simple: AI first, to create scale, so enablement reaches every corner of the Groups team faster. Building this way grows Engine, and it grows your skill set too. If you're growth-minded and excited to build what's next, you'll thrive here.
 What You'll Bring to Engine: 
Experience: 4+ years in revenue enablement, sales enablement, sales training, or a customer-facing revenue role, including 2+ years designing and delivering enablement or training programs. 
Group Sales Familiarity: Experience enabling or working in group sales, hospitality, events, or travel sales teams is a strong plus but not required.
Facilitation: You can lead a room, in person or virtually, and you can turn complex products and processes into training people actually use.

Tech-Savvy: Bonus points if you're fluent in Salesforce, conversation intelligence tools (e.g., Momentum), and enablement/LMS platforms (e.g., GTMBuddy, LetterAI).
AI-First Mindset: You reach for AI first to create scale, and you're excited to get hands-on with a wide range of AI tools. You're growth-minded and eager to keep building your skill set.
Mindset: You're ready to roll up your sleeves, work independently, and deliver results that matter.

Experience carrying a quota or working as a rep or account manager.
Examples of enablement content, practice, or coaching you've built with AI.
 Location & Travel: 
This role is preferably based in or near one of our hubs in Denver, CO; Tempe, AZ; or Chicago, IL, and we're open to remote candidates elsewhere in the US. Expect to travel about one week per month to work with teams in person, plus major company events.
 We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early.

title: Sales Compensation Lead
description:
We’re reinventing payments. In less than four years, Dojo disrupted the market to become the largest and most loved acquirer in the UK. Our payments infrastructure, purpose-built for in-person commerce, is game changing.
Now, over 150,000 customers across four countries choose to transact billions with us every year. But we’re just getting started.
Our people are the driving force behind our success. They are our greatest investment and our ultimate competitive advantage. We hire exceptional people and give them the autonomy, trust, and ownership to thrive. The results take care of themselves.
 The role
 We’re looking for an experienced Sales Compensation Lead to shape the design, evolution, and commercial performance of incentive structures across our sales channels – with a primary focus on our self-employed field team.
In this role, you’ll define how we reward our sales force while balancing commercial growth with strong unit economics. Your commission models will improve deal quality, maximize merchant lifetime value (LTV), celebrate high-performing sellers, and protect gross margin.
Sitting within Revenue Strategy & Operations, you’ll optimize Dojo’s global sales compensation strategy. You’ll partner closely with Sales, Finance, Analytics, RevOps, and People teams to align our incentives with our biggest growth priorities.
 What You Will Do...
Design and refine commission structures, residual splits, and quality bonuses for self-employed Payment Consultants to support high-margin acquisition, prevent mis-selling, and maximize merchant LTV.
Benchmark commission rates, residual models, and seller terms against industry standards so our offering stays sharp and appealing.
Partner with Finance and Analytics teams to model margin impact, payback periods, and CAC-to-LTV ratios for proposed compensation changes.
Analyze retention, churn, and processing volumes across seller tiers to optimize commission spend.
Collaborate with Monetization to set clear profitability floors and guardrails for automated field pricing tools.
Advise C-suite, Sales Leadership, RevOps, and People teams on variable pay strategy – turning complex models into simple documentation, transparent earnings calculators, and smooth rollouts.
 What You Will Bring...
Proven capability in designing and managing variable compensation plans, quota modeling, and incentive structures, including indirect or self-employed sales channels.
A background in high-growth fintech, SaaS, or B2B tech with a practical understanding of unit economics, margins, and merchant churn – payments knowledge is a plus.
Deep familiarity with B2B sales models (direct, partner, and inside sales) and what motivates sellers to perform at their best.
Advanced financial modeling and quantitative skills in Excel and Google Sheets to evaluate scenarios, build predictive payout models, and shape data-informed recommendations.
Clear communication and stakeholder management skills to explain complex concepts simply to C-suite leaders and technical teams alike.
Proficiency with Salesforce and BI tools like Looker or Tableau, plus hands-on capability using AI to prototype seller tools and automate recurring tasks.
 Dojo home and away
 We believe our best work happens when we collaborate in-person. These “together days” foster communication, drive innovation and spark our brightest ideas.
That's why we have an office-first culture. This means working from the office 4+ days per week.
With offices across Europe, we know a thing or two about staying dynamic. Need deep focus? Head to a quiet zone. Big ideas? Collaboration spaces have you covered. Just here for a catch-up? Our social hubs make it easy. Do work that counts, in spaces made for you.
 Question: what’s curious, relentless, and customer obsessed?
 If you’re keen to know the answer, you’re a third of the way to meeting our Dojo values.
 If The Following Speak To You, Let’s Talk
 You’re curious. You have a real desire to learn and create.
You’re relentless. You keep going even when it’s easier not to.
You’re customer-obsessed. You know how important customers are to what you do.
 Diversity, equity, and inclusion at Dojo
 From local bakeries to well-known eateries, Dojo payments serve over 150,000 places across the UK.
And something that’s fundamental to creating relevant, innovative products at Dojo is to build teams to reflect the diversity of the businesses we serve.
Our drive to improve diversity, equity, and inclusion is closely linked to helping employees thrive and innovating for better customer experiences.
If you care about your work, you’re curious, and you think customer-first, you have a place at Dojo.
To make sure you’re the best you can be throughout the recruitment process, let us know if you need any extra adjustments to help you thrive.
Visit dojo.careers to find out more about our benefits and what it’s like to work at Dojo, or check out our LinkedIn and Instagram pages.

title: Revenue Operations Analyst
description:
What We Do 
We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.
Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.
Together, we’ve provided more than 3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.
About Roo
Roo is building the modern labor marketplace and operating system for veterinary care. We help hospitals reliably access great veterinary professionals and help veterinary professionals find flexible, meaningful work.
We're looking for a Revenue Operations Analyst to build the systems and reporting behind Relief-to-Hire, the Roo business that helps hospitals hire the veterinarians and technicians they met through relief shifts. You are accountable for one outcome: a placement pipeline the team trusts, that runs without manual chasing.
This is not a reporting-only role. Today much of the placement process runs through messages and spreadsheets. You will move it into a real pipeline with clear stages, automated handoffs and numbers everyone uses, so our Career Pathways managers spend their time closing placements instead of tracking them.
What You'll Own
Pipeline and CRM
Build and own the Relief-to-Hire pipeline in our CRM, with stages that match the funnel: relief match, interest from one side, interest from both sides, closed placement.
Set data standards so every deal has an owner, a stage and a next step.
Keep one deal per hospital-provider pair, linked to both records, so revenue can be traced to its source.
Retire manual tracking as the CRM takes over.
Reporting and Forecasting
Build the weekly Relief-to-Hire scorecard and placement forecast.
Find where deals stall and size what fixing each step is worth.
Make sure placement revenue is attributed correctly across the business units that share it.
Invoicing and Automation
Act as the business owner for automated placement invoicing, working with Platform and Finance.
Write requirements for lifecycle and workflow automations, and measure whether each one worked.
Experiments and Expansion
Set up and read tests on fees, terms and outreach, with the holdout defined before launch.
Extend the same pipeline and reporting to Canada when the business launches there as Locum-to-Hire.
What Success Looks Like
In your first year, you will:
Deliver one trusted Relief-to-Hire scorecard used in the weekly business review.
Get every active placement deal tracked in the CRM, not in chat or spreadsheets.
Help launch automated placement invoicing in the US, then Canada.
Measurably reduce the time Career Pathways managers spend on manual updates.
What We're Looking For
Experience in revenue operations, sales operations or business analytics at a marketplace, staffing, recruiting or SaaS company.
Strong SQL and spreadsheet skills, and experience with a BI tool.
Hands-on CRM administration experience, such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
You turn a messy process into clear requirements that engineers and operators can act on.
A record of changing a team's workflow with them, not to them.
You understand why different deal types, such as veterinarian and technician placements, need different processes.
Rigor with data. You check a surprising number against a second source before you share it.
Experience with cohort analysis, including knowing when recent cohorts are too new to read.
Clear, concise writing.
Experience with recruiting or placement funnels is a plus.
Fluency with AI as a way of working, including using it to automate your own work.
High agency and coachability.
Why Roo
Build the operating system for a business that is moving from manual to automated.
See your work show up directly in revenue and in how the team spends its time.
Join a company defining a new category in veterinary workforce flexibility.
Partner closely with an ambitious leadership team that values first-principles thinking, ownership and continuous improvement.

title: Customer Success Operations Specialist
description:
Description 
The Customer Success Operations Specialist (CSOS) enables the effectiveness, scalability, and operational excellence of Customer Success by translating strategic partnership priorities into consistent, scalable processes and day-to-day execution. The role works cross-functionally with CSMs, Sales, Licensing, Finance, Services, and Microsoft to ensure programs and offerings are effectively operationalized and delivered.
The CSOS supports operations and program offerings end-to-end, from inception through implementation and ongoing execution. This includes agreement and licensing operations, program administration, reporting, platform enablement, process optimization, and the development of workflows, tools, training, and best practices that enable CSMs and supporting teams to achieve adoption, expansion, retention, profitability, and vendor program objectives.
The role partners closely with Strategic Partnerships and Operations leads to optimize processes across the customer and sales lifecycle, maximize gross profit and Microsoft incentive opportunities at the customer level, and ensure accurate and timely execution through systems such as Salesforce and Gainsight. The CSOS also supports the operationalization of emerging Microsoft requirements, programs, and services, ensuring they can be consistently adopted and scaled across CDW Canada.
The CSOS plays a key role in team enablement and operational continuity , including new-hire onboarding, documentation and maintenance of Customer Success best practices, cross-training, reporting, and coordination of program communications. The role identifies opportunities to improve, automate, and standardize processes while ensuring the Customer Success organization has the systems, information, and operational support required to execute effectively.
Key Areas of Responsibility
Program and Project Support
· Support strategic Microsoft programs end to end, delivering KPIs and milestones on time, in scope and on budget, and prioritizing time against the opportunities with the strongest potential return.
· Be fiscally responsible for program results, and keep the project team accountable to deadlines
· Understanding Microsoft programs, funded workshop engagements and co-sell motions.
· Maintain and improve the Program & Operations process guides and standard operating procedures in our knowledge base
· Supporting and educating the Microsoft practice where needed, while showcasing the end-to-end funding process.
Process Optimize, Governance and Compliance
· Optimize, implement and manage scalable operational processes for CDW Customer Success.
· Continuously identify and investigate opportunities for process development and improvement, to ensure internal and external customer satisfaction and maximum efficiency.
· Lead our submission of the annual Partner compliance audit, act on the findings, identify and communicate audit results to mitigate operational risk.
· Update CDW/Microsoft SOP documentation to keep the Licensing Operations manual accurate, and work with CDW USA to leverage existing processes wherever the opportunity exists.
Licensing and Software Operations
· Support Software Operations processes, including the Microsoft Enterprise Agreement T36 process, renewal management, Software EDC maintenance, software contract management and vendor reporting tools, and assist with vendor performance tracking such as rebates and incentives.
· Support Contract Lifecycle Management, and process and invoice customer agreements across marketplaces, operationalizing the end-to-end journey accurately and on time.
· Enter all anniversary orders into our systems within Microsoft timelines, and complete annual Open Value, Select Plus, EES, MPSA and Indirect EA billings.
· Enter and manage CPOR claims and provide support on level 100 licensing inquiries.
· Work with internal teams and partners to keep quoting, ordering and deal registration running smoothly for Microsoft customers.
· Provide accurate and timely responses on operational processes to Software Product Managers, Licensing Specialists, Customer Success Managers and Sales.
Partner Programs, Funding and Incentives
· Facilitating collaboration across CDW Delivery, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Finance to ensure strategic alignment
· Supporting Microsoft Programs by driving alignment with CDW’s strategic goals and desired business outcomes
· Work directly with Microsoft to gather funding program updates to enable our workforce, covering ECIF, workshops, FastTrack, MDF, MCI Deployment programs and Adoption accelerators.
· Submit, track and claim Microsoft funding for all eligible programs, including workshop and funding claims.
· Support Microsoft funded programs to maximize return on investment.
· Collaborate with CDW’s Customer Success Microsoft practice leads and marketing to develop go-to-market strategies for promotional campaigns and customer-facing documentation.
· Support all CDW sellers with the tools, resources, and enablement needed to effectively lead Microsoft program discussions with customers.
Growth, Renewals and Enablement
· Support Licensing Specialists and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) in achieving on-time Microsoft renewals and true-ups by ensuring orders are processed by the deadline.
· Grow Services revenue by educating and promoting Microsoft Programs across the organization.
· Support virtual and in-person customer facing events that promote Microsoft and CDW services, and assist CDW sales and partner teams with field alignment and account mapping.
· Assist in developing and delivering Microsoft program training for CDW coworkers, and work with relevant departments to create and maintain collateral that promotes CDW Canada Solutions and Services capabilities.
Tools, Reporting and Data
· Support tools and processes across customer management profile, reporting, and deal registration within all our toolsets.
· Track and report Microsoft weekly, monthly and annual performance, design reporting metrics with Operations, and monitor campaign effectiveness to aid decision making and planning.
· Maintain pipeline opportunities with support from Customer Success Managers, Licensing Specialists and Sales.
· Take on other operational & support responsibilities as needed.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
· Bachelor's degree in business or a computer-related field, or equivalent experience.
· Three or more years of industry experience delivering quality technology solutions.
· Three or more years supporting technology projects across IaaS and cloud solution areas.
· One or more years in a Microsoft Licensing Operations role or equivalent experience.
Other Required Qualifications

title: Strategy and Operations - Canada 🇨🇦
description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 
Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.
Alan exists to end the wait.
Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.
So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.
We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.
Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.
⭐️ THE ROLE
You are the Canada GM's right hand. Not a support role: you own strategic initiatives end to end and are accountable for the outcome, not the slide deck.
This seat owns Strategy & Operations: the operating cadence, the operational build-out of a young insurer, and the regulatory execution that lets Alan operate province by province. You'll work daily with Canada's leadership and draw on the global Alan platform, including GM Associate peers in five countries.
🎯 YOUR MISSION
Your core missions:
 - Own Canada's operating cadence. MBRs, QBRs and the Canada Weekly pulse: turn inputs from nine communities into the narrative and decisions leadership acts on.
 - Build new operations from scratch. New products, processes and reporting (e.g. virtual care expansion, pipeline and quota dashboards): define, launch, hand over.
 - Own insurance & regulatory execution. Provincial licensing, other filings and clinical licensing for new provinces. These are commitments to regulators, not internal deadlines.
 - Build your own AI tooling. Automate your own job with agents that do real work (e.g. automate weekly reporting, hiring pipeline digests, regulatory monitoring).
 - Lead through influence and clarity. Write the docs that let others decide without you (e.g. the business case for a 2nd GM Associate, summer interns, staffing BC expansion) and keep Canada and Europe aligned.
 - Step in where the business needs you. Cover leaders when they're out and pick up adjacent work (e.g. running hiring loops, managing summer interns, running the Toronto office).
💪 YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE
 - 1-4 years in consulting, banking, M&A, a high-growth startup, or as a founder.
 - Strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You set direction, then build the model, fix the process and file the renewal on time.
 - Exceptional written communication. You can turn a messy quarter into three paragraphs a board will act on.
 - A real command of AI tools, used to extend your output, not replace your thinking. We'll ask you to show us.
 - Strong organisation, time management and autonomy. You run projects start to finish with precision and little oversight.
 - An entrepreneurial mindset. Comfortable with ambiguity, you take ownership beyond your remit.
 - Mission-driven. You want to transform healthcare in Canada.
 - Based in Toronto and in our office 5 days a week.
 - As a plus: French, international team experience, or a background in scale-ups, healthcare or insurance.
Earlier in your career? Apply anyway. If you've shown real ownership (a company you started, a team you carried, work that shipped), we'd rather see your application than screen you out on a number.
🚀 WHAT THIS ROLE LEADS TO
The role is built on a minimum two-year horizon: long enough to compound real impact, and the springboard to leading a community or function. You'll have a buddy and a coach from day one.
🙌 PERKS & BENEFITS
 - Competitive salary + equity - B0-C1, ($96-140k CAD) see the salary & equity grid https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.
 - Monthly TTC pass, and a generous employer matching program for your RRSP.
 - Excellent health coverage through Alan's own app.
 - Office at King & Yonge in the financial district, with free lunch.
 - Flexible leave, no pre-approval needed.
 - Personal growth through coaching. Every Alaner has a dedicated coach from day one. Read about our coaching culture https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-culture-excellence-through-coaching.
flags: Owning the operating cadence (MBRs, QBRs, weekly pulse) is exactly the forum-running scope Tom has only contributed to.
Provincial insurance and clinical licensing execution is a core mission with no matching experience on his CV.
Profile targets 1-4 years from consulting, banking or founders; 11 years of CS/AM risks an overqualification screen.
Young Canadian entity may struggle to absorb a delayed start while the citizenship certificate is unproven.
verdict: Generalist GM-associate strategy-and-ops seat in Toronto, pitched junior and regulatory-heavy; tangential to RevOps and low on Tom's location ordering.

title: Sales Enablement Instructor
description:
About Kaseya 
Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.
Backed by Insight Partners , a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.
Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.
We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.
At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.
The Sales Enablement Instructor is a core member of Kaseya's GTM Onboarding team, responsible for delivering New Hire Training that gets reps ready to sell. Reporting to the Senior Manager, GTM Onboarding, the Trainer facilitates live BaseCamp sessions, coaches reps through the first six months of ramp, and helps build the content that powers the program. The ideal candidate combines strong facilitation presence with real sales credibility, sound coaching instincts, and a commitment to helping every seller succeed from day one.
Key Responsibilities
- Lead and facilitate live New Hire Training (BaseCamp, Day 0 to 15) for each cohort, covering core curriculum, product knowledge, sales process, systems, and role-play practice.
- Deliver everboarding sessions for reps in the ramp tail (Day 16 to 180), including reinforcement sessions, targeted coaching, and plug-and-play sessions for tenured or struggling reps.
- Provide 1:1 coaching and role-play feedback, helping reps connect classroom learning to real customer conversations.
- Review assessments and certifications, track rep progress, and flag at-risk reps to their managers and the Senior Manager.
- Answer new-hire questions, prepare upcoming sessions, and cover delivery for teammates as needed.
- Partner with the Senior Manager and the Instructional Design team to build and refine content, including competency-based tracks and e-learning for the tiered New Hire Training model.
- Contribute to assigned onboarding improvement projects, such as piloting new session formats or assessments.
- Coordinate with SMEs and guest speakers to prepare sessions, and join prep calls and post-session debriefs.
- Share field feedback on what is and is not working so the program improves cohort over cohort.
- Partner with managers to reinforce training on the floor and support reps who need extra help ramping.
- Support delivery for other regions and time zones when assigned.
- Help run afternoon activity blocks, including role-play practice, e-learning check-ins, and certification prep.
- Maintain accurate records of coaching notes, assessment results, and session delivery in the team's tracking tools.
- Model the sales behaviors and methodology the program teaches, reinforcing a consistent standard across every cohort.
Qualifications
- 3-5 years of experience in sales training, sales enablement, or B2B sales, ideally in SaaS or technology.
- Proven ability to facilitate engaging live and virtual training for groups of sellers.
- Strong coaching skills, with comfort giving direct, constructive feedback in role-plays and 1:1 settings.
- Solid understanding of B2B sales cycles, discovery, objection handling, and deal progression.
- Ability to simplify complex products and concepts into clear, practical guidance.
- Highly organized, adaptable, and comfortable in a fast-paced environment with frequent iteration.
- Experience with LMS platforms and sales tools such as Salesforce and Showpad.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
- Willingness to flex hours occasionally to support sessions in other regions.
Preferred Experience
- Prior quota-carrying sales experience, such as Account Manager or Account Executive.
- Familiarity with sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or Challenger.
- Experience with AI roleplay or conversation intelligence tools.
- Exposure to instructional design or adult learning principles.
- Experience supporting global teams across multiple time zones.
- Train-the-Trainer or similar facilitation certification.
 Additional information 
 Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
hard_gaps: Experience with LMS platforms and Showpad
Proven facilitation of live sales training for seller cohorts
flags: no pay stated in the ad or the feed, verify vs floor
Role is classroom training delivery for new reps, not enablement strategy or RevOps systems ownership.
Reports to Senior Manager with 3-5 year band; overqualification screen risk for 11 years plus MBA.
Posting states no work location, so market fit cannot be confirmed from the ad.
Requires flexing hours to deliver sessions across other regions and time zones.
verdict: Junior new-hire sales trainer role; tangential to the RevOps pivot and below his level — skip unless the pipeline is empty.

title: GTM Operations Analyst – Analytics & Automation
description:
Job Description: 
 As part of the Global Go-to-Market (GTM) Operations team, this hands-on role delivers commercial analysis, reporting, and automation across the commercial organization. 
 Working alongside GTM Operations colleagues, business leaders, and technical specialists, the Analyst develops reliable insights and practical solutions that improve decision-making and reduce manual work. This role takes ownership of agreed initiatives while building on existing capabilities and supporting reuse across regions. 
 Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities 
 Partner with commercial stakeholders and GTM Operations colleagues to understand business needs and deliver agreed analytics and automation initiatives. 
 Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical models supporting planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and commercial execution. 
 Identify trends, risks, and opportunities, translating analysis into clear insights and recommendations. 
 Develop workflow automations and AI-assisted solutions, working with technical specialists on complex requirements and integrations. 
 Validate reporting and workflow outputs, document business logic, and support testing, adoption, and ongoing maintenance. 
 Partner with Finance, Data & Analytics, IT, and regional operations to maintain consistent metric definitions and resolve data discrepancies. 
 Share reusable solutions across regions, measure improvements in efficiency and business use, and manage assigned priorities independently. 
 Required Qualifications 
 Minimum eight (8) years of experience in enterprise B2B software-as-a-service (SaaS) GTM Operations, Revenue Operations, or commercial analytics.

 Hands-on business intelligence (BI) and data modeling skills, including experience building dashboards, analyzing data, and validating results.

 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience. 
 Preferred Qualifications

 Innovate Boldly With a Growth Mindset — Progress demands smart risk. We'll try new approaches, learn fast, and keep pushing the boundaries — especially where AI can remove friction and unlock value. 
 Communicate with Care, Candor and Transparency — Honest, constructive conversations make us better. Let's speak plainly about what's working and what isn't and help each other improve.
 Pay Transparency Statement:

 Base pay offered to new hires may vary based upon factors including relevant industry and job-related skills and experience, geographic location, and business needs.* The range displayed does not encompass the full potential of the role, which allows for further growth and career progression. 
 In addition, as a part of our total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Vertex Bonus Plan (VOB), a role-specific sales commission/bonus, and/or equity grants. 
 Learn more about Life at Vertex and connect with your recruiter for more details regarding Vertex's compensation and benefit programs.

title: Senior Strategy and Operations Manager
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. 
We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as  personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and  combine their pensions with us. 
With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!
We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️
 
📍London / Distributed (UK) | 💰 £86,100 - £101,300 (depending on experience) ➕ incentive awards tied to your performance |  Benefits  |  Hear from the team 
 ⭐ About the role 
We’re looking for a strategic, commercially minded, and data-driven Senior Strategy and Operations Manager , who will be an individual contributor and help shape the future of Payments at Monzo. You’ll play a critical role in supporting the GM of Payments and the leadership team to define, measure, and drive our strategy - balancing long-term vision with the realities of day-to-day delivery.
This is a high-ownership, high-impact role, ideal for someone who thrives on solving complex problems, is fuelled by strategic thinking, and enjoys using data to bring clarity to ambiguity. You’ll move seamlessly between blue-sky thinking and tactical execution - one day modelling the impact of a new product bet, the next helping optimise how we run the collective.
You’ll bring a birds-eye view across Payments’s portfolio - ensuring our goals, investments, and initiatives line up coherently with each other and with Monzo’s broader mission. And you’ll be the connective tissue that keeps us operating effectively: tracking performance, surfacing insights, and making sure we’re focused on what really matters.
 🔑 You’ll play a key role by… 
 Driving strategic clarity: Supporting the GM of Payments and leadership team in defining, tracking, and evolving Payments’s strategic direction to align with Monzo’s wider mission
 Data-Driven Problem Solving: Actively dive into large, complex datasets to uncover insights, diagnose operational challenges, and independently design and implement scalable solutions.
 Translating data into action: Building and maintaining data-informed views of performance across products, squads, and initiatives; using insights to inform priorities and trade-offs
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data and Design teams to bridge the gap between ideas and strategic business execution
 Owning business performance rhythm: Leading monthly business reviews, reporting, and governance materials to keep the collective aligned and accountable
 Shaping new opportunities: Scoping new bets through market sizing, commercial modelling, partnerships evaluation, and budget/forecast analysis
 Making the org more effective: Optimising how we balance KTLO, BAU, and growth work; supporting resourcing and squad setup decisions across the collective
 Connecting the dots: Ensuring consistent communication and alignment across Payment squads, and with other Monzo collectives
 Scale & Geographic Expansion: Playing a pivotal role in scaling our lending book and supporting launch operations as we expand our Borrowing products into new geographies
 Bringing teams together: Leading Payments All Hands, goals processes, and strategic forums that ensure cohesion and momentum across the collective
 🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you have... 
 Strategic Acumen: You have a deeply strategic mind, capable of seeing the bigger picture, thinking in systems, and anticipating future trends
 Exceptional Problem-Solving Skills: Your “superpower” is solving complex problems with analytical rigor, commercial viability, and execution certainty
 Adaptability & Ownership: You’re a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, adept at navigating complex, rapidly evolving environments, and driven by impact and ownership
 Collaboration & Influencing Without Authority: You have an exceptional ability to connect the dots across different parts of the business, foster collaboration, and drive alignment without authority
 Commercial Mindset: You’re comfortable making trade-offs and prioritisation decisions based on data, business impact, and resource constraints
 Analytical Rigour : A strong analytical skillset with a proven track record of comfortably navigating large datasets to solve unstructured problems independently
 Collaborative Mindset: Experience working cross-functionally with highly technical teams such as Machine Learning and Data/Analytics Engineering
 Operational Excellence: You’re motivated by improving how teams work - finding ways to make organisations more efficient, scalable, and focused on what matters most
 🙌 What’s in it for you 
💰 £86,100 - £101,300 (depending on experience) + incentive awards tied to your performance
📍 We're open to distributed working within the UK, with the expectation of working from the London office on occasional basis.
⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 
📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.
🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. 
➕ Plus lots more!  Read our full list of benefits .

Phone call with Recruiter (30 mins)
Initial behavioural video call with Hiring Manager (45 mins)
Analytical interview (60 mins)
Problem solving interview (60 mins)
Our average process takes around 3–4 weeks, but we will always work around your availability.

 Equal opportunities for everyone

title: Senior Manager, Sales and Customer Success
description:
Description
 Clubspeed & Resova
 Build the team. Create the playbook. Scale the customer revenue engine.
 Clubspeed and Resova provide venue management, booking, and payments technology to experience-based businesses around the world.
We’re entering an exciting new chapter. With new investment behind the business, we’re building the teams, systems, and operating rhythms needed to accelerate growth while delivering a consistently strong experience for our customers.
We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Sales & Customer Success to lead that transformation across our customer segments.
The Opportunity
This is not a role where you inherit a fully built sales and customer success machine.
You’ll have the opportunity to help build it.
You’ll lead and develop a growing team responsible for customer retention, expansion, and new revenue while creating the processes, playbooks, metrics, and management structure required to operate effectively at scale.
The role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution. One day you may be designing the customer segmentation model or renewal process; the next, you may be coaching a rep through an expansion opportunity, reviewing an at-risk account, or helping close a deal.
You’ll have meaningful ownership over how we serve and grow our SMB and Mid-Market customers—and the opportunity to build a function that can scale with the business.
What Success Looks Like
 In This Role, You Will
Build a high-performing SMB and Mid-Market Sales & Customer Success organization with clear roles, expectations, KPIs, and accountability.
Recruit, onboard, coach, and develop a strong team of Account Managers and Customer Success professionals.
Create scalable customer journeys and playbooks across onboarding, adoption, retention, renewal, and expansion.
Improve Net Revenue Retention by reducing preventable churn and creating a consistent expansion motion across the customer base.
Establish clear forecasting and pipeline management for renewals, upsells, cross-sells, and other customer revenue opportunities.
Introduce a scalable operating model that balances high-touch engagement for strategic customers with efficient 1-to-many programs for SMB customers.
Build better visibility into customer health, revenue risk, and expansion potential.
Create a disciplined, accountable culture where the team understands what great performance looks like and has the coaching and tools to achieve it.
What You’ll Do
Key Responsibilities
 Lead, Build & Develop the Team
Lead the SMB and Mid-Market Sales & Customer Success teams, establishing clear expectations, responsibilities, and performance standards.
Own recruiting and hiring as the organization grows.
Build structured onboarding and enablement programs that help new team members ramp quickly.
Conduct regular 1:1s, pipeline reviews, account reviews, and call coaching.
Develop the team’s capabilities in consultative selling, negotiation, customer relationship management, retention, and expansion.
Establish clear individual and team KPIs and create a strong culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Identify performance gaps early and coach team members toward stronger outcomes.
 Build the Customer Success Operating Model
Design and document scalable playbooks for onboarding, adoption, account management, renewal, expansion, and churn prevention.
Develop differentiated engagement models for SMB and Mid-Market customers based on customer value, complexity, opportunity, and risk.
Build repeatable 1-to-many programs that allow the team to effectively support a high-volume customer base.
Establish customer health scoring and early-warning indicators for churn and expansion opportunities.
Define clear escalation paths and operating processes across Sales, Customer Success, Support, Implementation, Product, and Payments.
Continuously identify opportunities to simplify workflows and improve team productivity.
 Drive Retention & Expansion
Own the team’s performance against Net Revenue Retention, renewal, churn, and expansion targets.
Establish a consistent renewal process that creates visibility well in advance of contract expiration.
Build and standardize upsell and cross-sell motions across the customer base.
Coach the team on identifying customer needs, creating value-based expansion opportunities, and successfully navigating commercial conversations.
Partner with internal teams to address customer risks before they become churn events.
Step into strategic or complex customer conversations when leadership involvement can materially improve the outcome.
 Create Revenue Visibility & Accountability
Build accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasting for renewals, expansion, and customer revenue.
Establish pipeline standards and operating rhythms that give leadership a clear view of expected performance.
Track and analyze performance metrics across the customer lifecycle.
Use product usage, customer engagement, commercial, and CRM data to identify risks and opportunities.
Ensure CRM and Customer Success systems accurately reflect account activity, pipeline, customer health, and next steps.
Provide leadership with clear insights into performance, trends, risks, and opportunities.
You’ll Thrive Here If...
