title: Sales Operations Analyst
description:
ABOUT EARTHDAILY 
EarthDaily is revolutionizing the way we understand and monitor our planet. Through cutting-edge Earth Observation (EO) technology and geospatial analytics, we provide unparalleled insights for industries ranging from agriculture to mining, insurance, and government intelligence. Our mission is to build the world’s most advanced change detection system to capture, analyze, and interpret global shifts in near real-time.
 OUR CREW 
Our global, distributed team represents a variety of business lines and is made up of business development, sales, marketing and support professionals, data scientists, software engineers, project managers and finance, HR, and IT professionals. We are currently looking for a detail-oriented, Vancouver-based Sales Operations Analyst to join our crew!
 READY TO LAUNCH? 
Do you want to join one of the most exciting space companies at the forefront of global change detection/change monitoring? At EarthDaily, the Sales Operations Analyst is responsible for the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of our CRM and sales data across multiple lines of business and market verticals. This is a full-time, hybrid position based at our Vancouver Convention Centre office. Occasional travel may be required.
 PREPARE FOR IMPACT! 
As a Sales Operations Analyst, you will partner with the Sales Operations and Finance teams to identify, investigate, and resolve data quality issues, establish and enforce data entry standards, and maintain the governance processes that keep records consistent as the business scales.
As a detail-oriented problem solver with a systems mindset, you will leverage CRM tooling, reporting platforms, and all available processes to surface anomalies before they reach downstream reporting. You’ll take a proactive approach to data stewardship, routinely auditing records rather than waiting for errors to surface and translating recurring issues into durable process and system improvements. As a trusted resource to the sales and finance teams, you will ensure that account, opportunity, and pipeline data can be relied upon for forecasting, commission calculation, and executive decision-making.
 Data Quality and Cleanup 
Review and audit CRM records (contacts, accounts, opportunities, leads) for accuracy, completeness, and duplicates
Identify and correct data entry errors, missing fields, and inconsistent formatting in the CRM
Lead or support data cleanup projects such as deduplication, record merging, and standardizing naming conventions
Manage the import and validation of new leads or account data from third-party sources
 Standards, Governance and Training 
Establish and maintain data entry guidelines, and train and support sales reps on proper data entry practices
Maintain data definitions and a data dictionary for standard fields used across the sales team
Recommend process improvements to reduce recurring data quality issues
Escalate or collaborate with senior Sales Operations, Finance, and/or Data Governance staff on complex or cross-system data issues
 Reporting and Metrics 
Build and monitor data quality dashboards and reports, and investigate anomalies and trends
Track and report on data quality metrics (e.g., duplicate rate, field completeness, data decay) and remediation progress to Sales Operations and Finance leadership
 Systems, Integrations and Automation 
Partner with Sales Ops and IT on integration checks between the CRM and other connected sales tools (e.g., marketing automation, lead enrichment platforms)
Design and build sales automation and AI solutions to increase process efficiency and suggest improvements to the customer experience
 YOUR PAST MISSIONS 
Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, information systems, data analytics, data science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
1 to 4 years of experience in sales operations, sales support, data quality, revenue operations, or a related analytical role, with a proven track record of improving the accuracy and reliability of business-critical data
Hands-on experience administering or maintaining a CRM platform, including bulk data operations using data loaders, deduplication tools, or similar utilities
Demonstrated experience cleaning, reconciling, and manipulating large datasets (10,000+ rows) using advanced Excel functions such as INDEX/MATCH, nested IFs, array formulas, data tables, and Power Query
Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports in a CRM or BI environment (Salesforce, HubSpot, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Exposure to data governance or data quality frameworks
Experience supporting forecasting, pipeline reporting, or commission processes in a SaaS or technical sales environment
Applied use of AI for analysis or automation
 YOUR TOOLKIT 
Deep working knowledge of CRM data structures, including the relationships between accounts, contacts, opportunities, and pipeline stages (HubSpot preferred but not required)
Understanding of sales and marketing processes and metrics (prospecting, lead gen, contracts, time to close, ACV/TCV/LCV, CAC/CPL, ROAS/ROMI, etc.)
Understanding of finance and reporting metrics (revenue recognition, backlog and pipeline calculations, close probabilities, growth scenarios, CAGR, etc.)
Has built, or can build, AI tools to automate sales processes (e.g., Claude, HubSpot Breeze)
Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, conditional formatting, and data validation
Basic to intermediate SQL for querying and validating data across systems
Strong attention to detail with a methodical, systematic approach to identifying, investigating, and resolving data issues
Understands the downstream impact of poor data quality on forecasting, reporting, and commission accuracy
Curious and inquisitive, excellent at asking questions to understand why an error occurred rather than only correcting it
Able to work independently on recurring data quality tasks while recognizing when to escalate; highly organized with excellent time management and the ability to balance competing priorities
Strong work ethic and self-drive, with an honest and ethical approach
Team player with a proactive and positive attitude, and experience collaborating with internal and cross-functional teams
 YOUR COMPENSATION 
 Base Salary Range: $55,000 to $80,000 CAD annually 
The range is based on Vancouver, BC-derived compensation for this role. Individual placement in the range is determined based on many factors, including experience, skills, and qualifications. The top end of the range is typically reserved for individuals that meet or exceed all required qualifications and show demonstrated experience and expertise in all responsibilities of the role.
 OUR SPACE 
We’d love to welcome you to our world of software for space. We have a shared passion for building production critical systems that generate near real-time views of Earth from satellites that power real-world applications like disaster mitigation, environmental monitoring and crop yield improvements.
This is a full-time, in-office role at our Vancouver Convention Centre office, working in a fast-paced environment with regular collaboration across a team spread over North American time zones, and occasional travel (approximately 10%).

------------------

You will work across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Product, and Data to translate company strategy into a clear GTM operating model. You will own Sales Operations, Customer Success Operations, GTM systems, and the processes and operating cadence that connect strategy to execution.

**What we're looking for:**

* Systems\-oriented. You understand how CRM, sales engagement, forecasting, compensation, enrichment, routing, and reporting fit together, and you know when a systems problem is actually a process or organizational problem.
* Excellent communicator and business partner. You can present a difficult conclusion to a CRO, CMO, or executive team without hiding behind the analysis.

title: Customer Success Manager - EcoPlant
description:
Ingersoll Rand is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.
 Customer Success Manager – EcoPlant 
 Location: Remote – Continental United States
 About Us 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.
EcoPlant combines software as a service (SaaS), industrial Internet of Things (IoT) technology, and predictive analytics to monitor, control, and optimize compressed-air systems. Its platform helps customers improve energy efficiency and reliability while understanding system performance, operating costs, and savings.
 Job Overview: 
The Customer Success Manager serves as a key point of contact for EcoPlant customers and channel partners, helping them understand and recognize value from the platform. Beginning after system installation, this role leads customer onboarding, provides dashboard training, and coordinates ongoing support. Working closely with account managers, Technical Support, Engineering, and Product teams, the Customer Success Manager translates system data into clear insights, supports business reviews and renewal discussions, and helps improve the overall customer experience.
 Responsibilities: 
Lead customer onboarding following system installation, helping users understand the EcoPlant dashboard, system information, and platform capabilities.
Build and maintain relationships with customers and channel partners, serving as an ongoing contact for platform questions, training, and support needs.
Provide training to customer contacts and new users, supporting continued platform adoption as customer personnel, equipment, or requirements change.
Review platform data to help customers understand compressed-air system performance, energy consumption, operating costs, and savings.
Identify system performance concerns and improvement opportunities, partnering with technical resources to evaluate findings and coordinate appropriate actions.
Prepare and deliver quarterly or annual business reviews, as needed, to communicate customer value and align on financial, operational, and sustainability goals.
Support account managers and channel partners with renewal and expansion conversations by preparing performance highlights, customer value summaries, and supporting information.
Coordinate with Technical Support, Engineering, Operations, and R&D to address customer concerns and follow issues through resolution.
Document customer feedback and submit product enhancement requests to Product and R&D teams, including colleagues in Israel.
Establish repeatable onboarding, training, communication, and customer success practices, and support customer case studies and performance documentation.
 Requirements: 
High school diploma or GED.
2–5 years of experience with industrial compressed-air systems.
 Core Competencies: 
Strong customer relationship skills with the ability to build trust and understand customer and channel partner priorities.
Clear written, verbal, and presentation communication skills when working with technical users, commercial stakeholders, and customer leadership.
Ability to onboard and train customers, explain platform features, and support continued adoption.
Technical aptitude with the ability to learn industrial systems and software and interpret technical information.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to review data, identify trends, and communicate performance and customer value.
Ability to collaborate across technical, commercial, and product teams and influence outcomes without direct authority.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel and PowerPoint, and the ability to learn business systems and customer-facing software.
Strong organization, attention to detail, initiative, and follow-through while managing competing customer needs in a remote environment.
 Preferences: 
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related field.
Customer success, technical account management, sales engineering, customer service, or other customer-facing experience in an industrial environment.
Experience with industrial IoT, condition monitoring, cloud platforms, or software/services solutions.
Experience onboarding customers, delivering platform training, presenting business reviews, or communicating measurable customer value.
Experience as a compressed-air system auditor or sales engineer.
Participation in or completion of the Ingersoll Rand Sales Development Program.
 Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 
 This position is fully remote within the continental United States. Candidates should have access to a major airport for business travel. Travel up to 30% across North America may be required, although actual travel is expected to be infrequent and based on customer and business needs, including customer meetings and system performance reviews.
 Pay Range: 
 The total pay range for this role, including incentives, is $90,000–$145,000 . The actual pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed pay range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Ingersoll Rand, it is not typical for a candidate to be hired at or near the top of the pay range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.
 What We Offer 
 At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment — as well as for our individual well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support needed to take charge of your health and future.
Our benefits include healthcare coverage (medical, prescription, dental, and vision), wellness programs, life insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid time off, and an employee stock program, among other offerings. These benefits, combined with our pay transparency and inclusive culture, reflect our commitment to supporting you at work and beyond.
Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology-driven excellence in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency.

title: Director, Renewals & Scaled Programs
description:
Want to help shape what comes next at a successful, fast-growing software company?  
 Company Overview 
 At Poppulo, we help the world’s leading organizations reach every employee, wherever they work. 
For a large, distributed workforce, that’s harder than it sounds. Today’s workforce is spread across offices, factories, retail stores, hospitals and other frontline locations. No single communication channel can reach everyone. Poppulo brings those channels together in one AI-powered employee experience platform, helping companies deliver relevant communications wherever their people are located. 
More than 10,000 organizations trust us to connect with their workforce across email, mobile, intranet, Microsoft Teams, and digital signage. Our communications reach more than 50 million employees worldwide, and the platform delivers content to more than 600,000 digital signs around the globe. We also help employees engage with their company, celebrate one another’s contributions, and stay connected wherever they work. 
We know there’s no such thing as a “perfect” candidate—we’re all works in progress, picking up new skills as we go. So apply even if you don’t tick every box. We want people who see things differently—because that’s how we see things too. 
 Job Summary
 The Director, Global Renewals, is responsible for defining and executing the global renewals strategy to drive customer retention, expansion, and revenue predictability. This leader oversees global renewals performance and the development of scalable retention motions, including digital-first engagement for long-tail customers. The role combines commercial accountability, people leadership, and operational discipline to maximize customer lifetime value.
 Primary Responsibilities
 Global Leadership & Strategy
Set and execute the global renewals vision and strategy, aligned with Poppulo’s corporate and revenue objectives. 
Own global outcomes for renewal rates, churn forecasting accuracy, contract value growth, and multi-year deal penetration. 
Present renewal performance, risks, and insights to executive leadership and inform business planning and forecasting cycles. 
Serve as a senior escalation point for complex renewals, strategic negotiations, and executive-level retention efforts. 
 People Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop global Renewals leaders and managers, with clear performance expectations and accountability. 
Provide leadership for scaled Customer Success Associates where this function falls within the role’s remit, aligning renewal and customer engagement teams. 
Build leadership capability through hiring, coaching, succession planning, and career development. 
Partner with Customer Success and People teams to align coverage models and team capacity with customer segmentation and growth priorities. 
 Scaled Customer Success & Retention Programs
Define a scalable engagement strategy for long-tail customers, combining one-to-many digital programs with targeted high-touch intervention. 
Oversee retention playbooks using customer health signals, product adoption insights, early-warning triggers, and at-risk escalation paths. 
Sponsor automated customer communications, enablement campaigns, webinars, and other programs that improve adoption and time-to-value. 
Measure the effectiveness of scaled engagement and translate customer feedback into improvements in retention strategy and customer experience. 
 Operational Excellence
Oversee the global renewals operating model, standardizing renewal playbooks, processes, and execution discipline. 
Establish governance for renewal pipeline health, churn forecasts, coverage, risk identification, and performance reporting. 
Partner with Finance and Revenue Operations on ARR reporting, pricing guidelines, CRM data quality, and commercial controls. 
Drive improvements in Salesforce, Customer Success platforms, dashboards, analytics, and automation to increase accuracy and efficiency. 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration & Commercial Growth
Collaborate with Customer Success, Sales, Finance, Legal, Product, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to optimize retention and renewal outcomes. 
Identify and operationalize cross-sell and upsell opportunities using customer insights and coordinated account planning. 
Support multi-year and multi-product renewal strategies that strengthen retention and revenue visibility. 
 Key Metrics You Will Own
 Gross Renewal Rate (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention / Net Renewal Rate (NRR),Churn Forecast Accuracy,Contract Value Growth % ;Multi-Year Deal Penetration % ,Timely Renewal Closure % ,Renewals Forecast Coverage and Scaled customer health, engagement effectiveness, and retention outcomes (where applicable)
 Requirements For Success
10+ years of experience in SaaS or IT renewals, revenue management, or Customer Success leadership, including 5+ years managing global or distributed teams. 
Proven track record of leading renewal organizations at scale, delivering strong retention, accurate forecasts, and measurable contract value growth. 
Experience designing or overseeing scaled, digital-first Customer Success and retention programs, including customer segmentation and health-based engagement. 
Strong commercial judgment and executive negotiation skills, including complex renewals and multi-year agreements. 
Deep analytical acumen and working knowledge of ARR, GRR, NRR, churn, and renewal pipeline management. 
Salesforce proficiency required; experience with ChurnZero, Gainsight, Totango, or similar platforms is a plus. 
Demonstrated success driving organizational transformation, operational excellence, and cross-functional alignment. 
Ability to inspire geographically distributed teams and communicate effectively with executive stakeholders. 
 Compensation 
 Annual base salary gross: 80,000-115,000 Plus variable EUR plus variable. The base salary range represents the low and high end of the Company's contemplated salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and geographic location. The salary is one component of Company's total compensation package for employees. Other rewards and benefits include variable compensation, short-term incentives, health insurance (several options to choose from), accident and life insurance, access to the best in class learning and development platforms, flexible work arrangement, to name just a few!
 Who We Are
 We’re a values-driven company. We want people to bring their best selves to work and have a real hand in the products we build and the culture we build together. You’ll be surrounded by smart, warm people who like a challenge, take ownership, and care about doing work that matters. If that sounds like your kind of place, come join us. 
We live the Poppulo values each day because they are central to everything we do. 
Bring Your Best Self - We show up authentically, remain self-aware, and always strive to improve.  
See It. Own It. Solve It - We proactively innovate and solve problems for our customers and one another. We set high standards for our work, build a culture of learning, and acknowledge both our successes and our failures.  
Together, We’re Better - We value and celebrate our diversity. We learn from others, respect their expertise, and focus on building trust. That’s what makes us a team.  
We’ve been recognized as a Top 10 Great Place to Work company and named one of the Best Workplaces in Tech and Best Workplaces for Women. We’re a fast-growing global technology company with teams in the United States, Ireland, France, the United Kingdom, and India. 
Poppulo is an equal opportunity employer. 
We are committed to protecting your privacy. For details on how we collect, use, and protect your personal information, please refer to our Job Applicant Privacy Policy. Please also review AI in Our Hiring Process for information on our approach to AI in hiring and guidance for candidates.

title: Senior Revenue Operations Analyst
description:
Who we are: 
 At Wagepoint, we're good people. It's easy to feel that way when you're surrounded by folks doing the best work of their careers, building great payroll software for small businesses across Canada. 
 Our team brings together diverse backgrounds, perspectives, experiences, and ideas to make payroll the easiest part of running a business. 
 We're remote-first, growing, and looking for passionate people who don't settle for the first solution or the way it's been done before. We care deeply about our customers and each other, and understand that when it comes to payroll, getting it right matters. 
 Our values guide how we work and what we expect from one another: 
 Cultivate Impact by focusing on what matters most and delivering meaningful outcomes for our customers. 
 Unify as One Team by collaborating openly, communicating clearly, and rallying around shared goals. 
 Stay Curious and Kind by challenging assumptions, learning quickly, and leading with empathy. 
 If you want to build the future of payroll in a place where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter, look no further! 
 The role at high level: 
 We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Analyst who can take a messy business question and come back with an answer people can act on. You'll be the analytical engine of our Revenue Operations team, owning the reporting, models, and definitions that Marketing, Sales, and Customer Support rely on to decide where to spend their time. This seat leans toward data. You'll write SQL against our data warehouse (Databricks) to connect product, billing, and CRM data, and bring the RevOps judgment to know which question the data should answer. 
This isn't a report-request role. You'll connect data from across our GTM stack, dig into why the numbers moved, and bring recommendations to team leads before they ask. You'll work hands-on in those systems where configuration or troubleshooting is needed to keep the data accurate, and you'll use AI to get from question to answer faster. You'll report directly to the Director of Revenue Operations .
 What you'll be expected to own: 
 Design, build, and maintain reporting and dashboards that provide meaningful insights across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Support. 
 Analyze GTM performance, identify trends, and translate complex data into actionable recommendations for business leaders. 
 Build and maintain SQL queries and spreadsheet models that support commission tracking, pipeline analysis, forecasting, capacity planning, and CRM data reconciliation. 
 Pull and connect data from across our GTM tech stack, including our data warehouse (Databricks), HubSpot, Zendesk, and Gong, into reporting that gives one reliable view of the business, working hands-on in those systems to keep the data accurate. 
 Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation and AI, while helping the broader GTM organization adopt new capabilities. 
 Lead cross-functional Revenue Operations initiatives, including CRM improvements, reporting enhancements, process redesigns, and system implementations. 
 Create and maintain clear documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge resources that improve consistency and scalability across the business. 
 Partner closely with Marketing, Sales, Customer Support, and leadership to improve data quality, streamline processes, and enable better decision-making. 
 What you bring to the table: 
 4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, or a data or business analyst role supporting go-to-market teams, within a SaaS or high-growth company. 
 Strong working SQL: multi-table joins, CTEs, window functions, and checking your results against the source system. 
 Experience independently managing projects across multiple business systems with minimal supervision. 
 Strong analytical skills with the ability to solve ambiguous business problems using data. 
 Working knowledge of CRM data structures (objects, associations, lifecycle stages). HubSpot experience is a strong asset, and exposure to Zendesk and Gong is a plus. 
 Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills for modeling and reconciliation work. 
 Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or embedded platform AI to improve workflows and productivity. 
 Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts and data insights to a variety of stakeholders. 
 A continuous improvement mindset with strong attention to detail and a passion for building scalable processes. 
 Post-secondary education in Business, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 Bonus points if: 
 You have experience with a cloud data warehouse (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery) or a BI tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI). 
 You use Python for data work. 
 You have experience building lead scoring models, lifecycle management, or marketing attribution reporting. 
 You hold HubSpot certifications or have deep CRM administration experience. 
 You've designed and implemented AI-enabled operational workflows that improved team efficiency. 
 You're passionate about improving how teams work through automation, documentation, and operational excellence. 
 What we bring to the table: 
 Impact: Dig in and directly contribute to Wagepoint’s growth and success. 
 Culture: Work alongside a team that genuinely enjoys solving problems together, celebrates wins, supports one another through challenges, and still finds time for the occasional terrible joke. 
 Growth: We believe learning is part of the job. We’re committed to helping you Get Better Every Day (a representation of our Stay Curious and Kind value!) by offering professional development, new experiences, and career growth as we continue to evolve. 
 Innovation: Curiosity and experimentation encouraged! Bring ideas, challenge assumptions, responsibly utilize AI, and help shape better ways of working. 
 Remote: Work from wherever you do your best work. Wagepoint has always been remote-first, giving you flexibility, autonomy, and hopefully a little extra time with the people (and pets) you love. 
 Ready to join the team? Apply now and help us continue making payroll the easiest part of running a business. 
 Next steps: 
 If this sounds like the right fit, we’d love to hear from you! No need for a formal cover letter, just send us your resume and if you’d like, a few lines about what excites you about the opportunity. 
 If we agree it's a great match, someone from our team will reach out to schedule a call. 
 Psssst! 
 In 2026, we were recognized as one of Canada's Best Workplaces for Mental Wellness and Inclusion. That commitment extends to our hiring process, where we strive to create an experience that is welcoming, respectful, and inclusive from day one. 
 We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and perspectives, and we're committed to building a workplace where everyone can thrive. 
 As a remote company, all interviews are conducted virtually. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We're happy to support you! 
 As part of our hiring process, AI-based tools are used to support the initial review of applications. Rest assured, our People Ops team carefully reviews all applications and makes the final decisions on candidate progression. 
Analyste principal ou principale, Opérations de revenus
 Qui sommes-nous : 
 Chez Wagepoint, nous sommes du bon monde. Et c'est facile à ressentir quand on est entouré de personnes qui réalisent le meilleur travail de leur carrière, à créer un logiciel de paie remarquable pour les petites entreprises de partout au Canada. 
 Notre équipe réunit des parcours, des perspectives, des expériences et des idées variés pour faire de la paie la partie la plus simple de la gestion d'une entreprise. 
 Le télétravail est notre norme, nous sommes en pleine croissance et nous cherchons des personnes passionnées qui ne se contentent pas de la première solution venue ni de la façon dont les choses ont toujours été faites. Nous tenons profondément à nos clients comme les uns aux autres, et nous savons qu'en matière de paie, l'exactitude compte. 
 Nos valeurs orientent notre façon de travailler et ce que nous attendons les uns des autres : 
 Cultiver l'impact en nous concentrant sur l'essentiel et en offrant des résultats concrets à nos clients. 
 Ne faire qu'une équipe en collaborant ouvertement, en communiquant clairement et en nous ralliant autour d'objectifs communs. 
 Faire preuve de curiosité et de bienveillance en remettant en question les idées reçues, en apprenant rapidement et en agissant avec empathie. 
 Si vous voulez bâtir l'avenir de la paie dans un milieu où vos idées sont accueillies et où votre contribution compte, ne cherchez pas plus loin ! 
 Le rôle : 
 Nous cherchons une personne au poste d'analyste principal ou principale des opérations de revenus , capable de prendre une question d'affaires floue et d'en rapporter une réponse sur laquelle on peut agir. Vous serez le moteur analytique de notre équipe des opérations de revenus : vous aurez la responsabilité des rapports, des modèles et des définitions sur lesquels le Marketing, les Ventes et le Soutien à la clientèle s'appuient pour décider où investir leur temps. Ce poste est davantage axé sur les données. Vous rédigerez des requêtes SQL dans notre entrepôt de données (Databricks) pour relier les données sur les produits, la facturation et le CRM, et vous mettrez à profit votre jugement en opérations de revenus pour savoir à quelle question les données doivent répondre. 
 Ce n'est pas un poste où l'on se contente d'exécuter des demandes de rapports. Vous relierez les données provenant de l'ensemble de notre pile de mise en marché (GTM), vous chercherez à comprendre pourquoi les chiffres ont bougé et vous présenterez des recommandations aux responsables d'équipe avant même qu'ils les demandent. Vous interviendrez concrètement dans ces systèmes lorsqu'une configuration ou un dépannage s'impose pour préserver l'exactitude des données, et vous utiliserez l'IA pour passer plus vite de la question à la réponse. Vous relèverez directement de la direction des opérations de revenus. 
 Vos responsabilités : 
 Concevoir, créer et maintenir des rapports et des tableaux de bord qui fournissent des renseignements utiles au Marketing, aux Ventes et au Soutien à la clientèle. 
 Analyser la performance de mise en marché (GTM), dégager les tendances et transformer des données complexes en recommandations concrètes pour les responsables d'affaires. 
 Créer et maintenir des requêtes SQL et des modèles de feuilles de calcul pour le suivi des commissions, l'analyse du pipeline, les prévisions, la planification de la capacité et le rapprochement des données du CRM. 
 Extraire et relier les données de notre pile technologique de mise en marché (GTM) — notamment notre entrepôt de données (Databricks), HubSpot, Zendesk et Gong — dans des rapports qui offrent une vue fiable et unifiée de l'entreprise, en intervenant concrètement dans ces systèmes pour préserver l'exactitude des données. 
 Repérer les occasions d'améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle grâce à l'automatisation et à l'IA, tout en aidant l'ensemble de l'organisation de mise en marché à adopter de nouvelles capacités. 
 Piloter des initiatives interéquipes en opérations de revenus : améliorations du CRM, bonification des rapports, refonte de processus et implantation de systèmes. 
 Créer et maintenir une documentation claire, des procédures normalisées et des ressources de connaissances qui améliorent la cohérence et l'évolutivité dans toute l'entreprise. 
 Collaborer étroitement avec le Marketing, les Ventes, le Soutien à la clientèle et la direction pour améliorer la qualité des données, simplifier les processus et favoriser de meilleures prises de décision. 
 Ce que vous apportez : 
 Plus de 4 ans d'expérience en opérations de revenus, en opérations de vente, en opérations marketing ou dans un rôle d'analyste de données ou d'analyste d'affaires au service des équipes de mise en marché, au sein d'une entreprise SaaS ou à forte croissance. 
 De solides compétences pratiques en SQL : jointures multitables, CTE, fonctions de fenêtrage et vérification de vos résultats par rapport au système source. 
 De l'expérience dans la gestion autonome de projets touchant plusieurs systèmes d'affaires, avec une supervision minimale. 
 De solides compétences analytiques et la capacité de résoudre des problèmes d'affaires ambigus à l'aide des données. 
 Une connaissance pratique des structures de données d'un CRM (objets, associations, étapes du cycle de vie). Une expérience de HubSpot est un atout important, et une familiarité avec Zendesk et Gong est un plus. 
 De solides compétences dans Google Sheets ou Excel pour la modélisation et le rapprochement de données. 
 De l'aisance avec des outils d'IA comme ChatGPT, Claude ou l'IA intégrée aux plateformes pour améliorer les flux de travail et la productivité. 
 D'excellentes aptitudes en communication et la capacité d'expliquer des concepts techniques et des analyses de données à des parties prenantes variées. 
 Un état d'esprit axé sur l'amélioration continue, un grand souci du détail et une passion pour la création de processus évolutifs. 
 Une formation postsecondaire en administration, en analytique ou dans un domaine connexe, ou une expérience pratique équivalente. 
 En prime : 
 Vous avez de l'expérience avec un entrepôt de données infonuagique (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery) ou un outil de BI (Looker, Tableau, Power BI). 
 Vous utilisez Python pour le travail sur les données. 
 Vous avez de l'expérience dans la création de modèles de notation des prospects, la gestion du cycle de vie ou les rapports d'attribution marketing. 
 Vous détenez des certifications HubSpot ou possédez une solide expérience de l'administration de CRM. 
 Vous avez conçu et mis en place des flux de travail opérationnels alimentés par l'IA qui ont amélioré l'efficacité de l'équipe. 
 Vous avez à cœur d'améliorer le travail des équipes par l'automatisation, la documentation et l'excellence opérationnelle. 
 Ce que nous vous offrons : 
 Impact : Mettez la main à la pâte et contribuez directement à la croissance et au succès de Wagepoint. 
 Culture : Travaillez aux côtés d'une équipe qui aime vraiment résoudre des problèmes ensemble, qui célèbre ses réussites, qui se soutient dans les moments difficiles et qui trouve toujours le temps pour une mauvaise blague à l'occasion. 
 Croissance : Pour nous, apprendre fait partie du travail. Nous nous engageons à vous aider à vous améliorer chaque jour (un clin d'œil à notre valeur Faire preuve de curiosité et de bienveillance !) en vous offrant du perfectionnement professionnel, de nouvelles expériences et des perspectives d'évolution de carrière au fil de notre croissance. 
 Innovation : La curiosité et l'expérimentation sont encouragées ! Apportez vos idées, remettez en question les idées reçues, utilisez l'IA de façon responsable et contribuez à inventer de meilleures façons de travailler.

title: Head of Customer Success
description:
Description 
The Head of Customer Success leads the customer success function within DNV Energy Systems Digital & Transformation, helping internal business customers and the clients they serve turn digital and AI-enabled capabilities into sustained, measurable value. The role sets the customer success strategy and leads a team focused on customer adoption, feature adoption, customer experience, value realization , and growth in adoption. 
You will partner with business-group and service-line leaders, regional teams, Global Service Area Leads and subject matter experts (SMEs) to understand their priorities and embed useful capabilities into day-to-day work. You will also help ensure that clients understand the value of DNV's digital offerings, experience smooth adoption, and realize benefits quickly. Success means meaningful use that improves business and customer outcomes, not simply access to a platform or completion of a pilot.
Working across global teams and time zones, you will connect customer needs with product, implementation and support teams. You will establish a consistent approach to onboarding, change enablement, customer health and value measurement while allowing for differences in business-group needs and regional ways of working.
 This role is based at our DNV office in Toronto, ON and Montreal, QC; offices, presenting a dynamic hybrid schedule where employees will typically spend three (3) days per week working from either a DNV office or client location/site. Further details regarding role-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process. 
 What you’ll do 
 Customer Success Strategy & Business Partnership 
Define and execute the customer success strategy across business groups, service lines and regions, aligning priorities with business outcomes, customer outcomes, and the digital product portfolio. 
Build trusted relationships with senior business stakeholders and client facing teams, create joint success plans with priority use cases, adoption milestones and expected benefits. 
Establish customer segmentation and engagement models that focus team capacity on the needs, readiness and value opportunities of each business group. 
Lead executive business reviews, communicate progress and risks clearly, and secure business ownership of the changes needed to realize value. 
Define and communicate clear value propositions that help users and clients understand the benefits of digital and AI-enabled capabilities and adopt new ways of working successfully. 
 Team Leadership & Customer Success Operations 
Build, lead and develop the customer success team, setting clear responsibilities, coaching performance, and creating a culture of accountability and customer advocacy. 
Create repeatable playbooks for onboarding, engagement, value reviews and adoption recovery. 
Set team priorities and resource plans, balancing high-touch support for complex needs with scalable enablement for broader adoption. 
Establish customer health reporting that combines meaningful usage, stakeholder engagement, progress toward outcomes and unresolved barriers; lead timely recovery actions. 
 Onboarding, Change Enablement & Sustained Adoption 
Own the customer journey from readiness and onboarding through first value and sustained use, with clear responsibilities shared with business sponsors and delivery teams. 
Lead role-based training, communications and change enablement that help users integrate relevant features into real business workflows. 
Develop a network of business and regional champions to share practical experience, support peer learning and scale proven approaches. 
Identify and address adoption barriers, including process, skills, data, product usability and policy constraints; coordinate escalation and confirm that interventions restore sustained use. 
 Adoption & Value Measurement 
Own the four measures below. Agree eligible populations, meaningful-use criteria, starting baselines, reporting periods and targets with business stakeholders; maintain consistent definitions and review progress by business group. Measure sustained completion of relevant work, not logins alone. 
Measure customer adoption as the number and share of eligible users and teams using the product meaningfully in agreed business workflows over the reporting period. Compare with the starting baseline and verify continued use across successive periods. 
Measure feature adoption as the number and share of eligible users and teams applying each priority feature to relevant work during the reporting period. Compare with the feature's baseline and assess repeat use, depth of use and workflow fit, rather than one-time trials. 
Measure value realized by business group as validated improvements against each group's pre-adoption baseline over an agreed period, such as time saved, reduced cycle time, improved quality or increased delivery capacity. Separate expected benefits from realized benefits and confirm sustained results with business owners. 
Measure growth in adoption as the net increase in meaningfully active users and teams, and the change in adoption rates, from the baseline to subsequent comparable periods. Account for drop-off and changes in the eligible population and show whether adoption is sustained as it expands across business groups. 
 Customer Insight, Product Partnership & Responsible Use 
Bring structured customer feedback, adoption evidence and unmet needs into product prioritization, advocating for improvements with the greatest business value. 
Partner with product and delivery leaders on launch readiness, feature enablement and resolution of recurring customer issues; close the feedback loop with affected business groups. 
Promote responsible digital and AI use that respects DNV's independence, confidentiality and quality requirements, with appropriate expert oversight and clear communication of capability limits. 
Use validated success stories and lessons learned to scale effective practices across regions, while continuously improving the customer success operating model. 
Le responsable de la réussite client dirige la fonction succès client au sein de DNV Energy Systems Digital & Transformation, aidant les clients d'affaires internes et ceux qu'ils servent à transformer les capacités numériques et basées sur l'IA en valeur durable et mesurable. Ce rôle définit la stratégie de réussite client et dirige une équipe axée sur l'adoption client, l'adoption des fonctionnalités, l'expérience client, la réalisation de la valeur et la croissance de l'adoption. 
Vous collaborerez avec des leaders de groupes d'affaires et de lignes de service, des équipes régionales, des chefs de secteur de service mondiaux et des experts en la matière (PME) pour comprendre leurs priorités et intégrer des compétences utiles dans le travail quotidien. Vous aiderez également à vous assurer que les clients comprennent la valeur des offres numériques de DNV, qu'ils vivent une adoption fluide et en tirent rapidement compte. Le succès signifie une utilisation significative qui améliore les résultats d'affaires et de clients, et non simplement l'accès à une plateforme ou la réalisation d'un projet pilote.
En travaillant à travers des équipes et des fuseaux horaires mondiaux, vous mettrez en relation les besoins des clients avec les équipes produit, d'implantation et de soutien. Vous établirez une approche cohérente pour l'intégration, l'activation du changement, la santé des clients et la mesure de la valeur tout en tenant compte des différences dans les besoins des groupes d'affaires et les modes de travail régionaux.
 Ce poste est basé à notre bureau DNV à Toronto, ON et Montréal, QC; présentant un horaire hybride dynamique où les employés passent généralement trois (3) jours par semaine à travailler soit à partir d'un bureau DNV, soit d'un emplacement/site client. D'autres détails concernant les exigences spécifiques au poste seront communiqués lors du processus d'entrevue. 
 Ce que tu vas faire 
 Stratégie de réussite client et partenariat d'affaires 
Définir et exécuter la stratégie de réussite client à travers les groupes d'affaires, les lignes de service et les régions, en alignant les priorités avec les résultats d'affaires, les résultats clients et le portefeuille de produits numériques.
Bâtir des relations de confiance avec les parties prenantes principales de l'entreprise et les équipes en contact avec les clients, élaborer des plans de réussite conjoints avec des cas d'utilisation prioritaires, des jalons d'adoption et des avantages attendus.
Établissez des modèles de segmentation et d'engagement de la clientèle qui concentrent la capacité de l'équipe sur les besoins, la préparation et les opportunités de valeur de chaque groupe d'affaires.
Dirigez les évaluations d'affaires par les cadres, communiquez clairement les progrès et les risques, et assurez-vous que l'entreprise prenne possession des changements nécessaires pour réaliser la valeur.
Définir et communiquer des propositions de valeur claires qui aident les utilisateurs et les clients à comprendre les avantages des capacités numériques et compatibles avec l'IA et à adopter de nouvelles façons de travailler avec succès.
 Leadership d'équipe et Opérations de réussite client 
Bâtir, diriger et développer l'équipe de réussite client, en définissant des responsabilités claires, en coachant la performance et en créant une culture de responsabilité et de défense des clients.
Créez des manuels de jeu répétables pour l'intégration, l'engagement, l'évaluation des valeurs et la récupération de l'adoption. 
Définissez les priorités de l'équipe et les plans de ressources, en équilibrant un soutien à haute portée pour des besoins complexes avec une capacité évolutive pour une adoption plus large.
Établir des rapports sur la santé des clients qui combinent une utilisation significative, l'engagement des parties prenantes, les progrès vers les résultats et les obstacles non résolus; diriger des actions de rétablissement en temps opportun.
 Intégration, habilitation au changement et adoption durable 
Assumez le parcours client depuis la préparation et l'intégration, jusqu'à la première valeur et l'utilisation soutenue, avec des responsabilités claires partagées avec les commanditaires d'affaires et les équipes de livraison.
Dirigez la formation basée sur les rôles, la communication et l'activation du changement qui aident les utilisateurs à intégrer les fonctionnalités pertinentes dans les flux de travail réels d'affaires.
Développez un réseau de champions des entreprises et régionaux pour partager leur expérience pratique, soutenir l'apprentissage par les pairs et faire évoluer des approches éprouvées.
Identifier et aborder les obstacles à l'adoption, y compris les procédés, les compétences, les données, l'utilisabilité du produit et les contraintes politiques; coordonner l'escalade et confirmer que les interventions restaurent une utilisation durable.
 Adoption et mesure de la valeur 
Posséder les quatre mesures ci-dessous. Convenir des populations admissibles, des critères d'utilisation significative, des références de départ, des périodes de rapport et des cibles auprès des parties prenantes de l'entreprise; maintenir des définitions cohérentes et examiner les progrès par groupe d'affaires. Mesurer l'achèvement soutenu du travail pertinent, et non les connexions seules.
Mesurez l'adoption par les clients comme le nombre et la part d'utilisateurs et d'équipes admissibles utilisant le produit de manière significative dans les flux de travail d'affaires convenus au cours de la période de rapport. Comparez avec la base de départ et vérifiez l'utilisation continue sur les périodes successives.
Mesurez l'adoption des fonctionnalités en fonction du nombre et de la part d'utilisateurs et d'équipes admissibles appliquant chaque fonctionnalité prioritaire à un travail pertinent durant la période de rapport. Comparez avec la base de la fonctionnalité et évaluez l'utilisation répétée, la profondeur d'utilisation et l'adéquation au flux de travail, plutôt que les essais ponctuels.
Mesurer la valeur réalisée par le groupe d'affaires comme des améliorations validées par rapport au seuil de référence pré-adoption de chaque groupe sur une période convenue, telles que le temps gagné, le temps de cycle réduit, l'amélioration de la qualité ou l'augmentation de la capacité de livraison. Séparer les bénéfices attendus des bénéfices réalisés et confirmer les résultats durables avec les propriétaires d'entreprise.
Mesurer la croissance de l'adoption en fonction de l'augmentation nette des utilisateurs et équipes réellement actifs, ainsi que la variation des taux d'adoption, de la base à des périodes comparables ultérieures. Tenir compte des baisses et des changements dans la population admissible et montrer si l'adoption se maintient à mesure que l'adoption s'étend à travers les groupes d'affaires.
 Analyse client, partenariat produit et utilisation responsable 
Intégrez la rétroaction structurée des clients, les preuves d'adoption et les besoins non satisfaits dans la priorisation des produits, en défendant des améliorations avec la plus grande valeur d'affaires.
Collaborer avec les responsables produits et de la livraison pour la préparation au lancement, l'activation des fonctionnalités et la résolution des problèmes récurrents des clients; fermer la boucle de rétroaction avec les groupes d'affaires concernés.
Promouvoir une utilisation responsable du numérique et de l'IA qui respecte l'indépendance, la confidentialité et les exigences de qualité de DNV, avec une supervision experte appropriée et une communication claire des limites de capacité.
Utilisez des histoires de réussite validées et des leçons apprises pour faire évoluer des pratiques efficaces dans toutes les régions, tout en améliorant continuellement le modèle opérationnel de réussite client.
 Responsibilities 
Generous paid time off (vacation, sick days, company holidays, personal days)
Medical, Dental and Vision benefit plans available to all employees
Special programs – Employee Assistance Program and accident and critical illness options for you and your family
Workplace strategies for mental help resources available to all employees
Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with company match
Company provided life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability benefits
Education Assistance Program
Flexible work schedule with hybrid opportunities
Consumer discounts and rewards through our BenefitsHub
Advancement opportunities 
 **Benefits vary based on position, tenure, location, and employee election 
DNV provides a reasonable compensation range for this role. The actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. For the cities of Vancouver and Toronto, the range of starting pay for this role is $180,000 - $210,000.
DNV is a proud equal-opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, or business need, without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. 
Congés payés généreux (vacances, congés de maladie, jours fériés d'entreprise, jours personnels)
Régimes d'avantages médicaux, dentaires et de la vue disponibles pour tous les employés
Programmes spéciaux – Programme d'aide aux employés et options pour les accidents et maladies graves pour vous et votre famille
Stratégies en milieu de travail pour les ressources d'aide mentale disponibles à tous les employés
Régime d'épargne-retraite enregistré (REER) avec contrepartie de l'entreprise
L'entreprise offrait une assurance vie, des prestations d'invalidité à court et à long terme
Programme d'aide à l'éducation
Horaire de travail flexible avec des opportunités hybrides
Rabais et récompenses consommateurs via notre Benefits Hub
Possibilités d'avancement
 **Les avantages varient selon le poste, la titularisation, l'emplacement et l'élection des employés 
DNV offre une fourchette de rémunération raisonnable pour ce rôle. La rémunération réelle est influencée par un large éventail de facteurs, y compris, mais sans s'y limiter, l'ensemble des compétences, le niveau d'expérience et l'emplacement spécifique. Pour les villes de Vancouver et Toronto, la fourchette de salaire de départ pour ce poste est de $180,000 -$210,000.
DNV est un employeur fier d'égalité des chances, engagé à bâtir une main-d'œuvre inclusive et diversifiée. Tout emploi est décidé en fonction des qualifications, du mérite ou des besoins d'affaires, sans égard à la race, la couleur, la religion, l'âge, le sexe, l'orientation sexuelle, l'identité de genre, l'origine nationale, le handicap ou le statut de vétéran protégé.
 Qualifications 
 What Is Required

10+ years in customer success, digital transformation, implementation or business enablement, including leadership of a customer-facing or internal customer success function.
A demonstrated record of growing sustained adoption of digital products and showing measurable business value beyond initial launches or pilots.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills (The employee would be required to serve customers by email and by phone, both in Quebec, in the rest of Canada, and in the United States)
We conduct pre-employment background screening

 What Is Preferred 
Experience in the energy sector, professional services, assurance, advisory or another complex or regulated business environment.

 Étant donné que ce poste exige une maîtrise de l'anglais, le processus de recrutement se fera en anglais.  We are seeking an experienced Principal Sales Enablement Consultant to drive sales effectiveness and empower commercial teams through strategic enablement initiatives. title: Principal Customer Success Manager, Aerospace, Propulsion & Energy
description:
nTop gives engineering teams a better way to explore the design space for complex, high-performance products. Engineers use nTop to turn design intent into reusable workflows that generate and evaluate thousands of configurations, connect to the simulation tools they already use, and run at a scale that manual design can't reach. Our customers work across aerospace and defense, turbomachinery, energy, marine, automotive, and industrial applications. More and more of them are building AI and agentic engineering workflows on top of nTop. 
 We're a small team selling a new way of doing engineering into some of the most demanding organizations in the world. Everyone here carries real ownership, and the work each person does shows up directly in how the company performs. 
 The Role 
 We're hiring a Principal Customer Success Manager to own nTop's most strategic customer relationships across the largest aerospace, propulsion, and energy organizations: airframers, engine OEMs, and power generation manufacturers. You'll own a focused book of nTop's most strategic accounts and report to the SVP of Sales and Customer Success. 
 Our Customer Success team runs two motions: a high-velocity motion, and a newer strategic motion focused on our largest enterprise customers. This role is part of the strategic motion. You’ll own the accounts and engagements that matter most to nTop: leading complex renewals, quarterbacking onsite engineering sprints, and turning first deployments into long-term, multi-program partnerships. nTop is a deep, technical product, and the customers using it are some of the most demanding engineering organizations in the world. Success in this role means understanding their engineering well enough to make nTop part of how they work. 
 This role also sits at the center of how nTop is evolving. We’re moving away from per-seat licenses towards platform and capacity-based pricing with outcome-focused engineering engagements. You’ll actively lead your customers through that shift at renewal, and help them build nTop into their AI and digital engineering roadmaps. 
 Our strategic agreements are typically structured as 12- to 24-month programs, with defined engineering scope, deliverables, and milestones. Managing them with real program discipline is what earns the renewal, and the next program after it. 
 What You'll Do 
 Own a strategic book. Be accountable for retention and growth across a focused set of nTop's most strategic accounts, with a net revenue retention target. 
 Run every account as a program. Treat each customer agreement as a 12- to 24-month engineering program with defined scope, deliverables, and milestones. Track progress, keep both nTop and the customer accountable, and tie results to the outcomes customers care about: schedule, performance, and win rate. Every renewal should be backed by results the customer has already seen. 
 Lead complex renewals. Forecast early, build the business case, and negotiate six- and seven-figure renewals and multi-year agreements. 
 Lead the pricing transition. Actively move your customers from seat-based licenses to platform and capacity-based pricing, working closely with the Strategic Account Director. 
 Quarterback onsite engineering engagements. Travel to customer sites to lead engineering sprints and services engagements, aligning customer stakeholders, nTop's Field Solutions Engineers, and the outcomes the engagement needs to deliver. 
 Build relationships at the top and across the organization. Develop executive sponsors among engineering and program leadership, run executive business reviews, and stay close to the engineers, IT, and procurement teams who keep deployments healthy. 
 Find and shape expansion. Identify new programs, divisions, and use cases inside your accounts, and partner with the Strategic Account Director to turn them into expansion deals. 
 Be technically credible. Understand how your customers design and simulate well enough to diagnose adoption blockers, run workflow conversations with engineers, and bring in Field Solutions Engineering at the right moment. 
 Lead the AI conversation after the sale. Help customers see how nTop fits into the AI and agentic engineering workflows they're building, and turn that into the next phase of the relationship. 
 See risk early. Track account health, flag issues before they reach the renewal, and lead escalations when they happen. 
 Work as one team. Partner closely with the Strategic Account Director, Field Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Support, and Product. We share relationships across accounts because the goal is nTop winning, not territory. 
 Raise the bar for strategic account management. Use AI tools to work faster, keep account health and renewal forecasts accurate in Salesforce, and help define how nTop runs its most strategic accounts. 
 What Success Looks Like 
 First 6 months: You’ve set clear program plans and identified executive sponsors at each of your accounts, your renewal forecast is accurate and visible, and you've led your first major renewal and onsite engagement. 
 First 12 months: Your book is hitting its net revenue retention target, you've moved key accounts onto platform pricing, you've sourced meaningful expansion opportunities with the Strategic Account Director, and you've helped define the playbook for how nTop runs strategic accounts. 
 Required Experience 
 A track record of owning a renewal number for large enterprise SaaS accounts, with individual renewals of $1M+, typically 8+ years in customer success or strategic account management. 
 Experience working with enterprise customers in complex, multi-stakeholder organizations. 
 Experience in a post-sale role with engineering software (CAD, CAE/simulation, PLM, or adjacent engineering and digital engineering software such as MBSE or design automation), working specifically with engineering leaders (directors and VPs of engineering, chief engineers, and heads of digital engineering). 
 Technical aptitude. You understand the engineering software ecosystem and how engineers move from CAD to simulation and back, and you're comfortable leading workflow conversations with engineers on a deep, technical product. 
 Executive presence. You're as credible across the table from a VP of Engineering or program executive as you are in a working session with engineers, and you build trust with senior leaders over years, not quarters. 
 Commercial ownership. You've negotiated large renewals and multi-year agreements yourself, not just managed the relationship around them. 
 Program management discipline. You’ve run complex, multi-month customer engagements with defined scope, deliverables, and milestones, and you know how to manage scope, timelines, and stakeholders so commitments are delivered. 
 U.S. Person status as defined by ITAR, due to export control requirements. 
 At least 30% travel to customer sites, onsite engineering engagements, and industry events, with heavier stretches around key engagements. 
 Strongly preferred (we don't expect all of these) 
 Experience working with airframers, engine OEMs, or energy manufacturers, and knowing how they operate: who holds budget, how programs fund tools year over year, and how procurement and export control shape a renewal. Existing relationships at companies such as Lockheed Martin, RTX/Pratt & Whitney, GE Aerospace, or Siemens Energy are a strong plus. 
 Experience moving customers from seat-based licensing to platform, usage, or value-based pricing, or managing accounts for AI, simulation-driven, or design automation products. 
 Also a plus 
 Hands-on familiarity with nTop or similar tools, enough to use the product at a high level. 
 Active security clearance (Secret or higher). 
 Exposure to additive manufacturing, generative design, or advanced manufacturing. 
 Experience at a high-growth startup or scale-up. 
 A degree in engineering, physics, applied math, computer science, or materials science. 
 How you work 
 You see a renewal as the result of value delivered all year, not a negotiation that starts 90 days out. 
 You're proactive. You raise risks and opportunities before anyone asks. 
 You're low-ego and collaborative. You win by pulling in the right people at the right time and making the team around you better. 
 You own your results. 
 Compensation 
 Compensation: the on-target earnings (OTE) range for this role is $177,000 to $224,000 USD, plus equity and benefits. Final compensation depends on seniority and level of industry experience. 
Please note that nTop may use AI products to assist in the recruiting process. All resumes are reviewed by, and all employment decisions are made by, nTop's Hiring Team. 
If you require a reasonable accommodation during the interview process, please don't hesitate to email us directly.
flags: CSM in US-Remote at a non-standout company
Stated $177K-$224K is OTE, not base; the base split is unknown, so verify it against the $130K CS floor.
Role expects deep technical credibility in aerospace and engineering simulation workflows, which Tom lacks.
Frequent onsite travel to customer sites to lead engineering sprints is central to the role.
Required qualifications section was truncated, so the posting's must-haves could not be fully checked.
Small startup selling into defense; export control or clearance considerations may favour other candidates.
verdict: Credible Principal CSM fit on renewals and pricing transition, but this is a US lateral CS role in a technical engineering niche, so it is runway only.

title: Customer Success Operations Specialist (Gainsight Administrator)
description:
Job DescriptionJob Description
Who We’re Looking For
At ScalePad, we hire thoughtful builders who want their work to matter. Our roles are designed for people who thrive on driving impact, see ambiguity as an opportunity, and believe that raising the bar is a team sport.
We don’t bring people in to run playbooks. We hire people who want to rewrite them . And in this role, you’ll get to do that, while shaping the future of managed services for our global partners. (That’s what we call our customers.)
What is ScalePad
At ScalePad, we’re building more than software; we’re building confidence and clarity for the people who manage the technology businesses rely on every day.
Our mission: help MSPs evolve into MVPs (their clients’ most valuable partner) . Our tools turn them from reactive service providers into strategic advisors through a consistent, scalable Customer Success motion.
Our product suite unifies risk insights, client planning, and service delivery so MSPs can have smarter conversations, show clients their value, and grow their revenue. 
But our purpose goes beyond our software. We’re creating a workplace where curious, growth-minded people can do their best work, where ideas are valued, progress is shared, and everyone belongs. Together, we’re creating a future where MSPs don’t just keep businesses running, they help them thrive. We believe that when our partners succeed, we all do.
With offices in Vancouver, Toronto, Montreal, and Phoenix and a global-first mindset. ScalePad has grown into a category leader trusted by 12,000+ partners across 60+ countries. We’ve been recognized for our products and corporate culture by MSP Today, G2, and Great Place to Work™, to name a few. 
About The Role 
 Make Gainsight the trusted operating system that drives our post sales success 
As our Customer Success Operations Specialist, you'll own the hands-on delivery of Gainsight CS across Customer Success, Onboarding / Professional Services, and Support. . This is a builder's role within our broader Revenue Operations organization, working directly with the CS Operations Lead to turn prioritized business needs into solutions that scale.
You'll work deeply in Gainsight — Rules Engine, Data Designer, Journey Orchestrator, Scorecards, Success Plans, CTAs, and playbooks — while keeping data flowing reliably across HubSpot, Zendesk, and Databricks. You'll also extend our stack through APIs, n8n, and AI-assisted automation.
When something doesn't look right, you're the person who gets under the hood, finds the root cause, and fixes it for good.
If you love turning business problems into thoughtful technical solutions and seeing what you build directly improves how customer-facing teams work, you'll thrive here. 
What You’ll Own
Get ready to go beyond order-taking. Your strategic responsibilities include:
Take a validated, prioritized requirement and decide the technical approach: gather the detail from the functional team, choose the approach, and recommend the build inside the target-state architecture.
Draft the technical design — tables, rules, data flows, trigger logic — for the Senior Manager to approve. Everything inside the existing architecture is yours to design and ship; architecture changes, new objects, and large modifications go through change-management review together.
Be the technical voice in scoping and discovery sessions: feasibility, effort, options and risks, so decisions get made with the real constraints on the table.
Estimate and phase realistically, and raise risks and blockers early rather than at the deadline.
Own Gainsight CS configuration end to end: Rules Engine, Data Designer, CTAs and playbooks, health scores and scorecards, Success Plans, layouts, and platform upgrades.
Build and maintain Journey Orchestrator programs — outbound journeys, email templates, audiences, triggers, and frequency guardrails.
Configure playbook content and CTA trigger criteria so every signal has an owner and an expected action.
Own the reports and dashboards the CS org runs on day to day, including what belongs on them: dashboards that tell a rep or a team lead where to spend their time, not everything we happen to have data for. You supply the numbers behind leadership's adoption and outcome reporting; you don't carry that narrative.
Build the integrations that feed the stack — CRM ↔ Gainsight, Zendesk → Gainsight, and the Databricks data flows — to the integration strategy CS Ops leadership agrees with RevOps and the data team.
Extend the platform where native features run out: API-based workflows, n8n automations, and AI-assisted scripting.
Protect system integrity: say what's technically possible, push back on hacks that create tech debt or ungoverned fields, and propose the durable version instead. We'd rather hear "not like that, but here's how" than get a workaround.
Own the release: sandbox testing, cutover, data validation, and a rollback plan you'd actually be willing to use.
Own the documentation that ships with every launch — what changed, how it works, and what to do when it doesn't — alongside the standing system documentation: configurations, data dictionaries, and integration maps. Process documentation stays with the teams who run the process; you make sure the technical picture behind it is accurate.
Partner with the Senior Manager, CS Operations and our Enablement team on launch training: you bring the substance and the walkthrough, they run the room.
Watch the weeks after go-live, not just the go-live: monitor programs and data in production, and close the loop on what needs fixing.
First line for "the system is broken" and "the data looks wrong": diagnose to root cause, apply a permanent fix, and document what happened.
Own the ongoing health of the integrations and syncs — catch failures before stakeholders do, and own data hygiene across the CS stack.
Maintain the support-data layer in Gainsight — ticket signals, sentiment, priority, volume — and the datasets the wider team builds on.
Own the AI layer of the stack: data readiness, agent configuration and maintenance, platform AI features, and the guardrails around them.
Turn around small field-level asks quickly — a missing field, a filter change — where they sit inside a project that's already approved. New work arrives scoped and prioritized through CS Ops intake; requests that land on you directly get routed there rather than quietly absorbed.
What we’re looking for
We care about what you can do more than where you’ve done it. However, experience in the following areas will help you hit the ground running in this role:
 Must-have 
 Gainsight CS — 2+ years hands-on administration in a SaaS environment: Rules Engine, Data Designer, Journey Orchestrator, Scorecards, Success Plans, CTAs and playbooks. Gainsight certification is a plus 
Demonstrated ability to take a scoped project and deliver it independently — estimating realistically, testing before deploy, and flagging risk early rather than at the deadline.
Working knowledge of APIs, data mapping, and SQL; comfort reasoning about data structures and joins.
Experience integrating multiple systems — CRM, support, and data warehouse — and debugging when they disagree. Our CRM is HubSpot; Salesforce integration experience transfers directly and we don't expect prior HubSpot exposure.
Strong troubleshooting instincts: you enjoy untangling data discrepancies and tracing behaviour to a root cause rather than patching symptoms.
Comfort gathering requirements directly from the people who'll use the thing — asking the questions that surface what they actually need, not just what they asked for.
Clear written communication and documentation habits. You can explain a technical constraint to a non-technical stakeholder without losing them or oversimplifying.
 Additionally valued 
Zendesk familiarity — the support integration and support datasets sit with this role, and admin-level Zendesk experience (triggers, automations, views, macros, SLAs) is a bonus rather than a requirement.
Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable data warehouse experience, and comfort with SQL against it.
iPaaS and scripting: n8n, Workato, Make, Tray.io; Python or JavaScript.
Practical AI usage in an ops context — agents, prompt design, human-in-the-loop design, and evaluating output quality before trusting it.
Governance mindset: permissions, PII handling, change control, incident response, rollback strategies.
Perks
ScalePad offers our employees a blend of purpose, growth, and genuinely great perks.
 Everyone’s an owner. Share in our success through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) and RRSP matching.
 Support for growing families. Parental leave programs are in place to support you and your family when it matters most.
 Structured mentorship with builders. Join opt-in mentorship programs and learn directly from founders and senior leaders who’ve scaled multiple SaaS ventures and spent decades in the MSP industry.
 Invest in your growth every year. Access an annual professional development budget to level up your skills, your career, and your impact.
 Set yourself up with great tools. Work with brand new, top-of-the-line hardware and equipment so you can do your best work, whether you’re at home or in one of our hubs.
 Modern ways of working. Roles at ScalePad are structured as remote or hybrid, with hub locations in Vancouver, Toronto, Montreal, and Phoenix. Specific work models are outlined in each posting.
 Support for hybrid life. Receive a monthly stipend to help you create an effective hybrid or remote work environment.
 Well-being and time to recharge. Take care of yourself with 100% employer-paid benefits.
Before You Apply
