title: Manager of Renewals, SMB
description:
Hi, I’m Alex, Head of Contract Management (Renewals) at Ashby. Our Contract Management team plays a critical role in helping customers navigate renewal and commercial conversations thoughtfully, strategically, and with a high degree of trust. We are building a team that takes pride in delivering exceptional customer experiences while also protecting the long-term health of the business, and I am excited to be hiring a Manager of Contract Management (Renewals) to help scale and evolve this function.
In this role, you’ll lead and develop a team of Startup Contract Managers responsible for guiding customers through renewals, pricing conversations, negotiations, and long-term partnership planning. A key part of this role is helping the team navigate increasingly complex commercial conversations while building scalable processes, operational rigor, and repeatable frameworks that elevate both the customer experience and the effectiveness of the Contract Management organization.
You’ll partner closely with leaders across Customer Success, Sales, RevOps, Product, Legal, Finance, and Support to help shape how Ashby approaches renewals and long-term customer growth as we continue to scale upmarket.
 About The Role
 As the Manager of Contract Management, you’ll lead a team of global Startup Contract Managers responsible for renewal strategy, customer retention, and commercial partnership management across Ashby’s customer base. You’ll act as a coach, operator, and strategic thought partner — helping the team grow their commercial acumen, negotiation capabilities, and customer judgment while also building scalable systems and processes that allow the organization to operate effectively at scale.
 In This Role, You Will
Lead and coach a team of 6 Startup Contract Managers (4 in America and 2 in EMEA) responsible for renewals, contract negotiations, and commercial partnership conversations. These individuals do high volume - about 
Up-level team performance through thoughtful coaching, operational discipline, and skill development across negotiation strategy, forecasting, customer communication, and stakeholder management
Help build scalable renewal processes, systems, and operational workflows that improve efficiency while preserving a high-touch customer experience
Partner cross-functionally with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, Support, and RevOps to align on customer strategy and commercial outcomes
Drive consistency in renewal execution, forecasting accuracy, CRM hygiene, and pricing governance across the team
Support the team in navigating complex negotiations involving procurement, legal, executive stakeholders, pricing transitions, and multi-product commercial conversations
Translate successful negotiation strategies and customer patterns into repeatable frameworks, playbooks, and enablement materials for the broader organization
Help shape the long-term vision and operational strategy for the Contract Management function as Ashby continues to scale
 Role Requirements
 Team Leadership & Coaching
 You have experience leading and developing high-performing customer-facing teams in a B2B SaaS environment. You know how to foster a culture centered around empathy, accountability, creativity, and transparency, while helping individuals grow through thoughtful coaching and continuous feedback.
 Commercial Acumen & Negotiation Strategy
 You have deep experience managing or overseeing complex renewals, pricing conversations, and contract negotiations. You understand how to balance customer partnership with commercial integrity, and can coach teams through nuanced negotiation scenarios with confidence and sound judgment.
 Renewal Strategy & Forecasting
 You understand how to proactively manage renewal risk, expansion opportunities, forecasting accuracy, and long-term account planning. You bring structure and discipline to renewal operations while remaining adaptable in dynamic customer situations.
 Operational Mindset
 You have experience building or improving scalable systems, workflows, and processes that allow teams to operate effectively at scale. You value operational excellence, data accuracy, and thoughtful process design.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration
 You are comfortable partnering across Sales, Customer Success, Product, RevOps, Legal, Finance, and Support to align around customer needs, pricing strategy, and long-term business outcomes.
 Customer & Executive Communication
 You are an excellent communicator who can navigate challenging conversations with empathy, professionalism, and clarity. You know how to build trust with both customers and internal stakeholders while maintaining transparency throughout the renewal process.
 Problem-Solving Orientation
 You don’t rely solely on “what worked before.” You are thoughtful, adaptable, and solutions-oriented — able to navigate ambiguity and develop creative approaches to complex commercial challenges.
 Data-Driven & Strategic
 You are comfortable using data, trends, customer insights, and operational metrics to drive decision-making and improve both team performance and customer outcomes.
 You’ll Be a Great Fit If You
You communicate with clarity and empathy. You ask thoughtful questions, simplify complex concepts, and build trust through transparent communication.
You enjoy coaching. You see every negotiation, renewal, and customer interaction as an opportunity to help your team learn and grow.
You are highly operational. You value strong internal systems, accurate forecasting, clean data, and scalable process design.
You thrive in dynamic environments. You are energized by solving complex problems and adapting processes as the business evolves.
You balance customer advocacy with business integrity. You can empathize deeply with customer needs while confidently protecting Ashby’s long-term commercial interests.
You are a strategic problem solver. You know how to navigate ambiguity, identify creative solutions, and align multiple stakeholders toward a shared outcome.
You enjoy building. You are excited about helping shape the future of the Contract Management organization and scaling its impact across Ashby.
 You Might Not Be a Fit If
You prefer highly rigid, unchanging processes and environments.
You are uncomfortable navigating pricing conversations, negotiations, or commercial ambiguity.
You prefer operating independently rather than through cross-functional collaboration and team development.
You are more interested in defining high-level strategy than owning execution alongside your team.
You avoid operational detail, forecasting rigor, or system/process improvement work.
You are uncomfortable balancing customer empathy with accountability and commercial discipline.
You prefer transactional customer interactions over long-term strategic partnership building.
 Our Philosophy
 Here Are a Few Key Points (relevant To The Go-to-market Side) That Should Give You An Idea Of What It Is Like To Work With Us
We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to position and support in commercial conversations.
We believe deeply in pairing customer empathy with accountability and operational excellence.
We value thoughtful communication, principled decision-making, and strong ownership across every function.
We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people deliver significantly better outcomes than large teams with unclear ownership or low accountability.
We care deeply about helping customers succeed while also building a sustainable, scalable business.
We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication — we’ll get into these and other values throughout the interview process.
 Interview Process
 At Ashby, Our Interview Process Is Designed To Help You Show Your Best Self While Also Giving You Insight Into How We Operate As a Team. The Process Typically Includes
Recruiter Screen - 30 minutes
Hiring Manager Interview - 45 minutes
Strategic Exercise - Take-home assignment
Final Round - 2 hours
Rather than a traditional panel interview with a large group, we structure our panel into a series of smaller conversations. This gives you the opportunity to meet with multiple team members in a more conversational setting focused on specific topics, instead of a formal Q&A. You'll discuss how you approach problem solving, how you work with sales, and dive into a product complexity exercise.
 Benefits
You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.
10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby - do it when you feel financially comfortable.
Unlimited PTO with four weeks is recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅
Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.
Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
$100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
Ashby’s success hinges on hiring exceptional people and creating an environment where they can do their best work. We’re being intentional about building that environment from the ground up, and we hope that excites you enough to apply.
 Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.
 Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
Escalon is a Toronto-based AI consultancy built by engineers. We help enterprises redesign their workflows around AI, then engineer, test and run those systems in production.
Our roots are in high-performance software, quality engineering and program delivery across gaming, SaaS and enterprise systems. That discipline is what makes AI hold up in the real world.
About the role
As a GTM Engineer you build the systems behind Escalon's growth: automated prospecting, lead enrichment and outreach workflows that put the right conversations in front of our team.
We are looking for a GTM operator who is also a hands-on builder. You understand how a revenue team works, you can turn its problems into working automations, and you have built those solutions yourself rather than only managing the tools and processes around them.
Our buyer and prospect signals live across a CRM, enrichment tools, outreach platforms, and public and third-party data. You will connect those sources, add context, and build workflows that show our team who to engage, why, when and with what message.
You do not need to be a traditional software engineer. You may come from revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, GTM systems or a similar technical GTM function. Because Escalon builds AI systems for clients, you will also be a first-hand user of the kind of AI workflows we recommend.
Clay CRM and workflow automation Lead enrichment Outreach tooling Data and integrations
What you'll do
Build prospecting and enrichment workflows: design and run automated account research, lead enrichment, scoring and prioritization that keep our pipeline full of the right companies and contacts.
Turn signals into action: connect and enrich data from the CRM, outreach tools, web activity and third-party sources to identify high-value accounts and recommend the next step.
Automate the GTM stack: build integrations and workflows across the CRM, Clay, sales engagement and outreach tools, enrichment providers and internal data sources.
Build agents and internal tools: use LLMs, APIs, webhooks, automation platforms and scripting to create tools that make our team faster and more effective.
Design outreach workflows: set up sequencing, personalization and follow-up, and keep them accurate, compliant with email and privacy rules, and well measured.
Prototype and iterate quickly: get solutions into users' hands, measure what works, and improve them from real feedback.
Make workflows reliable: add validation, guardrails, human review where it matters, monitoring and error handling so automations can be trusted in production.
Keep data clean: own data quality across tools so records, owners and statuses stay consistent as volume grows.
What you need
Experience in revenue operations, sales operations, GTM systems, marketing operations or a similar GTM function.
A solid understanding of B2B revenue workflows: lead management, routing, enrichment, qualification, account prioritization, prospecting and pipeline generation.
Hands-on experience building automations, integrations, internal tools or data workflows yourself.
Experience with GTM platforms such as Clay, a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce or similar), and outreach or sales engagement tools.
Experience building AI or LLM-powered workflows, with tools such as Claude, OpenAI, n8n, Zapier, Make or similar.
Comfort working with APIs, webhooks and scripting to connect systems.
The ability to work directly with the people who use your systems and translate their problems into working solutions.
Nice to have
Experience building account intelligence, scoring, routing or signal-based GTM workflows.
Experience taking an automation or AI workflow from prototype through production and adoption.
Experience in a consulting, services or other B2B environment with long sales cycles.
Escalon is committed to an inclusive hiring process and to equal opportunity. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and consider every applicant on their skills and experience. If you need an accommodation at any stage of the process, let us know and we will work with you.
Have a complex challenge or an ambitious idea? Let's explore what's possible.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Head of GTM Field Strategy & Ops, EMEA

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. You turn EMEA growth targets into plans the field can run: quotas, territories, coverage, organization design, and an operating rhythm that produces decisions.

Partner with People, Legal and Finance on the operational steps of building a regional organization.

 Cross-Functional & AI-Native Ops

 Qualifications

title: Senior Business Analyst, GTM Systems
description:
Description 
Sprout Social is looking to hire a Business Analyst, GTM Systems to the Sales & Customer Experience team.
You’ll be the bridge between our revenue teams and the systems they run on. You’ll turn business needs into clear requirements, make sure what gets built actually works before it reaches the field, and work hand in hand with our Salesforce IT team. You’ll also play a leading role in our CPQ evaluation and in fixing how we measure marketing and pipeline attribution.
 Why join Sprout’s Revenue Operations, Sales & Customer Experience team? 
At Sprout Social, our Sales and Customer Experience team is the driving force behind how today’s most innovative brands use Sprout to power the future of customer connection. We sell and support the leading social intelligence platform for businesses, helping organizations unlock the full value of social data to drive strategic decisions. Through powerful social intelligence and trusted partnership, we enable teams to build authentic relationships and drive meaningful business impact.
As the strategic engine of our go-to-market organization, Revenue Operations builds the infrastructure that turns data into action. We specialize in architecting world-class processes and delivering the operational clarity that allows our teams to move with speed, anticipate market shifts, and optimize the entire customer lifecycle for sustainable growth.
In this role, you will collaborate with the brightest minds in the industry to support global giants like Salesforce, Airbnb, and Equifax. Just as importantly, we believe in the power of our people. You’ll find a culture that honors your ambition, encourages you to explore new horizons, and provides the framework for you to build a career that matters. If you’re ready to champion innovation and accelerate your impact, this is where you can do your best work.
 What you’ll do 
Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Renewals and Deal Desk to turn business needs into clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
Own intake and prioritization for GTM systems requests, working with the Director of GTM Systems & Applied AI and Salesforce IT to maintain a single, prioritized backlog.
Plan and run user acceptance testing, triage defects, and secure business-owner sign-off before changes reach the field.
Write release notes and field communications, and support reps and managers through changes.
Lead requirements, scenario design and scoring for our CPQ evaluation, and support delivery of the CPQ roadmap.
Define and fix marketing and pipeline attribution: requirements, source data capture in Salesforce, and validated reporting that Marketing and Sales both trust.
Monitor data quality on forecast, renewals and source fields, find root causes, and keep data and process definitions documented.
Use AI tools to draft, test and document, and spend your own time on judgment, review and decisions.
 What you’ll bring 
You know how revenue teams work and how to get the right thing built. You write requirements that engineers can build from, you’re rigorous about testing, and you earn trust with everyone from a frontline rep to a VP.
The minimum qualifications for this role include:
4+ years of experience in business analysis, systems analysis or sales operations, supporting a B2B SaaS go-to-market team.
Hands-on Salesforce experience and a working understanding of the data model.
Proven ability to gather business requirements and write user stories and acceptance criteria.
Experience planning and running UAT and managing releases with a central IT team that owns the platform.
Fluency in GTM data: pipeline, forecast, bookings and renewals.
Clear written and verbal communication with both frontline teams and executives.
Preferred qualifications for this role include:
Experience with Salesforce CPQ or quote-to-cash, or running a systems evaluation or vendor selection.
Experience with marketing or pipeline attribution.
Experience with Gong or another revenue intelligence platform.
Salesforce Administrator certification, or familiarity with SOQL.
Experience using AI tools to speed up analysis, documentation and testing.
 How you’ll grow 
Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:
Complete Sprout Social’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. You’ll gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization.
Make a plan with your manager to set initial priorities, align on expectations for your role, plant goalposts for your career, and learn about Sprout’s approach to building and releasing GTM systems changes.
Learn our GTM stack, the Salesforce data model and Salesforce IT’s release process.
Meet your key stakeholders in Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Renewals and Deal Desk.
Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:
Build connections with members from other teams through active networking and community building.
Run intake and a standing cadence with Salesforce IT, and ship your first release end to end with stories, UAT and field communications.
Document the requirements baseline and evaluation criteria for CPQ.
Audit current attribution gaps and agree on requirements with Marketing and Sales leadership.
Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:
Have your first performance conversation with your manager, where you’ll discuss your accomplishments in your role and work together to build goals for your professional growth.
Lead the CPQ evaluation, including scenario scripts, demos or proofs of concept, and a scored recommendation.
Own UAT for our Gong Forecasting rollout.
Agree on attribution definitions and rules, and test the Salesforce changes with IT.
Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:
Surprise us! Use your unique ideas and abilities to change your team in beneficial ways that we haven’t even considered yet.
Own requirements and UAT for the first waves of the CPQ roadmap and our multiple contracts per account work.
Deliver pipeline attribution reporting that Marketing and Sales both accept.
Show a clear data quality trend and documented definitions that teams and AI agents can rely on.
Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.
 Our Benefits Program  
We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:
 Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Premium BCBSIL medical, dental (high/low plans), and vision (Eyemed) insurance for you and your eligible dependents.
 Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
 Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 50% company match on your first 6% of contributions (a 3% total match).
 Financial Security: 100% employer-paid Life and Disability insurance for your peace of mind.
 Flexible Paid Time Off: A flexible PTO policy, supplemented with additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days throughout the year.
 Paid Parental Leave: Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents to support you in expanding your family.
 Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $1,000 USD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
 Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet.
 Giving Back: 16 hours of paid volunteer time annually, plus a $100 annual match for your charitable donations.
 Additional Financial Perks: Access to pre-tax commuter benefits, subsidized child/eldercare (Care.com), discounted pet insurance (Figo), and no-cost personalized financial wellness support through Your Money Line .
* This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits. 
 Whenever possible, Sprout wants to provide our team with the flexibility to work in the location that makes the most sense for them. Sprout maintains a remote workforce in many places in the United States. However, we are not set up in all states, so please look at the drop-down box in our application to see whether your state is listed. Few roles require an office setting. Proven requirements gathering, user stories and acceptance criteria

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.
If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.
We are seeking an experienced Principal Revenue Enablement Professional to elevate the effectiveness of our Sales Engineering audience and strengthen alignment across the broader Go-To-Market organization. This person will partner closely with Sales Engineer leaders, field teams, Product Marketing, Sales, and other stakeholders to identify capability needs and translate them into practical, scalable enablement experiences.
The role will design and execute end-to-end programs that help Sales Engineers connect technical capabilities to customer outcomes, lead effective discovery, deliver compelling demonstrations, navigate technical validation, and partner effectively with Account Executives throughout the customer journey.

 Qualifications

Ability to build practical, scalable learning experiences that move from knowledge acquisition to practice, application, reinforcement, and measurable readiness.
Strong presence with the ability to engage technical audiences, lead interactive sessions, and provide clear, constructive feedback.
Ability to learn complex concepts quickly and translate them into clear, relevant, customer-centered stories and enablement materials.
Project Management: Strong organization, prioritization, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives in a changing environment.

title: Principal, Sales Strategy
description:
About the team 
Zillow's Agent Sales organization empowers real estate professionals with the solutions and technology they need to succeed. Within it, the GTM Strategy & Operations team serves as our internal strategy house — architecting business models that deliver value to agents while building sustainable revenue for Zillow. The team partners directly with Sales and Customer Success leadership to turn strategy into measurable performance.
 About the role 
As a Principal Sales Strategy Business Partner reporting to the Director of Sales Strategy, you'll function as the embedded strategy lead for segment and channel owners — owning the analytical, operational, and strategic agenda that drives performance across your portfolio. You'll shape how leaders diagnose problems, allocate resources, and pursue growth, translating ambiguous challenges into frameworks and decisions that move the business. This role demands intellectual rigor paired with the operational credibility to implement: you don't just advise, you drive outcomes.
 What you’ll own: 
Act as the primary thought partner to Sales segment and channel leaders on performance, resource allocation, and growth priorities — bringing a structured point of view to their most consequential decisions
Drive the Weekly Business Review cadence for your segments — defining performance metrics, driving forecast accuracy, , and translating pipeline and performance signals into decisions and interventions
Design, execute, and evaluate sales plays in partnership with Sales and CSM leadership — owning the full cycle from hypothesis through post-mortem to drive product adoption, retention, and revenue growth
Set the analytical standard for how the team approaches performance questions — establishing frameworks, modeling best practices, and elevating the quality of insights produced across the GTM Strategy org
Identify process inefficiencies and bottlenecks, then design and lead cross-functional implementation of operational improvements that boost sales effectiveness
Turn data into decisions: run deep-dive analyses on activation, usage, and productivity, diagnose root causes of performance gaps, and deliver data-backed recommendations to improve rep productivity and customer adoption
Own analytical input and scenario modeling for territory design, headcount planning, and resource allocation
Collaborate across GTM Strategy, Business Intelligence, Marketing, Product, and Finance to align on strategic initiatives and ensure seamless execution
Champion adoption of AI and automation across business rhythms and analytical workflows, setting the standard for how the team leverages modern tools
This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.
In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $136,700.00 - $218,300.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $129,800.00 - $207,400.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.
In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.
 Who you are 
You bring 8+ years of go-to-market strategy experience across management consulting and in-house roles, including significant time inside a direct B2B sales organization at a software or technology business, where you defined segmentation, territory and coverage strategy with sales leadership.
Originate the strategic agenda — proactively identifying coverage gaps, untested assumptions, and unrealized leverage across your segments, and bringing a point of view to leadership before they've framed the question

title: Sales Enablement Manager
description:
Job Title : Sales Enablement Manager
 Location : Remote
 Division: Revenue 
 About Us: 
Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) (Nasdaq: QUBT) is an innovative, integrated photonics company that provides accessible and affordable quantum machines to the world today. QCi products are designed to operate at room temperature and low power at an affordable cost. The Company’s portfolio of core technology and products offer unique capabilities in the areas of high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, cyber security as well as remote sensing applications.
 Scope of the Job: 
Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) is seeking its first Sales Enablement Manager to build our sales enablement function from the ground up. As we refine our brand, product story, and approach to selling, this person will help our sellers clearly explain who we are, what we offer, the customer problems we solve, and how to sell our solutions. 
This is a hands-on role for someone who can set priorities and create the content and training to deliver them. Working closely with Revenue Leadership, Sales Operations, Marketing, Product, and technical experts, you will investigate gaps, bring the right people together, and turn complex information into practical sales resources. You should be comfortable asking difficult questions, constructively challenging assumptions, and following through to get the information and decisions sellers need.
 Duties / Responsibilities: 
Build and maintain a practical sales enablement roadmap and playbook, prioritizing the most urgent seller needs with Revenue Leadership. 
Develop and deliver onboarding and ongoing training covering company and product knowledge, customer use cases, discovery, qualification, demos, and value conversations. Use practice and feedback to assess seller readiness. 
Create and maintain sales presentations, product and use case guides, discovery questions, objection handling, and competitive battle cards. Organize approved resources so sellers can easily find current materials. 
Learn QCi’s products, subsidiaries, target customers, and selling motions through interviews with experts, sales conversations, and existing materials. Partner with Marketing to translate the evolving brand and positioning into clear sales messaging, validated by Product and technical teams. 
Support product launches with seller training, messaging, FAQs, and sales tools. Surface unclear product scope, capabilities, availability, or claims and drive follow-up with the accountable owners before communicating them to sellers. 
Measure adoption, knowledge and skill development, and seller feedback. Partner with Sales Operations and sales leaders to assess business impact and improve programs. 
Coordinate subject matter experts, clarify owners and deadlines, and escalate unresolved dependencies with a clear recommendation. Product and leadership retain ownership of product definition and commercial readiness; Marketing retains ownership of brand and positioning. 
 Qualifications 
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. 
Typically 5+ years of relevant experience in sales enablement, product marketing, sales training, or a related commercial role, with direct ownership of enablement deliverables. Equivalent experience demonstrating the capabilities below will also be considered. 
Demonstrated experience building an enablement program, playbook, or onboarding approach from an early stage, including personally creating materials and delivering training. 
Strong writing, facilitation, and project management skills, with the ability to turn complex technical information into clear, accurate customer value and practical sales guidance. 
Ability to work independently amid incomplete information, influence stakeholders without formal authority, ask probing questions, and persist constructively to secure input and resolve blockers. Strong commercial curiosity and the ability to understand customer needs, buying processes, and how sellers move opportunities forward
 Additional Preferred Skills:

title: Staff Revenue Operations Manager, Revenue Planning & Analytics
description:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.
We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.
We are looking for a Staff Revenue Operations Manager to help shape how EvenUp plans for and achieves its growth targets. As we scale our go-to-market organization, this person will own the bottoms-up revenue model that connects company-level goals to the underlying assumptions across our Sales and broader GTM teams.
You'll partner closely with Revenue Operations and GTM leadership to build annual and quarterly plans, evaluate revenue performance, and conduct the strategic analyses that inform decisions around sales capacity, quotas, territories, and resource allocation. This is a highly analytical role that requires both strong modeling skills and the ability to translate complex business questions into clear recommendations.
**Title and compensation to be determined based on candidate experience.**
**What you'll do:**
* **Own revenue planning and forecasting:** Build and maintain EvenUp's bottoms-up GTM model, connecting revenue targets to the underlying drivers of performance, including pipeline, win rates, deal size, quota attainment, sales capacity, ramp time, churn, and expansion. Translate company-level growth targets into detailed operating assumptions and forecasts.
* **Lead annual and quarterly planning:** Partner with Revenue Operations and GTM leadership to develop annual and quarterly plans across relevant departments. Evaluate what needs to be true across headcount, productivity, conversion, and retention to achieve our goals, identifying key assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
* **Drive strategic GTM analysis:** Lead analyses that inform how we structure and allocate our GTM resources, including territory design, customer segmentation, quota setting, capacity planning, and sales productivity. Develop recommendations that help leadership make informed tradeoffs as the business scales.
* **Evaluate business performance:** Analyze actual performance against plan, identify the underlying drivers of variances, and assess their implications for future results. Build scenarios and sensitivities to help leadership understand potential outcomes and determine where adjustments are needed.
* **Partner with GTM leadership:** Serve as a strategic thought partner to Revenue Operations and functional leaders, translating complex analyses into clear insights and recommendations. Help leaders pressure-test assumptions, evaluate investment decisions, and prioritize opportunities to improve revenue performance.
* **Strengthen planning methodologies:** Improve the models, assumptions, and analytical approaches used to plan and forecast the business. Partner with Finance, Data, and other cross-functional teams as needed to ensure planning is grounded in reliable data and reflects how EvenUp's GTM organization operates.
**What we look for:**
* **Relevant experience:** 10+ years of experience in Revenue Planning & Analytics, GTM Strategy & Planning, Strategic Finance, Sales Finance, Revenue Operations, or a related function, ideally at a high-growth B2B SaaS company.
* **Revenue modeling expertise:** You have built and owned a bottoms-up revenue forecast, sales capacity model, or comparable operating model. You understand how assumptions around pipeline, win rates, deal size, quota attainment, ramp time, churn, and expansion translate into business outcomes.
* **Strong analytical and quantitative skills:** You can build models from scratch, evaluate scenarios, pressure-test assumptions, and break down complex business questions into structured analyses. You are comfortable working with large datasets and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
* **GTM and SaaS business acumen:** You understand the drivers of revenue growth in a recurring-revenue business and how decisions around sales capacity, territory design, segmentation, quotas, and productivity affect performance.
* **Strategic problem-solving:** You can identify the right questions to investigate, determine what the data needs to show, and develop recommendations that help leaders make decisions about planning, resource allocation, and GTM strategy.
* **Cross-functional partnership:** You communicate analytical findings clearly and can work directly with senior stakeholders to challenge assumptions, align on plans, and influence decisions without relying on formal authority.
* **Ownership and execution:** You are comfortable operating in a fast-growing environment, managing ambiguous problems independently, and building planning models and processes that can evolve as the business scales.
**Benefits & Perks:**
As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:
* Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
* Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.
* Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.
* 10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.
* A home office stipend.
* 401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.
* Paid parental leave.
* A local in-person meet-up program.
* Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.
*(Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees)*
***Notice to Candidates:***
*To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our* *careers page**.*
*Please note that EvenUp may use AI notetakers and other recording devices in the recruiting process. If you interview with us, with your consent, we may record your conversations and summarize them into notes for internal use. Recording is optional, and declining will not affect your candidacy.*
*EvenUp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*
Compensation Range: $144,024 - $194,633
hard_gaps: 10+ years in revenue planning, GTM strategy or RevOps
Built and owned a bottoms-up revenue forecast or capacity model
Owned quota, territory and capacity planning analyses
flags: Staff-level pure planning and modeling role; his only capacity or quota evidence is one MBA case study.
Toronto hub and Canadian benefits suggest a possible Canada-based hire or later transfer route; worth confirming.
Legal-tech vertical SaaS echoes his LexisNexis background, a useful talking point despite the planning gap.
verdict: Excellent pivot-direction role at strong pay, but Staff-level, 10+ years of dedicated revenue-planning ownership is a screen he likely fails.

title: Director, EMEA Sales Operations

We're looking for a Director of EMEA Sales Operations to be the dedicated GTM Operations partner for our EMEA region. This role sits at the centre of EMEA's go-to-market motion, spanning New Logo, Growth, and Commercial/hybrid motions across a fast-growing, multi-country region.

Because EMEA spans many countries and time zones relative to global GTM Operations and Systems teams based in the US, this role requires someone who can operate with real autonomy, exercise judgment on what to escalate versus solve locally, and represent EMEA's specific needs (FSI and financial services-heavy Strategic accounts across UK/Ireland and DACH, multiple hybrid Commercial motions, territory splits across UK/Ireland, DACH, Nordics, and Southern Europe) back into Temporal's global GTM Operations function.
We're building a GTM Operations function that is AI-native from the ground up. We expect this leader to bring demonstrated experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis, surface insights, and scale operational work—not as a future aspiration, but as a core part of how they work today.
 Responsibilities 
Serve as the dedicated Sales Operations partner for EMEA, supporting New Logo, Growth, and Commercial/hybrid motions across the region, and knowing when to solve locally versus escalate to global GTM Operations or Systems.
Partner with the VP of EMEA and regional sales leadership to deliver actionable insights on net-new pipeline generation, account penetration, and territory design.
Own pipeline visibility and forecasting hygiene across all EMEA motions, including large complex enterprise deals, consumption workload ramps, and Commercial/self-serve pipeline.
Conduct white-space and TAM analysis to identify high-propensity targets across EMEA's markets, with particular attention to the region's concentration of financial services, banking, and fintech accounts.
Identify process gaps across the region's hunting, growth, and hybrid motions, and partner with GTM Systems to scope and implement automation—including AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort and increase regional coverage.
Analyse regional sales performance (win/loss, deal velocity, conversion, quota attainment) across segments, and translate findings into clear recommendations for the VP of EMEA and regional leaders; leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis and surface patterns at scale.

Support the region's full operating cadence: forecasting calls, QBRs, pipeline reviews, and account planning sessions, often prepping leadership with regional metrics ahead of cross-timezone reviews.

Evaluate new market entry and partner with regional GTM leadership on market expansion priorities, including coverage models and impacts to org design.
 Qualifications 
Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Field Operations supporting a B2B enterprise or strategic sales organization in technology or software.
Proven track record supporting multiple sales motions at once: net-new logo hunting, growth/expansion within existing accounts, and self-serve or hybrid AE-assisted motions.
 Demonstrated AI-native working style: hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Notion AI, or purpose-built GTM AI tools) to accelerate analysis, automate repeatable ops tasks, generate insights from large datasets, and improve the speed and quality of decision-making. We are not looking for theoretical familiarity—we want to see how AI is embedded in how you work today.
Deep experience across EMEA markets and fluency in the cultural and commercial similarities and differences across these markets.
Hands-on experience with building equitable territories, account scoring, quota allocation, and capacity modelling across a multi-country region.
Strong Salesforce expertise, including building scalable reports and dashboards across multiple sales motions and segments.
Highly analytical, with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable insights for regional sales leadership; comfortable pairing SQL, BI tools, and AI assistants to move faster and go deeper.
Strong cross-functional partner who can work effectively with regional sales and SA leadership, global GTM Operations, GTM Systems, and Marketing.
Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior regional and global leadership.
Able to operate both strategically and tactically depending on business needs.
 Bonus: experience operating in a consumption-based business, with a strong understanding of how usage impacts forecasting, pipeline, and quota planning for newly acquired and expanding accounts.

title: Sales Operations Analyst
description:
Reporting to the Senior Manager, Revenue Systems and Insights, the Sales Operations Analyst supports sales performance through effective process design, reporting, pipeline management, and Salesforce enablement. This role translates complex data into clear, actionable insights and provides hands-on-operational support to sellers, including troubleshooting related to pipeline management, forecasting, and order placement. The ideal candidate is highly project and service oriented, deeply data driven, and technically proficient in advanced Excel, Salesforce, and modern AI tools, with a strong focus on continuous improvement and scalable execution.
 Essential Functions
 Business Process
Partner with cross functional stakeholders to translate business needs into clear technical and operational requirements
Monitor and evaluate sales performance through analytics and reporting. Compile, analyze, and deliver sales data for internal leadership and investor reporting
Drive process design re-engineering and productivity initiatives that improve sales execution and scalability
Identify recurring issues across sales processes systems and data and implement practical solutions to streamline workflows and improve outcomes
Design build and maintain intermediate Excel based analytical tools including complex formulas pivot tables and Power Query Power Pivot to automate reporting and data preparation. Power BI experience is a requirement
Leverage AI tools to support data analysis trend identification anomaly detection summarization and insight generation with strong interest in applying Gemini Enterprise within enterprise analytics workflows

Support global sales forecasting and pipeline management by analyzing tracking and trending KPIs and sales metrics for leadership
Serve as a frontline operational partner to sellers providing hands on Salesforce support troubleshooting and guidance to enable accurate pipeline management forecasting and order placement
Act as a power user of Sales Operations tools including Salesforce.com , Gemini Enterprise, and related platforms

 Qualifications

2 plus years of experience in a Sales Operations Analyst, Sales Coordinator, or similar analytical role

title: Senior Staff GTM Communications Manager
description:
**Location**
------------
Toronto, ON; Austin, TX
**Employment Type**
-------------------
Full time
**Location Type**
-----------------
Hybrid
**Department**
--------------
GTM
***1Password is growing.*** *We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.*
**About 1Password**
*At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.*
*If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.*
As part of the Go To Market (GTM) Performance & Strategy team, you’ll turn company, product, market, and GTM priorities into clear narratives and high-impact communications for a global customer-facing organization. You’ll own core communications channels and key live experiences—including monthly all-hands, Sales Kickoff (SKO) programming, and new hire onboarding—helping teams understand what matters, why it matters, and how to act.
Your work will support 1Password’s mission to enable a safer, simpler digital future by strengthening clarity, alignment, and execution across the business. Reporting into the Sr Dir, Sales Performance & Strategy, this hybrid role is based in Austin, TX or Toronto, ON.
**How we’re using AI today**
Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.
**Expectations of this role** 
This is a hybrid role. You will be expected to work from 1Password's Toronto or Austin office 3 days per week, with the flexibility to work from the office up to 5 days based on business needs.
Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.
**What we're looking for:**
* Required: 8+ years of experience in Go To Market (GTM) communications, executive communications, sales or revenue enablement, strategic communications, or a related field.
* Exceptional writing, storytelling, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex business and product strategies into clear, compelling narratives.
* Experience partnering directly with senior executives on high-impact presentations, talking points, and organization-wide communications.
* Experience leading communications and programming for large-scale GTM forums such as Sales Kickoff, new hire onboarding, leadership meetings, or similar events.
* Strong understanding of Business-to-Business Software as a Service (B2B SaaS) organizations, including how partners, resellers, distributors, and service providers contribute to a go-to-market motion.
* Strong facilitation and presentation skills, including experience preparing and coaching senior presenters.
**Bonus points for:**
* Experience partnering with Product Management and Product Marketing to translate product strategy and positioning for customer-facing audiences, along with strong editorial judgment and operational rigor.
**What you can expect:**
* Own the strategy, narrative, editorial rhythm, and delivery of core GTM communications channels in partnership with GTM leadership.
* Translate company, product, market, channel, and GTM priorities into relevant communications tailored to different audiences.
* Lead monthly global GTM all-hands, including agenda and narrative development, content curation, presenter preparation, presentation development, and facilitation.
* Own the weekly GTM newsletter and short-form video update, synthesizing inputs, supporting message development, and maintaining a clear communications archive.
* Partner with executive and cross-functional leaders—including Product Management, Product Marketing, Channel, and Workplace Experience—to develop high-impact messaging.
* Lead the GTM communications and role-based breakout experience for Sales Kickoff, including session design, materials, presenter preparation, rehearsals, and speaker coaching.
* Own the GTM curriculum and facilitation for live new hire onboarding, using participant feedback and changing priorities to improve the experience over time.
USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $162,000 USD and $235,000 USD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.
Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $155,000 CAD and $225,000 CAD and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.
At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.
*This posting is for an existing vacancy.*
**Our culture** 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.
You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, *1Password is not for everyone*. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.
**How we work with AI**
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.
This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others. 
**Our approach to work**
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.
For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.
Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. 
**What we offer**
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:
*Health and wellbeing*
Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
Competitive health benefits
Generous PTO policy
*Growth and future* 
RSU program for most employees
Retirement matching program
Free 1Password account
*Community* 
Paid volunteer days
Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
Remote-first work environment
*\*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.*
**You belong here.**
*1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.*
*Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.*
*Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.*
*Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.*
*1Password uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, including natural language processing and predictive analytics, to assist in the initial screening of employment applications and improve our recruitment process. See* *here* *for the latest third party bias audit information. If you prefer not to have your application assessed using AI/ML features, you may opt out by completing* *this form**. For additional information see our* *Candidate Privacy Notice**.*

title: Sales Enablement & Pricing Manager
description:
We understand that the world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today, and that’s why we’re inspired to make A Better World for Pets. Antech is comprised of a diverse team of individuals who are committed to each other’s growth and development. Our culture is centered on our guiding philosophy, The Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom. Today Antech is driving the future of pet health as part of Mars Science & Diagnostics , a family-owned company focused on veterinary care.
Current Associates will need to apply through the internal career site. Please log into Workday and click on Menu or View All Apps, select the Jobs Hub app, then click the magnifying glass to Browse Jobs.
The Sales & Pricing Enablement Manager is responsible for driving commercial performance across Antech's EU & APAC markets through strategic pricing, commercial analytics, and sales enablement.
Operating within a matrix structure, this role acts as a commercial partner to Sales, Product Management, Marketing, and Finance. The position translates pricing, portfolio, and market data into actionable insights that support revenue growth, margin expansion, and competitive positioning.
The role is responsible for regional pricing strategy and analysis, ensuring pricing is managed consistently and supports both revenue and gross margin objectives. It also partners closely with sales teams, providing the tools, insights, and commercial guidance needed to win new business, retain customers, and grow existing accounts. Through a combination of strong analytical skills and commercial understanding, the Sales & Pricing Enablement Manager helps drive profitable growth across Antech's EU & APAC markets.
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** 
Pricing Strategy & Commercial Analysis
Conduct detailed analysis of list prices, customer-specific pricing, promotional effectiveness, rebates, and discount structures across the Antech portfolio to identify opportunities for revenue growth, margin expansion, and improved price realization.
Develop customer segmentation and profiling models to support differentiated pricing strategies, contract structures, and commercial offers.
Perform market research, competitor benchmarking, and pricing intelligence to ensure Antech remains competitively positioned while protecting profitability.
Analyze pricing elasticity, customer purchasing behaviour, and commercial performance trends to inform strategic pricing decisions.
Monitor customer profitability, lifetime value, and portfolio mix performance across key customer segments and markets.
Assess the commercial viability of new products, services, partnerships, and growth opportunities through pricing analysis, profitability modelling, and business case development.
Pricing Governance & Commercial Support
Own the governance, maintenance, and integrity of regional price lists, discount frameworks, pricing policies, and commercial terms.
Coordinate and implement annual list price increases, promotional campaigns, contractual pricing updates, and pricing harmonization initiatives across EU & APAC markets.
Support contract negotiations, pricing reviews, tenders, and customer-specific commercial discussions with Sales and Commercial Leadership teams.
Provide commercial recommendations and pricing approvals for strategic opportunities and large customer agreements.
Troubleshoot and resolve pricing-related issues raised by commercial teams.
Sales Enablement & Commercial Excellence
Develop and maintain commercial tools, calculators, templates, ROI models, and value-selling resources that enable sales teams to improve pricing discipline and deal profitability.
Support sales teams with pricing recommendations, deal structuring guidance, and commercial analysis for strategic opportunities.
Create and maintain sales enablement materials that improve understanding of pricing strategies, value propositions, competitive positioning, and commercial best practices.
Deliver training and coaching on pricing excellence, commercial acumen, value-based selling, and margin optimization.
Reporting, Analytics & Business Intelligence
Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reporting tools, and executive scorecards that provide visibility into pricing performance, revenue growth, gross margin delivery, discount utilization, contract compliance, and sales effectiveness.
Perform other pricing, commercial analytics, sales enablement, and strategic business projects as required. Education and Qualifications:
3+ years of successful experience in Strategic Revenue Management (SRM), commercial pricing analysis, sales operations, commercial finance, or business analytics.
Demonstrated experience managing pricing operations, price catalogues, customer discount strategies.
Proven success supporting multiple international markets and collaborating across matrixed cross-functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Operations).
2+ years of experience in Animal Health, Veterinary Diagnostics, Medical Devices, Pharmaceuticals, FMCG, or Life Sciences is strongly preferred.
Proven track record of developing customer-facing pricing simulators, calculators, and enablement tools that simplify complex data for frontline sales teams.
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Commercial Management, or a related field
Professional proficiency in English (written and verbal) is required for regional collaboration; fluency in another regional European language is a strong advantage.
Advanced expertise in Microsoft Excel
Hands-on proficiency with Power BI for designing and maintaining interactive commercial dashboards.
Experience with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and ERP / CPQ pricing engines.
**Commercial & Financial Acumen:** Solid understanding of P&L mechanics, price-volume-mix dynamics, margin protection, and commercial contracting principles.
Exceptional accuracy and organizational rigor in managing high-volume pricing requests and maintaining master price databases.
Strong communication skills with a proven ability to articulate complex financial/pricing concepts and data-driven stories clearly to non-analytical commercial partners.
Ability to uphold pricing governance and compliance firmly while maintaining a collaborative, solution-oriented partnership with sales leadership.
Self-starter with high accountability, agility, and enthusiasm for driving continuous commercial improvement across diverse growth markets
About Antech
Antech is a leader in veterinary diagnostics, driven by our passion for innovation that delivers better animal health outcomes. Our products and services span 90+ reference laboratories around the globe; in-house diagnostic laboratory instruments and consumables, including rapid assay diagnostic products and digital cytology services; local and cloud-based data services; practice information management software and related software and support; veterinary imaging and technology; veterinary professional education and training; and board-certified specialist support services.
Note to Search Firms/Agencies
Antech Diagnostics, Inc. and its subsidiaries and affiliates (Antech) do not compensate search firms for unsolicited assistance unless they have a written search agreement with Antech and the requisition is position-specific. Any resumes, curriculum vitae, and other unsolicited assistance from search firms that do not have a written search agreement or position-specific requisition submitted to any Associate of Antech will be deemed the sole property of Antech and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Antech.

title: RevOps Process Architect
description:
We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason. Our team solves critical network challenges for some of the world's largest organizations. In simple terms, we manage the systems that keep networks running smoothly, securely, and reliably—the backbone infrastructure that powers digital transformation for enterprises globally. Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.
But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.
We are seeking a RevOps Process Architect to define how our go-to-market engine should work and to make it ready for automation and AI. Reporting to the SVP, Revenue Operations, you will design the future-state processes, operating frameworks, and data standards that span Sales, Marketing, Channel, Customer Success, Renewals, Finance, and Professional Services, and translate them into implementation-ready requirements for our GTM Systems team.
 Responsibilities 
• Simplify, define, and document future-state processes across the revenue lifecycle before automating, with clear ownership, decision rules, and SLAs
• Own the process and knowledge library, structured so people and AI tools and agents can rely on it
• Define data standards and governance to resolve data integrity issues, and simplify CRM objects, fields, and tools across a complex GTM stack
• Identify and prioritize AI and automation opportunities, and design AI-ready workflows with human checkpoints and governance, building the foundation for a future GTM engineering function
• Define how customer and conversational data from sales and engagement tools flows into the CRM to power insights, reporting, and risk visibility
• Write business requirements and acceptance criteria for Salesforce, CPQ, and GTM tools, and support UAT and rollout
• Guide platform and tool evolution toward simplification, favoring out-of-the-box capabilities, and support tool rationalization across the GTM stack
• Define the intake and prioritization framework for process and system changes, design cross-functional changes, and drive adoption with Enablement
• Define KPIs with Analytics and monitor process performance and data quality
• Align senior stakeholders and drive change without direct authority
 Qualifications 
• 6–10+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Business Systems in a B2B SaaS company
• Track record of designing cross-functional GTM processes that were adopted and measured
• Working knowledge of Salesforce and CPQ, and the ability to write requirements that admins and developers can build from
• Hands-on experience applying AI or automation to GTM workflows
• Experience with data governance and process modeling (e.g., swim-lane, BPMN, RACI)
• Familiarity with the GTM tech stack and how data moves between systems
• Strong project and change management skills; comfortable influencing teams through change in a complex, fast-moving environment
• Strong facilitation, documentation, and change management skills
• Preferred: Salesforce Administrator, Business Analyst, or CPQ certification; interest in growing toward GTM engineering and AI agent development
This position offers a salary range of $160,000 - $185,000 USD per year plus participation in a discretionary bonus plan. Final compensation will be based on skills, experience, and qualifications. The role is for an existing vacancy.

title: Sales Enablement & Pricing Manager
description:
We understand that the world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today, and that’s why we’re inspired to make A Better World for Pets. Antech is comprised of a diverse team of individuals who are committed to each other’s growth and development. Our culture is centered on our guiding philosophy, The Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom. Today Antech is driving the future of pet health as part of Mars Science & Diagnostics , a family-owned company focused on veterinary care.
Current Associates will need to apply through the internal career site. Please log into Workday and click on Menu or View All Apps, select the Jobs Hub app, then click the magnifying glass to Browse Jobs.
The Sales & Pricing Enablement Manager is responsible for driving commercial performance across Antech's EU & APAC markets through strategic pricing, commercial analytics, and sales enablement.
Operating within a matrix structure, this role acts as a commercial partner to Sales, Product Management, Marketing, and Finance. The position translates pricing, portfolio, and market data into actionable insights that support revenue growth, margin expansion, and competitive positioning.
The role is responsible for regional pricing strategy and analysis, ensuring pricing is managed consistently and supports both revenue and gross margin objectives. It also partners closely with sales teams, providing the tools, insights, and commercial guidance needed to win new business, retain customers, and grow existing accounts. Through a combination of strong analytical skills and commercial understanding, the Sales & Pricing Enablement Manager helps drive profitable growth across Antech's EU & APAC markets.
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** 
Pricing Strategy & Commercial Analysis
Conduct detailed analysis of list prices, customer-specific pricing, promotional effectiveness, rebates, and discount structures across the Antech portfolio to identify opportunities for revenue growth, margin expansion, and improved price realization.
Develop customer segmentation and profiling models to support differentiated pricing strategies, contract structures, and commercial offers.
Perform market research, competitor benchmarking, and pricing intelligence to ensure Antech remains competitively positioned while protecting profitability.
Analyze pricing elasticity, customer purchasing behaviour, and commercial performance trends to inform strategic pricing decisions.
Monitor customer profitability, lifetime value, and portfolio mix performance across key customer segments and markets.
Assess the commercial viability of new products, services, partnerships, and growth opportunities through pricing analysis, profitability modelling, and business case development.
Pricing Governance & Commercial Support
Own the governance, maintenance, and integrity of regional price lists, discount frameworks, pricing policies, and commercial terms.
Coordinate and implement annual list price increases, promotional campaigns, contractual pricing updates, and pricing harmonization initiatives across EU & APAC markets.
Support contract negotiations, pricing reviews, tenders, and customer-specific commercial discussions with Sales and Commercial Leadership teams.
Provide commercial recommendations and pricing approvals for strategic opportunities and large customer agreements.
Troubleshoot and resolve pricing-related issues raised by commercial teams.
Sales Enablement & Commercial Excellence
Develop and maintain commercial tools, calculators, templates, ROI models, and value-selling resources that enable sales teams to improve pricing discipline and deal profitability.
Support sales teams with pricing recommendations, deal structuring guidance, and commercial analysis for strategic opportunities.
Create and maintain sales enablement materials that improve understanding of pricing strategies, value propositions, competitive positioning, and commercial best practices.
Deliver training and coaching on pricing excellence, commercial acumen, value-based selling, and margin optimization.
Reporting, Analytics & Business Intelligence
Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reporting tools, and executive scorecards that provide visibility into pricing performance, revenue growth, gross margin delivery, discount utilization, contract compliance, and sales effectiveness.
Perform other pricing, commercial analytics, sales enablement, and strategic business projects as required. Education and Qualifications:
3+ years of successful experience in Strategic Revenue Management (SRM), commercial pricing analysis, sales operations, commercial finance, or business analytics.
Demonstrated experience managing pricing operations, price catalogues, customer discount strategies.
Proven success supporting multiple international markets and collaborating across matrixed cross-functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Operations).
2+ years of experience in Animal Health, Veterinary Diagnostics, Medical Devices, Pharmaceuticals, FMCG, or Life Sciences is strongly preferred.
Proven track record of developing customer-facing pricing simulators, calculators, and enablement tools that simplify complex data for frontline sales teams.
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Commercial Management, or a related field
Professional proficiency in English (written and verbal) is required for regional collaboration; fluency in another regional European language is a strong advantage.
Advanced expertise in Microsoft Excel
Hands-on proficiency with Power BI for designing and maintaining interactive commercial dashboards.
Experience with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and ERP / CPQ pricing engines.
**Commercial & Financial Acumen:** Solid understanding of P&L mechanics, price-volume-mix dynamics, margin protection, and commercial contracting principles.
Exceptional accuracy and organizational rigor in managing high-volume pricing requests and maintaining master price databases.
Strong communication skills with a proven ability to articulate complex financial/pricing concepts and data-driven stories clearly to non-analytical commercial partners.
Ability to uphold pricing governance and compliance firmly while maintaining a collaborative, solution-oriented partnership with sales leadership.
Self-starter with high accountability, agility, and enthusiasm for driving continuous commercial improvement across diverse growth markets
About Antech
Antech is a leader in veterinary diagnostics, driven by our passion for innovation that delivers better animal health outcomes. Our products and services span 90+ reference laboratories around the globe; in-house diagnostic laboratory instruments and consumables, including rapid assay diagnostic products and digital cytology services; local and cloud-based data services; practice information management software and related software and support; veterinary imaging and technology; veterinary professional education and training; and board-certified specialist support services.
Note to Search Firms/Agencies
Antech Diagnostics, Inc. and its subsidiaries and affiliates (Antech) do not compensate search firms for unsolicited assistance unless they have a written search agreement with Antech and the requisition is position-specific. Any resumes, curriculum vitae, and other unsolicited assistance from search firms that do not have a written search agreement or position-specific requisition submitted to any Associate of Antech will be deemed the sole property of Antech and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Antech.

title: Sales Operations Planning Analyst
