title: Spécialiste bilingue des opérations des ventes / Bilingual Sales Operations Specialist
description:
Dans une entreprise de distribution B2B générant plusieurs milliards de dollars de revenus, l’accélération des ventes est bien plus qu’un simple concept à la mode : c’est un véritable avantage concurrentiel.
 Le ou la Spécialiste des opérations des ventes occupe un rôle stratégique et essentiel, conçu pour des professionnels performants qui allient réflexion stratégique, rigueur opérationnelle et sens des affaires. Vous travaillerez à travers l’ensemble de l’écosystème des ventes, notamment avec les représentants des ventes externes, les spécialistes techniques, les équipes de développement des affaires et des marques exclusives, afin de permettre aux équipes de vente d’être plus efficaces, de conclure davantage d’opportunités et de mieux servir nos clients.
Il ne s’agit pas d’un rôle de soutien administratif traditionnel. Vous serez un moteur de croissance proactif, guidé par les données, capable de créer des liens entre les équipes des ventes, du marketing, de la gestion de catégories, du service à la clientèle, des comptes recevables et de l’analytique. Qu’il s’agisse de simplifier des processus complexes, d’éliminer des obstacles ou de concrétiser des stratégies intelligentes, vous serez un partenaire d’exécution incontournable permettant d’assurer la fluidité du pipeline des ventes et l’efficacité de l’équipe.
Chez Bunzl , nous misons sur l’excellence opérationnelle, l’exécution numérique et une approche centrée sur le client. Si vous êtes passionné par l’optimisation des ventes, motivé par la résolution de problèmes et enthousiaste à l’idée de constater l’impact concret de votre travail sur les revenus et la satisfaction de la clientèle, cette opportunité est faite pour vous.
 Responsabilités principales
 À titre de Partenaire en accélération des ventes , vous agirez comme pilier stratégique et opérationnel de l’équipe des ventes, en veillant à ce que les opportunités progressent plus rapidement, que les données soient exploitables et que les représentants demeurent concentrés sur les clients.
Votre rôle s’articulera autour de cinq grands volets :
 Optimisation des ventes et accélération des opportunités
Collaborer avec les équipes de vente afin de faire progresser les opportunités tout au long du processus de vente, de la qualification jusqu’à la conclusion.
Analyser les données du pipeline dans le CRM afin de comprendre l’étape de vente, la valeur des opportunités et leur alignement stratégique.
Participer aux séances de planification des ventes afin d’aligner les stratégies, les enjeux des clients et les leviers de valeur.
Fournir des analyses basées sur les études de marché, l’intelligence concurrentielle et les données clients.
Demander et gérer les informations produits, les exceptions tarifaires et le soutien des fournisseurs.
Élaborer des modèles de coûts et préparer les dossiers de tarification pour approbation interne.
Cartographier les interactions du parcours client afin d’identifier les points de friction, améliorer l’engagement et favoriser la conversion.
Concevoir du matériel de vente professionnel et adapté aux besoins internes et externes.
 Analyse de données et intelligence client
Analyser les activités du pipeline et les données clients afin de mettre en évidence les risques et les opportunités.
Créer et maintenir des organigrammes clients afin de soutenir la planification stratégique des comptes.
Développer des tableaux de bord, des prévisions et des rapports de synthèse offrant des informations claires et exploitables aux parties prenantes.
Utiliser les outils de Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Power BI, Dynamics CRM et les plateformes d’automatisation pour soutenir la prise de décision basée sur les données.
Relier les informations provenant de différentes plateformes afin de favoriser des approches de vente personnalisées.
Soumettre les prévisions et données d’utilisation des nouveaux produits à l’équipe des achats.
 Soutien opérationnel et optimisation des processus
Collaborer avec les équipes de gestion de catégories et de chaîne d’approvisionnement afin d’identifier des SKU ou de lancer la création de nouveaux produits.
Coordonner les demandes d’échantillons et les refacturations aux fournisseurs afin de contrôler les coûts et respecter les échéances.
Préparer les dossiers de révision des prix et gérer les soumissions tarifaires officielles.
Soutenir l’équipe des comptes recevables lors de l’ouverture de nouveaux comptes clients en recueillant les renseignements manquants et en facilitant la résolution rapide des dossiers en suspens.
Assurer l’exactitude des fichiers de prix et d’articles afin de garantir l’intégrité des soumissions et des commandes.
Effectuer le suivi des demandes jusqu’à leur résolution complète tout en éliminant les ambiguïtés dans les processus.
Identifier les inefficacités et mettre en œuvre des solutions visant à optimiser l’exécution.
 Soutien administratif et commercial
Rédiger et réviser les ententes de prix, contrats et autres documents commerciaux.
Surveiller les demandes en cours et les échéances, puis effectuer les suivis nécessaires afin d’assurer leur réalisation.
Maintenir une documentation centralisée et organisée des interactions clients, des ententes et de la documentation commerciale.
Configurer les programmes de ristournes clients conformément aux ententes commerciales établies.
Assurer le suivi du cycle de vie des contrats, de la demande initiale jusqu’à l’exécution et au renouvellement.
Veiller au respect des politiques internes, des exigences des clients et des normes d’audit.
Préparer des sommaires destinés à la direction, des présentations d’approbation et des dossiers de validation afin de soutenir la conclusion des ventes.
 Collaboration interfonctionnelle et relation clientèle
Agir comme principal point de liaison entre les équipes des ventes, du marketing, des produits, du service à la clientèle, des comptes recevables, de la gestion de catégories et de l’analytique.
Faciliter les transferts internes et la livraison efficace des engagements envers les clients.
Intervenir de façon proactive afin de clarifier les besoins, résoudre les obstacles et maintenir la confiance des clients.
Identifier les points de friction et contribuer activement à l’amélioration continue des outils, des processus et des méthodes de travail.
 Qualifications
 Formation
 Diplôme collégial ou universitaire en administration des affaires, ventes, marketing ou dans un domaine connexe.
 Expérience
 Minimum de trois (3) années d’expérience en opérations des ventes, soutien aux ventes ou analyse d’affaires, idéalement dans un environnement B2B. Une expérience dans le secteur de la distribution constitue un atout.
 Compétences techniques
 La maîtrise des applications Microsoft Office (Excel, Word et PowerPoint), de Power BI, de Dynamics CRM et des plateformes d’automatisation est fortement valorisée.
 Compétences et aptitudes recherchées
 Vision stratégique : Comprend comment les activités quotidiennes contribuent aux objectifs d’affaires à long terme.
 Esprit analytique : À l’aise avec l’analyse approfondie des données afin d’en dégager des recommandations concrètes.
 Excellentes aptitudes en communication : Capable d’adapter son message à différents auditoires, des représentants sur le terrain jusqu’à la haute direction.
 Résolution de problèmes : Aborde les défis avec curiosité, calme et méthode.
 Souci du détail : Veille à l’exactitude et au suivi rigoureux dans un environnement rapide et exigeant.
 Orientation client : Cherche constamment à créer de la valeur pour les clients internes et externes.
 Esprit collaboratif : Développe des relations de confiance et contribue à la réussite collective.
 Indicateurs de performance
 Le Succès Dans Ce Rôle Sera Mesuré Par Votre Capacité à Accroître La Rapidité, La Clarté Et L’efficacité Du Processus De Vente :
Vélocité des opportunités : Réduction du délai entre la création d’une opportunité et sa conclusion.
Efficacité du soutien aux ventes : Rapidité et précision dans la préparation des soumissions ainsi que satisfaction des partenaires internes.
Impact client : Commentaires positifs des clients et amélioration de leur engagement.
Excellence opérationnelle : Amélioration de la qualité des données du pipeline, de l’efficacité des processus et de leur adoption.
Retour sur investissement des outils d’aide à la vente : Hausse de l’utilisation et de l’efficacité des outils, modèles et ressources commerciales.
 Pourquoi se joindre à nous?
 Bunzl Canada Inc. fournit les emballages alimentaires et de détail, les produits et équipements d’entretien et d’hygiène, ainsi que les fournitures de sécurité et industrielles qui permettent à plus de 58 000 entreprises canadiennes de fonctionner efficacement chaque jour.
Nous offrons à nos clients les avantages d’un approvisionnement mondial, de l’innovation produit et d’une présence nationale, combinés à un service local réactif et à une expertise approfondie de nos catégories de produits.
 Bunzl Canada est certifiée Great Place to Work® et s’engage à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif, équitable et positif où chaque employé peut développer un fort sentiment d’appartenance tout en évoluant tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel.
Bunzl Canada est une filiale opérationnelle de Bunzl plc (BNZL.L) , une société du FTSE 100 inscrite à la Bourse de Londres. Avec plus de 27 000 employés dans plus de 30 pays , notre présence mondiale s’étend aux Amériques, à l’Europe, à l’Asie-Pacifique ainsi qu’au Royaume-Uni et à l’Irlande.
 Chez Bunzl, le potentiel est illimité… Votre carrière. Notre avenir!
 Bunzl Canada souscrit au principe de l’égalité des chances en emploi. Notre politique consiste à attirer et retenir les personnes les plus qualifiées, sans égard à la race, la couleur, la religion, l’origine nationale, le sexe ou le genre (y compris la grossesse), l’orientation sexuelle, l’âge, le handicap ou le statut d’ancien combattant, conformément aux lois applicables.
In a multi-billion-dollar B2B distribution business, sales acceleration is more than a buzzword — it is a competitive advantage. The Sales Operations Specialist is a mission-critical role built for high-performing professionals who blend strategic thinking, operational precision, and commercial insight. You will operate across the entire sales ecosystem — from Outside Sales and Technical Specialists to Business Development and Own Brand teams — ensuring every seller is empowered to move faster, win more, and serve customers better.

If you are enthusiastic about sales enablement, obsessed with problem-solving, and excited to see the tangible impact of your work on revenue and customer success – this is your opportunity to lead from the center.
 Key Responsibilities
 As a Sales Acceleration Partner, you will function as the strategic operations backbone for the sales team — ensuring deals move faster, data is actionable, and sellers stay focused on customers. Your work spans five core areas:
 Sales Enablement & Deal Acceleration
 You will fuel deal momentum through hands-on, tactical execution across the sales cycle
 Partner with selling teams to advance opportunities through the qualify to close selling process
Review CRM pipeline data to understand stage, deal size, and strategic fit
Join sales planning sessions to align on strategy, customer pain points, and key value drivers
Contribute insights from market research, competitive intel, and customer data
Request and manage product information, pricing exceptions, and vendor support
Build cost models and compile pricing packages for internal review and approval
Map customer journey touchpoints to spot friction, improve engagement, and drive conversion
Create polished, purpose-built sales materials for internal and external use
 Data Analysis & Customer Insights
 You will turn raw data into actionable insights that support smarter selling:
Analyze pipeline activity, and customer data to highlight risks and opportunities
Create and maintain customer organizational charts to support strategic account planning.
Develop dashboards, forecasts, and data summaries to provide stakeholders with clear, actionable data
Leverage reporting tools including Microsoft Office Applications: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Power BI, CRM - Dynamics, and automation platforms to support data-driven decision-making.
Connect insights across platforms to support personalized selling approaches
Submit new item usage and forecasts to the purchasing team
 Operational Support & Workflow Optimization
 You will take charge of optimizing operational processes, ensuring deals stay on track and progress efficiently:
Partner with Category and Supply Chain teams to source SKUs or initiate new item creation
Coordinate product sample requests and vendor bill-backs to manage costs and meet delivery timelines
Prepare pricing review packages and manage formal pricing submissions
Support Accounts Receivable by collecting missing customer information during New Customer setup and facilitating timely resolution of outstanding issues
Ensure part and price file accuracy to support quoting and order integrity
Track requests through completion and eliminate ambiguity in workflows
Identify inefficiencies and implement solutions to streamline execution
 Administrative & Commercial Support 
 You will ensure sales teams stay organized, compliant, and focused:
Draft and review pricing agreements, contracts, and other commercial documents
Monitor open requests and deadlines, following up to ensure completion and accountability
Maintain organized, centralized records of customer interactions, agreements, and sales documentation
Establish customer rebate based on trade agreements in the system
Track and manage contract lifecycles — from initial request to execution and renewal
Ensure all documentation complies with internal policies, customer requirements, and audit standards
Prepare executive-ready summaries, approval decks, or sign-off packages to support deal closure
 Cross-Functional & Customer Collaboration
 You will serve as a communication bridge and problem-solver across teams and with customers:
Function as a key liaison between Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Service, Accounts Receivable, Category Management, and Data teams.
Facilitate smooth internal handoffs and customer deliverables
Proactively step in to clarify requirements, resolve blockers, and preserve customer confidence
Escalate friction points and co-lead efforts to improve tools, processes, and execution
 Qualifications

 Diploma or degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
 Experience: 
 Minimum 3 years in a sales operations, sales enablement, or business analysis role, preferably within a B2B environment. Experience in a distribution environment an asset.
 Technical Skills:
 Experience with Microsoft Office Applications: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Power BI, CRM - Dynamics, and automation platforms are highly valued.
 Skills & Competencies
 Strategic Thinker: You see how tactical work connects to long-term business goals.

 Collaborative: You build trust and make your teammates better through partnership
 Performance Metrics

 What would make you stand out

Domain knowledge in contact centres, CX or conversational AI.

Why you should join us

title: Senior Director, Revenue Operations

 Responsibilities 
 Revenue Strategy & Operating Model

 Strategic Projects

 Requirements

● Experience supporting a B2B enterprise sales organization.
● Strong understanding of CRM systems and revenue technology.
● Demonstrated experience building and managing forecasting, pipeline management, reporting, and revenue analytics processes.
● Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
● Excellent communication and presentation skills.
● Ability to translate complex data into clear recommendations for executives.
● Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
● Adhere to all organizational information security policies and protect all sensitive information including but not limited to ePHI and PHI in accordance with organizational policy and Federal, State, and local regulations.
 Even Better 
● Experience in healthcare technology, SaaS, AI, or enterprise software.
● Experience selling to health systems, hospitals, health plans, or other healthcare organizations.
● Experience with long, complex enterprise sales cycles.
● Experience with Salesforce or another leading enterprise CRM.
● Experience building Revenue Operations functions within a growing company.
● Familiarity with SaaS metrics and financial concepts including ARR, ACV, NRR, GRR, CAC, LTV, pipeline coverage, bookings, and revenue forecasting.
 About GW RhythmX 
GW RhythmX is revolutionizing healthcare through connected, AI-native intelligence that unites clinical insight, patient engagement, and system-wide care orchestration. The company combines market-leading AI precision care technology with extensive trusted patient engagement leadership to help health systems deliver the right care, at the right time, through the right clinician and channel. Its solutions are deployed across more than 150 health systems, touching more than 85M patients including 8M U.S. military veterans. The company's award-winning solutions were recognized again in 2024 by KLAS Research, Fierce Healthcare, and AVIA Marketplace. A SymphonyAI Group company, GW RhythmX leverages various firm assets, including $1B+ in R&D investment, longitudinal data related to 300 million patients, 4.4 billion total annual claims, and 1.8 million healthcare professionals at more than 3,000 facilities globally. 
 Most relevant press releases:

SAIGroup companies ConcertAI, SymphonyAI, and GW RhythmX deliver AI solutions that transform industries and bring value to companies, workers, healthcare professionals, and patients. The companies collectively represent a workforce of more than 4,000 talented engineers, data scientists and industry/healthcare experts. SAIGroup is backed by a $1 billion commitment from Founder and CEO Dr. Romesh Wadhwani, a noted entrepreneur and philanthropist. Learn more at www.saigroup.ai and follow SAIGroup on LinkedIn.

title: Director of Revenue Operations
description:
Join the ACI Learning Adventure! 
Our Mission
Welcome to a new era of learning, where individuals and organizations come to transform goals into measurable success. At ACI Learning, we believe that anything worth doing is worth leading the way—with innovation, exceptional experiences, and impactful results.
We provide a full ecosystem of learning and development solutions that empower people and businesses to lead with confidence, learn with purpose, and achieve outcomes that matter. Join us, and together, we'll shape the future of skill-building and professional growth.
The ACI Team
Imagine collaborating with over 200 of the brightest minds who are passionate, grounded, and dedicated to shaping the future of eLearning. Together, we're not just a team; we're a movement in one of the most exciting times in tech.
Purpose-Driven Culture
At ACI Learning, work isn’t just a job. It’s a passion we pour into every project, every day. We celebrate creativity, innovation, and the joy of doing what we love.
Your Opportunity
Are you ready to be part of something transformative? Dive into a world of collaboration, growth, and endless potential. Apply now and help lead the change!
 Who We Are 
ACI Learning is a leading provider of audit, cybersecurity and IT training solutions, empowering individuals and organizations worldwide to improve their technical capabilities and their cybersecurity with compelling and comprehensive training. Our leadership position extends even further to our new SaaS Learning Platform myACI that goes beyond audit, cyber and IT training to provide organizational and individual knowledge assessment, analytics and training delivery with integrated AI to understand capabilities and skill gaps for organizations.
Our revenue engine has grown faster than the systems and standards behind it. We need someone who has built a RevOps function before and wants to do it again. You’ll own how we plan, forecast, sell, retain, and pay for revenue, and you’ll be the person leadership trusts to tell them what the numbers mean. This is a senior, hands-on role with no direct reports. You’ll get into the work yourself.
What You'll Do
You’ll lead Revenue Operations across the full revenue lifecycle, from pipeline to renewal. That covers planning, forecasting, process standards, GTM tech adoption, territory and compensation design, and the analysis that helps leadership make confident decisions. You’ll run weekly pipeline reviews, make sure reps follow our sales process and keep CRM data clean, and work with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success so our documented process matches what actually happens.
Set and enforce the operating standards for Sales and Customer Success, from ICP alignment and seller activity to opportunity qualification and pipeline management.
Own revenue forecasting and pipeline health reporting, and turn the data into clear analysis of how the business is performing.
Own our core SaaS metrics and their definitions: ARR, GRR, NRR, churn, expansion, CAC, LTV, and pipeline coverage.
Build board-ready revenue reporting with Finance.
Own renewal forecasting, churn and expansion reporting, and the Sales-to-CS handoffs that drive NRR.
Own the end-to-end revenue process from lead to renewal. Define how we sell, qualify, and retain, build those standards into our systems, and fix execution where it breaks down.
Work with Marketing on lead scoring, routing, and lifecycle stages. Set data hygiene standards for Salesforce and HubSpot and hold the team to them.
Build an attribution model that Sales and Marketing both trust.
Partner with our VP of Enterprise Applications so our stack (Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach) reflects how we sell and is fully adopted. You’re accountable for the team getting value from the tools, not for building or owning the systems.
Put AI and automation to work across forecasting, deal inspection, account research, and reporting, with the goal of giving reps time back.
Build annual territory, quota, and headcount models with Sales, Customer Success, and Finance.
Design variable comp for every quota-carrying role, including AEs, BDRs, and CSMs. Set pay mix and OTE, design plan mechanics, and weight new logo, expansion, and renewal so the plan pays for the revenue we want.
Model plan cost and payout scenarios, produce clear plan documents with Finance, own commission calculations and dispute resolution, and track attainment and comp cost of sale.
What You'll Need (Requirements)
10+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a similar function, as the senior RevOps owner in a high-growth SaaS or recurring revenue business.
Experience building a RevOps function from scratch.
Experience supporting a business in the $25M to $100M ARR range with combined Sales and CS teams of 20 or more.
Deep familiarity with SaaS unit economics (ARR, NRR, churn, CAC, LTV) and experience building revenue reporting around them.
Deep, working knowledge of Salesforce and HubSpot, and a clear sense of how to use them to improve the lead journey, sales stages, and handoff to Customer Success.
Experience designing and modeling variable comp plans for Sales and CS teams. You understand pay mix, quota, and accelerators, and you can defend a plan to both leadership and the field.
The ability to turn complex data into a clear story for an executive audience.
Experience with both high-velocity SMB sales motions and enterprise and channel motions, and an understanding of how their operational needs differ.
A track record of influencing across functions without direct authority.
What We'd Like You To Have
Salesforce Certified Administrator credential (strongly preferred). It tells us you get into the system yourself instead of directing others to do it.
Higher education or edtech experience, including forecasting by adoption cycle and term, not just ARR.
Comfort building things that don’t fully exist yet. Much of what this role needs is still to be created.
At ACI Learning, we offer a competitive, experience-driven salary range that aligns with your qualifications and contributions. To that end, the posted salary range reflects our most reasonable assumption of pay for this position at the time of posting.
Pay range
 $151,100 — $175,300 USD 
 Why ACI Learning is Your Next Big Move 
 For Full-Time, Benefits Eligible Positions 
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage—starting the 1st of the month after your hire date.
Four weeks of paid parental or medical leave, so you can focus on what matters most.
Flexible PTO policy, sick time, and eight paid holidays — because we believe in balance.
401(k) retirement plan so you can invest in your future from day one.
One free course each year after 90 days — advancing your skills is part of the job.
Tuition assistance to support your continued education and professional growth.

title: Commercial Operations Specialist
description:
About the role 
 Flexible on location (ideally can travel to either London, Cheltenham or Wakefield office) 
 The Commercial Operations Team will bring together renewals, sales support and commercial administration into a single specialist, customer facing function. 
 The team will support sales in all areas of the sales cycle, reducing the amount of time being spent on administrative tasks. Its purpose is not to replace sales, it’s to work alongside sales, in partnership, enabling sales to sell more efficiently and effectively. 
 Maximise the time sales spend selling, removing administrative burdens. 
 Proactive management of renewals and commercial opportunities. 
 Provide exceptional commercial/sales support to customers. 
 Improve consistency across relevant commercial processes. 
 Provide accurate commercial reporting and insight. 
 Engage customers directly to retain with better commercial offers when cease requests are received. 
 Continually improve commercial efficiency through process improvement/automation. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 The Commercial Operations Specialist will be a multi-skilled individual, supporting sales to perform key aspects of the sales cycle. These include renewals, sales support and commercial administration. 
 Renewals 
 Working alongside sales to manage the end-to-end customer renewals process 
 Proactively tracking customer renewals (planning & reporting) 
 Create renewals packs for customers (identify upsell opportunities) 
 Engage with vendors for the best commercial offer 
 Contract analysis & pricing validation 
 Process renewals directly or provide the AM with the details 
 Supporting renewals campaigns 
 Knowledge of renewals across all products (including Mitel and Avaya) 
 Following up on cease requests, contacting customers to take every action to prevent customer churn 
 Process renewals in the system (e.g. updating billing dates in aBILLity or “resigning” with a supplier) 
 Sales Support 
 Interacting with customers to manage customer queries/issues 
 Managing customer quote requests (e.g. negotiating around internal teams for product spec/pricing etc.) 
 Finalising supplier pricing 
 Producing and checking/managing customer opportunities/deals in hubspot 
 Creating & sharing commercial proposals with customers 
 Completing customer order forms 
 Sharing customer contracts and managing contract queries 
 Using Clevr360 to create sales review packs for customers, at sales request 
 Commercial Operations 
 CRM governance/reporting – owning the data related to renewals & sales support 
 Sales forecast support 
 Provide commercial insights from customer interactions 
 Campaign administration 
 What the Team Does Not Own 
 Account ownership 
 Commercial negotiations with customers 
 Technical pre-sales 
 Project delivery 
 Operational support, however, will be expected to liaise with other teams to support customer queries rather than simply handing off responsibility 
 Success Measures 
 The Commercial Operations Team will be governed by the following success measures - 
 Increased selling time for Account Managers, through reduced administrative burden. 
 Improved visibility of renewals; upcoming, completed, pillars, values etc. 
 Improved renewal conversation (lower customer churn). 
 Improved customer engagement; faster quote turnaround & response times. 
 Improved CRM data quality in relevant areas. 
 Greater commercial consistency across renewals and sales support. 
 About CloudClevr 
 Our vision is simple: a world where technology helps you to achieve your technology goals with the confidence that outcomes will be achieved and a return on investment will be delivered. Where you have a clear, measurable technology roadmap, transparency on performance and trust in the security of your technology estate. 
 Our mission is to increase confidence in technology transformation and remove doubt and uncertainty through our technology expertise, our partnerships with our customers and through Clevr360, our unique software platform. 
 Our carefully curated, world-class solutions boost collaboration, productivity and customer satisfaction. We work with you in partnership to ensure our services meet your specific needs. We call this our Customer Technology Partnership. 
 Our differentiation comes from technology but also in the way we work with our customers, the results we deliver, the commitment we show and the continued investment in our team’s expertise across our technology practices.

title: Manager, Customer Success, International
description:
Be part of the team that defends the networks the world depends on 
Corelight defends the world’s most sensitive networks—from global commerce to national defense—quietly, relentlessly, and with resolve. As cyber threats grow faster and smarter, we serve as the trusted force behind network resilience, putting elite defense within reach.
By transforming digital footprints from physical, virtual, and cloud networks into actionable insights, we empower defenders to illuminate blind spots and stay ahead of an evolving threat landscape. Built on open-source innovations and fueled by industry leading agentic AI technology, Corelight helps teams to detect advanced threats and close cases with unprecedented clarity and precision.
 About the Role 
Corelight is looking for an experienced Customer Success leader to lead our International Customer Success organization, supporting customers across markets outside the United States. This leader will be responsible for building a consistent, outcome-driven customer success practice while recognizing the different market dynamics, customer expectations, and partner relationships across regions. You'll lead and develop a geographically distributed team, strengthen strategic customer relationships, and partner with regional Sales, Technical Account Management, Renewals, and other teams to drive adoption, retention, and long-term customer value.
The ideal candidate brings global leadership experience, strong commercial judgment, and the ability to build scalable practices without losing the flexibility required to serve customers across diverse markets.
 What You'll Do 
Lead, coach, and develop an internationally distributed Customer Success team, establishing consistent expectations and performance standards.
Develop and execute regional customer success strategies aligned to Corelight's global priorities and local market requirements.
Drive measurable customer value, adoption, retention, and long-term account health across international customer portfolios.
Establish a consistent customer engagement model while adapting execution to regional business practices, partner ecosystems, and customer needs.
Build and maintain executive relationships with strategic enterprise customers across international markets.
Partner with regional Sales and Renewals leaders to identify customer risks, strengthen renewal readiness, and support account growth.
Coordinate with TAM, Professional Services, Support, and regional partners to deliver a consistent post-sales customer experience.
Develop visibility into customer health, engagement, adoption, and retention performance across regions.
Identify recurring customer challenges and regional differences that should inform global customer success strategy.
Establish effective team operating rhythms, coaching practices, and cross-regional collaboration.
Help shape Corelight's global Customer Success operating model and support the development of a scalable international organization.
 What You'll Bring 
7+ years of experience in Customer Success, strategic account management, or a related post-sales function within enterprise technology.
3+ years of people leadership experience, including managing teams across multiple countries or regions.
Demonstrated experience supporting international enterprise customers, ideally across EMEA and/or APAC.
Proven ability to drive customer adoption, retention, and measurable business outcomes.
Strong commercial judgment and experience partnering with regional Sales and Renewals teams.
Experience operating across different cultures, time zones, and customer engagement models.
Ability to establish scalable processes while adapting to regional market requirements.
Familiarity with cybersecurity, network security, cloud infrastructure, or similarly complex enterprise technologies.
Experience navigating channel and partner-led customer relationships.
Strong communication, executive relationship management, and cross-functional leadership skills.
 Why Join Us? 
Fueled by investments from top-tier venture capital organizations such as Crowdstrike, Accel and Insight, Corelight is one of the fastest growing network detection and response platforms in the industry. Our passionate team thrives in a collaborative, inclusive, and geographically distributed culture. We embrace diverse perspectives, neurodiversity, curiosity and low ego results - fostering an environment where every innovator can solve the toughest challenges in cybersecurity and contribute their best work.
We are looking forward to meeting you. Check us out at www.corelight.com

title: Customer Success Lead
description:
Cambio is growing rapidly and looking for a Customer Success Lead to build and head our best-in-class customer success program. As Cambio’s Customer Success Lead, you will own the end-to-end experience for our enterprise real estate customers. You will be responsible for ensuring that our customers derive maximum value from our platform by overseeing the customer journey, working with our Customer Success team to address customer needs, and driving our platform’s integration with quantitative reporting processes. Your role is crucial in ensuring customer satisfaction, retention, and growth.
**What you will be doing**
* **Customer Relationship Ownership:** Serve as the primary point of contact for our enterprise customers and own their end-to-end experience with Cambio platform. Proactively engage with customers to understand their needs, customer goals, and opportunities for expansion. relationships with enterprise customers, acting as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor.
* **Quality Assurance Management**: Lead the customer success and data quality assurance teams in ensuring proactive anomaly checking and remediation in order to drive a 10/10 data quality assurance process.
* **Driving Customer Onboarding:** Manage the Customer Success team to onboard new customers onto the Cambio platform, ensuring a smooth transition to Cambio and providing training on our product. Improve our best-in-class onboarding program to increase speed of value creation, and support customers in driving adoption among team members.
* **Quantitative Reporting:** Own customer processes with platform-integrated sustainability reporting, such as GRESB, TCFD, CDP, etc. Enable customers to integrate data and utilize the Cambio platform for these reporting processes, and track & relay customer experience feedback to Cambio’s product team to improve the platform over time.
* **Owning Customer Metrics:** Such as time to onboarding completion, number of properties on Cambio, user metrics, and other critical measures of customer success.
* **Owning and Improving Customer NPS:** Deliver customer value to improve NPS and ensure customer retention, tailoring customer use of the platform to their unique goals and objectives.
* **Cross-Functional / GTM Collaboration:** Work closely with sales, product, and engineering teams to manage customer deliverables such as pilots and demos.
* **Customer Advocacy:** Serve as the voice of the customer within Cambio, advocating for customer needs and collaborating with product and engineering teams to drive improvements.
* **Retention and Growth:** Develop strategies to ensure customer retention and identify opportunities for account growth and upsell.
**Impact**
In this role, you will achieve the following key accomplishments in your first 12-18 months:
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with enterprise customers, leading to high customer satisfaction and retention rates.
* Lead and scale Cambio’s customer success team to deliver consistent, high-quality support to all customers.
* Enable customer integration with Cambio for quantitative reporting processes that drive annual sustainability and financial compliance for customers.
* Increase customer onboarding speed, customer NPS, and other critical customer metrics by building upon Cambio’s in-platform onboarding program.
* Manage delivery of critical customer pilots to help driving closing of new customers.
* Drive successful customer renewals and identify opportunities for expansion within existing accounts.
**Qualifications**
* **5+ years of experience** in customer success, account management, or a related field, with specifically 2+ years of experience working with customers on climate / sustainability reporting.
* **Real estate / buildings experience:** Familiarity with building energy benchmarking, real estate reporting metrics, and / or other energy-related experience.
* **Quantitative Skills:** Strong analytical skills with the ability to create, manage, and interpret complex reports and data sets, with high attention to detail that leads to 100% data accuracy for Cambio customers.
* **Customer-centric relationship management:** Proven track record of building and maintaining strong client / customer relationships, providing strategic guidance to customers, and owning customer processes.
* **Leadership background:** Proven experience leading and managing a customer success team or similar role.
* **Communication Skills:** Exceptionally strong written and verbal communication skills; strong translator between different audiences. Other spoken languages is a plus.
* **Process-Oriented:** Ability to design, implement, and optimize customer success processes.
* **Regulatory Knowledge:** Familiarity with regulatory environments related to real estate or sustainability is a plus.
* **Team Player**: Commitment to the team's success and collaborative working style.
**Logistics:**
* **Work Authorization:** Authorization to work in the United States or Canada is required.
* **Location:** This is a hybrid role requiring 2–3 days of in-person collaboration per week.
If you thrive on creating well-crafted products and systems that have a disproportionate impact on the real estate industry’s path to net zero, we invite you to join our team. Apply now to embark on this journey with us.

title: GTM Strategy & Growth Director
description:
Job Title: Director, GTM Strategy & Growth
 Location: London, UK / Austin, TX / Cork, IE
 Work type: Hybrid (3 days in office)
 Role Overview
 The Director, GTM Strategy & Growth defines where and how the company competes to deliver scalable, capital-efficient growth. Reporting to the VP, Global Revenue Operations & GTM, this role architects the enterprise-wide go-to-market strategy — aligning market opportunity, competitive advantage, and internal capability into a focused, defensible growth model.
At a pivotal stage of scale, this role ensures that growth is deliberate and prioritized, with clear trade-offs and disciplined capital allocation. The output is a GTM engine designed to improve win rates, reduce cost of sale, and support IPO readiness.
 What You’ll Do
Market Segmentation & Strategic Prioritization: Own and continuously refine the company’s segmentation framework, defining distinct customer groups based on use case, buying behavior, SAM, and structural attractiveness. Evaluate each segment across growth potential and right-to-win to determine where the company should focus investment. 
Right-to-Win Levers: Articulate differentiated right-to-win levers for target segments based on structural advantages such as product-market fit, ecosystem partnerships, customer proof points, pricing power, and execution capability. Assess competitive intensity, buyer decision criteria, and internal performance data to determine where we have demonstrable advantage versus aspirational ambition. 
GTM Direction Setting: Translate segmentation analysis into explicit GTM guidance — clearly defining where we lead through direct sales, scale via partners, pursue opportunistically, or intentionally deprioritize to maximize focus and return on capital. 
Coverage Model & Growth Architecture: Design and optimize the GTM coverage model across direct, partner, and hybrid channels. Allocate cross-functional resources to priority segments to maximize win probability, revenue concentration, and long-term economic return while structurally reducing cost of sale. 
Coverage and Productivity Modelling: Partner with Finance, Sales Ops and Sales leadership to develop scalable capacity, territory, and productivity models that align hiring plans and partner strategy with segment priorities and growth ambition. 
Executive Decision Support & Strategic Planning: Translate market analysis, competitive intelligence, and performance data into board-ready growth scenarios and investment recommendations. Set the strategic agenda for executive decision-making by synthesizing complex analysis into clear, actionable direction. 
Cross-Functional Orchestration & Governance: Ensure strategic prioritization converts into coordinated execution across Sales, Marketing, Product, Partnerships, and regional teams. Establish KPIs and governance mechanisms that track growth by segment, win rates, and capital efficiency, reinforcing organizational focus and commercial discipline. 
 Experience & Expertise
8+ years of experience in GTM strategy, growth strategy, commercial strategy, or revenue operations 
Background in top-tier strategy consulting (MBB or equivalent) and/or senior strategy roles in B2B SaaS 
Demonstrated experience designing market segmentation and coverage models in complex, multi-segment environments 
Strong financial modelling capability, including sales productivity, capacity planning, and scenario modelling 
Advanced analytical fluency (BI tools, data-driven decision frameworks) 
Proven ability to influence C-suite stakeholders and present at board level 
Track record of driving measurable improvements in win rates, growth concentration, or cost-of-sale efficiency 
Experience operating in high-growth, pre-IPO, or scaling technology environments preferred

title: Head of Customer Success
description:
About us
We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
 About Energy Systems 
We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry. 
About the role
The Head of Customer Success leads the customer success function within DNV Energy Systems Digital & Transformation, helping internal business customers and the clients they serve turn digital and AI-enabled capabilities into sustained, measurable value. The role sets the customer success strategy and leads a team focused on customer adoption, feature adoption, customer experience, value realization , and growth in adoption. 
You will partner with business-group and service-line leaders, regional teams, Global Service Area Leads and subject matter experts (SMEs) to understand their priorities and embed useful capabilities into day-to-day work. You will also help ensure that clients understand the value of DNV's digital offerings, experience smooth adoption, and realize benefits quickly. Success means meaningful use that improves business and customer outcomes, not simply access to a platform or completion of a pilot.
Working across global teams and time zones, you will connect customer needs with product, implementation and support teams. You will establish a consistent approach to onboarding, change enablement, customer health and value measurement while allowing for differences in business-group needs and regional ways of working.
 This role is based at our DNV office in Toronto, ON and Montreal, QC; offices, presenting a dynamic hybrid schedule where employees will typically spend three (3) days per week working from either a DNV office or client location/site. Further details regarding role-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process. 
 What you’ll do 
 Customer Success Strategy & Business Partnership 
Define and execute the customer success strategy across business groups, service lines and regions, aligning priorities with business outcomes, customer outcomes, and the digital product portfolio. 
Build trusted relationships with senior business stakeholders and client facing teams, create joint success plans with priority use cases, adoption milestones and expected benefits. 
Establish customer segmentation and engagement models that focus team capacity on the needs, readiness and value opportunities of each business group. 
Lead executive business reviews, communicate progress and risks clearly, and secure business ownership of the changes needed to realize value. 
Define and communicate clear value propositions that help users and clients understand the benefits of digital and AI-enabled capabilities and adopt new ways of working successfully. 
 Team Leadership & Customer Success Operations 
Build, lead and develop the customer success team, setting clear responsibilities, coaching performance, and creating a culture of accountability and customer advocacy. 
Create repeatable playbooks for onboarding, engagement, value reviews and adoption recovery . 
Set team priorities and resource plans, balancing high-touch support for complex needs with scalable enablement for broader adoption. 
Establish customer health reporting that combines meaningful usage, stakeholder engagement, progress toward outcomes and unresolved barriers; lead timely recovery actions. 
 Onboarding, Change Enablement & Sustained Adoption 
Own the customer journey from readiness and onboarding through first value and sustained use, with clear responsibilities shared with business sponsors and delivery teams. 
Lead role-based training, communications and change enablement that help users integrate relevant features into real business workflows. 
Develop a network of business and regional champions to share practical experience, support peer learning and scale proven approaches. 
Identify and address adoption barriers, including process, skills, data, product usability and policy constraints; coordinate escalation and confirm that interventions restore sustained use. 
 Adoption & Value Measurement 
Own the four measures below. Agree eligible populations, meaningful-use criteria, starting baselines, reporting periods and targets with business stakeholders; maintain consistent definitions and review progress by business group. Measure sustained completion of relevant work, not logins alone. 
Measure customer adoption as the number and share of eligible users and teams using the product meaningfully in agreed business workflows over the reporting period. Compare with the starting baseline and verify continued use across successive periods. 
Measure feature adoption as the number and share of eligible users and teams applying each priority feature to relevant work during the reporting period. Compare with the feature's baseline and assess repeat use, depth of use and workflow fit, rather than one-time trials. 
Measure value realized by business group as validated improvements against each group's pre-adoption baseline over an agreed period, such as time saved, reduced cycle time, improved quality or increased delivery capacity. Separate expected benefits from realized benefits and confirm sustained results with business owners. 
Measure growth in adoption as the net increase in meaningfully active users and teams, and the change in adoption rates, from the baseline to subsequent comparable periods. Account for drop-off and changes in the eligible population and show whether adoption is sustained as it expands across business groups. 
 Customer Insight, Product Partnership & Responsible Use 
Bring structured customer feedback, adoption evidence and unmet needs into product prioritization, advocating for improvements with the greatest business value. 
Partner with product and delivery leaders on launch readiness, feature enablement and resolution of recurring customer issues; close the feedback loop with affected business groups. 
Promote responsible digital and AI use that respects DNV's independence, confidentiality and quality requirements, with appropriate expert oversight and clear communication of capability limits. 
Use validated success stories and lessons learned to scale effective practices across regions, while continuously improving the customer success operating model. 
Le responsable de la réussite client dirige la fonction succès client au sein de DNV Energy Systems Digital & Transformation, aidant les clients d'affaires internes et ceux qu'ils servent à transformer les capacités numériques et basées sur l'IA en valeur durable et mesurable. Ce rôle définit la stratégie de réussite client et dirige une équipe axée sur l'adoption client, l'adoption des fonctionnalités, l'expérience client, la réalisation de la valeur et la croissance de l'adoption. 
Vous collaborerez avec des leaders de groupes d'affaires et de lignes de service, des équipes régionales, des chefs de secteur de service mondiaux et des experts en la matière (PME) pour comprendre leurs priorités et intégrer des compétences utiles dans le travail quotidien. Vous aiderez également à vous assurer que les clients comprennent la valeur des offres numériques de DNV, qu'ils vivent une adoption fluide et en tirent rapidement compte. Le succès signifie une utilisation significative qui améliore les résultats d'affaires et de clients, et non simplement l'accès à une plateforme ou la réalisation d'un projet pilote.
En travaillant à travers des équipes et des fuseaux horaires mondiaux, vous mettrez en relation les besoins des clients avec les équipes produit, d'implantation et de soutien. Vous établirez une approche cohérente pour l'intégration, l'activation du changement, la santé des clients et la mesure de la valeur tout en tenant compte des différences dans les besoins des groupes d'affaires et les modes de travail régionaux.
 Ce poste est basé à notre bureau DNV à Toronto, ON et Montréal, QC; présentant un horaire hybride dynamique où les employés passent généralement trois (3) jours par semaine à travailler soit à partir d'un bureau DNV, soit d'un emplacement/site client.  Ce que tu vas faire 
 Stratégie de réussite client et partenariat d'affaires

Bâtir des relations de confiance avec les parties prenantes principales de l'entreprise et les équipes en contact avec les clients, élaborer des plans de réussite conjoints avec des cas d'utilisation prioritaires, des jalons d'adoption et des avantages attendus.
Établissez des modèles de segmentation et d'engagement de la clientèle qui concentrent la capacité de l'équipe sur les besoins, la préparation et les opportunités de valeur de chaque groupe d'affaires.

 Leadership d'équipe et Opérations de réussite client

Définissez les priorités de l'équipe et les plans de ressources, en équilibrant un soutien à haute portée pour des besoins complexes avec une capacité évolutive pour une adoption plus large.

 Intégration, habilitation au changement et adoption durable

Dirigez la formation basée sur les rôles, la communication et l'activation du changement qui aident les utilisateurs à intégrer les fonctionnalités pertinentes dans les flux de travail réels d'affaires.
Développez un réseau de champions des entreprises et régionaux pour partager leur expérience pratique, soutenir l'apprentissage par les pairs et faire évoluer des approches éprouvées.
Identifier et aborder les obstacles à l'adoption, y compris les procédés, les compétences, les données, l'utilisabilité du produit et les contraintes politiques; coordonner l'escalade et confirmer que les interventions restaurent une utilisation durable.
 Adoption et mesure de la valeur 
Posséder les quatre mesures ci-dessous. Convenir des populations admissibles, des critères d'utilisation significative, des références de départ, des périodes de rapport et des cibles auprès des parties prenantes de l'entreprise; maintenir des définitions cohérentes et examiner les progrès par groupe d'affaires. Mesurer l'achèvement soutenu du travail pertinent, et non les connexions seules.
Mesurez l'adoption par les clients comme le nombre et la part d'utilisateurs et d'équipes admissibles utilisant le produit de manière significative dans les flux de travail d'affaires convenus au cours de la période de rapport. Comparez avec la base de départ et vérifiez l'utilisation continue sur les périodes successives.
Mesurez l'adoption des fonctionnalités en fonction du nombre et de la part d'utilisateurs et d'équipes admissibles appliquant chaque fonctionnalité prioritaire à un travail pertinent durant la période de rapport. Comparez avec la base de la fonctionnalité et évaluez l'utilisation répétée, la profondeur d'utilisation et l'adéquation au flux de travail, plutôt que les essais ponctuels.
Mesurer la valeur réalisée par le groupe d'affaires comme des améliorations validées par rapport au seuil de référence pré-adoption de chaque groupe sur une période convenue, telles que le temps gagné, le temps de cycle réduit, l'amélioration de la qualité ou l'augmentation de la capacité de livraison. Séparer les bénéfices attendus des bénéfices réalisés et confirmer les résultats durables avec les propriétaires d'entreprise.
Mesurer la croissance de l'adoption en fonction de l'augmentation nette des utilisateurs et équipes réellement actifs, ainsi que la variation des taux d'adoption, de la base à des périodes comparables ultérieures. Tenir compte des baisses et des changements dans la population admissible et montrer si l'adoption se maintient à mesure que l'adoption s'étend à travers les groupes d'affaires.
 Analyse client, partenariat produit et utilisation responsable 
Intégrez la rétroaction structurée des clients, les preuves d'adoption et les besoins non satisfaits dans la priorisation des produits, en défendant des améliorations avec la plus grande valeur d'affaires.
Collaborer avec les responsables produits et de la livraison pour la préparation au lancement, l'activation des fonctionnalités et la résolution des problèmes récurrents des clients; fermer la boucle de rétroaction avec les groupes d'affaires concernés.
Promouvoir une utilisation responsable du numérique et de l'IA qui respecte l'indépendance, la confidentialité et les exigences de qualité de DNV, avec une supervision experte appropriée et une communication claire des limites de capacité.
Utilisez des histoires de réussite validées et des leçons apprises pour faire évoluer des pratiques efficaces dans toutes les régions, tout en améliorant continuellement le modèle opérationnel de réussite client.

title: Senior Business Operations & Strategy Manager
description:
About us: 
BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.
We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.
Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.
Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.
By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.
We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.

Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)

Flexible working hours, with hybrid working at its heart
A culture built on passionate, growth-minded people
A flexible approach to holiday
Opportunities to travel to our offices around the world
An open and creative environment where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets
 At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team. 
Compensation packages are based on candidate experience and relevant certifications.

$165,000 - $210,000 USD

title: Lead Revenue Operations Analyst
description:

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
 AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered. 
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
 YOUR IMPACT 
OpenText is seeking a Lead Revenue Operations Analyst to join our growing Support Revenue Operations team, acting as a key financial partner focused on adding value to the business. This position reports to the Manager, Revenue Operations, and will be responsible for supporting revenue forecasting, bookings analysis, planning, and reporting processes, while acting as a key interface with business leaders and other cross-functional stakeholders to optimize business performance. The successful candidate will be analytical, detail-oriented, and have a high degree of autonomy along with a broad understanding of business and finance. The individual will foster strong working relationships with various internal stakeholders, thrive on process improvements, and manage inputs from multiple sources.
 WHAT THE ROLE OFFERS 
• Provide operational support and analysis to various business teams. 
• Support continuous process improvement, automating and streamlining processes for forecasting, reporting, and analysis. 
• Build relationships with leaders to improve how estimates and actual financials are consolidated and analyzed. 
• Review and prepare weekly forecast and pipeline reports for accuracy and business insight. 
• Support ongoing forecasting, planning, budgeting, and reporting. 
• Understand what drives forecast changes and explain variances to plan, year-over-year, and quarter-over-quarter and share clear variance analysis with stakeholders and senior management. 
• Learn and use new tools to gather data from multiple sources for better reporting. 
• Work with internal teams like Revenue Recognition, Billing Operations, Sales Operations, and Business Operations. 
• Handle ad-hoc analysis and reporting as needed.
 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED 
• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Business Administration, Financial Analysis, Accounting, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in business analysis, financial analysis, and/or reporting.
 Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Word. Basic SQL knowledge to run queries is a plus.
• Strong analytical skills, with attention to detail and accuracy in handling large amounts of data.
• Ability to build effective working relationships with senior management, business partners, and peers.
• Experience with Power BI, SAP, SAP AO, or Salesforce is an asset.
• Proven ability to compile and analyze data using pivot tables, VLOOKUP, and other advanced formulas.
• Experience reading customer contracts and interpreting revenue recognition schedules and policies.
• Strong problem-solving skills in a fast-changing, ambiguous environment.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present ideas clearly to audiences at all levels, verbally and in writing.
• Track record of improving and streamlining operational processes.
• A self-starter who can connect financial results to business drivers, solve problems, and minimize risk. Proven ability to take initiative and adapt to new challenges.
• Financial analysis and modeling skills are a plus.
 One last thing:

Join us on our mission to drive positive change through privacy, technology, and collaboration. At OpenText, we don't just have a culture; we have character. Choose us because you want to be part of a company that embraces innovation and empowers its employees to make a difference.

About AnywhereNow 
Founded in 2010 in The Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued. With around 240 employees working from 22 different countries, we partner with over 2,000 leading enterprises, including Mazda, the UN International Organization for Migration, Adecco Group, and the University of Cape Town, to deliver exceptional customer experiences through the power of Microsoft Teams and AI-driven insights.
Our commitment to innovation, customer focus, and accountability drives our success. Our portfolio includes Dialogue Cloud, Deepdesk (AI Agent Assist), and Tendfor, delivering cutting-edge capabilities across Microsoft Teams environments and enterprise CX platforms.
 Position Summary 
The Commercial Operations Director owns the commercial engine of the post-sale customer lifecycle, renewals, pricing, deal desk, invoicing, and order-to-cash for AnywhereNow’s SaaS portfolio. You’ll protect and grow contract value, safeguard margin, and convert earned revenue into cash, combining commercial leadership, negotiation strength, and operational rigour.
You’ll lead the renewals and revenue-operations function and personally manage and negotiate the most difficult, complex, and at-risk renewals, working across Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and Legal to secure timely, profitable outcomes and a frictionless billing experience for customers. The role is deliberately designed to balance effectiveness, efficiency, and cost across the commercial operation.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Renewals Management & Negotiation 
• Own the end-to-end renewals process, forecasting, pipeline, administration, and on-time execution across the customer base
• Personally lead and negotiate difficult, complex, high-value, and at-risk renewals, including multi-year, escalated, and competitively contested deals
• Develop renewal playbooks, negotiation strategies, concession frameworks, and save plays to de-risk and retain at-risk accounts

 Pricing, Deal Desk & Commercial Governance

 Billing, Invoicing & Order-to-Cash

 Revenue Processes, Systems & Data

 Retention & Cross-functional Alignment

• Ability to assess commercial decisions and clearly articulate their financial impact.

title: Head of GTM Operations - IT Services
description:

Location: London (hybrid) | Salary: £75k-£90k bonus + benefits | Reports to: Chief Revenue Officer
 The opportunity 
Our client is a London-headquartered IT services and networking provider with a strong vendor partnerships and a customer base across public and private sector. The business is growing, the sales team is growing with it, and the CRO now needs one person to own the engine behind that team.
This is a new, hands-on leadership role. You will build and run the commercial operations function that sits between sales leadership and the salespeople: the process, the governance, the bids and frameworks, and the inside sales and sales support team that keeps deals moving. If you have come up through IT services or public sector sales and moved into enablement, sales operations or bid management, and you want to own the whole thing rather than one slice of it, this is the step up.
 What you will own 
Commercial operations. Pipeline hygiene, forecasting cadence, deal desk and pricing governance, CRM discipline and the weekly and quarterly rhythm that lets the CRO see the truth of the pipeline. You will set the standards and hold the sales team to them.
Sales support and inside sales. Lead, develop and scale the inside sales and sales support team: quoting, order processing, renewals, lead qualification and vendor deal registrations. Make it a team that salespeople want behind them.
Bid and framework management. Own the bid function end to end: qualification, bid/no-bid governance, writing and submission, and the public sector frameworks the business trades through. Keep the business compliant and competitive on every route to market.

title: Senior Sales Enablement Manager
description:
Senior Sales Enablement Manager
 Job Overview 
The Senior Sales Enablement Manager will play a critical role in designing, developing, and delivering scalable enablement programs that strengthen seller capability and support Convera's global go-to-market priorities. Working across Convera's full seller curriculum, this role will design and deliver enablement that builds capability across sales processes, skills, tools, product and solution knowledge, and other priority areas. The role will help sellers confidently apply what they learn through practical, engaging, seller-friendly content and learning experiences. 
The ideal candidate is a hands-on enablement professional who can translate complex business and seller needs, including process, customer, market, product, solution, and tool-related inputs, into high-quality enablement, facilitate live sessions with confidence, and flex across priority initiatives as team and business needs evolve. This role is for someone comfortable moving from strategy to execution: shaping the plan, building the materials, facilitating sessions, and improving the experience based on field feedback. 
 Responsibilities 
Shape and lead scalable sales enablement programs across the full seller curriculum, including sales processes, skills, tools, product and solution knowledge, and priority role-specific needs. 
Assess business priorities, seller needs, existing programs, content, and workflows; identify gaps; and develop practical plans that balance immediate requirements with scalable, long-term solutions. 
Partner with subject-matter experts and cross-functional teams to translate complex business, process, customer, market, product, and competitive information into clear, practical, and engaging seller-ready learning and resources. 
Design and deliver learning experiences for global audiences through live and virtual facilitation, self-paced content, seller practice, and in-the-flow-of-work support, adapting delivery for specific roles, teams, regions, and business priorities. 
Design and strengthen the architecture for onboarding, ramp, certification, continuous learning, and role-specific enablement by defining learning outcomes, applied practice, readiness milestones, and reinforcement approaches. 
Advise and partner with sales leaders and managers to define what sellers must know, say, show, and do; build alignment around priorities; and enable managers to reinforce application through coaching and inspection. 
Drive execution governance across multiple workstreams, including program goals, scope, stakeholder alignment, project plans, dependencies, risks, communications, delivery, and follow-through. 
Use Highspot, Gong, AI tools, and other enablement technologies to scale access, practice, reinforcement, insight, and adoption. 
Define success measures and evaluate program impact across engagement, proficiency, adoption, behavior change, seller confidence, manager reinforcement, and business outcomes; communicate insights and recommendations to stakeholders. 
 Required Qualifications 
8+ years (approx.) of related experience in sales enablement, revenue enablement, sales training, product marketing, or an equivalent field, ideally supporting complex B2B sales organizations. 
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience. 
Demonstrated success leading complex enablement programs end to end, from discovery and strategy through design, development, deployment, measurement, insight generation, and continuous improvement. 
Demonstrated experience developing seller capability across multiple enablement areas and supporting effective application in the field. 
Strong instructional design and content development skills, with the ability to simplify complex information into practical, engaging learning and resources for sellers. 
Hands-on experience with sales enablement, conversation intelligence, learning, or content management platforms is required; experience with Gong and Highspot is strongly preferred. 
Practical fluency with generative AI and the judgment to use it efficiently, responsibly, and with appropriate human review. 
Excellent facilitation, consulting, project leadership, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, influence cross-functional partners, and challenge constructively. 
Experience supporting global or geographically distributed sales organizations and balancing global consistency with relevant local application. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
The following experience is helpful, but not required: 
Previous experience in an SDR, BDR, Account Executive, Sales Manager, or other customer-facing sales role. 
Experience in payments, fintech, financial services, foreign exchange, or another complex B2B environment. 
Experience designing manager-led coaching, reinforcement, competency, and certification approaches. 
Convera is a global leader in commercial payments that powers international business by moving money with ease. We provide tech-led payment solutions to help more than 26,000 customers globally grow with confidence, from small businesses to CFOs and treasurers. As experts in foreign exchange, risk and compliance, with an unrivaled regulatory footprint, Convera’s financial network spans more than 140 currencies and 200 countries and territories. 
Our teams care deeply about the value we deliver to our customers, which makes Convera a rewarding place to work. This is an exciting time for our organization as we expand our team with growth-minded, results-oriented people who are looking to move fast in an innovative environment.  
As a truly global company with employees in over 20 countries, we are passionate about diversity; we seek and celebrate people from different backgrounds, lifestyles, and unique points of view. We want to work with the best people and ensure we foster a culture of inclusion and belonging.   
 Pay Transparency Statement 
Convera is committed to pay transparency and equity in accordance with applicable U.S. state and local laws. For this position, the expected base salary range is $95,000 - $136,000 per year, depending on factors such as experience, qualifications, and geographic location. We use a tiered geographic pay system to ensure fairness across regions. Candidates in high-cost areas may receive higher offers within the posted range.
We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, which may include:
Health insurance (medical, dental, vision)
Retirement savings plan
Paid time off, holidays, and parental leave
Wellness programs and mental health resources
Final compensation and benefits will be discussed during the hiring process and may vary based on individual circumstances and business needs.
There are plenty of amazing opportunities at Convera for talented, creative problem solvers who never settle for good enough and are looking to transform Business to Business payments. Apply now if you’re ready to unleash your potential.
#LI-AS1

title: Client Strategy & RevOps Manager
description:
**Contract (20 hrs/week) | Remote - International| Client-facing strategic role**
**About Map2Close**
Map2Close is a B2B sales enablement and revenue operations consultancy. We embed directly inside our clients' sales organizations and rebuild how they sell: the CRM and sales systems, the training and coaching programs, the compensation structures, the hiring pipelines, and the reporting leadership actually reads.
**The Role**
This is not a client management role in the traditional sense. If you are picturing an inbox-and-calendar job, this is not it. You will be responsible for understanding the client's entire commercial engine, their CRM and sales systems architecture, their compensation and incentive structures, their sales training and coaching programs, their hiring and onboarding pipeline, and their leadership reporting, well enough to draw up a real strategic gameplan for each of those areas.
You do not need to personally build every automation or write every line of a playbook. You do need to understand the problem deeply enough to design the right solution, get it approved, and then either execute it yourself or hand it off as a precise, unambiguous set of tickets to someone who can, and manage that work to completion.
**Core Responsibilities**
**Strategic Gameplan Ownership:** Take vague client requests, write structured execution plans with options/timelines, get Director approval, and project-manage the ticketed work to completion.
**Revenue Systems Fluency:** Audit CRM pipelines and outbound sales tooling to fix broken workflows, attribution gaps, and messy reporting data.
**Sales Enablement & Coaching Strategy:** Design cold call/demo playbooks, qualification frameworks, and objection guides, then run recurring labs and 1-on-1 coaching based on real performance data.
**People & Organizational Design:** Model compensation/bonus tradeoffs, build clear performance improvement frameworks, and design onboarding & adoption programs for new hires and team expansions.
**Executive & Stakeholder Communication:** Turn raw back-end metrics into clear improvement frameworks, run recurring weekly/monthly reporting cadences, and build quarterly business reviews that prove engagement value.
**Relationship Stewardship:** Lead agenda-driven stakeholder meetings with decision choices, proactively write documentation that boosts your client contact’s internal standing, and widen Map2Close’s presence across departments.
**Execution Ownership:** Understand the problem deeply enough to draft and defend the plan, then either build it yourself or convert it into precise briefs for specialists and manage their delivery to high standards.
**Role Requirements**
* 2+ years in a role that combined direct sales or sales leadership with systems or operations responsibility.
* Deep, hands-on fluency with a major CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce class) and outbound sales engagement tooling, enough to spot a broken workflow.
* Excellent written communication. You should be comfortable being the named author of a document a CEO will read.
* Exposure to designing or running sales enablement programs (playbooks, objection frameworks, coaching cadences) - understanding what good sales training looks like.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity: able to take a vague or half-formed client request, ask the right clarifying questions, and turn it into a structured plan without needing to be told exactly what "done" looks like.
**Nice to Have**
* Experience inside a client-facing consultancy or agency managing a strategic account, not just a support queue.
* Background in sales training, coaching, or enablement.
**Compensation & Logistics**
* Contract, remote role: 20+ hours per week expected
* $30 USD/hour. Additional hours requested are paid at the same rate and tracked via time tracking.
* Core hours of availability & responsiveness are generally 11:00 AM–7:00 PM GMT (UK time); hours are flexible, but availability within this window is expected for the majority of the role.
* A ticketing system is used to track ongoing work & time reporting
Pay: $27.00-$30.00 per hour

* How many years of hands-on experience do you have working directly in HubSpot or Salesforce (building workflows, fixing pipelines, not just using it as a rep)?
* Are you available for core working hours of 11:00 AM–7:00 PM GMT (UK time) for the majority of your work week?
Work Location: Remote
