title: Growth Strategy and Operations Analyst
description:
Hi, we’re Penfold - we’re on a mission to help everyone save enough to be comfortable in later life! 🚀
 There’s over a trillion pounds sitting in UK pensions – but most of it is with legacy providers offering outdated products and poor service. We’re here to change that.
Penfold is building the pension of the future – a modern, tech-first platform that makes saving for later life easy, engaging and accessible for everyone.
We’re a growing team of 70+ builders across London and Tallinn, backed by some of the world’s leading FinTech investors. Having raised £25M+, we manage £1bn+ in pensions for over 100,000 savers and thousands of businesses — and we’re on track for profitability next year.
As one of our first 90 hires, you’ll play a key role in shaping our culture and have loads of opportunity to grow, progress and make your mark.
 About The Role
 We are building a small, dedicated growth team, and this is a new role within it. The team is responsible for growing the value of the pensions our members hold with us, and increasing membership through the Refer-a-Friend programme.
The role covers several areas across a member’s pension journey, from the point they join us through to long after they leave an employer.
You would report to the Head of Growth, who is accountable for the growth numbers themselves. Your job would be to make sure the team is aiming at the right things, that the numbers it relies on can be trusted, and that decisions get made on evidence.
 Your Responsibilities
 Analysis and direction
Use cohort and funnel data to work out how to maximise post-acquisition customer value
Turn that analysis into specific recommendations for colleagues about who to contact, and why
Use AI tools and automation where they help you reach an answer faster, particularly for exploratory analysis
Maintain the framework the team uses to measure growth, and work out what the underlying dashboards need to show
 Forecasting and sizing
Build and maintain the forecast for the growth function
Size new growth ideas before they are pursued, so effort goes toward the highest impact ones
Write the business case for larger initiatives
 Experiment design
Design experiments properly with clear hypotheses, agreed ways of judging success, and appropriate holdout groups
Interpret results and ensure they reflect genuine effects
Write up what was learned after each significant test, along with a view on what should happen next
 Coordination and reporting
Support the Head of Growth in coordinating the planning and follow-up for the team’s initiatives each quarter, most of which are cross-functional
Growth PMO support – keeping track of who owns what and by when, and flagging early if something is falling behind schedule
Support the Head of Growth in producing the regular reporting the wider business sees on how growth is progressing
 Skills And Experience
 Must-haves
2-4 years in a role such as revenue operations, management consulting, strategy, or growth / product analytics - ideally somewhere that was growing quickly
A strong analytical toolkit: highly capable with spreadsheet modelling; and experience working with AI for deep analysis, and BI tools such as QuickSight, Looker or Tableau
A first-principles approach to problems: the ability to take an ambiguous situation apart, question the assumptions built into it, and arrive at a model, a number and a recommendation
A working understanding of experiment design: holdouts, sample size, and how to judge whether a result reflects a real effect
Clear communication: the ability to explain your thinking in writing and in person, and to make a case to someone senior, calmly, when the evidence supports it.
A tendency to see things through: you take an idea, do the work to move it forward, and follow up without needing to be chased
 Nice-to-haves
Some exposure to pensions, financial services, payroll or workplace benefits, or another regulated industry with both business and consumer customers
Experience with dbt or a similar data warehouse, and with tools used for running experiments, such as Statsig
Familiarity with CRM or lifecycle marketing platforms, and how marketing attribution works.
Exposure to a business where teams are measured against commercial targets.
 What We’re Looking For
 This role suits someone who takes a considered, evidence-led approach to a commercial problem. You will probably recognise yourself if:
You back up a recommendation with a model and a number
You can take a vague, messy problem, work out what is actually being asked, and get to a clear answer
You know how to set up an experiment properly, and can tell when a result is worth trusting
You are comfortable coordinating work that spans several teams at once
You care whether your analysis actually changes what the team does next
Be prepared to work hard! Ultimately, we’re looking for smart, hardworking & energetic people who get stuff done & are committed to contributing to a great team. So, if you’re excited about what we’re doing, get in touch – definitely don’t be put off if you don’t tick every box!
 Our Application Process
Intro Call (30 mins) – get to know Penfold and briefly discuss your experience.
Experience Deep-Dive (45 - 60 mins) – walk through a piece of work you have owned; discuss your approach, your results, and how you work day to day
Take-Home Task (max 120 mins) – to see how you structure a problem, reach a number, and explain it.
Task Review + discussion (60 mins)
Culture Fit (up to 45 mins with 3 people from other departments)
 Benefits
 We’re working hard to create a working environment where people feel empowered to do their very best work, make a big impact, and enjoy what they do. Specifically, our benefits package includes:
A competitive salary; we proactively review salaries to make sure you get what you deserve
Meaningful share options, you’ll own a part of Penfold and share in our success
10% pension contribution each month that you don’t need to match (on top of your salary)
Medical insurance, through Vitality
Unlimited holiday, we’re interested in your output, not how many holidays you go on!
Hybrid working, we like people to come in to our office (so it would be great if you lived in the London area) at least a couple of days a week to collaborate, but we trust you to get your work done in whatever environment suits you
Great community office space, plenty of people come into our wonderful private office near Borough Underground station.
Free tea, coffee, soft drinks and snacks
Free company lunch every week (e.g., Borough Market, Mercato Metropolitano)
Laptop and any WFH equipment you need 
Option to buy a bike tax free, and spread the cost (using the cycle to work scheme)
Learning and Professional Development – we conduct regular 360 feedback and focus on role progression that suits each individual. We support everyone with courses, events and coaching to help everyone reach their goals
Quarterly company socials, and regular meet-ups throughout the year too!
Plus a host of other benefits – see here: https://getpenfold.com/careers 
—
We are 100% committed to building a diverse and representative team. Whatever your race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability - we want to hear from you. If you have questions about the role or the company or the interview process, please let your recruiter know and we’re happy to answer these anonymously if that makes you feel more comfortable.
We’re all about giving every candidate the best chance to shine. If you require any reasonable adjustments to the job description, application, or selection process, just let us know — we’d be happy to help. When it comes to hiring, we focus only on your skills, experience, and how you live our values.

By attending an interview with Penfold, you consent to the use of recording and AI-generated notes for this purpose. If you have any concerns or would prefer not to be recorded, please let us know in advance.
As we’re a regulated business, any offer (and ongoing employment) depends on passing the usual pre-employment and regulatory checks, which are started before your first day.

 Go-to-Market Planning & Operations Associate Director, EMEA
 Grant Thornton Advisors is expanding across more than 20 markets. As the organisation grows, we are establishing a regional marketing function for EMEA, connecting regional priorities with market plans, investment and global marketing capabilities.
The Go-to-Market Planning & Operations Associate Director, EMEA will be a senior adviser and operational partner to the Head of EMEA Marketing.  Regional planning and priorities

Represent EMEA requirements in global planning and investment discussions. 
 Investment, capacity and risk

title: Director, Sales Enablement
description:
Do you believe enablement should be measured in ramp speed and revenue, not completion rates?
 Then Jobber might be the place for you! We’re looking for a Director, Sales Enablement to be part of our Sales Enablement & Operations department.
Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!
Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers.
 The team:
 Sales Enablement & Operations exists to make sure Jobber’s go-to-market org never has to choose between moving quickly and being ready. We build the systems, tools, and people development that turn strategy into execution: how we forecast and plan, how we pay and motivate, how our tech stack works for reps instead of against them, and how every seller gets better at their craft. The team is organized into peer pillars: Sales Operations, Revenue Technology, Sales Planning & Operations, and Enablement Programs.
 The role:
 Reporting to the Sr. Director, Sales Enablement & Operations, the Director, Sales Enablement will lead Enablement Programs and make sure every seller at Jobber has what they need to win: the skills, the confidence, and the readiness to perform from day one and through every new launch. You’ll lead a team of five to six, as a peer to the leads of Sales Operations, Revenue Technology, and Sales Planning & Operations. You’re accountable for outcomes, not activity — whether reps are actually ready, whether launches actually land in the field, and whether the enablement investment shows up in ramp speed, pipeline, and revenue.
 The Director, Sales Enablement will:
Set the strategy for onboarding, training, certification, and coaching across the sales org, and build, manage, and upskill a team of enablement managers and practitioners. 
Own ramp programs and certification standards across go-to-market roles, and hold the bar on what “certified and ready” actually means. 
Lead enablement for new product, pricing, and process launches, building workback plans that trace every training, content, and certification milestone back from the launch date. 
Build structured, repeatable playbooks and coaching frameworks, and keep them current as products, segments, and motions change. 
Bring AI into how the team builds and delivers enablement — content creation, coaching feedback loops, practice and roleplay, knowledge access — and into what reps are taught to use in their own workflow. 
Partner with Product, Product Marketing, Sales leadership, and Customer Success so enablement priorities match what the business needs next, and launches land with sales rather than at sales. 
Define success beyond completion rates, and report on ramp time, certification pass rates, and downstream impact on pipeline and revenue. 
 To be successful, you should have:
Extensive experience in sales enablement, revenue operations, or sales leadership, including building and running onboarding, training, or certification programs at scale. 
Demonstrated people leadership experience, including managing managers, and a track record of developing your own team’s skills alongside the field’s. 
A proven track record of leading enablement for product or pricing launches in a B2B SaaS environment, with workback plans that hold up against a real launch timeline. 
Hands-on fluency with AI tools in enablement work itself: content generation, coaching and roleplay, and knowledge management. 
Experience building structured, scalable learning frameworks rather than one-off training events. 
Strong stakeholder management with director-level and senior partners across Product, Marketing, and Sales leadership, and the ability to influence roadmap and go-to-market timing rather than only execute against it. 
Comfort operating with ambiguity and building infrastructure where none exists yet. 
Sharp written and verbal communication. 
A bias toward outcomes over activity, and the judgment to know the difference. 
 Compensation:
 At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $181,400, a midpoint of $213,500, and a maximum salary of $245,500, designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.
We design our compensation to reflect each new hire’s skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual’s current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.
Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You’ll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.
We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we’re happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!
 Location:
 We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo.
 What you can expect from Jobber:
A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options. 
A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential. 
A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet. 
To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers. 
 We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.

 Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

title: Strategy Manager - Go-to-Market
description:

Our portfolio covers global voice, messaging and data connectivity, alongside 5G and IoT solutions. It also includes digital identity, verification and CPaaS platforms for personalised, omnichannel engagement. Through these capabilities, we help businesses and communities stay connected, secure and ready to grow. Today, we reach more than 5 billion subscribers, secure over 180 billion transactions every year, and connect more than 1,000 destinations worldwide — delivering on our commitment to connect, protect and engage everywhere.
**Key highlights**
------------------
Powering more than **13 billion** digital communications every month
Supporting over **3,500** active customers through a presence in **50+** global offices across **100+** countries
Managing **50%** of global roaming data traffic and connecting **150 million** IoT devices
Driving innovation in **5G**, private networks and IoT, reinforcing our position in next-generation communications
**About us**
Proximus Global brings together Telesign, Route Mobile and Masiv to help enterprises protect and engage their customers. Our solutions span digital identity, fraud prevention, verification and Network APIs (Protect), and omnichannel communications such as SMS, RCS, WhatsApp and voice (Engage).
Growth Marketing sits inside the Protect & Engage business unit and turns product value into measurable, scalable revenue. The team has five pillars: Go-to-Market Strategy, Regional Marketing, Paid Media, Account-Based Marketing and Inbound SDRs.
**The role**
You will lead Go-to-Market Strategy for the Protect & Engage business unit and decide where we play, who we target and how we win. Today our ICPs and personas exist, but we need someone who sharpens it into clear priorities, use cases and value propositions that sales and marketing can act on.
You report to the Head of Growth Marketing and lead and coach the GtM specialists. You are the senior GtM counterpart for Product, Sales, Partnerships and Regional Marketing. 
The role is based in Belgium, with occasional international travel.
**What we mean by GtM strategy**
GtM strategy is how we take a product to a market and win there: where we play, who buys and why, what we offer them, how we reach and sell to them, and how we measure success. 
For example: AI-native companies, such as AI app builders and voice AI platforms, are growing fast. You would work out what they need, where our products fit and how we should sell to them, then turn that into a plan sales and marketing can run. Often there is no playbook yet: you build it.
**Key responsibilities**
Set GtM strategy and priorities
* Define the GtM priorities for the next 6-12 months across Protect and Engage: segments, verticals, countries and priority use cases
* Answer "where do we win first" with clear, data-backed choices, and say what we stop doing
* Build GtM strategies from scratch for new segments, such as AI-native companies
Own segmentation, ICPs and value propositions
* Own segmentation, ICPs and personas, and keep them current
* Define priority use cases per industry and a clear messaging hierarchy, from core message to industry narratives
* Build differentiated value propositions and competitive positioning
Lead product launches and strategic initiatives
* Shape the GtM plan for new products and launches with Product Marketing, Regional Marketing and
* Sales: target accounts, channels, sales motion and success metrics 
 Bring the GtM view into product planning (PI planning, roadmap reviews)
Equip sales and marketing
* Give sales clear pitch decks, sales plays, case studies and testimonials focused on customer problems
* Give Regional Marketing, ABM and Paid Media the priorities, audiences and messages to build campaigns on
Bring the customer and market voice in
* Own customer feedback: run interviews, market research and an Executive Advisory Board with key customers
* Track the market and competitors, and feed insights to Product and leadership
Lead and coach the GtM team
* Coach and develop the GtM specialist, raising the bar on strategic thinking and structure
* Set the GtM way of working: templates, intake and prioritisation of requests, and clear handoffs to execution teams
**Requirements**
* 10+ years in go-to-market strategy, product marketing, strategy consulting or growth roles in B2B tech,
* SaaS, API or telecom businesses
* Proven record of designing GtM strategies from scratch for new segments, markets or products, and seeing them through to measurable pipeline or revenue
* Strong structured thinking: turns ambiguous questions into clear choices, frameworks and recommendations a leadership team can decide on
* Deep experience with segmentation, ICP and persona definition, value propositions and competitive positioning
* Comfortable getting to grips with fast-moving new markets, including AI-native and developer-led companies
* Credible with senior stakeholders in Product, Sales and leadership; able to challenge and align them 
 Experience coaching or managing marketers or strategists
* Fluent English, written and spoken
**Strong plus**
* Experience in CPaaS (SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, voice) and Digital Identity (verification, authentication, fraud
* prevention, Network APIs) is a major advantage.
**Why Proximus Global?**
------------------------
### **Global & Inclusive**

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

title: Sales Enablement Manager
description:
About AirGarage 
AirGarage is on a mission to bring real estate online, starting with parking.
We replace broken parking machines, fragmented software, and manual, labor-intensive operations with a unified, data-rich operating system for parking real estate. We handle everything it takes to run and optimize a parking asset: payments, dynamic pricing, enforcement, license plate recognition, analytics, and more.
By building all of our technology in-house, we are able to deliver a magical experience for drivers while providing real-time visibility and revenue increases of 20-50% or more for real estate owners. That’s why national real‑estate leaders like Hines and Greystar, as well as technology companies like Meta, partner with AirGarage to optimize their parking facilities.
AirGarage uses datapoints like real-time occupancy, local events, weather, driver behavior, competitor pricing, and more to bring true intelligence to real estate owners’ assets for the first time.
We’re investing aggressively to make the physical world legible to a digital system: cameras, sensors, and software that generate a firehose of real-time data about the world around us. That data fuels models and algorithms that allow us to optimize performance at each property while giving owners the clarity and control they’ve never had before.
Before you can optimize an asset, you need to observe it. Before you can observe it, you need to bring it online.
We are starting with the $131 billion US parking real estate market because it is one of the most offline and mismanaged commercial real estate asset types. 26% of the land area in the median American urban core is dedicated to parking.
We are backed by top tier investors including Headline Growth, Andreessen Horowitz, Floodgate, Founders Fund, Abstract Ventures, and angel investors who have founded or worked at companies like Uber, Opendoor, Flexport, and more.
Want to learn more about AirGarage and the problem we're tackling? 
Check out these podcasts: 
 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AU0NkDK51E4 
 https://youtu.be/_8aM6NQHYiE?si=p5WIujBWUA1sG-b7 
 THE ROLE 💼 
AirGarage's growth depends on how well our sales team executes - and this role is on the front lines of making that happen.
We are looking for a hands-on Sales Enablement Manager to build and run the day-to-day enablement programs that help our AEs and SDRs ramp faster, sell more effectively, and operate as a cohesive team. You will work directly with our VP of Sales to deliver onboarding, training, content, certification and tooling programs that compound rep productivity over time.
This is not a content librarian or training coordinator role. While you will own the systems and assets, the broader expectation is to own measurable improvements in ramp time, rep productivity, and sales execution.
You will partner closely with Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, Head of Sales Development, Marketing, and Product to translate sales strategy into the programs, tools, and content that make every rep better.
If you want to build enablement programs from the ground up at a scaling sales org - and grow into a senior enablement leader as we scale - this role offers the chance to do exactly that.
You will:
Build and run onboarding and ramp programs for new AEs and SDRs
Operationalize sales methodology (MEDDPICC) into the day-to-day workflows of the sales team
Create and maintain sales content: battlecards, talk tracks, objection handling, discovery libraries, ROI tools, and call libraries
Run ongoing training programs tied to specific funnel gaps and business priorities
Partner with Revenue Operations on Gong, sales tools, and AI capabilities that improve seller productivity
Support frontline managers with coaching enablement, training, and program delivery
Build readiness programs for new product launches
Over time, this role will be the foundation of AirGarage's sales execution engine - with real opportunity to grow into a senior enablement leader as the function scales.
 What You'll Own 📊 
 1) New Hire Onboarding & Ramp 
Run the onboarding and ramp programs that get every new rep productive faster.
Build and continuously improve AE and SDR onboarding programs with milestone-based certifications
Deliver new hire training across product, pitch, prospecting, discovery, demo, and methodology
Track ramp metrics by cohort and surface what's working and what isn't
Success measured by faster ramp time and stronger early productivity vs. prior cohorts.
 2) Sales Content & Playbooks 
Build and maintain the content stack that compounds rep productivity.
Work with Product Marketing to create and own battlecards, talk tracks, objection handling, discovery question libraries, messaging, ROI tools, and call libraries
Build playbooks for discovery, multi-threading, competitive selling, and late-stage execution
Maintain a single source of truth for sales content that reps actually use
Surface top-performer behavior from Gong and turn it into team-wide best practice
 3) Ongoing Training & Skill Development 
Run a calendar of training programs tied to actual business needs.
Identify funnel gaps with RevOps and design targeted training to close them
Run quarterly training calendars covering methodology reinforcement, skill development, and product, pricing, and packaging launches
Deliver training in formats that stick - workshops, role plays, certifications, async modules
Tighten the SDR → AE handoff in partnership with Sales Development leadership
Reinforce training in the field by coaching managers on what to look for in 1:1s and pipeline reviews
Success measured by improvements in the specific funnel metrics each training is designed to move.
 4) Sales Tools, Gong & AI 
Make the sales tech stack a force multiplier, not a tax.
Partner with RevOps on Gong, CRM workflows, LMS, and sequencing tools
Build call libraries, scorecards, and Gong workflows that reinforce methodology and best practices
Identify and pilot AI tools - call analysis, deal-risk scoring, automated coaching, generative content - that make every rep meaningfully better
Help administer and roll out new tools with training, certification, and adoption tracking
Track AE utilization of tools
 5) Cross-Functional Partnership 
Act as a connective layer across GTM.
Partner closely with:
VP of Sales on priorities, methodology rollout, and program design
Head of Sales Development on SDR ramp, outbound playbooks, and handoff quality
Revenue Operations on tooling, data, and instrumentation
Marketing on messaging, references, and competitive intelligence
Product on launches, ensuring sellers are certified before go-live
Operations on customer handoffs, post-sale best practices, and using insights from launching and supporting customers to sharpen the sales motion
This role helps ensure GTM work turns into revenue.
 WHO YOU ARE: 🦚 
Our ideal candidate has:
3-5+ years in sales enablement, sales operations, or sales productivity roles
Hands-on experience building or running an onboarding program at a scaling sales org
Prior selling experience as an AE or SDR
Comfortable creating content from scratch - battlecards, playbooks, training decks, certifications
Familiarity with MEDDPICC or a comparable sales methodology
Working knowledge of Gong, Salesforce, LMS, sequencing tools, and emerging AI capabilities
A self-starter who thrives in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
Strong cross-functional instincts and a desire to grow into a senior enablement leader
 🚨 WHY THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE FOR YOU 🚨 
You want a head-of-function role with a team and budget on day one
You prefer to set strategy rather than execute on programs hands-on
You expect a fully built playbook, content library, and ramp program to operate from
You are not comfortable with content creation, training delivery, or tool administration
You want to focus exclusively on either AE or SDR enablement, not both
You prefer pure project management over building durable systems
You want to inherit a mature function rather than build the foundation
 IMPORTANT NOTE 🚨 
AirGarage is a remote-first company, but we also value in-person collaboration to strengthen trust and teamwork. Team members should expect ~6 weeks of travel per year for:
2–3 full company offsites, “Remote Weeks”
Lending a hand to support one new location launch
In-person onboarding as well as supporting other onboarding sessions for new team members
The rest of the year, team members can work remotely from wherever (US time zones) they’re most comfortable as long as they are performing well in their role. Attendance at in-person events throughout the year is expected—if you’re not open to traveling ~6 weeks per year for work, our team won't be a good fit for you.
 THE UPSIDE 📈 
📈 Equity: Have a stake in the business that you’re helping to build and grow.
🌴 Work remotely: Live and work wherever you like! We believe in folks working where they are happiest and most productive. We currently hire teammates that are located anywhere within North America.
🏥 Health insurance: We offer health insurance and currently cover 85% of the cost of medical, dental, and vision plans for the primary employee and 50% of the cost of plans for dependents.
🍼 Parental Leave: We offer 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave to all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. The 12 weeks can be taken as a continuous leave or intermittently over the first 18 months of the child's life.
💻 Home office setup: Get a laptop + additional equipment needed to set you up for success.
⛺ Time to recharge: We have an unlimited PTO policy with a minimum requirement of 10 days per year.
🤑 401k: Make financial planning right for you with a 401k retirement savings program.
✈️ Team Off-sites: ~2 times per year our team comes together for a full week in places like Tahoe, Charleston, San Diego, Park City, and Austin.
📚 BookGarage: Our team loves to learn and grow together, so join us for our optional recurring book club.
🪴Room to grow: Our team will be orders of magnitude larger within a few years; as a part of our foundational team, you'll have opportunities to grow with us.
🏙️ Transform our cities: The opportunity to change the way that the world thinks about real estate use in our cities.
👐 Work with a diverse team: At AirGarage, we've always been committed to building a thriving team that represents the communities we serve. Our team is currently 40% female and 30%+ from underrepresented communities.
 Note : Employment with AirGarage is contingent upon successful completion of a background check and employment verification conducted in compliance with applicable laws. Background checks are completed only after a conditional offer of employment has been made.
 We understand that there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. We're looking for someone passionate, with grit and determination, who is excited to face the challenges of a rapidly growing startup. AirGarage is the type of company where you can grow exponentially, and we encourage you to apply to us even if you don't 100% match the candidate description.

Candidates and employees are always evaluated based on merit, qualifications, and performance. title: Director, Sales Operations (Corporate)
description:
“Join us in building Careers and shaping Experiences Beyond the Box” 
 About Us 
At Atlantic Packaging, every box tells a story and yours begins here. As a proudly Canadian-owned company with over 80 years of excellence in the corrugated packaging industry with operations within North America (Ontario, Quebec and United States), we’re committed to sustainability, customer excellence and community impact. Since 1945, we’ve supported local jobs and built a legacy of trust with our clients and team members. At Atlantic, your ideas matter, your growth is supported and your work makes a real impact.
 The Opportunity 
The Director, Sales Operations is responsible for owning, standardizing, and continuously improving the commercial operating system across the organization. This is a corporate role working in collaboration with all sales regions in the Atlantic Packaging network (Ontario, Quebec, USA).
This role does not own sales targets nor manage sales teams directly. Instead, it enables Sales Leadership and P&L owners to execute consistently by providing clear processes, disciplined governance, and effective tools.
The role addresses recurring structural issues in sales execution (contracts, risk exposure, forecast visibility, onboarding effectiveness, and CRM adoption) and brings process excellence to an area historically driven by individual experience rather than system discipline. Sales Operations builds the system so Sales / Marketing / Legal / Finance / CX work together efficiently.
The corporate Customer Experience function will report into the Director, Sales Operations, which expect will increase the probability that customer feedback results in retention, growth, and operational improvement.
 Success Factors in the Role 
Success in this role will be judged on system outcomes, not activity.
Sales execution becomes repeatable
Fewer deal-specific workarounds; consistent deal flow through the same stages and approvals.
Sales leaders use the tools willingly
Salesforce is used because it makes running the business easier, not because it’s mandated.
Commercial risks are visible before decisions (with a disciplined reduction process)
P&L owners can see contract duration mix, terms exposure, and liability accumulation before approving deals.
Fewer “surprises”
Fewer last-minute escalations due to undocumented terms, unclear approvals, or cross‑region inconsistencies.
Improved funnel credibility
Forecast discussions are grounded in a shared, disciplined view of the pipeline.
CX feedback loop is integrated into the sales process which will result in better CX scores across the businesses
 What You’ll Do 
This role sets standards and runs governance. Sales Leadership owns execution. Finance/Credit/Legal co-own approval rules and risk thresholds.
1. Sales Operating Model & Governance
Own and maintain the front-end sales operating model, including:
Contract approval workflows and limits of authority (with Legal).
Clear rules when customers operate across regions.
Partner with Legal, Finance, and Credit to make risk explicit and decision-ready.
Ensure P&L leaders have visibility before commitments are made, not after.
2. Salesforce Ownership
Act as business owner of Salesforce (process design, usage standards, reporting logic).
Drive adoption by defining how and why Salesforce is used:
Funnel structure aligned with business needs (product mix, seasonality, capacity).
Standard dashboards for P&L owners and Sales Leadership.
Reduce “system noise” so the tool supports decisions, not administration.
3. Funnel Management & Sales Planning
Define and enforce consistent funnel management practices.
Provide forward-looking visibility on revenue concentration by:
Factory
Asset type
Industry
Salesperson
Other cuts as needed
Enable proactive capacity and production discussions (vs. reactive firefighting).
Drive development of sales plans that can be handed off for execution.
Enable consolidation of this data for the Group.
4. Contract, Terms & Risk Tracking
Implement standardized reporting on:
Contract tenure mix (no contract, quarterly, annual, etc.).
Payment terms exposure.
Aggregate liability commitments.
Make commercial risk measured, visible, and discussable (not implicit or anecdotal).
5. Sales Training / Motivation / Sales incentive management
Design and institutionalize a formal sales onboarding and training framework.
Develop role-specific training (e.g., Salesforce usage, contract basics).
Build a repeatable cadence for sales meetings to drive consistent themes and execution.
Administer the sales incentive program, including consistent publishing of performance vs. targets.
6. Manage corporate CX program
 What You Bring 
Strong background in Sales Operations, Commercial Excellence, or Revenue Enablement.
Comfortable influencing senior sales leaders without hierarchical authority.
Process-oriented, systems thinker with a strong business bias.
Credible with Finance, Sales, and Operations alike.
Required: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Finance, Operations, or a related field required.
7+ years of experience in progressive experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Commercial Excellence, or Business Analytics
Expert in Salesforce, specifically in design, governance and adoption.
 What We Offer 
Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage (dependents included)
Teamwork-focused culture with sustainability initiatives and social events
A culture of appreciation through a point-based recognition
Opportunities for advancement and internal movement
Education assistance for continuous skill development
Academic scholarships for employees’ children
Safety equipment and PPE support program
Retirement savings and wellness initiatives
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
 Inclusion and Accessibility 
Atlantic Packaging is committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible and respectful environment for all candidates. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please contact our Talent Acquisition team—we’re here to support you.
We sincerely thank all applicants for their interest in joining Atlantic Packaging. While we appreciate the time and effort invested, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
 Please Note :
Candidates who are 18 years or older are required to complete a criminal and background check. Details will be provided through the application process.
 Sommaire du rôle 
Le/La Directeur(trice), opérations commerciales corporatives est responsable de définir, standardiser et améliorer en continu le système d’exploitation commercial de l’organisation. Il s’agit d’un rôle corporatif qui travaille en collaboration avec toutes les régions de ventes du réseau Atlantic Packaging, incluant l’Ontario, le Québec et les États-Unis.
Ce rôle n’est pas propriétaire des objectifs de ventes et ne gère pas directement les équipes de ventes. Son rôle est plutôt de permettre aux leaders des ventes et aux responsables P&L d’exécuter de façon constante, en mettant en place des processus clairs, une gouvernance disciplinée et des outils efficaces.
Le rôle adresse des enjeux structurels récurrents dans l’exécution commerciale, notamment les contrats, l’exposition aux risques, la visibilité sur le funnel, l’efficacité de l’intégration des nouveaux employés et l’adoption de Salesforce. Il amène de la rigueur de processus dans une fonction qui a historiquement reposé davantage sur l’expérience individuelle que sur une discipline institutionnelle. Les opérations commerciales corporatives bâtissent le système pour permettre aux Ventes / Marketing / Légal / Finances / CX de travailler ensemble efficacement.
La fonction corporative d’expérience client relèvera du/de la Directeur(trice), opérations commerciales corporatives, ce qui est un arrimage naturel puisque la Voix du client, l’adoption de Salesforce, la discipline du funnel, la boucle fermée et les cadences commerciales doivent être connectées au même système de gestion pour transformer les commentaires clients en actions concrètes, soutenir la rétention, favoriser la croissance et améliorer l’exécution opérationnelle.
 Facteurs de succès dans le rôle 
Le succès dans ce rôle sera évalué sur les résultats du système, et non sur le niveau d’activité.
L’exécution des ventes devient reproductible
Moins d’exceptions gérées à la pièce; un flux de dossiers plus constant à travers les mêmes étapes et approbations.
Les leaders des ventes utilisent les outils parce qu’ils les aident à gérer le business
Salesforce est utilisé parce qu’il facilite la gestion commerciale, et non seulement parce qu’il est obligatoire.
Les risques commerciaux sont visibles avant les décisions
Les responsables P&L peuvent voir la durée des contrats, l’exposition aux termes de paiement et les engagements de responsabilité avant d’approuver les ententes.
Moins de surprises
Moins d’escalades de dernière minute causées par des termes non documentés, des approbations floues ou des incohérences entre régions.
Crédibilité accrue du funnel
Les discussions de prévisions sont basées sur une vision partagée et disciplinée du pipeline.
La boucle de rétroaction CX est intégrée au processus de ventes afin d’améliorer les scores CX dans l’ensemble des unités d’affaires.
 Portée et responsabilités clés 
Ce rôle établit les standards et anime la gouvernance. Les leaders des ventes demeurent propriétaires de l’exécution. Les finances, le crédit et le légal codéfinissent les règles d’approbation et les seuils de risque.
1. Modèle opérationnel des ventes et gouvernance
Définir et maintenir le modèle opérationnel commercial de première ligne, incluant les flux d’approbation des contrats, les limites d’autorité et les règles applicables aux clients opérant dans plusieurs régions.
Travailler avec le juridique, les finances et le crédit afin de rendre le risque explicite et prêt à être décidé.
S’assurer que les leaders P&L ont la visibilité requise avant que les engagements soient pris, et non après.
2. Ownership Salesforce
Agir comme propriétaire d’affaires de Salesforce pour le design des processus, les standards d’utilisation et la logique de reporting.
Favoriser l’adoption en définissant clairement comment et pourquoi Salesforce est utilisé.
Aligner la structure du funnel avec les besoins d’affaires, incluant le mix produit, la saisonnalité et la capacité.
Développer des tableaux de bord standards pour les responsables P&L et les leaders des ventes.
Réduire le bruit administratif afin que l’outil soutienne les décisions, plutôt que de devenir une couche de reporting additionnelle.
3. Gestion du funnel et planification des ventes
Définir et faire vivre des pratiques cohérentes à travers le groupe de gestion du funnel.
Donner une visibilité prospective sur la concentration des revenus par usine, type d’actif, industrie, représentant et autres découpages nécessaires.
Permettre des discussions proactives sur la capacité et la production, plutôt que de fonctionner en mode réaction ou escalade.
Contribuer au développement de plans de ventes clairs, prêts à être transférés en exécution.
Permettre une consolidation au niveau du groupe de ces données.
4. Contrats, termes et suivi des risques
Mettre en place un reporting standardisé sur la durée des contrats, l’exposition aux termes de paiement et les engagements de responsabilité.
Rendre le risque commercial mesurable, visible et discutable, plutôt qu’implicite ou anecdotique.
5. Formation, mobilisation et gestion des incitatifs de ventes
Concevoir et institutionnaliser un cadre formel d’intégration et de formation pour les équipes de ventes.
Développer des formations adaptées aux rôles, notamment sur Salesforce et les notions de base liées aux contrats.
Bâtir une cadence reproductible pour les rencontres de ventes afin de renforcer les thèmes clés et l’exécution.
Administrer le programme d’incitatifs de ventes, incluant la publication constante de la performance par rapport aux objectifs.
6. Gestion du programme corporatif d’expérience client
Assurer l’arrimage entre la Voix du client, les données d’expérience client, Salesforce, les initiatives de ventes et les priorités opérationnelles.
Mettre en place une boucle fermée permettant de transformer les commentaires, irritants et opportunités d’amélioration provenant des clients en actions concrètes, priorisées et mesurables.
Renforcer la culture client en rendant les enjeux CX visibles, actionnables et intégrés aux cadences commerciales et opérationnelles.
 Profil recherché 
Solide expérience en opérations commerciales, excellence commerciale, enablement ou analytique commerciale.
Capacité d’influencer des leaders de ventes expérimentés sans autorité hiérarchique directe.
Profil structuré, orienté processus et système, avec une forte proximité d’affaires.
Crédible auprès des ventes, des finances et des opérations.
 Formation et expérience 
Baccalauréat requis en administration des affaires, commerce, finance, opérations ou domaine connexe.
Minimum de 7 ans d’expérience progressive en opérations commerciales, revenue operations, excellence commerciale ou analytique d’affaires.
Expertise avancée avec Salesforce, particulièrement en design, gouvernance et adoption.
hard_gaps: Minimum 7 years progressive sales/revenue operations experience
Advanced Salesforce expertise in design, governance and adoption

title: Sr Manager Commercial Operations Internationa - Based in Madrid
description:
Role 
The Senior Manager Commercial Operations is the operational backbone of International Commercial Excellence. The role connects commercial data, tools, systems and ways of working into one coherent operating model, ensuring priorities are translated into disciplined execution, faster decisions and measurable business value across markets.
 WHAT MAKES THIS A GREAT OPPORTUNITY? 
Suntory Global Spirits is a world leader in premium spirits with $5.5 billion in annual revenues and an ambition to become the World’s Most Admired Premium Spirits Company.  Mission of Role

title: Sales Operations Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
The Sales Operations Manager is responsible for ensuring the sales organization operates efficiently, accurately, and effectively by overseeing the systems, processes, tools, data, and administrative functions that support the sales team. This role drives continuous improvement across sales operations, forecasting, order and contract administration, and cross-functional coordination, providing the structure and support required for the sales team to focus on customers and revenue generation. As the function grows, this role will also build and lead the Sales Operations team.
**Responsibilities**
**Sales Systems, Tools & Data**
* Own and continuously improve CRM and other sales systems, ensuring they effectively support business needs.
* Maintain data integrity across customers, opportunities, orders, forecasts, pricing, and sales reporting.
* Manage sales tools, licenses, access, integrations, system implementations, and user adoption.
* Develop dashboards, reports, documentation, and training to support effective system use and management decision-making.
**Sales Administration & Order Management**
* Oversee sales administration from quotation and order entry through fulfillment, shipment, and delivery.
* Ensure quotations, proposals, orders, pricing, customer information, and supporting documentation are accurate and complete.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Production, Project Management, Finance, and Shipping to ensure customer requirements and commitments are fulfilled.
* Oversee export documentation, shipping, invoicing coordination, payment terms, and resolution of operational issues.
**Forecasting & Reporting**
* Manage the sales forecasting and pipeline reporting process, ensuring opportunities, timing, probabilities, and expected revenue are accurately maintained.
* Establish consistent forecasting and reporting practices and provide management with reliable pipeline, order, and sales information.
* Identify gaps, risks, and inconsistencies in sales data and coordinate corrective action.
**Contracts & Commercial Administration**
* Manage NDAs, customer Terms & Conditions, and other commercial documentation from receipt through execution and filing.
* Review documentation against approved templates and requirements, escalating non-standard terms or risks to management or legal counsel.
* Maintain organized, accurate, and appropriately controlled commercial records.
**Processes & Cross-Functional Coordination**
* Develop and continuously improve sales processes, procedures, workflows, templates, and documentation standards.
* Establish effective communication and handoffs between Sales and other departments, ensuring responsibilities, commitments, and actions are clearly tracked.
* Identify and resolve process gaps, bottlenecks, recurring errors, and unnecessary administrative work.
* Ensure sales processes remain efficient and scalable as the organization grows.
**Marketing & Events**
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external marketing partners on sales collateral, website content, campaigns, and other marketing activities.
* Coordinate trade shows, customer demonstrations, and industry events, including registration, logistics, equipment, collateral, and follow-up.
* Maintain marketing materials and support tracking of marketing and event expenditures.
**Sales Team Support & Leadership**
* Serve as the primary operational resource for the sales team, removing administrative, system, and process barriers to effective selling.
* Train and onboard sales personnel on systems, tools, processes, and operational best practices.
* Support sales and forecasting meetings, operational reviews, and follow-up activities.
* As the function grows, build, develop, and lead the Sales Operations team.
**Qualifications**
* 5+ years of experience in sales operations, sales administration, or business operations.
* Hands-on experience with CRM/ERP systems, including data management and reporting.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
* A track record of improving processes, workflows, or systems.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends and risks, and present clear findings to management.
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to coordinate across internal teams, customers, and vendors.
* Strong interpersonal and customer service skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships at all levels.
* Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential customer and commercial information.
* Ability to quickly learn technical products and understand customer requirements.
* Self-directed and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership.
**Nice to have/Preferred:**
* NetSuite administration or implementation experience.
* Experience managing sales forecasting and pipeline reporting.
* Experience administering sales tools, software licenses, and user access.
* Experience reviewing contracts, NDAs, or customer Terms & Conditions.
* Experience coordinating trade shows, events, or marketing activities.
* Experience developing SOPs, training materials, or system documentation.
* Experience in a technical, manufacturing, marine, defence, or electronics environment.
* Team leadership or supervisory experience.
* Diploma or degree in business or a related field.
* Additional languages.
**Skills & Attributes**
* Energetic and proactive, with a strong willingness to learn.
* Excellent multitasking and time management abilities.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable in a fast-paced, team-based environment.
**WHO WE ARE:**
Current Scientific Corporation, based in Port Coquitlam, BC, is a dynamic Small and Medium-sized Enterprise (SME) with a keen focus on the international export market. As a growing marine tech company, we take pride in manufacturing cutting-edge stabilized electro-optical systems.
Our reach extends globally, with customers situated around the world. Specializing in serving the Naval & Defence sector and the Marine & Yacht industry, we are dedicated to crafting high-quality products that meet the rigorous standards of these sectors.
At the core of our ethos is a commitment to innovation, as evidenced by our continuous investment in Research and Development (R&D) to bring forth new products and enhance the overall customer experience.
Our clientele within the marine industry spans a diverse range, including electronics & bridge integrators, shipyards, and end users in segments such as coast guard, paramilitary & navy, ferries & explorer cruises, super-yachts, icebreakers, marine mammal research, and other specialty vessels.
CURRENT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager (Remote Canada)
description:
Job DescriptionJob Description About Directive 
At Directive, we’re a remote-first team of performance marketers obsessed with driving measurable growth for B2B SaaS and tech companies. We believe in data-backed strategy, radical accountability, and world-class execution across every channel — Paid Media, SEO & Content, CRO, Creative, and RevOps.
We’re building the next era of integrated marketing leadership, where creativity meets commercial discipline. Join us as we elevate how client strategy, retention, and growth are delivered at scale.
 Role Summary 
We're hiring a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to own the systems our go-to-market runs on. You'll sit on the internal marketing team as the operator behind the Marketing and Sales teams, owning CRM architecture across Salesforce and HubSpot, lead routing, attribution, reporting, and the tech stack that ties it all together. You’ll work cross-functionally with sales, executive leadership, and finance. This is a team-of-one role with direct leadership visibility: you'll set the ops strategy, and you'll also be the one building the workflows and systems that make it real.
We're looking for someone who has built ops functions, not just inherited them. You're fluent in Salesforce and HubSpot, you've rebuilt messy routing and attribution before, and you can walk an executive through why a conversion rate moved and what you're doing about it. You care about data integrity because you know every leadership decision sits on top of it.
If you love owning the full marketing stack, turning weekly numbers into a story leadership trusts, and leaving systems better than you found them, this role is built for you.
 Key Responsibilities 
Own CRM architecture across Salesforce and HubSpot: objects, fields, validation rules, Flows, formula fields, page layouts, and the sync logic between the two.
Run lead routing and scheduling end to end across LeanData, Chili Piper, HubSpot, and Salesforce, including round robin logic, booking windows, booking rules, and capacity, so every handraiser reaches the right rep fast.
Own attribution strategy: first- and last-touch source tracking, lead source definitions and governance, marketing influence tagging, and offline conversion tracking (Google, LinkedIn, Meta).
Report weekly and monthly on full-funnel performance (handraisers, intro calls, strategy calls, proposals, closed won) against goal, with rolling conversion rates, pacing, and YoY context. Maintain the Growth Dashboard and MoM/QoQ trackers leadership runs the business on.
Protect data integrity: deduplication (Cloudingo, LeanData), email validation, enrichment, platform properties, and sync logic.
Own email marketing end to end: newsletters, promotional sends, and nurture programs, including segmentation, build, QA, scheduling, A/B testing, and performance reporting. Protect deliverability and sender health through list hygiene, validation, and suppression management.
Build and optimize inbound and outbound programs, including handraiser and non-booker follow-up strategy, workflows, suppression logic, and signal-based campaigns across HubSpot, Instantly, Gong Engage, and UserGems.
Manage the MarTech stack and its budget: tool audits, access, renewals and negotiations, consolidation decisions, and monthly actuals vs. forecast for marketing and sales spend.
Partner with marketing on campaigns and thought leadership, from webinar operations and event lists to benchmark data for The Verdict Report and standardized campaign setup in Salesforce.
Support sales and leadership with analysis that drives decisions: pipeline goals by stage and division, channel influence analysis, and spend allocation recommendations.
Enable the org by training Account Directors, sales, and new hires on Salesforce, HubSpot, and Gong, and by keeping ops documentation, process diagrams, and how-tos current.
Maintain customer data that powers retention and expansion: point-of-contact and decision maker tracking, CSAT and reference program workflows, and CRM adoption for client-facing teams.
Design and enforce the pipeline: opportunity stages, entry and exit criteria, and stage-by-stage goals modeled from historical conversion rates so forecasts hold up.
 Who You Are 
 Experience & Background 
5+ years in marketing operations, revenue operations, or a similar B2B go-to-market systems role, including experience building or rebuilding an ops function.
Advanced Salesforce admin skills (validation rules, Flows, formula fields, custom objects, reports and dashboards, Data Loader) and deep HubSpot experience (workflows, lists, properties, forms, integrations). HubSpot and/or Salesforce certification is a plus, but not required.
Hands-on experience with lead routing and scheduling tools like LeanData and Chili Piper.
A strong grasp of attribution models, lead source governance, UTM standardization and tracking, and offline conversion tracking with ad platforms.
The analytical chops to build funnel reporting and pacing models in Salesforce and Google Sheets, and the judgment to explain what the numbers mean, not just what they are.
Experience with sales engagement, outbound, and data tools such as Gong and Gong Engage, Instantly, UserGems, and Zapier.
The ability to turn messy, cross-functional requests into clean systems, and the backbone to push back when a request would break reporting.
Comfort operating as a team of one: you prioritize ruthlessly, communicate tradeoffs clearly in weekly updates, and still sweat the details.
Experience managing vendor relationships, renewals, and MarTech budgets.
Confident in presenting performance and recommendations to executive leadership.
Bonus points for using AI agents or LLMs to automate ops workflows, and for agency or professional services experience.
 Cultural Fit & Traits 
You take ownership of outcomes and follow through on the details.
You’re curious about all aspects of marketing and are motivated to help the team succeed.
You’re comfortable building repeatable processes while staying hands-on with execution.
You communicate directly, welcome feedback, and work independently in a remote environment.
You put the team’s success first. We work as one marketing team, with shared goals and flexible responsibilities. You take ownership of your work, jump in where you can make an impact, and collaborate across functions to drive pipeline and revenue together.
You use AI thoughtfully to support research, personalization, and execution while maintaining accuracy and a natural human voice.
 What We Offer: 
We have a set living wage at Directive; the actual salary may vary based on Directive's compensation practices, job related skills, and depth of experience.
Medical, dental, vision plans, disability, and life insurance coverage for you and your family that fit your lifestyle
Including a 100% employer-paid plan for you and a 50% employer contribution for your dependents (US, CAD, MX)
Benefits to Support the Whole Person:
 Mental - Access to certified therapists through Spring Health , membership to Headspace 
 Physical - Physical therapy through Omada, thousands of Aaptiv virtual workouts , complimentary One Medical membership for primary and virtual care
T ime Off - Unlimited PTO (2-week minimum), Paid Company Holidays, Your Birthday Off, End of Year Recharge (Closed December 24 - January 1), Paid Parental Leave
 Financial - Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 3% company match
 Bonus - Annual bonus based on tenure, which scales in total amount over time
 Annual Company-wide Retreat 
 Work Environment Requirements 
As a remote-first company, you’ll have the ability to work from your home office. For some positions, as posted, we will accommodate global opportunities where we have established businesses, including Canada, Mexico, and the UK. For global locations, you must have established and current work authorization and permanently reside in that country.
This role has the opportunity to operate 100% virtually from your home office. We primarily collaborate with our colleagues through virtual meetings (Zoom), and Slack. In this role, you will be required to operate a laptop computer (PC or Mac available), computer software platforms, and other office productivity tools as necessary. Due to the nature of this role, you must be able to remain stationary for extended periods, must be able to observe and interpret written and/or verbal communication, must have reliable internet access, and a professional background.
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.
If you require reasonable accommodations in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, direct your inquiries to recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.
 Additional Information 
At Directive, one of our core values is People First. We’re committed to fostering a more diverse and inclusive culture in the digital landscape. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
About Vantage: 
At Vantage, we're passionate about building a cloud cost transparency platform that helps enable everyone – from developers to enterprises – analyze, report, collaborate on and optimize their cloud infrastructure costs. Both our CEO (a repeat founder) and CTO are passionate about cloud infrastructure. Having worked together at DigitalOcean, they are taking their combined knowledge to build and scale the Vantage platform. Together we are a high output team of ~55 employees based out of New York City (but embrace a remote-friendly lifestyle).
Our current customers include Square, Circle CI, Metronome, Decagon, Temporal and many more.
Vantage is also well capitalized and backed by outstanding top-tier investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Scale Ventures, Matthew Prince (Co-Founder, Cloudflare), Calvin French Owen (Co-Founder, Segment), Ben and Moisey Uretsky (Co-Founders, DigitalOcean), Stephanie and Nat Friedman (CEO, Github), Julia Lipton, Brianne Kimmel and others.
 About the Role
 Vantage’s customer base is growing and, as a result, we’re looking to onboard another member to our customer success team. The Vantage customer success team works with customers after they’ve already chosen to subscribe to Vantage. You’ll serve as your customer’s main point of contact after being introduced by a sales team member. You’ll lead your customers through onboarding, conduct training sessions, solicit ongoing product feedback, present business reviews, and be the voice of the customer in internal company meetings.
This role is more technical and product-oriented and you’ll be looked at as a subject matter expert from a customer perspective. Customer Success Managers currently work with customers from growth stage startups up to enterprises.
Our customers are technical in nature and require a high bar for people that they work with. If you enjoy infrastructure and working with companies to learn about their infrastructure in an effort to help them save money, this could be an ideal job for you.
 What You Will Do: 
You will own and lead the complete lifecycle of post sale customer engagement, including onboarding, adoption, value reviews, and renewal playbooks. As we scale, this will evolve
Become a trusted advisor to Vantage customers, ensuring they maximize the benefit of the Vantage solution
Be the voice of the customer within the Vantage organization, advocating on their behalf to drive timely resolution to support issues, feature enhancement requests, and issues representing friction to broader adoption
Effectively engage at all levels of our customer organization and stakeholder personas to ensure a comprehensive, multi-threaded, engagement model
 What We're Looking For: 
5+ years of customer-centric industry experience as a Customer Success or Technical Account Manager across B2B tech or SaaS
A strong communicator with exceptional attention to detail and an ability to cater to a specific audience, including CTOs, VPs of Engineering/Infrastructure, and DevOps professionals
Previous experience with FinOps Cloud Cost Management solutions
You have a bias for action and believe in continuous development, ambiguity is in your comfort zone
Ability to efficiently manage a wide portfolio of accounts from SMB up to large enterprise accounts
Strong emotional intelligence and the ability to empathize with customers
A kind person
 Bonus Points: 
Monitoring and observability expertise
One or more of the following certifications: FinOps Certified Practitioner, FinOps Certified FOCUS Analyst, FinOps for AI, FinOps Certified Engineer
One or more of the following certifications: AWS Cloud Practitioner (Foundation), Microsoft Certified (Azure Fundamentals), Google Cloud Digital Leader
Experience building and deploying to cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.)
Relevant Data Visualization / financial product experience
At this time, Vantage is only set up to employ in the United States

title: Senior Customer Success Architect
description:
About GitHub 
GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.
 Locations 
In this role you can work from Remote, United States
 Overview 
GitHub is growing its Regulated Industries (Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing, Healthcare and Pubsec) Customer Success Architecture team and we're seeking experienced professionals to elevate our customer engagement efforts. As a Senior Customer Success Architect , you will synthesize and integrate diverse business and industry insights to support customer digital transformation initiatives and align customer business requirements with GitHub's product features. The ideal candidate will be a driver in helping customers achieve their digital transformation goals, shaping innovative solutions while gaining deep industry insights, expanding technical expertise, and contributing to GitHub’s customer engagement strategies for long-term success.
 Responsibilities 
Develop and maintain deep industry and customer insights to identify opportunities for growth and align GitHub solutions with customer digital transformation goals.
Serve as a trusted advisor by providing technical guidance to both internal teams and customer stakeholders, promoting the integration of GitHub technologies to enhance customer technology landscapes.
Lead efforts to resolve implementation blockers and support customer technology adoption through readiness resources, product demonstrations, and integration with existing customer workflows.
Partner with sales and technical teams to identify customer challenges, conduct proofs of concept, and drive solution selection and implementation in post-sales context.
Cultivate expertise in GitHub Products, advising customers on developing robust DevOps and DevSecOps using GitHub narratives.
Assist in creating and delivering content, acting as a liaison to enhance customer engagement and demonstrate GitHub's capabilities.
Analyze customer situations to identify gaps that GitHub solutions can address and contribute to the creation of strategic frameworks to drive product adoption and customer success.
Utilize advanced data analytics to provide insights into customer usage patterns, identify areas for improvement, and recommend strategies to enhance customer satisfaction and product adoption.
Proactively identify potential risks in customer engagements and develop mitigation strategies to ensure successful project delivery and long-term customer satisfaction.
Lead initiatives aimed at improving customer success and retention by developing best practices for product usage and facilitating workshops or enablement sessions for customers.
Engage in post-sales activities with customers, aligning partners and stakeholders to drive solution implementation and developing external relationships within the customer organization.
 Qualifications 
 Required/Minimum Qualifications: 
8+ years experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience,
OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 6+ years experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience, 
OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 4+ years experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience, 
OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 2+ years experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience, 
OR equivalent experience.
Ability to travel up to 25% to serve business or client needs.
 Additional or Preferred Qualifications: 
10+ years' experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience.
3+ years' experience in digital transformation using software modernization to drive customer business outcomes.
3+ years' experience in business consulting, consultative selling, or customer-facing experience.
5+ years' experience orchestrating technical, support, and/or partner teams.
Proficiency in using GitHub and other DevOps tools, with a deep understanding of software development practices and application security, including SAST, DAST, and SCA.
Experience in the software development platform industry, including driving digital transformation initiatives and aligning technology solutions with business objectives.
 Strong preference for deep experience in regulated industries (financial services, manufacturing, healthcare & life sciences, public sector). 
 Compensation Range 
The base salary range for this job is USD $94,000.00 - USD $249,280.00 /Yr.
In addition, this role also has the opportunity to earn sales incentives. On target earnings (OTE) is based on a 80/20 base salary/sales incentive.
These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.
This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
 GitHub values 
Customer-obsessed
Ship to learn
Growth mindset
Own the outcome
Better together
Diverse and inclusive
 Manager fundamentals 
Model
Coach
Care
 Leadership principles 
Create clarity
Generate energy
Deliver success
 Who We Are 
GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). 
At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.
 EEO Statement 
GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!
