title: Revenue Operations & GTM Systems Lead
description:
About Threecolts
 Threecolts is a software suite built for consumer brands, helping them recover revenue, operate more efficiently and grow across major retailers and marketplaces.
Our largest business, Margin Pro, helps brands recover money owed to them by retailers and marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart and Target by managing disputes on their behalf. Alongside this, we’re building and scaling newer products, including AI Operator and Retail 365, while continuing to grow our portfolio of subscription products across our customer base.
 Who We Are 
 We’re a global team of 340 people across 33 teams, having grown through 24 acquisitions. We operate with a flat structure, giving people real ownership and the ability to move quickly. AI is embedded in how we work across the business, helping us increase speed, improve quality and operate at scale.
 🔥 What you'll do
Translate evolving commercial strategies, commercial workflows, and executive directives into scalable, rock-solid Salesforce architecture and automated flows.
Own end-to-end CRM architecture, designing, building, and maintaining custom objects, complex flows, and third-party integrations across the full customer lifecycle (acquisition, partner attribution, contracting, expansion, and renewals).
Partner closely with DataOps to ingest, model, and maintain data pipelines flowing into Salesforce from our core platform (Threecolts Hub) and financial systems (Sage, Stripe), ensuring object schemas and field mappings stay synchronized so commercial teams see reliable, real-time product usage and billing data.
Lead technical scoping, build, testing, and deployment for cross-functional initiatives across Sales, Account Management, Finance, and Operations.
Work with commercial teams to understand challenges across lead management, pipeline visibility, forecasting, and the customer lifecycle, translating these into practical systems and process improvements.
Enforce operational hygiene, data validation rules, and system governance to ensure business logic remains reliable as the commercial model evolves.
Maintain system documentation, technical change logs, and deployment workflows so platform enhancements are predictable and transparent across engineering and operations.
Continuously audit our commercial tech stack, identifying cost-reduction opportunities and executing seamless vendor migrations without disrupting rep workflows.
Actively contribute to internal planning, team process design, and systems architecture roadmaps, identifying cross-functional bottlenecks and proposing scalable operational solutions that accelerate team execution and capability.
 😊 About You
6–8+ years of hands-on Salesforce development/advanced administration experience (expertise well beyond basic setup/maintenance).
Experience working within Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Systems, with a strong understanding of how commercial teams operate and how systems support revenue performance.
Commercially minded, with the ability to understand challenges across pipeline management, forecasting, lead conversion, and renewals, and translate these into effective Salesforce solutions.
Able to identify process inefficiencies, challenge stakeholder requirements, and recommend improvements based on business impact, rather than simply delivering what is requested.
You've led complex cross-functional builds end to end, from scoping through build.
You have a demonstrated track record designing scalable data models and modern workflow automations in complex enterprise CRM environments.
You have a proven track record of sitting with operational and business leaders, taking ambiguous business models or rapid process changes, and independently translating them into elegant technical designs without needing hand-holding.
You understand relational database structures and event-based tracking. You treat the CRM as a critical upstream node in the company’s data pipeline and actively coordinate schema changes with DataOps before deployment.
You are technically minded – working with technology, systems, and tools is something that gives you energy. You stay up to date naturally on the latest developments in tech across Salesforce, AI, and related technologies.
You have previously worked in a high-growth environment (startup and/or scaleup) in a build phase and are comfortable with ambiguity.
 💼 Technical & Tooling Competencies
Proven mastery of relational database design, custom object schemas, complex validation rules, field-level security, and Governor limit management.
Proven experience leveraging native enterprise-tier capabilities (high governor limits, developer sandboxes, Einstein features/ECI, advanced pipeline inspection) to consolidate tech stack bloat and avoid unnecessary external SaaS purchases.
Deep hands-on experience or rapid technical aptitude with Sweep for visual business logic modeling, automated routing, dependency tracking, and staging-to-production deployment, prioritizing centralized orchestration over fragmented native Flow sprawl.
Demonstrated experience working as an upstream recipient of data pipelines. Fluent in relational concepts to cleanly ingest and map product and financial data (Stripe, Sage) via webhooks, REST APIs, or middleware without breaking validation rules.
Proven track record of executing rip-and-replace, vendor consolidation, and cost-reduction projects across the revenue stack (e.g., migrating conversation intelligence from Gong to Fireflies, consolidating e-signature tools, swapping enrichment providers). Skilled at data archival, license optimization, and end-user cutover management.
Hands-on experience integrating Salesforce with Slack for automated commercial deal alerts, approval workflows, and rep notification channels; comfortable connecting data feeds across enrichment, marketing automation, and internal operational bots.
Advanced proficiency with SF Inspector, Data Loader, Workbench, and spreadsheet modeling (Google Sheets/Excel) for mass data remediation, deduplication, and historical audits.

title: GTM Campaign Manager
description:
Job DescriptionJob Description
Procurify is the agentic procurement platform that helps mid-market organizations get complete control over their spend. We're trusted by hundreds of companies around the world, across industries like biotechnology, education, health care, manufacturing, and software, to manage over $100B in spend. We're looking for a driven, systems-minded, and execution-focused GTM Campaign Manager to join us on our journey.
 About the Role 
As a GTM Campaign Manager, you will architect and operate the campaign systems that convert pipeline strategy into pipeline reality. Working directly under GTM Engineering, you'll build, launch, and continuously optimize the campaigns and targeted lists that feed our go-to-market teams — across every source of pipeline: inbound, outbound, tier/segment, and expansion (cross-sell/upsell) .
Think of this role as a regulator's right hand . Procurify's pipeline comes from multiple, interdependent sources, and the business's #1 constraint is total pipeline coverage against our revenue targets. Rather than owning any single channel in isolation, you'll help balance effort dynamically across all of them — surging outbound when inbound softens, activating expansion campaigns against the install base, and calibrating targeting by segment so we maximize total pipeline, not just one number.
We're looking for someone who thinks from first principles — questioning why a campaign, list, or process exists, breaking it down to its fundamentals, and rebuilding it in ways that are simpler, faster, and more scalable. This is not a role for someone who runs one-off campaigns and moves on. We want a systems thinker who sees how targeting, data, messaging, and channels connect — and who designs campaign engines that compound in value over time rather than resetting from zero every quarter. The best campaign is often the one you can systematize and automate away.
This role also sits at the intersection of campaign execution and our evolution as an AI-enhanced platform. You'll champion how AI and automation can eliminate manual list-building, generate and personalize outreach at scale, surface which segments and plays are converting, and free human effort for the highest-leverage pipeline. If you see systems where others see silos, and you believe the best process is one you can automate, you'll thrive here.
We're also looking for someone relentless about the "last mile." Strategy without clean execution and closed-loop communication is worthless — the difference between a booked meeting and a lead sitting untouched. You'll own that last mile as a system : build the list, launch the campaign, hand it off cleanly, communicate it clearly, and measure what actually happened — then feed those learnings back into the engine.
This is not a systems-administration role (that's RevOps), a people-management role (that's BDR leadership), or a strategy-and-budget role (that's Demand Gen leadership). This is the connective tissue that all of those functions rely on but none of them owns: turning targeting, positioning, systems, and AI into campaigns that drive real pipeline.
 What you'll be working on: 
 Campaign Systems Across All Pipeline Sources 
Design and operate repeatable, scalable campaign systems — not one-offs — that generate pipeline across inbound, outbound, tier/segment, and expansion.
Build and deliver targeted, ICP-aligned lead lists to BDRs proactively and on a repeatable cadence — increasingly automated and AI-generated — as the single most reliable driver of booked meetings.
Design, launch, and optimize outbound campaigns end-to-end for both new-business and expansion pipeline, using automation and AI to scale personalization and volume without sacrificing quality.
Support inbound performance by iterating and building on systems that improve MQL→SQL conversion.
Build expansion (cross-sell/upsell) campaign systems against the existing customer base in partnership with Customer Success and Account Management — a large, under-served pipeline source today.
Calibrate campaign targeting by tier/segment (SMB vs. mid-market) to protect and maximize total pipeline, not just a single tier.
 Pipeline Coverage & Rebalancing (Under GTM Leadership) 
Help monitor pipeline coverage across all sources as a connected system , and reallocate campaign effort to the highest-leverage source as conditions shift.
Work from the operational math: track conversion rates by source (MQL→SAL→SQL→pipeline $), model where the leverage is, and use data and automation to drive proactive intervention through GTM led efforts.
Flag pipeline softness early , so the business can compensate proactively rather than discovering gaps a quarter too late.
 AI, Automation & First-Principles Optimization 
Apply first-principles thinking to identify and remove friction in how campaigns are built, launched, and handed off — automating the repeatable and reserving human effort for high-value plays.
Champion AI and automation across the campaign lifecycle: list generation, enrichment, segmentation, message personalization, sequence optimization, and performance analysis.
Continuously deconstruct and rebuild campaign processes to be faster, simpler, and more scalable as we grow.
 Last-Mile Ownership & Closed-Loop Execution 
Ensure clean, automated hand-offs to BDRs and AEs — leads loaded, listed, assigned, and communicated so nothing sits un-worked.
Support data fidelity across platforms (Salesforce, Marketo, sequencing, enrichment tools) as a power user of the systems RevOps builds.
Define and track measurable outcomes per campaign and per source (SAL, SQL, pipeline $) so "what good looks like" is always explicit — and feed learnings back into the system.
 Collaboration & Cross-System Alignment 
Partner with Marketing, RevOps, Product Marketing, Sales, BDR leadership, and Customer Success to align targeting, messaging, and campaign execution across the funnel.
Apply existing positioning and personas to concrete targeting — and flag when segment/positioning shifts appear to be suppressing high-converting traffic.
Work cleanly across teams without owning any of their core mandates — you are the systems builder and connector, not the administrator or the people manager.
 KPIs for Success 
Increased qualified pipeline creation across all sources (inbound, outbound, tier, expansion), measured in SQLs and pipeline $ — accelerated by AI and automation.
Consistent, proactive delivery of high-quality targeted lists to BDRs and AE’s — with measurable lift in meeting production.
Improved conversion efficiency across the funnel (session→MQL, MQL→SQL, SAL→SQL).
Growth in expansion/upsell pipeline generated through structured, repeatable campaign systems.
Reduced manual effort per campaign through automation and systematization.
Zero leads lost to poor hand-off — clean, closed-loop execution with no items sitting un-worked.
Early, accurate surfacing of pipeline-coverage risk against targets.
 Who we're looking for: 
1–3 years in a campaign management, demand generation, sales development, or GTM operations role (or a sharp, high-potential candidate ready to grow into it under mentorship).
A systems thinker who sees how people, processes, tools, and data connect — and who designs for scale rather than one-off fixes.
A first-principles problem solver who questions assumptions, deconstructs complex processes, and rebuilds them more efficiently.
 Genuine enthusiasm for AI and automation — with a track record (or strong interest) in using them to eliminate manual work and amplify pipeline output.
 ICP, persona, and tier fluency — able to independently determine who to target and why , and translate positioning into executable campaign systems.
Quantitatively strong — can track conversion rates and pipeline coverage across sources and understand where the leverage is (this is a math + systems + execution role, not execution alone).
 Proactive, closed-loop communicator — flags blockers early and asks for help rather than silently stalling.
Comfortable rebalancing priorities as conditions change; thrives in ambiguity with strong organization.
Working knowledge of CRM (Salesforce) and sales/marketing automation (Marketo, Outreach/sequencing, enrichment tools like ZoomInfo/Clay).
Strong project management, organization, and communication skills, with an impeccable eye for detail.
Bonus: Experience in high-growth SaaS; familiarity with Gong, Clay, ZoomInfo, AI/automation tooling, or enablement platforms.
For customer-facing or GTM roles, maintains an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensures it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect their role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.
 WHY PROCURIFY? 
 Help us modernize spend management 
Procurify is redefining how organizations manage spend - transforming a historically manual, reactive process into a strategic advantage. Today, hundreds of companies trust us to manage billions in spend, and we’re just getting started.

description:

 About the Role 
As a GTM Campaign Manager, you will architect and operate the campaign systems that convert pipeline strategy into pipeline reality. Working directly under GTM Engineering, you'll build, launch, and continuously optimize the campaigns and targeted lists that feed our go-to-market teams — across every source of pipeline: inbound, outbound, tier/segment, and expansion (cross-sell/upsell) .
Think of this role as a regulator's right hand . Procurify's pipeline comes from multiple, interdependent sources, and the business's #1 constraint is total pipeline coverage against our revenue targets. Rather than owning any single channel in isolation, you'll help balance effort dynamically across all of them — surging outbound when inbound softens, activating expansion campaigns against the install base, and calibrating targeting by segment so we maximize total pipeline, not just one number.
We're looking for someone who thinks from first principles — questioning why a campaign, list, or process exists, breaking it down to its fundamentals, and rebuilding it in ways that are simpler, faster, and more scalable. This is not a role for someone who runs one-off campaigns and moves on. We want a systems thinker who sees how targeting, data, messaging, and channels connect — and who designs campaign engines that compound in value over time rather than resetting from zero every quarter. The best campaign is often the one you can systematize and automate away.
This role also sits at the intersection of campaign execution and our evolution as an AI-enhanced platform. You'll champion how AI and automation can eliminate manual list-building, generate and personalize outreach at scale, surface which segments and plays are converting, and free human effort for the highest-leverage pipeline. If you see systems where others see silos, and you believe the best process is one you can automate, you'll thrive here.
We're also looking for someone relentless about the "last mile." Strategy without clean execution and closed-loop communication is worthless — the difference between a booked meeting and a lead sitting untouched. You'll own that last mile as a system : build the list, launch the campaign, hand it off cleanly, communicate it clearly, and measure what actually happened — then feed those learnings back into the engine.
This is not a systems-administration role (that's RevOps), a people-management role (that's BDR leadership), or a strategy-and-budget role (that's Demand Gen leadership). This is the connective tissue that all of those functions rely on but none of them owns: turning targeting, positioning, systems, and AI into campaigns that drive real pipeline.

 Campaign Systems Across All Pipeline Sources 
Design and operate repeatable, scalable campaign systems — not one-offs — that generate pipeline across inbound, outbound, tier/segment, and expansion.
Build and deliver targeted, ICP-aligned lead lists to BDRs proactively and on a repeatable cadence — increasingly automated and AI-generated — as the single most reliable driver of booked meetings.
Design, launch, and optimize outbound campaigns end-to-end for both new-business and expansion pipeline, using automation and AI to scale personalization and volume without sacrificing quality.
Support inbound performance by iterating and building on systems that improve MQL→SQL conversion.
Build expansion (cross-sell/upsell) campaign systems against the existing customer base in partnership with Customer Success and Account Management — a large, under-served pipeline source today.
Calibrate campaign targeting by tier/segment (SMB vs. mid-market) to protect and maximize total pipeline, not just a single tier.
 Pipeline Coverage & Rebalancing (Under GTM Leadership) 
Help monitor pipeline coverage across all sources as a connected system , and reallocate campaign effort to the highest-leverage source as conditions shift.
Work from the operational math: track conversion rates by source (MQL→SAL→SQL→pipeline $), model where the leverage is, and use data and automation to drive proactive intervention through GTM led efforts.
Flag pipeline softness early , so the business can compensate proactively rather than discovering gaps a quarter too late.
 AI, Automation & First-Principles Optimization 
Apply first-principles thinking to identify and remove friction in how campaigns are built, launched, and handed off — automating the repeatable and reserving human effort for high-value plays.
Champion AI and automation across the campaign lifecycle: list generation, enrichment, segmentation, message personalization, sequence optimization, and performance analysis.
Continuously deconstruct and rebuild campaign processes to be faster, simpler, and more scalable as we grow.
 Last-Mile Ownership & Closed-Loop Execution 
Ensure clean, automated hand-offs to BDRs and AEs — leads loaded, listed, assigned, and communicated so nothing sits un-worked.
Support data fidelity across platforms (Salesforce, Marketo, sequencing, enrichment tools) as a power user of the systems RevOps builds.
Define and track measurable outcomes per campaign and per source (SAL, SQL, pipeline $) so "what good looks like" is always explicit — and feed learnings back into the system.
 Collaboration & Cross-System Alignment 
Partner with Marketing, RevOps, Product Marketing, Sales, BDR leadership, and Customer Success to align targeting, messaging, and campaign execution across the funnel.
Apply existing positioning and personas to concrete targeting — and flag when segment/positioning shifts appear to be suppressing high-converting traffic.
Work cleanly across teams without owning any of their core mandates — you are the systems builder and connector, not the administrator or the people manager.
 KPIs for Success 
Increased qualified pipeline creation across all sources (inbound, outbound, tier, expansion), measured in SQLs and pipeline $ — accelerated by AI and automation.
Consistent, proactive delivery of high-quality targeted lists to BDRs and AE’s — with measurable lift in meeting production.
Improved conversion efficiency across the funnel (session→MQL, MQL→SQL, SAL→SQL).
Growth in expansion/upsell pipeline generated through structured, repeatable campaign systems.
Reduced manual effort per campaign through automation and systematization.
Zero leads lost to poor hand-off — clean, closed-loop execution with no items sitting un-worked.
Early, accurate surfacing of pipeline-coverage risk against targets.
 Who we're looking for: 
1–3 years in a campaign management, demand generation, sales development, or GTM operations role (or a sharp, high-potential candidate ready to grow into it under mentorship).
A systems thinker who sees how people, processes, tools, and data connect — and who designs for scale rather than one-off fixes.
A first-principles problem solver who questions assumptions, deconstructs complex processes, and rebuilds them more efficiently.
 Genuine enthusiasm for AI and automation — with a track record (or strong interest) in using them to eliminate manual work and amplify pipeline output.
 ICP, persona, and tier fluency — able to independently determine who to target and why , and translate positioning into executable campaign systems.
Quantitatively strong — can track conversion rates and pipeline coverage across sources and understand where the leverage is (this is a math + systems + execution role, not execution alone).
 Proactive, closed-loop communicator — flags blockers early and asks for help rather than silently stalling.
Comfortable rebalancing priorities as conditions change; thrives in ambiguity with strong organization.
Working knowledge of CRM (Salesforce) and sales/marketing automation (Marketo, Outreach/sequencing, enrichment tools like ZoomInfo/Clay).
Strong project management, organization, and communication skills, with an impeccable eye for detail.
Bonus: Experience in high-growth SaaS; familiarity with Gong, Clay, ZoomInfo, AI/automation tooling, or enablement platforms.
For customer-facing or GTM roles, maintains an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensures it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect their role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.

title: Senior Revenue Operations & Analytics Director
description:
About Us 
Scorpion is the leading provider of technology and services helping local businesses thrive. We do this by helping customers understand local market dynamics, make the most of their marketing, and deliver experiences their customers will love. We offer tools to know what’s going on with marketing, competitors, and customers. We offer a unique blend of AI support and teams of real human people with local expertise committed to customer success. At Scorpion, we are ready to do whatever it takes to help our clients reach their goals. Our technology and personalized tools bring everything together to help local businesses easily understand their unique business, market, and customer needs. We put SEO, Reviews, Advertising, Email Marketing, Chat and Messaging, Social Media, Website, Lead Management, Appointment Scheduling, and more to work for local businesses. We’re a technology-led service with a human touch.
About the Role
As Senior Revenue Operations & Analytics Director, you'll play a critical role in building and optimizing the systems, data, and processes that power Scorpion's revenue organization. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, with a dotted line to the Chief Marketing Officer, you'll be responsible for establishing a scalable Revenue Operations function that supports predictable revenue growth and informed business decisions.
This is a senior-level individual contributor role for someone who thrives on building solutions, solving complex problems, and turning data into business impact. With support from a Salesforce admin, you'll take hands-on ownership of our Revenue Operations infrastructure, from data architecture and systems integration to forecasting, analytics, reporting, and process optimization.
You'll also help advance how Scorpion leverages AI and automation, identifying and implementing solutions that streamline workflows, improve data accuracy, increase productivity, and strengthen revenue insights.
Beyond building and maintaining the infrastructure, you'll serve as a strategic advisor to our General Managers and executive leadership team. You'll analyze revenue performance, identify risks and growth opportunities, and translate complex data into actionable recommendations that influence business strategy.
You'll collaborate closely with Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Finance, Customer Success, and Product to connect data and processes across the customer journey, driving improvements through technical expertise and cross functional influence rather than traditional people management.
 What Your Success Will Look Like 
Revenue Data and Analytics
Build and manage revenue data architecture across Marketing and Sales, ensuring accurate, reliable, and accessible information.
Develop dashboards, reporting, and analytics that provide visibility into revenue performance, trends, and opportunities, including insights for business reviews and QBRs.
Establish data quality standards and governance processes to improve the consistency and reliability of revenue data.
Translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations and partner with stakeholders to implement improvements.
Forecasting and Planning
Own revenue forecasting and pipeline inspection processes to improve sales predictability and accountability.
Develop and maintain forecasting models, analyzing pipeline health, conversion rates, and attainment to identify risks and opportunities.
Partner with Finance and the CRO on quota setting, compensation planning, attainment analysis, and scenario modeling.
Systems and AI Enablement
Own the architecture, integration, and optimization of Salesforce and the broader go to market technology stack in partnership with Marketing Operations.
Oversee Salesforce administration with support from a dedicated contractor and external partners, ensuring systems are reliable, scalable, and aligned with business needs.
Identify and implement AI and automation solutions across pipeline generation, deal inspection, forecasting, lead scoring, conversation intelligence, and seller enablement.
Drive adoption of AI tools and automated workflows, measuring their impact on operational efficiency, productivity, and revenue performance.
Revenue Operations and Process
Design and improve processes across the revenue funnel, including handoffs between Marketing and Sales.
Partner with Customer Success and Finance to analyze onboarding, early churn indicators, retention, and expansion opportunities.
Strategic Influence and Partnership 
Partner with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Product on revenue priorities and opportunities.
Present revenue performance, forecasts, trends, and recommendations to the executive stakeholders.
Lead cross functional initiatives through collaboration, technical expertise, and influence rather than formal reporting authority.
 Who You Are And What You Bring
 Education 
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Analytics, or a related field or a related field.
 Experience 
8+ years of experience of Revenue Operations experience, including hands-on ownership of systems, data architecture, analytics, and operational infrastructure.
Proven experience independently designing, implementing, and optimizing RevOps systems, forecasting models, reporting, integrations, and automation.
Experience leveraging AI and automation to improve operational efficiency, analytical capabilities, and revenue performance.
Experience analyzing complex revenue data and translating findings into actionable business recommendations for senior executives.
Experience developing and owning revenue forecasting models and improving forecast accuracy.
Experience partnering with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and other cross functional stakeholders to connect revenue data and improve business performance.
 Skills 
Advanced technical expertise: Deep understanding of revenue systems, data architecture, integrations, and automation, with the ability to independently design, build, and troubleshoot solutions.
Salesforce expertise: Strong hands on knowledge of Salesforce administration, configuration, integrations, data modeling, and optimization.
Data analytics and business intelligence: Advanced SQL proficiency and hands on experience building dashboards, analytical models, and reporting using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
AI and automation: Ability to identify, implement, and optimize AI powered solutions and automated workflows that improve efficiency, forecasting, and decision making.
Strategic business acumen: Ability to interpret complex revenue data, identify business opportunities and risks, and develop recommendations that influence growth strategies.
Executive communication: Ability to translate technical findings into clear, compelling insights and actionable recommendations for General Managers and executive leadership.
Independent execution: Comfortable owning complex technical and analytical initiatives from design through implementation and ongoing optimization.
Cross functional collaboration: Ability to partner effectively with existing Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Finance, and other business teams without direct management authority.
Our Scorpion Values
 Winning Mindset: When our clients win, we win.
 Genuine Care: We only succeed when we are truly invested in our clients and each other.
 Unmatched Results: We deliver more than expected–and then some–driving the best results and impacting lives.
 Constant Improvement: We believe there is always a better way. We learn we ask “What if?” we build and then do it again.
 Unbeatable Teamwork: We come from different backgrounds but have the same vision. We only get there by doing it together, as a team.
Compensation 
We acknowledge that states have passed legislation promoting pay transparency. As a national employer, Scorpion has made the decision to post our expected pay rate or pay range (as applicable) in all our job postings, regardless of geographic location.
The base salary is $150,000 (entry-level) - $180,000 (highly experienced). This position's base salary + annual variable is $165,000 (entry-level) - $198,000 (highly experienced), exclusive of fringe benefits. If you are hired at Scorpion, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience. Additionally, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider the internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the total salary + annual variable range for the role. Hiring at the maximum of the range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth.
Our Benefits
We invest in our employees by offering them diverse benefits from best-in-class carriers. These benefits provide enough choice and flexibility to keep our employees and their families healthy and happy—today and tomorrow.
100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance
Flexible paid time off, so you can rest, relax, and recharge away from work
Paid parental leave
Paid cell phone and service
Remote office allowance
Professional development and development courses
Regular manager check-ins to drive performance and career growth through Lattice
 Work Location & Flexibility 
Scorpion supports a range of work arrangements, including in-office, hybrid, and remote roles. For positions designated as remote, employees who live within commuting distance of a Scorpion office may be asked to work from the office based on team needs, collaboration opportunities, or business priorities. Specific expectations will be discussed during the interview process.
 Equal Opportunity Employer 
Scorpion is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or physical or mental disability. We believe in creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion.
 [Reasonable Accommodations] 
 Applicant Privacy 
When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to Scorpion. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Privacy Notice . This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

Scorpion participates in the E-Verify program to confirm employment authorization of all newly hired employees. The E-Verify process is completed during new hire onboarding and completion of the Form I-9, Employment Eligibility Verification, at the start of employment. E-Verify is not used as a tool to pre-screen candidates. For more information on E-Verify, please visit www.uscis.gov .

Backed by $180M+ in total funding, including a $125M Series C led by Norwest, with participation from SoftBank Vision Fund 2 and Microsoft's M12, Zenity is trusted by Fortune 500 and Global 2000 enterprises worldwide.
 Join us in shaping how AI agents are secured at enterprise scale. 
What You’ll Do
﻿Own the full technical and strategic success of Zenity’s accounts, serving as the primary technical and customer-facing resource post-sale.
Lead complex, multi-party enterprise engagements across deployment, integrations, budgeting cycles, governance approvals, and long-term platform expansion.
Coordinate joint account motions involving customer stakeholders, Zenity internal teams, and large technology platform teams, ensuring alignment on strategy, integrations, and long-term value realization.
Run strategic reviews that clearly articulate security program improvements, roadmap alignment, integration progress, and expansion opportunities.
Serve as the voice of the customer to Product, Engineering, Sales, and Field Engineering to streamline complex motions and reduce internal friction.
Own high-impact technical escalations end-to-end, maintaining executive visibility while driving resolution across internal teams.
Translate sophisticated requirements into structured success plans, identifying technical risks, integration dependencies, and phased deployment strategies.
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to surface customer insights that influence roadmap direction and support the continued evolution of Zenity’s platform.

Requirements
 What You've Done

 Strongly preferred

What We Look For At Zenity
Ownership mindset, with accountability for customer outcomes rather than activity.
Executive presence and analytical thinking, whether you're in a technical working session or a leadership review.
Comfort in a fast-moving startup where structure is still maturing, and the energy to help build it.
Interview Process
Our interview process is designed to be transparent, conversational, and focused on real-world experience.

Compensation
The expected OTE range for this role is $210,000–$230,000, depending on experience, skills, and location. In addition to base compensation, this role may be eligible for equity and performance-based incentives.
Zenity is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We enable enterprises to adopt AI agents securely and at scale, and that starts with building a team that reflects a wide range of perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where talented people can do their best work, securely, confidently, and with impact.

title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations and Compensation
description:
Traditional surveys fall short in today’s world. That’s why we built ThoughtExchange, a platform powered by cutting-edge AI that helps leaders meaningfully connect with their communities and uncover immediate, actionable insights that drive real change.
We empower K12 leaders with the high-quality data they need to make informed decisions and create lasting impact. Our mission fuels everything we do, and we’re proud to work alongside a team of brilliant, curious, and collaborative individuals.
At ThoughtExchange, we’re reshaping how organizations engage their people for good. If you’re passionate about making a difference, we’d love to have you on the journey.
We are looking for a Senior Manager, Revenue Operations and Compensation at ThoughtExchange. This person is a Revenue Operations leader who also owns variable compensation for our revenue organization. You'll partner with revenue leaders on strategic and operational projects, analytics, planning, and our revenue operating rhythm. You'll also design and run incentive plans that drive the right behaviours, stay affordable, and scale with the business.
Reporting to the VP of Strategy & Operations, you'll work with the wider RevOps team (CS Ops, Sales & Marketing Ops, and our Data Scientist). When something breaks in a revenue process, you'll coordinate the fix across Sales, District Success, Marketing, Finance, People, and BI.
 What You’ll Do
Partner with revenue leaders on strategic and operational projects that improve productivity and efficiency, keep revenue teams aligned, and measure how new initiatives perform.
Support the revenue operating rhythm, including the bi-weekly forecast, monthly performance summaries, QBRs, and KPI tracking.
Work with revenue leaders, Finance, and People to design annual (July to June) and in-year incentive plans for all incentive roles, turning priorities like retention, multi-year renewals, and new business into plan mechanics.
Model plan economics (cost of sales, pay mix against OTE, payout curves at different attainment levels) so plans work, fit each role's variable budget, and scale.
Run the monthly commissions close in CaptivateIQ: data validation, plan processing, accrual review with Finance, rep statements, and the payroll handoff.
Keep plans, data, and users in CaptivateIQ accurate and auditable, and keep extending how much of the close is automated.
Apply commission rules consistently, and manage rep inquiries, disputes, exceptions, and clawbacks through the Quotas & Commissions governance process.
Own commission letters and plan rollouts, from rates and prorations through stakeholder sign-off and team presentations.
Track how well plans work (attainment distribution, payout vs. performance, cost vs. forecast) and recommend changes.
Work with CS Ops, Sales & Marketing Ops, and the Salesforce team to build systems and processes that simplify daily workflows, cut errors, and drive adoption.
Partner with the Data Scientist, BI, and Salesforce teams to give revenue leaders insights and clear recommendations on rep workflows, performance, and strategic initiatives.
Help rationalize the revenue tech stack to cut cost and complexity, and keep revenue systems, processes, and data easy to inspect and audit.
Contribute to annual planning with Operations leadership and Finance, including territory design and quota setting, and keep quotas aligned with commission plans.
 What We’re Looking For
6+ years in Sales Compensation and/or Revenue Operations at a B2B SaaS company, with meaningful experience in both broader RevOps and incentive compensation.
Experience supporting forecasting, planning, and revenue operations across Sales, Customer Success, and Finance.
Hands-on experience administering commissions in CaptivateIQ (strongly preferred) or a similar ICM platform (e.g., Spiff, Xactly, QuotaPath), including building plans in the tool.
A track record of designing incentive plans for new business, renewal/retention, and expansion roles, and measuring their impact.
Strong financial modelling skills: plan cost, payout scenarios, OTE and pay mix, quota capacity.
Solid command of SaaS revenue metrics (ARR, ACV, TCV, NRR/GRR) and how plan and process design affect them.
Strong Salesforce knowledge (opportunity, renewal, and invoice data; reporting). SOQL/SQL or BI tool experience is an asset.
Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills. Experience with scripting or AI-assisted automation (e.g., Python, Claude) is an asset.
Experience leading cross-functional process improvements from diagnosis to adoption.
Able to hold a firm line on plan integrity and cost while keeping strong relationships with revenue leaders.
Clear communicator who can explain complex plan mechanics simply.
The salary range for this position is $120,758 -142,068 CAD per year. Your specific compensation within this range is determined based on your job-related skills, knowledge, experience, and our internal equity assessment.
This job posting is for an actual vacancy.
We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) to screen resumes or evaluate candidate fit against job criteria. All interview and hiring decisions are made by people.
If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed in the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out, apply, and tell us more about yourself in your application. Research has shown that some individuals only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We are committed to removing obstacles to ensure we have the best talent.
ThoughtExchange prioritizes accessibility. Support is available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the selection process. Finally, we know from time to time, emergencies happen, and you may need to reschedule an interview - we understand and encourage you to be in communication without worrying about losing the opportunity or your credibility.
 What We Offer
 ThoughtExchange wants to ensure our people are heard, supported, and cared for, so we invest in our employees. We continuously ask our employees what they need to ensure we're supporting their successes in the workplace and in life.
 We Are Proud To Offer Our Employees The Following
 Benefits & Well-Being: From day one, you’ll receive a benefits package focused on health & wellness that includes a generous time off policy, flexible extended benefits plan options, and company-wide wellness days off scheduled throughout the year. Our benefits package also includes maternity & parental leave top-up programs, as well as access to Maple & Inklbot, which support our employees' primary care, mental health, and wellness needs.
 Flexibility: We’ve been remote-first for over ten years. We’re contribution-focused and operate on mutual trust because we need you to feel empowered to be your best self. You know the circumstances in which you excel—where you work and how you structure your day.

We value and prioritize everyone’s voice, so we use our anonymous, anti-bias platform to ensure people feel comfortable sharing their genuine thoughts and feedback.
 Compensation: We want you to do your best work, and part of that is being happy with your compensation. We pay fairly, considering the complexities of market rates, experience, location, and demand. We believe in pay transparency and pay equity. In addition to competitive pay and benefits, employees receive share options when joining the company.
 Connection: In addition to remote hubs of employees across Canada and the US and offices in Rossland and Vancouver, we get together as a company every few years in some pretty cool locations. We also connect virtually as a company every month and celebrate one another in our #gratitude Slack channel.

description:

Schedule and facilitate posting to both company and executives/SME LinkedIn profiles.

title: Associate Director, Global B2B Customer Success & Commercial Adoption
description:
Associate Director, Global B2B Customer Success & Commercial Adoption 
 Role Summary 
 Summary: Randstad is hiring a Global Associate Director of B2B Customer Success & Commercial Adoption to lead an international team across 30+ operating companies, driving global commercial enablement, customer lifetime value (LTV), and enterprise digital transformation. This executive leadership position oversees global strategy, sub-functional budget allocation, and high-stakes vendor contracts. 
 Location & Working Conditions 
 Primary Location: NL preferably (hybrid), central Europe (Remote) 
 Role Classification & Differentiation 
 Important Note: This is an Executive Strategy, P&L, & Line Management Leadership Role , NOT a hands-on account management, customer support, or content creation role. You will directly manage senior people managers, govern multi-market budgets, and advise regional OpCo Managing Directors and Executive Committee members. 
 Key Role Questions Answered 
 What You Will Achieve 
 Global Team Leadership: Directly lead, develop, and scale the global Customer Success organization, providing formal line management, performance governance, and talent coaching to senior specialists and regional managers. 
 Multi-Market Portfolio Governance: Co-own and drive the end-to-end strategic roadmap for B2B commercial enablement across 30+ operating companies, establishing standardized operating frameworks aligned with enterprise growth objectives. 
 Leadership Advisory: Partner directly with OpCo Managing Directors, Regional Commercial Heads, and Global Executive Leaders to accelerate sales cycles, expand digital revenue influence, and optimize client lifetime value (LTV). 
 Enterprise Transformation: Direct cross-functional alignment across Marketing, Sales, IT Services, Legal, and Product teams to overcome structural resistance and embed customer-centric digital capabilities across all business segments. 
 Key Metrics & Deliverables You'll Own 
 Budget & ROI Management: Hold direct accountability for sub-functional budget planning, capacity planning, and resource allocation; manage strategic partner and agency contracts to maximize program ROI. 
 Commercial Impact: Expand digital revenue influence and drive measurable customer lifetime value (LTV) across global operating companies. 
 Operational Excellence: Maintain rigorous line management and performance governance across cross-cultural international teams. 
 What You Need to Succeed 
 Experience: 10–12+ years of progressive commercial and operational leadership experience, with at least 5+ years of direct line management and people leadership across international B2B Go-To-Market (GTM), Customer Success, or Commercial Operations teams. 
 Enterprise Leadership: Proven track record governing commercial programs across a broad international footprint (30+ countries) and managing P&L/departmental budgets within large matrix enterprises. 
 Technical & MarTech Expertise: Deep command of customer success methodologies, sales enablement engines, enterprise MarTech platforms (HubSpot CRM, enterprise data models, business intelligence tooling), AI-enabled commercial workflows, and agile delivery principles. 
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or related field required; Master’s degree or MBA strongly preferred. 
 Communication: Fluency in English with executive-level communication, negotiation, and board presentation skills. 
 Randstad Leadership Principles & Culture

description:

With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. 
 About the role: 
Hi there! We're seeking a strategic and operationally excellent Senior Manager, Revenue Operations & Sales Commission to own the design, implementation, and governance of our enterprise sales compensation program. This senior-level individual contributor role reports to the VP of Revenue Operations and serves as the architect and steward of compensation strategy across our diverse go-to-market organization.
You'll partner with GTM Leadership, Finance, and People Operations to build world-class compensation programs that attract talent, drive the right behaviors, and align with business objectives. You'll manage the full lifecycle of compensation—from design through implementation, compliance, analytics, and continuous improvement—across Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Sales Leaders, Partner Managers, Customer Success Managers, Technical Account Managers and other functions on variable compensation plans.
Note: This role focuses on compensation design and operations. Our Finance team manages commission accounting and invoice processing in Xactly.
 What You Will Do 
Compensation Strategy & Design
Own the strategic design of annual sales compensation programs for all eligible roles and adjust for market conditions, competitive landscape, and business priorities
Benchmark compensation against market data and peer software companies; conduct pay equity analysis and recommend adjustments to ensure competitiveness and fairness
Design commission structures, accelerators, quotas, and incentive mechanics that drive desired sales behaviors and align with revenue goals
Design and own SPIFF and other incentive programs outside of the official incentive plan
Lead cross-functional design reviews with Sales, Finance, and executive leadership to validate programs before launch
Program Implementation & Operations
Manage the end-to-end program launch calendar; coordinate cross-functional efforts and communicate timelines, changes, and deadlines to stakeholders
Build and maintain the primary source of truth for all compensation program documentation, including plan documents, commission schedules, quota assignments, and policy guidelines
Configure compensation programs in Xactly and SFDC; validate data integrity, test calculations, and ensure system configurations reflect approved plan design
Develop training materials and lead training sessions for sales teams on compensation plan mechanics, commission calculations, and incentive rules
Governance & Compliance
Ensure compensation programs comply with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies across all geographies where we operate
Manage exceptions, disputes, and appeals related to commissions, quotas, and incentive payouts; work with VP RevOps, Finance and HR to resolve efficiently and fairly
Maintain audit trails and documentation for all material compensation decisions and changes
Analytics & Reporting
Build dashboards and reports to monitor role based performance metrics, compensation spend, payout distributions, plan attainment, and ROI on incentive investments. Including SPIFF reporting metrics
Conduct post-program analysis (win/loss, attainment distribution, program metrics) and deliver insights to leadership on plan effectiveness
Recommend program adjustments mid-year based on market shifts, business performance, and feedback from sales leaders
Cross-functional Collaboration
Partner with VP of RevOps to align compensation with business strategy and sales priorities; maintain regular feedback loops with Sales Leaders
Work directly with Commission Accounting on attainment data, payouts, calculations and discrepancies
Collaborate with Finance on budgeting, forecasting, and year-end reporting of incentive spend
Work with People Operations on equity, total rewards strategy, and talent retention initiatives
Communicate compensation strategy and changes to the broader organization with clarity and confidence
 What You Will Bring to the Role 
Required Qualifications
8+ years of progressive experience in sales compensation, incentive design, or related revenue operations roles (within software, SaaS, or enterprise sales environments preferred)
Demonstrated expertise in designing and managing compensation programs for multiple sales roles and structures
Advanced proficiency with sales compensation platforms (Xactly, Anaplan, SAP SuccessFactors, or equivalent); strong data analysis and Excel skills
Deep understanding of CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and comfort configuring objects, fields, and reporting for incentive programs
Strong project management and cross-functional collaboration skills; ability to influence without authority and manage competing priorities
Excellent communication and presentation skills; comfort translating complex compensation concepts for diverse audiences (sales teams, executives, finance, HR)
Meticulous attention to detail; strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Familiarity with GDPR, CCPA, and other employment law considerations affecting compensation (particularly for global organizations)
Preferred Qualifications
Experience managing compensation programs across multiple geographic regions with different regulatory requirements
Background in financial analysis, FP&A, or accounting; understanding of revenue recognition impacts on compensation timing
Exposure to Customer Success, Services, or other non-traditional sales comp models
Certification in compensation (e.g., WorldatWork CECP, GRP) or related HR disciplines
Experience at a high-growth or publicly traded software company
 This role is an existing vacancy

title: Sales Enablement Manager, Multi Location Sales - US - Remote
description:
Summary
 Yelp is looking for a Sales Enablement Manager to support our Emerging and Partner & Agency Sales team . Enablement is a critical part of growing our Multi Location Sales org. The Sales Enablement Manager will be revenue-focused, working in partnership with sales leadership to develop programming that aligns with sales strategies to drive sales outcomes, including increasing rep productivity rates and increasing GTM proficiency. 
 The ideal candidate has sales and/or enablement management experience, has excellent verbal and written skills, a collaborative approach, and has a strong interest in data. The Sales Enablement Manager will have experience building online (self-learning), virtual instructor-led and classroom based enablement curriculums for sales teams using an LMS and CMS. You will be responsible for creating innovative content and materials on topics like sales process/methodology, advertising products, forecasting and reporting systems, policies and processes, etc. that can be delivered through different methods. The Sales Enablement Manager will also be aware of current trends including AI and integrate them into the content & materials to make them relevant to today. 
 We’re looking for a strong communicator who excels at simplifying the complex to develop the training content, curriculum and programs that enable our sales people to be successful in their jobs. The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for creativity, collaboration, content creation and communications. 
 This role reports to the Sr. Director of Sales Enablement, Multi Location Sales and will be responsible for executing on the strategy including the programs, processes, practices and tools to enable our Emerging and Partner sales teams to effectively sell Yelp’s Advertising offerings. 
We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Yelp, we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes. This is a full-time remote role based in the United States.
What you'll do:
 You will create, design and execute enablement initiatives for our sales teams, both in classroom and virtual 
 Support ongoing development and certification programs for B2B sales teams including: facilitation, content creation, processes, practices, and tools needed to enable success 
 Develop metrics and reporting to demonstrate effectiveness and return on investment for key programs 
 Work in partnership with leaders across Yelp’s advertising business, including sales, customer success, operations, product, marketing, and more. 
 Utilize creative techniques and various delivery mechanisms to reach a distributed sales organization 
 You will iterate/maintain enablement materials as necessary 
 You will co-build, author and deliver materials for an internal wiki and newsletters 
 You will stay up to date on the Digital Marketing space, Yelp product, and sales best practices 
 You will gather feedback from the business to consistently improve enablement efforts 
What it takes to succeed:
 You have 5+ years of previous leadership experience within a sales or sales-adjacent team 
 3+ years Sales Enablement experience 
 You have excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills 
 You have experience with developing new enablement curriculum and collateral for instructor-led, eLearning learning, and self-directed learning modules 
 You have experience with building and launching AI tools for broad groups 
 You have experience with coordination, collaboration and organization with cross-functional teams 
 You excel at managing multiple projects at once, prioritization, have a strong attention to detail and are highly organized 
 You have a demonstrated ability to assess enablement effectiveness and contribute evidence demonstrating ROI to stakeholders and leaders 
 You have industry certifications in instructional design, curriculum development, performance improvement, and content-specific certifications as appropriate 
 Experience with advertising sales strongly preferred

Effective your first day: Full medical, vision, and dental 
15 days PTO (accrual begins on date of hire and increases with 2+ years of tenure thereafter), 12 paid holidays, plus one floating holiday
Up to 14 weeks of parental leave
Monthly wellness subsidy
Work from home reimbursement
Flexible spending account
401(k) retirement savings plan
Employee stock purchase plan

title: Revenue Operations Business Applications Manager
description:
At OneSpan , we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.
 Revenue Operations Business Applications Manager 
This role owns the operational backbone and field-readiness infrastructure of the GTM organization: wiring together the systems, integrations, and workflows that power the sales process, and building the enablement programs, content, and support model that keep the field self-sufficient. This is a systems and enablement role — it does not own executive or regional reporting, dashboards, KPI visibility, or field-facing data hygiene enforcement, which sit with the Sales Operations/Reporting function.
 Business Application Wiring 
Own end-to-end configuration and integration architecture across the GTM tech stack (Salesforce, Salesloft, ZoomInfo, Partner Portal, and adjacent tools), ensuring systems are correctly wired together and data flows cleanly between them.
Lead technical implementation of new tools, including configuration, integration build, sync/API health monitoring, and troubleshooting when systems break or drift out of sync.
Make recommendations on Salesforce architecture decisions related to data model design, automation (flows, validation rules, assignment rules), and deduplication logic — defining the business standards other teams build against.
Maintain living documentation of the tech stack: system-of-record map by data object, integration architecture diagrams, and admin runbooks for troubleshooting.
Own vendor technical relationships for GTM tools — evaluating new tools for integration feasibility, managing implementation timelines, and auditing feature utilization to inform renew/replace decisions.
Partner with IT/Engineering on system design for new or changing sales processes, translating business requirements into technical specifications and build plans.
 Enablement & Support 
Own the RevOps support queue end-to-end: triage tickets related to sales process, tooling, and Salesforce; identify recurring themes; and route root-cause fixes into process, tooling, or content changes.
Own onboarding architecture for new hires — structured ramp plans, tooling access, and milestone check-ins through the first 90 days.
Own the enablement content platform and knowledge base: information architecture, version control, and periodic content audits to retire stale material.
Identify and make recommendations to Leadership on tooling gaps and sales-facing material needs.
 Process & Documentation 
Build and maintain process documentation across the full lead-to-cash lifecycle, focused on how systems and tools support each stage from lead routing, opportunity management, approvals, contracting, and post-sale handoffs.
Identify operational bottlenecks and resolve them through process redesign, automation, or tooling changes.
Collaborate with RevOps on cross-functional process initiatives from problem definition through requirements, technical build, piloting, and rollout, partnering with leadership to shape the broader systems and process roadmap.
 Requirements 
5+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Systems, with a focus on Salesforce administration and systems architecture.
Deep hands-on Salesforce experience: data model design, automation build (flows, validation rules), integrations, and administrative configuration. Salesforce Admin certification a plus.
Experience implementing and integrating GTM tools such as Salesloft, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
Experience building and maintaining structured knowledge bases or enablement content platforms. SharePoint experience a plus.
Strong written communication skills for technical documentation and training content creation.
Advanced Excel proficiency for structured data work (formulas, pivot tables) — used for systems/data organization, not executive reporting.
Actively incorporates AI tools into daily workflows to work more efficiently, with strong fluency in applying new AI capabilities as they emerge
Strong sense of ownership and urgency, with a track record of taking initiative and operating comfortably in ambiguity.
Strong prioritization skills to manage competing technical and enablement requests across a varied, often unpredictable workload.
 Salary: $115,000 - $125,000 (depending on experience and qualifications)

title: Product Growth Marketing Manager, Lifecycle & GTM Systems
description:
About KidKare 
 The people who care for and feed children every day have enough on their plates. Their software shouldn't add to it. 
For more than 30 years, KidKare has built technology for the people behind childcare and child nutrition, helping them spend less time on paperwork, compliance, and administrative work and more time focused on the children and communities they serve.
Our roots run deep in the Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP), a federal nutrition program that helps provide healthy meals and snacks to children and adults across the country. Today, we're building on that expertise with a growing ecosystem of software supporting childcare organizations across food program compliance, business management, professional development, and licensing.
We're growing into new products, new markets, and have a much bigger vision for what KidKare can do for the childcare community. To support these goals, we're looking for a Product Growth Marketing Manager, Lifecycle & GTM Systems to build and run the engine that turns our product value into pipeline, adoption, and revenue.
 Position Summary 
This is an execution-first growth role.
You'll partner with Product and Revenue Operations leadership to define the positioning and value proposition for each product, then put them to work: translating individual product propositions and features into audience-specific messaging and deploying that messaging through various tactics. You’ll be involved in managing the CRM, data enrichment, prospect scoring, routing, & lifecycle marketing. You'll report to our VP of Revenue Operations and work across Product, Sales, and Customer Growth to turn every launch and feature release into measurable pipeline, adoption, and expansion.
In a given week you might ship a new CRM workflow, tune a fit-and-intent scoring model, launch a demand-gen test to a newly enriched segment, build an app telemtry guide for a feature release, fix a routing rule that's sending leads to the wrong queue, or walk leadership through what moved in the funnel and why.
 You'll build the machine, and you'll run it. 
You'll partner closely with our Digital Marketing Manager, who owns brand, creative, content, and channel execution. You'll own the systems, segmentation, lifecycle logic, experiment design, and measurement that make that work reach the right audience at the right moment. Together, you'll turn product and market insight into demand.
 Primary Responsibilities 
 Positioning, Feature Messaging & Launch Execution 
• Partner with product leadership to define and refine positioning and value propositions for each product and major release, grounded in customer, competitive, and market insight.
• Translate individual product features and releases into audience-specific messaging (the value, the proof, and the call to action) for each persona and segment we serve, carrying positioning down to the feature level.
• Execute launches through the systems you manage: target segments, lifecycle and nurture workflows, in-app guides, sales sequences and snippets, with launch tiers matched to the size of the release.
• Package features into the battlecards, talk tracks, and objection handling our Sales and Customer Growth teams need, delivered inside CRM where reps actually work.
 CRM Management & GTM Systems 
• Manage the CRM as the system of record for marketing and lifecycle: data model, custom properties, lifecycle stages, lead status, lists and segments, forms, and workflow automation.
• Maintain CRM data quality and governance, including deduplication, field standards, consistent deal stages across pipelines, and clear documentation, so Sales, Customer Growth, and leadership trust the data.
• Orchestrate the GTM stack (CRM, app telemtry, data enrichment, and automation tools) so product, marketing, and sales data flow cleanly between systems.
 Enrichment, AI Scoring & Routing 
• Build and maintain enrichment workflows that close firmographic, contact, and segment data gaps, including vertical-specific sources relating to childcare, education, and food program participation data.
• Design, deploy, and continuously tune fit, intent, and product-usage scoring models, using AI and predictive approaches where they outperform rules-based logic.
• Own lead and account routing rules, handoff SLAs, and alerts to Sales and Customer Growth, and monitor speed-to-lead and conversion by route.
 Demand Generation Experiments 
• Run a structured demand-gen experimentation program: define the hypothesis, audience, channel, offer, success metric, and decision rule before launch, then scale or move to the next experiment based on results.
• Build and execute campaigns, nurture tracks, and outbound sequences against enriched, scored segments, partnering with the Digital Marketing Manager on creative and channel execution.
• Use customer, competitive, and market insight to surface new segments and opportunities worth testing, and maintain a prioritized backlog and a visible results log so learnings compound.
 Lifecycle & In-App Engagement 
• Own lifecycle programs across the customer journey: onboarding, activation, feature adoption, cross-sell and expansion, renewal, and win-back.
• Build behavior-triggered journeys that combine CRM email and telemetry in-app guides, driven by product usage signals rather than calendar cadence alone.
• Partner with Product and Customer Growth to identify adoption gaps and cross-sell opportunities across our product portfolio, and run the programs that close them.
 Funnel Reporting & Measurement

 What Success Looks Like

 You'll Probably Love This Role If…

• You're comfortable owning your work end to end without needing a huge team around you.
• You're excited to build the GTM engine rather than inherit a finished one.
 Required Qualifications

• Strong funnel reporting and analytics skills: defining stages and conversion metrics, building dashboards, and working comfortably with data in spreadsheets or BI tools.
• Clear, concise writing, from lifecycle copy to experiment readouts to leadership summaries.
• Strong project management and systems thinking, with a habit of documenting what you build.
• A builder mentality and the ability to move comfortably between strategy and hands-on execution.
 Preferred Qualifications 
Experience with CACFP, childcare, child nutrition, education, government programs, or other regulated industries is a huge plus, but not a requirement.
CACFP has its own language, regulations, acronyms, and complexities. If you already know it, amazing. If you don't, you'll be surrounded by an exceptional team of people who do, and we'll help you get up to speed.
A few other things we'd love to see:
• Experience with vertical SaaS, multi-product portfolios, or marketing to both SMB and enterprise or public-sector buyers.
• CRM certifications (Marketing, Sales, or Operations related) or hands-on experience with CRM AI and data enrichment features.

• Comfort building AI-powered workflows for research, enrichment, scoring, and content variation. You know how to make AI your copilot, not your copywriter.
 Why KidKare? 
We're at an exciting inflection point, taking decades of experience in childcare and child nutrition and using it to build a broader ecosystem of products for the organizations and people who help care for our communities.
You won't be starting from scratch. We've invested deeply in understanding our customers, markets, competitors, and products. But we're not handing you a finished machine and asking you to keep it running.

If you want to own the systems, run the experiments, build the lifecycle, measure the funnel, and see exactly how your work moves pipeline and adoption, you'll have plenty to dig into here.

 Our Values

 Revenue Operations is a strategic growth engine at Clio, accountable for optimizing how we acquire, expand, and retain revenue globally. This role is responsible for translating company and GTM strategy into capacity plans, territories, quotas, and incentive design that drives the right outcomes across Sales, Channel, and Customer Success. You will operate as a strategic advisor to GTM and Finance leadership, balancing competitiveness, simplicity, scalability, and financial discipline.

Your work will directly influence revenue predictability, seller behavior, retention, and long-term growth.
What you’ll work on:
 GTM Planning, Capacity & Quotas
Leading GTM capacity planning and quota-setting, translating growth targets into coverage, headcount, and productivity plans across Sales and CS.

Owning quota exceptions, relief policies, and disputes, balancing consistency with practical business judgment.
 Territory Design & Maintenance

Translating revenue targets into coverage models and account assignments, and identifying where the organization is over- or under-covered and what needs to change.

 Compensation Strategy & Plan Design
Owning and evolving Clio's global GTM compensation and rewards strategy spanning SMB and Enterprise segments, partnering with Sales, Channel, and CS leadership to ensure alignment with company objectives, GTM motions, and growth stages.
Leading the design, modeling, and optimization of Sales and CS compensation plans, pay mix, quotas, accelerators, SPIFFs, and performance levers that drive desired behaviors, improve productivity, and support multi-year growth.

 Compensation Administration & Systems
Ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant compensation processing in partnership with Payroll, Finance, HR, Legal, and RevOps.
Establishing and maintaining compensation governance, principles, and decision frameworks to ensure consistency, fairness, and scalability.
Owning compensation communications, including plan documentation, guidelines, timelines, and appeals processes.
Leading the refinement, governance, and continuous improvement of Clio's compensation and commission system (Forma.ai), driving automation, self-service, and operational excellence across regions.
Championing automation, self-service, and AI capabilities across planning and compensation to improve accuracy, scalability, and stakeholder experience.
 Leadership & Team Development
Leading, coaching, and developing high-performing GTM planning and compensation teams, fostering accountability, strategic thinking, and continuous improvement.
Building scalable processes and operating rhythms, including the cross-functional planning calendar with Finance, HR, and GTM leadership, that enable the team to move from transactional execution to strategic impact.
Supporting change management for new plans, territories, tools, and policies across regions.
Serving as a role model for cross-functional partnership, ownership, and results-driven leadership.

8+ years of experience in SaaS or technology, with direct ownership of capacity planning, territory, quota, and compensation design.
Demonstrated ability to operate as a strategic advisor to senior GTM and Finance leaders.
Excellent executive-level communication skills, both written and verbal.
Experience leading and developing teams, with a focus on coaching and accountability.

Advanced Excel skills.

 What you will find here:
 Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

 As Director of Revenue Operations, you will lead Riva’s Revenue Operations function and team as an independent, enterprise-wide operating capability.
You will be accountable for the governance, measurement, Business Intelligence, forecasting, process architecture, systems strategy, and continuous improvement of Riva’s revenue engine. You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, IT, and the executive team while maintaining an enterprise-wide perspective on priorities and decisions.

Revenue Strategy, Planning & Performance
Partner with executive and functional leadership to translate company growth objectives into measurable revenue plans, operating metrics, and execution priorities. 
Establish and lead the operating cadence for revenue performance, including pipeline, forecast, bookings, ARR, retention, expansion, productivity, and other key SaaS metrics. 
Own and continuously improve revenue forecasting methodologies, processes, and governance to improve predictability and executive confidence. 
Develop the analytical frameworks required to understand revenue performance across segments, products, channels, cohorts, and stages of the customer lifecycle. 
Identify performance gaps, diagnose root causes, quantify business impact, and recommend actions to leadership. 
Partner closely with Finance on annual planning, forecasting, performance reporting, capacity planning, and the alignment of financial and operational revenue metrics. 
Support territory, quota, capacity, productivity, and compensation planning as Riva’s go-to-market organization evolves.

Develop and govern an executive KPI framework that establishes consistent definitions, methodologies, ownership, and sources of truth for key revenue metrics. 
Lead the development and adoption of dashboards, reporting, analytics, and self-service Business Intelligence that enable leaders and teams to make faster, better-informed decisions. 
Move reporting beyond describing what happened by providing insight into why performance changed, what is likely to happen next, and where action is required. 
Drive analysis across areas including pipeline health, conversion, sales productivity, segmentation, cohort performance, customer retention, churn, expansion, and go-to-market efficiency. 
Partner with technical and functional stakeholders to establish a scalable Revenue Intelligence architecture connecting Riva’s operational systems with its Business Intelligence capabilities.
