1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.
 About 1Password
 At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.
 If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.
 As Director, Global Field Sales Operations, you’ll partner with Sales and Revenue Operations leadership to run the operating rhythm of a global sales organization serving customers from Small and Medium-sized Businesses (SMB) through Enterprise across multiple regions. You’ll lead forecasting, pipeline management, planning, and productivity initiatives while building a scalable field operations function. By helping sales teams operate with greater clarity and consistency, you’ll support 1Password’s mission to help businesses protect what matters most with simple, human-centric security. Reporting to the Vice President, Revenue Operations, this role is remote in the USA or Canada.
 How We’re Using AI Today
 Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.
This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.
Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.
 What We're Looking For
 8+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, or sales strategy and operations within Business-to-Business (B2B) software, including 3+ years leading teams.
 Deep experience with sales forecasting, pipeline management, sales process, and operating rhythms across multiple segments.
 Experience leading annual planning, territory design, quota setting, and in-year adjustments.
 Experience supporting sales organizations across multiple regions, including Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA).
 Ability to build trusted relationships with senior Sales leaders, communicate clearly, and influence decisions using sound judgment and data.
 Experience hiring, developing, and coaching strong sales or revenue operations leaders.
 Experience using Salesforce and artificial intelligence (AI) to improve forecasting, pipeline management, or sales productivity.
 What You Can Expect
 Partner with Sales leaders to set quarterly priorities, align hiring plans and trade-offs, and create recovery plans when teams fall behind.
 Establish consistent global standards for forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and quarterly business reviews.
 Develop independent forecasts for each team, lead large-deal reviews, and turn insights into clear decisions.
 Improve sales productivity through stronger coverage, faster ramping, and effective support from solution engineering and Privileged Access specialists.
 Lead the use of AI in forecasting and pipeline work, helping managers reinvest time saved into selling and coaching.
 Run annual planning with Sales Strategy and Planning and Enablement so that teams begin each year with clear territories and quotas.
 Lead and develop a high-performing global field sales operations team.
USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $187,000 USD and $257,000 USD. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.
Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $160,000 CAD and $220,000 CAD. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.
At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.
 This posting is for an existing vacancy.
 Our culture 
 At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.
You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.
 How We Work With AI
 We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.
This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.
 Our approach to work
 We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.
For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.
Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.
 What We Offer
 We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:
 Health and wellbeing
 👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy
 Growth and future 
 📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account
 Community 
 🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.
 You belong here.
 1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.
 Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.
 Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.
 Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

For additional information see our Candidate Privacy Notice .

title: Commercial Operations Manager (Remote)
description:
Description
Elevar Therapeutics is seeking a detail-oriented, experienced, strategic, highly collaborative, and highly organized Commercial Operations Manager to help build and scale the operational infrastructure required to support the buildout and ongoing execution of a successful commercial operations capabilities for an organization and potential U.S. launch. Reporting to the Vice President, Commercial Development, this individual will play an important role in supporting commercial readiness, field operations, CRM and commercial systems, performance reporting, data quality, vendor coordination, meeting management, and cross-functional project execution. This role will work closely with and serve as a key partner to Commercial, Sales, Marketing, Market Access, Patient Services, Medical Affairs, Finance, IT, Legal, Compliance, and external partners/vendors to help ensure the commercial organization has the tools, systems, data, reporting, processes, and operational support needed to execute effectively. This role will be responsible for driving commercial readiness, operational excellence, field effectiveness, CRM and commercial systems, performance reporting, incentive compensation, vendor management, and cross-functional launch planning. The ideal candidate brings strong attention to detail, analytical curiosity, project coordination skills, and an interest in biotechnology commercial operations experience within biotech or pharmaceutical commercialization environments, hands-on launch experience, strong analytical capability, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial organization. This is a remote-based position located in the United States. 
 Responsibilities: 
Support commercial operations leadership in executing launch readiness activities, commercial workplans, project timelines, and cross-functional deliverables
Assist with coordination of commercial operations workstreams, including field operations, CRM support, data management, reporting, incentive compensation tracking, targeting, call planning, and vendor readiness
Assist in supporting MLR Initiatives, streamlining workflows, and ensuring materials are quality checked
Help maintain commercial dashboards, trackers, KPIs, scorecards, and business review materials to support visibility into performance, milestones, risks, and opportunities
Support CRM and related commercial systems by assisting with user coordination, data quality checks, issue tracking, training logistics, documentation, and adoption support
Partner with Sales, Marketing, Market Access, Patient Services, Medical Affairs, Finance, IT, Legal, Compliance, and external vendors to help coordinate execution of commercial priorities
Support field operations activities, including territory alignment logistics, targeting files, field reporting, call planning support, account lists, and related documentation
Assist with incentive compensation operations, including data collection, tracking, reporting, quality checks, communication materials, and coordination with Sales Leadership, Finance, and Compliance
Support vendor onboarding, purchase order tracking, invoice coordination, budget trackers, contract routing, meeting scheduling, and vendor performance documentation
Coordinate cross-functional launch readiness meetings, agendas, meeting notes, action items, timelines, and follow-up activities to ensure alignment and accountability
Identify opportunities to improve commercial operations processes, documentation, data quality, and ways of working
Ensure commercial operations activities are conducted in accordance with applicable policies, legal and compliance requirements, and industry standards
Requirements
We are looking for an articulate, energetic, and commercially curious team-minded member with strong attention to detail, project coordination skills, operational discipline, business acumen, analytical capability, and the ability to work effectively influence across a complex, fast-paced, cross-functional environment. The successful candidate will be comfortable operating strategically and tactically, building new capabilities, managing details, maintaining trackers, coordinating with stakeholders, supporting systems and vendors, helping vendors, and partnering cross-functionally to support commercial teams execute execution and launch readiness and operational priorities.
Bachelor’s degree required
8 years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, healthcare consulting, commercial operations, sales operations, business analytics, project coordination, or a related business function
Oncology and successful launch experience highly preferred 
Interest in biotech or pharmaceutical commercialization, product launch, commercial operations, field operations, analytics, or market access
Experience supporting business operations capabilities such as CRM, reporting, data management, dashboards, project trackers, vendor coordination, budget tracking, or process documentation preferred
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and PowerPoint; experience with CRM, business intelligence, project management, or collaboration tools preferred
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage details, track deliverables, and communicate progress clearly
Excellent communication, collaboration, and follow-through skills with the ability to work effectively across functions and with external vendors
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, remote environment where priorities may evolve quickly
Highly accountable, flexible, detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn
Ability to demonstrate Elevar’s core values by holding ourselves and each other accountable for the work we do, taking time to collaborate effectively while working remotely, making space for ingenuity in work and thought, and staying grounded in compassion
The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is $115,000 to $140,000. Final compensation depends on multiple factors including but not limited to, relevant experience, skillset, depth and breadth of knowledge, internal equity, and external market factors. Elevar Therapeutics is a rapidly growing biotech company that offers competitive wages and benefits package including medical, dental, vision, time off, a retirement plan, and other voluntary benefits for employees.
#LI-REMOTE
flags: band 115000-140000 USD starts below your 125000 USD RevOps floor -- only the top half clears it
This is pharma commercial ops (MLR review, call planning, HCP targeting), which does not build a SaaS RevOps narrative.
Duties read support and coordination heavy, including PO tracking, invoices and meeting scheduling, despite the Manager title.
The company is a pre-launch biotech, so the role depends on a US launch that may slip or not happen.
Biotech launch experience is highly preferred, and screeners will likely favour candidates from pharma backgrounds.
verdict: Pharma launch-support role in a US backstop market; the pay clears the floor, but domain and trajectory don't fit the SaaS RevOps pivot.

title: Customer Sales Operations
description:
Company Description: 
Element Six (E6), is a global leader in the design, development and production of synthetic diamond and tungsten carbide supermaterials. Part of the De Beers Group, our primary manufacturing sites are located in UK, Ireland, Germany, South Africa and the US. 
Our mission 
We put our customers first. Using our technological expertise and industrial leadership we deliver innovative solutions to achieve competitive advantage. 
Our vision 
With access to the most sophisticated R&D technology and the best minds in the business, the future is full of possibilities… 
Employment Equity & Inclusion and Diversity 
We are committed to fostering a vibrant workplace culture that is inclusive and embraces our diversity, where we value and respect every colleague for who they are and provide equality of opportunity so that everyone can fulfil their potential, and thrive. 
You can find out more about who we are and what we do on our website: 
e6.com/en/about/corporate-information 
 Job Description: 
 Role Overview 
The Sales Operations Specialist proactively manages the day-to-day customer and sales operation, to deliver flawless customer experience, and owns delivery of the 0-3 months revenue target through disciplined forecast monitoring (demand control) and execution. This position is the sole point of contact for all customer and distributor queries and escalations. The role is responsible for optimising sales processes, systems, data, and performance to enable the sales organisation to operate efficiently and effectively in supporting growth ambitions. This role partners closely with Sales Leadership, Finance, Marketing, Operations and Customer Centricity to Champion Customer Intimacy, provide operational excellence, actionable insights, and scalable processes that drive revenue growth and meet/exceed customer expectations. Ad hoc travel may be required to support the business requirements.
 Key Responsibilities 
Own delivery of the 0–3 month revenue plan through disciplined demand control, monitoring bookings, backlog, forecast and supply position to identify risks early, drive actions, and remove blockers that impact near-term revenue.
Own the 0–3 month demand control process by reviewing forecast, backlog, supply constraints and shipment outlook, identifying revenue risks and opportunities early, and driving clear recovery or pull-in actions with Sales, Supply Chain and Operations. Ensure Future Master is updated to reflect changes in the 0–3 month window.
Review backlog and shipment commitments, validating forecast versus open orders, identifying pull-in or push-out opportunities, prioritising constrained supply against revenue impact, coordinating recovery plans for shortfalls, escalating material risks, and updating Future Master and related demand signals to reflect agreed actions.
Proactively identify and propose suitable alternatives (product substitution), confirm availability and commercial impact, obtain required approvals, and updating quotes, orders and customer communications accordingly.
Own and continuously improve end-to-end sales processes, from lead management and forecast accuracy through to order administration, order fulfilment and after-sales service, identifying bottlenecks and implementing scalable solutions by defining system requirements, managing enhancements, and working with IT or external partners on system improvements.
Ensure consistent execution of sales policies, procedures, and governance across the organization.
Identify sales process inefficiencies and lead initiatives to streamline workflows, reduce friction points, and improve customer journey and productivity.
Manage Microsoft Dynamics CRM and ERP data quality: customer master data, pricing/discount structures, product set-up, territory/account assignments and user support (in line with governance).
Utilise Microsoft Dynamics CRM as a relationship management and sales enablement tool, driving CRM adoption and user compliance. Register and manage all customer activities, including appointments and actions, in CRM. 
Produce and maintain recurring sales performance reporting, including pipeline, bookings, backlog, revenue, and forecast accuracy, and provide actionable insights to Sales leadership.
Ensure commercial policy and profitability by confirming pricing, discounts, and key terms are applied correctly
Partner with Finance on credit, invoicing, and returns
Act as the sole point of contact for customers and distributors on operational topics with all related queries and escalations routed through Sales Operation
 Criteria skills 
Strong commercial acumen with expertise in pricing, deal economics and sales operations across the quote-to-cash lifecycle.
Excellent stakeholder management skills and a passion for delivering a flawless service to customers, able to work effectively cross functionally.
Clear and effective communication skills (written and verbal); ability to manage customer expectations and proactively influence the outcome.
High attention to detail and strong process discipline
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to translate data into clear actions and recommendations
Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups); experience with BI/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI/Tableau) is an advantage
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Dynamics CRM (Dynamics 365) and confidence working across CRM and ERP.
 Qualifications: 
3-5 years’ experience in Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Customer Service within a multinational manufacturing organisation.
Demonstrated experience supporting sales teams and senior leadership.
Experience in process improvement, forecasting, and sales performance management.
Experience working with an ERP system (e.g., SAP, JD Edwards, Oracle or similar) and understanding of order management and master data
Strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Excel, PowerPoint, Teams)
Third-level qualification in Business, Finance, Analytics, Operations or a related discipline (or equivalent experience).
 Additional Information:
hard_gaps: Sales ops experience in multinational manufacturing organisation
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM
ERP experience (SAP, JD Edwards, Oracle) and order management
Quote-to-cash pricing and deal economics expertise
flags: no pay stated in the ad or the feed, verify vs floor
Role is heavily order administration, demand control and supply-chain backlog management, not SaaS RevOps strategy.
Sole point of contact for all customer and distributor operational queries implies a high-volume service and execution workload.
A 3-5 year experience band risks screening out a candidate with 11 years plus an MBA as overqualified.
Industrial manufacturing context means the candidate's SaaS retention and NRR strengths carry little weight here.
verdict: Manufacturing order-to-cash and demand-control role on Dynamics and ERP; off his SaaS post-sale strengths and pivot, so skip.

title: Head of Revenue Enablement
description:
About Marcura: 
Marcura is a global leader in maritime technology and operations, supporting nearly one‑third of the world's seaborne commodity trade. Our trusted platforms which span software, data intelligence and payments sit at the centre of digital transformation across the maritime industry. We are now seeking a Head of Revenue Enablement to join our high‑impact team and contribute to the success of one of the sector's most forward‑looking organisations.
 Purpose of the role: 
The Head of Revenue Enablement helps every seller and account manager at Marcura sell more of the portfolio, more consistently. Marcura sells software and payments to the maritime industry through a family of brands including DA-Desk, ShipServ, MarTrust, PortLog, VesselMan and Marcura Claims. 
The role has two halves. The first is the groundwork: building one Marcura way of selling on Sandler, ProActive Selling and JOLT, making it stick through the sales managers, and helping the existing team win more often and across more products. The second is the build: turning that method into something the call-capture and AI tools can recognise and learn from, so that admin becomes a by-product of selling and what the team learns from wins and losses feeds straight back into coaching. 
The role works directly with the EVP, Commercial Operations & Growth, and in partnership with four teams. Product marketing owns content and messaging, and this role sets what the field needs and tests it with sellers. RevOps owns tool configuration and data, and this role designs what is captured and coached. Customer Success leaders own CS enablement, and this role shares playbooks with them and agrees the cross-sell handover. Sales managers own their pipelines, and this role equips them to coach to the method. 
 Job Responsibilities 
In priority order. Each states what is done, why, and the key result. 
1. Roll out Sandler, ProActive Selling and JOLT as one Marcura way of selling, so every team sells, coaches and forecasts the same way, with the method taught and coached in every sales team. 
2. Equip sales managers to coach to the method in deal reviews and 1:1s, because a method sticks through managers or not at all, so that managers run reviews to a shared standard. 
3. Define the pipeline stage exit criteria for the new method with RevOps, so the process, the CRM and the capture tools all use the same definitions, with the criteria live in the CRM and used in every deal review. 
4. Run a development programme for the current sellers and account managers, including cross-training across products and into account management, so growth comes from the team Marcura already has, measured by how many of the team close deals each quarter and in how many products. 
5. Define what good looks like at each stage of a seller's development, with sales leadership and HR, so every seller knows what is expected and how to grow, giving a published competency standard used in every 1:1 and review. 
6. Design the content of capture templates, coaching scorecards and agent workflows, such as win/loss, objection and question analysis, so the selling produces the data and the data improves the selling, delivered as a monthly readout that changes what managers coach. 
7. Run the release path for new products, from product to product marketing to enablement to the first deals, then packaged for the field, so new products reach the whole sales team quickly, with each launch certified and sold by sellers beyond the launch team. 
8. Prioritise and run the enablement programme, playbooks and certifications, building on the programme design already in place, so sellers learn from one trusted source, with owners named for every asset, priority modules live and certification running. 
9. Help sellers get the best out of Salesforce, Gainsight and the call-capture tools, so the tools pay back without adding admin, with higher adoption and complete records. 
10. Agree one primary success measure with the EVP and report on it monthly, so enablement shows what it changed, with a baseline, a target and a monthly view. 
 Key Success Factors 
Every sales manager coaching to the one Marcura method within the first year 
More of the existing team closing deals each quarter, and in more than one product 
The new stage exit criteria and win/loss capture in use across all sales teams 
At least one new product taken through the release path to repeatable sales 
A monthly win/loss and objection readout that sales leaders act on 
Product marketing, RevOps and Customer Success working to one shared enablement plan 
 Requirements
 Qualifications and Education 
Minimum: educated to degree level, or equivalent professional experience 
Desired: certification in Sandler or ProActive Selling 
Good to have: formal training in coaching, instructional design or change management
 Work Experience 
Minimum: 8 years in B2B, including a carried quota in complex, multi-product software, payments, logistics or vertical SaaS 
Minimum: 3 years leading sales enablement, sales effectiveness or sales training 
Minimum: proven record of rolling out a sales method across more than one region and making it stick through sales managers 
Minimum: proven record of using conversation intelligence, prompt or template design, or agent workflows to change what sellers do, with measurable results 
Desired: maritime or shipping industry experience 
Desired: experience building an enablement function from the start 
Good to have: experience in a multi-brand group; experience running a sales kick-off 
 Skills and Knowledge 
Hard skills 
Practitioner of Sandler or ProActive Selling; working knowledge of JOLT 
Designs sales stages, exit criteria and meeting types that a CRM and capture tools can track 
Writes capture templates, coaching scorecards and prompts for AI note-taking and agent tools 
Analyses deal data to test a hypothesis, using Salesforce reports, Excel or BI tools 
Builds learning journeys, certifications and assessments 
Soft skills 
Coaches the coaches: equips sales managers to run deal reviews and 1:1s to one method 
Influences without authority across product marketing, RevOps and Customer Success 
Clear, plain communicator in writing and in the room, in English 
Leads change by piloting, proving the result, then scaling 
Curious about where sales tooling is heading, and practical about what works now 
 Benefits
 What You'll Gain 
Exposure to strategic, monetization, and commercial product development.
Mentorship from experienced product and growth leaders.
The opportunity to see the full product lifecycle, from discovery to revenue impact.
The chance to make a measurable impact on business and customer KPIs.
 Show more
 Show less
 Seniority level
 Director
 Employment type
 Full-time
 Industries
 Maritime Transportation

 See who you know

Rolled out a sales method across multiple regions via managers
Proven conversation intelligence/agent workflow results changing seller behaviour
Director-level head of enablement function

title: Senior Product Solutions Lead, Voice AI (Global GTM) — London
description:
Responsibilities
 Role Overview
BytePlus is bringing ByteDance's advanced foundation model capabilities to enterprise customers worldwide. Powered by products including Seed Speech, Seed Audio, and Seedream, we are accelerating the global commercialisation of voice and multimodal AI—helping customers unlock new value across content creation, voice agents, content localisation, interactive entertainment, and more.
We are looking for a Senior Product Solutions Lead in London who combines deep voice-industry insight, enterprise customer experience, and strong go-to-market expertise. This is a high-impact senior role with broad business influence and meaningful scope to shape decisions. You will lead the global GTM strategy for voice AI, drive strategic enterprise engagements, and translate market signals, customer needs, and high-impact insight into product direction and commercial growth.
This is an opportunity to help define the next chapter of voice AI, turning high-quality voice model capabilities into real, scaled enterprise applications around the world. You will take meaningful ownership as a senior individual contributor, directly influencing global voice GTM, strategic account priorities, product direction, and ecosystem partnerships. Built on a high-growth global platform with growing international recognition, BytePlus and its model products—including Seedream—offer strong leverage for our voice and multimodal AI businesses. You will partner with exceptional global teams across product, research, engineering, sales, and marketing to solve complex problems and expand your impact as the business grows.
Responsibilities
- Shape and drive the global GTM strategy for voice AI, defining priority markets, industries, customer segments, and use cases for Seed Speech, Seed Audio, and related offerings; sharpen value propositions, routes to market, and commercial playbooks to drive business outcomes.
- Win strategic customers and build industry solutions by partnering with sales, business development, and channel teams throughout enterprise discovery, solution design, technical engagement, PoC, and scaled deployment—creating repeatable solutions and flagship global customer references.
- Develop market, customer, and industry insight by tracking global voice AI demand, the broader landscape, business models, and ecosystem shifts; form a clear point of view and use it to influence positioning, roadmap priorities, pricing, and partnership strategy.
- Bridge product and market by working across product, research, engineering, sales, and marketing teams globally to translate frontline customer feedback into clear priorities and faster product iteration; expand the customer and partner ecosystem and explore multimodal opportunities with products such as Seedream.
 Qualifications
 Minimum Qualifications
- 5+ years of experience in enterprise product solutions, GTM, solution consulting, pre-sales, customer success, strategic business development, or a related field.
- Hands-on experience serving large enterprise customers at a leading voice AI, generative AI, cloud, or developer-platform company, with direct involvement in strategic customer solutioning, PoCs, deployment, or scaled adoption.
- Strong understanding of TTS, ASR, speech-to-speech, voice agents, and audio generation, with the ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Ability to prioritise amid ambiguity, lead complex initiatives in a fast-moving environment, and align global cross-functional teams through strong communication and influence.
- Full professional fluency in written and spoken English, with the ability to engage deeply and credibly with global enterprise customers.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant industry experience.
Preferred Qualifications
- Cross-cultural working experience and the ability to collaborate effectively across global teams.
- Experience exploring or delivering multimodal AI solutions (e.g., integrating voice with vision or other modalities).
- Familiarity with the global voice AI customer landscape, including key use cases, enterprise buying processes, and ecosystem dynamics.
 About Us
 Founded in 2012, ByteDance's mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. With a suite of more than a dozen products, including TikTok, Lemon8, CapCut and Pico as well as platforms specific to the China market, including Toutiao, Douyin, and Xigua, ByteDance has made it easier and more fun for people to connect with, consume, and create content.​
 Why Join ByteDance
 Inspiring creativity is at the core of ByteDance's mission. Our innovative products are built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and enrich life - a mission we work towards every day.​
As ByteDancers, we strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our Company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​

title: Head of Customer Success
description:
FintechOS is a financial product management platform that helps banks and insurers design, launch, and manage financial products and customer journeys more efficiently.
Our technology enables financial institutions to modernise their products and processes while working alongside their existing technology infrastructure.
At FintechOS, you will join an international team working at the intersection of financial services, enterprise technology, and digital transformation. We value customer impact, ownership, collaboration, and the ability to turn complex challenges into practical outcomes.
The opportunity
We are looking for a commercially minded Head of Customer Success to lead our end-to-end Customer Success strategy for enterprise banks, insurers, and other regulated financial-services organisations.
This is a player-coach leadership role combining strategy, people leadership, commercial thinking, and hands-on customer engagement.
You will lead the customer journey from late-stage presales and implementation through go-live, adoption, live service, renewal, and expansion. Your mission is to turn successful customer outcomes into a repeatable engine for retention and growth.
You will lead a multi-region team that works closely with customers, maintains a regular presence within their organisations, and provides one accountable point of ownership across the customer lifecycle.
What you will lead
Customer strategy and outcomes
Define the Customer Success strategy, customer segmentation, engagement model, and operating rhythm.
Create measurable outcome plans focused on adoption, business value, retention, and growth.
Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across business, operations, technology, risk, and compliance.
Act as executive sponsor for strategic accounts and lead recovery plans for at-risk customers.
Implementation and service delivery
Improve the predictability of enterprise implementations across scope, milestones, quality, budget, margin, and time to value.
Involve Customer Success in late-stage presales to validate commitments, assumptions, and dependencies before delivery begins.
Maintain an integrated view of each customer’s projects, risks, and priorities.
Lead the recovery of complex or underperforming customer programmes.
Partner with Support to improve service transitions, incident communication, platform stability, and recurring-problem resolution.
Monitor delivery effort, cost to serve, and gross margin at customer and portfolio level.
Retention, adoption, and growth
Own customer health, product adoption, and value realisation as the leading indicators of retention.
Identify renewal risks early and lead practical mitigation plans.
Partner with Account Management on account strategy, renewal planning, and expansion opportunities.
Turn product usage, delivery progress, support data, and stakeholder sentiment into actionable customer insights.
Identify new customer needs and use cases through regular engagement, bringing qualified opportunities to Account Management.
Team and operating model
Lead, coach, and scale a multi-region team of Customer Success leaders and managers.
Define clear roles, portfolio coverage, capacity models, career paths, and performance standards.
Establish consistent customer health reviews, service reviews, renewal-risk reviews, and executive business reviews.
Build playbooks covering onboarding, implementation, go-live, adoption, value realisation, risk recovery, renewal support, and advocacy.
Clarify decision rights across Customer Success, Account Management, Product, Engineering, Delivery, and Support.
What you bring
Senior leadership experience in Customer Success, Professional Services, Delivery, Account Management, or Post-Sales within enterprise B2B SaaS.
Experience working with banks, insurers, or other regulated financial-services organisations.
A strong record of improving enterprise customer retention, adoption, and value realisation.
Hands-on leadership of complex enterprise software implementations, from solution design through go-live and support.
Experience recovering high-risk or underperforming customer programmes.
Experience building or scaling Customer Success operating models, including segmentation, customer health, capacity planning, and renewal-risk management.
Commercial understanding of recurring revenue, GRR, NRR, services economics, delivery margin, forecasting, and cost to serve.
Strong executive presence and confidence managing escalations and high-impact customer decisions.
Experience hiring, coaching, and developing Customer Success leaders and teams.
Data literacy and experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify technical, operational, and commercial complexity.
What will set you apart
You have led Customer Success for mission-critical enterprise platforms.
You can quickly distinguish between product, delivery, adoption, and relationship risks.
You build scalable systems without making strategic customers feel standardised.
You combine strategic thinking with the willingness to step directly into complex customer situations.
You challenge customers and internal teams constructively, using evidence and shared outcomes.
How success will be measured
Retention: Customer health, GRR contribution, logo retention, and early visibility of renewal risks.
Value: Customer outcome attainment and executive business review quality.
Adoption: Active usage and breadth and depth of product adoption.
Growth: Qualified expansion opportunities and NRR contribution.
Delivery: Milestone predictability, time to go-live, and stabilisation.
Service: Platform stability, issue ageing, and recurring-problem reduction.
Economics: Gross margin at customer and portfolio level.
Team: Capacity, productivity, engagement, and talent progression.
Why join FintechOS?
This is an opportunity to shape a strategic function at the intersection of customer value, enterprise software delivery, product strategy, and recurring revenue growth.
You will influence how leading financial-services organisations adopt and scale FintechOS technology while building the team and operating model for our next stage of growth.
If you have led enterprise Customer Success in financial-services technology and enjoy combining strategy, commercial ownership, people leadership, and direct customer engagement, we would like to hear from you.

title: Sales Operations Lead
description:
Picture this: a big refinery needs anchors for a furnace shutdown in six weeks. Our account manager sends in the enquiry, and from that moment it’s in your hands. Your team makes the quote, checks if it can be produced, confirms the order and keeps the customer updated. The customer gets a clear answer fast and knows exactly where they stand. That’s the experience you create. You probably already see where it could be better. Some quotes take too long. Some details get lost between people. Some standard orders still go through five manual steps when one would do. That’s why we need you. In your first months, you’ll get your hands dirty. You’ll make basic quotes yourself, follow orders from start to finish, and learn exactly where things break. Then you start fixing them.
 Established in 1982, SILICON has evolved into a global frontrunner in metal fabrication. We specialize in refractory stainless-steel fastening and anchoring systems, alongside cutting-edge welding machines. With a dedicated workforce of approximately 85 talented professionals, SILICON is renowned for delivering top-quality products and services to the petrochemical, chemical, cement, construction, and shipbuilding industries worldwide.
 What do we offer you? 
Are you the Sales Operations Lead who can make our quote-to-order engine faster, smarter and more scalable? Here’s what you can expect from us:
Salary between €4.400 and €6.800, matching your experience.
200 hours of annual leave (applicable to full-time employment).
Travel allowance of €0,25 p/km within a 25 km radius.
Added benefits include a bike plan, on-site fresh fruit, and a fitness incentive.
Extensive onboarding program to set you up for success in your position.
An annual training budget of €850 for internal or external training to drive your professional development.
International and informal organization with over 25 nationalities.
Opportunity to join the SILICON Social Club, offering fun activities for you and your family!
 What are your responsibilities? 
As our Sales Operations Lead, you make sure every customer enquiry turns into a fast, correct quote and a smoothly processed order. You are a hands-on leader: you don’t only manage the process, you also build and fix it yourself. You will be responsible for:
Leading the Sales Operations team and setting the right priorities, so complex project work gets the expertise it needs and standard work is handled quickly.
Making sure every order has one clear owner from enquiry to confirmed order, with no details lost at handover.
Making sure order confirmations go out on time and customers are informed quickly when something changes.
Setting up KPIs and reporting on turnaround, conversion, accuracy and cost to serve, so we steer on numbers and not on gut feeling.
Improving the quote-to-order process step by step, from a measured baseline to a measured result.
Building and maintaining our commercial tools (configurator, pricing logic, automation) together with ICT, Product Management and Engineering.
Automating standard quotes and orders, so they need little or no manual work.
Making basic quotes yourself in the first months, to learn the process and find where it breaks.
Coaching your team, running appraisals and helping to hire new colleagues.
You will do this reporting directly to the CEO, leading the Inside Sales team.
 What are your qualities? 
We’re looking for a hands-on builder with a strong process and data mindset. Additionally, the ideal candidate will have the following qualifications:
Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree, preferably with a commercial background.
Proven experience running or building a quote-to-order, order-processing or sales-support operation, and a track record of improving it.
Experience with continuous-improvement methods (baseline, measure, improve, sustain).
Comfortable with data: you set baselines, measure change and steer on numbers.
Experience building commercial tools such as configurators, pricing logic or automation.
Working knowledge of ERP (SAP preferred) and CRM.
Leadership experience, with a structured, proactive and solution-oriented way of working.
Fluent in English, spoken and written. Dutch is an advantage.
Are you ready to make impact? Then don’t hesitate and click apply!
For questions, please contact the HR Department via +31629203963 or recruitment@silicon.nu.

title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.
 Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.
Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.
 About The Role
 Hi there! We're seeking a strategic and operationally excellent Senior Manager, Revenue Operations & Sales Commission to own the design, implementation, and governance of our enterprise sales compensation program. This senior-level individual contributor role reports to the VP of Revenue Operations and serves as the architect and steward of compensation strategy across our diverse go-to-market organization.
You'll partner with GTM Leadership, Finance, and People Operations to build world-class compensation programs that attract talent, drive the right behaviors, and align with business objectives. You'll manage the full lifecycle of compensation—from design through implementation, compliance, analytics, and continuous improvement—across Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Sales Leaders, Partner Managers, Customer Success Managers, Technical Account Managers and other functions on variable compensation plans.
Note: This role focuses on compensation design and operations. Our Finance team manages commission accounting and invoice processing in Xactly.
 What You Will Do
 Compensation Strategy & Design
Own the strategic design of annual sales compensation programs for all eligible roles and adjust for market conditions, competitive landscape, and business priorities
Benchmark compensation against market data and peer software companies; conduct pay equity analysis and recommend adjustments to ensure competitiveness and fairness
Design commission structures, accelerators, quotas, and incentive mechanics that drive desired sales behaviors and align with revenue goals
Design and own SPIFF and other incentive programs outside of the official incentive plan
Lead cross-functional design reviews with Sales, Finance, and executive leadership to validate programs before launch
Program Implementation & Operations
Manage the end-to-end program launch calendar; coordinate cross-functional efforts and communicate timelines, changes, and deadlines to stakeholders
Build and maintain the primary source of truth for all compensation program documentation, including plan documents, commission schedules, quota assignments, and policy guidelines
Configure compensation programs in Xactly and SFDC; validate data integrity, test calculations, and ensure system configurations reflect approved plan design
Develop training materials and lead training sessions for sales teams on compensation plan mechanics, commission calculations, and incentive rules
Governance & Compliance
Ensure compensation programs comply with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies across all geographies where we operate
Manage exceptions, disputes, and appeals related to commissions, quotas, and incentive payouts; work with VP RevOps, Finance and HR to resolve efficiently and fairly
Maintain audit trails and documentation for all material compensation decisions and changes
Analytics & Reporting
Build dashboards and reports to monitor role based performance metrics, compensation spend, payout distributions, plan attainment, and ROI on incentive investments. Including SPIFF reporting metrics
Conduct post-program analysis (win/loss, attainment distribution, program metrics) and deliver insights to leadership on plan effectiveness
Recommend program adjustments mid-year based on market shifts, business performance, and feedback from sales leaders
Cross-functional Collaboration
Partner with VP of RevOps to align compensation with business strategy and sales priorities; maintain regular feedback loops with Sales Leaders
Work directly with Commission Accounting on attainment data, payouts, calculations and discrepancies
Collaborate with Finance on budgeting, forecasting, and year-end reporting of incentive spend
Work with People Operations on equity, total rewards strategy, and talent retention initiatives
Communicate compensation strategy and changes to the broader organization with clarity and confidence
 Required Qualifications
 What You Will Bring to the Role
8+ years of progressive experience in sales compensation, incentive design, or related revenue operations roles (within software, SaaS, or enterprise sales environments preferred)
Demonstrated expertise in designing and managing compensation programs for multiple sales roles and structures
Advanced proficiency with sales compensation platforms (Xactly, Anaplan, SAP SuccessFactors, or equivalent); strong data analysis and Excel skills
Deep understanding of CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and comfort configuring objects, fields, and reporting for incentive programs
Strong project management and cross-functional collaboration skills; ability to influence without authority and manage competing priorities
Excellent communication and presentation skills; comfort translating complex compensation concepts for diverse audiences (sales teams, executives, finance, HR)
Meticulous attention to detail; strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Familiarity with GDPR, CCPA, and other employment law considerations affecting compensation (particularly for global organizations)
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience managing compensation programs across multiple geographic regions with different regulatory requirements
Background in financial analysis, FP&A, or accounting; understanding of revenue recognition impacts on compensation timing
Exposure to Customer Success, Services, or other non-traditional sales comp models
Certification in compensation (e.g., WorldatWork CECP, GRP) or related HR disciplines
Experience at a high-growth or publicly traded software company
 This role is an existing vacancy
 #C1
 Compensation

 We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.
 The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills , experience , and location , and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

United Kingdom: £120,800.00 to £198,600.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.
 Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP) .
 Benefits & Perks
 We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.
Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.
In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.
Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.
Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.
Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

title: Strategy & Operations Manager
description:
Founded in 2017, NinjaHoldings works to give everyday Americans better access to financial services than traditional institutions typically provide. Through our CreditNinja and NinjaCard brands, we offer digital banking and lending products designed for consumers often overlooked, paired with incentives that support long-term financial improvement. Our Edge brand extends this expertise to other companies, providing underwriting, fraud detection, and analytics services. Headquartered in Chicago with a distributed global workforce, we are a lean, growing organization committed to advancing consumer finance in the US.
**Job Summary**
The Manager, Strategy & Operations drives business growth through operational efficiency, strategic execution, and cross-functional project leadership. This role identifies opportunities to improve processes and performance, translates business needs into actionable requirements, and leads initiatives from initial discovery through implementation and ongoing optimization. The ideal candidate is a data-driven, hands-on operator with strong product management skills who can navigate ambiguity, bring structure to complex problems, and partner effectively across Product, Engineering, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Marketing, and other functions to deliver measurable business outcomes.
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Identify new business opportunities, optimize existing products, and evaluate business performance to uncover opportunities for growth and operational improvement
* Translate business objectives into clear project plans, product requirements, user stories, and success metrics
* Evaluate existing business processes, products, and operational workflows to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for optimization
* Own cross-functional initiatives from problem identification and requirements gathering through prioritization, development, testing, launch, and post-launch evaluation
* Partner with business stakeholders, Product, and Engineering to define requirements, align priorities, resolve dependencies, and ensure solutions meet business needs
* Use data and business insights to develop recommendations, build business cases, and prioritize high-impact initiatives
* Manage project timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder communications to ensure initiatives remain on track and deliver intended results
* Design and implement scalable operational processes that improve efficiency, customer experience, and business performance
* Monitor the performance of implemented solutions, measure results against defined success metrics, and identify opportunities for continued optimization
* Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Finance, Marketing, and other teams to ensure initiatives align with business objectives and operational requirements
**Ideal Candidate Will Have:**
* 6+ years of experience in strategy, operations, product management, business analysis, management consulting, or a high-growth fintech/startup environment
* Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional projects and driving initiatives from concept through execution
* Strong product management skills, including requirements gathering, writing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, prioritizing work, and coordinating with technical teams
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured plans and actionable recommendations
* Experience using data to evaluate business performance, identify improvement opportunities, and measure the impact of initiatives
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and project management abilities
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and drive results in a fastpaced environment
* Prior fintech, payments, lending, or financial services experience is highly preferred
* Experience with SQL, business intelligence tools, process automation, or workflow optimization is a plus
**Benefits & Perks:**
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Health Benefits with generous medical, dental and vision insurance plans
* 401(k) with matching contribution
* Paid Family Leave
* Annual Wellness & WFH Subsidies
* Employee Referral Program
* Remote first culture with convenient downtown office in the heart of the city

We recommend that you refrain from responding to suspicious emails and file a complaint with the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) at* https://www.ic3.gov*. For questions or to confirm the authenticity of a communication, please email* hr @ninjaholdings.com*.*

title: Senior Manager, GTM Systems
description:
Air is a Creative Ops System for creative teams. Our product automates the mindless tasks that creatives and marketers do every day to manage content and unlocks creativity through image recognition, automated versioning, and approval workflows. We launched in March 2021 and have raised +$70m from world-class venture capital groups including Avenir, Tiger Global, Headline Ventures, Lerer Hippeau, WndrCo, and Slack Ventures.
 This role requires in-office attendance at least 3 days/week in Toronto. 
 The Role 
Air is hiring our founding GTM Systems lead to be the chief architect of the tech stack that powers our go-to-market organization. GTM Operations runs as an internal product team, and the choices we make shape how fast Air can scale from $XXM to $XXXM ARR. GTM leaders bring you the outcome they need, and you bring back the plan, the timeline, and a solution sized to the problem.
 Core Responsibilities 
Own the architecture of Air's GTM stack, with Salesforce at its center: the object model, permissions, data pipeline, release governance, and integrations. You design the details, without losing sight of the whole.
Lead the builds behind each stage of our customer lifecycle — from marketing attribution and speed-to-lead, to CPQ and deal desk, across sales-led and product-led motions.
Own change management from requirements through adoption: sequence the work, de-risk each cutover with test coverage and monitoring, and run enablement that makes changes stick.
Own a living roadmap tied to GTM strategy. Partner with the leaders of Marketing, Sales, CS, Data and Finance so system design shapes decisions from the start.
Amplify the team. Work hand in hand with GTM Ops process generalists and arm them with the documentation, best practice, and tooling to ship safely on our systems.
 Requirements 
 Experience: 5+ years in Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering or Business Systems, including time as the product owner of a CRM that a revenue org depends on. You have owned a systems roadmap and delivered against it.
 Systems architecture: You think in data models, integrations, and dependencies, and can explain why a system is shaped the way it is and how a change will ripple through it.
 Technical fluency: You're comfortable in code, even if you don't write it from scratch. You can read Apex, SQL, and API payloads, reason about what they do, direct AI tools toward the right approach, and verify the output before it touches a live system.
 Strategic judgment: You right-size solutions to the problem in front of you, weighing scale against speed and process against engineering, and you keep the most important thing the most important thing.
 AI-native tooling curiosity: You build with Claude Code or similar agentic tools regularly, have shipped AI-powered workflows or agents to real users, and review AI-written work critically before it reaches production. You track the tooling frontier, enjoy testing and comparing new tools, and have a point of view on what belongs in a modern GTM stack.
 Cross-functional communication: You turn business requirements into systems logic and explain the tradeoffs back to the business.
 How We Work at Air 
 Act like a driver : Take initiative and ownership without waiting to be told.
 Work in public : Share ideas openly, get feedback early, and collaborate across teams.
 Play to win : Aim high and bring creativity, adaptability, and focus to your work.
 Say the hard thing : Give and receive feedback with clarity and respect.
 Disagree and commit : Debate honestly, then align quickly to move forward together.
 Benefits 
 Why Air? 
 Growth and Impact: Join a rapidly scaling company with a mission to transform the creative ops space. Your work will have a direct, tangible impact on [our ARR growth].
 Comprehensive Benefits: We offer competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance, along with dependent coverage. You’ll also enjoy a generous work-from-home stipend, professional development reimbursement, and unlimited vacation days.
 Commitment to Diversity: We believe in the power of diverse perspectives and strive to create an inclusive culture that welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and experiences.
 Competitive Compensation: The compensation range for this role is CAD $138,000 - $205,000 + equity, commensurate with experience.
At Air, we’re committed to building a world-class team and helping every individual reach their full potential. If you're passionate about solving big problems and growing with an innovative company, we’d love to meet you!
hard_gaps: 5+ years in RevOps, GTM Engineering or Business Systems
Product owner of a revenue-critical CRM
Owned and delivered a systems roadmap
Own Salesforce architecture: object model, permissions, integrations
Read Apex, SQL and API payloads
Shipped AI-powered workflows or agents to real users

title: Senior Manager, Sales Enablement
description: Overview CoolSys solves the most complex challenges in refrigeration, air conditioning, heating, engineering, and energy management. With over 3,700 associates nationwide, we deliver tailored solutions to help businesses cut costs, improve equipment performance, and reduce emissions. Our services include HVAC and refrigeration equipment sourcing, installation, repair, maintenance, monitoring, and optimization. We also offer engineering design, energy resilience and consumption optimization, asset recycling, and seamless multi-site rollouts across states. CoolSys serves over 45,000 customer locations in industries like retail, food service, commercial, data centers, industrial, and pharmaceuticals. No wonder Newsweek named CoolSys one of America’s Greatest Workplaces! We understand that hiring great people is the foundation of everything we do. Our employee benefits packages include: Competitive pay: $120-155K Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision and Prescription coverage. Paid vacation, holidays, and floating holiday. 401(K) with Company match. Company sponsored life insurance, as well as optional AD&D, short and long-term disability. Tuition reimbursement. Employee discounts on vehicles, hotels, theme parks, select cell phone bills and so much more. Pet Insurance. Legal Plan, and ID Theft Protection. JOB SUMMARY The Senior Manager, Sales Enablement is responsible for improving seller effectiveness and accelerating adoption of CoolSys' commercial strategy across the organization. This role translates go-to-market priorities, customer insights, sales methodology, and CoolSys capabilities into the programs, tools, coaching frameworks, sales plays, and resources sellers and sales leaders need to win. The Senior Manager will establish and lead a centralized sales enablement function across business units, creating greater consistency in how CoolSys sellers onboard, plan accounts, manage opportunities, communicate value, execute strategic growth plays, and develop their capabilities. The role will partner closely with Sales Leadership, Commercial Operations, Marketing, Pricing, Analytics, and business leaders to ensure enablement priorities are aligned to the company's growth strategy and embedded into day-to-day selling motions. The successful candidate will combine strong sales and commercial acumen with program leadership, facilitation, change management, and analytical skills. The role is accountable not simply for delivering training or content, but for improving seller readiness, sales execution, adoption, time-to-productivity, and measurable commercial performance. Responsibilities Sales Enablement Strategy & Operating Model Establish and lead a centralized sales enablement strategy, operating model, roadmap, and governance framework across CoolSys business units. Translate commercial priorities and growth initiatives into clear seller enablement plans, programs, tools, and adoption strategies. Partner with Sales Leadership and Commercial Operations to identify the highest-impact capability gaps affecting seller productivity, growth, and execution. Create scalable enablement standards while allowing for appropriate differences by business unit, vertical, seller role, and sales motion. Prioritize enablement investments based on business impact, seller needs, customer opportunity, and commercial strategy. Sales Methodology & Selling Process Develop, implement, and continuously improve a common sales methodology and selling framework that creates greater consistency in how CoolSys sellers engage customers and advance opportunities. Define and enable best practices for discovery, qualification, value-based selling, opportunity strategy, stakeholder mapping, solution positioning, and opportunity progression. Develop practical tools, templates, and coaching resources that reinforce the methodology in active opportunities and customer conversations. Partner with Commercial Operations to align sales methodology, opportunity stages, qualification standards, account planning, and seller workflows within CRM and other commercial tools. Measure methodology adoption and identify opportunities to improve execution and consistency across teams. Seller Onboarding, Training & Certification Design, develop, and manage role-based onboarding programs for new sales representatives, account managers, business development leaders, and other commercial roles. Create learning paths that accelerate time-to-productivity and build knowledge of CoolSys capabilities, customer needs, verticals, value propositions, commercial processes, and selling expectations. Deliver and coordinate training for new and existing sellers using a mix of live, virtual, self-paced, and field-based learning approaches. Establish seller certification, reinforcement, and ongoing learning programs for critical capabilities and strategic priorities. Maintain curriculum and training content so it remains current, practical, and aligned with evolving business priorities. Sales Manager Enablement & Coaching Develop manager enablement programs that strengthen the ability of sales leaders to coach sellers, inspect opportunities, reinforce methodology, and improve performance. Create coaching guides, opportunity review frameworks, account review tools, and manager routines that reinforce consistent sales execution. Equip managers to support seller development, identify capability gaps, and reinforce strategic initiatives after formal training is complete. Partner with Sales Leadership to build accountability for enablement adoption and sustained behavior change within the field. Strategic Account Planning, Cross-Sell & Growth Plays Develop and maintain account planning frameworks for strategic and enterprise customers. Equip sellers to identify customer whitespace, cross-sell opportunities, account penetration opportunities, and ways to bring the broader CoolSys portfolio to existing customers. Create tools and guidance that help sellers connect customer needs to relevant CoolSys capabilities across services, solutions, and business units. Support coordinated enterprise selling and account planning across divisions where multiple CoolSys capabilities can create greater customer value. Partner with Sales Leadership, Marketing, and Analytics to translate customer and performance insights into targeted growth plays for priority accounts and segments. Vertical, Solution & Strategic Initiative Readiness Translate vertical strategies, customer insights, value propositions, and strategic offerings into seller-ready plays, messaging, discovery questions, proof points, and tools. Lead sales readiness for new services, solutions, pricing changes, commercial programs, and strategic growth initiatives. Develop launch and adoption plans that include training, manager reinforcement, seller communications, tools, and field feedback mechanisms. Coordinate cross-functional readiness with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Pricing, Commercial Operations, and relevant business leaders. Monitor adoption and field effectiveness of strategic plays and recommend improvements based on seller feedback and commercial results. Sales Playbooks, Content & Proof Points Own the enterprise sales playbook framework and enablement content library. Develop and maintain buyer-focused playbooks, discovery guides, opportunity tools, objection-handling resources, competitive materials, and pitch resources aligned to priority sales motions. Partner with Marketing to develop and activate customer success stories, case studies, testimonials, proof points, and value-based content that strengthens customer conversations. Ensure sellers have simple access to current, approved, and relevant resources within their normal workflows. Establish content governance standards and eliminate duplicate, outdated, or low-value materials. Program Adoption & Change Management Develop communication and adoption strategies that ensure sellers understand, adopt, and consistently execute new commercial priorities, sales plays, processes, pricing changes, and tools. Create structured communication cadences that simplify key sales updates and reduce information overload. Build reinforcement plans that extend beyond initial launches or training and drive sustained behavior change. Gather structured feedback from sellers and managers to identify adoption barriers and improve enablement programs. Measurement & Continuous Improvement Develop an enablement measurement framework that connects program adoption and seller readiness to commercial outcomes. Track and analyze time-to-productivity, methodology adoption, account-planning adoption, training effectiveness, seller and manager engagement, content utilization, and strategic-play adoption. Partner with Commercial Performance & Analytics to evaluate the relationship between enablement initiatives and measures such as seller productivity, opportunity progression, win rates, pipeline conversion, cross-sell penetration, and other relevant performance indicators. Conduct post-program and post-launch analysis to determine what is working, where adoption is weak, and where enablement should be adjusted. Present enablement outcomes, insights, and recommendations to Sales and Commercial Leadership. Qualifications Education / Training Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Education, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Work Experience / Skills 7+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, Sales Effectiveness, Sales Operations, Sales Training, or a related commercial function, including experience supporting B2B sales organizations. Demonstrated experience building or scaling sales enablement programs across a complex, multi-business-unit or multi-region organization. Experience developing and implementing sales methodologies, onboarding programs, playbooks, account planning frameworks, training programs, and seller tools. Strong understanding of B2B sales processes, opportunity management, account growth, value-based selling, and seller productivity. Strong project and program management skills with the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives from strategy through adoption. Excellent presentation, facilitation, communication, and stakeholder-management capabilities. Ability to influence sales leaders and business stakeholders without direct authority and create consistency across decentralized teams. Join Us Today, there are 27 different companies that make up the CoolSys family of brands. Our valued employees are at the heart of our continued growth and success. We invite you to be part of that growth! Connect with us on Facebook and X. CoolSys is an EEO/AA Employer.  All qualified individuals - Including all ages, colors, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other characteristics are encouraged to apply.   Pre-employment background screening (criminal and MVR for driving positions) and drug testing are required for all positions. CoolSys will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with federal law, state law, or local ordinance.

title: Revenue Operations & Proposal Coordinator
description:
About Draganfly: Draganfly Inc. (the “Company”) has been a recognized technology leader within the commercial UAV space for over two decades. We helped establish the commercial market & adoption of multi-rotor helicopters for public safety, agriculture, aerial imaging, & more. As a leader who helped shape the industry, Draganfly’s focus is on the sale of drone products and services, contract engineering & custom integration product development, and health monitoring products and services.
