title: Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
description:
**Job Description:**
Pluralsight helps tech teams build the skills that drive innovation, and Revenue Operations is how we turn our go-to-market strategy into reality. As Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations, you will lead the team that translates strategy into scalable Salesforce systems, processes, and data across our direct, partner, and digital motions. You will own the RevOps roadmap, set priorities based on business impact, and coach a team of analysts and admins to deliver. You'll work in a mission-driven, collaborative culture where you can take on new challenges and grow with purpose.
**What you'll do**
* Turn go-to-market strategy into clear system, data, and process requirements, and lead the team that delivers them in Salesforce
* Own the Salesforce request backlog and RevOps roadmap, balancing new requests, roadmap commitments, and ongoing maintenance based on business impact
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of RevOps Analysts and Admins, setting priorities and holding the team accountable for delivery
* Partner with Sales, Partner, Digital, IT, and data governance teams to resolve trade-offs and keep RevOps work aligned to company goals
* Own workflow and process documentation by role, from lead handoff and pipeline creation to forecasting, quoting, and renewals, so it reflects how reps work day to day
* Drive Salesforce data quality and territory integrity, and use insights on how reps spend their time to guide process and tooling investments
**What you'll bring**
* Experience leading process documentation and workflow health assessments across multiple go-to-market roles or teams
* Experience with CRM consolidations and/or CPQ implementations, plus familiarity with Jira, Confluence, and/or Lucidchart for requirements documentation
* Hands-on knowledge of key revenue tools such as Gainsight, Gong, ZoomInfo, and Dun & Bradstreet; forecasting tool experience is a plus
* Strong Excel and Salesforce reporting skills, with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable insights (Tableau is a plus)
* A track record of partnering across teams to set priorities, resolve trade-offs, and manage several initiatives at once with close attention to detail
* A coaching mindset, comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and a drive to find more efficient, scalable ways to work
**Requirements**
* 8+ years of experience in Sales, Revenue, or GTM Operations
* 4+ years managing analysts and/or administrators in a Revenue Operations function
* 4+ years of Salesforce experience (SFDC Admin experience is a plus), plus CPQ or related quoting tool experience
* Experience supporting global organizations
* **Travel:** You can expect to travel once a month for internal or team events.
* This is a remote role; however, applicants located within 45 miles of our Westlake/Dallas, TX office should expect to work on-site Tuesday through Thursday, with remote flexibility on Mondays and Fridays. This approach enables more effective collaboration, quicker decision-making, and a stronger culture, while still providing flexibility.

* We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging, where everyone can contribute and thrive.
* We are always learning, creating an environment where you can take on new challenges, expand your skills, and grow with purpose.

title: Director, Head of Sales Operations
description:

 This leadership role will own and modernize the sales operations engine for a growing commercial organization in the healthcare and life sciences technology space.
You will connect Sales, Finance, Marketing, Client Experience, and Client Solutions, translating strategy into scalable operating processes and actionable insights.
The role spans sales planning, forecasting, pipeline management, territory and quota design, commercial analytics, and deal support.
You will also lead the evolution of the sales technology stack and embed AI-driven forecasting, automation, and productivity tools into the commercial workflow.
As a strategic and hands-on leader, you will help improve seller productivity, data quality, revenue visibility, and operational efficiency.
You will lead an established Sales Operations team while partnering closely with senior leadership to support sustainable commercial growth.
The position offers a fully remote environment with occasional travel for client meetings, industry events, conferences, and team collaboration.
 Accountabilities
Lead annual and quarterly sales planning across territories, capacity, quotas, account segmentation, and compensation, while supporting go-to-market planning for new offerings.
Own the forecasting process across new business, renewals, and expansion, establishing pipeline standards, inspection rhythms, and regular forecast reviews with Sales leadership.
Partner with Finance on bookings-to-revenue reconciliation, campaign delivery pacing, and quarterly business reviews.
Build and maintain commercial reporting covering pipeline, win/loss performance, retention, renewals, upsell, representative productivity, and account or agency performance.
Establish and govern a single source of truth for commercial data and translate complex information into actionable insights for senior leadership.
Own the sales technology ecosystem, including Salesforce, forecasting, enablement, data enrichment, workflow tools, integrations, vendor relationships, and roadmap planning.
Define and execute an AI roadmap using AI agents, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation to improve forecasting, identify deal risks and next-best actions, reduce manual work, and increase seller productivity.
Drive CRM adoption, data quality, and scalable workflows while evaluating emerging AI technologies, piloting practical use cases, measuring results, and expanding successful solutions.
Oversee deal desk activities, including pricing governance, approval workflows, proposal support, and order processing in collaboration with Legal, Finance, and Client Experience.
Continuously improve quote-to-cash processes and rules of engagement across Sales, Client Experience, and Market Development.
Identify effective sales, outreach, deal, and renewal practices and scale them across the organization in partnership with Sales Enablement and Training.
Lead, mentor, and develop an established Sales Operations team covering analytics, systems administration, and deal support.
 Requirements
Bachelor’s degree required, with 10+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, or commercial strategy and at least 3 years leading the function or a significant portion of it.
Demonstrated people management experience and the ability to lead teams across analytics, systems, and commercial operations.
Deep hands-on expertise with Salesforce, including administration, reporting, and process design; broader revenue technology stack ownership is an advantage.
Proven experience with forecasting, territory and quota planning, and sales compensation within a quota-carrying sales organization.
Experience in media, advertising, point-of-care marketing, life sciences, healthcare technology, or similar environments; familiarity with annually renewing or re-sold revenue models is a plus.
Strong analytical capabilities, including practical experience using AI tools for analysis, forecasting, workflow automation, or similar applications.
Experience with tools such as Salesforce Einstein/Agentforce, generative AI assistants, or comparable AI technologies is valuable.
Advanced proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets; SQL and Power BI or similar business intelligence tools are preferred.
Ability to transform complex commercial data into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations for executive audiences.
Demonstrated ability to scale commercial functions through AI and automation, including identifying use cases, driving adoption, and measuring productivity impact.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to operate effectively at both strategic and hands-on levels in a fast-growing environment.

Base compensation of $200,000–$230,000 CAD, depending on experience, inclusive of base salary and variable incentive.

title: GTM Analytics Manager

As a GTM Analytics Manager , you'll operate as a senior individual contributor - independently owning high-visibility analytics work across pipeline, forecasting, and performance measurement, and serving as a trusted go-to partner for Sales, Delivery, and RevOps leadership.
This position is for an existing vacancy.
We work Flexible First. This role can be performed remotely anywhere within the province where you reside, whether that’s Ontario, Canada or British Columbia, Canada. We’d love for you to join us!
 The Impact You'll Have 
Independently own and drive high-visibility analytics projects across the revenue lifecycle - pipeline analysis, forecasting, win/loss trends, and conversion optimization - from scoping through delivery with minimal guidance
Serve as a go-to analyst and trusted cross-functional partner to Sales, Delivery, and RevOps leadership, translating business questions into data-driven recommendations backed by rigorous validation and documented QA
Lead the design and build-out of one or more of the team's strategic self-service dashboards (Pipeline Metrics, Sales Activity Performance, or Existing Customer Data Performance) in Tableau/Looker/Salesforce, in support of getting the sales org fully self-service on business-critical metrics
Help reduce the team's ad-hoc reporting load by identifying common request patterns, building reusable data models and templates, and creating self-service tools and documentation for "power users" on the sales team
Contribute to streamlining the delivery/launch forecast process - partnering with FP&A, Partner Operations, and RevOps
Bring AI into the team's day-to-day work: design, build, and implement AI-assisted workflows, automations, or lightweight agentic tools that cut down manual reporting and data-hygiene work and free the team up for higher-value analysis
Model the team's operating principles day to day: data-first decision-making, rigorous QA, active cross-functional collaboration, and continuous improvement of tools and process
 Who You Are 
5+ years of Fintech or payments experience in Sales/Revenue Operations, GTM/business analytics, or business consulting (or equivalent) - you operate as a strong independent contributor and need no guidance on core technical execution
Advanced SQL (multi-table joins, window functions, CTEs, query optimization) and expert-level dashboard/report development in Tableau and/or Looker
Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate analytics work - e.g., automating reporting pipelines, building lightweight agentic or LLM-powered tools, or using AI coding assistants to move faster
A track record of independently scoping and delivering analytics projects end-to-end, using research, data, and peer feedback to move work forward with little oversight
Strong data storytelling skills - able to translate technical analysis into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Established credibility as a cross-functional partner, with a collaborative, feedback-oriented approach to working with stakeholders and teammates

Experience with Python or R for analytics and automation
Statistical analysis background (hypothesis testing, regression, cohort analysis)
Experience with Jira, Asana, or similar tools
Prior experience informally mentoring or guiding junior analysts

Retirement savings program with company contribution
Equity in a publicly-traded company
Monthly stipend to support our remote work model

title: Sr. Director, GTM Operations
description:
**About Backstory**
Backstory (formerly People.ai) is the leading AI answers platform for sales teams. With more than a decade of training AI models on billions of sales interactions, Backstory enables modern sales teams to ask questions and get the right answer in the moment directly within their existing AI workflows. Sales leaders from companies like OpenAI, IBM, Red Hat, Verizon, Palo Alto Networks, Iron Mountain, TransUnion, Randstad and others rely on Backstory to get trusted answers wrapped in real business context helping them orchestrate deals more effectively and drive revenue.
By connecting every signal to the right accounts and opportunities, Backstory shows teams exactly what is happening and what to do next. Customers across industries including enterprise, cybersecurity, data and analytics, and defense use Backstory to drive trillions in pipeline and revenue.
Recognized by Gartner and Forrester, the Inc. 5000, Y Combinator Top Companies, and the Forbes AI 50, Backstory is based in San Francisco and backed by ICONIQ Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Akkadian Ventures and Mubadala Capital.
**The Role**
We are hiring a Sr. Director of GTM Operations to build the operating system behind Backstory’s growth. You will own the metrics, systems, cadences, and commercial operations that let a small, AI-leveraged team run what once took a much larger ops function. The role reports to the SVP of Customer Value.
This role brings GTM operations together in one place. Comp design, territory and quota planning, pricing approvals, lead routing, and CRM administration consolidate here instead of sitting in separate functions. Sales, CS, and Partnerships should run on one integrated operating system.
You will present quarterly results and forward guidance to the Executive Leadership Team, and be the authority on how confident leadership should be in the numbers. You will also run our GTM on Backstory itself, turning our own operating model into a proof point for customers.
### **Responsibilities**
**Measurement and data foundation**
* Instrument the full customer journey, from pre-funnel and partner activity through credit consumption and expansion. At our scale, this is a weeks-not-months deliverable.
* Define the GTM data model, funnel stages, and metric definitions so numbers reconcile across Sales, CS, Partnerships, and Finance.
* Connect product usage and billing data to the revenue stack so every customer is represented completely and consistently.
* Govern CRM fields and data quality through automation and clear standards, not manual cleanup.
**Forecasting and executive reporting**
* Design and run a forecasting rhythm built for a consumption-based, land-and-expand model: channel and marketing activity into pipeline, new-logo velocity, consumption trajectories, and expansion revenue.
* Present completed-quarter results and forward guidance to the ELT at each quarter-end.
* Give ELT members the analysis, forecasts, and materials they need to run their functions and report upward.
* Run forecast reviews, pipeline inspections, and business reviews as forums for decisions, not status updates.
* Use the data to pressure-test plans and flag risk early, even when the conclusion is unwelcome.
**Intelligence layer and AI**
* Build AI-driven reporting and analysis across solution presentation, adoption, credit consumption, and customer outcomes, with Backstory as the primary source of truth.
* Deliver automated briefings, pipeline intelligence, and self-serve analytics to the whole GTM organization, not just leadership.
* Make build, buy, or connect decisions for the GTM data and tooling that power instrumentation and the intelligence layer.
**Retention and expansion signals**
* Re-anchor our early warning system around solution adoption: credit consumption, feature activation, workflow integration depth, CS engagement, and conversation signals.
* Turn those signals into a review cadence and save and expand plays triggered by what customers are actually doing.
* Feed adoption-based churn and expansion signals into the forecast, so save and expand plays show up in projected revenue.
**Commercial operations**
* Comp plan design for Sales, CS, and Partnerships, in partnership with Finance and People.
* Territory, quota, and capacity planning, including clear rules of engagement and handoffs across direct, CS, and partner teams.
* CPQ and pricing approvals, from quote to close.
* Lead routing across marketing, sales, CS, and partners, with defined service levels.
* Day-to-day CRM administration and the health of revenue-critical systems.
**Be Our Best Customer**
* Run Backstory's GTM on Backstory, learning from our strongest adopters and trying uses customers that have not yet tried.
* Document the results so they can be referenced in customer and prospect conversations.
* Engage with customers and the market as a practitioner of the platform.
### **Qualifications**
* **Builder instinct.** You have built functions, systems, or processes from scratch rather than inheriting mature ones. You reach for leverage before headcount and lead a small team while staying close to the work.
* **Applied AI.** Deep understanding of the AI tooling landscape and the ability to make informed tooling decisions and understand where Backstory fits. You have deployed LLMs and AI tools in operational workflows, not just evaluated them. You know where AI outperforms traditional automation and where it adds risk. You have experience building the right AI infrastructure and supporting the change management required.
* **GTM operating model fluency.** You have run GTM operations through a real business model change, ideally consumption-based, land-and-expand, or channel-augmented. You can set the right metrics framework and put it in place without a long assessment phase.
* **Data architecture literacy.** You understand how GTM data is structured and flows across CRM, warehouse, and AI layers well enough to design instrumentation and make build, buy, or connect decisions. You don't need to be an engineer, but you don't depend on one to understand the data model.
* **Forecasting authority.** You know ARR forecasting deeply: where each input comes from, how it is calculated, and where it may be wrong. You can reconcile sources and tell executives how confident to be and why.
* **Commercial operations depth.** You have hands-on experience with comp design, territory and quota planning, CPQ and pricing approvals, lead routing, and CRM administration.
* **SaaS metrics fluency.** You can connect ARR, GRR, NDR, CAC, pipeline coverage, capacity, and productivity to how the business actually performs.
* **Modern data tooling:** working knowledge of SQL, dbt, or BI tools.
* **Executive presence.** You can present a difficult conclusion to the ELT without hiding behind the analysis, and push back constructively when the data calls for it.
* **Experience.** Typically 10+ years in revenue operations, GTM operations, or GTM strategy at a growth-stage B2B SaaS company, including leading a team.
**Nice to have**
* **Chief of Staff or CEO-adjacent experience:** translating strategic intent into operating plans, preparing board materials, and managing cross-functional work without formal authority.
* **Channel and partnership operations:** tracking, attribution, and handoffs between partner-sourced and direct pipeline.
* **Usage- or consumption-based pricing:** structuring and governing credit-based deals.

description:
About Hologram 
Hologram is building the future of IoT connectivity, delivering internet access to millions of connected devices worldwide. We process over 5 billion transactions per month across our global infrastructure. This isn't just another app; it's the invisible backbone powering everything from fleet tracking to smart city infrastructure. We tackle challenges of scale, reliability, and performance that few companies face.
What Makes a Hologrammer?
We look for people with insatiable curiosity and an uncompromising commitment to excellence. Hologrammers are the type who dig deeper when things break, ask 'why' before 'how,' and aren't satisfied until the solution is bulletproof.
 You'll love working here if you:

You will lead a small, high-leverage team (a Salesforce Admin and a GTM Engineer) and partner closely with Revenue Strategy & Planning, Sales Operations, Revenue Enablement, Customer Success Operations, Product & Technology, and Information Security.
 Your first job is to bring Gong to life, from rollout plan to adoption. 
 Responsibilities 
Gong Rollout
 Plan and Launch: Define scope, timeline, rollout waves, risks, and success measures. Run the project and keep commercial leadership informed.
 Integrate: Connect Gong to Salesforce, calendar, email, and conferencing tools, so every conversation lands on the right account, contact, and opportunity.

Revenue Technology Stack

 Connected Tools: Administer and optimize our data orchestration, enrichment, lead routing, and content management tools. Retire what we don’t use and integrate what we do.
 Signal-to-Action Workflows: Build workflows that turn signals into Sales rep and CSM actions, and own the signal-routing handoff that sends product usage and CSM insight to Account Management queues.
 Vendors, Roadmap, and Intake: Manage tech stack vendor relationships and renewals, run one intake and prioritization process for commercial tooling requests, and publish a roadmap that commercial leaders can see and shape.
 AI and Automation: Evaluate AI tools with a clear build-or-buy view and show the value they create.
 Documentation and Change: Keep the stack documented, communicate releases, and run training so changes stick.
 Security and Compliance: Work with Information Security, Legal & Compliance, and Procurement to keep our tools and data safe.

 Qualifications 
8+ years in revenue operations or sales systems, including 3+ years leading people.
A record of implementing conversation intelligence from kickoff to adoption. Gong experience is strongly preferred; experience with a similar CI platform also counts.
Deep Salesforce expertise across architecture, data model, automation, integrations, and governance. Salesforce certifications are a plus.
Hands-on experience connecting GTM tools through APIs and workflow automation platforms.
Working knowledge of a data warehouse and BI tools, such as Snowflake and Sigma, to connect system data to reporting.
Comfort with AI-enabled workflows, including LLM-based automation and MCP, and a clear sense of where automation shines and where people still lead.
Experience with enablement, lead routing, and sales intelligence platforms.
Experience managing vendors, contracts, and budgets alongside Procurement and Finance.
Strong change management skills. You can bring skeptical sellers along and make the new tool the easy choice.
Experience in B2B SaaS, data, or financial information services is a plus.
 Who You Are 
You pair process and engineering rigor with seller empathy. You like a clear target and a blank page. You challenge how things have always been done and back your ideas with data. You explain complex systems in plain language, whether you’re talking to a rep, a lawyer, or an executive.

We strive to create an inclusive and diverse work environment where all individuals are valued, respected, and treated fairly. We believe that diversity enriches our workplace and enhances our ability to innovate and succeed.

This is a strategic leadership role operating at the intersection of portfolio management, partner ecosystems, product development and go-to-market strategy. Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Solutioning and Partner teams, you will be responsible for shaping and commercialising Sogeti's service offerings, ensuring they are packaged, positioned and brought to market effectively through both direct and indirect channels.

This role is critical to accelerating partner-led growth, increasing marketplace adoption and enhancing Sogeti's overall go-to-market effectiveness.  Key responsibilities 
Portfolio & Product Leadership
• Own and evolve Sogeti UK's portfolio of solutions and offerings, ensuring alignment with market demand, client needs and business priorities.
• Lead the productisation of services and solutions, transforming capabilities into repeatable, market-ready propositions.
• Develop and maintain a portfolio strategy that supports growth, differentiation and long-term commercial success.
• Collaborate with solution, delivery and business leaders to identify, develop and launch new offerings.
Go-To-Market Strategy & Offer Development
• Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for new and existing offerings.
• Create scalable, packaged solutions that can be sold through both direct and partner-led channels.
• Drive the development of marketplace-ready offerings, including AWS Marketplace and other strategic partner platforms.
• Ensure propositions are clearly defined, commercially compelling and easily consumable by clients and partners.
• Support the creation of repeatable offerings that simplify the purchasing process and strengthen market positioning.
Partner & Ecosystem Management
• Build and maintain strategic relationships with key partners including AWS, Microsoft, Google Cloud and other digital-native organisations.
• Work closely with Partner Management teams to develop joint growth initiatives and go-to-market motions.
• Identify opportunities for co-investment, solution development and partner-enabled market expansion.
• Optimise the use of partner funding and investment programmes to maximise business impact and growth.
• Act as a key liaison between partner ecosystems, sales teams and marketing functions.
Market & Commercial Enablement
• Conduct market analysis to identify industry trends, competitive dynamics and growth opportunities.
• Support sales teams by ensuring offerings are aligned with market demand and partner priorities.
• Influence pipeline generation and revenue growth through effective portfolio positioning and ecosystem engagement.
• Support marketing campaigns, partner events and industry initiatives that strengthen market presence and brand awareness.
Stakeholder Management
• Act as the central point of collaboration between Sales, Marketing, Solutioning, Alliances and Leadership teams.
• Provide regular updates on portfolio performance, partner initiatives and go-to-market effectiveness.
• Contribute to strategic planning activities and support the continued growth of Sogeti's business serving target commercial organisations.
• Work across regional and global stakeholders to ensure alignment with broader Capgemini and Sogeti portfolio objectives.
 Qualifications and Experience 
• Proven experience in portfolio management, product strategy, partner ecosystems, alliances or go-to-market leadership roles within a technology services, consulting or systems integration environment.
• Strong understanding of cloud ecosystems and strategic partnerships, particularly AWS, Microsoft and Google Cloud.
• Demonstrable experience developing and launching market-ready service offerings, solutions or products.
• Experience working with partner-led growth models, digital marketplaces and indirect sales channels.
• Strong commercial acumen with the ability to combine strategic thinking with practical execution.
• Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills.
• Strong analytical capability with the ability to interpret market trends and business performance data.
• Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed organisation.
• Experience within a boutique consultancy, cloud-native organisation, hyperscaler ecosystem or technology business. 
 Preferred Background 
We expect this individual to come from a portfolio, alliances, ecosystem, product marketing or go-to-market leadership background rather than a traditional direct sales role. Experience developing partner-led growth strategies, marketplace offerings and repeatable technology services propositions will be particularly valuable for success in this position.
Experience working within cloud-focused consultancies, specialist technology firms or organisations with strong partner-led business models would be advantageous
 Why you should consider Capgemini 
Growing clients' businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you'll join a thriving company and become part of a diverse collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what's possible. It's why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world's leading businesses, and it's how you'll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you'll build the skills you want. You'll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.
 About Capgemini and Sogeti 
Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fuelled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. 
Sogeti, part of the Capgemini Group, is a leading provider of technology, engineering and digital transformation services. Combining the agility of a specialist technology consultancy with the scale, capabilities and global reach of Capgemini, Sogeti helps clients unlock value through cloud, data, AI, software engineering and cybersecurity solutions.
Focused on serving commercial organisations with annual turnover between £1 billion and £5 billion, Sogeti works with organisations to accelerate innovation, modernise technology platforms and achieve measurable business outcomes through technology-led transformation.

title: Sales Operations Analyst - 20-month contract
description:
Company Overview
 Brother is a leading provider of home and office equipment, sewing and crafting products, and industrial solutions. With a legacy spanning over 115 years, our brand is renowned for producing award-winning printers, sewing machines, P-touch labelers, and more. Brother Canada was established in 1960, marking over 65 years of operations. Brother Canada is headquartered in Dollard-des-Ormeaux, Quebec and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Brother International Corporation (BIC), based in the United States. BIC is in itself a subsidiary of Brother Industries Limited (BIL), which was founded in 1908 in Nagoya, Japan and operates in more than 30 countries worldwide.
 Why Work at Brother?
 At Brother Canada, we’re more than a team; we’re a community guided by our culture drivers of Accountability, Authenticity, Excellence, and Boldness. We foster collaboration, growth, and work-life balance through flexible hours, hybrid work options, wellness subsidies, learning and development, recognition programs, and employee discounts. With roots in Montreal since 1960, we embrace continuous improvement and a culture of “Challenging Spirit,” offering stability while delivering a superior customer experience.
 Role Overview
 Reporting to the Director, B2C Sales, the B2C Sales Operations Analyst supports the B2C Sales team by managing sales reporting, analytics, and operational processes. The role works closely with B2C Sales team members, internal stakeholders from cross functional teams, and key retail accounts to consolidate and analyze sales, inventory, order, and promotional information. By delivering accurate reporting, actionable insights, and responsive operational support, the Analyst helps the sales team make informed decisions, identify business opportunities, and maintain strong customer relationships.
 Duties & Responsibilities
 Reporting & Data Analysis
Prepare and distribute accurate weekly and monthly sales, purchase, cancellation, inventory, order, and point-of-sale reports for assigned retail accounts and sales channels
Consolidate data from multiple internal and external sources, validate its accuracy, investigate discrepancies, and escalate significant issues when required
Analyze sales performance, inventory, order plans, and promotional activity to identify trends, risks, gaps, and business opportunities
Translate reporting results into clear insights and recommendations that support account planning and B2C Sales decision-making
Maintain retail account reporting tools and dashboards, ensuring information is accurate, current, and available according to established reporting timelines
Prepare reporting materials and business updates for internal reviews, customer meetings, and account-planning discussions
Identify and implement opportunities to improve reporting accuracy, information flow, process efficiency, and stakeholder experience 
Sales, Accounts & Cross-Functional Support
Monitor weekly order-plan performance and collaborate with account buying teams, account managers, and Supply
Chain to address forecast, inventory, or order-related issues 
Support product launches by coordinating pricing, item setup, launch information, and other required product data with internal teams and customer contacts 
Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product Management, Supply Chain, and other internal stakeholders to respond to customer and account information requests 
Support promotional planning and execution by maintaining relevant information, monitoring activity, and communicating changes or issues to appropriate stakeholders 
Act as a responsive point of contact for operational and reporting questions from assigned key retail accounts and internal stakeholders 
Participate in weekly B2C Sales meetings and provide updates on reporting, orders, inventory, promotions, risks, and follow-up action 
Customer & Additional Support
Attend customer meetings occasionally, as required 
Perform other related duties and support ad hoc projects as assigned
 Education
 Experience & Qualifications
University degree or college diploma in business, commerce, analytics, supply chain, finance, or related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
 Experience
At least three years of experience in sales operations, sales support, retail account support, customer service, supply chain, business analytics, or a related field
Experience in consumer electronics, consumer packaged goods, retail, or another product-based industry Preferred
Experience supporting major retail or e-commerce accounts Preferred
 Languages
Bilingual
Proficiency in both written and verbal English communication is essential for effective correspondence with clients, suppliers, business partners and colleagues beyond the province of Quebec
 Skills / Knowledge / Abilities
Demonstrated ability to consolidate, validate, analyze, and interpret data from multiple sources
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, data validation, and the organization and analysis of large data sets
Experience preparing recurring reports, dashboards, or sales performance analyses
Strong attention to detail and demonstrated commitment to data accuracy and quality
Ability to identify discrepancies, investigate underlying causes, and raise issues or risks in a timely manner
Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into clear insights and recommendations
Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage recurring deadlines and changing priorities
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams and external customer contacts
Experience working with point-of-sale, inventory, order, forecast, and promotional data Preferred
Experience using Tableau or another business intelligence and data-visualization platform Preferred
Experience improving reporting processes, dashboards, or data-quality controls Preferred
 Additional Details For This Role
 Hybrid Work Setting – Enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid model, with three days working remotely and two days in the office each week, supporting work-life balance and meaningful in-person collaboration. Exceptions may apply according to business needs. #atyourside
 Our Benefits
 We believe benefits should empower you to thrive at work and beyond. Our health and wellness benefits go beyond the basics, with medical, dental, vision, mental health support, financial advisors, and fitness programs to keep your mind and body in top shape. We’re big believers in recharging your batteries, with flexible vacation, personal days, summer hours, and a company-wide holiday shutdown so you can enjoy real downtime. Our retirement plan helps your savings grow faster with matching contributions and extra perks like a TFSA and mortgage benefits. And because growth fuels success, we invest in you with development programs, from LinkedIn Learning and Brother curated learnings to tuition reimbursement and personalized development plans. But it’s not all work, we love to celebrate! From BBQs to gala nights and our STAR recognition program, your wins get noticed and rewarded. At Brother Canada, we are truly At Your Side, supporting your success every step of the way.
 Our Mission, Vision & Culture
 Our mission is to live our “at your side” promise to simplify and enrich the lives of our customers, employees, and communities. We aim to be where people and technology meet, providing products and solutions that enhance how people live, work, and create. We look to our strategic culture drivers - accountability, authenticity, boldness, and excellence - to enable us to consistently deliver on our vision, mission, and shared values. These drivers help us shape a culture that empowers the business to succeed.
 About Where We Work
 Brother Canada’s head office and distribution centre in Montreal’s West Island is at the heart of our operations, housing teams in Marketing, Sales, Customer Experience, HR, IT, Finance, Supply Chain, and more. Our sales office in Mississauga, Ontario, and distribution centre in Richmond, British Columbia, support our coast-to-coast operations. We collaborate across Canada and Brother Americas - always At Your Side.
 Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) Statement
 At Brother Canada, we strive to provide an environment where everyone feels valued by respecting individual differences and welcoming diverse life and work styles. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate or make employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Associate Director, Commercial Operations
description:
At Gilead Sciences Canada Inc. we take pride in being recognized as one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employer 2024. Click here to find out why Gilead Sciences Canada is a top employer!
Chez Gilead Sciences Canada Inc., nous sommes fiers d’être reconnus comme l’un des meilleurs employeurs du Grand Toronto pour 2024. Cliquez ici pour en savoir plus sur les raisons de notre succès.
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.
Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.
We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.
 Job Description
 Associate Director, Commercial Operations 
 Mississauga, hybrid eligible 3 days/week on site
 The Associate Director will have a focus on Customer Centricity & Commercial Analytics Enablement and will be accountable for the systems, tools and insights that make Gilead Canada a more customer-centric organization. The role leads a team of three specialists and sets the vision across three pillars: driving affiliate-wide adoption and effective use of G360 (Veeva CRM); delivering up-to-date, reliable and usable Tableau dashboards on the ICF platform; and providing strategic oversight on the standardization of AI tools — including Databricks Genie and related AI models — that leverage our data to generate timely insights. The role partners closely with Business Units, Marketing, Market Access, GDSI, IT and Global Commercial Operations.
 Essential Duties And Job Functions
 Lead and develop a team of three specialists (G360/BPO, Tableau/Dashboards, and AI Insights Standardization), setting clear objectives, backlogs and priorities aligned to affiliate strategy
Own the affiliate customer-centricity roadmap, integrating interaction data, account-centric (xKAM) and reporting into a cohesive backbone for field execution
Lead the Incentive Compensation Plan for the Canadian Affiliate, working with leadership to ensure plans drive sales execution, meet Canadian legal requirements and are aligned to the affiliate goals. Ensure IC plans are aligned to Canadian pharmaceutical company norms.
Champion enhanced G360 adoption and data quality across the affiliate; ensure readiness for the 2027 G360 upgrade and Veeva Align through global (ROW) standardization.
Support potential launch initiatives and ongoing business requirements through the analysis of sales force sizing, HCP coverage, overlap with existing sales teams, etc. to enable successful product launches. 
Lead the Gilead Canada pre and post launch evaluations with Canadian Leadership.
Establish governance and standards for AI tooling that uses our data, ensuring consistency, security (Unity Catalog persona-based access), auditability and a single source of truth for KPIs.
Enhance sales business planning by working closely with internal stakeholders on templates and aligning templates to BPOA strategies. Ensure that measurements are in place to ensure execution is enabled.
Partner with GDSI, IT and Global Commercial Operations to expand use of ICF Data Products and align local practices to enterprise data and AI governance policy.
Communicate insights and recommendations to senior management; influence strategic direction and secure resourcing for capability investments.
Measure and report on adoption, usability, time-to-insight and engagement outcomes; continuously improve ways of working and reduce manual effort/rework.
 Knowledge, Experience And Skills
10+ years of experience with a Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, economics, data/analytics or a related field; advanced degree an asset.
Demonstrated leadership of analytics, CRM/commercial operations or data capabilities, ideally within pharmaceutical/biotech.
Strong understanding of CRM (Veeva or Salesforce), BI platforms (Tableau), modern data platforms (Databricks/ICF) and AI/GenAI concepts.
Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead cross-functional change management.
Excellent communication, prioritization and vendor/stakeholder management skills.
A self-starter with high motivation, proactive problem-solving skills and thrives in complex and ambiguous situations
Ability to manage complex projects independently, from planning through execution, with strong organisational and time management skills.
 For Current Gilead Employees And Contractors
 Please apply via the Internal Career Opportunities portal in Workday.
The salary range for this position is CAD $147,305 - $190,630 annually. In addition, this role is eligible for a discretionary target annual bonus. Gilead determines base compensation by considering factors such as experience, qualifications, and geographic location. As a result, actual compensation may vary.

title: Regional Lead – Revenue Operations & Project Lifecycle
description:
At Oliver Wyman, a Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) business, we bring deep industry insight, bold innovation, and a collaborative approach that cuts through complexity to help organizations navigate their most defining transformative moments.
For more information, visit oliverwyman.com , or follow us on LinkedIn and X .
 This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
 Role Purpose
 Lead the operational execution and ongoing evolution of Oliver Wyman Europe’s end-to-end project lifecycle, ensuring projects move efficiently from setup through invoicing and cash collection with strong governance, commercial accuracy and operational excellence.
As Regional Lead, you will combine people leadership with hands-on operational expertise, leading the Europe Project Setup team while acting as the senior escalation point for complex project lifecycle matters.
Working closely with Partners and cross-functional Finance and Technology teams, you will simplify processes, strengthen revenue operations and drive the adoption of AI, automation and ERP capabilities to improve efficiency and enhance the Partner and colleague experience.
 Why Join Us
Shape a critical business capability by leading the operational engine that supports Oliver Wyman’s commercial delivery across Europe.
Work at the centre of the business, partnering with senior stakeholders across Finance, Technology, Talent Management and the Partnership to solve complex operational challenges.
Drive meaningful transformation by modernising project lifecycle processes through AI, automation and digital technologies, while developing regional leadership experience and scalable operating models.
Benefits: Enjoy a competitive pension, comprehensive private medical cover, life assurance, and a vibrant culture with regular happy hours, social events, and opportunities to connect with colleagues.
 Meet the Team
Reports to:Regional Executive Director of Finance
Day-to-day collaborators:Partners, FP&A, Controllership, Talent Management and Technology teams
People management: Lead the Europe Project Setup team, ensuring consistent, high-quality project setup delivery across the region while developing capability, balancing workload and scaling the operating model. Manager Input Required – confirm the approximate team size, reporting structure and formal people-management responsibilities for publication.
 How This Role Will Contribute To Team Success
 Strengthen operational governance across Europe’s project lifecycle, improving commercial accuracy, forecasting reliability and service consistency from project setup through cash collection.
Enable increasingly sophisticated commercial models by translating complex commercial arrangements into scalable operational processes that protect revenue integrity and support Partners.
Lead the evolution of the Project Lifecycle operating model through simplification, automation and the adoption of AI and ERP capabilities that improve efficiency and reduce administrative effort.
 Your Day-to-Day
 Project Lifecycle Operations & Team Leadership
 Lead the Europe Project Setup team, ensuring consistent, high-quality delivery of project setup activities across the region. Build a high-performing team by balancing workload, developing capability and maintaining resilient service levels across markets.
Provide hands-on support for complex commercial arrangements and periods of peak demand, acting as the senior escalation point for project lifecycle issues and Partner enquiries. Monitor operational performance, resolve service-level escalations and use operational KPIs to identify improvement opportunities.
Provide leadership and Partners with clear reporting, insight and actionable recommendations that strengthen governance, consistency and service quality across Europe.
 Revenue Operations
 Own the regional Revenue Operations control framework, ensuring accurate project setup, reliable backlog management, forecasting, invoicing and cash collection. Maintain accurate project and backlog data to support dependable forecasting, revenue reporting and commercial decision-making, and lead regular reviews with FP&A colleagues.
Coordinate with FP&A, Talent Management and Controllership to determine the appropriate operational treatment of revenue and commercial arrangements, enabling sophisticated commercial models through clear controls and governance.
Improve the accuracy of revenue outcomes by addressing contractor costs, expert interview costs, rebates, e-invoicing and other non-standard commercial arrangements. Act as the regional Finance operations coordination point across Controllership, Talent Management and Technology for project lifecycle processes.
 Project Lifecycle Transformation Enablement
 Lead the redesign of Europe’s project lifecycle operating model, identifying opportunities to simplify processes, standardise ways of working and automate repetitive activities.
Champion the adoption of AI, ERP capabilities and automation technologies that reduce manual effort, improve operational efficiency and enhance the Partner experience.
Own the regional roadmap for project lifecycle systems, working with Technology and Global Finance teams to prioritise enhancements, resolve issues and deliver continuous operational improvements.
 Skills & What You Bring To The Team
Experience in a senior project lifecycle management, revenue control or finance operations leadership role within a professional services environment.
Deep understanding of work in progress, billing and revenue recognition practices.
Commercial judgement and the ability to interpret complex contracts and influence senior stakeholders and Partners.
Experience leading operational improvement or transformation initiatives that improve efficiency, governance or commercial outcomes.
Experience analysing complex operational or financial information and communicating recommendations to stakeholders across international teams.
 What Will Make You Stand Out
Experience implementing AI or workflow automation within finance or operational processes.
Experience with ERP, CRM and project lifecycle platforms; Salesforce experience is advantageous.
Experience using reporting and visualisation tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
Advanced Excel and PowerPoint capability.
Fluent English; additional European language skills are advantageous.
 How To Apply
 Submit CV

title: Global Head of Customer Success
description:
Your job
Assaia is a Series B vertical SaaS company building AI-powered turnaround intelligence for the aviation industry. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Zurich and a strong presence in Germany, Spain and the United States, we are a team of around 125 people across Europe and North America.
Our two products, ApronAI and Assaia RMS, turn live video and operational data from the apron into real-time insight, alerts and predictions that help airports, airlines and ground handlers run safer, more punctual and more efficient turnarounds. We work with more than 25 leading aviation organisations worldwide, including New York JFK (JFKIAT), United Airlines, London Heathrow, Dubai Airports and Singapore Changi Airport. See details and demos on our website and LinkedIn.
Aviation is a small industry where everybody knows each other. From day one, our Customer Success team has been essential in making sure that every customer we win turns into a live, well-adopted deployment and a partner who is happy to vouch for us. As we scale, we are making Customer Success an even more commercial function with clear ownership of customer expansion and contract extensions.
 The Role
 We are looking for a Global Head of Customer Success with a strong operational aviation background and a commercial mindset working in a player-coach setup. You will lead our global Customer Success team of four, three Customer Success Managers across North America and Europe plus yourself, while personally owning a portfolio of our most strategic accounts. We are looking for someone who is based in North America, on the East Coast. You can work from wherever you are based, as long as you can travel to our customers and spend time with a team spread across North American and European time zones.
The role has three layers: 
leading and developing the team and its way of working; 
being the senior customer-facing owner of outcomes for your own accounts;
building the engine that turns customer value into references, renewals and growth.
You will work closely with Sales, Delivery and Product and be part of Assaia's extended leadership team.
Ultimately, the Customer Success team exists to ensure:
References. Happy customers who are willing to share, or let us share, the story of what we achieved together.
Retention. Customers who see value every day, renew at the end of their initial term and regard us as an essential part of their business.
Revenue. Additional revenue through extensions, increased scope, new use cases and new sites, as a direct result of the value we have proven.
Responsibilities
 Lead the Customer Success team 
Lead, coach and develop a global team of Customer Success Managers; set clear goals and make sure every customer has a named owner and an active success plan.
Own the CS operating model: playbooks for onboarding, adoption, health monitoring, executive reviews and renewals, plus the tooling and metrics to run them consistently across regions.
Review account goals and health across the team and step in personally on escalations or at-risk customers.
Define and report on the team's KPIs, such as time-to-value, adoption and usage, customer health, net revenue retention and referenceability, and represent Customer Success in the leadership team.
Grow the team as Assaia grows, including hiring, onboarding and capability building.
 Own customer outcomes for your own accounts (roughly 50% of your time) 
Build a deep understanding of each customer's operations (airport, airline, ground handler) and translate it into use cases and concepts of operations that define how Assaia's products will be used and where the value comes from.
Prepare customer organisations for implementation and the new way of working; run workshops with our Delivery team to define product configuration so every customer receives a system built around its intended use cases.
Manage user training and onboarding, and design and execute adoption strategies together with customers so Assaia becomes part of their daily routines and Standard Operating Procedures.
Track usage, detect adoption problems early and act on them; analyse and report on the operational and financial impact we create, and make that impact visible to customer leadership.
Build and maintain trusted relationships with both frontline operational staff and senior leadership, and stay close to the customer organisation even when there is no immediate requirement to do so.
 Drive expansion, extensions and renewals
Own the health and growth plan for your accounts, and ensure one exists for every account across the team: identify expansion opportunities and turn proven value into a compelling business case.
Develop these opportunities together with the customer and hand them over to Sales in a qualified, well-prepared state.
Prepare renewals and contract extensions well ahead of time.
Turn successful customers into references: case studies, joint conference presentations, peer-to-peer introductions and site visits for prospects.
 Be the voice of the customer 
Consult customers on how to further improve their operations and bring back structured feedback, requirements and roadmap input to Product, prioritised by customer value and commercial impact.
Facilitate the sharing of best practices between customers to drive further value creation across our customer base.
 Support Sales 
Support pre-sales campaigns with best practices, key use cases and achieved results, and run pre-sales workshops with prospects to map use cases, scope and required features.
Make sure prospective customers understand how our solutions are used in daily operations and the value they can expect, based on real results from existing customers.
What success looks like in the first 12 months
Your own accounts are healthy with high user adoption, proven impact and renewals secured.
Every customer has a named CSM, a success plan and a health score, and the team works from shared playbooks across regions.
Customers that are not yet live have a clear path to go-live and adoption, and time-to-value is measurably shorter than today.
A visible, qualified expansion and renewal pipeline exists for the customer base, jointly managed with Sales, and net revenue retention is trending up.
A growing set of referenceable customers is actively supporting our sales efforts worldwide.
Requirements
In-depth experience in the aviation sector, preferably from a ground operations, APOC or OCC perspective, so you can relate to how our customers work and speak their language.
Several years in customer success, account management, consulting or an operational leadership role in a B2B software or aviation environment.
Proven experience in leading a global team in a player / coach setup. .
A commercial mindset: you understand how value turns into renewals and growth, are comfortable building business cases and discussing scope and commercials with senior stakeholders, and enjoy working hand-in-hand with Sales.
Experienced in business- and behavioural change management, and able to get frontline staff and senior leadership equally excited about a new way of working.
Strong understanding of corporate hierarchies and proven ability to successfully maneuver in complex matrix organizations.
Strong analytical skills; you like working with data and turning it into insight and action.
Highly ambitious, self-confident and loves to engage with customers; likeable and highly empathetic.
Comfortable and able to work with people from different cultural and professional backgrounds, and leading a distributed team across time zones.
Works independently and proactively in a remote setting.
Ability and willingness for extensive international travel to customers across North America, Europe and beyond, and to work flexibly across time zones.
Very good command of English; any other language skills are a bonus.
Why Assaia
Assaia is a unique place where you can work on a technically advanced and innovative product, built with novel technologies for an exciting and important industry. You will be working in a diverse international team of smart people who learn a lot from each other, and you will shape how a scaling company treats its customers. Additionally, we offer:
Participation in making important decisions, your ideas will be heard and implemented.
A leadership role with real ownership of a function that is central to how Assaia grows.
Remote work with a flexible schedule, and the chance to travel the world for us.
A great company culture based on honesty and mutual respect, with live team events.
Paid relevant conferences and online education.
We are a team of around 125 people today and we are looking forward to growing it with you!

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:

The Revenue Operations Specialist will support Diligent's global revenue operations function by managing product catalog data, SKU governance, and Deal Desk processes. Working closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and a high-performing global Deal Desk team, this role will ensure products, pricing, quotes, and commercial data are accurately maintained across Salesforce and related systems. The successful candidate will help drive operational excellence, improve quote-to-cash efficiency, and support scalable growth through strong data governance, cross-functional collaboration, and process optimization.
 Key Responsibilities 
Transform marketing materials and business inputs into standardized product catalog structures
Support the creation, maintenance, and governance of SKU files to ensure accuracy and consistency
Assist in gathering and documenting SKU requirements from business cases and product initiatives
Partner with cross-functional teams to align catalog structure with pricing, packaging, and revenue strategy
Enable seamless integration of the product code catalog into backend systems (e.g., ERP, billing, CRM) 
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and alignment across all platforms 
Support system updates and enhancements related to product catalog and SKU structures 
Assist with the integration of acquired companies into existing product catalog and SKU frameworks
Standardize and map legacy product structures into the company’s catalog model 
Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure smooth transition and minimal revenue disruption
Support Revenue Operations testing processes for new SKU and product launches
Validate catalog setup and system readiness prior to go-live
Troubleshoot issues and ensure successful deployment
Support the Revenue Operations Manager in managing SKU workflows and request queues
Help prioritize incoming requests and ensure timely processing
Maintain documentation and process clarity for ongoing RevOps operations
 Required Experience/Skills 
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field
5-7 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Accounting Operations, or Product Operations 
Strong attention to detail and data accuracy 
Experience working with product catalogs, SKUs, or pricing structures preferred 
Familiarity with ERP, CRM, or billing systems (e.g., NetSuite, Salesforce) is a plus 
Strong organizational and cross-functional collaboration skills
 About Us 
Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700,000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. The Diligent One Platform gives practitioners, the C-Suite and the board a consolidated view of their entire GRC practice so they can more effectively manage risk, build greater resilience and make better decisions, faster. 
At Diligent, we're building the future with people who think boldly and move fast. Whether you're designing systems that leverage large language models or part of a team reimaging workflows with AI, you'll help us unlock entirely new ways of working and thinking. Curiosity is in our DNA, we look for individuals willing to ask the big questions and experiment fearlessly - those who embrace change not as a challenge, but as an opportunity. The future belongs to those who keep learning, and we are building it together. At Diligent, you’re not just building the future - you’re an agent of positive change, joining a global community on a mission to make an impact.
Learn more at diligent.com or follow us on LinkedIn and Facebook
 What Diligent Offers You 
 Creativity is ingrained in our culture. We are innovative collaborators by nature. We thrive in exploring how things can be differently both in our internal processes and to help our clients
 We care about our people. Diligent offers a flexible work environment, global days of service, comprehensive health benefits, meeting free days, generous time off policy and wellness programs to name a few
 We have teams all over the world . We may be headquartered in New York City, but we have office hubs in Washington D.C., Vancouver, London, Galway, Budapest, Munich, Bengaluru, Singapore, and Sydney.

title: Manager, GTM Evolution
description:
who are we
lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.
about this team
The Go-To-Market Evolution Team sits at the heart of the end-to-end value chain transformation of how lululemon operates. We are accountable for architecting the future-state vision and GTM engine while providing strategic support, evaluating & driving synergies, to drive discipled, measurable progress to deliver that vision.
We are experts in how all the functional processes come together to make up our go-to-market value chain. This provides us the unique ability to bring voice to trade-offs as we identify, design, and deliver evolutions that are best for the business, our teams, and our guest.
We always have the guest in mind when we identify, and drive integration needs across the value chain and make recommendations for action in alignment with the luluemon’s overall strategy. The team members are essential thought partners with several areas of the Company, including executive leadership, brand, merchandising, planning, design, supply chain and other functions that support how we create and sell our product.
This means taking a holistic approach to meet our guest expectations by improving our GTM engine, including processes and timelines, establish a KPI driven approach on how we go to market that complements our creativity, and increase our partner collaboration while yielding higher quality processes, better strategy integration and an authentic engagement with all involved parties.
The selected candidate will be a self-starter with an entrepreneurial spirit and team leader who can provide drive future growth opportunities, along with strategic direction and prioritization while integrating cross-functional strategies into the GTM process.
core responsibilities
This person will ensure on-time delivery of workstreams, raise risks and flags to the GTM Evolution leadership team as well as lead complex and impactful initiatives and work-streams underneath the overall transformation umbrella. They will support their leader in exec reporting, materials, updates, and other documentation as needed and will support effective decision making.
* Each day will look different in your project-based role, including activities like clarifying strategic questions, design solutions, project managing your workstream, and document creation.
* Enhance the GTM process by identifying strategic decisions, desired process, and tooling capabilities and solutions, with the entire value chain in mind.
* Build trusted relationships at many levels of the organization to provide clarity and garner buy-in for ongoing initiatives.
* Act as an internal advisor to cross-functional leaders to define the problem, develop options, and design solutions.
* Conduct and/or guide detailed operational process mapping and capability modelling.
* Collaborate with other teams involved in business transformation programs - including enterprise transformation, product management, change management, communications, learning/training, org design, etc. to plan and deliver against transformation objectives on-time and on-budget
qualifications
* Minimum of 5+ yrs of relevant professional experience in this field of work, including consulting and/or direct business management
* Deep understanding of apparel value chain, specifically the product creation and/or brand activation Value Chain
* Strong facilitation and problem-solving skills to drive alignment and innovative solutions
* Ability to drive problem solving process: frames problems, guides analytical modelling, and through analysis provides insights into solutions
* Drive continuous improvement and increased efficiency and effectiveness as business needs shifts
* Proven track record of building relationships, establishing rapport, credibility and trust
* Self-motivated, passionate, detail-oriented, multi-tasker extraordinaire who thrives in a fast-paced environment
* Resourceful, able to navigate an organization independently and comfortable with ambiguity
must haves
* Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life.
* Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovate to achieve great results.
* Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same.
* Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.
* Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships.
* Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously.
additional notes
Authorization to work in Canada is required for this role.

lululemon’s compensation offerings are grounded in a pay-for-performance philosophy that recognizes exceptional individual and team performance. The typical hiring range for this position is from $116,200 - $152,600 CAD annually; the base pay offered is based on market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity. **Who We Are**
Ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. Its AI-powered Connected Intelligence Platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. Partnering closely with the CRO and revenue organization leadership team, you'll own the systems, processes and cross-functional cadences that keep the revenue teams aligned as we scale.

title: Director Go to Market Operations
description:
Director Go to Market Operations
Be part of an iconic story.
TOMMY HILFIGER is one of the world’s most recognized global lifestyle brands, confidently welcoming and inspiring consumers since 1985. Originally established in New York City and infused with the vibrant spirit of Americana, to create the modern uniform of accessible luxury. The TOMMY HILFIGER brands consist of TOMMY HILFIGER and TOMMY JEANS, complemented by a range of licensed product categories that extend the brand lifestyle across generations, geographies, activities and occasions. Tommy Hilfiger’s global marketing approach and communications strategy taps into culture through the world of F.A.M.E.S.: the people, organizations and ideas boldly driving the future of Fashion, Art, Music, Entertainment and Sport. Major global campaigns, sponsorship platforms, and disruptive activations with world-class athletes, musicians and entertainers bring a constant source of energy and inspiration to the brand. Immerse yourself in TOMMY HILFIGER here! (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok)
About the team
The Go-To-Market team enables consistent, effective and scalable execution of the end-to-end Go-To-Market process. The team defines and maintains the operating model, governance, standards, milestones, decision rights, playbooks and enabling capabilities that help cross-functional teams align priorities, make timely decisions and bring products and initiatives to market effectively.
Working closely with Product, Marketing, Consumer Brand Experience, Sales, Operations, Finance, Merchandise Planning and other cross-functional partners, the team creates clarity and accountability across the Go-To-Market lifecycle and continuously strengthens how the organization plans and executes.
The Go-To-Market process is the backbone of how the Tommy Hilfiger brand delivers the very best products from concept to consumer. Through their leadership, the Director ensures this process builds compelling collections that meet consumer needs, delivers positive employee experiences for a broad group of team members, and that we move closer to consumers.
About the job
As Director, Go-To-Market Operations, you lead the Go-To-Market function and own the vision, operating model, governance and continued evolution of the organization’s end-to-end Go-To-Market process.
You translate business priorities into departmental plans, portfolio priorities, decision rights, performance measures and scalable ways of working. You lead delivery through managers and GTM professionals and are accountable for the team’s performance, capability, resources and sustainable delivery.
The role balances enterprise consistency with the flexibility required across different businesses, products and initiatives. You create clarity across complex cross-functional dependencies, shape and sponsor the GTM change agenda, and ensure that decisions are made by the appropriate owners at the right time.
The role reports to the VP, Product Strategy & Operations and partners closely with senior functional leaders across the organization.
Key responsibilities
Including, but not limited to:
• Define the Go-To-Market vision, functional strategy and multi-year roadmap, ensuring the GTM operating model remains aligned with business priorities and supports effective cross-functional execution.
• Lead transformation of our Go-To-Market process for the Product organization from creative brief to market launch, moving the organization toward a more effective and efficient future state model.
• Translate strategy into departmental objectives, operating plans, performance measures and clear accountabilities, ensuring the GTM team delivers agreed outcomes and continuously improves the effectiveness of the end-to-end process.
• Own and evolve the GTM operating model, including its principles, phases, milestones, governance, standards, decision rights, escalation paths, operating cadence, playbooks and knowledge assets.
• Lead delivery through managers and GTM professionals by setting direction, delegating accountability and decision-making at the appropriate level, and holding leaders and team members accountable for agreed outcomes.
• Establish effective cross-functional planning and governance forums that create visibility of milestone readiness, decisions, dependencies, risks and ownership, ensuring issues are resolved or escalated to the appropriate decision owner.
• Set priorities across the GTM portfolio and manage the function’s resources and allocated resources within delegated authority; make or recommend decisions to accelerate, sequence, defer, reduce in scope or stop work based on business value, urgency, risk, dependencies and available capacity.
• Establish and develop strong communications tools for all stakeholders to ensure clarity of accountability, deliverables, and timelines.
• Build trusted relationships with senior cross-functional stakeholders, constructively challenge assumptions and requests, clarify business and delivery implications, and align realistic scope, sequencing, ownership and timing.
• Define GTM success measures and ensure reliable management information is available; use data, stakeholder feedback and business outcomes to assess performance and maturity, identify systemic issues and redirect attention or resources.
• Sponsor continuous improvement across process, data, enabling technology, organizational design and ways of working, ensuring proposed solutions are scalable, practical and deliver measurable value.
• Shape and sponsor the GTM change agenda, ensuring managers and cross-functional partners translate changes into coherent plans, communication, capability building and sustained adoption.
• Create the conditions for sustainable delivery by aligning commitments with available capability and capacity, addressing structural resource or skill gaps and preventing unnecessary churn or unresolved pressure from cascading through the organization.
• Build organizational capability through workforce planning, recruitment, performance management, coaching and succession; foster an inclusive culture of accountability, collaboration, learning and continuous improvement.
The ideal candidate
• 12+ years of progressive experience in Go-To-Market, strategy and operations, program management, business operations, organizational effectiveness or a related field, preferably within fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), apparel and/or footwear, including substantial experience leading managers and senior professionals.
• Bachelor’s degree, or the equivalent in relevant experience, required; a Master’s degree or relevant professional certification in business, operations, strategy, program management or a related discipline is preferred.
• Proven experience defining, implementing and evolving an organization-wide operating model or complex cross-functional business process, including governance, standards, decision rights and operating cadence.
• Strong understanding of the end-to-end Go-To-Market lifecycle and the organizational dependencies required to coordinate priorities, decisions, milestones and execution across functions.
• Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy into departmental plans, portfolio priorities, resource choices, performance measures and measurable outcomes.
• Experience shaping and sponsoring significant organizational change, building leadership and team capability, and sustaining adoption of new processes, standards and ways of working.
• Strong executive communication and influencing capability, with the ability to simplify complex topics, constructively challenge assumptions, negotiate trade-offs and secure alignment without relying solely on direct authority.
• Strong analytical and systems-thinking capability, with experience using data, process insight and fit-for-purpose technology to identify root causes and develop scalable solutions across process, organizational and resource dimensions.
• Demonstrates sound judgment in complex and changing situations, balancing business value, urgency, risk, dependencies, quality and capacity while creating the conditions for sustainable team delivery.
Your Wellbeing is Our Priority
In the heart of Amsterdam, PVH is home to the global headquarters of Tommy Hilfiger and the European offices of Calvin Klein.
•
Wellbeing: exclusive onsite gym and fitness classes, personal training, meditation studio, sports clubs, in-house physio, and receive access to our nutritional and wellbeing programs
•
Campus: extensive food and beverage offerings, top-notch restaurant, barista coffee bars, sky bar, monthly social events, weekly Thursday drinks, game nights, and campus-themed activities that will keep your social life busy
