Be at the forefront: stay closely connected to our brands, CALVIN KLEIN and TOMMY HILFIGER, and be a part of seasonal market launches, sample sales and receive employee discounts!
Check out our Amsterdam Campus here.
About PVH:
We are brand builders who focus our passion and creativity to build Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER into the most desirable lifestyle brands in the world and at the same time position PVH as one of the best-performing brand groups in our sector. Guided by our values and enabled by our scale and global reach, we are driving fashion forward for good, as one team with one vision and one plan. That’s the Power of Us, that’s the Power of PVH+.
One of PVH’s greatest strengths is our people. Our collective desire is to create a workplace environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse community of associates with a strong sense of belonging. In addition to complying with all applicable laws, PVH is also committed to ensuring that all current and future PVH associates are compensated solely on job-related factors such as skill, ability, educational background, work quality, experience and potential.

Speed Wins. Make decisions, move quickly, and know that if things go wrong, it's okay for you and the company.

title: GTM Analytics Lead
description:
About the role
This role leads GTM Analytics within the Revenue Strategy function and reports directly to the Head of Revenue Strategy & Operations. You will own how Thatch measures GTM performance, understands channel economics, and governs the data foundation behind commercial decisions.
The role covers three areas: GTM performance and channel economics, GTM data strategy and governance, and analytical support for forecasting, planning, and executive reporting. Your work is the analytical engine behind all three.
You set the analytical agenda for your areas. You decide which questions matter most, focus effort on the highest-value work, and turn findings into recommendations that change where Thatch invests. You will partner closely with Marketing, Data Science, Finance, and RevOps.
What you'll do
 GTM Performance and Channel Economics 
Build performance frameworks that show GTM health across the full customer lifecycle, from lead through close, onboarding, retention, and expansion.
Own the framework for comparing Thatch's GTM motions: win rates, CAC, payback, and conversion by segment, geography, and channel, plus broker attribution and quoting performance.
Partner with Marketing on funnel and attribution, with Data Science on modeling and segmentation, and with Finance on unit economics and scenario analysis.
Spot emerging trends early and recommend where to invest and where to pull back, including clear tradeoffs.
Prioritize the analytics roadmap by business impact.
 GTM Data Strategy and Governance 
Own the GTM data strategy and set priorities for the integrity, scalability, and evolution of the GTM team’s data foundation, in partnership with Data Science. 
Define and govern core GTM metrics, business logic, and data standards so every standing number is consistent, auditable, and reconciles with Finance.
Set governance for definitions, lineage, quality, and usage in partnership with RevOps, Data Science, Engineering, and Finance.
Define GTM business requirements before technical work begins. RevOps and Engineering keep ownership of technical build.
Prioritize GTM data initiatives and make sequencing recommendations based on dependencies and business impact.
Make sure data assets support critical use cases, including forecasting, pipeline management, planning, compensation, and performance measurement.
Drive adoption of governed metrics and BI across GTM teams.
 Forecasting, Planning, and Reporting Support 
Build and maintain the analytical inputs behind the forecast: pipeline snapshots, coverage, stage conversion, and pacing.
Supply the data and models that feed target setting, capacity planning, and compensation analysis.
Deliver complete, accurate analytics for board, QBR, and MBR materials on every cycle.
Flag when the data signals risk to the forecast or plan.
 Strategic Decision Support 
Break down ambiguous GTM questions, combining data, financial implications, and operational context.
Lead high-stakes segment, channel, and territory analyses from problem definition through recommendation.
Present findings, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to senior leadership.
Background we're looking for
 Experience. 5 to 8 years in GTM analytics, RevOps, BizOps, strategy, or FP&A at a high-growth B2B company, with direct partnership with sales, marketing, and finance leadership.
 Technical depth. Expert SQL. Deep experience with sales and product telemetry data, mainstream business intelligence tools.

title: Technical GTM Lead
description:
Job title: Technical GTM Lead 
 Location: London; full in-office working as default
 Start date: ASAP
 Reports to: CRO
 Compensation: Salary and Equity options available for discussion
 Application deadline: 01/11/26 at 23:59 UK time 
___________________________________________________________________________
Help put frontier AI to work in the real world
Cosine is a UK AI lab building models, applications and training infrastructure for mission-critical organisations.
We build coding agents that work across real software systems, specialised Lumen models, AI-native security products and the infrastructure needed to deploy advanced AI in demanding environments. Our customers include some of the world’s largest enterprises, including organisations operating behind strict security, regulatory and technical constraints.
We’re also training Lumen Sovereign, the first frontier large language model trained in the UK, with the support of the UK Government.
We’re now looking for a Technical GTM Lead to become the technical centre of gravity for our go-to-market team.
You’ll sit at the intersection of customers, sales, product, engineering and machine learning. You’ll show prospective customers what Cosine can do, help existing customers get deployed, build the technical assets that make our products compelling, and ensure what we learn in the field directly improves what we build.
This is not a traditional solutions consultant role. It is highly hands-on. One day you may be running a technical evaluation with an enterprise engineering team; the next you may be debugging a deployment, building a demonstration environment, writing a technical blog or working with ML researchers to turn a new capability into something customers can understand and use.
___________________________________________________________________________
What you’ll do
Make Cosine real for customers
Lead technical demonstrations and evaluations for prospective enterprise customers.
Understand a customer’s development environment, architecture, security model and constraints, then tailor the conversation accordingly.
Explain Cosine’s products, models, integrations, deployment options and security considerations with accuracy and confidence.
Design and run technical evaluations, pilots and proofs of concept.
Work alongside the commercial team to help turn technical interest into customer momentum.
Build the technical GTM engine
Create high-quality demo environments that show Cosine at its best.
Build reusable repositories, workflows and customer scenarios across our coding agent, desktop application and Sparklr model-training platform.
Develop technical materials that help the wider GTM team explain, demonstrate and position Cosine effectively.
Work with Product, Engineering and ML to turn new capabilities into compelling customer-facing demonstrations.
Create technical content such as blogs, product pages, webinars and enablement materials.
Get customers successfully deployed
Own the technical side of customer onboarding, from initial architecture conversations through to a working deployment.
Help customers integrate Cosine with their existing repositories, development environments, infrastructure and enterprise systems.
Support deployments across cloud, VPC, on-premise and other controlled environments.
Troubleshoot issues directly and coordinate with Engineering when deeper product support is required.
Lead onboarding sessions and become a trusted technical counterpart for customer engineering, platform, security and AI teams.
Connect customers, GTM and the product organisation
Act as the primary technical bridge between GTM and Cosine’s Product, Engineering and ML teams.
Bring structured customer feedback into the product organisation, including recurring questions, blockers, feature requests and deployment issues.
Identify patterns across customer conversations and distinguish one-off requests from strategically important product gaps.
Help the GTM team understand new technical capabilities, product changes and their implications for customers.
Help Product and ML understand what enterprise customers actually need in order to adopt Cosine.
Raise the technical bar
Become the first port of call for technical questions from the commercial team.
Build enough depth across Cosine’s products and underlying technology to explain not only what they do, but how and why they work.
Help the GTM team communicate technical capabilities accurately and avoid overpromising.
Train, document and support the wider commercial organisation.
Create a culture where technical rigour and commercial momentum reinforce each other.
___________________________________________________________________________
What we’re looking for
You may have come from software engineering, solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineering, developer tooling, technical product or a similar technical customer-facing role.
You should be comfortable:
Reading, writing and debugging code.
Working with Git, CI/CD, APIs, containers and cloud infrastructure.
Understanding enterprise deployment architectures, including cloud, VPC and on-premise environments.
Speaking credibly with software engineers, platform teams, security teams and technical executives.
Learning complex products quickly and explaining them clearly.
Debugging ambiguous customer problems and finding a practical path forward.
Moving between a customer meeting, a terminal and a conversation with an ML or Product team without losing context.
Making sound technical judgements without pretending to know what you do not know.
Experience with LLMs, coding agents, ML infrastructure or enterprise AI deployment would be valuable. But deep curiosity, technical ability and strong customer instincts matter more than having worked in exactly the same category before.
You do not need to be an ML researcher or the world’s best infrastructure engineer. You do need to be able to go deep when required, find the right answer quickly and communicate it in a way that earns trust.
___________________________________________________________________________
What success looks like
In your first three months, you will:
Become the person the GTM team relies on for difficult technical customer conversations.
Independently run excellent demonstrations across Cosine’s core products.
Build a useful library of repeatable demo environments, workflows and technical assets.
Reduce the friction and time involved in getting enterprise customers deployed.
Establish a strong feedback loop between customers, GTM, Product, Engineering and ML.
Give the commercial team confidence that Cosine can engage deeply with technically sophisticated customers.
Longer term, you will help define how Cosine is understood, evaluated and adopted by the world’s most demanding engineering organisations.
___________________________________________________________________________
Why this role matters
Cosine is building technology that cannot be sold through a slide deck alone.
Our customers want to see the product working in their environments. They want to understand how it behaves across complex codebases, legacy systems, security boundaries and real development workflows. They want technically honest answers and a partner who can stay with the problem when deployment gets difficult.
You will be that person.
You’ll have unusual proximity to customers, product decisions and the underlying research. You’ll help shape the demonstrations, deployments and feedback loops that determine where Cosine goes next.
If you enjoy being close to the technology, close to customers and close to the teams building the future of AI, this is an opportunity to have a significant impact.
Come help make frontier AI useful.
___________________________________________________________________________
 Why join Cosine 
Opportunity to sell a genuinely differentiated product into mission-critical defence and national security environments
 Meaningful early equity with real upside
 Direct impact on product direction and go-to-market strategy
 Small, elite team with high standards and strong technical depth
___________________________________________________________________________
Cosine is an equal opportunity employer. 
We value diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and ways of thinking, and we’re committed to creating an inclusive and respectful workplace.
We encourage applications from anyone who meets the role requirements, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the hiring process, we’re happy to discuss them.
___________________________________________________________________________
 Compensation, Benefits & Ways of Working 
We’re an in-office team, five days a week, by design. We believe the work we’re doing benefits from being together, collaborating closely, and building shared context.
 What you can expect: 
 Competitive salary , benchmarked to the market
 Equity / share options , so you share in the upside you help create
 30 days’ holiday + bank holidays 
 Work hard in the office, collaborate closely, and switch off properly 
 Dog-friendly office — bring your dog to work
 Daily lunch provided 
 Monthly team breakfasts 
 Monthly socials 
 Pension 
 High-quality equipment to do your best work
We care about focus, sustainability, and doing great work — not performative overwork. We value people who show up, contribute thoughtfully, collaborate well with their colleagues, and then go home.
This role won’t suit everyone. But if you want structure, clarity, strong collaboration, and a team that takes both the work and work-life balance seriously, it’s a great place to be.
___________________________________________________________________________
 Agency & Data Protection Notice 
To comply with UK GDPR and our internal data-protection and equal-opportunity obligations, we only accept candidate applications and agency submissions via our Applicant Tracking System (ATS). This ensures appropriate privacy notices, lawful processing, auditability, and consistent retention controls.
Any CVs or candidate details received outside the ATS (including via email, Slack, or direct message) will be treated as unsolicited, will not be considered as part of the recruitment process, and will not give rise to any fee or payment obligation.

title: Senior Manager, GTM Operations
description:
**Who we are:**
Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.
Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.
Visit gomotive.com to learn more.
**About the Role:**
-------------------
Motive's GTM Intelligence & Operations team owns the systems, data, and governance behind how 2,000 sellers, managers, and marketers engage our customers worldwide. As Manager, GTM Intelligence & Operations, reporting to the Senior Director of GTM Intelligence & Operations, you'll lead a team of systems administrators and program owners responsible for our end to end GTM SaaS stack: Salesforce at the core, plus sales engagement, prospecting, enrichment, gifting, references, conversation intelligence, and the integrations that connect them. You'll own the stack's roadmap, architecture, budget, and licensing, and partner with Sales Operations, Sales leadership, Enterprise Systems, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and other teams to deliver our biggest GTM initiatives.
You're a battle tested enterprise systems leader with a business owner's mindset. You've run GTM platforms at scale, built and led admin teams, and seen enough implementations, migrations, and outages to know what good looks like. You know why every field, integration, and setting you own exists, and you use that to make better decisions, not just faster ones. You stay calm when a platform goes down and the field still needs to sell by lunch. You lead with data and translate technical and regulatory requirements into plain language that sellers and executives can act on. Above all, you grow your people into independent experts and keep the focus on the business.
**What You'll Do:**
-------------------
* Lead, coach, and grow a team of GTM systems administrators and program owners by setting clear priorities, delegating platform ownership, and developing each person into a trusted subject matter expert.
* Own the end to end GTM platform ecosystem as a connected system, with Salesforce at its center, including architecture, data model, profiles and permissions, automation, integrations, and the downstream tools that depend on it. Serve as the final escalation point for complex platform issues.
* Set the standard for Salesforce administration across the GTM org, including release management, change control, documentation, and the quoting and CPQ processes that connect pipeline to revenue, in partnership with Enterprise Systems.
* Own the strategy, budget, renewals, and license governance for the broader GTM SaaS portfolio, including our sales engagement platform, and partner with Finance and Procurement on ROI, seat forecasting, and investment decisions.
* Lead vendor evaluations and major tool migrations from requirements and diligence through build, launch, change management, and retirement of the legacy tool, so that multi-million dollar decisions are grounded in data and the voice of the user.
* Partner with Legal, Security, and Marketing to design and enforce GTM compliance and governance across markets, covering consent management, Do Not Contact, call recording, texting, and email deliverability. Provide data and audit support to Legal and leadership when needed.
* Act as the systems lead for major cross-functional initiatives such as new market launches, rebrands, and new sales motions, and partner with Enablement to deliver onboarding, training, and documentation that drive lasting adoption.
* Keep the revenue engine running when things break by leading incident response with vendors and ESYS, engineering workarounds, protecting data integrity, and keeping field and executive leaders informed.
**What We're Looking For:**
---------------------------
* 10+ years of experience in GTM operations, sales or revenue operations, or GTM systems within an enterprise or high-growth B2B SaaS organization, including 5+ years of direct people management experience leading systems administrators or GTM operations teams.
* Deep, hands-on Salesforce administration experience at an enterprise scale of 1,000+ users, including objects, security and sharing, profiles and permission sets, automation, reporting, and integrations. Salesforce Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, CPQ Specialist, or other Salesforce certifications are a plus.
* CPQ experience is strongly preferred, ideally Salesforce CPQ or Revenue Cloud, including product and pricing configuration, discount approvals, and quote to cash handoffs.
* A proven track record of managing an entire end to end GTM platform within an enterprise org, spanning CRM, sales engagement (Outreach, Salesloft, or a comparable platform), data and enrichment (such as ZoomInfo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator), conversation intelligence, gifting, and customer reference platforms. title: Junior Revenue Operations Associate
description:
$55,000 - $60,000 a year
 Junior Revenue Operations Associate
 Team: US Revenue Operations
Level: Junior IC
Reports to: Senior Revenue Operations Associate
Compensation: $55k to $60k CAD / year
 About Zen Educate
 Zen Educate is a technology company that matches schools with temporary educator staff. Our mission is to change the world of education recruitment. Schools spend over $9bn a year on temporary educators, with over $2bn per year of that spent on fees that take money out of the education system. By leveraging the latest technology, we purpose built a platform that helps schools to pay less while educators earn more.
We want students to have access to the best education possible, and we go the extra mile to find, onboard, match, and coach incredible educators that deeply care about their students. We wake up every day on a mission to care more. We care more about our schools. And we care more about our educators.
We have recently raised our Series B funding of $37mil, the largest round in European EdTech last year. This is an exciting opportunity to make a difference and be part of a high growth start-up that is expanding rapidly in the UK and US markets!
 Why this role exists
 Zen Educate places educators in K-12 schools across :20 US regions. Behind every new partnership sits operational work that has to be done right: RFP submissions with tight deadlines and long compliance checklists, hectic conference seasons with significant logistical and planning requirements, nuanced district contracting processes that need to be managed with care and attention.
As Zen has grown, so has the volume of this work, and we're investing in RevOps capacity to match. That gives us room to run each process well and to keep raising the bar on it: every RFP, conference and contract is a chance to make the next one faster and more automated while holding the same standard of polish and accuracy.
This role takes ownership of the critical operational tasks RevOps supports today, and is accountable for how each one turns out. You'll learn each process by running it yourself, which is how you'll see where it breaks and which steps can be automated. Then you'll build those automations, so the work gets faster and more reliable each cycle and frees you to take on the next area. RFPs, conferences and deal desk are where you start. As those run well, the role grows into other parts of RevOps where the same approach pays off.
 What You'll Own
 Your first priorities are below. Each one has a direct line to how quickly Zen signs and launches new partnerships, and they're where RevOps support is most stretched today. Expect the list to change as your automations take work off your plate and new areas need an owner.
 RFP submission coordination. You'll own Zen's RFP process from the moment a bid is identified through submission, and early on it will take the largest share of your time. That means understanding what each district is asking for and what it takes to be compliant, building responses from our existing content, and bringing in subject matter experts across sales, operations, compliance and finance where a question needs something new. You set the plan, keep contributors on it, and make sure what goes out is complete and compelling. The quality of what goes out decides whether we win, so each bid should leave our content library and process in better shape for the next one.
 Conference and event coordination . Our sales team attends state and national education conferences throughout the year, and they're some of the best chances reps get to meet district decision makers in person. Once an event is on the calendar, you own setting the team up to make the most of it. That covers logistics (registration, booth and sponsorship, shipping, travel, spend against the events budget) and the work around them: pulling attendee lists, supporting the coordination and planning of tertiary events around the conference, collaborating with marketing sponsorships that put us in front of the right people, and making sure every key progress with conference attendees is logged in Hubspot following the event.
 Deal desk . A contract stuck in redlines delays when a district gets educators in classrooms and when Zen starts billing. You'll own the contract redline process for new partnerships, from a district's first markup through to a signed agreement, and you're accountable for deals moving through it without stalling. You'll also own business case and proposal support for the sales team, so reps can put a clear, accurate case for Zen in front of every district quickly.
 Automation and process design. In every area you own, you'll document how the work runs, find the steps that repeat, and automate them where the tooling allows, using Claude, HubSpot and the internal tools our RevOps team already builds on. You stay accountable for the quality of the output, whether a step is automated or not. Once an area runs reliably, you hand off what's routine and take on the next operational task that needs an owner.
 What We're Looking For
A strong sense of ownership: you follow work through to the result and improve the process when it isn't working 
Highly organized, able to manage several deadlines at once 
A close reader with strong attention to detail, comfortable working through long, dense documents 
Clear, careful writer with good judgment about when to bring in others 
Comfortable working with senior colleagues across teams to keep shared work on schedule 
Comfortable with numbers and basic financial reasoning 
Strong spreadsheet and Google Workspace skills; experience with HubSpot or another CRM is a plus 
Curious about automating repetitive work; experience with AI tools like Claude is a plus 
0 to 1 years of professional experience; new grads welcome 
 Team & Culture 
 We are a collaborative, high energy, and mission-driven team solving a problem that makes a real difference in the world. We celebrate each others’ wins, lift each other up, and raise our hands any time we can help a teammate solve a problem.
 Benefits
Equity compensation 
Role includes bonus 
18 Paid Vacation Days and 10 Paid Company Holidays 
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance 
401(k) retirement plan with no match
Sick leave 
Paid biweekly 
 Ready to Apply 
 If you’ve read this far and you’re excited (maybe even a little nervous), we’d love to hear from you.
We welcome applicants with diverse backgrounds, and different experiences and perspectives - just like the staff who teach through Zen and the children at the schools we work with. We believe in hiring the best people from the widest pool and creating an inclusive atmosphere with a culture where people’s voices are heard and all our team can look forward to coming to work.
We value and respect all differences in all people (seen and unseen). We believe in an environment with equal access to career development opportunities and actively encourage applications from BAME candidates.
If you require any reasonable adjustments during your interview process with us, please do let us know.
Due to the high volume of applications, we regret that we are unable to provide individual feedback on initial submissions.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. description:
Who are Tyk, and what do we do?
The Tyk API Management platform is helping to drive the connected world and power new products and services. We’re changing the way that organisations connect any number of their systems and services. Whether internal, external, public or highly encrypted systems, Tyk helps businesses drive value across the retail, finance, telecoms, healthcare, or media industries (to name just a few!) 
If you’ve banked online, used an app to check the news, or perhaps even driven a connected car, API’s, and by extension, Tyk, make that possible. Founded in 2015 with offices in London - UK, London - Ontario, Atlanta and Singapore, we have many thousands of users of our B2B platform across the globe. Brands using Tyk range from Lotte, Bell, T Mobile, to RBS, Capital One and Vinci. We have a varied user base hailing from every continent – even Antarctica.
Our Mission
Tyk is on a mission to connect every system in the world. We’ve started by building an API Management platform.
 Total flexibility, default remote, radical responsibility 
We offer unlimited paid holidays and remote working from anywhere in the world , for everyone, Why? Tyk was founded on the principle of offering flexibility and autonomy to our employees, we believe this allows our employees to achieve their best results. It also means we can build the best possible team, location and working hours are no barrier. 
If this sounds like an environment that you believe could work for you then read on to find out more.
About the role
As a Senior Customer Success Engineer at Tyk, you'll be a strategic and technical leader within the Customer Success organization. The team owns traditional support, but this role goes well beyond reacting to issues. You'll help build a proactive Customer Success function focused on long-term customer trust, early risk detection, a better customer experience, and making sure customers get the most value from Tyk.
You'll lead high-priority and technically complex engagements, mentor Customer Success Engineers, and work with Engineering, Product and Account Management to turn customer challenges into improvements across the business.
Your focus is your region. You'll work alongside the Customer Success Engineers there to raise their technical understanding, share knowledge and close gaps, so the region handles more complex work independently.
A key part of the role is improving how the team operates. You'll build processes that strengthen customer relationships, improve technical delivery and let the team scale. You'll also champion AI across Customer Success: faster debugging and investigation, better knowledge sharing, and less repetitive work.
You're the person people turn to when things get complex, whether technical, customer-facing, operational or cross-functional.
Key responsibilities
 Escalation management 
Proactively oversee the Zendesk queue, making sure SLAs are met and stepping in on critical escalations.
Act as an escalation point for systemic issues, leading incident resolution. Escalations come to you before going to Product.
Work with Senior and Principal engineers across regions to resolve recurring support workflow challenges.
Guide triage practices so issues are isolated quickly and accurately across the team.
 Mentorship and team development 
Coach and mentor Customer Success Engineers in your region on technical depth, customer engagement, ownership and handling complex situations independently.
Set a high standard for technical quality, communication, accountability and customer ownership.
Flag capability gaps to Customer Success leadership and help close them through training, documentation and hiring input.
Support engineers through complex cases while building their confidence to lead them independently.
Foster a culture of learning, knowledge sharing, collaboration and constructive feedback.
 Proactive customer engagement 
Build trusted relationships with key Enterprise customers through regular account syncs, acting as their senior technical partner.
Lead onboardings and regular syncs for Enterprise customers, whose complex environments need senior-level judgement. Onboardings are completed to the checklist.
Partner with Account Management to spot customer risk, recurring pain points and opportunities before they become escalations.
Help improve proactive engagement processes, so the team builds relationships rather than only answering tickets.
 Technical excellence and innovation 
Lead deep technical investigations, including complex debugging and source code analysis.
Innersourcing is strongly encouraged: contribute bug fixes, small features or workarounds to the product to unblock customers, and help other engineers do the same.
Build and adopt tools, automation and AI to reduce response and resolution time.
Maintain ticket quality, so Product receives actionable, high-quality submissions.
Anticipate platform-wide issues and prevent them through architecture awareness.
Keep critical knowledge documented: the Zendesk knowledge base, debugging guides and external documentation.
 Operations and cross-team collaboration 
Meet escalation SLAs and play a key role in the on-call rotation for 24/7 global support.
Own high-severity incidents and critical customer escalations.
Review team metrics regularly and help set team goals and focus areas.
Represent Customer Success in company initiatives, and help evolve support policies such as SLAs, escalation procedures and "won't fix" standards.
 Voice of the customer and long-term impact 
Contribute evidenced trends to the monthly Voice of the Customer digest to Product.
Lead root cause analysis and post-mortems for major incidents from the Customer Success side.
Reduce ticket volume by finding recurring pain points and proposing durable fixes in the platform or documentation.
Help evolve support strategy as Tyk grows, influencing structure, tooling and hiring.
Requirements
What we're looking for
Extensive experience in technical support, Customer Success Engineering or similar roles, with proven leadership in complex escalations and systemic improvements.
Experience coaching or mentoring engineers.
Strong technical depth and a hands-on engineering mindset: reproducing problems, working through logs and configuration, reading source code, and diagnosing issues across distributed systems.
Strong Docker and Kubernetes knowledge, including debugging deployments, networking, configuration, scaling and application behaviour in containerized environments. This is essential.
Experience deploying and troubleshooting on-premise environments, including standing up representative customer environments.
Strong background with large Enterprise customers and complex technical environments.
Strong experience with APIs and API Management: gateways, authentication, networking, traffic flows and distributed architectures.
Comfort learning technologies beyond Tyk, such as Redis, MongoDB, SQL databases, load balancers, proxies, SSO, OAuth/OIDC and Identity Providers.
Comfort contributing product code and documentation changes.
Exceptional written and verbal communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to lead without authority, influencing Product, Engineering, Account Management and Customer Success.
Passion for operational excellence, automation, AI adoption and scalable Customer Success practices.
A growth mindset: curiosity, humility and a desire to keep improving yourself and those around you.
Comfort working with customers across regions, with willingness to join rotational on-call shifts, including weekends.
Why Customer Success @ Tyk?
Tyk is on a mission to simplify API and service management for everyone. As a Senior Customer Success Engineer, you'll shape the future of Customer Success, not just as a service but as a strategic advantage. You'll lead initiatives, mentor engineers and work with passionate people around the globe.
Benefits
Here’s why you should join us:
Please note that benefits vary by country. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to ask your Talent Partner.
Excellent Medical, Dental, and Vision packages
401k plan
Everyone has unlimited paid holiday. 
We have total flexibility in hours, as we believe creativity flows better when our people are given freedom to decide when they are most productive. Everyone is unique after all.
Employee share scheme
Generous maternity and paternity leave
Company retreats
We all share the same vision - we value authenticity, respect, responsibility, independence, honesty, diversity and inclusion and most importantly treating others how you wish to be treated. We look for like-minded people who bring their personalities to work everyday, strive to achieve their personal goals and who are willing to challenge the way we do things, why? - to make what we do even better!
 Our values tell the story of Tyk - here’s how: 
 It’s ok to screw up! 
We’ve found that it’s often the ‘stupid’ or unexpected ideas that turn out to be the successful ones - so try it, at least we can say we have!
 The only stupid idea, is the untested one! 
It’s in our DNA - starting a business with founders 12 hours apart, giving our gateway away for free - sure, we did that, and we’d do it again!
 Trust starts with you - make it count! 
Trust is a two-way street - instill it from day one!
 Assume best intent! 
We have each other’s back - we’re all on the same team. Think before you speak or act. 
 Make things, better! 
Always try to leave things better than when you found them - change is constant, inevitable and embraced! Be that change we want to see.
What’s it like to work here?! check it out: https://tyk.io/worklife/ 
Tyk is an equal opportunities employer and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.
You can see more about us here https://tyk.io

title: Growth Strategy and Analytics Manager
description:
Why We Exist 
 The world is moving away from rigid ownership models in favour of more flexible, affordable access. Yet the $1.5 trillion device market has barely moved. 
 Our mission is to transform how technology is bought, used and reused — creating better outcomes for customers, brands and the planet.
 What We've Built 
 Raylo is the subscription infrastructure that enables leading electronics brands, including PlayStation, HP and Dyson, to move from one-off device sales to recurring subscription programmes that increase conversion, deepen loyalty and capture more lifetime value. 
 We have over $100M ARR, we’re profitable, growing fast, with over a quarter of a million subscriptions across consumers and small businesses. Customers trust us too, with a 4.5/5 Trustpilot rating from more than 20,000 reviews. 
 For customers, the experience is simple: subscribe to a device, get support throughout, upgrade when you want, and return it when you’re done. Behind that sits an AI-powered operating system that executes and manages device subscriptions end to end: credit and fraud decisioning, lifecycle operations, and the financing engine that enables brands to run subscription programmes at scale. 
 Brands can unlock a powerful new growth engine with Raylo across embedded checkout, Raylo.com and the customer app — converting more DTC customers, reaching subscription-first demand, and driving repeat upgrades that compound customer lifetime value. 
 The impact of our circular model is big. We cut emissions per device by around 50% compared to buy-and-discard. We’re B Corp certified, backed by Macquarie, NatWest and Channel 4 Ventures, and recognised by Tech Nation’s Future Fifty.
 How We Work 
 AI is changing what small, ambitious teams can build. Companies that embrace it will define the next decade. 
 Raylo is uniquely placed to benefit. We combine proprietary technology and data with the orchestration of physical assets, operating across credit, fraud, pricing, logistics, refurbishment, resale and customer care. With AI improving every cycle, our moat deepens with scale. 
 At Raylo, AI is woven into how we work every day. We don’t ration access or hedge our bets. Our people use the best models and tools, and we expect them to do things that weren’t possible a year ago. Processes that used to be good enough are being rebuilt. Teams are replacing spreadsheets with bespoke tooling, and anyone can query our data layer in plain English and get a real answer in seconds. 
 We give every team their own hackathon: a chance to step back, start with a blank sheet, and ask: if we were starting today, how would we do this? 
 The more we automate, the more human judgement matters. AI gives people back time, and we expect them to spend it on the things no model can replicate: conversations, trust, craft and team judgement. 
 We hire to a high bar. You’ll work with people who push you, raise your game and expect you to do the same. We want every person at Raylo to do the best work of their lives, and enjoy doing it.
 Our Core Values 
 💡 Be deeply curious – We thrive on innovation through diverse approaches, views, and people. 
 👟 Walk in your customer’s shoes – To build the best products and make the best decisions for the long term, we must figure out what our customers need, not just what they want. 
 🎯 Focus and execute – We have a big vision, but we believe in nailing the most important problems first. 
 💥 Be gritty – Only gritty teams succeed. Our individual ownership, passion, and perseverance mean we’re a team through thick and thin. 
 What to Expect 
 The Credit and Fraud Strategy team sits at the heart of how Raylo grows. We find ways to say yes to more customers, without taking on risk we don’t understand. It’s a balance that requies sharp analytical thinking, sound commercial judgment, and the ability to balance upsides and downsides in your head at the same time.
 In this role, you’ll be transforming how we think about decisioning and performance. Your specific scope will be defined depending on your professional experience and specific priorities for the team when you join. Big areas of focus for our team over the next year include:
 • Identifying and going after growth opportunties with our first-time customers, leveraging newly built internal models and building experiments to understand performance.
 • Rethinking eligibility for our existing customers who want to take out more tech.
 You'll be responsible for the decisioning logic for who is eligible, using traditional and AI-enhanced analytics to identify and go after growth opportunities, and identifying where new data sources are needed for better decisions.
 Our team uses the latest technology to stay nimble, even as our business grows more copmlex. We use a cutting edge decisioning platform with lots of flexibility. And we are embedding AI tooling into every aspect of our roles - from research enhancement, to always-on monitoring, to assistance in writing complex code. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Lead strategic projects to drive growth through better credit decisioning. 
 Investigate key drivers of performance and identify opportunities for improvement. 
 Use AI to boost your analytical capabilities and drive innovation in monitoring, automation, and internal decision making. 
 Collaborate with Product and Engineering on technical design of rule changes and implementation of new data sources. 
 Partner with Growth and Marketing teams to develop seamless positive experiences and reduce friction where a decline decision is the best outcome for us and the customer. 
 Design scalable data frameworks and tracking systems to support smarter decisions. Ensure we have strong controls and arrive at sound, explainable decisions. 
 Balance flexibility and scalability while maintaining high data quality across multiple sources.
 You’ll Succeed with 
 3-5 years of experience in strategy, analytics, or product/data roles in fast-paced, high-performance, data-driven environments. 
 A 2:1 or above from a top university , ideally in a STEM or other highly analytical discipline 
 Hands-on daily use of AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to accelerate the insight → decision → implementation cycle 
 Strong working knowledge of SQL is required ; Python experience is a strong plus. Even with AI tools, this foundation is essential. 
 A track record of going from ambiguous problems to in-market impact using data, not gut feel. 
 Experience with modern analytics stacks (data warehouses, dashboards, monitoring systems). 
 A direct communication style that adapts appropriately to audiences with different technical expertise, and enables quick, effective decision making. 
 Takes feedback well and moves quickly on it 
 Comfort working in a fast-moving , high-ownership environment where the answer is not always obvious. 
 Opportunities & Benefits 
 🚀 Fast-track your career – 40% of our employees progress every review cycle (bi-annually) 
 📱 Exclusive Raylo device lease for employees 
 🏥 Private Medical Insurance 
 📈 Stock options for all employees 
 📚 L&D budget to support the skills you value 
 🏢 Hybrid working model 
 🌴 33 days off, your way – 25 days + 8 bank holidays with full flexibility to use on the days that mean the most to you 
 👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption or shared parental leave, if you've been with us for 12 months. 
 🧸 Workplace nursery scheme for major cost savings
 Hiring Process 
 We move quickly and we'll aim to give you the best candidate experience possible. It starts with a 15-minute call — no prep needed. If there's a fit, we move fast, every stage has a purpose, and we'll tell you what we're looking for at each one. 
 If there's anything we can do to support you through the process, whether that's adjustments or anything else, please let us know. 
 *As an FCA-regulated business, we conduct background checks (DBS and AML) on all successful candidates who are offered a position at Raylo during the onboarding process. 
 Diversity & Inclusion at Raylo 
 At Raylo, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, believing they make us stronger.

Job DescriptionJob Description
Directive Consulting is the leading B2B performance marketing agency that delivers real revenue—not just leads.

 * Internally this role is titled Associate Director, Revenue Operations* 
 About The Role 
We’re looking for an Associate Director, Revenue Operations to help lead and scale Directive’s Revenue Operations practice. You’ll partner closely with the Director of Revenue Operations to lead a team of RevOps Strategists, oversee complex client engagements, and ensure we consistently deliver high-quality strategic and technical work. title: Director, Sales Compensation
description:
Dropbox is a Virtual First company. For this role, we are currently only authorized to hire candidates from the following provinces: Alberta, British Columbia, Ontario, and Saskatchewan.
Role Description
As the Head of Sales Compensation & Planning within the Customer Strategy & Operations (CSO) organization, you will define and lead Dropbox's global sales compensation, quota strategy, and incentive planning framework. You will be responsible for shaping the philosophy, governance, and execution of compensation programs that drive revenue growth, profitability, and seller productivity across multiple routes to market.
This leader will partner closely with Executive Sales Leadership, Finance, Accounting, HR, and Strategy to translate business objectives into scalable incentive programs, quota methodologies, and sales planning decisionsthat accelerate performance while ensuring financial discipline. Beyond leading one of Dropbox's most business-critical operational functions, this role will influence how Dropbox motivates its global sales organization, aligns incentives to business strategy, and evolves our go-to-market model over time.
The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in sales compensation and planning with strong commercial acumen, executive presence, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders through data-driven recommendations. Reporting to the Head of Revenue Operations, this role will have significant visibility across Dropbox's executive leadership team and serve as a trusted advisor on sales performance, incentive strategy, and organizational planning.
Responsibilities
Define Dropbox's long-term sales compensation philosophy, quota methodology, and incentive governance aligned to evolving business strategy.
Serve as the primary advisor to Executive Sales Leadership, Finance, and CSO leadership on compensation strategy, seller productivity, and annual planning decisions.
Influence executive decision-making through data-driven recommendations balancing revenue growth, profitability, customer outcomes, and employee motivation.
Evaluate market trends and emerging GTM models to continuously evolve Dropbox's compensation and planning strategies.
Partner with the Sales Operations organization to ensure compensation strategy, quota methodology, and planning decisions remain aligned with Dropbox's commercial strategy.
Own the global design, governance, and evolution of scalable sales compensation programs across multiple products, customer segments, and routes to market.
Partner cross-functionally to ensure compensation programs drive strategic priorities while remaining financially sustainable, equitable, and compliant.
Establish governance processes for plan changes, new product launches, acquisitions, and evolving sales motions.
Serve as the business owner for the incentive compensation platform (Forma), partnering with Systems to prioritize enhancements, maintain governance, and ensure the platform effectively supports compensation operations.
Define compensation philosophies, principles, and governance for new sales roles, emerging routes to market, and evolving go-to-market motions, ensuring consistent and scalable incentive design.
Establish frameworks for evaluating, piloting, and scaling new incentive models that support business transformation while maintaining governance, financial discipline, and seller trust.
Lead the quota planning workstream within the annual sales planning process, partnering closely with Sales Operations, Finance, and Sales Leadership to ensure quota methodologies support business objectives, seller productivity, and compensation strategy.
Develop and maintain quota methodologies, governance, and planning frameworks, while evolving ownership and operating models in partnership with Sales Operations as the organization scales.
Partner on annual sales planning decisions, translating commercial priorities into scalable quota and incentive recommendations that support evolving go-to-market strategies.
Evaluate seller productivity, quota attainment, and commercial performance to recommend planning and compensation adjustments that improve business outcomes.
Provide strategic thought leadership on commercial planning, ensuring compensation, quotas, and incentives remain aligned as Dropbox's operating model continues to evolve.
Own the end-to-end incentive compensation operations, including quarter-end and year-end compensation processes, payout calculations, governance, executive reporting, and payroll readiness.
Lead quarter-end and fiscal year-end compensation execution, ensuring accurate and timely seller payouts while partnering closely with Payroll, Finance, HR, and Sales Operations to resolve exceptions and maintain operational excellence.
Drive continuous improvement through automation, scalable systems, and simplified operational processes.
Partner with Systems and Operations teams to enhance Salesforce, Forma, and reporting capabilities supporting incentive management.
Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing compensation and planning function capable of supporting Dropbox's future growth.
Foster strong cross-functional partnerships across Finance, Sales, HR, Revenue Operations, and Executive Leadership.
Build a strong operating partnership with the Sales Operations organization to ensure alignment across planning, coverage, quotas, and compensation.
Lead through influence across global stakeholders while driving alignment during annual planning and business transformation initiatives.
Requirements
12+ years of experience in sales compensation, sales operations, finance, or a related field with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing sales compensation and planning.
Deep knowledge of sales compensation design, quota-setting best practices, incentive operations, and quarter-end compensation execution.
Demonstrated experience designing executive-level compensation strategies supporting complex, multi-product SaaS organizations.
Deep expertise in sales compensation design, quota methodologies, and financial modeling, with experience partnering on territory planning and sales planning processes.
Proven ability to influence executive leadership and drive strategic decisions through analytical insights.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance revenue growth, seller behavior, customer outcomes, and financial performance.
Experience leading large cross-functional planning initiatives involving Finance, Sales Leadership, HR, and Operations.
Advanced analytical capabilities including Excel, financial modeling, scenario planning, and executive business reviews.
Experience with Salesforce, incentive compensation platforms (Forma preferred), and reporting tools such as Tableau.
Demonstrated ability to automate and simplify day-to-day compensation operations, reducing administrative effort and allowing the team to focus on higher-value activities such as compensation strategy, planning, and business partnership.
Excellent executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Demonstrated ability to build scalable processes and lead organizational change in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience leading global sales planning and incentive strategy for enterprise SaaS organizations.
Strong understanding of P&L management, annual operating planning, and revenue forecasting.
Experience supporting multiple sales motions including Direct, Channel, Enterprise, and Self-Serve.
Familiarity with AI-driven sales planning, predictive productivity modeling, or next-generation incentive optimization tools.
Durable Skills
AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:
 Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
 Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
 Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
 Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.
To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.
Compensation
The range listed above is the expected annual salary/OTE (On-Target Earnings) for this role, subject to change. Salary/OTE is just one component of Dropbox’s total rewards package. All regular employees are also eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).
Read more about our benefits here.
Company Description
Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. We’re a global community of bold visionaries and resourceful doers shaping the future of Dropbox and, in turn, the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you’re ready to push boundaries and challenge yourself, Dropbox is ready for you.
Team Description
The Dropbox Business Strategy & Operations team unlocks the company’s full potential by driving strategic initiatives and promoting operational excellence. We combine analytical rigor with creative problem-solving to tackle Dropbox’s biggest opportunities and challenges across all business functions. Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Finance, we translate our strategic vision into actionable plans that foster growth, optimize performance, and facilitate informed decision-making. Our work shapes the future of Dropbox by leading cross-functional business planning, developing insights that guide corporate and business unit strategies, creating systems and processes that power scalable success. If you're passionate about strategic thinking, solving complex problems, and making an impact through collaboration, join our Business Strategy & Operations team.
Virtual First
Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. Virtual First is built to provide the same access to opportunity, growth, and impact for everyone, regardless of location.
This role requires travel to offsites and various other team gatherings (approximately 5-10% of the year or 2-3 days per quarter). We provide advance notice when possible and encourage candidates to discuss any accommodation needs during the interview process.
AI Fluency
AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others.
We look for four key behaviors in candidates:
 Ownership: You use AI responsibly by protecting data, applying sound judgment, and taking accountability for the quality and accuracy of your work.
 Experimentation: You explore new AI capabilities and apply them to improve workflows within approved tools and practices.
 Leverage: You use AI to enhance thinking, improve efficiency, and increase your impact and your team’s.
 Learning: You stay current on emerging AI tools and trends, continuously build your skills, and share what you learn with others.
Together, these behaviors help build a workforce where technology amplifies human judgment, creativity, and impact.
Dropbox supports responsible use of AI for preparation, but misrepresentation of skills or experience is not permitted. To learn more, see our approach to AI in hiring.
Dropbox is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

title: Customer Success Engineer Pod Lead (AMER)
description:
Who are Tyk, and what do we do?
The Tyk API Management platform is helping to drive the connected world and power new products and services. We’re changing the way that organisations connect any number of their systems and services. Whether internal, external, public or highly encrypted systems, Tyk helps businesses drive value across the retail, finance, telecoms, healthcare, or media industries (to name just a few!).
If you’ve banked online, used an app to check the news, or perhaps even driven a connected car, API’s, and by extension, Tyk, make that possible. Founded in 2015 with offices in London - UK, London - Ontario, Atlanta and Singapore, we have many thousands of users of our B2B platform across the globe. Brands using Tyk range from Lotte, Bell, T Mobile, to RBS, Capital One and Vinci. We have a varied user base hailing from every continent – even Antarctica.
Our Mission
Tyk is on a mission to connect every system in the world. We’ve started by building an API Management platform.
 Total flexibility, default remote, radical responsibility 
We offer unlimited paid holidays and remote working from anywhere in the world , for everyone, Why? Tyk was founded on the principle of offering flexibility and autonomy to our employees, we believe this allows our employees to achieve their best results. It also means we can build the best possible team, location and working hours are no barrier. 
If this sounds like an environment that you believe could work for you then read on to find out more.
About the Role
As a Customer Success Pod Lead at Tyk, you're a strategic and technical leader within our Customer Success team. This isn't just about reacting to tickets - you'll help build a proactive function that spots risk early, strengthens customer trust, and makes sure customers get real value from Tyk.
You'll lead complex, high-priority customer engagements, mentor Customer Success Engineers, and partner with Engineering, Product, and Account Management to turn customer feedback into real improvements.
You'll also shape how the team works day to day - building processes that scale, and championing AI adoption to speed up debugging, share knowledge, and cut out repetitive work.
When things get complicated - technical, customer-facing, or cross-functional - you're who people turn to. You'll play a key role in defining what modern Customer Success looks like at Tyk.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Leadership & escalations. You own the health of the Zendesk queue and are the first point of call for critical, high-impact escalations - stepping in before issues reach Product, and taking part in the 24/7 on-call rotation (weekends included).
 Coaching & team development. You coach and mentor Customer Success Engineers, raising the bar for technical quality and ownership across the pod, and helping close capability gaps through training, hiring, and documentation.
 Technical depth & innovation. You lead the toughest technical investigations - debugging, source code analysis, root cause analysis - and drive the process improvements, automation, and AI adoption that make the whole team faster.
 Customer relationships. You build trusted, senior-level relationships with key Enterprise customers, partnering with Account Management to catch risk early and championing improvements to the customer journey.
 Driving continuous improvement. You turn support data into action - feeding it to Product and Engineering, evolving support policies as Tyk scales, and representing Customer Success Engineering in company-wide initiatives.
Requirements
 What we're looking for: 
Extensive experience in Technical Support, Customer Success Engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role, with a track record leading complex escalations and driving systemic improvements.
A strong, hands-on engineering mindset - comfortable reproducing issues, digging through logs and config, reading source code, and diagnosing problems across distributed systems.
 Strong Docker and Kubernetes knowledge is essential. A large share of our customer environments are containerized, and many investigations involve debugging Kubernetes deployments, networking, and scaling.
Experience deploying and troubleshooting on-premise environments and a solid background with large Enterprise customers, ideally including API/API Management (gateways, authentication, networking, distributed architectures).
Comfortable getting hands-on with unfamiliar technologies - Redis, MongoDB, SQL databases, load balancers, proxies, SSO, OAuth/OIDC, and Identity Providers.
Sharp debugging instincts and excellent communication - you can move from symptom to root cause and explain it clearly to both customers and internal teams.
Demonstrated ability to lead without authority, and a growth mindset: curious, humble, and always looking to improve yourself and the people around you.
Comfortable working with customers across regions, with willingness to take part in rotational on-call (including weekends), and to contribute code and documentation changes directly.
Why Customer Success @ Tyk?
Tyk is on a mission to simplify API and service management for everyone. As a CSE Pod Lead, you'll help shape the future of technical support - not just as a service, but as a strategic advantage. You'll be empowered to lead initiatives, make a real impact, and work with passionate people around the globe.
Benefits
 Here’s why you should join us: 
Everyone has unlimited paid holidays. 
We have total flexibility in hours, as we believe creativity flows better when our people are given freedom to decide when they are most productive. Everyone is unique after all.
Employee share scheme
Generous maternity and paternity leave
Volunteering Days
Company retreats
Employee Wellbeing platform
We all share the same vision - we value authenticity, respect, responsibility, independence, honesty, diversity and inclusion and most importantly treating others how you wish to be treated. We look for like-minded people who bring their personalities to work everyday, strive to achieve their personal goals and who are willing to challenge the way we do things, why? - to make what we do even better!
 Our values tell the story of Tyk - here’s how: 
 It’s ok to screw up! 
We’ve found that it’s often the ‘stupid’ or unexpected ideas that turn out to be the successful ones - so try it, at least we can say we have!
 The only stupid idea, is the untested one! 
It’s in our DNA - starting a business with founders 12 hours apart, giving our gateway away for free - sure, we did that, and we’d do it again!
 Trust starts with you - make it count! 
Trust is a two-way street - instil it from day one!
 Assume best intent! 
We have each other’s back - we’re all on the same team. Think before you speak or act. 
 Make things better! 
Always try to leave things better than when you found them - change is constant, inevitable and embraced! Be that change we want to see.
What’s it like to work here?! Check it out: https://tyk.io/worklife/ 
Tyk is an equal opportunities employer and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favorable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.
👉 You can see more about us here https://tyk.io

Intelligently Moving Your World 
 XPENG is a leading technology company focused on designing, developing, manufacturing, and marketing intelligent mobility solutions, including electric vehicles (EVs), electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft, and robotics. We aim to create a thoughtful and empathetic future for mobility that enhances driving experience. Headquartered in Guangzhou, China, XPENG has regional offices in Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Silicon Valley, and San Diego, and in 2021, we established our European headquarters in Amsterdam, along with offices in Copenhagen, Munich, Oslo, and Stockholm.
Our passionate and diverse team, with expertise in technology, finance, and the automotive industry, spans hubs in China, the US, and Europe. Together, we are forging our international presence as pioneers in the future of mobility.
 Why should you be part of our success story?

In 2023, XPENG further strengthened its growth trajectory with a $724 million strategic investment from Volkswagen, solidifying its position in the global market. There has never been a more exciting time to join XPENG — a leader in smart electric vehicles and sustainable mobility solutions.
 About XPENG and Belgium expansion 
XPENG is a young technology company building smart electric vehicles and shaping the future of AI mobility. We started with a small team and big ideas, and we still keep that explorer mindset today. We move fast, we challenge convention, and we turn ambitious technology into real world customer experience. Because our Belux business is growing strongly, we are expanding our activities and opening a new office in Mechelen, Belgium. If you want a role where you can build, learn, and have visible impact, you will feel at home here.
 Sales Operations Specialist - Belux 
 The role in a nutshell 
You keep fleet sales running smoothly behind the scenes. You make sure orders are clean, systems are correct, and partners get quick answers. You are the link between leasing partners, retail partners, and internal teams, ensuring that the order journey moves without friction from contract to registration to delivery readiness. When the pace increases, you bring structure and calm.
 What you will focus on in the first 90 days 
Learn our fleet order flow end to end including systems, partner touchpoints, and approval steps
Bring order hygiene to a high standard by tightening validation and documentation routines
Build a reliable cadence with leasing partners and stores for questions, exceptions, and status updates
Create a clear view on stock allocation logic and reduce manual rework and delays
 What you will do

Check completeness and accuracy of contract terms, vehicle specifications, billing details, and delivery information
Enter orders into internal systems such as Scepter and ensure correct triggers for logistics and delivery workflows
Allocate available stock vehicles to incoming orders in coordination with planning and logistics
Monitor order progress from entry to delivery readiness and proactively resolve issues or delays
Support stores and leasing partners with questions on order processing and tools such as Leaselink, NCO, or similar systems
Coordinate registration and handover documentation with local authorities and registration partners across Belux as applicable
Maintain clear documentation for fleet orders until invoicing and final delivery are complete
Own fleet sales reporting such as pipeline, order intake, and conversion views and keep CRM hygiene standards high
Build templates and simple tools that standardise the process and speed up execution
 What success looks like 
Fleet orders are clean and complete and can move through the process without rework
Partners get fast answers and trust the status because data is accurate
Stock allocation and registration steps are predictable and delivery readiness improves
Sales teams spend more time selling because the operational flow is solid
 What we need from you 
1–3 years of experience in sales administration, fleet operations, order processing, leasing operations or automotive administration.
Experience working with administrative systems and order management processes.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Service minded communication with partners and internal stakeholders
A structured and proactive working style, with a strong sense of responsibility.
Preferably trilingual: Dutch Flemish, French, and English.
 XPENG offers: 
An interesting, unique and very varied job at XPENG
A job with an incredibly large contact surface both internally and externally
An attractive salary package incl. pension and with the possibility of a bonus
To be involved in the growth of an existing EV brand in Europe

title: Manager, FinOps, RevOps & Finance Systems
description:
About Mesh 
At Mesh, our mission is to enable consumers to pay and be paid with any asset. Today, trillions of dollars in tokenized assets exist but remain largely unusable for everyday commerce. Mesh is bridging this gap by making crypto payments reliable, useful, and ubiquitous. We combine a powerful orchestration engine with a seamless consumer app to unlock liquidity for the world. Backed by leading investors like SBI, Money Forward, Paradigm, Dragonfly, Galaxy, and PayPal Ventures, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of the global economy. Join us!
 Overview 
You will build the systems that connect Mesh's products to its books, and produce the revenue metrics that run the business. Working with Sales, Product and Engineering, you design and ship the integrations, billing logic and reconciliation tools behind our deposit, on/off-ramp, OTC and card products. You own revenue operations end to end: Salesforce, revenue reporting and commission administration. This is a builder role: most of your time goes into shipping systems, not running reports by hand.
 What You'll Do 
Own the finance and revenue systems architecture and integrations across Salesforce, HubSpot, NetSuite, Bill.com, card programs and the data warehouse.
Co-build with Product and Engineering the billing engine for ramps and payments: partner fee schedules, markups, revenue splits and monthly partner settlements.
Build reconciliation and alerting systems in coordination with Engineering and Product: matching platform transactions, partner statements, bank and on-chain activity and the ledger, with alerts for subsidy balances, float levels, uncredited deposits, refunds and failed settlements that feed Treasury and Accounting.
Own Salesforce as a system: data standards, account ownership, the HubSpot sync, pipeline reporting, and the deal approval workflow and pricing guardrails.
Produce the payments metrics we manage to and an account health view that shows which customers are ramping or slowing and why.
Administer sales commissions: calculate payouts from Salesforce and billing data in a system.
Automate recurring non-payroll close work: expense allocations, cost of revenue reclasses and transaction coding.
Build AI-assisted workflows for AP intake, coding, payment matching and collections.
 Metrics You'll Produce 
Total payment volume by product and account; take rate actual vs. contracted; usage against minimum commitments.
Gross and net revenue and volume retention, logo churn and silent churn.
New logos, time to go-live and to first transaction, ramp to committed volume, pipeline coverage and win rate.
Transaction success rate, stuck or failed transaction rate, refund rate and settlement time.
 Who You Are 
5+ years in revenue operations, finance operations, finance systems or billing at a payments or fintech company. Payments experience is required.
Integrations and data pipelines you shipped yourself, including Salesforce and NetSuite.
Experience building revenue metrics and administering sales commissions.
Experience writing requirements with engineering teams and seeing them through to production
 Nice to have 
Payment reconciliation at scale.
On-chain and stablecoin data.
Commission tools.
The compensation range provided may span multiple career levels and will be narrowed during the interview process based on factors including a candidate's experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. For candidates outside of New York or San Francisco, compensation will be adjusted to reflect the applicable market and location-based pay band. The base salary range listed excludes commission (if applicable), equity, and benefits. The pay range represents the minimum and maximum target for new-hire compensation. Actual compensation may vary and may be higher or lower depending on individual circumstances.
Pay Range
 $160,000 — $200,000 USD 
 Why You’ll Love It Here 
At Mesh, you're not stepping into a typical role—you're joining a rocket ship in mid-liftoff. You'll tackle complex, meaningful problems that actually move an industry forward, working alongside a sharp, motivated team that moves quickly, collaborates deeply, and expects everyone to operate with ownership. This is the kind of place where you'll see your work ship fast, make real impact, and be able to point to something and say, "I built that." You'll grow fast, level up your skills, and get a front-row seat to how a high-growth company scales from the inside, with competitive comp, solid benefits, and room to stretch your craft all coming standard. If you're energized by building, learning, and shaping something big—this is where you'll want to be.
 In-Office Expectations 
Employees based in our San Francisco, New York, and Bangalore hubs are expected to work from the office at least 40% of the time (approximately two days per week). This expectation may vary slightly depending on role, team, and business needs. Certain roles that require closer cross-functional collaboration or operational support may have additional in-office requirements, which will be discussed during the interview process. Our hybrid approach is designed to balance meaningful in-person collaboration, team building, and real-time decision-making with the flexibility to work remotely. We believe this structure supports strong execution while preserving autonomy and focus time.
 How We Care For Our Team 
We believe great work happens when people feel valued and supported. That starts with competitive salary and equity that grows as you and the company grow, plus comprehensive health coverage for you and your family. We offer unlimited PTO—and we mean it. Take the time you need to recharge and show up at your best.
We're invested in your growth with a dedicated budget for courses, conferences, and certifications. Work from wherever you're most productive with our remote-friendly approach, and count on having the top-tier tools and equipment you need to do exceptional work.
Mesh Pay is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
