title: Sales Operations & Customer Support Specialist
description:
Sales Operations & Customer Support Specialist 
 Contract Full-Time (7 months) | Remote (Canada) 
 Meet Canadian Science Publishing (CSP): 
 As Canada’s largest independent, not-for-profit publisher of scientific journals, we are dedicated to mobilizing research that drives discovery and innovation. 
 With roots dating back to 1929, CSP publishes 26 international journals across the natural and physical sciences and engineering. We champion open science, equity, diversity, and sustainability. Through strong partnerships and a commitment to excellence, we empower the scientific community to share knowledge that shapes a better future. 
 We’re proud of our remote-first workplace, which provides employees with sought-after perks like flexible work schedules, generous paid time off, employer-sponsored health and wellness benefits, pension plan, and much more – in addition to working with a team of bright, highly engaged people who are deeply committed to CSP’s mission and values, and to each other. 
 What you’ll do: 
 CSP is seeking a Sales Operations & Customer Support Specialist to join our Strategy & Growth team for 7 months on a fixed term contract, reporting to the Director of Sales Operations with no direct reports. The position is available starting in November 2026 . This role is to fill an existing position vacancy. 
 The Sales Operations & Customer Support Specialist provides comprehensive operational and customer support to institutional subscribers and authors, helping to ensure a seamless and positive experience with CSP products and services. 
 This role supports subscription and product inquiries, platform access and entitlements, payment reconciliation, author support, and the administration of subscription systems and sales tools. The Specialist also assists with reporting, supports sales activities such as trials and materials preparation, and contributes to team initiatives and special projects as needed. 
 Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following: 
 Triages and/or resolves by personal follow-up all subscriptions, product and purchasing issues with clients, ensuring resolution and customer satisfaction. 
 Deliver comprehensive author support, including assistance with manuscript submissions, author dashboards, permissions requests, and access to published content. 
 Manage and maintain subscriber access to the publishing platform, ensuring accurate entitlements, troubleshooting access issues, and coordinating updates as needed. 
 Reconcile payments for subscriber orders, ensuring accurate invoicing, payment tracking, and resolution of discrepancies in collaboration with finance and sales teams. 
 Respond appropriately and efficiently to all product enquiries, nurturing client relationships, and identifying client’s needs. Directing general enquiries to the appropriate audience if not immediately resolved. 
 Site administrator for subscription management tool (e.g., modify customer records as needed) 
 Manages sales offers and content slices for access control, provides internal support for financial reporting (e.g., pay per view and access), and IT where required. 
 May take direction from the other managers in the Business Group and support the highly collaborative and teamwork approach in the group. 
 Supports the network of sales agents by providing usage reports, distributing sales materials, and setting up and monitoring trials. 
 Other tasks or projects as required. 
 What you'll bring : 
 Relevant education and/or equivalent professional experience in customer support, sales operations, publishing, or related field. 
 Demonstrated experience working in a customer-focused or service-oriented environment, with a strong commitment to providing responsive and high-quality support. 
 Proactive and solutions-oriented, with the ability to anticipate challenges, evaluate options, and independently resolve issues by leveraging available tools, systems, and resources. 
 Experience supporting external partners such as vendors, agents, or resellers is considered an asset. 
 Strong technical skills, including experience working with business software and tools such as spreadsheets, document management systems, and email platforms. 
 Experience working with databases or customer relationship management (CRM) systems, including the ability to interpret and work with data to identify patterns and support decision-making. 
 Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally and respectfully with diverse stakeholders and provide service with tact, discretion, and cultural awareness. 
 Ability to work both independently and collaboratively, with sound judgment to determine when issues should be escalated. 
 Ability to communicate in both French and English is considered an asset but is not required. 
 Why join us? 
 Looking for a career where you can make an impact? At CSP, we are a mission-driven organization where every team member plays a vital role in shaping the future of scientific publishing. Our team fosters collaboration, provides training and resources, and supports programs that recognize contributions to the research community. 
 When you join CSP, you’ll enjoy: 
 Fully remote work (within Canada) with a flexible work environment 
 Employer-sponsored health benefits and generous leave allowance 
 Wellness and office equipment subsidies 
 Ongoing learning and development opportunities 
 A small team where your work makes a real impact 
 CSP’s commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion is embedded in our work, teams, and interactions with all people. We recognize that varied perspectives and backgrounds generate richer ideas and solutions. For these reasons, CSP is an equal opportunity employer. 
 The anticipated salary range for this position is CAD $60,000 – $70,000, but the actual starting salary will be determined based on the successful candidate’s skills and abilities . 
 Please submit your resume to people@cdnsciencepub.com if you require accommodation throughout any part of the recruitment process and we will work with you to meet your needs. 
 Please apply by October 21, 2026. 
 Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment 
 Canadian Science Publishing uses artificial intelligence (AI) as one of the tools in our recruitment process to assist with reviewing and assessing applications. AI-generated information, including Profile Relevancy scores, may be used to help prioritize applications for review. Profile Relevancy scores are one factor considered during the recruitment process and do not determine whether a candidate is qualified, selected for screening, or advanced in the recruitment process. Every hiring decision is made by a member of the CSP team based on the qualifications, experience, and overall suitability of candidates for the position.

Description
 This role is the driving AWS database go-to-market across EMEA, owning the strategy and execution that helps our customers optimise their existing database estate and modernise it to be ready for AI and agentic workloads. Data is the context layer that turns generic AI into personalised, differentiated customer experiences; every AI conversation is a data conversation, and this role sits at the centre of it. You will drive the migration of on-premises SQL Server and Oracle estates to AWS managed databases, position AWS's purpose-built database portfolio, and ensure our customers' data foundations are cloud-native, resilient, and AI-ready. You will work on some of EMEAs largest customers and largest deals, partnering closely with our migrations and account teams and partners to land complex, multi-year outcomes. You will also be the voice of EMEA back to the service team, carrying the needs of EMEA customers to our database service teams to help reshape our service and roadmap strategy.
Key job responsibilities
 GTM strategy and execution for AWS Database across EMEA, messaging, positioning, and campaigns for the EMEA areas, with customers from all segments.
 Serve as the EMEA point of contact for all database motions, the connective tissue between Sales Specialists, Specialist SAs, Partner teams, and the area sales teams carrying database quota.
 Win large migrations to AWS, migrate on-premises commercial database estates to AWS managed, purpose-built databases, getting customers ready for AI and agentic workloads.
 Lead engagement on EMEA's largest and most strategic deals, partnering with migrations, commercial/deal, and partner teams to accelerate and close complex, multi-year opportunities.
 Design Scale Sales Motions that drive adoption beyond the top tier, leveraging AWS Field teams, partner channels, and funding levers to unblock deals.
 Be the voice of EMEA to the database service teams, feed customer needs, adoption signals, and competitive gaps back to product leadership to reshape service and roadmap strategy.
 Engage at CxO/VP level and with developers and architects to build pipeline, secure lighthouse customers, and drive revenue across 15+ AWS database services.
 Plan and host database events, workshops, and executive briefings for customers and partners.
A day in the life
You are the person the field, partners, and customers come to for anything database in EMEA. One day you're in a CxO briefing making the case to migrate a legacy Oracle estate to Aurora ahead of an AI initiative; the next you're enabling an area sales team on a large migration, unblocking a stalled deal with the right partner funding lever, or feeding EMEA customer signal back to the service team to shape the roadmap. You operate across the EMEA areas and every segment, building the strategy and executing it, measuring success by the collective growth of the EMEA database business.
 About The Team
 The WWSO Data team helps customers adopt our newest and most advantageous technologies. We are technology specialists. This role works as an integrated unit with account teams, Specialist Sellers & SAs, and partner teams to drive database adoption across EMEA. We believe in a collaborative working model where BD, Sales Specialists, and Specialist SAs operate in concert each bringing unique strengths to deliver customer outcomes. We value individuals who are not only strong strategists but also effective communicators who can bridge the gap between local market needs and global organisational priorities. If you thrive where you build the strategy AND execute it, where you influence across organisational boundaries, and where you measure success by the collective growth of the team, this is the role for you.
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
 Basic Qualifications
 Experience in developing, negotiating and executing business agreements
 Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
 Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
 7+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
 5+ years of relational database technology (such as Redshift, Oracle, MySQL or MS SQL) experience
 Experience with database migration and modernisation motions (e.g. migrating commercial databases such as SQL Server and Oracle to cloud-native / managed database services).
 Experience working with large enterprise customers and complex, strategic deals, including collaborating with migration, commercial/deal, and partner teams.
 Preferred Qualifications
 Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
 Experience identifying, negotiating, and executing complex legal agreements
 Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
 Experience owning end-to-end GTM strategy for a technology domain across multiple geographies and segments.
 Track record of building rapport with customer executives (CxO/VP) and closing strategic, multi-year deals.
 Experience positioning data foundations for AI/ML and agentic workloads (e.g. data readiness, modernisation, purpose-built databases as the context layer for AI).
 Strong data-based storytelling skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with both executives and developers.
 Cloud expertise as demonstrated by one or more cloud certifications.

description:

title: Senior Sales Operations Specialist
description:
Critical role as the touchpoint collaborating between sales, operations and customers across the order to cash lifecycle in a high-end retail organization. This role is not about processing, it is about process improvement, improving efficiencies, liaising with the team and the business as well as customers to ensure a successful process. This company has a fantastic entrepreneurial culture that is truly genuine, and passionate about what they do. They are going through exciting growth; and this role can only evolve and grow for the right person with the right attributes. Ideal is a critical thinking, problem solver that has a strength in building relationships would enjoy coaching others and have an aptitude for numbers!
 Who – The Company: 
Our client is a growing, entrepreneurial, high end retail brand. With 90 employees now and poised for growth, this is an exciting time to get into a growing brand still in its infancy. They take pride in being a team of creative, collaborative, and highly dynamic people who love what they do, and strongly believe that their diverse team of motivated individuals makes the company strong and successful.
 What – The Role: 
This position provides critical ongoing daily support for our growing operations team. As the Senior Sales Specialist, you are the main point of contact between sales and all other internal and external customers by validating pricing, checking the status of orders, and communicating any issues immediately to all stakeholders. You will process a high volume of sales orders, order acknowledgments, and customer invoices. Most importantly, you will provide strategic guidance to the Operations team to streamline sales, order management, and fulfillment workflows, driving efficiency and best practices across the order-to-cash lifecycle.
This role is not about processing, it is about process improvement, collaborating with teams, thinking critically to problem solve and improve efficiencies and processes for the business and team.  Swim can share a more detailed description with interested candidates.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret sales, inventory, and profitability data and translate findings into clear recommendations.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data, systems, or process changes to both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Commercial Operations Coordinator
description:
Are you looking for a career in an inspiring, global environment where your expertise makes a difference? At Neste, you will be working for the world’s leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel. 
 We are looking for you,
 Commercial Operations Coordinator
 to join our Hoofddorp Commercial Operations team in Renewable Products focusing on EMEA sales operations. (office relocation to Rotterdam city center in 2027)
You will join the dynamic Hoofddorp Operations team responsible for independent and proactive coordination of day-to-day commercial planning, implementation, and optimization of the commercial-, service- and terminal contracts in the domestic and international oil and renewable business. In the area of renewable business your responsibilities include bio-criteria management for our products.
You will work closely with a wide internal and external stakeholder network. Our Hoofddorp team is responsible for sales operations from our terminals in the ARA region to European customers. We also work in close cooperation with regional and global operations teams. Together with you and your expertise, we can make an impact today and keep our promises for tomorrow.
 Reasons to join
 We operate in an inspiring and evolving business environment as a global leader in renewable fuels. We contribute to Neste’s success by living our values every day: we care, we have courage, we cooperate.
We prioritize safety at all times and in every location. We strive to create a positive and impactful work environment.
Transformation brings new possibilities and fosters our courage and curiosity. As a global company, we support personal development with versatile learning and career opportunities. Collaboration is key, and we believe in flexible, smart ways of working. We work at the office at least three days a week to ensure seamless teamwork and a sense of belonging.
 More about the job 
Carrying out operations in renewable products sales in compliance with Neste principles and processes.
Day-to-day management of logistics, individual operations, transactions, contract execution, reconciliation, sustainability tasks and/or inventory monitoring
Driving optimal contract performance and problem solving
Early involvement in deal, offer and contract preparation with internal and external stakeholders
Participating in delivery and/or inventory planning
Managing and handling the biocriteria, database entries and proof of sustainability documentation for our renewable products
Timely and accurate data entries for all contracts and inventory
Primary contact for external and internal counterparties
Efficient cooperation with Sales, Supply, SCM, Land Logistics, Chartering and other relevant stakeholders
 Keys to success in this role / The best combination to succeed in this role
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant area, e.g. from business, technology, logistics, sustainability 
Experience in international commodity business, operations, shipping, inventory, logistics and/or various modes of transport
Experience and knowledge of operations workflow and efficient ways of carrying out operations
Ability to work under pressure, cope with sudden changes, hectic and demanding work environment which requires flexibility in working hours and adapting to the operational needs
Possibility to be on stand-by and work if needed during weekends 
Good and proactive communication and collaboration skills
Accuracy and attention to details
Performance and result driven mindset with the ability to make quick decisions
Fluency in written and oral English
 Other strengths we value 
Previous knowledge of ERP-systems (e.g. SAP, DistX), reporting (e.g. Power BI) and/or data mining tools (e.g. Celonis)
Fluency in other languages is considered a plus
Experience of working with customers
Continual improvement mindset
Good sense of humor and a smiling attitude, it’s allowed to have fun at work!
 Let’s get you started
 We look forward to receiving your CV and application by 30th October 2026.
 If you have any questions regarding the process or the position, please get in touch with Debbie Veldmeijer, Talent Acquisition Specialist a.i. on debbie.veldmeijer@partners.neste.com
To ensure security and confidentiality, please submit your application through our recruitment system, as we are unable to consider applications sent via email.
We will do our best to contact you within 2 weeks after the application time has ended. The recruitment process will include interviews and a potential aptitude assessment. 
Depending on the location and the requirements of the position, the process may include a health examination (with a drug test) and/or a security clearance.
 Neste in brief
 Neste (NESTE, Nasdaq Helsinki) is the world's leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), with production on three continents. Neste’s strategy focuses on growth in renewable fuels. The company’s renewables production capacity is expected to reach 6.8 million tons annually in 2027. The company has a network of nearly 1,000 fuel stations with expanding service offering, such as EV charging, in Finland and in the Baltics. title: Head of Customer Success
description:
About Wrisk
At Wrisk, we are rewriting the rules of insurance to make it simple, transparent, and seamless. Working alongside leading global brands, OEMs, and insurers, our modern MGA platform delivers flexible, customer-centric insurance products directly into the digital journeys that matter most. We combine cutting-edge tech with human expertise to ensure our customers and brand partners experience world-class service at every touchpoint. 
The Role at a Glance 
As the Head of Customer Success, you will act as the executive champion for our customer proposition both internally and externally to ensure exceptional customer experience and the continuous improvement of the customer proposition. You will also drive the overarching operational strategy, governance, and service delivery across Wrisk’s UK MGA Customer Care function (~35 FTE).
Leading strategically through the Customer Care Operations Manager and operational management team, you will bridge executive commercial goals with operational execution, steward the evolution of our omni-channel customer support solutions roadmap, and embed FCA Consumer Duty standards to ensure friction-free, high-quality customer outcomes. 
While primarily leading our UK customer operations, you will also serve as a subject matter advisor to our European operations, helping shape and guide outsourced customer success models in line with Wrisk’s overarching service standards.
Requirements
What You’ll Do
 Drive Strategy & Partner Interface: Champion the customer proposition across all broking functions, ensuring customer-centricity is front and centre of company strategy. Interface directly with brand, insurer, and claims partners on customer-related matters to ensure service delivery reflects and maintains brand standards
 Support Regulatory Compliance & Governance: Help embed FCA Consumer Duty outcomes across all servicing channels to ensure good customer outcomes and prevent foreseeable harm. Partner with Risk and Compliance team to design and execute robust remediation plans and customer redress schemes where breaches occur, taking full accountability for audit outcomes
 Guide Operational Direction & Data Insights: Provide high-level leadership and direction to the customer operations function, steering department performance. Translate data-driven insights and customer sentiment trends, including Root Cause Analysis (RCA), into actionable, continuous business improvements
 Steward Tech & Future Proofing: Steward the future proofing of our customer care operations by formulating and deploying a solutions development roadmap in concert with the Platform, Product, Insurance and Tech Ops teams. Identify opportunities to introduce smart workflows, digital self-service solutions, and next-generation communication tools to reduce friction and enhance customer satisfaction 
 International Best Practice & Advisory Oversight: Act as a strategic advisor for Wrisk’s European outsourced customer servicing models; share operational playbooks, quality benchmarks, and continuous improvement frameworks to ensure brand alignment and consistent customer outcomes across international partners.
About You
 Industry Experience: Minimum 5 years in senior customer operations leadership within the UK general insurance market (MGA or broker MVI experience highly preferred)
 Regulated Leadership: Proven track record of leading a regulated operations customer service function, with experience managing customer service provision to high-value affinity relationships or corporate partnerships
 Partner & Supplier Collaboration: Experience working alongside insurers and third-party suppliers to deliver customer operational excellence. Some experience collaborating with or providing advisory guidance to third-party BPOs or outsourced European customer servicing partners is highly desirable.
 Transformation & Workflow Solutions: Demonstrated experience delivering workflow solutions that optimise the combination of digital technology and human intervention
 Education & Qualifications: Degree preferred; professional insurance qualifications, such as Diploma (DipCII) or Advanced Diploma (ACII) from the Chartered Insurance Institute, are highly desirable.
Benefits
What We Offer (Our Value Proposition)
At Wrisk, we believe exceptional customer operations thrive in an environment built on trust, clear ownership, and pragmatic execution. Joining as Head of Customer Success for our UK MGA entity means stepping into a pivotal role where your operational leadership directly shapes our customer ecosystem, regulatory governance, and partner SLA delivery as we continue to scale.

description:
About IonQ: 
 IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .
Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. 
 Location: Remote, US
 Travel: 30% 
Job ID: 1899
 The Role: 
IonQ is developing the world's most powerful full-stack quantum computer based on trapped-ion technology. We are pushing past the limits of classical physics and current supercomputing technology to unlock a new era of computing. Quantum computing has the potential to impact every area of human society for the better. IonQ's computers will soon redefine industries like medicine, materials science, finance, artificial intelligence, machine learning, cryptography, and more. IonQ is at the forefront of this technological revolution.
We are looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager, Quantum Adoption & Technical Enablement to join a dynamic, cross-functional team dedicated to driving IonQ's mission of delivering exceptional experiences for our customers. In this role, you will be IonQ's primary customer-facing technical expert, going hands-on with customers to drive real adoption of our trapped-ion quantum computers. You will bridge deep platform and quantum-algorithm expertise with customer empathy, guiding organizations through performance optimization, circuit design, and workflow integration as they build on IonQ's platform.
As a trusted technical advisor, this position offers a high-visibility opportunity to influence and inspire highly technical internal and external stakeholders, ensuring they have the best possible experience on our platform. Scientific expertise and hands-on credibility, combined with exceptional communication skills, are essential for success in this role.
 Responsibilities :
 Technical Onboarding & Platform Mastery: Facilitate adoption for major accounts by translating contract terms into technical provisioning, leading onboarding sessions, and managing day-to-day technical engagement operations.
 Performance Optimization & Circuit Design: Leverage expertise in optimization, machine learning, and chemistry/materials simulation to guide customers on best practices for designing quantum circuits, applications, and workflows, in close collaboration with quantum compiler and system experts.
 Technical Support & Blocker Removal: Standardize troubleshooting workflows for job failures, establish Customer Success team best practices, and provide direct, high-touch technical support to remove barriers to adoption.
 Curriculum & Enablement Content: Expand IonQ's user base by identifying real-world challenges for industry customers and creating workshops, challenges, and curricula, including code, circuits, slides, and videos, that empower them to learn and apply quantum computing.
 Product Advocacy: Act as the primary internal advocate for user perspective across Product, Cloud Platform, Data Engineering, and Ops, on topics ranging from specific UI/UX design to high-level platform architecture.
 Data-Driven Customer Health: Design and maintain dashboards tracking job metrics, system usage, and overall customer health, and leverage usage data to provide actionable technical intelligence to internal teams.
 External Technical Representation: Represent IonQ on standards bodies, government committees, quantum working groups, industry panels, and other relevant forums, leading technical sessions and workshops at industry conferences.
 Cross-Functional Technical Alignment: Collaborate with Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales, and Engineering teams to provide technical customer insights on product functionality, documentation, and educational materials, and refine term-sheet language to align customer expectations with technical capabilities.
 Requirements: 
Master's or PhD in Physics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Operations Research, or a related STEM field.
5+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles or equivalent, with a proven track record of performance and goal achievement.
3+ years of experience creating customer-facing technical content such as training material, success plans, playbooks, and workflows.
Hands-on experience with Python and quantum frameworks such as Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane, CUDA-Q, or other quantum computing SDKs.
Working knowledge of Jupyter Notebook, Google Colab, or similar platforms.
Strong understanding of key physics concepts and mathematical techniques relevant to quantum computing, including linear algebra and probability.
Exceptional technical and executive presentation skills, with the ability to influence and inspire audiences ranging from researchers and end-users to C-suite executives, all with varying levels of quantum knowledge.
Proven ability to teach complex topics to diverse audiences, tailoring curricula to customer needs, including large lectures, smaller study sessions, and one-on-one mentoring.
 Preferred Qualifications:
In-depth knowledge of the strengths and weaknesses of various quantum computing hardware platforms, with a solid understanding of quantum hardware-software dependencies.
Demonstrated experience in quantum information science, applications, and algorithms.
Experience with SaaS platforms, REST APIs, and/or HPC systems.
Proficiency in SQL; experience in data science or data analytics.
Familiarity with subscription-based and renewal business models.
Ability to engage in technical and business discussions with professionals across diverse domains, including finance, pharmaceuticals/healthcare, chemistry, computer vision, and operations research.
This position can have periods of occasional travel to customer sites and conferences, with evening/off-hours meetings as needed to support global customers.

title: Director, Preconstruction and Sales Operations
description:
Polar Racking Inc. is a North American leader in the design, engineering and manufacturing of PV mounting systems. We are at the forefront of PV innovation, leading the industry in cutting-edge design with a focus on continuous innovation, with a vision to deliver the highest value to our clients at the lowest cost per kWh. Our diversified portfolio of rooftop and ground mount products for the residential, commercial, and utility scale markets, coupled with our unique suite of engineering collaboration tools, technical services, and installation support, allows us to deliver turnkey solutions that are modular, lighter, and quicker to install. We support our North American clients from our locations in North America.
The Director, Preconstruction & Sales Operations leads the work that turns qualified sales opportunities into commercially sound, technically coordinated, and execution-ready projects. The role owns the preconstruction process, including estimating, proposal development, pricing governance, risk review, and the handoff from Sales to Operations.
This is a hands-on leadership position for someone with experience in technical sales and project operations. You will align customer commitments with engineering requirements, supplier capacity, installation needs, and project schedules, while developing the team and processes needed to support growth.
**Responsibilities::** 
**Preconstruction leadership:** 
* Lead projects from opportunity qualification through bid submission, contract award, and formal handoff to the delivery team.
* Establish bid/no-bid criteria and project review gates based on profitability, customer requirements, technical feasibility, capacity, and commercial risk.
* Coordinate preliminary layouts, design inputs, foundation assumptions, site information, quantities, and installation requirements with Engineering and Operations.
* Develop preconstruction schedules and identify long-lead materials, supplier constraints, site risks, and required customer decisions before commitments are made.
* Evaluate alternatives that improve cost, constructability, schedule, or customer value, with technical validation by the responsible engineering team.
**Estimating and commercial management:** 
* Lead the estimating function and set standards for takeoffs, cost models, supplier quotations, contingencies, and documented pricing assumptions.:
* Review material, foundation, installation, freight, duty, currency, and other project costs with the appropriate functional leaders.
* Oversee proposals so that scope, exclusions, deliverables, payment milestones, warranties, and schedule assumptions are clear and consistent.
* Recommend pricing and negotiate commercial terms within delegated authority; escalate margin exceptions and material contractual risks to leadership and legal counsel as appropriate.
* Maintain cost benchmarks and compare bid assumptions with actual project outcomes to improve future estimates.
**Sales operations and customer support:** 
* Set consistent processes for opportunity qualification, proposal requests, quote turnaround, approvals, and customer follow-up.
* Maintain CRM discipline and provide reliable reporting on pipeline, forecast bookings, bid status, conversion, and expected project start dates.
* Partner with Sales and Business Development on strategic pursuits, technical presentations, and negotiations with developers, EPC contractors, and other customers.
* Align proposal workloads and expected awards with Engineering, Supply Chain, and Operations capacity.
* Resolve technical and commercial questions during the sales cycle and ensure customer commitments are documented and achievable.
**Operational readiness and project handoff:** 
* Coordinate procurement plans, supplier lead times, delivery sequencing, and preliminary installation schedules before project release.
* Lead structured handoff meetings supported by approved scope, budgets, drawings, assumptions, commitments, risk registers, and key milestones.
* Confirm that unresolved design inputs, scope gaps, and customer dependencies have assigned owners and resolution dates.
* Support Operations during early execution and significant scope changes; incorporate lessons learned into future bids and processes.
**People leadership and process improvement:** 
* Build and coach the preconstruction, estimating, and sales operations team; set responsibilities, workload priorities, and performance expectations.
* Introduce practical templates, dashboards, and approval workflows that improve accuracy and reduce avoidable rework.
* Promote respectful communication, accountability, and timely decisions across departments.
**Qualifications:** 
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in engineering, construction management, business, or a related discipline; an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience will be considered.
* Typically 10 or more years of progressive experience in preconstruction, estimating, technical sales, project management, or operations within solar, renewable energy, construction, structural systems, or engineered products.
* At least 5 years of people leadership experience, with responsibility for team performance, budgets, and cross-functional delivery.
* Demonstrated experience connecting technical sales with project execution, including bids, pricing, contract negotiations, and project handoffs.
* Strong understanding of project costing, gross margin, commercial risk, procurement, logistics, construction scheduling, and change management.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, bills of materials, and scope documents and work effectively with engineering specialists.
* Experience with CRM and ERP systems, advanced Excel analysis, and project scheduling or reporting tools.
* Strong negotiation, presentation, decision-making, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage several concurrent pursuits.
* Ability to travel to customer, supplier, and project locations in Canada and the United States, as required by the role.
* Experience with solar racking, trackers, steel fabrication, foundation systems, or EPC project delivery.
* Knowledge of Canadian and US construction markets, cross-border supply chains, and international sourcing.
* Experience building or scaling an estimating or preconstruction department.
* PMP, relevant estimating credentials, or P.Eng. licensure would be an asset. P.Eng. is not required for this commercial and operational leadership role; professional engineering approvals remain with appropriately licensed professionals.
Why Polar Racking?
Join our team and become part of a dynamic company at the forefront of the renewable energy sector. In addition to competitive compensation, we offer a comprehensive benefits package including RRSP contributions, generous vacation time, and the opportunity for career growth.
As a valued member of our team, you'll also enjoy collaborative, fun work environment where innovation and teamwork are celebrated. If you're passionate about making a positive impact in the world while working with a supportive team, we invite you to apply and embark on an exciting journey with us.
We value an innovative, diverse workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

location: City Of London, England, United Kingdom
description:
If you are a current Jazz employee please apply via the Internal Career site.
 Jazz Pharmaceuticals is a global biopharma company whose purpose is to innovate to transform the lives of patients and their families. We are dedicated to developing life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases — often with limited or no therapeutic options. We have a diverse portfolio of marketed medicines, including leading therapies for sleep disorders and epilepsy, and a growing portfolio of cancer treatments. Our patient-focused and science-driven approach powers pioneering research and development advancements across our robust pipeline of innovative therapeutics in oncology and neuroscience. Jazz is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland with research and development laboratories, manufacturing facilities and employees in multiple countries committed to serving patients worldwide. Please visit www.jazzpharmaceuticals.com for more information.
 Brief Description
 The Director, Business Strategy & Operations (BS&O) – GCDO serves as the strategic business partner and Chief of Staff to the Head of Global Clinical Development Operations and the GCDO Leadership Team (LT). Reporting to the Head of R&D Business Strategy & Operations, this role drives strategic alignment, operational cadence, workforce planning, and continuous improvement across the global clinical development operations organization.
The Director oversees multi-year workforce and resource planning, acts as the functional data steward for capacity models and budget cycles, coordinates business development due diligence and integration, and partners with the Communications team to ensure unified, transparent organizational messaging.
 Essential Functions
 Chief of Staff & Operational Governance 
Serve as trusted advisor and Chief of Staff to the Head of GCDO and the GCDO LT. 
Lead the operational rhythm of GCDO: establish agendas, facilitate LT meetings and strategic offsites, track action items, and drive execution. 
Partner with the R&D Chief of Staff to align GCDO priorities and governance with enterprise R&D strategy and portfolio milestones. Supports preparation for Quarterly Performance Meeting (QPM) and Board of Director Meetings. 
Represent GCDO in key R&D operational committees and cross-functional forums. 
 Workforce Planning & Resource Data Stewardship 
Lead proactive, multi-year workforce planning across GCDO in partnership with Finance, HR, and Resource Management. 
Serve as functional Data Steward for resource planning, overseeing named allocation tools, algorithm-based demand models, and timecard coding adherence to ensure data integrity. 
Translate clinical study pipeline requirements into robust FTE and contract resourcing forecasts to secure functional headcount and budget during annual and Long-Range Planning (LRP) cycles. 
 Financial Stewardship & Budget Management 
Partner with R&D Finance and GCDO budget holders to build, track, and optimize the functional operating budget (OpEx and headcount). 
Drive the financial operating cadence across monthly accruals, quarterly forecasting, variance reporting, and annual budget builds. 
 Business Due Diligence & Functional Integration 
Serve as the clinical operations lead on business development (BD), licensing, and M&A evaluations, assessing operational viability, trial delivery models, risks, and resource impacts. 
Lead post-transaction functional integration for acquired or partnered clinical assets, ensuring seamless onboarding, process alignment, and operational continuity. 
 Goal Setting, Performance & Process Improvement 
Lead GCDO annual goal-setting (OKRs/KPIs), cascading R&D priorities into actionable functional metrics and executive dashboards. 
Lead and implement targeted process improvement initiatives across GCDO and R&D interfaces, streamlining trial delivery workflows, eliminating bottlenecks, and updating operating standards. 
Apply structured change management methodologies to ensure sustainable adoption of process improvements across global teams. 
 Functional Communications & Culture 
Partner closely with the Communications team to design and execute GCDO communications, including Town Halls, All-Hands forums, and leadership announcements. 
Drive organizational health and engagement initiatives that reinforce accountability, trust, and clinical operational excellence. 
Foster a cohesive, forward-looking organizational culture that bridges project management rigor with data science and AI innovation, reinforcing transparency, accountability, and collaboration. 
 Required Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
 Key Competencies
Executive Presence & Influence: Skilled at navigating organizational complexity, building consensus, and influencing without direct authority. 
Operational & Analytical Acumen: Adept at translating clinical pipeline demands into rigorous capacity models, budgets, and actionable operational plans. 
Strategic Problem-Solving: Ability to drive root-cause problem solving and lead impactful continuous improvement initiatives. 
Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills; experienced in partnering with Communications to engage large, dispersed organizations.
 Experience
Extensive progressive experience in the biopharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry, with substantive exposure to drug development, portfolio/project management, data science/informatics, or R&D business operations.
Experience operating in a strategic business operations, Chief of Staff, or PMO leadership capacity partnering directly with executive leaders (VP/SVP level).
Direct experience leading workforce planning, capacity modeling oversight, named resource allocations, and timecard compliance.
Demonstrated track record managing departmental budgets, financial forecasting, and variance tracking in collaboration with Finance.
Experience participating in business development due diligence and leading post-deal functional integrations or external platform onboardings.
Executive Presence & Strategic Partnership: High emotional intelligence with a proven ability to advise and influence senior functional executives (VP/SVP level) across diverse technical, analytical, and operational disciplines. 
High-Stakes Communication: Exceptional ability to synthesize complex project management narratives, data science strategies, and operational data into polished, compelling executive- and board-level presentations. 
Operational & Analytical Acumen: Strong capability to interpret complex resource models, algorithm demand outputs, and financial analyses to formulate actionable business strategies. 
Financial & Resource Stewardship: Demonstrated financial acumen managing multi-million-dollar functional operating budgets (OpEx, vendor contracts, software licensing) and multi-year workforce plans. 
Cross-Functional Orchestration: Proven track record in orchestrating multi-faceted initiatives across matrixed global teams, balancing competing priorities across distinct functional domains. 
Continuous Improvement & Innovation: Deep experience in process optimization, change management frameworks, and the practical application of digital and AI tools to enhance operational efficiency. 
 Required/Preferred Education And Licenses
Bachelor’s degree in a Life Sciences discipline (Biology, Chemistry, Pharmacology, Neurobiology, Oncology, etc.) or related business/scientific field required. 
Advanced degree (MS, PhD, or MBA) strongly preferred. 
Lean Six Sigma, Agile, or Project Management (PMP) certification is a plus. 
 Jazz Pharmaceuticals is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any characteristic protected by law.
 FOR US BASED CANDIDATES ONLY

Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors, including qualifications, skills, relevant experience, job knowledge, and other pertinent factors. The goal is to ensure fair and competitive compensation aligned with the candidate's expertise and contributions, within the established pay framework and our Total Compensation philosophy. Internal equity considerations will also influence individual base pay decisions. This range will be reviewed on a regular basis.
At Jazz, your base pay is only one part of your total compensation package. The successful candidate may also be eligible for a discretionary annual cash bonus or incentive compensation (depending on the role), in accordance with the terms of the Company's Global Cash Bonus Plan or Incentive Compensation Plan, as well as discretionary equity grants in accordance with Jazz's Long Term Equity Incentive Plan.
